title: Project Manager – EHT Power Infrastructure ((400 KV Substation)
description:
**Who We Are**




**Princeton Digital Group (PDG)** 
 is a leading developer and operator of AI and cloud hyperscale data centers in Asia Pacific. Headquartered in Singapore, PDG has a presence across high\-growth markets in the region including Singapore, Japan, India, Indonesia, China, Malaysia, South Korea, and Australia
 



  





 PDG is backed by some of the world’s most reputed blue\-chip investors \-
 **Warburg Pincus,** 
 a leading global private equity firm with a successful history of creating world\-class technology, media, and telecommunications (TMT) and real estate platforms;
 **Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan** 
 (OTPP), Canada's largest single profession pension plan;
 **Mubadala Investment Company** 
 , a sovereign investor that manages a diverse global portfolio for the Government of Abu Dhabi and
 **Stonepeak** 
 , a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets globally.
 



  





**Why Join PDG?** 



* **Impact at Scale** 
 : Be part of a company that’s enabling digital transformation of economies.
* **Career Growth Without Borders** 
 : With operations across Asia Pacific and a fast\-growing footprint, your next opportunity could be anywhere.
* **Culture That Empowers** 
 : We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where every voice is heard and every contribution matters.
* **Commitment to Excellence** 
 : From governance to workplace safety, we hold ourselves to the highest standards because our people deserve nothing less.



  





 PDG empowers individuals in every role to grow, lead, and leave a lasting impact.
 



  





 Join us to build the digital future of Asia.
 



  





 For more information, visit our website www.princetondg.com or follow us on LinkedIn.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Project Manager will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of Extra High Tension (EHT) power infrastructure projects, including 220kV and 400kV substations, transmission systems, grid interconnections, and utility coordination. The individual shall lead project execution from concept, design, procurement, construction, testing \& commissioning through energization and handover.
 



  





 This role requires a seasoned professional with extensive experience in managing utility\-scale EHT infrastructure projects and strong stakeholder engagement with utilities, EPC contractors, OEMs, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
 



  





**Mandatory Experience Requirements** 



* Minimum 15 years of experience in power transmission, substations, and EHT infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large\-scale utility\-connected projects from inception to commissioning.
* Must have successfully executed and commissioned at least one 400kV Substation project in a Project Manager or Lead Project role.
* Project Delivery
* Lead complete lifecycle execution of 220kV/400kV substations and associated transmission infrastructure.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, safety, quality, and stakeholder expectations.
* Develop project execution strategies and risk mitigation plans.
* Review and manage engineering deliverables, including: SLDs, Protection schemes, SCADA/SAS
* architecture, Earthing and lightning protection systems, Relay coordination studies of
* GIS/AIS layouts.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Execution of multiple 220kV/400kV substations.
* Experience with 400kV GIS/AIS substations.
* Experience with utility interfaces such as PGCIL, MSETCL, TANGEDCO/TANTRANSCO, GETCO,
* KPTCL, APTRANSCO, etc.
* Experience in EHV cable systems, LILO schemes, grid connectivity projects, and switching stations.
* Experience supporting hyperscale data centers, industrial parks, renewable energy projects, or large infrastructure developments.
* Monitor manufacturing progress, FAT, SAT, and vendor performance.
* Lead energization activities and final handover.
* Stakeholder Management
* Act as the primary interface with utilities, consultants, EPC contractors, OEMs, and senior management.
* Provide regular project updates, risk assessments, and executive reports.



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* 400kV GIS/AIS Substations
* 220kV/400kV Transmission Systems
* Power Transformers \& Reactors
* Protection \& Control Systems
* SCADA/SAS
* EHV Cables
* Grid Connectivity \& Utility Approvals
* Earthing \& Lightning Protection
* Power Quality Systems
* Project Controls \& Risk Management.



  





**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering.

title: Project Manager Construction. Iconic Residential Interior Works.
description:
**Iconic homes. Demanding work. Opportunity in Mumbai.** 




  





 Amarilla builds exceptional custom homes across the world. These are not standard projects. They are detailed, complex, and technically demanding homes that require discipline, organization, precision, and people who care deeply about the work.
 



  





 We combine traditional construction discipline with advanced tools, including BIM and Digital Twin workflows, to deliver homes finished to an uncompromising standard.
 



  





 We are looking for a Project Manager to own field execution and drive the construction process on site every day.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 You will be Amarilla’s presence on site. You will coordinate contractors, subcontractors, vendors, inspections, materials, logistics, and field activity through the critical phases of construction.
 



  





 You will work closely with our Construction Manager and BIM/Digital Twin engineers to keep the work on scope, on schedule, and on budget, while holding every trade accountable to Amarilla’s standard.
 



  





 This role is for someone disciplined, practical, detail\-obsessed, and comfortable carrying real responsibility on site.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  




* Run daily site operations and coordinate contractors and subcontractors across construction phases
* Drive the field execution process, making sure work is planned, sequenced, verified, and completed correctly
* Monitor schedule and budget, identifying risks early and escalating issues before they grow
* Inspect and verify subcontractor work for quality, completeness, and timeliness
* Prepare and submit payment requests for approval
* Communicate scope deviations, field conflicts, and contractual issues to the Project Partner
* Coordinate inspections and ensure compliance with local, state, federal, and OSHA requirements
* Maintain accurate daily logs, progress reports, and field documentation
* Manage materials, equipment, and logistics so the right resources arrive at the right time
* Uphold Amarilla’s 5S site standard and hold every subcontractor accountable for a clean, organized job site



  





**Required** 




  




* Experience in complex custom residential construction
* Degree in architecture, construction management, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on construction experience
* Strong ability to read and understand construction drawings, shop drawings, and specifications
* Proven discipline, organization, and attention to detail
* Strong ownership mindset and commitment to high execution standards
* Ability to communicate clearly and coordinate multiple teams on site



  





**A Plus** 




  




* Experience with BIM or Digital Twin workflows
* Confidence managing demanding schedules, field pressure, and multiple trades
* Ability to maintain urgency and composure in a fast\-moving environment



  





**About Amarilla** 




  





 What we build is who we are.
 



 Our work requires initiative, excellence, care, innovation, and strategic thinking. We are looking for people who take pride in the details, respect the craft of construction, and want to be part of a team that holds the work to a higher standard.
 



  





 If that sounds like you, we would like to meet you.
 



  





 More about us: www.amarilla.in

title: Life Cycle Manager
description:
**Summary**
 Location: Mumbai, India
   

  

 Ready to lead complex product life cycle projects that directly impact patients around the world? As a Life Cycle Manager, you will act as the ESO project lead for technical, manufacturing, and engineering initiatives across the life cycle of a product, including launches, transfers, changes, divestments, due diligence activities, and other strategic projects. You will bring together global and local stakeholders, lead cross\-functional teams, and drive the successful execution of product strategies while balancing service levels, inventory, compliance, and cost objectives. Working across a highly interconnected global network, you will play a key role in ensuring seamless product transfers to contract manufacturing organizations and delivering operational excellence throughout the product life cycle.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technical transfer projects from initial planning through delivery and formal closure.
* Create project charters, detailed action plans, timelines, milestones, and governance structures.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams across Manufacturing Science and Technology, Quality, Artwork, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and external partners.
* Act as the main point of contact between Novartis teams and contract manufacturing organizations.
* Track project activities, dependencies, milestones, risks, and deviations against agreed timelines.
* Resolve project obstacles and escalate critical issues promptly to protect timelines and product supply.
* Organize regular governance meetings and provide clear project updates to teams, stakeholders, and sponsors.
* Develop submission, implementation, and change\-control strategies with relevant regulatory, planning, and quality stakeholders.
* Coordinate inventory and contingency stock planning to prevent supply disruptions during transfers and product changes.
* Ensure projects meet agreed strategies, regulatory requirements, quality standards, budgets, and operational objectives.


**Essential Requirements**
* Degree in Pharmacy or a related pharmaceutical discipline.
* 10 to 15 years of experience working with solid oral dosage forms.
* 7 to 10 years of project management experience involving technology transfers and cross\-functional project delivery.
* Technical understanding of tablet formulation, manufacturing processes, and product requirements.
* Working knowledge of registration requirements across Europe and Rest of World markets.
* Ability to develop Gantt charts and manage complex projects, timelines, risks, and escalations.
* Professional English, with strong communication, collaboration, and results\-oriented problem\-solving skills.

title: Construction Manager - Pharma/Food
description:
The Resident Construction Manager will be responsible for managing and coordinating all mechanical construction activities at the pharmaceutical project site. The role requires strong experience in 
 **pharma project execution, mechanical installation, utility systems, contractor management, commissioning, and coordination with engineering, QA/QC, EHS, and project teams** 
 .
 



  





 The incumbent will act as the key site representative for mechanical construction and ensure that the project is executed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with approved engineering documents, GMP requirements, specifications, and quality standards.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





  





 1\. Construction Management
 



  




* Manage day\-to\-day mechanical construction activities at the project site.
* Supervise installation of mechanical equipment, piping, utility systems, HVAC, and related systems.
* Ensure construction activities are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project schedules.
* Monitor progress against the baseline schedule and identify potential delays.
* Coordinate with contractors and subcontractors to ensure timely completion of work.
* Resolve site\-related technical and construction issues.



  





  





 2\. Pharmaceutical/Food Utilities \& Mechanical Systems
 



 Experience/knowledge in installation and execution of systems such as:
 


* HVAC and cleanroom systems
* Chilled water and cooling water systems
* Process and utility piping
* Compressed air
* Steam and clean steam systems
* Boiler and utility system
* ETP/STP and other utility equipment
* Pumps, tanks, vessels, heat exchangers, and other mechanical equipment



 3\. Project Coordination
 


* Coordinate closely with Civil, Electrical, Instrumentation, HVAC, Automation, QA/QC, Validation, EHS, and Engineering teams.
* Participate in project review meetings and provide construction status updates.
* Coordinate with design consultants, EPC contractors, vendors, and client representatives.
* Review technical queries, RFIs, change requests, and site modifications.



  





  





 4\. Safety \& EHS
 



  




* Ensure all construction activities comply with site EHS requirements.
* Conduct/participate in toolbox talks, safety inspections, and permit\-to\-work activities.
* Ensure contractors follow approved safety procedures.
* Identify and mitigate construction\-related risks.
* Stop unsafe work when necessary and ensure corrective actions are implemented.



  





  





 5\. Planning \& Progress Monitoring
 


* Develop and monitor detailed mechanical construction schedules.

title: Senior Mechanical Commissioning Engineer - Data Center
description:
At FPC Global, our people are our greatest asset. We’re a fast\-growing, global consultancy where collaboration, innovation, and ambition come together to deliver exceptional outcomes across the full facility lifecycle.
   

  





 Founded in 2014 by our CEO, Dean Francis, we’ve grown into a team of 140\+ professionals working across the Americas, EMEA, APAC, and our London headquarters. We partner with clients to deliver integrated, future\-focused consultancy services—setting new benchmarks for sustainability, technology, and performance.
   

  





 We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. That’s why we foster a culture where voices are heard, initiative is encouraged, and careers are built with purpose.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We’re thrilled to announce that, due to recent project wins, we have several exciting roles opening up across our team, all of which are available to start immediately
   

  





 We’re specifically interested in hearing from candidates with
 **strong data center experience** 
 , so if this is your area of expertise, we’d love to connect.
   

  





 If you’re ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  





 The Role:
   

  





 The CX Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the planning, execution, and management of commissioning activities for mission\-critical
 **mechanical systems** 
 within hyperscale data center environments. This role ensures that all mechanical and thermal infrastructure is installed, tested, integrated, and handed over in full compliance with project requirements, safety standards, and operational objectives, supporting high\-availability and energy\-efficient operations.
   

  





 The responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  





**Commissioning Management**



* Lead and manage the end\-to\-end commissioning process for mechanical systems, from pre\-functional testing through integrated systems testing (IST) and final handover.
* Ensure commissioning activities are executed in accordance with approved commissioning plans, project schedules and quality standards.
* Coordinate phased and systems\-based commissioning strategies typical of hyperscale delivery model



**Mechanical Systems Testing \& Validation**




 Commission and validate critical mechanical infrastructure, including but not limited to:
   

  




* Chilled water systems (chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers)
* Airside systems (CRAC/PAHUs, AHUs, FWUs)
* Direct\-to\-chip, liquid cooling, or hybrid cooling systems (where applicable)
* HVAC distribution systems (ductwork, piping, valves, dampers)
* Fuel oil and lube oil systems supporting standby generation
* Make\-up water, water treatment, and blowdown systems
* Verify system performance under normal, abnormal, and failure conditions.
* Validate thermal performance, capacity, control response, and efficiency against design intent and client requirements.



**Project Coordination \& Oversight**



* Plan, coordinate and lead mechanical commissioning activities in collaboration with design engineers, construction teams, vendors, controls specialists and operations stakeholders.
* Act as the primary technical authority for mechanical commissioning issues on site.
* Support construction readiness, system turnover and commissioning sequencing in fast\-track hyperscale environments.



**Mechanical \& Controls Integration**



* Ensure seamless integration of mechanical systems with:
   

  




	+ Electrical power systems
	+ Controls, BMS, and EPMS
	+ Fire/life safety systems
	+ IT load and white\-space requirements
* Validate system redundancy (N, N\+1, 2N), fault tolerance, and maintainability to support mission\-critical operations.
* Lead functional performance testing and integrated systems testing involving mechanical failure scenarios.



**Documentation \& Reporting**




 Develop and manage commissioning documentation, including:
   

  




* Commissioning plans and schedules
* Mechanical test procedures and functional performance scripts
* Method statements and risk assessments
* Final commissioning reports, as\-built records and handover documentation
* Provide clear, accurate progress, risk and readiness reports to project and client stakeholders.



**Standards \& Compliance**



* Ensure all mechanical systems and commissioning activities comply with applicable codes, standards and best practices, including:
   

  




	+ ASHRAE (including TC 9\.9\)
	+ CIBSE, SMACNA, IPC
	+ IEC, ISO, and local authority requirements
	+ Uptime Institute Tier Standards
	+ TIA\-942 and client\-specific hyperscale standards
* Support third\-party audits, peer reviews and certifications where required.



**Factory \& Site Acceptance Testing (FAT \& SAT)**



* Plan, coordinate and lead FAT and SAT activities for mechanical equipment and packaged systems.
* Review vendor submittals, test data and corrective actions to ensure equipment readiness for site installation and integration.
* Witness performance testing of major plant (chillers, PAHUs, cooling towers, packaged plant).



**Risk Management \& Troubleshooting**



* Identify technical, schedule, operational and safety risks related to mechanical commissioning.
* Implement mitigation strategies and lead root\-cause analysis and troubleshooting to resolve issues efficiently.
* Support rapid issue resolution in live or partially energized data hall environments.



**Health, Safety \& Environmental Compliance**



* Demonstrate a strong understanding of mechanical and process safety, particularly when working with:
   

  




	+ Pressurized systems
	+ Rotating equipment
	+ Chemical treatment systems
	+ Live data center environments
* Ensure all commissioning activities comply with health and safety regulations, permit\-to\-work systems, confined space requirements and lock\-out/tag\-out (LOTO) procedures.
* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all commissioning activities.



**Leadership \& Team Development**



* Lead and support contractors, and subcontractors.
* Provide technical guidance, training and oversight to ensure consistent commissioning quality and hyperscale delivery standards.
* Interface effectively with client operations teams to ensure a smooth transition to steady\-state operations.



**Continuous Improvement**



* Adhere to company policies, procedures and quality management systems.
* Capture lessons learned and promote continuous improvement in commissioning methodologies, energy performance and reliability outcomes across hyperscale data center projects.


**Qualifications**

 The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in mechanical commissioning within mission\-critical environments, combined with strong leadership, analytical capability, and a disciplined approach to safety, quality, and compliance.
   

  





**Technical Experience \& Expertise**



* Proven track record in commissioning critical mechanical systems within data centers or other mission\-critical facilities, including:
   

  




	+ Chilled water plants (chillers, primary/secondary pumps, heat exchangers)
	+ Cooling towers and adiabatic systems
	+ CRAH / CRAC units, PAHUs, FWUs
	+ Air distribution systems (ductwork, dampers, VAVs)
	+ Hydronic distribution systems (piping, valves, strainers, balancing devices)
	+ Fuel oil and lube oil systems supporting standby generators
	+ Make\-up water, water treatment and water reuse systems
* Strong understanding of data center cooling architectures, including:
   

  




	+ Air\-cooled and water\-cooled systems
	+ N, N\+1, and 2N redundancy concepts
	+ Containment strategies (hot aisle / cold aisle)
	+ Liquid cooling and hybrid cooling systems (desirable)
* Demonstrated experience validating mechanical system performance under normal, abnormal, and failure scenarios, including loss\-of\-power and failover events.
* Solid knowledge of
 **c** 
 ontrols and automation systems, including:
   

  




	+ BMS
	+ Plant controls and sequencing
	+ Integration with EPMS and IT load signals
* Proven experience developing Functional Performance Test (FPT) and Integrated Systems Test (IST) scripts and leading on\-site teams to successfully execute tests in live data center environments.
* Working knowledge of commissioning Life Safety and critical interfaces, including:
   

  




	+ Fire alarm system interfaces with HVAC
	+ Smoke control and purge systems
	+ Emergency shutdown and equipment interlocks
* Demonstrated ability to review mechanical designs, calculations and specifications from a commissionability, operability, and maintainabilit
 **y** 
 perspective.



**Tools, Software \& Digital Competence**



* Proficiency with mechanical and building services design tools such as AutoCAD (MEP coordination experience preferred).
* Familiarity with BIM platforms (Revit, Navisworks) for coordination, clash detection and commissioning readiness.
* Experience using project management tools such as MS Project or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with commissioning and construction management platforms such as CxAlloy, Procore, Compass, or similar systems.
* Working knowledge of data analytics, trend logs, and performance data for system validation and reporting.
* Exposure to cloud\-based client platforms (Google, Microsoft, Amazon) is advantageous.



**Project Delivery \& Operational Experience**



* Demonstrated experience managing mechanical commissioning activities across schedule and resource constraints.
* Proven capability to conduct technical audits and operational readiness assessments of existing facilities, including:
   

  




	+ Installed equipment verification
	+ System performance evaluation
	+ Compliance with design intent and operational standards
* Experience delivering projects across the full data center lifecycle—from design review and construction support through commissioning, integrated testing, and operational handover—is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with hyperscale delivery models and phased handover strategies is an advantage.



**Leadership, Communication \& Problem Solving**



* Strong leadership, organisational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to guide multi\-disciplinary teams, contractors and vendors.
* Effective communicator, capable of interfacing confidently with clients, operators, project stakeholders and technical teams.
* Highly developed analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify, assess and resolve complex mechanical and controls\-related issues efficiently and safely.



**Essential Qualifications**



* B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (B.E. or equivalent).
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in testing and commissioning of mechanical systems in mission\-critical or large\-scale commercial facilities.
* Minimum 5 years of commissioning experience within the data center industry, including demonstrable leadership of Integrated Systems Testing (IST).
* Strong working knowledge of relevant standards, including ASHRAE (TC 9\.9\), CIBSE, SMACNA, Uptime Institute Tier Standards, and TIA\-942\.



 Based in
 **Mumbai, India** 
 , or willing to relocate to Mumbai.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**FPC Employee Benefits:**




 We offer a competitive salary and benefits package tailored to your role, with additional performance\-based rewards. Our benefits include:
   

  




* Family Health Insurance
* Flexible Holidays
* Competitive Salaries and Discretionary Annual Bonus Scheme
* Professional development opportunities



**Why Join FPC?**




 At FPC, we’re not just a company—we’re a thriving community where innovation flourishes, ideas are celebrated, and careers are shaped. When you join us, you become part of a dynamic team that:
   

  




* **Shapes the Future:** 
 Work on groundbreaking projects that are redefining industries with sustainability, cutting\-edge technology, and bold ambition.
* **Supports Your Growth:** 
 From leadership training to cross\-functional collaboration, we prioritize your professional development and empower you to explore new ideas, take initiative, and grow in your career.
* **Values Balance and Inclusion:** 
 We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard—while maintaining a strong commitment to work\-life balance.
* **Creates Impact:** 
 Contribute to the delivery of iconic, high\-performance buildings and innovative solutions that have a lasting, positive impact on the world.



**Together, we’ll build tomorrow’s digital planet—and you’ll be part of something truly extraordinary.**

title: Assistant Manager, Agentic Search
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next\-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created agentic AI role within our HQ Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation org, and will be based in our India office.
   

  

 As the Agentic Search \- Assistant Manager, you will be a key part of General Mills’ Marketing Activation and Operations team, helping translate real\-time data signals into prioritized actions that improve the visibility, accuracy and representation of our brands in leading AI systems. This role will sit at the intersection of data and insight generation, with a focus on interpreting regular outputs from LLM (large language model) optimization partners and converting those outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for the broader AEO (answer engine optimization) team. You will regularly receive and analyze data from third\-party vendors, identify what the results mean for content, help inform optimization decisions, map the phasing of recommended actions, and coordinate implementation with cross\-functional partners. In addition, you will be directly responsible for hiring, mentoring, and coaching another Agentic AI Analyst, who will be reporting to you. As a thought leader, you will be building cross\-functional relationships, and working across marketing, content, and operations teams to bring in key insights that are actionable and help us show up in the agentic results.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a highly curious, detail\-oriented analyst who enjoys working through complex datasets, finding the story in the data, and helping teams move from insight to action.
   

  

 Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day\-to\-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.\-based functional partners and managers.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Data Analysis \& Performance Diagnostics: Analyze large, nuanced datasets from LLM optimization platforms to diagnose what is working, what is not, and where search visibility can be improved.
* Market \& Competitor Trend Tracking: Maintain a proactive external view of relevant digital topics, retailer landscapes, and competitor movements to surface emerging generative search trends for internal teams.
* Strategic Planning \& Prioritization: Translate complex, rapidly evolving AI engine outputs into prioritized, phased optimization plans that focus resources on the highest\-value business opportunities.
* Cross\-Functional Implementation: Coordinate closely with cross\-functional partners to support the accurate, timely execution of approved optimization initiatives.
* Stakeholder Reporting \& Capability Building: Track optimization outcomes, maintain organized reporting, and surface risks and follow\-up opportunities to stakeholders while documenting learnings to refine the team's analytical approach over time.
* Global Operating Model Support: Enable a consistent, scalable way of working between U.S.\- and India\-based teams through proactive communication, strong organization, and clear documentation.
* Pillar Leadership: Build a high performing Agentic Analysis team in GIC, as an extension on the US Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation team. This involves both building the team, being responsible for deliverables – learning, context and acumen, and building capabilities/tools that may be required for the pillar.
* Influence and Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate and provide leadership in meetings, influence decision making by proactively reaching out to stakeholders, ensuring timelines are met, meetings are productive and priorities are met timely.
* Mentor and coach the associate in India on best practices and remove roadblocks if any, with support from your manager
* Facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the larger Agentic Search team
* Stay current on industry trends and consumer behavior insights, applying knowledge to refine and inform AI search optimization strategies.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field, with an MBA in Marketing / International Business.
* 4–6 years of experience in SEO, organic search, content optimization or digital marketing, with 2\+ years in AI Marketing Agents, AI Search Optimization, AEO, GEO or LLM\-based search.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, semantic/entity optimization, structured data, content strategy and AI\-powered search platforms.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini/Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity and concepts such as LLMs, RAG and AI citations.
* Strong analytical, communication, project management and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to generate actionable insights to optimize brand strategy execution.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel, Navigating Tableau dashboards, R/SQL a plus


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush/Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
* Strong understanding of search relevance, ranking, personalization, and evaluation metrics.
* Data\-driven approach to experimentation, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to translate business needs into scalable search solutions and product roadmaps.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and cross\-functional leadership skills.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Finance Transformation Manager
description:
**Finance Transformation Manager
   

  

 Location: Mumbai**
* Do you have a background in Finance transformation, systems change and project delivery?
* Do you want to own Finance systems and change end\-to\-end in a fast\-scaling embedded payments business?
* Do you want the opportunity to shape how a modern Finance function runs across systems, controls and processes?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 You will lead, govern and deliver Finance transformation, systems change and operational improvement across Modulr's Finance function. You will ensure Finance has scalable, controlled and well\-documented processes, effective systems, clear ownership and robust project governance, working across Financial Control, FP\&A, Finance Operations, Product, Technology, People, Legal, Risk, Compliance, external advisers and system vendors. The role reports into the Director of Financial Control and supports the CFO and wider Finance leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibility**
**Lead Finance transformation and continuous improvement**
* Lead Finance transformation initiatives across Financial Control, FP\&A, Finance Operations, Payroll, Billing and Treasury.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate and strengthen Finance processes, facilitating workshops to move from current to future state.
* Develop workplans and implementation approaches that are practical, controlled and capable of being adopted by the relevant teams.


**Own NetSuite and Finance systems change**
* Act as the Finance\-side owner for NetSuite change requirements, enhancements and adoption \- scoping, prioritising, testing and coordinating changes.
* Manage Finance requirements for approvals, cost centres, entities, country packs, billing logic, reporting, integration and data integrity.
* Coordinate UAT, release planning, defect tracking and Finance sign\-off, working with Coefficient, Oracle and Technology teams to resolve issues.
* Support decisions on licenses, add\-ons, system capability and renewals, ensuring NetSuite remains a reliable source of truth, alongside tools such as Web expenses and TravelPerk.


**Govern the Finance project portfolio**
* Maintain a structured view of Finance initiatives, priorities, owners, dependencies and status.
* Create and maintain RAID logs, action trackers and decision logs, giving visibility of delivery risks, blockers and decision points.
* Support prioritisation with Finance leadership and prepare concise updates for finance leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Deliver projects end\-to\-end**
* Apply a structured, control\-led project framework from discovery and problem definition through scope, planning and governance.
* Lead solution design workshops and translate Finance requirements into clear specifications for Technology, vendors and implementation partners.
* Coordinate UAT, testing and validation, then go\-live readiness, change readiness and controlled handover into BAU.
* Run post\-implementation reviews to confirm benefits, capture lessons learned and close residual risks.


**Support new entity, jurisdiction and regulatory change**
* Lead or support Finance readiness for new entities and jurisdictional expansion \- payroll, bank accounts, NetSuite setup, tax, transfer pricing and regulatory reporting.
* Liaise with external advisers including KPMG, Deloitte and other specialists, and support tax, regulatory and compliance evidence gathering.
* Ensure Finance impacts are identified, tracked and delivered in a controlled way, with handover to BAU once stable.


**Manage vendors, advisers and third parties**
* Manage day\-to\-day Finance engagement with key vendors and external advisers, coordinating requests, requirements, actions and escalations.
* Challenge unclear scope, costs, delays or outputs, keeping vendor activity aligned to Finance timelines, priorities and controls.
* Support commercial awareness around licences, implementation costs, support arrangements and renewals.


**Embed controls, auditability and risk management**
* Embed control considerations into Finance change from the design stage \- approvals, evidence, segregation of duties, documentation and audit trails.
* Identify operational, financial, regulatory and data risks, and maintain risk and issue logs with owners, mitigations and escalation routes.
* Support audit evidence gathering and walkthroughs for areas impacted by Finance change.


**Lead stakeholders and build capability**
* Build strong relationships across Finance, Product, Technology, People, Legal, Risk, Compliance and external partners, communicating complex issues in a concise, decision\-focused way.
* Support senior leaders with updates, analysis, options, risks and recommendations, and facilitate alignment where ownership spans functions.
* Provide coaching and practical support to Finance colleagues, create training materials and system guidance, and promote consistent project, documentation and risk disciplines.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Confident using AI tools to draft documentation, analyse information, map processes and improve productivity.
* Proven experience delivering Finance change, transformation and systems projects end\-to\-end \- ideally involving an ERP such as NetSuite \- from discovery through to post\-implementation.
* Strong project management discipline across scope, planning, RAID governance, UAT, handover and benefits realisation.
* Solid Finance process knowledge across R2R, P2P, and O2C with a strong controls, audit and documentation mindset.
* Excellent stakeholder management \- able to translate Finance needs for technical, operational and vendor teams and communicate concisely to senior leaders.


**Desirable**
* Experience of new entity or multi\-jurisdiction setup and working with external advisers (e.g. KPMG, Deloitte, tax and payroll providers).
* Experience in a regulated financial services or fintech environment.


**What We Offer You**
* Share Options – We offer a Company Share Option Plan (CSOP), giving you the opportunity to benefit from any increase in share value in the event of a sale, merger, or flotation.
* Bonus – Our annual discretionary bonus, paid in May for the previous year, is based on both company and individual performance.
* Insurance Coverage – Comprehensive medical, life, and accident insurance provided to support you and your family's wellbeing.
* Holidays \& Leave – A generous annual leave allowance, your birthday off, and menstrual leave for female employees, with the flexibility to choose days to suit your personal schedule.
* Learning \& Development – Our onboarding programme, ModStart, equips you for success. Learning doesn't stop there; we'll continue to support your development through various channels and opportunities.
* Mental Health, Wellbeing \& Inclusion – Access to accredited therapists, coaches, counsellors, management training, and mindfulness sessions with company\-funded hours and flexible top\-up options.
* Company\-Wide Events – Participate in collaborative and engaging events with colleagues across the business.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we’re committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where everyone feels they belong and can bring their whole self to work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds as we believe it’s the right thing for our people, our business, and the community we operate in.

description:

title: Principal Engineer/Sr. Principal Engineer - CQV
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 Design Manager\-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end\-to\-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets.
   

  

 The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk\-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C\&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of \>15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C\&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

* Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments.
* Manage multi\-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors.
* Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality \& regulatory teams.
* Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Drive decision\-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client.
* Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle.
* Review P\&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation.
* Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff.
* Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies.
* Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Prepare C\&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA\+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.

 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Director, Head RCO India
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 This role will lead the India clinical operations teams and is responsible for execution excellence in operational planning, implementation, trial management, site management and monitoring of clinical trials (registrational, non registrational / Investigator Sponsored Research (ISR)) conducted within India. This leadership role will serve as a member of the RCO APAC Senior Leadership Team and be part of the RCO and GDO extended leadership teams. This role will also serve as a member of the local affiliate leadership team (as applicable) managed by the General Manager, as well as other affiliate senior leadership committees. This role will interact with the development teams, local medical and key BMS stakeholders in order to ensure effective management of India conducted clinical trials. This role will support a GDO Quality culture collaborating with both the GDO Global Clinical Compliance team as well as the GQ Clinical Trial and Safety group.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Major Duties**
* Executes clinical trials, as per the India Book of Work. Ensures timely studystart\-up and that target subject recruitment numbers and database lock timelines are met.
* Proactively evaluates clinical trial feasibility and site selection by collaborating with the BI\&A team to evaluate current metrics and data.
* Endorses country and site feasibility targets for India.
* Manages the India team’s workload and support of multiple studies. Provides continuous assessment of resource needs and anticipates and initiates actions in response to multiple/changing demands and priorities.
* Takes a broad business perspective when making decisions. Makes judgements to ensure work is achieved within target timelines. Exercises sound judgement in areas of clinical trial management, resource allocation (headcount and budget targets) and recruitment activities.
* Builds and maintains a highly performing team of highly qualified, India based, research professionals and the respective line managers.
* Managing the hiring, development, coaching, mentoring, performance management and succession planning of staff.
* Ensures effective utilization of FSP resources in the execution of clinical trials conducted in the India.
* Meeting or exceeding project deliverables and initiatives with the highest quality through alignment with senior leaders and key stakeholders through flexible and fluid resourcing.
* Develop, maintain and maximize strong working relationships with peers, senior leaders, key stakeholders and external institutions/networks to influence decisions and achieve optimal results focused on our patients.
* Drive alignment across development programs promoting knowledge sharing, operational issue resolution through close collaboration with key stakeholders.

* Significant experience in the planning, conduct and management of clinical programs (Phase I\-IV).

* Previous experience leading, managing, coaching and developing direct reports.
* In depth understanding of GCP, ICH Guidelines and other local guidance, regulation and codes of practice related to Clinical Research and Medical Affairs.

We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.
 



  





**Divisional Overview:** 




 The Strategic, Analytics, and Business Re\-engineering (SABRE) division houses the Digital Tool Innovation (DTI) team, which serves as Nomura's centre of excellence for technological innovation and digital transformation. DTI is responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and implementing cutting edge digital solutions that drive operational efficiency and strategic advantage across the organization. DTI specializes in creating scalable Python\-based applications, Alteryx workflows, Power BI dashboards, and automation frameworks that address complex business challenges across 1,500\+ operations users. The team works at the intersection of technology and finance, transforming traditional processes through digital means and enabling data\-driven decision making. Our projects span from process automation and workflow optimization to sophisticated data processing pipelines and interactive dashboards that provide critical insights to stakeholders. The division collaborates closely with business units across Nomura to identify opportunities for digital enhancement, develop tailored solutions, and provide ongoing support for implemented tools. DTI professionals combine technical expertise with business acumen to deliver solutions that tangibly impact the firm's operational excellence and strategic capabilities. With a growing portfolio of successful implementations—including 150\+ Alteryx workflows, 300\+ Power BI dashboards, and numerous Python applications—the DTI team is positioned as a key enabler of Nomura's digital future.
 



  





**Business Overview:** 




 The DTI team manages a comprehensive portfolio of digital solutions spanning SSG, CSG, MO, and IWM, serving 1,500\+ operations users globally. The VP, Digital Tooling Initiatives leads the DTI book of work (200\+ JIRAs), manages the team, and owns critical programs including Japan DTI integration, new EUC framework implementation, and the Control Uplift Program. This role provides strategic leadership for DTI portfolio management, JIRA governance, regional integration. The position requires deep technical expertise in Alteryx, Power BI, and Python to guide team members and ensure technical excellence across all DTI solutions.
 



  





**What We Offer:** 




 • We support employee wellbeing by ensuring a sense of purpose and belonging.
 



 • We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
 



 • Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family's holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.
 



  





**Position Specifications:** 



* Corporate Title: Vice President
* Functional Title: VP, Digital Tooling Initiatives
* Experience: 12\-15 years (including 5\+ years in digital transformation and 3\+ years in leadership roles
* Qualification: B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent; MBA preferred



  





**Role \& Responsibilities:** 




  





**DTI Portfolio Management:** 




 • Own and manage the complete DTI book of work across all four business units (SSG, CSG, MO, IWM) • Manage 200\+ JIRAs spanning S1\-S8 stages with clear prioritization and sequencing • Ensure greater OVS (Operations Value Scorecard) adherence through disciplined benefit tracking and documentation • Send regular portfolio updates to business unit sponsors and senior stakeholders • Conduct governance calls to review progress, risks, and dependencies across the portfolio • Drive timely escalations of risks, blockers, and resource constraints • Maintain portfolio health metrics including velocity, cycle time, and value delivery
 



  





**Program Leadership:** 




 • Lead Japan DTI integration, ensuring seamless adoption of global DTI frameworks and solutions • Own implementation of new EUC (End User Computing) framework across the organization • Run the Control Uplift Program to enhance governance, documentation, and compliance across DTI solutions • Coordinate cross\-regional initiatives spanning AEJ, EMEA, and Americas • Manage vendor partnerships and external resource coordination for program delivery • Track program milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
 



  





**Team Management \& Development:** 




 • Manage the DTI team, providing leadership, mentorship, and career development • Foster a high\-performing culture focused on quality, innovation, and collaboration • Conduct regular 1\-on\-1s, performance reviews, and development planning • Build team capabilities in Python, Alteryx, Power BI, and emerging digital tools • Manage workload distribution, capacity planning, and resource allocation • Ensure team wellbeing, engagement, and retention • Recruit, onboard, and integrate new team members
 



  





**Technical Leadership:** 




 • Provide technical expertise and guidance in Alteryx, Power BI, and Python to junior team members • Review technical designs and code to ensure quality, maintainability, and best practices • Set technical standards and frameworks for DTI solution development • Drive technical innovation and adoption of new tools and methodologies • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and provide hands\-on support when needed • Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate relevance to DTI portfolio
 



  





**DTI BAU Solutions Management:** 




 • Manage day\-to\-day operations of DTI BAU (Business As Usual) solutions serving 1,500\+ users • Ensure service continuity, uptime, and performance of production DTI tools • Coordinate issue resolution, user support escalations, and maintenance activities • Manage solution refresh cycles, upgrades, and enhancements • Monitor usage, performance, and user feedback to drive continuous improvement • Ensure proper documentation and knowledge transfer for all BAU solutions
 



  





**Governance \& Compliance:** 




 • Ensure JIRA governance standards are met across all DTI initiatives • Drive EUC registration, documentation, and recertification processes • Participate in broader DTI developments and strategic planning initiatives • Coordinate with Risk \& Control teams on compliance requirements • Maintain audit\-ready records for all DTI solutions and processes • Implement quality gates and controls throughout the development lifecycle
 



  





**Agile Implementation:** 




 • Participate in Scrum methodology implementation with 4\-week sprint cadence • Lead sprint planning, retrospectives, and refinement sessions • Manage JIRA workflows including dedicated QC/QA gates • Drive value\-driven prioritization and WSJF\-based decision making • Implement explicit buffer/expedite lanes for critical business asks • Foster continuous improvement culture through Agile practices
 



  





**Stakeholder Engagement:** 




 • Build and maintain strong relationships with business unit sponsors across all divisions • Communicate portfolio status, risks, and achievements to senior leadership • Gather requirements and translate business needs into technical specifications • Manage stakeholder expectations and negotiate priorities across competing demands • Facilitate workshops, demos, and training sessions for DTI solutions • Drive user adoption and change management for new tools and capabilities.
 



  





**Mind Set:**

**Desired:**

**What work you will be responsible for:**
 The Senior Consultant, Legal Administration Services position performs various assigned tasks related to client engagements. The Senior Consultant communicates with team members, vendors, and clients, and performs various project management and data analysis functions. As the Senior Consultant assumes and demonstrates the ability to perform greater levels of responsibility, work assignments of increasing difficulty and complexity are assigned. **Responsibilities:**

* Develop a strong understanding of project requirements to provide accurate, consistent, and context\-driven responses to claimants.
* Collaborate closely with Project Managers and team members to stay updated on project developments and ensure accurate communication with stakeholders.
* Support project planning and documentation by gathering requirements and maintaining clear, structured records.
* Maintain and organize documentation, including procedures, findings, and claimant correspondence.
* Adhere to quality control standards, confidentiality requirements, and firm protocols in all deliverables.
* Perform timely self\-reviews of work to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality.
* Contribute to the development and updates of SOPs, checklists, and process documentation as processes evolve.
* Support team initiatives, including digital content development and process improvement efforts.
* Identify and appropriately escalate issues or risks, while proactively seeking guidance when required.
* Demonstrate ownership of assigned tasks, ensuring completion within timelines, budget expectations, and quality standards.
* Track and record time accurately across projects in compliance with firm requirements.
* Build proficiency in firm tools, systems, and training materials, and demonstrate adaptability in a fast\-paced environment.


**Other Responsibilities:**
* Able to periodically work overtime and weekends to meet project or client needs.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* Post graduate / Bachelor’s degree in fields related to Business, Legal, Information Systems and Decision Sciences, Data/Computer Science, Marketing/Communications, or an approved related field is required.


**Preferred / Desired Skills:**
* 3\+ years of experience in consulting/advisory (Legal Administration) or relevant experience in legal administration, claims administration, or project management.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to quickly understand new concepts, workflows, and systems, with a strong learning mindset.
* Excellent analytical and critical\-thinking skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment, including handling repetitive tasks with consistency and focus.
* Proactive, positive, and solution\-oriented attitude with a high level of professionalism and integrity.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and continuously evolving environment while maintaining a high degree of organization.
* Strong understanding of confidentiality requirements and commitment to maintaining data integrity.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook); advanced proficiency preferred.
* Experience in updating and maintaining SOPs, process documents, and operational workflows is an advantage.
* Project Management Institute’s (PMI) Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or related credential is preferred.


 We strongly believe in a supportive work environment where all our colleagues can succeed. EisnerAmper India is proud to be an Equal Opportunity merit\-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste \& religion, disabilities, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper:**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 4500 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
   

  

 Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper India:**
 EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
   

  

 EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 800 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

title: Commissioning Project Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning APJC
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS Infrastructure is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles to power the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure.  

  

This role offers a structured development path within the Commissioning organization:  

* Comprehensive onboarding and training on AWS commissioning processes and management systems
* Mentorship from DCCD Cx team members
* Exposure to diverse project types across AWS's global data center portfolio including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems
* Clear progression pathway: advance to Business Analyst / Program Coordinator (program management track) or Commissioning Engineer (technical track)

  

In this role, you will provide project management support to the commissioning engineers. You will provide support on both administrative and process tasks including vendor onboarding and procurement coordination and commissioning workflow management. You will be given opportunities to work alongside experienced commissioning professionals and will analyze commissioning workflow data to identify bottlenecks, recommend process improvements to enable smooth execution of data center construction projects across AWS’s infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, take ownership of their work, demonstrate passion for process improvement and show eagerness to learn and be curious in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The key responsibility of a Project Engineer is to develop a detailed understanding of AWS critical infrastructure. You will learn the fundamentals related to managing a commissioning project within AWS. As part of this process you will work with different team members who will introduce you to the internal project management tools. You will then progress to the on the job phase where you will participate in the on\-site commissioning activities. During the phase of you will support the Lead Commissioning Engineers with managing a project from beginning to end.  

  

* Manage the creation of projects within internal Amazon systems.
* Manage the financial and vendor management related task of the commissioning process.
* Support the Request for Quote process, ensuring all relevant documentation is available for the commissioning vendors to provide a detailed quote.
* Provide administrative support to commissioning engineers in managing commissioning workflows and processes
* Organize and maintain commissioning documentation
* Gather feedback from commissioning engineers and stakeholders to improve workflows and processes by identifying and implementing workflows improvements

  

About the team  

Join the commissioning team, a critical function within AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery that ensures technical excellence and operational readiness across our global data center construction portfolio. Our team provides oversight and coordination of multi\-discipline commissioning activities related to pre\-commissioning, startup, and acceptance testing of Amazon critical infrastructure construction projects.  

  

As part of the Data Center Commissioning Team, you will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centers within the APJC region and globally. The AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning team (DCCD Cx) understands, evaluates, defines, and manages the expectations of construction and equipment quality in accordance with engineering designs to meet customer requirements and ensure systems perform as designed.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise in data center commissioning and startup coordination within one of the world's most innovative technology companies. You'll receive mentorship from industry\-leading commissioning professionals, gain exposure to technology leading critical infrastructure systems, and contribute to projects that shape the future of cloud computing infrastructure.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Master's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems
* Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sr. Project Manager
description:
**About Snipp**

  

Snipp Interactive is a global provider of promotions and loyalty technology, helping brands turn transactions into relationships. Our platform supports receipt\-based promotions, consumer rebates, and enterprise loyalty solutions \- trusted by leading CPG, retail, and B2B companies worldwide.

 **The Opportunity**

  

Snipp is seeking a sharp, adaptable Senior Project Manager to join our growing team. Snipp is a global loyalty and promotions technology company. We run receipt\-validated promotions, rebates, loyalty programs, digital offers, and sweepstakes for many of the world's largest CPG, QSR, retail, and beverage brands and their agencies. You'll own delivery on a portfolio of programs inside accounts we already serve, from sales handoff through launch, reporting, and wrap.

  

You'll manage the delivery of rebate, promotion, and sweepstakes programs from sales handoff through launch and reporting, working closely with clients, internal teams, and distributed development teams. You'll act as the liaison between Clients, Sales, and Engineering, Creative, and Legal, owning scope, timelines, budget, risk, and communication across each program. You'll report to the Team Lead, Project Management, and join a distributed PM team working across North America, Europe, and India. **What****you'll****do****:**

  

* Own intake and scoping from sales handoff. Turn the signed contract into requirements, milestones, owners, and a delivery plan.
* Configure and validate program setup on the Snipp platform: promotion and game mechanics, receipt processing and validation rules, offer and reward logic, and client reporting.
* Own the legal and compliance path on every program: official rules, prize structure and fulfillment, privacy and data handling, and client legal review.
* Own QA and UAT. Test each program in staging and production before and after launch, run client UAT, log and chase defects.
* Surface risk early. Flag slipping dates, stalled dependencies, and clients who have gone quiet before they turn into escalations, and bring a mitigation option with the cost and effort attached.
* Manage scope and change requests. Assess impact, quantify cost and effort, and secure written client approval before work starts.
* Manage multiple concurrent client programs, own deadlines, and communicate priorities clearly to clients and developers across time zones.
* Escalate and help resolve participant\-facing issues that require tier\-1 support.
* Coordinate reward fulfillment, prize vendors, and agency partners, and hold them to the dates they commit to build a deep understanding of each client's brand standards, internal approval workflows, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain accurate program tracking and reporting for both clients and internal stakeholders.
* Be creative and excited to learn new concepts. This is an evolving field and requires an adaptable and curious mind to excel.
### **Requirements**

**What****we're****looking for:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in project management, digital/marketing operations, marketing technology or a client\-facing agency role.
* + Master's degree preferred.
* 5 to 7 years of project or program management experience, with at least 2 of those years running client\-facing programs in promotions, loyalty, shopper marketing, marketing technology, or a digital agency. Direct experience working alongside developers is required.
* Business\-fluent spoken and written English required. Candidates must be able to communicate clearly and effectively with enterprise clients and distributed teams across North America and Europe.
* Excellent client service skills with diplomatic written and verbal communication. You'll be writing directly to enterprise brand and agency stakeholders.
* Solid understanding of the full program lifecycle, from intake and requirements through QA, launch, and reporting, including the ability to scope requirements and configure platform features yourself.
* Comfort with technical concepts, the confidence to ask engineering the right questions, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear, client\-friendly language.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams) and Zoho CRM and Zoho Projects, or directly comparable CRM and project management tooling. Working familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus for reviewing creative assets, not a requirement.Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills; experience with modern PM tooling a plus.
* Proven ability to juggle multiple concurrent, quick\-turn projects with shifting priorities.
* Flexible schedule; comfortable working with distributed, international teams across time zones, including occasional early calls with our European and Indian teams.
* Exposure to promotions and sweepstakes compliance (official rules, prize fulfillment, US and Canadian regulations) is a strong plus.
* PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 or CSM is a plus, not a requirement.
 **Location:**

  

* Remote within India. Snipp is distributed nationally and internationally, so most communication happens electronically.

This role supports North American and European clients and delivery teams. Plan on a shift with meaningful overlap into the window, including client calls in the evening.  
* 

**Compensation:**

  

* The typical hiring range for this role is ₹24–36L annually. Base pay will be determined based on role\-related skills, knowledge, and experience.

 As a
 **Team Lead – Medium Voltage** 
 you will be responsible to lead a team of application/electrical engineers engaged in the engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) Motor Control Center (MCCs), Switchgear and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), customizing as per customer requirement utilizing the AutoCAD tools, while providing engineering support to the manufacturing plants of RA. **Your Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor and develop a team of MV application/electrical engineers – allocating and prioritizing work, managing workload and ensuring on\-time delivery, high quality engineering and customer satisfaction
* Manage day\-to\-day execution of CTO/ETO projects within defined timelines, ensuring high quality engineering while leveraging standard and reusable engineering practices
* Serve as the technical escalation point and subject\-matter expert for MV products (MV MCCs, MV Switchgear, MV Drives), providing robust technical solutions, addressing queries and resolving technical deficiencies
* Work closely with internal and external customers, and collaborate with global stakeholders across regions and time zones, to review requirements and deliver customized technical solutions that comply with electrical standards and Rockwell Automation's engineering practices
* Coordinate overall system integration activities, maintaining accurate documentation and fostering effective collaboration across teams and functions
* Drive capability development, continuous improvement and knowledge\-sharing within the team – coaching engineers, building technical depth and supporting other initiatives
* Monitor team performance, quality metrics, resource utilization and project KPIs, reporting progress and risks to the Execution Manager

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in leading and managing an engineering team
* Exposure of working in a global setup – collaborating with global stakeholders, customers and cross\-functional teams across regions and time zones
* Strong domain expertise in Medium Voltage Drives, PLC \& MCC System Designing
