title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Associate Manager \- SAM will lead client\-facing Software Asset Management delivery for enterprise publishers, with primary focus on SAP, IBM and Microsoft. The role is accountable for translating contract terms, entitlement records, discovery data and SAM tool outputs into defensible Effective License Positions, compliance insights and optimization recommendations. The role is expected to guide a SAM delivery team, manage stakeholder governance, and support functional implementation or enhancement of SAM tools such as Flexera and ServiceNow SAM Pro.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 SAM delivery leadership: Lead day\-to\-day SAM delivery for assigned clients, including planning, task prioritization, quality review, risk tracking and stakeholder reporting.
   

  

 Publisher compliance and ELP: Oversee license compliance assessments and ELP preparation for SAP, IBM and Microsoft, including entitlement validation, consumption normalization, metric application and variance analysis.
   

  

 Contract and entitlement interpretation: Review agreements, purchase records, product terms, subscription rights, support status, bundles and usage restrictions to define the correct compliance methodology.
   

  

 SAP licensing review: Guide SAP user, engine, HANA, S/4HANA and indirect usage reviews by validating system extracts, user classifications, role mapping and license measurement outputs.
   

  

 IBM licensing review: Support IBM licensing evaluations covering Passport Advantage records, PVU/VPC/Authorized User/AppPoints concepts, ILMT or BigFix Inventory evidence and sub\-capacity considerations.
   

  

 Microsoft licensing review: Support Microsoft compliance reviews across M365, Azure, Windows Server, SQL Server, Visual Studio and related agreement constructs using portal and entitlement evidence.
   

  

 Tier\-2 and Tier\-3 publishers: Lead or review SAM activities for additional publishers such as Adobe, VMware, Red Hat, ServiceNow, Citrix, BMC, Quest and other client\-specific vendors.
   

  

 Tooling implementation: Provide functional direction for Flexera and ServiceNow SAM Pro configuration, entitlement upload, SKU\-to\-model mapping, software model validation, license creation, normalization and reconciliation.
   

  

 Discovery and data validation: Coordinate with discovery, CMDB, infrastructure and application teams to validate inventory coverage, server mapping, SaaS data, user extracts and deployment models.
   

  

 Optimization: Identify license harvesting, right\-sizing, contract rationalization, renewal and architecture optimization opportunities while maintaining compliance defensibility.
   

  

 Team enablement: Coach SAM analysts and licensing specialists, review workpapers, define calculation logic, and ensure consistent documentation of assumptions and exclusions.
   

  

 Governance and reporting: Prepare executive\-ready compliance dashboards, risk registers, ELP summaries, remediation trackers and stakeholder meeting inputs.
   

  

 Delivery and leadership: Ability to lead a team, manage client deliverables, structure reviews, communicate risks, and convert technical licensing findings into business\-ready recommendations.
   

  

**Preferred Experience And Credentials**
 Recommended 7\+ years of SAM / ITAM experience with 3\+ years in enterprise publisher compliance, ELP or audit support roles.
   

  

 Experience in creating ELP workbooks, compliance position reports, risk and remediation registers, and renewal optimization inputs.
   

  

 Good working knowledge of Excel\-based reconciliation, data cleansing, pivot analysis, entitlement\-to\-consumption mapping and executive reporting.
   

  

 Certifications such as CSAM, CITAM, IAITAM, Flexera, ServiceNow SAM Pro, Microsoft, IBM or SAP licensing certifications are preferred.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and share your updated resume at praveen@nam\-info.com* 




  





**Role: Delivery Manager** 




**Work Location: Pune (Hinjewadi Phase 2\) — Local Pune Candidates Only** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid** 




**Client: Inferyx (Full\-time)** 




**Total Experience: 9\+ Yrs** 




  





**Interview Mode: 2 Virtual Rounds \+ 1 Face\-to\-Face Round** 




  





**About Inferyx** 




 Inferyx is a next\-generation Data Orchestration Platform enabling enterprises to build scalable Data Lakes using Medallion Architecture (
 *Bronze → Silver → Gold* 
 ) across various domains including BFSI, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Inferyx accelerates data engineering delivery through a low\-code orchestration engine, reducing data pipeline build times by up to 60% compared to traditional approaches.
 



  





 We are aggressively expanding our India footprint and looking for a seasoned Delivery Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of our client delivery programs.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 As the senior delivery owner for Inferyx’s enterprise client accounts, you will inherit an active, operational engagement and serve as the single point of accountability for delivery health, stakeholder management, and client satisfaction. You will operate with high autonomy, manage technical complexity, and ensure delivery excellence—enabling our executive leadership to focus on nationwide growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Inferyx data platform, including medallion architecture implementation, sprint governance, and Go\-Live milestones.
* Lead daily/fortnightly scrum calls, sprint reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain delivery health by tracking sprint velocity, proactively managing risks, resolving blockers, and escalating only critical exceptions to executive leadership.
* Ensure all contractual SLAs, delivery milestones, and quality standards are consistently met or exceeded.
* Maintain and update the Client Delivery Runbook, RACI matrix, and issue logs, presenting monthly summaries to Inferyx leadership.



  





**2\. Stakeholder \& Relationship Management** 



* Act as the primary senior relationship manager between Inferyx and client teams (Project Managers, Architects, and Business Owners).
* Conduct fortnightly on\-site visits to client locations to participate in steering committees, executive reviews, and architecture sessions.
* Manage delivery escalations professionally, converting challenges into opportunities to strengthen client trust.
* Identify and cultivate internal client champions to advocate for Inferyx platform adoption and expansion across other business units.



  





**3\. Program Governance \& Reporting** 



* Drive structured program governance using weekly status reports, risk registers, RAID logs, and monthly steering dashboards.
* Maintain a transparent, metric\-driven single source of truth for delivery status that is executive\-ready at all times.
* Prepare and present monthly delivery review decks to Inferyx’s Head of Technology, COO, and CEO.
* Track key delivery KPIs, including sprint velocity, defect rates, deployment frequency, and Client NPS.
* Manage Production incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement sustainable action plans to minimize incident recurrence.
* Manage Change Requests (CRs) professionally—scoping, pricing, and negotiating without damaging client relationships.



  





**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Platform Adoption** 



* Partner with Inferyx engineering and pre\-sales teams to ensure the platform is deployed to its maximum capability at the client site.
* Identify expansion opportunities within client accounts for new business units, additional data domains, or advanced medallion layers.
* Participate in architecture reviews, data model walkthroughs, and pipeline design sessions, applying technical depth to ask the right questions.
* Translate client feedback into actionable insights for internal product teams to shape the Inferyx product roadmap.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Onboarding** 



* Successfully onboard into the engagement via a structured 4–6 week handover from the outgoing delivery lead.
* Mentor and manage junior delivery resources or Business Analysts assigned to the account.
* Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for repeatable delivery processes.
* Contribute to Inferyx's overall delivery methodology through best practices, reusable frameworks, and lessons learned.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




**Essential (Must Have)** 



* Experience: 9 to 13 years of total experience in technology delivery, program management, or client\-facing delivery roles within enterprise IT.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Data platforms—Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or Data Orchestration tools.
* Architecture: Practical understanding of Medallion Architecture, Lakehouse concepts, or multi\-layer data processing (
 *Bronze / Silver / Gold* 
 ).
* Agile Governance: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and velocity tracking).
* Location \& Mobility: Must be currently residing in Pune (or local to Pune) and willing to visit client sites in Hinjewadi Phase 2 on a fortnightly basis.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; proven capability to navigate complex corporate structures and manage stakeholders up to the C\-suite level.



  





**Preferred (Good to Have)** 



* Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, GCP BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.
* Experience working in a product startup or scale\-up environment, demonstrating adaptability in fast\-paced setups.
* Understanding of BFSI data domains (e.g., reconciliation, settlement, regulatory reporting) or Telecom data domains.
* Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
* Track record of building delivery playbooks, SOPs, and scaling delivery processes from scratch.

 As a Regional Innovation Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading and driving the innovation project portfolio across the IMEA region, ensuring strategic initiatives are effectively managed from concept through commercialization. You will act as the central coordinator between R\&D, Marketing, Supply Chain, Operations, Commercial, and other key stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that support business growth and market competitiveness.
   

  

 The role requires strong project and portfolio management capabilities to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, manage risks, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope. You will establish governance frameworks, create transparency across the innovation pipeline, and facilitate data\-driven decision\-making to maximize portfolio value.
   

  

 In addition, you will lead cross\-functional teams in a matrix environment, influencing stakeholders at various organizational levels and driving alignment around common objectives. A key focus will be translating innovation strategies into successful product launches and commercial outcomes while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Success in this role requires excellent leadership, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and communication skills, along with a passion for innovation and the ability to navigate a dynamic, multicultural business environment across the IMEA region.

title: DE-NCLC-M365 Migration and Modernization Manager-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DE NCLC Manager – Technology Consulting**
 EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Manager with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a client\-focused technology leader who can shape and deliver Microsoft 365 transformation engagements. The role combines solution leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement and team development, with a preference for candidates who have led large\-scale migration or modernization programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
* Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
* Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
* Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
* Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
* Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
* Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
* Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
* Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
* Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
* Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.


**Skills And Attributes**
* 9\-12 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong SME\-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
* Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
* Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
* Hands\-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target\-platform decisions.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant\-to\-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
* Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.


**Soft Skills**
* Ability to lead, motivate and develop high\-performing teams across locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
* Sound decision\-making and problem\-solving in complex situations.
* Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
* Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Led large\-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
* Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
* Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**EY \| Building a better working world**

title: Manager, AI/HPC Infrastructure Technical Delivery — India
description:
Are you a technically seasoned leader with a passion for driving excellence in AI, HPC, and data center infrastructure delivery? Do you thrive in leading technical teams to build and deploy some of the world’s largest and fastest AI/HPC systems across the India region? At NVIDIA, we are revolutionizing deep learning, data analytics, and data center capabilities, and we are seeking a Senior Technical Delivery Manager (People Manager) to oversee a team of technical specialists—with end\-to\-end technical control over Ethernet, InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery across APAC. This role requires a strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (Networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools), full\-stack data center technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU), and deep understanding of AI technology, paired with proven people management skills to lead a team of a few to dozens of technical professionals. Additionally, you are expected to have a solid grasp of the the region's business model, as well as experience engaging with the customers closely.
   

  

 As a key leader in NVIDIA’s Infrastructure Specialist Team, you will serve as the Senior Technical Delivery Manager, owning people management for a team of Senior Networking (Eth/IB/AI/HPC) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, while providing overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the India and APAC region. You will balance team leadership, technical oversight, and customer\-centric delivery—leveraging your understanding of the APAC business model and Chinese customer needs—to ensure alignment with NVIDIA’s strategic goals and maintain the highest standards of technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Your deep expertise in AI technology and full\-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) will be critical to guiding the team and delivering successful projects.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Lead, manage, and develop a high\-performing technical team (size: a few to dozens of members) of Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, overseeing the full people management lifecycle—hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, coaching, and retention—fostering a collaborative, technically driven team culture. Provide overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the region, ensuring technical excellence, adherence to NVIDIA DC product standards, and alignment with customer requirements.
* Oversee the design, deployment, and operational reliability of large\-scale AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers in India and APAC, with a focus on InfiniBand networking, HPC clusters, and AI orchestration tools (e.g., BCM \- Base Command Manager).
* Lead technical decision\-making for complex delivery projects, leveraging your deep understanding of AI technology and full\-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) to resolve critical technical challenges related to InfiniBand networks, data center architecture, network automation, and GPU\-accelerated infrastructure.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, leveraging your deep technical expertise to optimize workflows for network provisioning, system design, automation, and post\-deployment support (monitoring, logging, alerting).
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams (engineering, sales, product, support) to align technical delivery strategies with NVIDIA’s product roadmap, especially for NVIDIA DC products (networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools).
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customers (including Chinese customers) and partners across India and APAC, leveraging your understanding of the India business model and bilingual communication skills to serve as the technical leadership point of contact for large\-scale AI/HPC delivery projects and address strategic technical and business needs.
* Ensure the team adheres to technical best practices, compliance standards, and NVIDIA’s quality requirements, while driving accountability for project delivery timelines, budgets, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor team performance, track project progress, and communicate technical delivery status, challenges, and solutions to senior leadership in a clear, data\-driven manner.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of progressive technical experience in data center infrastructure, or equivalent experience, and 5\+ years of people management experience leading a technical team (size: 10 or more members).
* Strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (networking solutions, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools, e.g., BCM \- Base Command Manager), GPU\-accelerated infrastructure, and full\-stack data center technologies including storage, server, networking, virtualization. Additionally, a deep understanding of AI technology and its integration with DC infrastructure is required.
* Deep expertise in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, data center architecture, and InfiniBand networks—with hands\-on experience in medium to large\-scale HPC/AI environments.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing end\-to\-end technical delivery of large\-scale AI/HPC infrastructure projects, with a focus on performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Strong people management skills: ability to lead, coach, and develop technical teams, foster collaboration, and drive accountability in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Excellent customer\-facing and communication skills (verbal and written in both languages), enabling effective engagement with customers (including Chinese customers), partners, and cross\-functional teams across the India region.
* A solid understanding of the India business model to address their unique technical and business requirements. Ability to support regional delivery needs and collaborate across time zones.
* Proven track record of resolving complex technical challenges and driving continuous improvement in technical delivery processes.
* Self\-motivated, results\-driven, and able to balance technical oversight with people management responsibilities.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Linux or Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, HCIE) or NVIDIA\-related certifications.
* Extensive experience with HPC job schedulers (Slurm, PBS) and cluster management technologies (BCM \- Base Command Manager is a strong plus).
* Experience leading technical teams in a professional services or tech vendor environment, with a focus on top CSP/Cloud/Hyper\-Scale customers in the India.
* Deep understanding of AI/ML workloads, their integration with HPC/InfiniBand infrastructure, and full\-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU)—with hands\-on experience optimizing performance for GPU\-accelerated systems.

* Hungry, Humble \& Curious: You bring strong self\-awareness, low ego, and high intellectual curiosity. You love learning new technologies (especially AI and identity) and are eager to prove yourself in a leadership capacity.

title: Senior Specialist - AI Strategy (Mobility)
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 Eaton announced, on June 11, 2026, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027\. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.
   

  

**Major Purpose**
 Define, develop, and deploy the vision and execution of enterprise AI platforms by leading high‑performing AI, data, and platform engineering teams to deliver reusable, cloud‑native ML and GenAI capabilities. The role enables AI‑driven insights, automation, and decision support across Mobility products and engineering workstreams spanning connected systems, electromechanical products, vehicle platforms, manufacturing, lifecycle management, NPI, NTI, and VAVE initiatives.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Define and drive the AI engineering strategy to deliver enterprise‑grade, production‑ready AI capabilities that create measurable business impact across Mobility products, mechanical systems, and automotive platforms.
* Build and evolve a scalable, cloud‑native AI platform—encompassing ML and LLM‑powered services, shared infrastructure — to serve as a foundational layer across the Mobility product portfolio \& workstreams
* Own the end‑to‑end AI technology lifecycle at a platform level, establishing standards and operating models for model development, deployment, monitoring, governance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Enable development of reusable AI services that support predictive insights, anomaly detection, design optimization, diagnostics, and operational intelligence across Mobility engineering and product teams.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and own the long‑term strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the AI platform, aligned with Mobility product vision and business priorities.
* Build, lead, and develop AI, data, and platform engineering teams with strong exposure to mechanical systems, automotive data, and connected product ecosystems.
* Translate Mobility product strategy, engineering challenges, and operational goals into a clear, executable AI platform backlog with well‑defined releases and milestones.
* Drive standardization through shared services, reference architectures, and best practices to accelerate innovation and reduce fragmentation.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Digital, DevOps, and Data Science leaders to enable AI‑driven decision‑making across the product lifecycle.
* Ensure the AI platform meets enterprise standards for security, compliance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.


**Qualifications**
**Education –**
* BE / B.Tech (Mechanical, Electrical, Automotive, Mechatronics, or related discipline preferred)
* Certification programs in AIML
* Master’s degree (Mechanical, Electrical, Automotive, Mechatronics, or related discipline preferred)


**Experience\-**
* 15 to 20 Years of experience


**Skills, Abilities, Knowledge –**
* 15\+ years of experience with significant exposure in enabling AI in business and driving impact through mainstreamed AI practices for various business workstreams
* Strong experience in identifying, developing, and deploying AI solutions for engineering analytics, product intelligence, diagnostics, optimization, or operational insights..
* Demonstrated ability to articulate AI impact using before‑and‑after comparisons tied to engineering efficiency, reliability, quality, cost, or performance metrics
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with all levels of the organization.
* Uses comprehensive knowledge and skills to act independently while guiding and training others on analyzing the business requirements \& AI application.
* Ability to independently drive complex initiatives while guiding teams on translating mechanical or automotive problems into AI solutions

**Skills**
**Skills \& Competencies:**
* Strong expertise in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI workflows.
* Proven experience building and operating data platforms, including large‑scale data pipelines, embeddings pipelines, and analytics systems.

**Competencies –**

The Planning Engineer is responsible for the delivery of project planning and progress measurement, ensuring that TCE’s procedures and best practices are applied, as appropriate, and recommending changes to the Project Controls Manager where required. title: Lead, Strategic Partnerships and Program Implementation
description:
**Position Overview:** 




  





 Room to Read India is seeking an experienced professional to lead program implementation across multiple locations and drive high\-quality proposal and concept note development for the Country Office. The role will work closely with the Program Operations Director, State and cross\-functional teams to ensure effective execution, track progress, address implementation challenges, and capture program learning. The role will also develop evidence\-based, donor\-responsive proposals and concept notes in collaboration with Programs, RM\&E, Finance, Fundraising and Global Grant Management teams. Strong project management, analytical, writing, synthesis and stakeholder management skills are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





**Proposal Development for Strategic Partnerships (50%).** 




  




* Lead the development and writing of high\-quality proposals for Room to Read India.
* Translate program strategies, implementation experience, evidence and organizational priorities into clear, compelling and donor\-responsive narratives.
* Work closely with Programs, RM\&E, Finance, Dev, Global Grant Management and other teams to gather, synthesize and validate technical inputs for proposals.
* Develop proposal narratives, theories of change, program approaches, implementation plans, results frameworks and other relevant sections as required.
* Coordinate inputs from multiple stakeholders and ensure consistency, coherence and quality across technical and financial components of proposals.
* Develop proposal content that clearly articulates the problem, proposed intervention, implementation approach, expected results, evidence and Room to Read’s comparative strengths.
* Ensure that proposals are responsive to donor requirements, guidelines, evaluation criteria and submission timelines.
* Review and strengthen proposal drafts to improve clarity, structure, logic, persuasiveness and alignment between program design, outcomes, activities, budgets and M\&E frameworks.
* Maintain and continuously strengthen a repository of proposal content, program evidence, organizational information, impact stories, case studies and other reusable resources.
* Develop standard content and templates that can enable faster, sharper and more consistent proposal development.
* Coordinate proposal review processes and ensure timely incorporation of feedback from internal and global stakeholders.



  





**Program Learning, Evidence \& Documentation (10%)** 




  




* Capture and synthesize implementation insights, innovations, challenges, success stories and lessons from State teams and program locations.
* Work with RM\&E and Program teams to identify relevant evidence and data that can strengthen program planning, communication and proposal development.
* Translate implementation experience and evidence into compelling narratives, case studies, briefs and proposal content.
* Maintain an updated evidence and learning bank to support proposal development and strategic program discussions.
* Identify recurring implementation issues and opportunities for cross\-state learning and improvement.



  





**Program Implementation \& Delivery (40%)** 




  




* Accountable for ensuring all projects in select geography achieve their respective goals.
* Lead and coordinate implementation of multiple projects/program initiatives across states and locations, ensuring alignment with approved plans, objectives, timelines and program KPIs.
* Work closely with State and Country Office teams to translate program strategies and plans into clear implementation priorities and actions.
* Track key implementation milestones, deliverables, dependencies and risks across projects and proactively flag areas requiring management attention.
* Facilitate periodic implementation reviews with State teams and relevant Country Office functions to assess progress, identify bottlenecks and agree on corrective actions.
* Ensure that required program permissions, approvals and implementation processes are in place in coordination with relevant teams.
* Monitor implementation against agreed timelines, quality parameters and budgets and support teams in addressing deviations.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of program reports and other key implementation deliverables.
* Support effective utilization of program budgets and track significant variances, risks and implementation implications.
* Work with relevant teams to ensure that implementation learning and emerging challenges are documented and translated into actionable improvements.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  





**Required:** 




  




* Master’s degree preferred in Education, Development Studies, Public Policy, Management, Communications or a related field.
* 7–12 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in program implementation, program management, proposal development, fundraising, consulting, development sector or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience of managing or coordinating large\-scale programs/projects involving multiple locations and stakeholders.
* Strong demonstrated experience in proposal writing and concept note development, including the ability to independently develop high\-quality narrative content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong ability to synthesize complex information into clear, structured and compelling documents.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and coordinating multiple inputs to deliver time\-bound outputs.
* Strong analytical, project management and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with budgets, implementation plans, project trackers and performance reports.
* Strong proficiency in preparing presentations, briefing notes, reports and other professional communication materials.
* Experience in the development/social impact/education sector would be an advantage.



  





**Competencies \& Attributes** 



* Strong execution orientation: Demonstrates ownership for moving plans from strategy to implementation and ensuring timely delivery.
* Excellent writing and communication: Able to develop clear, compelling and well\-structured proposals, concept notes and program documents.
* Structured thinker: Able to break down complex problems, connect information across functions and develop practical solutions.
* Strong project management: Able to manage multiple priorities, timelines, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.
* Collaborative and influencing: Comfortable working across functions and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
* Analytical and detail\-oriented: Able to work with qualitative and quantitative information and identify key insights, gaps and risks.
* Proactive problem solver: Anticipates implementation challenges and takes initiative to address them.
* Adaptable and resilient: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines.
* High ownership and accountability: Demonstrates discipline, follow\-through and commitment to quality.
* Passion for equity and education: Strong alignment with Room to Read’s mission of improving learning outcomes and advancing gender equality.



  





**Compensation:** 




  





 Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include thirteenth month bonus, health insurance, and a retirement plan. The non\-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries through literacy and gender equality in education.
 



  





**Room to Read is a child\-safe organization; all personnel are expected to adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy and Child Protection Code of Conduct.**

title: People Systems Manager
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 




 We are seeking a proactive and experienced People Systems Program Manager to join our dynamic People Team. This role is crucial for supporting our People systems and enhancements and requires 5 – 7 years of hand\-on experience with large HCM platforms and other HR systems. As a self\-starter, you will be responsible for both the daily support and the strategic improvement of our People Team technology, acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to drive successful outcomes.
 

  
 




**Your Impact**

  
 





 As the People Systems Program Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and optimizing our People systems and processes. Your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of People systems initiatives, improve user experience, and ensure our People platforms evolve to meet business needs. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact by transforming business requirements into effective, scalable solutions.
 

  
 




**Key Responsibilities**

  
 



* Own and deliver the cross\-functional People systems roadmap, directly enabling the success of the People and IT teams. Design and manage a centralized intake and prioritization process for all system enhancement requests, owning this significant process within the People team's project structure.


* Proactively identify and solve People systems and data problems before they impact other teams. Use your deep expertise in HR processes and systems to translate vague requirements into practical, innovative solutions and clear functional specifications for the configuration team.


* Partner with People Team stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing systems enhancements and reports, while ensuring People data integrity and governance.


* Coordinate and support implementation and management of our People systems and related internal tools.


* Train end users and create collateral to target audiences


* Support and maintain compliance activities by ensuring HR data, system configurations, and business processes align with internal controls and regulatory requirements.


* Manage and support release cycles, including analyzing new features and advising People Team leaders and functional SMEs on potential benefits and considerations.



**Your Qualifications**

  
 



* 5\-7 years of experience in an HRIS, People technology, or related Program Management role.


* Demonstrated ability to own and deliver cross\-functional projects from start to finish, influencing peers and stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.


* Sought out for your ability to resolve ambiguity and proactively identify and solve complex problems before they escalate.


* Experience acting as an autonomous owner of project deliverables and mentoring junior team members.


* Strong experience with a major HCM platform and a deep understanding of core HR business processes.


* Proven ability to translate business needs into functional requirements and system specifications.


* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted and influential voice in planning discussions.


* Must be able to work flexible hours to ensure overlap with the U.S. Eastern time zone.



**Desired Skills and Attributes**

  
 



* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.


* A collaborative team player with a passion for learning and continuous improvement.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Lead - MBD Validation (EV Controls)
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead \- MBD Validation (EV Controls)
 



  





 Location: Mohan Estate, Delhi
 



  





 Technical Skills Required:
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* About the role
* We design our vehicle controllers in\-house, so no Tier\-1 supplier validates the software for us. That makes validation our own quality gate between a Simulink model and a vehicle in a customer's fleet.
* You will build and run that gate: the test strategy, the MIL/SIL/PIL/HIL infrastructure, the automation, and the release sign\-off. Our vehicles run 150–250 km a day in commercial duty, so a field fault means lost revenue for a fleet operator, not just a warranty claim.
* Key responsibilities
* **Validation strategy and process**
* • Define the V\-model validation strategy for each controller: what is proven at MIL, SIL, PIL, HIL and vehicle level, and what exit criteria each stage needs.
* • Derive test cases from system and software requirements, with bidirectional traceability (requirements ↔ model ↔ test ↔ result).
* • Set and enforce model quality gates: MAAB/JMAAB modelling guidelines, Model Advisor checks, and structural coverage targets (decision, condition, MC/DC as needed).
* • Own software release sign\-off: no controller build ships to production or fleet without a validation report from your team.
* **Model and code\-level testing**
* • Run unit and integration testing on Simulink/Stateflow models using Simulink Test, Test Manager and harnesses.
* • Run back\-to\-back (MIL vs SIL/PIL) equivalence testing on auto\-generated Embedded Coder / TargetLink code.
* • Drive static analysis and run\-time error checks on generated and handwritten C (Polyspace or equivalent, MISRA C).
* • Build and maintain plant models (motor, inverter, battery, charger, vehicle dynamics) fit for closed\-loop testing.
* **HIL and test infrastructure**
* • Own the HIL benches (dSPACE SCALEXIO or equivalent): architecture, I/O and CAN configuration, fault\-injection, and commissioning of new rigs.
* • Build test automation (Python, AutomationDesk / ECU\-TEST or equivalent) with nightly regression runs integrated into CI (Jenkins/GitLab).
* • Cover fault\-injection and edge cases the vehicle can't safely reproduce: sensor failures, CAN loss, thermal derating, over/under\-voltage, contactor faults.
* **Vehicle and field validation**
* • Plan and support vehicle\-level validation with the T\&V team, using CAN logs (CANoe/CANalyzer) to close the loop between bench and road.
* • Triage field and fleet issues back to root cause in model or code, and add a regression test for every escaped defect.
* **Team and cross\-functional leadership**
* • Hire, lead and mentor a team of 4–6 validation engineers.
* • Work with controls, embedded, electrical, charging and service teams, plus suppliers for sensors, cells and chargers.
* • Support functional safety (ISO 26262\) and cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434\) work products for validation, and prepare for ASPICE\-style process audits.
* Must\-have qualifications
* • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechanical Engineering; M.Tech in automotive electronics or controls preferred.
* • 8–12 years in automotive controls, with at least 5 years hands\-on in MBD testing and validation.
* • Deep MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow skills, including Simulink Test and Embedded Coder or TargetLink generated code.
* • Proven MIL and unit testing of production controller models, with coverage and traceability reporting.
* • Hands\-on HIL experience on dSPACE, NI or Vector platforms, including fault\-injection testing.
* • Working knowledge of at least two EV controllers (VCU, MCU, BMS or charger) and how they interact over CAN.
* • CAN tools fluency: CANoe/CANalyzer, DBC management, log\-based debugging.
* • Test scripting in Python for automation and log analysis.
* • Has taken at least one EV controller software release from model to production vehicle.
* Good\-to\-have qualifications
* • Set up or commissioned an EV controls lab or HIL bench from scratch.
* • ISO 26262 functional safety exposure (ASIL decomposition, safety\-case evidence from testing).
* • ISO/SAE 21434 cybersecurity awareness or certification.
* • ASPICE SWE.4–SWE.6 process experience or audit participation.
* • CI/CD for model\-based workflows (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Simulink Project, Git/SVN).
* • Static analysis with Polyspace and MISRA C compliance.
* • Battery algorithms (SOC/SOH estimation) or DC fast\-charging protocols (Bharat DC\-001, CCS2, GB/T).
* • Commercial 3W or 4W EV background, where duty cycles and fleet uptime drive requirements.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Migration Architect to lead complex Data Centre Exit and DC Consolidation programmes, migrating large\-scale enterprise estates to Amazon Web Services (AWS). This is a technically demanding, client\-facing role that sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, migration engineering, and programme delivery.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end architectural direction of migration programmes — from initial discovery and dependency mapping through to wave execution, cutover, and post\-migration optimisation. You will bring deep expertise in AWS infrastructure, licensing portability (BYOL, BYOS, AWS Licence Manager), network transformation using AWS Transit Gateway and Direct Connect, and the unique complexities that arise when exiting or consolidating physical data centres onto AWS.
   

  

 This role is suited to an architect who is equally comfortable whiteboarding a target\-state AWS Landing Zone architecture with a CTO and sitting with an engineering team to resolve a blast\-radius dependency conflict the night before a cutover.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture \& Technical Leadership**
* Design and own the target\-state cloud architecture for DC Exit / DC Consolidation programmes on AWS, including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS), storage (EBS, EFS, S3\), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway), identity (IAM, AWS SSO), and security (AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, SCPs)
* Lead application and infrastructure discovery using AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), Migration Evaluator, and dependency mapping to produce migration\-ready groupings and blast radius analysis
* Define migration patterns (rehost via AWS MGN, replatform to RDS/EKS, refactor to Lambda/containers, retire, replace with SaaS) per workload with clear technical rationale and risk assessment
* Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), High\-Level Designs (HLDs), and Low\-Level Designs (LLDs) to programme\-grade quality, aligned to the AWS Well\-Architected Framework
* Govern architectural consistency across migration waves and enforce AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower guardrails throughout the transition


**Licensing Portability \& Compliance**
* Lead licensing portability strategy for DC exit — BYOL (Bring Your Own Licence) for Windows Server and SQL Server on EC2, AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence impact analysis, and SPLA transition planning for MSP\-operated environments moving to AWS
* Advise on AWS Dedicated Hosts as the mechanism for BYOL compliance for Windows Server and SQL Server (per\-socket/per\-core licence models), ensuring licence counts are correctly mapped to Dedicated Host instance families
* Design licence governance controls using AWS Licence Manager rules, resource tagging strategies via AWS Config, and integration with third\-party SAM tooling (Flexera, Snow Software) to prevent compliance drift post\-migration
* Engage the AWS account team and AWS Partner Network (APN) to maximise programme value through AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) funding, AWS Credits, and AWS Professional Services co\-delivery


**Network Transformation**
* Design target\-state hybrid network architectures on AWS: AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) as the centralised routing hub, AWS Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted connections), Site\-to\-Site VPN as failover, and SD\-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Define internet egress and traffic inspection strategy for the post\-DC state, replacing DC\-based security perimeters with AWS Network Firewall, AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) with third\-party NVAs (Palo Alto, Fortinet), and AWS WAF
* Lead DNS transformation planning — Amazon Route 53 Private Hosted Zones, Route 53 Resolver (inbound/outbound endpoints), split\-horizon DNS — and IP addressing strategy for migration with minimal re\-IP using AWS IPAM
* Design VPC architecture across accounts and regions: hub\-and\-spoke or flat TGW models, VPC sharing via AWS RAM, and PrivateLink for service consumption without public exposure
* Ensure latency\-sensitive workloads (ERP, payments, OT/SCADA) are isolated in dedicated VPCs with appropriate Direct Connect SIFs and QoS, and their connectivity requirements validated pre\-cutover


**Migration Programme Delivery**
* Own the migration wave plan using AWS Migration Hub as the central tracking plane — sequencing, dependency groupings, rollback criteria, and cutover playbooks across programmes of 500\+ workloads
* Lead rehost migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) for agent\-based lift\-and\-shift, and AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) or AWS VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC) for VMware estate migration
* Define and enforce go/no\-go criteria for each migration wave, including pre\-flight AWS MGN replication lag thresholds, post\-cutover smoke test suites, and DNS TTL management during cutover windows
* Manage and resolve technical blockers across infrastructure, networking, security, and application teams during wave execution
* Ensure regulated workloads (financial services, public sector) are handled with appropriate regulatory notifications, BCP/DR evidence updated in AWS Resilience Hub, and audit trails via AWS CloudTrail


**FinOps \& Cost Governance**
* Build pre\-migration cost models using AWS Migration Evaluator and AWS Pricing Calculator, incorporating BYOL savings on Dedicated Hosts, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance pricing, S3 storage tiering, and data transfer / egress cost assumptions
* Establish a FinOps operating model — visibility via AWS Cost Explorer and Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), accountability through AWS account\-level tagging and chargeback, optimisation via Compute Optimizer and Savings Plans, governance via AWS Budgets and anomaly detection
* Conduct post\-migration right\-sizing reviews using AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations and Trusted Advisor checks to close the gap between business case projections and actual AWS spend


**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**
* Act as the primary technical authority for client stakeholders up to CTO / CIO level, translating complex AWS architectural decisions into clear business outcomes
* Lead multi\-vendor technical governance — defining interface agreements, RACI frameworks, and joint testing protocols across SIs, MSPs, and AWS
* Manage AWS account team, network vendors (Direct Connect providers, SD\-WAN), and third\-party migration tooling vendors as an integrated programme team


**Essential**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud architecture, with a significant portion focused on large\-scale migration programmes (DC Exit, DC consolidation, or cloud\-first transformation) on AWS
* Deep hands\-on expertise in AWS compute and migration services: EC2 (including Dedicated Hosts for BYOL), AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), AWS Migration Hub, AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), and AWS Database Migration Service (DMS)
* Demonstrable expertise in AWS licensing portability: BYOL on Dedicated Hosts (Windows Server and SQL Server per\-socket/per\-core models), AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence restrictions, and SPLA transition planning for MSP colo environments
* Network transformation experience: AWS Transit Gateway, Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted), VPC design (hub\-and\-spoke, shared VPCs), Route 53 Resolver, AWS Network Firewall, and SD\-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Proven experience designing and executing migration wave plans for estates of 500\+ VMs in enterprise or regulated environments, using AWS Migration Hub as the tracking plane
* AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower design and guardrail enforcement across multi\-account organisations
* FinOps experience: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, and pre\-migration cost modelling using AWS Migration Evaluator
* Strong technical documentation skills — ADRs, HLDs, LLDs, cutover playbooks, and AWS Well\-Architected Review outputs to consulting\-grade standard
* Experience operating in multi\-vendor programme environments (SI, MSP, AWS account team triangles)


**Highly Desirable**
* Hands\-on experience with VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC on AWS) as a migration accelerator for VMware\-heavy DC estates
* Experience with AWS Outposts for hybrid workloads that cannot fully exit on\-prem, and AWS Local Zones for latency\-sensitive edge workloads
* Experience with third\-party migration tooling: Zerto on AWS, Carbonite Migrate, CloudEndure (now MGN), or PlateSpin
* Container and modernisation experience: Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, AWS App2Container (A2C) for containerising legacy applications during DC exit
* Azure exposure — useful for programmes with workloads that are split across hyperscalers


**Certifications**
**Certification** 
**Status** 
**Notes** 
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional Required Core requirement at this level AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Expected Assumed as prerequisite to Professional AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty Highly Desirable Essential for network transformation\-heavy programmes AWS Certified Security – Specialty Highly Desirable For regulated and public sector programmes AWS Cloud Practitioner Expected Foundational — assumed at this level TOGAF / ArchiMate Desirable Enterprise architecture governance contexts Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) Desirable For multi\-cloud or Azure\-adjacent programmes
   

  

**Competency Framework**
**Competency** 
**Behavioural Indicators at Senior Level** 
 Technical Depth Provides technically precise answers without being prompted; anticipates second\-order consequences of architectural decisions Risk Ownership Proactively surfaces programme risks before they become issues; defines rollback criteria and escalation paths without being asked Stakeholder Influence Can translate technical complexity into business language for C\-suite; influences without authority across vendor teams Delivery Pragmatism Makes pragmatic trade\-off decisions under time pressure; knows when 'good enough now' beats 'perfect later' Continuous Learning Stays current with AWS service releases and deprecations; proactively shares knowledge with programme teams and clients via internal tech talks or runbook updates

title: Head of Operations – Interior Fit-Out & Project Execution
description:
**1\. Role Purpose**

The Head of Operations will be responsible for leading and controlling the **end\-to\-end operational delivery of Geographics Interiors LLP’s projects** across locations.

The role will ensure that projects are delivered **on time, within approved budgets, as per quality standards, safely and in line with client expectations**, while maintaining operational efficiency and project profitability.

The position will act as the **single\-point operational authority** between Management, Projects, Design, MEP, Procurement, Commercial/Accounts, Vendors, Contractors and Site Teams.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Execution \& Delivery**

* Lead the execution of multiple interior fit\-out and turnkey projects simultaneously.
* Take overall ownership of project delivery from project handover to final client handover.
* Ensure project execution is aligned with approved drawings, BOQ, specifications, timelines and commercial commitments.
* Review project schedules, milestones and critical\-path activities.
* Monitor planned vs. actual progress and take corrective action wherever required.
* Identify project delays, bottlenecks and dependencies at an early stage.
* Ensure timely completion, snag closure and final handover.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with Project Managers and Site Teams.

**B. Operations \& Resource Planning**

* Plan and allocate Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, MEP resources and other manpower based on project requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower across all active projects.
* Identify manpower gaps and arrange timely deployment.
* Review site productivity and team performance.
* Develop a structured manpower/resource deployment plan for upcoming projects.
* Ensure no critical project is affected due to resource shortages.

**C. Project Management Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor Project Managers, Site Engineers and operational teams.
* Establish clear accountability and ownership for every project.
* Set project\-level performance expectations and review them periodically.
* Monitor PM/site team performance through measurable KPIs.
* Resolve internal conflicts and operational issues.
* Develop a culture of ownership, discipline and timely execution.

**D. Procurement \& Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Purchase/Procurement for project material requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of material requisitions based on project schedules.
* Monitor material availability against project requirements.
* Track critical materials and long\-lead items.
* Coordinate with vendors, contractors and subcontractors for timely execution.
* Monitor vendor/contractor performance, quality and delivery commitments.
* Escalate procurement delays that may impact project timelines.
* Support commercial teams in vendor negotiations and operational decisions.

**E. Cost Control \& Project Profitability**

* Monitor project costs against approved budgets and BOQs.
* Review manpower productivity, material wastage, rework and subcontractor costs.
* Identify cost overruns at an early stage.
* Monitor project variations, additional works and client changes.
* Ensure commercial implications of project decisions are communicated to Management/Commercial teams.
* Work with Accounts/Commercial teams to monitor project profitability and cost\-to\-complete.
* Drive cost optimization without compromising quality or delivery.

**F. Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a senior escalation point for key clients and project stakeholders.
* Participate in important client meetings and project reviews.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants, architects and PMC representatives.
* Resolve critical operational issues and client escalations.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are properly communicated to internal teams and tracked to closure.
* Support the Project Team in achieving high client satisfaction and successful handovers.

**G. Design, Technical \& MEP Coordination**

* Ensure smooth coordination between Design, Projects and Site Teams.
* Review critical design/drawing issues affecting execution.
* Ensure drawings, BOQs, specifications and site requirements are aligned before execution.
* Coordinate with MEP, Civil, Interior and other specialist teams.
* Ensure technical issues and RFIs are resolved within required timelines.
* Prevent execution delays arising from design or coordination gaps.

**H. Quality \& Safety**

* Establish and monitor project quality standards across all sites.
* Ensure execution is as per approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Implement project quality checklists and inspection systems.
* Monitor workmanship, material quality and installation standards.
* Drive systematic snagging and snag closure.
* Ensure pre\-handover quality inspections are completed.
* Ensure compliance with company safety requirements and applicable site safety standards.
* Take immediate corrective action on serious quality or safety concerns.

**I. SOP \& Process Improvement**

* Develop, implement and continuously improve Operations SOPs.
* Standardize processes from project handover through execution and final handover.
* Establish clear workflows between:
* **Sales → Design → BOQ/Estimation → Procurement → Projects → Site → Commercial → Handover**
* Identify operational inefficiencies and introduce corrective systems.
* Implement standard project review formats, reporting systems and escalation mechanisms.
* Ensure SOP compliance across projects.**J. MIS \& Management Reporting**

Submit regular Operations MIS to the Management covering:

* Project\-wise progress
* Planned vs. actual completion
* Project\-wise manpower
* Material status
* Procurement delays
* Cost/budget status
* Project profitability
* Vendor/contractor performance
* Quality issues
* Safety concerns
* Client escalations
* Project risks
* Critical decisions required from Management
* Upcoming project resource requirements

**K. Risk \& Escalation Management**

* Maintain a project risk register for major projects.
* Identify risks related to manpower, material, design, procurement, client approvals, vendors and timelines.
* Ensure timely escalation of critical matters to Management.
* Develop recovery plans for delayed projects.
* Monitor corrective actions until closure.
* Ensure operational issues are resolved at the appropriate level without unnecessary escalation.

**3\. Key Performance Areas / KPIs**

The Head of Operations will be measured on:

* **On\-Time Project Delivery**
* **Project Budget \& Cost Control**
* **Project Gross Margin / Profitability**
* **Manpower Productivity \& Utilization**
* **Material Availability \& Procurement Efficiency**
* **Quality Compliance**
* **Snag Closure \& Handover Performance**
* **Client Satisfaction \& Escalation Closure**
* **Vendor \& Contractor Performance**
* **Safety \& Site Compliance**
* **SOP Implementation \& Process Discipline**
* **Accuracy and Timeliness of Operations MIS**
* **Project Risk Identification \& Resolution**
* **Overall Operational Efficiency**

**4\. Decision\-Making Authority**

The Head of Operations will have authority to:

* Recommend/approve operational manpower deployment within approved structures.
* Reallocate project resources based on business priorities.
* Escalate underperforming vendors/contractors.
* Recommend replacement of non\-performing project resources.
* Direct corrective actions for project delays and quality issues.
* Escalate commercial deviations and project risks to Management.
* Recommend process improvements and operational SOP changes.
* Recommend additional manpower, vendors or resources based on project requirements.

Major commercial commitments, salary decisions, contractual commitments and deviations beyond approved budgets will remain subject to Management approval.

**5\. Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related discipline.
* PMP / RICS / NICMAR / MBA in Operations or Project Management would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **12–18 years of overall experience**, preferably in commercial interior fit\-out, turnkey projects, workplace interiors or construction.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior project/operations leadership role.
* Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience managing large project teams, contractors and vendors.
* Experience handling corporate, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, retail or large\-scale fit\-out projects will be preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* Interior Fit\-Out Project Management
* Operations Leadership
* Project Planning \& Scheduling
* Commercial \& Cost Control
* Resource Planning
* Vendor \& Contractor Management
* Client \& Stakeholder Management
* Procurement Coordination
* Quality Management
* Risk Management
* Team Leadership
* SOP \& Process Development
* MIS \& Management Reporting
* Negotiation \& Problem Solving

 Own sprint planning, backlog grooming support, release schedules, and cross\-team dependency tracking for engineering programs.

 • Demonstrated ability to manage day\-to\-day program activities independently and proactively, with minimal supervision.

description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Job Description: Project Manager (T4\)**
**Position:** 
 Principal Program Manager— Level T4
   

  

**Function:** 
 Engineering / Program Management — EDA Software Development
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex, high\-stakes initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams in the context of
 **Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development** 
 . You will be the central orchestrator ensuring delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and continuous innovation across the full EDA product lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Multi\-team coordination: Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams (engineering, QA, design, operations, business) to ensure seamless execution and on\-time delivery of EDA software projects.
* Customer project ownership: Manage end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-facing EDA projects, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring commitments are met with quality.
* High\-stakes project leadership: Lead critical, high\-visibility programs with significant business or technical impact, managing risks proactively and escalating appropriately.
* Structured planning: Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans using rigorous methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* Innovation facilitation: Champion new approaches and continuously explore emerging tools — including AI\-assisted project management (intelligent scheduling, risk prediction, automated reporting, and AI\-driven decision support) — to improve team efficiency and project outcomes.
* Status reporting: Provide clear, concise, and accurate communication to all stakeholders — from engineers to senior leadership.
* Team collaboration: Foster a strong team spirit, removing blockers and ensuring every contributor feels supported and empowered.


**Required Profile**
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-team programs in a technical or software development environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and structured in approach.
* Collaborative mindset with genuine team spirit — you succeed when the team succeeds.
* Comfortable operating under pressure and navigating ambiguity on high\-stakes deliverables.
* Experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent).
* Understanding of EDA tools and the semiconductor design flow is a strong plus — familiarity with the domain (simulation, synthesis, place \& route, verification, etc.) enables faster ramp\-up and more credible engagement with engineering teams.
* PMP certification (Project Management Professional) is a strong plus — it demonstrates mastery of globally recognized PM standards and a commitment to the discipline.


**What We Value**
 You are not just a process enforcer — you are a builder of bridges between teams, a guardian of commitments to customers, and a driver of a culture where quality and innovation go hand in hand. You embrace AI as a force multiplier to manage smarter, not just harder — and you bring enough EDA domain awareness to speak the language of the engineers you serve.
   

  

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

 TheHireHub.AI is an AI\-driven recruitment platform founded in 2025 and headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana, India. This role offers close exposure to the founders and the opportunity to contribute directly to company\-building initiatives across strategy, operations, research, customer\-facing work, and execution.

 The Founder’s Office Associate will work closely with the founders to drive strategic, operational, and cross\-functional priorities for TheHireHub.AI. The role is designed for a skilled early\-career professional who can move comfortably between research, planning, execution, communication, and problem\-solving. You will help the founders organize priorities, prepare business insights, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure important initiatives move forward with speed and clarity. Success in this role means creating leverage for the founders, improving execution quality, and converting loosely defined opportunities into completed outcomes. The ideal candidate communicates confidently, manages multiple workstreams without losing detail, and takes ownership from start to finish. This is a high\-exposure role suited to someone who enjoys variety, learns quickly, handles ambiguity, and wants to understand how an AI recruitment software company is built and scaled.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own founder\-led projects from problem definition through execution, using structured plans, milestones, and stakeholder follow\-ups to deliver timely business outcomes.
* Prepare market, customer, competitor, and business research that helps the founders evaluate opportunities, refine priorities, and make informed decisions.
* Coordinate cross\-functional initiatives across product, sales, marketing, operations, and customer conversations, maintaining clear ownership and momentum.
* Build concise presentations, business updates, operating documents, and decision briefs that improve alignment and accelerate founder\-level decision\-making.
* Track key priorities, action items, and dependencies through reliable systems, escalating risks early and ensuring commitments are closed.
* Support customer, partner, and internal communication by preparing context, managing follow\-ups, and representing the company with professionalism and clarity.
* Identify recurring operational gaps and implement lightweight processes, templates, and dashboards that improve execution consistency as the company grows.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to simplify complex information, present clear recommendations, and interact confidently with founders, customers, and stakeholders.
* Proven multitasking and prioritization skills, with disciplined execution across multiple simultaneous workstreams, shifting priorities, and incomplete information.
* Comfortable using productivity, documentation, presentation, spreadsheet, project\-management, and collaboration tools to organize information and create visibility.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring 1–4 years of experience in a Founder’s Office or a comparable role involving business operations, strategy, project execution, or cross\-functional coordination. You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, organize information well, and can adapt your message for founders, customers, and internal teams. You are comfortable handling several priorities at once while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and follow\-through. You do not wait for perfect instructions; you clarify the objective, structure the problem, propose a path forward, and keep stakeholders informed. You can move between detailed execution and broader business context, understanding how individual tasks connect to company outcomes. You are skilled with common workplace tools for documents, presentations, spreadsheets, research, communication, and task tracking. You bring sound judgment, curiosity, discretion, and a bias toward action. Most importantly, you take ownership of outcomes rather than limiting yourself to assigned activities, and you are motivated by the opportunity to work closely with founders while helping build an ambitious AI recruitment software company.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work closely with the founders and gain broad exposure to strategy, operations, product, customers, and company\-building decisions from an early stage.

* Develop high\-value skills across structured problem\-solving, communication, prioritization, stakeholder management, and operating systems.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to founders and meaningful ownership across strategic and operational initiatives in an AI\-powered recruitment software company.
* A high\-learning, cross\-functional environment where strong performance creates opportunities to take on broader responsibilities and influence company\-building priorities.
* The opportunity to work from the Noida office with a focused early\-stage team and contribute to products shaping modern recruitment workflows.

description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
 You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning.
   

  

 Project Engineering:
   

  

* Review project inputs from customer meetings, site surveys, and technical documents
* Lead engineering for DCS\-based ECMS and data\-center projects
* Develop network architectures, control logic, protection schemes, and procurement specifications for ECMS and Hybrid EMS
* Engineer software logic for load shedding, MW and MVAr sharing, grid tie\-ins, synchronization, islanding, and black start functions
* Integrate LV, MV, and HV electrical distribution systems, including switchgear, substations, GIS, and switchyards
* Implement control logic based on SAMA diagrams and functional descriptions
* Develop breaker control macros, faceplate templates, and simulation logic
* Configure third\-party communication protocols and interfaces, including Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3
* Lead point database development, I/O list extraction, and hardware/software integration
* Prepare and review system architecture, GA drawings, and network topology documents
* Ensure compliance with IEEE, IEC, NEC, and applicable regional grid codes
