* Coordinate with system integrators to support timely, cost\-effective, and high\-quality delivery
* Support utilization tracking and management reporting, including MORs


 Field Services:
   

  

* Prepare site execution plans in coordination with the project manager
* Lead the site team during Ovation system power\-up, redundancy checks, and I/O testing
* Maintain procedures for loop checks, device checks, and panel charging
* Lead site testing and troubleshooting for analog and binary devices
* Coordinate with customers and vendors on commissioning issues, progress updates, risks, and roadblocks
* Troubleshoot network and communication interfaces, including OPC, Modbus, DNP3, serial links, and IEC 61850
* Perform loop and device checks and implement required updates to logic, graphics, and databases based on site or customer requirements
* Work closely with the engineering team to troubleshoot hardware and software issues, including controllers, modules, and link modules
* Commission ECMS systems for commercial operation
* Manage customer\-facing activities and prepare site reports

* 8–16 years of experience in the electrical industry or with a DCS/PLC OEM or vendor, preferably in captive power plants or refineries, with knowledge of DCS/PLC programming, engineering, and commissioning.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform well under pressure.
* Proficiency in report writing and business communication.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors and subcontractors.
* Familiarity with relevant industry standards, including NEC, IEEE, IEC, and OSHA.

* Willingness to work in industrial environments while following all required safety protocols.
* Willingness to travel to project sites across India and internationally, as required.


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Strong knowledge of electrical distribution systems, substations, GIS, and switchyard operations.
* Proven experience in ECS software design, including load shedding and power sharing functions.
* Expert knowledge of electrical equipment, including switchboards, generators, turbines, AVRs, motors, transformers, capacitors, CTs, VTs, feeders, meters, and relays.
* Solid understanding of programming languages, preferably C or C\+\+.
* Experience with IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC UA, and other control system protocols over TCP/IP or serial communication.
* Experience with protective relays, substations, and renewable energy automation systems.
* Experience designing and configuring SEL RTAC and equivalent IED architectures.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist (SaaS, US)

title: Technical Product Specialist - Global Social Responsibility
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management, continuous improvement, and operational health of the learning technology stack that powers learner experiences and program delivery.
   

  

 This includes supporting the LMS, key SaaS integrations (e.g., Marketo), reporting and data flows, and custom operational tooling.
   

  

 You will work closely with programming teams, vendors, and firm Learning Technology colleagues to gather requirements, identify enhancement opportunities, maintain platform reliability, and coordinate delivery of technical improvements. You will help define and maintain the product roadmap for the GSR learning technology ecosystem, recommending priorities and enhancements based on user needs, operational considerations, and platform opportunities. You will help with major roadmap decisions, strategic tradeoffs, and platform evolution initiatives will be developed in partnership with and syndicated through the Learning Technology team to ensure alignment with broader firm technology strategy. Your success requires strong technical judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder coordination, and the ability to balance operational excellence with continuous platform improvement in support of the Global Social Responsibility (GSR) mission\-driven learning programs.
   

  

 You will support platform performance, resilience, integrations, security, and vendor\-orchestrated delivery while partnering across program teams, firm functions, and external providers to deliver a high\-quality learner experience at scale.
   

  

 You will help define and maintain the technical product roadmap across the LMS, integrations, reporting, and operational tooling by gathering requirements, prioritizing enhancements, evaluating technical solutions, identifying automation and process improvement opportunities, assessing risks and dependencies, and contributing recommendations for future platform capabilities in partnership with the Learning Technology Product Manager.
   

  

 You will serve as the day\-to\-day steward of the GSR learning technology ecosystem by monitoring platform health, coordinating incident response, supporting root\-cause analysis, maintaining visibility into operational risks and dependencies, and driving continuous service improvement.
   

  

 You will support learner, program, and operational data flows by translating reporting requirements into technical solutions, improving data quality and reporting usability, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
   

  

 You will manage day\-to\-day platform operations, including configuration, integrations, release coordination, change management, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and lightweight technical enhancements while improving platform maintainability and supporting adoption of new capabilities.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for technology vendors by coordinating issue resolution, managing vendor\-delivered enhancements, monitoring service performance, supporting sourcing and renewal decisions, and ensuring alignment with firm technology governance, architecture, and security standards.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* 5\+ years of experience in technical product management, platform operations, enterprise systems, learning technology, or a closely related field
* Experience supporting business\-critical SaaS platforms, integrations, and enterprise technology ecosystems
* Working knowledge of LMS technologies, APIs, SSO/SAML, CRM/marketing automation integrations, data pipelines, reporting platforms, and cloud\-based systems
* Experience with platforms such as Docebo, Marketo, AWS, Domo, Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, or comparable technologies
* Experience managing external vendors and service providers against SLAs, KPIs, roadmaps, budgets, and security/compliance expectations
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize work, manage multiple initiatives, and drive delivery in a fast\-paced environment
* Product management skills, including requirements gathering, backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross\-functional coordination
* Strong technical aptitude with experience supporting platform operations, integrations, automation, reporting workflows, and continuous improvement
* Analytical problem\-solving skills with the ability to leverage data, metrics, structured analysis, and GenAI\-assisted tools to troubleshoot issues and implement practical solutions
* Sound judgment, adaptability, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, build productive partnerships, and escalate strategic decisions appropriately
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

title: Global Senior Environmental Data Manager
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Supply
   

  

 Our communications and external affairs team are at the very heart of Reckitt's brand, purpose and products, bringing them to life around the globe for our employees, consumers, investors, governments and our suppliers. It's a rewarding task, growing and protecting Reckitt's image and brand. Every day, we design public relations and communication strategies that build awareness, trust and relationships, while steering us away from reputational risk. We do this by gathering and maintaining knowledge of our policies, principles, and business strategies, while keeping up\-to\-date with relevant developments right across our business units and trusted brands. From digital, media and events to employee experience, strategic relationships, and community partners, we identify opportunities to deliver on our business and sustainability agenda, while proactively identifying storylines and opportunities to advance our narrative.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role oversees the systems\-development, data\-analysis, and reporting of global, regional \& site\-based energy, waste, water metrics and other environmental key performance indicators (KPI’s) that measure our progress toward publicly declared targets. This includes:
   

  

* Planning and project management \- Above all the role requires strong data analytics, project and time\-management leadership. It involves responding to dynamic data enquiries from Reckitt’s senior leadership tier, overseeing the delivery of monthly \& quarterly reports, as well as supporting our annual report published in Q2 each year, and its associated data assurance by leading external accreditors. In addition to this, the Env reporting team supports and polices sites’ data entries into our systems, aids their training on the same, and fields sites’ data enquiries.
* Data systems management and analysis – The Global Environment Data Manager will support the Global Head of Environment as the team\-lead on the interpretation and summarising of site, BU and regional environmental performance reporting, forecasting and insights, in conjunction with the regional environmental managers. Leading all Reckitt’s environmental data, the role requires robust environmental data collection, reporting and analytical skills, together with proficiency in Sustainability data management software. Preference will be given to Enablon specialists.
* Sustainability \& EHS Network development – Effective and timely communication is key within Reckitt together with developing robust networks, building relationships, (often virtually), to provide on\-going site support to enhance understand and drive performance opportunities.
* Presentation skills – Data enquiries are part of the daily routine and come our leadership teams across our Global Business Units. A key role is therefore presenting environmental performance of our sites to a range of stakeholders across the business, often at senior vice\-president level and upwards. This will involve utilizing and developing data communications software such as Power BI.
* Training – From time to time, both the role and their subordinates may also be required to provide training to engineers and EHS professionals across our sites in Enablon, Glidepath Tool either in person, or via e\-learning and webinar.
* (Reporting) Stakeholder liaison – This role will require leading the analyst on supporting liaison with key regional stakeholders, in the financial, SRI, NGO and reporting best practice communities, to bring reporting intelligence back into the environment leadership team.
* General sustainability support – this role will largely concentrate on the elements above, but another responsibility within this position in support to the wider Global Environment Team. This offers the opportunity of exposure to other aspects of corporate responsibility – everything from regulatory tracking and preparedness, audit support and strategy\-setting, to specific events and awareness initiatives.


 Your responsibilities
   

  

**PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES (Major End Results The Role Will Achieve)**
 Planning \& Project Management
   

  

* Good organisational and planning skills are essential. Support the collection of all Reckitt’s environmental data via various internal management systems.
* Plan and schedule monthly and quarterly reporting to the senior leadership
* Support the provision of regular monthly/quarterly updates to regional and global management on sites’ environmental performance status related to all long\-term performance targets detailed in our reports
* Support the Global Head of Environment in devising \& implementing new environmental targets and programmes to drive continual improvement in Reckitt operational environmental performance.


 Reporting, Presentation \& Communication skills
   

  

* Lead and conduct internal data assurance and manage the external assurance process for environmental data included in the Reckitt annual report including clarification/ review of the findings (in line with external reporting requirements including GRI, GHG Protocol, SASB, CDP \& DJSI)
* Under the oversight of the Global Head of Environment, lead in the provision of regular monthly and quarterly reports and updates to the sustainability network and Senior Leadership teams on environmental compliance and performance status
* Developing clear, professional presentation\-ware for information provision across Reckitt. Strong familiarity with PowerPoint and equivalent
* Delivering presentations to everyone from site\-colleagues to executive level. Provide insights and performance to Reckitt senior leadership to help drive improvements
* Support new starters and newly acquired sites aligning with Reckitt’s environmental information systems and reporting framework.
* Support to comm’s colleagues on sustainability performance, (e.g. via articles and social media messaging).


 Data Systems and Analysis Skills
   

  

* You will be the Reckitt lead across our key data management \& comm’s tools. These include our licensed Enablon system. Our bespoke Glidepath Tool tracking future projections, and Power BI, Rubi and other reporting platforms. Leadership includes coordination with our regional environmental leads and direct site interactions, provide environmental insights and performance to Reckitt senior leadership to help drive improvements, and collaboration with the Global Head of Environment on direction of the above.
* You’ll have a proven track\-record on data management and interpretation over a 5\+ year period, including, conducting data analysis and forecasting, and work with key people to drive change, and overseeing a wider data management team. Ideally in an area of sustainability, but this is NOT essential. Experienced data analytics leadership is.
* Develop techniques to allow retrospective comparisons of historically diverging performance data sets base on previous denominators (e.g. consumer units v’s tonnages)
* Familiar with databases \& data management software(s) – Enablon, Power BI, Excel, SAP, etc.


 Support to Other Teams
   

  

* A maximum of 5% of the time will be spent supporting colleagues in the Human Rights, Environment and H\&S team on Enablon support, including systems change control, campaign launches, dashboard development etc, Enablon 3rd party support and ad hoc training.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

 KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE (Knowledge and experience needed for satisfactory performance of the job)
   

  

* Relevant degree or postgraduate qualification in the accounting/data analytics arena.
* Strong project leadership experience with proven analytical abilities and attention to detail
* Knowledge of data\-reporting software solutions (Enablon, SAP, Ariba, Intertek, Excel etc).
* Environmental experience on the following is an advantage, but not essential: GRI, SASB \& CDP reporting, GHG Protocol Scope 1 and Scope 2 accounting. Plus, familiarity with the wider external reporting landscape (e.g. FTSE, DJSI, integrated reporting, TCFD implementation, SGDs etc).
* Understanding of the FMCG or Healthcare sector is preferred, although again not essential.
* Excellent writing and communication skills.


 PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
   

  

 We are not your average nine\-to\-five. Environment at Reckitt is as demanding as it is rewarding. We’re on a journey to leadership. So, we’re really looking for a self\-starter – someone who likes to roll their sleeves up \& take ownership, who’s persuasive to colleagues, and who can motivate and inspire her/his team from the outset. Your natural organisational skills are essential, as are thriving under pressure without losing sight of the big picture, and who’s attentive to detail. A people person, you should be someone who’s passionate about the power of corporate good to see a more sustainable society. The winning candidate will possess the ability to collaborate, motivate and work effectively with employees across all levels of Reckitt, a ‘data storyteller’ who can inspire a positive culture of business social purpose.
   

  

 j
   

  

* Be persistent and undeterred on encountering obstacles and tracking work through to completion.
* Have clear and concise communications skills, both written and verbal, requiring a good level of English language, with the ability to adapt communications to various audiences.
* Ability to build and maintain knowledge across Reckitt.
* Be willing to travel


 The skills for success
   

  

 Strategic Thinking, Environmental Knowledge, Stakeholder Engagement, Regulatory Compliance, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Reporting and Communication, Environmental Management Systems, Auditing, Risk Management, Sustainable Sourcing, Training and Education, Life Cycle Assessment, Regulatory Knowledge, Human Rights, Due Diligence, International Standards, Stakeholder Collaboration, Training and Capacity Building, Incident Response, Policy Development, Legal Understanding.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Specialist- Value Chain Optimisation
description:
**Role And Impact**
 As a Senior Specialist in Value Chain Optimization, you will be a key member of our Global team, focusing on technology solutions and proprietary hardware. Your role will have a broad impact across the technology value chain, where you will:
   

  

* 
+ Implement governance for Value Engineering (VE), Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA), and Root Cause Analyses (RCA), including reporting standards, follow\-up actions, and handover processes after project completion.
+ Prepare management reports and decision materials for VE, FMECA, and RCA projects.
+ Drive VE initiatives across the portfolio to reduce costs and lead times for technology offerings.
+ Lead hardware robustness initiatives with experts from Global Supply, Global Commercial, and Research and Development (R\&D), including Technology Product Managers, Technology Chief Engineers, Technology Managers, and other specialists.
+ Facilitate RCA sessions to identify root causes, mitigation, and prevention measures for complex problems or critical customer complaints.
+ Train and coach colleagues in facilitation and application of Value Chain Optimization methodologies, ensuring knowledge transfer and capability building across the organization.


 Your work will directly support the optimization of our technology value chain, enhance project outcomes, and strengthen our ability to deliver innovative solutions to customers worldwide.
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 To thrive in this position, you will combine a strong technical foundation with excellent interpersonal and organizational skills. You are comfortable navigating complex technical, industrial, or engineering environments and have a track record of facilitating collaboration and driving results across diverse teams.
   

  

**Specifically, You Will Bring**
* 
+ Proven experience in facilitation, networking, project controls, project support, or management reporting.
+ Strong stakeholder management, cross\-functional communication, and presentation skills.
+ Deep understanding of governance, reporting, risk management, and follow\-up processes.
+ Hands\-on experience leading Value Engineering (VE), Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA) initiatives.


 Your approach is structured and analytical, yet proactive, enthusiastic, and pragmatic. You are skilled at building relationships, mentoring, and coaching others, with expertise in Lean and systematic problem solving. Your ability to create structure across multiple projects and interfaces sets you apart.
   

  

 Additionally, you are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with Power BI, SAP, or similar tools is an advantage. A relevant degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, and formal training in facilitation methodologies or portfolio management will be considered beneficial.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
 At Topsoe, we’re problem solvers. In every role, across every office, you’ll find people passionate about finding the right answers. For over 80 years, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, always focused on solving some of the world’s biggest challenges together. We believe great results start with collaboration and respect, where every idea is heard and can drive real change. You’ll join a team of dedicated experts, united by a commitment to perfecting our craft and delivering real impact. We don’t just promise change – we make it happen. And with your contributions, we’re shaping a more sustainable future with solutions that truly matter.
   

  

 We prioritize the safety and well\-being of our employees and are committed to maintaining a safe work environment where everyone looks out for each other's health and safety
   

  

**Your New Team**
 You will join GS Technology, a global team of project managers, engineers, and specialists who deliver more than 100 technology projects annually to Topsoe customers worldwide. As part of this collaborative and innovative group, you will help optimize the value chain across complex technology deliveries—from engineering design and proprietary hardware to site services, commissioning, and start\-up support. Working closely with Research and Development (R\&D) and cross\-functional teams, you will contribute to scaling innovative solutions within Low Carbon, Renewables, and Clean Air. Our team's success is built on strong technical expertise, a commitment to continuous improvement, and the drive to enhance capabilities, efficiency, and competitiveness across the global value chain.
   

  

**How You Can Apply**
 If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
   

  

**Application deadline:** 
 07\-10\-2026
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
   

  

 To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

title: Consultant – Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit)
description:
Position Code : PHFI\-CNST\-2683
   

  

 Position Title : Consultant – Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit)
   

  

 No. of Positions : 1
   

  

 Working Location : Delhi
   

  

 Duration of Position : 06 Months or co\-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier
   

  

**Brief On The Organization**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) is working towards building a healthier India. It is helping to address the limited institutional and systems capacity in India by strengthening education and training, advancing research and technology and facilitating policy and practice in the area of Public Health. PHFI is headquartered in New Delhi with national presence through its constituent units of regional Indian Institutes of Public Health (IIPHs) and Centers of Applied Research in core public health themes. The Foundation, established in 2006 as a public private initiative, is governed by an independent board comprising of senior government officials, eminent Indian and International academic and leaders, civil society representatives and corporate leaders. For more information, please visit the website w
 **ww.phfi.org** 
 .
   

  

**Project Brief**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) serves as a Sub\-Recipient (SR) under the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GFATM) for the period April 2024 to March 2027, to implement key capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program Phase V (NACP\-V). The project officially commenced on May 1, 2024\. PHFI is responsible for implementing activities under three major components:
   

  

* SR Activity Management HUB
* Capacity Building – Central Region
* Capacity Building – North Region


 As the SR for the SR Activity Management HUB, PHFI will manage and coordinate sub\-recipient activities and provide institutionalized oversight and technical support. This includes performance monitoring, financial management, risk mitigation, and facilitating capacity\-building interventions. The HUB plays a critical role in ensuring horizontal integration at the SACS and NACO levels and acts as a central technical agency for strengthening community systems (CSS), DISHA, and community\-led monitoring (CLM).
   

  

 In the Central and North Regions, PHFI will directly implement capacity\-building activities in line with the project agreement and work plans. These include training, technical assistance, and supportive supervision aimed at enhancing service delivery in HIV prevention, care, and support. The SR ensures effective resource management, collaboration with the Principal Recipient (PR) and stakeholders, and alignment of programmatic goals across all implementation sites.
   

  

 PHFI’s role across these three components emphasizes accountability, technical excellence, and a coordinated approach to achieving the goals of the HIV program under GFATM.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit) supports the planning, coordination, implementation, and monitoring capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) and other public health projects. The Associate Coordinator will also assist in monitoring project progress, facilitating communication among stakeholders, contributing to data analysis and report reporting.
   

  

**Deliverables**
* Support the planning, coordination, and implementation of national, regional, state, and district\-level capacity\-building activities, including training, workshops, orientations, and review meetings.
* Coordinate with National Program Divisions, State AIDS Control Societies (SACS), government departments, implementing partners, technical agencies, and other stakeholders to facilitate timely execution of project activities.
* Assist in developing, reviewing, updating, and disseminating training curricula, facilitator guides, participant handbooks, presentations, job aids, and other learning resources.
* Undertake data analysis (in STATA or R) and review of literature, as and when required, as part of the project.
* Prepare high\-quality technical reports, meeting minutes, concept notes, briefing papers, presentations, progress reports, donor reports, and other project documentation.
* Perform any other task as assigned by the project team and PI.


**Qualification**
**Essential:**
* Master’s Degree in Public Health/ Social Sciences or related field.


**Experience**
 Essential:
   

  

* No prior work experience required; up to 6 months of relevant experience in data analysis and/or literature review is desirable.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Experience in project management, documentation, and coordination activities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

title: Associate Director- TraumaCare
description:
Last date of application: 15 Oct 2026
   

  

 Location: New Delhi
   

  

 Key Partners: Government of India,Skoll Foundation, Mulago Foundation, Cartier, Philanthropy, Škoda Auto Volkswagen India, Hindustan Unilever, BCG India, etc
   

  

 Are you passionate about saving lives and creating lasting impact in healthcare? Are you a clinically trained professional who is excited by the opportunity to shape and scale high impact trauma care and health systems initiatives across India? If so, we invite you to join SaveLIFE Foundation and help transform the Right to Trauma Care into a measurable, accessible, and sustainable reality for every person in India.
   

  

**About SaveLIFE Foundation**
 SaveLIFE Foundation (SLF) is an award\-winning, independent non\-profit organization committed to saving lives on roads across India and the Global South. By combining grassroots action with systems reform, SLF has been at the forefront of introducing landmark road safety innovations—such as India’s Good Samaritan Law and the Zero\-Fatality Corridor (ZFC) model. Our work has helped reduce road crash deaths by up to 67% on some of India’s most dangerous highways and has been recognized by institutions such as the Skoll Foundation, World Bank, and Government of India.
   

  

 At SLF, we believe that road crashes are not accidents—they are preventable tragedies. We are on a mission to prove that loss of life on roads is not a price we must pay for mobility.
   

  

 Join us to help scale this mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 SaveLIFE Foundation is seeking an experienced and mission\-driven leader to spearhead the organisation’s Trauma Care \& Health Systems portfolio, with a particular focus on translating the Supreme Court of India’s landmark 2026 recognition of the Right to Trauma Care as an integral part of the Right to
   

  

 Life under Article 21 into a measurable and scalable system across India.
   

  

 Role and Responsibilities
   

  

**I. Right To Trauma Care – National Implementation**
* Translate the Supreme Court’s directions into a coherent national trauma\-care implementation strategy for SLF;
* Develop State, district and highway\-level implementation roadmaps;
* Identify gaps in trauma\-care systems and prioritise high\-impact interventions;
* Support governments in developing time\-bound implementation plans and mechanisms for monitoring compliance;


**II. Trauma\-Care Network Development**
* Establish (and lead) guidelines for assessments of existing trauma\-care infrastructure, hospitals and referral networks;
* Develop models for trauma\-centre designation, grading and referral;
* Adapt and disseminate guidelines among various relevant stakeholders for facility upgradation based on levels of care;


**III. Ambulance \& Pre\-Hospital Emergency Care**
* Develop a framework and guidelines for assessment and repositioning of ambulance networks
* on National and State Highways (using crash, population, geography and travel\-time data available);
* Establish and monitor response\-time and performance benchmarks;
* Support integration of ambulance systems with 112, GPS/VLTD and relevant emergency\-response platforms;


**IV. Trauma Training \& Capacity Building**
* Develop a national trauma\-care capacity\-building strategy on BLS, ATLS and other recognised trauma\-care training programmes, as appropriate;
* Adapt or develop training and competency frameworks for prehospital and hospital trauma care;
* Establish systems for certification, refresher training, quality assurance and impact
* Measurement;


**V. Government \& Strategic Partnerships**
* Build, manage and represent at Ministry of Health \& Family Welfare; Ministry of Road Transport \& Highways; Government and private hospitals; Medical colleges and trauma centres; Emergency medicine


 and trauma\-care professional bodies; NGOs and civil society organisations; and other agencies
   

  

 Professional Experience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive professional experience, including direct clinical experience in an Emergency Room (ER), Intensive Care Unit (ICU), or dedicated Trauma Department.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering medical or clinical training is essential.
* Experience in the public health, healthcare, or development sector is highly desirable.
* Postgraduate qualification in one or more of the following areas:


 Public Health, Emergency Medicine, Trauma Care, Healthcare/Hospital Management, Public Policy, Development Studies, Health Systems, or a related discipline.
   

  

* An MBBS/medical qualification, MPH, MHA, MBA Healthcare or equivalent is desirable.


 What You’ll Gain
   

  

* A unique platform to lead change at scale, with the ability to directly influence infrastructure and policy in India and beyond.
* The chance to work with India’s only organization that combines system reform with on\-ground action for road safety.
* Cross\-sector exposure across engineering, governance, public health, and civic engagement.
* An entrepreneurial environment that values innovation, courage, and execution excellence.
* An opportunity to be part of a globally recognized movement saving thousands of lives each year.


 SaveLIFE Foundation is for you if you
   

  

* Crave purpose in your work and want to solve real problems for real people.
* Thrive in a high\-performance environment where outcomes matter.
* Are passionate about improving systems through technology and design.
* Want your work to matter—not just for your company, but for your country.


 Personal Characteristics and Desirable Skills
   

  

* Familiarity with social impact frameworks like Theory of Change or Logic Models.
* Experience working with NGOs, development organizations, or social enterprises.
* Ability to work in a collaborative team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Passion for social change and a deep interest in contributing to impactful programs that improve lives.

 As part of Accenture’s Process Excellence organization within Strategy \& Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value — taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
   

  

 You are a senior, process\-driven, industry\-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes — working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end\-to\-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI\-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands\-on design judgment that goes beyond high\-level recommendations — turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent\-first mindset.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Owns end\-to\-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
* Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps — and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
* Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
* Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
* Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.

 Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy \& Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end\-to\-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI\-native / agentic service operating models.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 The Accenture Song practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services – Customer Service team, you will help the world’s leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost\-driven function into an intelligence\-led, AI\-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem — driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C\-suite executives, shape AI\-native service operating models, and lead end\-to\-end transformation for the world’s leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end\-to\-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future\-ready retail service solutions.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Service Strategy \& Advisory**
* Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
* Shape AI\-native service vision, target operating models and multi\-year transformation roadmaps.
* Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value\-realization frameworks.
* Advise boards and C\-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise\-scale change.


**Experience Design**
* Map end\-to\-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
* Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
* Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock\-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
* Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.


**Operating Model \& Process Transformation**
* Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store \& workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
* Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact\-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
* Establish governance frameworks — policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.


**Technology \& AI Transformation**
* Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
* Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
* Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) — intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
* Integrate across order, store and supply\-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS\-enabled field and delivery tracking.
* Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root\-cause analysis capability.


**Human \+ Agentic Operations**
* Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
* Design agents for high\-volume service capabilities — order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
* Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
* Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.


**Enterprise Transformation Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
* Orchestrate multi\-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
* Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.


**Practice Building**
* Develop market\-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
* Coach and mentor consulting teams.
* Support business development and strategic pursuits — collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Song’s Consulting, Technology and Data \& AI teams for delivery.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end\-to\-end value chain — merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in\-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last\-mile fulfilment — and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
* First\-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory\-only) — having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
* Proven track record across service strategy \& advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology \& AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
* Hands\-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery\-exception handling; substitutions, out\-of\-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse\-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi\-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
* Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase\-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score\-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account\-management workflows.
* Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in\-store fulfilment; store\-to\-contact\-centre escalation and case hand\-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
* Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed\-delivery, missed\-slot and delivery\-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns\-to\-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last\-mile SLAs, on\-time performance and partner score\-carding.
* Working knowledge of core retail service processes — order\-to\-delivery, returns \& refunds, complaint \& case management, store\-to\-contact\-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution — with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end\-to\-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
* Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM \& CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge \& case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS\-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root\-cause analytics).
* Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity — reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy \& business rules, approvals \& escalation, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, SLAs \& entitlements, privacy \& consent, security \& access, compliance \& audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics \& bias controls, and data quality \& traceability).
* Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes — customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality \& productivity (first\-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost\-to\-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability \& resilience (in\-stock rate, on\-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
* Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.


**Additional Information**
* Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large\-scale programmes delivered end\-to\-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
* Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
* Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus — CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).

title: GSPANN - SAP Business Transformation Management Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an SAP Business Transformation Management Consultant to help build a connected, data\-driven transformation capability across Enterprise Architecture, business process management and ERP programme delivery.
   

  

 The role is centred on SAP LeanIX and SAP Signavio. SAP LeanIX will be the primary platform for enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, landscape transparency, repository governance and transformation insights. SAP Signavio will be the primary platform for process modelling, process governance, process intelligence and fit\-to\-standard support. Together, these tools will help connect applications, capabilities, processes, initiatives and transformation outcomes.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
 SAP LeanIX and Enterprise Architecture Management :
   

  

* Act as a hands\-on delivery partner for SAP LeanIX, supporting application portfolio management, enterprise architecture management, repository governance and transformation insight.
* Improve the reliability, completeness and usability of LeanIX data through profiling, cleansing, validation, ownership follow\-up and recurring data\-quality controls.
* Support fact\-sheet onboarding, ownership assignment, lifecycle management, taxonomy alignment, business\-capability mapping, technology mapping, interface visibility and initiative linkage.
* Produce dashboards and portfolio insights covering application ownership, lifecycle, technology risk, rationalisation, obsolescence, transformation impact, adoption and data\-quality trends.
* Support application portfolio assessment, modernisation and rationalisation by translating repository data into clear options, risks and recommended actions.
* Strengthen the integration between SAP LeanIX and ServiceNow to improve alignment between enterprise architecture, CSDM 5\.0 concepts, CMDB structures, service ownership and operational technology data.
* Help evolve LeanIX from an APM repository into a broader EAM platform supporting roadmaps, standards, transformation planning, AI inventory and architecture governance.


**SAP Signavio And Process Transformation**
* Support SAP Signavio as the digital process foundation for transformation, including process modelling, process governance, fit\-to\-standard support, process ownership and continuous improvement.
* Work with Process Owners, Product Owners, architects and programme teams to connect business processes to approved applications, business capabilities, initiatives and ERP transformation milestones.
* Facilitate structured process discovery and improvement activities; document decisions, dependencies and follow\-up actions.
* Apply process intelligence and process\-mining concepts to identify variants, bottlenecks, control gaps and improvement opportunities where suitable data is available.
* Translate process insight into implications for application portfolios, architecture roadmaps, programme design and transformation governance.
* BTM Toolchain, WalkMe Incubation and SAP Cloud ALM Collaboration
* Contribute to a joined\-up BTM operating model across SAP LeanIX, SAP Signavio and, over time, WalkMe, with a focus on reusable practices across SAP and non\-SAP ERP programmes.
* Build working knowledge of WalkMe and digital adoption principles to support future incubation, including user journeys, in\-application guidance opportunities, adoption analytics and change enablement.
* Partner with the SAP Cloud ALM specialist to align process, architecture and delivery information, including traceability between process design, requirements, testing, deployment and transformation milestones.
* Support common identifiers, ownership rules, data mappings, synchronisation controls and reconciliation practices across the transformation toolchain.
* Explore innovation opportunities across an agentic BTM toolchain, including automation patterns, AI\-assisted analysis, MCP server concepts, headless paradigms and reusable orchestration between architecture, process and delivery data.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
* 6\+ Years of Relevant experience in enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, business process transformation, SAP or ERP transformation, IT governance, data governance or consulting.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP LeanIX, another recognised enterprise architecture platform, or a substantial architecture repository implementation.
* Experience improving architecture, portfolio or process data through profiling, cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation, ownership engagement and repeatable governance controls.
* Experience with application portfolio assessment, rationalisation, lifecycle management, technology\-risk analysis or transformation roadmap support.
* Working experience with business process modelling, process governance or process improvement; exposure to SAP Signavio, BPMN 2\.0 or process mining is strongly preferred.
* Experience producing dashboards, reports or portfolio insights and translating data into decisions, recommendations and prioritised actions.
* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA or broader ERP transformation programmes is desirable, including non\-SAP ERP


 environments.
   

  

* Exposure to APIs, enterprise\-system synchronisation and LeanIX integration with ServiceNow, with basic understanding of CSDM 5\.0, CMDB principles and service modelling.
* Demonstrated curiosity and practical experimentation with automation, AI\-enabled ways of working, agentic concepts or integration patterns that improve speed, quality and reuse.
* Experience working in global, matrixed or GCC delivery environments is essential.


**Preferred Certifications**
* SAP Certified Enterprise Architecture Consultant SAP LeanIX, strongly preferred or expected after joining.
* SAP Certified Process Management Consultant SAP Signavio, desirable.
* SAP Certified Process Data Analyst SAP Signavio, desirable for candidates with a process\-mining emphasis.
* SAP Certified Solution Transformation Consultant with SAP Cloud ALM, desirable but not core.
* SAP Certified WalkMe Digital Adoption Consultant, future\-facing advantage.
* TOGAF, ArchiMate, BPMN, Lean/Six Sigma, SAP Activate or recognised change\-management qualifications are advantageous.

 Looking for an exceptionally driven
 **Client Servicing Manager**

 **Client Management, Video Production, Creative Thinking, and Project Delivery** 
 .

 **brief → scripting → storyboard → production → post\-production → final delivery** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with video editors, motion graphic designers, animators, and creative teams, ensuring that the output is creatively strong, technically sound, and delivered within timelines.

* Conduct client discussions and translate conversations into clear creative briefs.
* Present ideas, scripts, storyboards, and creative directions confidently.
* Handle feedback professionally and ensure it is translated accurately to the creative team.

**3\. Scripting \& Storyboarding** 



* Participate actively in the conceptualisation, scripting, and storyboarding of video projects.
* Develop and refine video narratives in collaboration with the creative team.
* Understand how to structure a story for different formats and audiences.
* Convert a broad client requirement into a clear visual narrative.
* Communicate ideas through references, moodboards, storyboards, and visual examples.
* Have the ability to explain
 **why** 
 a particular visual or storytelling approach will work.



**4\. Project \& Delivery Management** 



* Own projects from initial briefing to final delivery.
* Coordinate between clients, creative teams, editors, animators, and other stakeholders.
* Create and maintain project timelines and delivery schedules.
* Ensure timely movement of projects through scripting, editing, review, and approval stages.
* Track feedback and revisions systematically.
* Anticipate bottlenecks and proactively resolve issues before they impact delivery.
* Be available and responsive during critical project delivery periods.
* Take ownership of deadlines — not just the communication around them.

 in Client Servicing, Video Production, Creative Production, or Project Management.

 working with an Event Management Company, Video Production House, Creative Agency, or similar content\-driven organisation.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

title: Project Manager(Telecom)
description:
**Project Manager – Telecom Infrastructure**

**Company:** Spectra Televentures

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience:** 6 – 7 Years

**About Spectra Televentures**

Spectra Televentures is a premier telecommunications infrastructure solutions provider. We deliver end\-to\-end, integrated infrastructure deployment and management—spanning Active Infrastructure, Passive Infrastructure, and Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) networks—for leading telecom operators and enterprise clients across India.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a high\-performing **Project Manager – Telecom** with 6 to 7 years of core domain experience to join our team in Gurugram. Serving as the primary right hand to the **Deputy General Manager (DGM) – Telecom**, you will be responsible for driving site\-level execution, resource planning, project timelines, and operational delivery across active, passive, and fiber deployment tracks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Support to DGM:** Act as the strategic and operational right hand to the DGM \- Telecom, assisting in schedule tracking, risk management, client reporting, and cross\-functional team alignment.
* **Turnkey Project Execution:** Manage daily operations and end\-to\-end rollout for active equipment (BTS, microwave, RAN), passive setups (towers, power systems, civil foundation), and fiber networks (OFC laying, blowing, splicing, and FTTH).
* **Vendor \& Field Operations Management:** Direct contractors, field engineers, and OEMs to ensure site execution meets technical specifications, quality standards, and strict timelines.
* **Timeline \& Budget Governance:** Track milestone progress using project management tools, manage project budgets, mitigate delays, and resolve site\-level bottlenecks proactively.
* **Client \& Regulatory Coordination:** Coordinate with telecom client project teams, local authorities, and regulatory bodies to ensure smooth site acquisition, row permissions, and operational compliance.
* **Quality \& SLA Compliance:** Oversee site audits, acceptance testing (AT), and handover processes to ensure complete alignment with SLA commitments and safety norms.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 6 to 7 years of hands\-on project management experience in telecom infrastructure execution.
* **Technical Expertise:** Proven, hands\-on operational background in all three areas: **Active Infrastructure**, **Passive Infrastructure**, and **Fiber Networks (OFC)**.
* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. in Electronics \& Communication (ECE), Electrical, or Telecommunications Engineering. PMP/PRINCE2 certification is a strong plus.
* **Location:** Based in or willing to work full\-time from **Gurugram, Haryana**.
* **Core Skills:** Strong leadership, data\-driven reporting, structured project tracking, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Offer**

* High\-visibility role working closely alongside executive leadership (DGM).
* Competitive salary and performance\-linked incentives.
* Fast\-track career growth within a leading telecom infrastructure ecosystem.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Job Title Strategy Senior Manager**

 EY's Technology Strategy \& Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting\-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business\-led, tech\-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
   

  

**Scope of engagements**
 We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
   

  

* reset, reimagine and re\-think their business and operating models with tech\-enabled, cutting\-edge solutions that re\-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst \& Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high\-profile clients with range of services including:
   

  

* 
+ Tech Strategy \& Vision
+ IT Operating Model optimization
+ Transformation strategy, roadmaps \& blueprints
+ Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
+ Product strategy \& management
+ M\&A due\-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
+ Enterprise Architecture Services


**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**
* Understanding the business strategy \& vision and translating them into enterprise\-wide technology vision \& strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech\-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management

* Significant experience in: 1\) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2\) analysing enterprise\-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3\) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise\-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross\-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights


**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**
* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end\-to\-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business \- IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture\-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS\-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self\-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point\-of\-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C\-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier\-1 B\-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 15\+ years of relevant experience in large\-scale, enterprise\-wide transformations
* 15\+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e\-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep\-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models \& organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT \- business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re\-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next\-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end\-to\-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies


**The following are preferred, but not required:**
* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier\-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C\-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).


**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day\-to\-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive\-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell\-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long\-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Support current\-state assessments, process redesign, gap analysis, and implementation planning activities.
* Prepare business requirements, process documentation, transformation roadmaps, and implementation deliverables.
* Support future\-state process design, governance setup, adoption planning, and benefits tracking for digital procurement initiatives.

**Technology Enablement \& Implementation**
* Support procurement technology implementation programs across planning, design, testing, deployment, training, and adoption phases.
* Participate in functional design discussions, requirement validation, process configuration inputs, testing support, and business readiness activities.
* Support supplier enablement and change management programs to improve adoption and operating discipline.
* Assist with go\-live readiness, issue tracking, user acceptance testing, training coordination, and post\-implementation stabilization.

**Process \& Performance Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency, compliance, operational controls, and user experience.
* Support workflow automation, reporting enhancements, procurement analytics, and process improvement initiatives.
* Track implementation performance, adoption progress, issue resolution, and benefits realization activities.
* Support process standardization, policy alignment, buying channel improvement, and procurement governance enhancements.

title: Global Salesforce Process Owner - Salesforce COE
description:
Date: Sep 23, 2026
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 IVGSSPL Kolkata, IN
