 Governance, Risk \& Controls
   

  

* Establish and manage program governance forums, decision frameworks, escalation paths, and executive reporting rhythms.
* Identify, track, and mitigate program risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Ensure adherence to audit, compliance, information security, change management, and operational readiness requirements.

* Coordinate cross\-team dependencies and facilitate timely resolution of delivery blockers.
* Promote continuous improvement in planning, estimation, delivery predictability, and team operating practices.

* Support capacity planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions across program workstreams.

* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release management, change management, and technology operations.

**Technical Skills**

* SDLC, Release Management, Change Management, DevOps, CI/CD

title: Assoc Content Delivery Lead
description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
   

  

 HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
   

  

 The Content Delivery Lead I supports the planning, organization, and execution of production activities for online professional services content. This hands\-on role independently prepares and quality\-checks content, manages files and media, maintains production tooling, and keeps assigned work moving through established workflows. Success is defined by accurate, high\-quality delivery assets, strong attention to detail, timely follow\-through, and early identification of risks and technical issues.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
 40\-60% of your time will include:
   

  

* Creating, maintaining, and organizing content libraries, including active and archived data and assets, and preparing files, media, and metadata for production readiness.
* Supporting delivery tooling and workflow management across Jira, Smartsheet, Confluence, Salesforce, and Microsoft 365; maintaining accurate trackers, boards, documentation, and status information.
* Conducting detailed quality assurance checks and making trained corrections using tools such as Articulate Rise; validating links, media playback in Brightcove, accessibility, formatting, and functional interactions.


 25\-35% of your time will include:
   

  

* Contributing to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to improve production processes, templates, documentation, and individual workflows, including appropriate use of AI tools to increase productivity and reduce manual effort.
* Preparing and maintaining clear documentation and knowledge\-sharing materials, so processes and production standards are consistent and repeatable.


 15\-25% of your time will include:
   

  

* Technical Diagnostics: identify defects, errors, and delivery issues during QA and production readiness checks; diagnose issues across tools, workflows, and platforms; independently resolve common issues; partner with Senior Delivery Leads and Engineering to validate fixes; verify resolutions; and escalate complex problems appropriately.


**What You’ll Need**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in digital content production, EdTech product delivery, operations, project coordination, or related field.
* Working knowledge of production and workflow tools, with experience learning and working across multiple platforms such as Jira, Smartsheet, Salesforce, Confluence, Microsoft 365, Articulate Rise, and Brightcove.
* Strong problem\-solving and QA skills, including the ability to diagnose common delivery issues, follow established processes, and know when to escalate.
* Strong organizational, written communication, and follow\-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established timelines independently.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment, manage assigned work independently with limited day\-to\-day direction, and communicate risks or blockers early.
* Ability to lead or coordinate small projects with a clearly defined scope.


**Knowledge And Skills (General And Technical)**
* Thorough understanding of digital content production, file management, metadata, and quality assurance principles.
* Excellent written communication and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail, follow\-through, and the ability to work independently.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and demonstrated ability to work across multiple business and content platforms.
* Working knowledge of Jira and Smartsheet, including maintaining boards, trackers, and production status information.
* Familiarity with Lean \& Agile practices.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Confluence, Articulate Rise, Brightcove, and related content or business systems.
* Familiarity with project management and agile delivery principles.
* Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot delivery issues across tools, workflows, content, media, and dependencies.
* Ability to use AI tools appropriately to improve productivity, documentation, QA, and production workflows.

**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.

* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.
   

  

**About Better Cotton Initiative**
 Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.

* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)

****Being you @ Better Cotton****
****Initiative****
 Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.
   

  

 We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Backdrop**AVIZVA is a Healthcare Technology Organization that harnesses technology to simplify, accelerate, \& optimize the way healthcare enterprises deliver care. Established in 2011, we have served as strategic enablers for healthcare enterprises, helping them enhance their overall care delivery.
With over 15 years of expertise, we have engineered more than 150 tailored products for leading Medical Health Plans, Dental and Vision Plan Providers, PBMs, Medicare Plan Providers, TPAs, and more. **Overview of The Role**
As a Scrum Master at AVIZVA, you will be the proud skipper of project\-level Scrum Ceremonies. You will act as a bridge of dialogue between the Scrum Team and other important stakeholders. You will not just spot and voice the potential hiccups in your team’s progress, but you will build solid safeguards by joining forces both within and beyond the team
As an ambassador of Scrum principles and values, you will coach your team to be a devoted Scrum follower. You will master the project scope curriculum and learn the program goal basics. You will team\-up with the Product Owner and make sure that the product backlog is always up to the minute. You will be the face of your Scrum team in cross\-team dependency reviews. **Job Responsibilities*** Acquire a holistic overview of all ongoing projects and initiatives within the allocated program to develop a thorough understanding of the assigned project, its objectives, scope, and alignment with the overall business strategy.
* Consolidate broader program\-level knowledge with deeper project\-level insights to identify significant cross\-team dependencies.
* Act as the primary custodian of Scrum practices and processes for the team.
* Lead the Scrum process by driving a series of Scrum ceremonies, such as Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective, ensuring their effectiveness and alignment with the team's goals.
* Mentor the team by helping them understand Agile practices, Scrum principles, product vision, and scope, empowering them to develop a shared sense of ownership and a continuous drive toward improvement.
* Monitor the project's progress and provide timely feedback to ensure on\-time deliverables, driving clear and transparent communication within the team and with all external stakeholders.
* Identify technical and people\-centered roadblocks and risks that might hinder the team's progress towards deliverables, collaborating with team members and stakeholders to define targeted risk mitigation strategies and proactively eliminate risks.
* Estimate story points and assist the Product Owner in refining and maintaining the product backlog using project management tools, ensuring visibility and transparency for all stakeholders.
* Represent the team in the weekly Scrum of Scrums meeting, presenting a detailed report on the team's progress, achievements in the previous sprint, and alignment with the defined project goals.

title: AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
description:
**Position Title:** 
 AI Deployment \& Enablement Lead
   

  

**Position Type:** 
 Regular \- Full\-Time
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 43595
   

  

**Overview**
 Our Digital Technology team's goal is to leverage technology and data to drive profitable growth, enhance customer experience, and further our purpose of celebrating real connections through delicious, planet\-friendly food.
   

  

 McCain has embarked on an ambitious digital transformation across our business, from Agriculture and Manufacturing to Commercial and Corporate Functions. As part of this transformation, we are making significant investments in digital capabilities, data, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
   

  

 The AI Deployment \& Enablement Lead plays a critical role in helping McCain realize value from AI investments by driving successful deployment, adoption, and business enablement of AI solutions across the enterprise. This role serves as the bridge between AI product teams, technology teams, business stakeholders, and end users to ensure AI capabilities are effectively implemented, embraced, and sustained.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine strong project execution, stakeholder management, change leadership, and business acumen to accelerate adoption of AI\-powered solutions that improve productivity, decision making, employee experience, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Reporting to the AI Deployment \& Enablement Manager, the AI Deployment \& Enablement Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the deployment and adoption of AI solutions across McCain.
   

  

 This role partners closely with product owners, AI engineers, business teams, functional leaders, and change management partners to ensure AI capabilities are successfully launched, effectively utilized, and continuously improved. The role focuses on driving business readiness, user adoption, training, communications, stakeholder engagement, value realization, and operational enablement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilites**
**AI Deployment \& Implementation**
* Lead deployment planning and execution for AI products, tools, and capabilities.
* Coordinate implementation activities across business, technology, and external partners.
* Ensure deployment plans are aligned to business priorities, timelines, and operational readiness requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation activities.
* Support pilot programs, proof\-of\-concepts, and scaled enterprise rollouts.


**Adoption \& Enablement**
* Develop strategies to drive successful adoption of AI solutions across functions and regions.
* Create adoption roadmaps and sustainment plans that encourage long\-term utilization.
* Identify adoption barriers and implement actions to improve user engagement and effectiveness.
* Measure user adoption, engagement, and business outcomes associated with deployed AI solutions.
* Share best practices and success stories to accelerate enterprise\-wide AI maturity.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product teams, and technology teams.
* Translate technical AI concepts into language that is understandable and actionable for business stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment among cross\-functional teams throughout deployment initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor supporting business readiness and organizational adoption.


**Change Management \& Communications**
* Partner with change management and communications teams to create deployment and adoption strategies.
* Design and execute communication plans to support awareness, understanding, and adoption.
* Assess organizational impacts and help stakeholders prepare for new ways of working.
* Support leaders in effectively communicating AI initiatives and benefits to their teams.


**Training \& Learning**
* Identify capability and skill development needs associated with AI adoption.
* Develop and coordinate training materials, learning resources, workshops, and enablement sessions.
* Support the creation of role\-based learning pathways for employees and leaders.
* Foster a culture of responsible AI usage and continuous learning.


**Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure deployments align with McCain's AI governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Gather user feedback and deployment insights to inform future product improvements.
* Track key success metrics and provide reporting on adoption, value realization, and business impact.
* Recommend opportunities to improve deployment methodologies and enablement approaches.


**MEASURES OF SUCCESS**
**AI Adoption**
* Adoption targets achieved for deployed AI solutions.
* Growth in active users and sustained utilization over time.
* Positive user experience and satisfaction scores.


**Business Value**
* Demonstrated business outcomes resulting from AI deployments.
* Improvement in productivity, efficiency, decision quality, or user experience.
* Improved realization of expected benefits from AI investments.


**Stakeholder Satisfaction**
* Positive feedback from business leaders and stakeholders.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and partnership effectiveness.
* Successful management of deployment timelines and expectations.


**Delivery Excellence**
* AI deployments delivered on schedule and within agreed scope.
* Risks and issues identified and managed effectively.
* Consistent application of deployment and enablement standards.


**Job Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Information Systems, Change Management, Organizational Development, or equivalent experience.
* 5\-8 years of experience in technology delivery, product deployment, digital transformation, change management, enablement, or related fields.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology implementations and adoption initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project delivery methodologies and change management practices.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams in global organizations.
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, automation, or digital technologies preferred.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
* Experience developing training, communication, and adoption strategies is considered an asset.


**Other Information**
* Key Internal Relationships
+ AI Product Teams
+ Data \& Analytics Teams
+ Digital Technology Leadership
+ Business Functional Leaders
+ HR and Learning Teams
+ Cybersecurity \& Data Governance Teams
+ Digital Transformation Teams

* Key External Relationships
+ AI platform and technology vendors
+ Consulting and implementation partners
+ Training and enablement providers

description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management, continuous improvement, and operational health of the learning technology stack that powers learner experiences and program delivery.
   

  

 This includes supporting the LMS, key SaaS integrations (e.g., Marketo), reporting and data flows, and custom operational tooling.
   

  

 You will work closely with programming teams, vendors, and firm Learning Technology colleagues to gather requirements, identify enhancement opportunities, maintain platform reliability, and coordinate delivery of technical improvements. You will help define and maintain the product roadmap for the GSR learning technology ecosystem, recommending priorities and enhancements based on user needs, operational considerations, and platform opportunities. You will help with major roadmap decisions, strategic tradeoffs, and platform evolution initiatives will be developed in partnership with and syndicated through the Learning Technology team to ensure alignment with broader firm technology strategy. Your success requires strong technical judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder coordination, and the ability to balance operational excellence with continuous platform improvement in support of the Global Social Responsibility (GSR) mission\-driven learning programs.
   

  

 You will support platform performance, resilience, integrations, security, and vendor\-orchestrated delivery while partnering across program teams, firm functions, and external providers to deliver a high\-quality learner experience at scale.
   

  

 You will help define and maintain the technical product roadmap across the LMS, integrations, reporting, and operational tooling by gathering requirements, prioritizing enhancements, evaluating technical solutions, identifying automation and process improvement opportunities, assessing risks and dependencies, and contributing recommendations for future platform capabilities in partnership with the Learning Technology Product Manager.
   

  

 You will serve as the day\-to\-day steward of the GSR learning technology ecosystem by monitoring platform health, coordinating incident response, supporting root\-cause analysis, maintaining visibility into operational risks and dependencies, and driving continuous service improvement.
   

  

 You will support learner, program, and operational data flows by translating reporting requirements into technical solutions, improving data quality and reporting usability, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
   

  

 You will manage day\-to\-day platform operations, including configuration, integrations, release coordination, change management, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and lightweight technical enhancements while improving platform maintainability and supporting adoption of new capabilities.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for technology vendors by coordinating issue resolution, managing vendor\-delivered enhancements, monitoring service performance, supporting sourcing and renewal decisions, and ensuring alignment with firm technology governance, architecture, and security standards.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* University degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred
* 5\+ years of experience in technical product management, platform operations, enterprise systems, learning technology, or a closely related field
* Experience supporting business\-critical SaaS platforms, integrations, and enterprise technology ecosystems
* Working knowledge of LMS technologies, APIs, SSO/SAML, CRM/marketing automation integrations, data pipelines, reporting platforms, and cloud\-based systems
* Experience with platforms such as Docebo, Marketo, AWS, Domo, Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, or comparable technologies
* Experience managing external vendors and service providers against SLAs, KPIs, roadmaps, budgets, and security/compliance expectations
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize work, manage multiple initiatives, and drive delivery in a fast\-paced environment
* Product management skills, including requirements gathering, backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross\-functional coordination
* Strong technical aptitude with experience supporting platform operations, integrations, automation, reporting workflows, and continuous improvement
* Analytical problem\-solving skills with the ability to leverage data, metrics, structured analysis, and GenAI\-assisted tools to troubleshoot issues and implement practical solutions
* Sound judgment, adaptability, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, build productive partnerships, and escalate strategic decisions appropriately
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager (APM)** 




**SBNRI · Product · \[Gurgaon, in\-office] · \[0–2 years] · \[Full\-time]** 




  





**About SBNRI** 





 35 million NRIs are trying to manage their money from thousands of miles away, and most of them don't trust anyone enough to help. SBNRI is building the company that changes that. We help NRIs in 120\+ countries invest and manage money in India: mutual funds, fixed deposits, taxation, compliance, and repatriation.
 




**The role** 





 You'll own real product problems end to end: figure out what's broken, work out why, ship the fix with Engineering and Design, and measure whether it worked. You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, and leadership.
 





 Problems like the ones you'll work on:
 



* Why does an NRI in Dubai start onboarding and not finish?
* What makes an investor redeem, and what could have kept them?
* Which manual workflows should AI be running instead of people?



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Define winning before you build:** 

 Every initiative starts with a success metric. If you can't say what "this worked" looks like in numbers, it isn't ready.
* **Execution:** 

 Write clear requirements, drive delivery with Engineering and Design, clear blockers, and close the loop. A task is yours until the outcome is delivered, not until you hand it off.
* **Analytics:** 

 Track funnels, adoption, and conversion. Judge features by whether they move the business, not by whether they shipped.
* **Talk to users every week:** 

 Have direct conversations with NRIs across geographies. Dashboards and CS summaries don't replace them. Support tickets and payment failures are requirements we missed, and you'll help trace them to root cause.
* **AI and automation:** 

 Use AI tools daily to research, prototype, and automate. If something is repetitive, your first question should be "why isn't this automated?"
* **Experimentation:** 

 Frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and read results honestly, including when an experiment fails.



  





**What we look for** 





 You don't need PM experience. We look for evidence of how you think and build:
 



* **A product project:** 

 a college project, app, website, or prototype you took from idea to something usable
* **Analytical thinking:** 

 the ability to take apart a product, find a real user problem, and back your fix with reasoning or data
* **AI fluency:** 

 practical use of AI tools to research, prototype, or automate something real
* **Ownership:** 

 a clear example of something you drove to completion, especially when it got hard



  





**How we work** 





 Your work will be challenged, and not in quarterly reviews. It happens in the moment, by the person next to you. A design gets torn apart because an NRI in Dubai would find it confusing. A feature gets sent back because it solves our problem, not the user's. That isn't conflict; it's how craft works when people care.
 





 We don't optimize for comfort. We optimize for the NRI in San Jose at 11pm, trying to figure out if their money in India is safe. That person deserves our best thinking, our fastest execution, and our most obsessive attention to detail.
 





 If that standard feels like pressure, this isn't the right place. If it feels like the point, you'll do the best work of your life here.
 




  





**Why SBNRI** 



* A small team, so your work ships and is visible to leadership from week one
* A rare domain: cross\-border, regulated wealth for a global customer base
* A steep learning curve across product, data, compliance, and growth



  





**How to apply** 





 Email
 
**sanskriti@sbnri.com** 

 with the subject "
 
**Application for Associate Product Manager – SBNRI** 

 ." Include:
 



1. Your resume
2. **One link** 

 to something you've built or analysed. This could be a product teardown, prototype, project, or a short doc on a problem you'd fix in any app you use.



**Applications without the link won't be reviewed.**

title: R&D Engineer 5
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

DP\-COE (Digital Photonics Center of Excellence), being part of Keysight Technologies has the responsibility for developing innovative products in the crucial portfolio segment of Oscilloscopes, Photonics, AWG (Arbitrary Waveform Generator), BERT (Bit Error Rate Tester), Digitizer, Logic Analysis, Protocol Analysis which provide fast, extensive insight and enable engineering teams to do their job faster, with higher quality. We serve our customers in the Computer, Semiconductor, Wireless, Automotive, Storage and Communication, Quantum industries with leading edge products and solutions. Keysight Solution teams work closely with DP\-COE to provide required solutions to these industries.
Responsibilities:

As a Senior Test \& Measurement Software Engineer (AI Solutions), you will work on bringing AI\-powered capabilities into our digital measurement instrument products, in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment with international teams. You will be responsible for designing and developing complex software that combines AI components with high\-performance instrument software, taking architectural direction from our Solutions Architect and delivering production\-ready features with limited day\-to\-day oversight. This is the senior technical position for this team in India, and you will also set the engineering bar locally and provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on site as the team grows.  

You will work closely with the Solutions Architect, R\&D Project Manager, Product Management, software engineers, QA and validation, and other stakeholders to develop new product offerings and improve existing ones. There will be significant ongoing interaction with our design teams located in the United States and Germany, so the candidate should be a strong team worker and should be able and willing to collaborate across sites and time zones.
Qualifications:
**Essential:**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science (or equivalent) with strong software engineering skills.
* Minimum 8 years of software development experience, with at least 3 years in a senior software development role.
* Experience in developing a significant software application.
* Proven mastery of one or more modern software languages such as C\+\+ or C\#.
* Strong foundation in software design patterns, system architecture, and performance optimization for complex multi\-threaded or real\-time systems.
* Expertise with Git and CI/CD pipeline workflows.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience deploying software components in production environments.
* Familiarity with — and a strong desire to learn — AI data flow, including prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, and multi\-step agent reasoning.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently against architectural direction set by a colleague in another time zone, and to mentor less experienced engineers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent team player, responsive and accountable.
* Self\-starter. Willing and able to quickly learn new applications and technologies.
* Experience in international collaboration (US, Europe).
 **Preferred:**  

* Experience with Keysight instruments like oscilloscopes, BERTs or AWGs — or a strong foundation in a closely related measurement or signal\-processing domain with the ability to ramp quickly.
* Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration toolkits.
* Experience building multi\-agent systems or custom orchestration layers, including agent roles, tool calls, memory, and reasoning loops.
* Experience deploying AI/ML models on edge or embedded platforms, including model quantization, pruning, and on\-device inference optimization.
* Knowledge of hardware/software integration, FPGA data pipelines, or low\-level driver interfaces relevant to AI\-assisted signal processing.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, explainability tooling (SHAP, LIME, attention visualization), and responsible AI practices.
* Experience implementing secure AI data flows with attention to data integrity and traceability.
* Atlassian tool experience — Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira.
* Scrum agile software development process background.
* Test\-driven development experience.
* Prior experience as the senior engineer at a satellite or secondary engineering site.

title: Product Designer
description:
Namma Yatri is a
 **Mobility\-as\-a\-Service (MaaS)** 
 platform built to empower drivers and provide seamless, frictionless ride experiences for users. We’re not just another ride\-hailing app — we’re reimagining urban mobility from the ground up, with drivers at the center and intuitive design as our backbone.
 



  





 We’re crafting thoughtful, scalable, and elegant design solutions that drive real\-world impact in ride\-hailing, multimodal transportation and public utilities. We are currently seeking a Product Designer with 1\-3 years of product design experience to join our team. You will work closely with other designers, developers, business leads, city operations managers and product managers to build great interfaces. We embrace big\-picture thinkers who also enjoy the finer details of day\-to\-day activities.
 



  





**We want to hear from you if:** 




 You’re the type of person who says “there’s a simpler way to design this”.
 



 You like to find the most unique solutions to complex problems.
 



 You like to nerd out on software design, the history \& future of it.
 



  





 Most importantly, if you’re willing to show up, get your artsy hands colored, and create all things beautiful \& impactful, we want to hear from you.
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR** 




 ● Understand user problems, business goals, and operational challenges to design meaningful product experiences.
 



 ● Craft intuitive, user\-centered designs that deliver seamless and thoughtful experiences, while continuously refining them based on user insights and feedback.
 



 ● Create and hand off production\-ready animations and micro\-interactions (e.g. Lottie assets) to support high\-quality product implementation.
 



 ● Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, engineering, marketing, data, and operations to craft delightful experiences that deliver real value to users.
 



 ● Design intuitive and scalable experiences for both consumer\-facing products and internal tools/platforms.
 



 ● Prototype ideas rapidly using modern AI\-assisted workflows, no\-code tools, and interaction design tools when needed.
 



 ● Work closely with engineers to ensure high\-quality implementation and smooth product delivery.
 



 ● Translate user research, analytics, and feedback into actionable design improvements.
 



  





**YOUR EXPERIENCE SHOULD SHOWCASE** 




 ● 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in product design at a digital product company or agency.
 



 ● Ability to translate complex problems into intuitive user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces.
 



 ● Strong portfolio showcasing end\-to\-end product thinking, UX problem solving, and visual design craft.
 



 ● Experience designing for mobile applications (Android/iOS) and responsive web platforms.
 



 ● Ability to clearly communicate design rationale, decisions, and tradeoffs to cross\-functional teams.
 



 ● Comfort working in fast\-moving environments with evolving priorities.
 



 ● A user\-first mindset with a strong understanding of usability, accessibility, and inclusive design principles.
 



 ● Empathy and strong collaboration skills—you’re open to feedback and also a constructive critic.
 



  





**TOOLS EXPERTISE** 




 ● Strong proficiency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows.
 



 ● Familiarity with interaction and prototyping tools such as LottieFiles, Jitter, Rive, or similar platforms.
 



 ● Familiarity with AI\-assisted design and productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar platforms.
 



  





**BONUS POINTS IF:** 




 ● You enjoy bringing ideas to life through motion, micro\-interactions, illustrations, or visual storytelling.
 



 ● You like prototyping and building interactive experiences using code, AI\-assisted workflows, or modern vibe coding tools.
 



 ● You’ve contributed to design communities through talks, writing, workshops, or open source/design initiatives.
 



 ● You’ve worked on data\-rich interfaces, operational dashboards, or products designed for non tech\-savvy users.
 



 ● You actively experiment with emerging AI workflows and explore how AI can enhance product experiences.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
**About EarnIn** 

 As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.
 



 We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.
 


**POSITION SUMMARY**
 We're looking for a highly creative and self\-motivated Senior Product Designer to join EarnIn's Financial Intelligence Platform team. This is a structured, quality\-focused group responsible for designing and improving the foundational experiences that power EarnIn's modern platform for financial flexibility and financial wellness for its community members. You'll work closely with product, engineering, design, compliance, risk, and finance partners to define and drive design excellence across core features like bank connectivity, earnings tracking, and repayment experiences. This role bridges deep design leadership with cross\-functional execution, championing both customer and business value while ensuring quality, simplicity, and regulatory compliance. Your work will directly influence customer satisfaction and retention across our core experiences. This position will be a hybrid role based in our Bengaluru office, with 2 days on\-site as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Palo Alto HQ. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 
* Design and refine core experiences across the full customer journey—from bank connection and account setup to earnings tracking and repayment experiences
* Partner with PMs, engineering, and data teams to define design requirements and validate solutions through research and usability testing
* Establish and maintain design patterns and systems that ensure consistency and simplicity across Financial Intelligence Platform features
* Identify friction points in critical flows and design thoughtful solutions that improve usability, clarity, confidence, and compliance
* Leverage research findings and customer feedback to inform design strategy and prioritize improvements that deliver measurable impact
* Champion quality and polish, ensuring every interaction reflects EarnIn's commitment to reliability, trust, and regulatory standards
* Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, and Finance teams to ensure designs meet industry and regulatory requirements
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and design excellence within the team


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 
* 7\+ years of experience designing consumer\-facing digital products, with demonstrated success on core experiences or core functionality
* A strong portfolio showcasing thoughtful problem\-solving, systematic design, and measurable improvements to user satisfaction and retention
* Deep understanding of financial products, user trust, and how to design for clarity in complex workflows
* Ability to balance creative thinking with research\-driven validation, comfortable collaborating with data teams to measure impact
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills, particularly in articulating design rationale to cross\-functional stakeholders at all levels
* Skilled in Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design workflows
* Comfortable in structured environments where roadmaps are planned across product areas, with the ability to drive projects to completion
* Passion for solving real customer problems and improving financial wellness for everyday people
* Background in systems design, design patterns, or design operations preferred
* Experience improving user satisfaction and retention metrics through design\-driven solutions is preferred


 A Note on AI in the Hiring Process: EarnIn may use Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-powered tools during the hiring process, including tools that generate summaries or notes for interviewers, review resumes, assist with scheduling, or help identify themes across candidate responses and profiles for a given role. Final hiring decisions are made by human interviewers and hiring managers. If you have any concerns about the use of AI in our hiring process, please connect with your recruiter. With your consent, EarnIn may use AI tools to help transcribe or summarize interviews. Recordings are treated as confidential candidate data and are accessible only to authorized hiring personnel. Declining to be recorded will not negatively affect your candidacy or evaluation.
 
  
 



 At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E\-Verify participant. 
 



  
 



 EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**About Wirality755**
**Wirality** 
 is building a new social\-first creative team designed for the way brands need to communicate today \- faster, more frequently and across more formats, audiences and platforms.
   

  

 755 is built for a world where brands need to create more content, for more audiences, across more platforms without treating every piece of content like a traditional advertising campaign.
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Graphics Designer** 
 who doesn’t believe their job ends with making something look good.
   

  

 You should be able to take an idea and figure out how to bring it to life \- whether that means designing a social post, creating a visual identity for a content series, animating typography, cutting a reel or figuring out the visual language for an entire campaign.
   

  

 This isn’t a role where you’ll sit on one side of the creative pipeline.
   

  

 You’ll move between design, motion and video depending on what the idea needs.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who is hands\-on, fast, visually sharp and comfortable figuring things out.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design at the Speed of the Internet


 Social doesn’t give you three weeks to perfect every creative.
   

  

**You’ll Be Expected To**
* Create social content, campaign assets, digital creatives, presentations and other brand communication.
* Turn ideas into strong visual executions quickly.
* Develop visual routes rather than simply executing layouts.
* Adapt ideas across formats, platforms and brand requirements.
* Work across multiple brands and projects without letting the quality fall apart.
* Know when something needs polish and when something simply needs to get out into the world.


 Speed matters. But speed without taste doesn’t.
   

  

* Think Beyond Static


 We don’t want someone whose creative process stops when Photoshop closes.
   

  

**You Should Be Comfortable Moving Between**
* Static design.
* Motion graphics.
* Typography.
* Animation.
* Short\-form video.
* Reels.
* Social edits.
* Creator content.


 You should understand how movement, transitions, typography, footage and sound can come together to make an idea more engaging.
   

  

 Sometimes the answer is a beautifully designed static.
   

  

 Sometimes it’s a 6\-second edit.
   

  

 Knowing the difference is part of the job.
   

  

* Develop Visual Ideas, Not Just Assets


 You won’t always be handed a fully formed visual direction.
   

  

**You Should Be Able To**
* Take a creative thought and figure out what it should look like.
* Develop visual languages for campaigns and content properties.
* Find interesting references and turn them into something original.
* Think about composition, typography, movement, imagery and storytelling together.
* Work with copywriters and strategists to make an idea stronger visually.
* Push back when you think there’s a better way to execute something.


 We want someone who asks “What could this become?” rather than only “What size should this be?”
   

  

* Live on the Visual Internet


 Your reference folder should probably be slightly out of control.
   

  

**You Should**
* Constantly consume visual culture, creators, design, film, photography and internet content.
* Understand what’s visually working across Instagram, YouTube and emerging social formats.
* Follow interesting designers, editors, creators, filmmakers and visual storytellers.
* Understand trends without blindly reproducing them.
* Bring references and new visual approaches into brainstorms.
* Recognise when a brand should participate in a visual trend \- and when it should do something completely different.


 Being culturally current is as important as being technically capable.
   

  

* Understand Video \& Production


 You don’t need to be a cinematographer.
   

  

 But you should understand what happens before the footage lands on your laptop.
   

  

**That Means Having**
* A basic understanding of cameras and production workflows.
* An understanding of framing, composition and lighting.
* Comfort working around shoots.
* An understanding of how footage should be captured for the intended edit.
* The ability to think about post\-production while something is being shot.
* An understanding of how shooting, editing, motion and design come together in the final output.


 The closer design and production work together, the better the final work becomes.
   

  

* Own the Output


 While this is a hands\-on creative role, you’ll also help maintain the quality and pace of the team’s output.
   

  

**That Could Mean**
* Helping assign and coordinate creative tasks.
* Reviewing work from junior designers.
* Giving clear visual feedback.
* Maintaining consistency across a brand’s output.
* Working closely with copywriters, strategists, creators, editors and account teams.
* Jumping into an execution yourself when that’s the fastest way to solve the problem.


 We don’t want someone who wants to graduate out of making things.
   

  

 You should still enjoy opening the file and doing the work.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 You should ideally have 2 \- 4 years of experience across design, art, motion, creative or a similar role.
   

  

**More Importantly, You Should Be Someone Who**
* Has a strong visual eye and knows what good design looks like.
* Can take an idea and figure out how to make it work visually.
* Is a generalist by nature rather than someone determined to stay in one lane.
* Can move comfortably between static, motion and video.
* Can work at a high pace without sacrificing basic craft.
* Is constantly collecting references and consuming visual culture.
* Understands social media as a creative canvas, not just somewhere assets get uploaded.
* Can collaborate closely with writers and strategists.
* Can give and receive feedback without ego.
* Can help younger designers improve their work.
* Is comfortable figuring things out without waiting for a perfectly defined brief.
* Cares about the idea as much as the execution.


**Tools**
**Required**
 You should be highly comfortable with:
   

  

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Premiere Pro


 Working knowledge of tools such as Figma and DaVinci Resolve is an advantage.
   

  

 We care about what you can make more than the number of software logos you can put on your CV.
   

  

**What We Care About**
 We care less about whether you’ve previously been called a Graphic Designer, Visual Designer, Motion Designer or Art Director.
   

  

 We care about your eye, your taste, your ideas and your ability to make things.
   

  

 Show us the static you’re proudest of.
   

  

 Show us the reel you edited.
   

  

 Show us the motion experiment nobody asked you to make.
   

  

 Show us the campaign where you helped shape the visual language.
   

  

 Show us something weird you made because you wanted to see if it would work.
   

  

 Your portfolio will tell us more than your designation will.
   

  

 Skills: video,motion,adobe premiere pro,design

title: Senior Software Engineer Frontend
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
 Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
   

  

**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer\-Frontend to join the team.
   

  

**The Problem We're Solving**
 Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self\-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi\-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
   

  

 The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct\-tape together a few API calls and call it production\-ready.
   

  

**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**
* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self\-hosted models, custom tools, and agents


**AI Gateway** 
 is the control plane: five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
   

  

 We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build, enhance, and maintain intuitive, high\-performance front\-end applications.
* Collaborate with the design and backend teams to translate ideas into seamless user experiences.
* Write clean, reusable, and well\-documented code.
* Optimize components for maximum speed and scalability.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment processes.


**Requirements**
* 4–8 years of experience with strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and React.js.
* Strong understanding of web fundamentals – HTML5, CSS3, DOM manipulation.
* Experience with REST APIs and integrating front\-end with back\-end services.
* Knowledge of modern build tools and version control (Webpack, Babel, Git).
* Passion for building beautiful, responsive, and user\-centric interfaces.


**Bonus Points**
* Experience with Next.js, TypeScript, or state management libraries (Redux, Recoil, Zustand).
* Familiarity with UI/UX best practices and design systems.
* Previous experience in a startup or fast\-paced environment.


**Traits we are looking for:** 
 Ownership, ability to execute, hustle and think out of the box, data\-driven decision making, be comfortable with more unknowns than knowns.
   

  

**Perks of Working at TrueFoundry**
* Join a fast\-growing Series A, Bay Area\-based startup building cutting\-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

title: Senior Engineer- React
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Energy Systems**
 We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production\-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital \& Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
   

  

 This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification \& Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
   

  

 This is not a project\-based delivery or staff\-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with our UX Designer, Backend Engineers, Product leadership, Data \& AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security \& Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI\-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
   

  

 The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft\-oriented full\-stack environment. The primary stack includes React, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind CSS, and a modern .NET backend on Azure, with project management in Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
   

  

 This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low\-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.
   

  

 This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role\-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Engineering \& Delivery**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across web applications, user interfaces, and platform integrations.
* Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production\-ready software.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions.
* Write clean, well\-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long\-term product quality and team velocity.
* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.


**React Application Development**
* Build responsive, reusable, and accessible frontend experiences using TypeScript, React, Redux, and Tailwind CSS, integrated with secure and maintainable .NET backend services.
* Use the established design system and contribute to its continual improvement.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real\-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Build reusable components that make data, AI outputs, workflow status, and platform capabilities accessible within the user experience.
* Integrate data\-driven, search, agentic, and AI\-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well\-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.


**Modern Development \& AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM\-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI\-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.


**DevOps, Reliability \& Security**
* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.


**Collaboration \& Technical Ownership**
* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data \& AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team


 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 \*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
   

  

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong experience developing production web applications using modern full\-stack technologies.
* Strong production experience developing frontend applications using React and TypeScript, particularly for real\-time collaborative applications.
* Experience consuming REST APIs and contributing to the design of new REST APIs.
* Experience building, modernizing, or operating scalable web applications in production environments, especially applications that support complex workflows, collaboration, reporting, document review, or customer\-facing delivery.
* Experience developing, deploying, and supporting cloud\-hosted applications, with practical experience in Microsoft Azure strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices.
* Demonstrated experience using AI\-assisted development tools or LLM\-enabled coding workflows to improve development productivity.
* Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Reliability, and cross\-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.


**What Is Preferred**
* Experience in working with C\# code.
* Experience with AI integration technologies such as AG\-UI.
* Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q\&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications.
* Experience of working with a real\-time collaborative system.
* Experience in product\-led or platform\-based organizations.
* Familiarity with low\-code or hybrid development environments.
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Experience with multi\-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience with multi\-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or integrating acquired software products into a broader enterprise platform.


 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.

 **Sr Product Designer** 
 to join our stellar design team. The ideal candidate for this role is an experienced digital product designer who excels in highly collaborative environments, is proficient in modern design tools (we're a Figma\-first organization), and consistently delivers high\-quality experiences in complex problem spaces. title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
***Sr Graphic Designer***




  




* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo is India's most influential
 **culture\-led tattoo and art brand** 
 , and a category creator in how tattooing is experienced, respected and scaled.
 



 Founded with the belief that tattooing is not just a service but a
 **transformational art form** 
 , Aliens Tattoo has grown into a multi\-city ecosystem spanning premium tattoo studios, education, digital products and community\-driven platforms.
 



 Today, we are valued at ₹350\+ Cr, operate across multiple cities in India, and are powered by 160\+ artists, creatives, technologists and operators.
 



 We lead at the intersection of
 **art, culture, self\-expression and business** 
 .
 



 Aliens Tattoo didn't follow a category —
 **we built one** 
 .
 



 And as the brand grows, design becomes even more important.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Senior Graphic Designer** 
 who understands that great design is not simply about making beautiful assets. It is about building a visual language that people recognise, remember and want to engage with.
 



 This role is for someone who lives and breathes
 **digital\-first brand design** 
 . Someone with strong fundamentals, sharp visual judgment and the ability to turn an idea, brief or business objective into work that feels distinctive, relevant and unmistakably Aliens.
 



 You will work across campaigns, social, digital platforms, launches, brand initiatives and visual systems — while helping shape how Aliens looks and feels as it continues to scale.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



**Build the visual language of Aliens and raise the creative standard of everything we put into the world.** 




 You will own the development of high\-quality digital and brand creatives across social media, campaigns, websites, landing pages and other digital touchpoints.
 



 You will translate business and marketing objectives into strong visual concepts, build scalable design systems and ensure consistency across every expression of the brand.
 



 But this is not an execution\-only role.
 



 We expect you to
 **think before you design** 
 .
 



 You will be expected to challenge weak ideas, bring stronger alternatives, experiment with new visual directions and contribute to the creative thinking behind campaigns.
 



 You will balance
 **creativity with clarity, experimentation with brand consistency, and speed with quality** 
 .
 



 Success in this role will not be measured by the number of creatives you produce.
 



 It will be measured by the
 **quality of the thinking, strength of the design, consistency of the brand and impact of the creative work you deliver.** 




  




* **What you'll be doing**



 Make the Brand Impossible to Ignore\- Create digital\-first campaigns, social creatives, key visuals, website assets and launch communication that make Aliens visually distinctive and culturally relevant.
 



 Turn Ideas into Visuals\- Take a brief, business objective or half\-formed idea and turn it into a strong visual concept. Challenge the obvious, explore new directions and bring fresh creative thinking to the table.
 



 Build the Aliens Look\- Evolve typography, colour, layouts, templates and visual systems that make every Aliens touchpoint feel connected, recognisable and unmistakably us.
 



  





 Own the Work\- Take projects from
 **brief → concept → design → feedback → final delivery** 
 . Manage timelines, priorities and quality without waiting to be chased.
 



  





  





 Create With People, Not in Isolation\- Partner with marketing, copy, photography, video and other creative teams. Present your thinking, challenge constructively and turn feedback into better work.
 



 Use Every Tool in the Box\- Work confidently across Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, and use AI tools such as Midjourney and Firefly to accelerate exploration, ideation and execution — without compromising design fundamentals.
 



 Raise the Creative Bar\- Bring strong taste, curiosity and attention to detail to everything you create. Stay inspired by
 **art, culture, fashion, music and visual trends** 
 and constantly push the quality of the work forward.
 



 Bring the Brand to Life\- Extend the visual language beyond screens when needed — from studio signage and posters to other physical brand touchpoints.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We’re looking for a
 **designer who thinks beyond the canvas** 
 — someone with 5–9 years of experience who understands that great design is not just about making things look good, but about making people
 **feel, notice and remember** 
 something. You have strong fundamentals in typography, colour, composition and visual hierarchy, but you’re not afraid to break the rules when the idea demands it.
 



 You know how to take a business objective, a rough thought or an unexpected brief and turn it into a visual idea worth talking about. You care about
 **brand, culture and craft** 
 , have a sharp visual eye, and naturally question work that feels ordinary. You’re comfortable moving between campaigns, social, digital experiences, brand systems and physical touchpoints — while making sure everything still feels unmistakably Aliens.
 



 You should be someone who
 **owns the work from thought to finish** 
 , works comfortably with marketing, copy, photography and video teams, and can explain
 *why* 
 a design works — not just what it looks like. You’re fluent in tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Figma, curious about AI and new creative technologies, and smart enough to use them as extensions of your thinking rather than substitutes for it.
 



 Most importantly, you’re
 **curious by nature** 
 . You look at art, fashion, music, culture, architecture, brands and the world around you for inspiration. You have taste, but you’re not trapped by it. You experiment, learn quickly, take feedback without losing your point of view, and care deeply about raising the creative standard of everything you put your name on.
 



  





  





**What success looks like** 



* Digital creatives consistently meet a high visual and brand\-quality standard.
* Campaign and social outputs are distinctive, relevant and aligned with the intended objective.
* Aliens maintains a consistent and recognisable visual language across digital touchpoints.
* Brand systems, templates and design frameworks make creative execution more scalable and consistent.
* Creative concepts demonstrate original thinking rather than simply following existing trends.
* Projects are delivered within agreed timelines with minimal avoidable rework.
* Design projects move from brief to final delivery with clear ownership and minimal supervision.
* Stakeholder feedback is incorporated efficiently while protecting creative quality.
* The designer becomes a strong creative partner to Marketing and other teams rather than functioning only as an execution resource.
* Modern tools and AI\-assisted workflows improve creative efficiency without compromising fundamental design quality.
