title: Lead UX Writer
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What does success look like**
 Sprinklr’s multi\-product platform is undergoing rapid unification and accelerated AI innovation. To support this transformation, we need a Lead Content Designer / User Experience (UX) Writer in India who can lead content strategy for complex product areas while helping teams make AI\-powered, agentic workflows easier
   

  

 to understand, trust, and use.
   

  

 This role shapes content direction across product areas, influences cross\-functional product decisions, and ensures customer interactions — from buttons and flows to AI explanations, agent actions, and onboarding — are clear, consistent, accessible, and aligned to Sprinklr’s unified platform experience. Mission: Lead and operationalize Sprinklr’s content architecture, AI interaction standards, and product language systems across priority product suites. Set direction, mentor others, and deliver scalable patterns that reduce friction, reinforce clarity, and make Sprinklr’s platform easier to learn, use, and trust.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Content Design \& UX Writing
   

  

* Lead content design for complex workflows across Social, Service, Insights, Marketing, and AI powered product experiences.
* Translate complex enterprise concepts — routing, permissions, case resolution, AI actions, analytics, and agentic workflows — into clear, action\-oriented language and reusable product patterns.
* Set a high bar for UX writing craft across clarity, brevity, accessibility, localization, consistency, and user intent while keeping content practical for fast\-moving product teams.


 Content Systems \& Standards
   

  

* Own and evolve cross\-product voice, tone, terminology, taxonomy, and reusable content patterns that scale across product suites and pods.
* Partner with Design System teams to define, document, and drive adoption of content standards for actions, errors, confirmations, states, empty states, guidance, and AI interactions.
* Lead naming, taxonomy, and information architecture decisions that clarify how customers understand and navigate the platform.


 AI \+ Human Collaboration \& Agentic Workflows
   

  

* Lead language strategy for prompts, agent actions, generative content, system explanations, recommendations, automation handoffs, and human\-in\-the\-loop intervention points.
* Define patterns that help users understand what AI is doing, why it is doing it, what confidence signals matter, and how to review, override, or intervene.
* Establish AI content standards that build trust through transparency, explainability, appropriate guidance, and responsible user control.


 Cross\-functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, Research, Documentation, Design Systems, AI/Data Science, Customer Success, Support, and global stakeholders to align content strategy with customer and business outcomes.
* Provide narrative clarity for product strategy, demo flows, onboarding, AI experiences, and internal product understanding.
* Guide discovery, prototyping, validation, usability testing, design reviews, and product reviews so content quality is considered early and consistently.
* Mentor designers, writers, and product partners on content strategy, UX writing craft, AI interaction language, and scalable decision\-making without taking ownership away from pod teams.
* Facilitate content critiques, pattern reviews, and working sessions that help teams make better content decisions without creating bottlenecks.


 Information Architecture \& Experience Clarity
   

  

* Lead decisions on navigation labels, object names, workflow language, taxonomy, and information hierarchy across complex product areas.
* Reduce cognitive load by shaping user\-aligned mental models, clearer information hierarchy, and consistent language across connected workflows.


 Governance \& Reusability
   

  

* Create lightweight governance models that help distributed pods adopt consistent content patterns through clear standards, review practices, and reusable documentation.
* Identify and drive opportunities for reuse, consolidation, simplification, and improved delivery velocity across the platform.


 Expected Outcomes
   

  

* Unified content standards adopted: Voice, tone, terminology, taxonomy, and reusable content patterns adopted across priority product areas.
* Cross\-suite consistency: Clear, cohesive language across Social, Service, Marketing, and Insights.
* AI and agentic content standards: Trust cues, action/explanation models, prompt frameworks, review states, and intervention patterns for generative and agentic interactions.
* Improved experience clarity: Reduced support tickets, fewer user errors, and smoother onboarding pathways.
* Operational efficiency: Faster design and Product Management (PM) delivery cycles through reusable patterns.
* Team enablement: Designers, PMs, and writers make stronger content decisions through mentorship, standards, critiques, and reusable guidance.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Comprehension ↑: Improved task success, clarity, and reduced user hesitation or confusion.
* Consistency ↑: Broader adoption of content standards and pattern libraries across pods.
* Time\-to\-value ↓: More intuitive workflows with fewer clarifying tooltips, walkthroughs, or docs required.
* AI trust ↑: Higher engagement with AI\-driven actions and increased user confidence.
* Velocity ↑: Faster iteration for designers and Product Management (PM) due to stronger content guidance and systems.


**What Makes You Qualified**
* 10\+ years of practical experience in UX writing, content design, product content strategy, or related product experience work for complex SaaS, enterprise, platform, startup, agency, or equivalent product environments.
* Portfolio demonstrating lead\-level impact through complex product content strategy, UX writing, workflow clarity, systems thinking, research\-informed decisions, cross\-functional influence, shipped enterprise or SaaS work, and measurable product or business outcomes.
* Proven experience leading product content strategy across complex workflows, platforms, or multiproduct ecosystems.
* Strong information architecture and taxonomy skills, including navigation models, object naming, terminology systems, content hierarchy, and user mental models.
* Working knowledge of design systems, including reusable content patterns, component guidance, interaction states, governance, documentation, and adoption across distributed product teams.
* Strong skill in simplifying dense, technical, or multi\-step workflows.
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, Research, Design Systems, and global stakeholders across distributed teams.
* Proven ability to mentor designers, writers, interns, new hires, and product partners while raising the quality of content decisions across teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of AI\-first product experiences, agentic workflows, generative content, explainability, trust cues, accessibility, user control, and human\-in\-the\-loop interaction patterns.
* Clear understanding of accessibility, localization, and writing for a global audience.
* Comfort using modern product design and collaboration tools, including Figma, FigJam, Figma Dev Mode, design systems, prototyping tools, Jira, Confluence, and AI\-assisted design or research tools.
* Equivalent practical experience is welcome, including experience gained through product roles, startups, agencies, freelance work, bootcamps, internships, academic projects, SaaS teams, or adjacent content, design, research, documentation, or product strategy work.


**Preferred**
* Deep experience applying content strategy to AI\-powered products, generative content, intelligent workflows, agentic systems, or enterprise automation.
* Background in enterprise software, SaaS, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), insights/analytics, CRM, marketing technology, social platforms, or content systems.


**Collaboration Model**
 Lead individual contributor (IC) within Product Experience (PX), responsible for setting content direction, influencing cross\-functional product decisions, mentoring others, and scaling content quality through standards, systems, and reusable guidance.
   

  

 Works closely with:
   

  

 Design, Research, Documentation, Product Management, Engineering, QA, AI/Data Science, Design Systems, Product Marketing Management (PMM), Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and global stakeholders.
   

  

 This India\-based role works in a distributed, global model. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously and occasionally overlapping with U.S. Pacific Time\-based stakeholders for key design reviews, planning discussions, and cross\-functional alignment
   

  

**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Senior Associate- Business Growth
description:
**Senior Associate – Growth \& Marketing \| Native** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Native Growth \& Marketing team, you will own some of the biggest growth levers for Native—from identifying where growth will come from to building the plan, launching it, measuring the impact, and scaling what works.
 



 Native is building a new\-age consumer brand across categories such as Water Purifiers and Smart Door Locks. In this role, you will get the opportunity to work at the intersection of
 **business, marketing, product and consumer behavior** 
 , with a direct line of sight to revenue.
 



 You will be expected to think like a business owner. That means you won't just receive a campaign brief and execute it—you will help define
 **what problem we need to solve, what the right growth lever is, how we should solve it, and how we know it worked.** 




 You will work across the entire growth funnel—from product and pricing to discovery, conversion and retention—and take initiatives from
 **0 → 1 → scale** 
 .
 



 If you are looking for a role where you can take ownership early, see the direct impact of your work on the business, and learn how to build and scale a D2C brand, this is for you.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 1\. Find the Next Growth Opportunity
 



 A big part of your role will be figuring out
 **where the next unlock is** 
 .
 



 You will:
 


* Deep dive into business and funnel data to identify opportunities and bottlenecks.
* Understand consumer behavior and speak to users to uncover what is driving—or preventing—conversion.
* Identify opportunities across product, assortment, pricing, offers, merchandising, channel experience and retention.
* Turn insights into clear hypotheses and action plans.
* Take ownership of solving the problem, not just reporting it.



 For example: Why are users dropping off? Why is one product converting better than another? Is the issue pricing, messaging, trust, discovery or the product experience? What should we test next?
 



  





 2\. Own GTM and Demand Generation End\-to\-End
 



 You will independently drive campaigns and growth initiatives from
 **strategy to execution to optimization** 
 .
 



 This includes:
 


* Identifying the objective and growth opportunity.
* Defining the target audience and proposition.
* Building the campaign and channel strategy.
* Planning budgets and expected outcomes.
* Working with internal teams to develop creatives and landing experiences.
* Setting up campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google and YouTube.
* Managing campaigns on a day\-to\-day basis.
* Tracking performance and making optimization decisions.
* Scaling successful campaigns and shutting down what isn't working.



 You will not be limited to coordinating execution. You will have the opportunity to understand how paid growth actually works—from campaign planning and setup to performance management and scale.
 



  





 3\. Own Revenue Growth Across Key Levers
 



 You will work on the levers that directly impact Native's revenue.
 



 Product \& Offering
 


* Identify opportunities to improve assortment, bundling, product positioning and merchandising.
* Improve how products are discovered and presented across e\-commerce platforms.
* Work on reviews, ratings, content and other conversion levers.
* Identify gaps in the customer journey and drive improvements.



 Pricing \& Offers
 


* Analyze pricing and conversion trends to identify opportunities.
* Build and test offers across products, channels and campaigns.
* Understand the trade\-off between discounting, conversion and revenue.
* Continuously iterate to improve offer effectiveness.



 Channel Experience
 


* Improve how Native is experienced across app/storefronts, landing pages, paid channels and CRM.
* Work on propositions, messaging and creatives to improve CTR and CVR.
* Identify and solve friction points across the purchase journey.



  





 4\. Build and Scale the Full Customer Funnel
 



 Your ownership won't end once a campaign goes live.
 



 You will work across the full funnel:
 



**Discovery → Consideration → Conversion → Retention** 




 This includes:
 


* Building campaigns that drive awareness and discovery.
* Improving consideration through stronger propositions and product communication.
* Driving conversion through better offers, messaging and user experiences.
* Building lifecycle journeys across Push, WhatsApp and Email.
* Identifying high\-intent users and key drop\-offs.
* Designing interventions for cart abandoners, new users and repeat customers.



 The goal is simple:
 **continuously improve how users move through the funnel and drive measurable business growth.** 




  





 5\. Experiment, Learn and Scale
 



 You will have significant freedom to test ideas.
 



 We believe growth comes from running the right experiments—not waiting for the perfect answer.
 



 You will:
 


* Form hypotheses based on data and consumer insights.
* Design experiments across creatives, audiences, propositions, pricing, offers and funnels.
* Measure results and understand why something worked or didn't.
* Rapidly iterate and improve.
* Scale winning ideas into repeatable growth levers.



 We are looking for someone who enjoys asking,
 **"What happens if we try this?"** 
 —and then has the ownership to actually make it happen.
 



  





 6\. Run the Business, Not Just the Campaigns
 



 You will have direct visibility into business performance and will be expected to develop a strong understanding of the numbers behind growth.
 



 You will:
 


* Track metrics such as revenue, CAC, ROAS, CTR and CVR.
* Monitor daily and weekly business performance.
* Identify gaps, risks and opportunities before they become bigger problems.
* Build a strong understanding of the relationship between demand, inventory, pricing and growth.
* Work with Category and Operations teams to ensure growth plans are aligned with business realities.



 Over time, you should be able to look at the business, identify the biggest problem to solve, and drive the right intervention.
 



  





**What Will You Learn?** 




 This role is designed to give you
 **breadth of exposure and depth of ownership** 
 .
 



 You will learn how to:
 


* Build and scale a consumer/D2C brand.
* Think about growth as a business problem, not just a marketing problem.
* Run end\-to\-end GTM campaigns.
* Manage performance marketing hands\-on across major digital platforms.
* Use data and consumer insights to make decisions.
* Understand pricing, offers and conversion economics.
* Build lifecycle and retention journeys.
* Run experiments and make decisions based on results.
* Work across Product, Design, Analytics, Category and Operations.
* Take an idea from
 **0 → 1 → scale** 
 .



 Most importantly, you will develop the ability to
 **own a business problem end\-to\-end** 
 .
 



  





**Who Should Apply?** 




 We're looking for someone who wants more ownership than a typical marketing role offers.
 



 You will be a great fit if:
 


* You have 1–2 years of experience in growth, marketing, strategy, consulting, e\-commerce or a similar role.
* You want to own outcomes—not just tasks.
* You enjoy solving ambiguous problems and figuring things out from first principles.
* You are comfortable getting your hands dirty, whether that means analysing data, setting up a campaign or fixing an execution gap.
* You think in terms of business impact and enjoy understanding what drives revenue.
* You are analytical and comfortable using data to make decisions.
* You are highly detail\-oriented and don't let things fall through the cracks.
* You move fast, take initiative and have a strong
 **"get it done"** 
 mindset.
* You are excited by the idea of building something in a fast\-growing business.



 Experience in D2C, consumer internet, e\-commerce or marketing is a plus, but a strong ownership mindset matters more.
 



  





**What Can You Expect?** 



* **High Ownership from Day One**



 You will own meaningful growth problems and have the autonomy to figure out how to solve them.
 


* **Direct Business Impact**



 You will be able to see the direct impact of your work on revenue, growth and key business metrics.
 


* **Steep Learning Curve**



 You will get exposure to multiple aspects of building a D2C business—not just one narrow marketing function.
 


* **End\-to\-End Experience**



 You will take initiatives from insight and strategy through execution, measurement and scale.
 


* **Work Closely with Leadership**



 You will get visibility into how key business decisions are made and have the opportunity to influence them.
 


* **Build, Don't Just Maintain**



 You will work on new launches, campaigns, growth experiments and initiatives that help shape the future of Native.
 



  





 Location \& Work Setup
 


* **Location:** 
 Gurgaon
* **Work Mode:** 
 100% Work from Office

* Ability to compassionately give and receive editorial and technical feedback.
* Communicate clearly and concisely, especially when working asynchronously or with a distributed team.

title: Request for Proposal Manager (India)
description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.
   

  

 Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”
   

  

 Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.
   

  

 The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for highly organized
 **RFP \& Proposal Managers** 
 to help our sales team develop high\-quality responses to Requests for Proposal (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and related customer questionnaires.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who can independently manage the complete proposal process—from reviewing requirements and coordinating with internal teams to drafting, editing, and submitting a compelling final response. The ideal candidate understands enterprise sales, writes clearly, manages deadlines rigorously, and can work across multiple stakeholders with minimal supervision.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and customer questionnaires from initial review through final submission.
* Review requirements, identify mandatory criteria, and create a clear response plan.
* Partner with sales leaders to understand the opportunity, customer priorities, competitive landscape, and win strategy.
* Coordinate inputs from product, engineering, security, legal, finance, implementation, and other subject\-matter experts.
* Draft clear, persuasive, and customer\-specific responses rather than relying solely on generic content.
* Manage timelines, assignments, reviews, approvals, and submission requirements.
* Ensure every response is accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned with the customer’s evaluation criteria.
* Identify missing information and proactively follow up with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Edit technical and business content for clarity, tone, grammar, and consistency.
* Prepare executive summaries, company profiles, solution descriptions, case studies, and implementation narratives.
* Maintain an organized library of approved answers, supporting documents, templates, and reusable content.
* Track open proposals, deadlines, outcomes, and common reasons for wins and losses.
* Improve the RFP process by introducing effective templates, workflows, and quality\-control practices.
* Manage multiple time\-sensitive proposals without compromising quality.


**What You Have**
* Experience in proposal management, RFP responses, bid management, sales enablement, presales, enterprise sales, or a related role.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, deadline\-driven projects.
* Excellent written English, editing, and business communication skills.
* Strong understanding of B2B or enterprise sales processes.
* Ability to translate technical or complex information into clear, persuasive customer\-facing language.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow complex submission instructions.
* Experience collaborating with sales teams and cross\-functional subject\-matter experts.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Google Workspace, and common collaboration tools.
* Sound judgment and the confidence to challenge incomplete, unclear, or weak responses.
* Ability to prioritize effectively and remain composed under tight deadlines.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience responding to enterprise, government, or regulated\-industry RFPs.
* Familiarity with proposal\-management or RFP automation platforms.
* Experience with security questionnaires, due\-diligence requests, and procurement processes.
* Knowledge of structured proposal methodologies or formal bid\-management practices.
* Experience building and maintaining an RFP content library.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.


 Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in
 **@** 
**commure.com** 
 . Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.
   

  

 Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

title: Course/Curriculum Dev 3-Training
description:
**Job Description**
 The Senior Learning Partner (IC3\) is an experienced Learning \& Development professional responsible for identifying learning needs and designing, developing, delivering, and evaluating effective learning solutions for Oracle Health client and operations teams. This role combines strong learning expertise with technical knowledge of Cerner Millennium and/or other Oracle Health solutions to enable associates and teams to develop the knowledge, skills, and capabilities required to perform effectively.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience delivering technical training, conducting training needs analysis, developing instructional content, facilitating onboarding and learning programs, and partnering with business stakeholders in a complex, global environment.
   

  

 The Senior Learning Partner will proactively identify training requirements across client and operations teams, translate business and performance needs into actionable learning strategies, and serve as a key point of contact for training\-related requirements. The role requires strong collaboration with business leaders, subject matter experts, stakeholders, and the broader Learning \& Development organization to ensure learning solutions are relevant, scalable, measurable, and aligned with business priorities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Learning Partnership and Training Needs Analysis
   

  

* Serve as a key Learning \& Development partner and point of contact for training\-related requirements across assigned client and operations teams.
* Build strong working relationships with business leaders, managers, subject matter experts, operations teams, and Learning \& Development stakeholders.
* Proactively identify current and emerging training requirements through stakeholder discussions, learner feedback, operational trends, performance data, and business priorities.
* Conduct training needs analysis to identify knowledge, skill, and performance gaps and determine appropriate learning interventions.
* Translate identified needs into actionable training strategies, learning plans, and implementation approaches.
* Provide learning recommendations that balance business requirements, learner needs, delivery timelines, and available resources.
* Manage multiple learning initiatives and stakeholder requirements independently, escalating risks and dependencies where appropriate.


 Technical Training and Oracle Health Learning
   

  

* Design, coordinate, and deliver technical training related to Cerner Millennium and/or other Oracle Health solutions for client and operations teams.
* Apply technical and functional knowledge to develop learning experiences that enable associates to effectively use applications, tools, workflows, and supporting processes.
* Facilitate technical learning sessions using appropriate instructor\-led, virtual, self\-paced, and blended learning methodologies.
* Partner with subject matter experts to validate technical accuracy and ensure learning materials remain aligned with product, process, and operational changes.
* Simplify complex technical concepts and workflows into clear, structured, and learner\-friendly content.
* Support learning requirements associated with application tools, user access, and relevant access\-management processes.
* Preferred experience includes supporting or understanding service tickets involving user access, application tools, access requests, and associated access\-management workflows.


 Instructional Design and Content Development
   

  

* Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve high\-quality instructional content for technical and operational learning programs.
* Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to create engaging and effective learning experiences.
* Develop eLearning modules, simulations, videos, presentations, facilitator guides, learner guides, job aids, knowledge checks, assessments, and other learning resources.
* Demonstrate hands\-on experience with instructional content development tools such as Camtasia, Articulate, and Rise 360, or comparable learning\-authoring technologies.
* Work with subject matter experts and stakeholders to convert technical information, business processes, and operational requirements into structured learning content.
* Review and update existing learning materials to ensure accuracy, relevance, consistency, and usability.
* Explore innovative and scalable learning approaches that improve learner engagement, knowledge retention, and accessibility.


 Learning Program Implementation and Evaluation
   

  

* Plan and implement learning programs from initial needs identification through design, development, delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate schedules, facilitators, participants, learning materials, communications, logistics, and other program dependencies.
* Establish appropriate measures to evaluate learner participation, knowledge acquisition, training effectiveness, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Gather and analyze learner feedback, assessment results, participation data, and other learning metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Develop reports and presentations that communicate learning outcomes, program performance, key insights, risks, and recommended actions.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to continuously enhance learning programs and improve the overall learner experience.
* Maintain appropriate learning documentation and support reporting requirements for assigned programs.


 Onboarding and Associate Development
   

  

* Coordinate and facilitate onboarding and learning sessions for GSSS associates across India and international teams.
* Provide structured and engaging onboarding experiences that help associates understand relevant applications, processes, tools, resources, and role expectations.
* Partner with regional and international stakeholders to support consistent learning experiences while adapting delivery to audience and business requirements.
* Develop and maintain onboarding materials, presentations, learning resources, facilitator content, and supporting documentation.
* Gather feedback from new associates, managers, and stakeholders and use insights to improve onboarding effectiveness.
* Support broader capability\-building and continuous learning initiatives based on evolving business and operational requirements.


 Stakeholder Management, Reporting, and Communication
   

  

* Develop trusted partnerships with business leaders, client teams, operations teams, subject matter experts, and Learning \& Development colleagues.
* Communicate learning plans, program status, outcomes, dependencies, and risks clearly and professionally.
* Demonstrate strong reporting and data interpretation skills to convert learning and operational data into meaningful insights.
* Prepare and deliver presentations for stakeholders, clearly communicating training requirements, learning strategies, program results, and recommendations.
* Collaborate effectively across geographical and organizational boundaries and demonstrate cultural awareness when supporting global audiences.
* Influence stakeholders through expertise, data, collaboration, and effective communication.


 Employee Engagement and Volunteering
   

  

* Support Oracle Volunteering and employee engagement initiatives for GSSS associates, particularly across India.
* Coordinate with Oracle Volunteers, NGOs, community organizations, internal teams, and other stakeholders to support successful volunteering activities.
* Assist with event planning, associate communication, participation coordination, scheduling, logistics, and post\-event activities.
* Contribute to newsletters and internal communications highlighting volunteering opportunities, participation, achievements, and community impact.
* Collaborate on creative engagement activities such as crosswords, quizzes, knowledge activities, and other interactive content that encourages associate participation.


**Required Qualifications**
* Relevant professional experience in Learning \& Development, Technical Training, Instructional Design, Talent Development, Enablement, or a related discipline.
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of Cerner Millennium and/or other Oracle Health solutions.
* Demonstrated experience delivering technical training to client, operations, or professional audiences.
* Experience identifying training needs and translating business requirements into structured learning strategies and programs.
* Hands\-on experience designing and developing instructional content using tools such as Camtasia, Articulate, and Rise 360, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning methodologies, and learning evaluation approaches.
* Strong facilitation, presentation, and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management skills and the ability to build productive relationships with business leaders, subject matter experts, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong reporting, analytical, and data interpretation capabilities, with the ability to translate information into actionable insights.
* Strong organizational and program management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliverables.
* Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting Cerner Millennium and/or Oracle Health learning programs in a client services, support, or operations environment.
* Experience supporting service tickets associated with user access, application tools, access requests, and access\-management processes.
* Experience developing technical eLearning, videos, simulations, job aids, assessments, and blended learning solutions.
* Experience supporting onboarding and capability\-development programs across multiple regions or countries.
* Experience working within a large, complex, global technology or healthcare organization.
* Exposure to learning management systems, learning analytics, reporting tools, and virtual collaboration platforms.
* Experience coordinating employee engagement, volunteering, or community initiatives is an advantage.


 Key Competencies
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate learning agility, technical aptitude, instructional design capability, customer focus, stakeholder partnership, analytical thinking, facilitation, communication, collaboration, and ownership.
   

  

 The candidate should be comfortable working independently within defined objectives, applying professional judgment to solve moderately complex learning and business problems, and partnering across teams to achieve results. They should be able to move effectively between technical content, learning design, facilitation, data analysis, stakeholder discussions, and program execution.
   

  

 Success in this role requires a learner\-centric mindset combined with an understanding of business and operational requirements. The Senior Learning Partner should be able to convert complex technical and process information into practical learning experiences, use data and feedback to evaluate effectiveness, and continuously improve learning solutions that support Oracle Health associates, client teams, and operations.
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Founder's Office - FDE Team
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
 Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure. A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
   

  

 That infrastructure layer is being built right now.
   

  

 We are looking for a Founder's Office to join our FDE team.
   

  

 We're TrueFoundry, and we're building it.
   

  

 The Problem We're Solving
   

  

 Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self\-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi\-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
   

  

 The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct\-tape together a few API calls and call it production\-ready.
   

  

**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**
* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self\-hosted models, custom tools, and agents


 AI Gateway is the control plane — five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
   

  

 We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Founder’s Office who will work closely with the founders and FDE leadership to drive strategic initiatives, customer engagements, and execution across the organization.
   

  

 This is a highly cross\-functional role spanning customers, engineering, product, and business strategy. You will work on some of TrueFoundry's most important and ambiguous problems and help turn strategic priorities into execution.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work directly with the founders and FDE leadership on high\-priority strategic initiatives.
* Partner closely with FDE engineers on enterprise customer engagements, technical challenges, and deployments.
* Understand customer problems and translate them into actionable requirements for Product and Engineering.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and opportunities to improve TrueFoundry's product and platform.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives from problem definition to execution and measurable outcomes.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure customer priorities are addressed effectively.
* Build processes and operating mechanisms that help the FDE organization scale efficiently.
* Track critical initiatives, identify bottlenecks, and drive teams toward resolution.

title: Sr. Specialist - L&D Operations
description:
**Scope**
 This role is responsible for enabling scalable, reliable, and business\-aligned learning operations. The position partners with business units and learning stakeholders to identify capability needs, translate them into learning priorities, and support execution through platforms, analytics, automation, and infrastructure. The role also ensures learning sites, LMS processes, reporting assets, and training environments remain accurate, accessible, stable, and fit for purpose.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Learning Business Partnership \& Strategy**
* Partner with business units to assess capability gaps and understand skill\-development priorities.
* Define and support learning strategies that align with business objectives, team priorities, and workforce capability needs.
* Translate stakeholder requirements into practical learning initiatives, delivery plans, platform actions, and measurable outcomes.


**Platform \& SharePoint Content Management**
* Manage and maintain SharePoint sites, document libraries, permissions, and learning\-team repositories.
* Maintain content structure, navigation, access governance, and learning resource availability across SharePoint environments.
* Support creation, update, and troubleshooting of digital learning pages, folders, libraries, and shared assets.
* Ensure content is organized, current, and easy for stakeholders, facilitators, and learners to access.


**Learning Infrastructure Support**
* Provision, configure, and manage virtual machines required for training programs.
* Ensure VM environments are updated, stable, accessible, and aligned with training requirements before delivery.
* Coordinate issue resolution for VM access, performance, environment readiness, and learner/facilitator support needs.
* Maintain readiness checks and environment\-support documentation for recurring training programs.


**Analytics, Dashboards \& Reporting**
* Perform analytics tasks for learning programs and the department, including dashboards, insights, and data extraction using Power BI.
* Build or maintain reports that show participation, completion, feedback, usage, trends, and learning\-program effectiveness.
* Convert learning data into actionable insights for stakeholders, leadership updates, and operational reviews.
* Support data quality, reporting consistency, and recurring reporting cycles for learning teams.


**Automation \& Process Improvement**
* Use Power Automate to simplify repetitive learning operations, notifications, approvals, data movement, and stakeholder communications.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes across learning delivery, reporting, reminders, and follow\-ups.
* Document automation logic, dependencies, and handover steps to ensure continuity and supportability.
* Apply a continuous\-improvement mindset to improve learner experience, facilitator support, and operational efficiency.


**Learning Management System Operations**
* Manage end\-to\-end Learning Management System operations, preferably in Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD).
* Support course setup, catalog maintenance, assignments, audience management, reporting, learner queries, and operational troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with platform owners, IT, vendors, and learning stakeholders to resolve LMS issues and improve platform usage.
* Maintain LMS process documentation, standard operating procedures, and data/reporting governance where applicable.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, learning, information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of Experience working in Learning \& Development, learning technology operations, LMS administration, or learning\-business\-partner roles.
* Ability to assess capability gaps, translate business needs into learning plans, and manage multiple learning initiatives with stakeholders.
* Hands\-on experience managing SharePoint sites, libraries, permissions, and structured learning content repositories.
* Experience provisioning or coordinating virtual machine environments for training programs, preferably using Azure or similar platforms.
* Strong Power BI and Excel skills for dashboards, insights, data extraction, and learning\-program analytics.
* Practical experience with Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools.
* End\-to\-end LMS operations experience; Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD) experience is preferred.
* Strong communication, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a global, fast\-paced environment and manage priorities with attention to detail.


**Additional Skills**
* Experience supporting CSOD integrations, reporting, learning assignments, or platform enhancement initiatives.
* Exposure to Azure or cloud\-based lab/training environments.
* Experience creating Power BI dashboards for learning, HR, operations, or business stakeholders.
* Experience building Power Automate flows for email communication, data updates, approval routing, or learning operations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow requests, access support, incident handling, or learning platform support tickets.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

description:

 As a Lead BSA on the Enterprise Applications team at Dolby, you will be pivotal in supporting and enhancing software systems across various business functions, including legal, compliance, licensing, sales, and customer support. Your role encompasses managing applications such as contract lifecycle management (CLM), customer relationship management (CRM), document management, customer support, and business intelligence (BI). You will be responsible for the functional deliverables throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and play a strategic role in the implementation and enhancement of enterprise systems. This position demands collaboration with IT and business stakeholders, mentoring junior team members, and shaping the strategic roadmap for enterprise applications. We are seeking candidates who can thrive in a dynamic environment. Demonstrating versatility and a proactive approach to problem\-solving is essential.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
* Champion one or more functional areas or applications supporting contracts, compliance, licensing, sales, and customer support operations. Key systems include CLM, CRM (Salesforce), document management, and BI applications.
* Handle all SDLC phases including requirements gathering, process reengineering, functional design, testing, training, support, and continuous improvement.
* Adapt to project demands by wearing multiple hats, seamlessly shifting between roles such as business analyst, solution designer and project manager as needed.
* Document business processes using tools such as MS Visio, Miro and/or other modeling applications and refine processes to maximize efficiency.
* Facilitate business process review meetings with subject matter experts to optimize efficiency.
* Gather and define functionality, usability, reliability, and performance requirements in collaboration with users for system implementation and enhancements.
* Translate business requirements into application functionality, deciding when to advocate and when to compromise to reach mutually acceptable solutions.
* Create high\-level functional designs mapped to business or architectural requirements, communicating these to technical development teams.
* Mentor and lead junior team members, including business systems analysts and contractors, fostering their development.
* Document and execute system, performance, and user\-acceptance test plans ensuring system changes are error\-free and meet approved requirements and designs.
* Analyze and prioritize application defects and enhancements, participating in change management processes.
* Develop mixed\-media training materials and deliver training to super\-users, ensuring they are well\-equipped to use the systems.

description:

 Ready to make your mark?
 **Join us and be part of something bigger.**
**Job Specification Description**
**As a Client Support Executive** 
**at Kainos** 
 , you will work as part of a large global team supporting our successful cloud\-based
 **Smart** 
 Product Suite, across our world\-wide Client\-base. You will work co\-operatively with colleagues to understand customer requirements, and with the guidance from more Senior Consultants, help provide Customer
 *value\-add* 
 service from the Smart Product Suite.
   

  

**Your Role Will Involve**
* Helping to on\-board and provide Business\-as\-Usual Support to our Customers using the Smart Product Suite.
* Providing support to our customers as part of the Kainos Smart Gold Service, enabling our customers to maximise value\-add from the Kainos Smart Product Suite by:
* Executing, Reporting and Maintaining customer Test Packs.
* Performing analysis on customer test coverage to recommend enhancements and improvements that will provide additional customer Value.
* Liaising directly with customers on a regular basis as part of the Smart Gold Service.
* Understanding Customer Needs – You will perform analysis of Customer’s Workday configuration and understand the specific domain (HCM, Recruiting, Financials, Payroll and Security) configuration that drives their business.
* Defining, Designing, Building and Refining Test Packs \- From initial discovery of the Customers’ specific configuration, you will help define the scope of appropriate tests to be created, ensuring they are aligned with the Customer’s test strategy.
* Customer Upskilling \- You will help transfer knowledge of the Smart Product Suite to Customer teams and colleagues.
* Providing Customer Added Value – You will help the team deliver added value to our customer\-base.
* Contributing to Continuous Improvement \- Outside of Customer engagements, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of the Kainos Smart Testing and Audit products by suggesting new features \& functionality and liaising with development on the creation and testing of features, fixes etc.
* Working as part of team \- You will deliver as part of a team, supported by experienced consultants and supporting more junior team members. You will also support your colleagues to foster an inclusive culture in all that you do.


**Minimum (essential) Requirements**
* Excellent customer focus, with experience in a customer\-facing environment.
* Positive can\-do attitude with the ability to work independently and to adapt your style and practices in order to respond to changing circumstances and customer needs
* Clear and effective communicator (both written and verbal). Due to the interactive nature of the role, our team members must be able to communicate effectively with both customers and colleagues.
* Ability to prioritise, plan workload and meet key deadlines.
* Ability to apply all relevant standards and procedures to your own work, maintaining high levels of quality and accuracy at all times.
* Good commercial awareness and understanding of project and business dynamics.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Capable of working within (remote) teams and alongside customers, as well as individual tasks with limited supervision.


**Desirable**
* Business, Finance, Computer Science or related degree to an honours level.
* A developed understanding of manual and automated testing.
* Exposure to software development, business analysis or quality assurance/test consulting environment.
* Experience in the implementation of on\-premise or cloud\-based Financials / Business Applications such as CRM, ERP, BI or HCM.
* Experience of the Workday Application Suite.


**Embracing our differences**
 At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 We are hiring a customer\-facing Presales Engineer to lead technical discovery, tailored demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and solution design for enterprise prospects evaluating our software testing and quality\-engineering platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines a strong technical foundation in QA space with customer\-facing solutioning experience. They should be able to engage credibly with engineering and QA teams, understand complex testing challenges, and articulate our capabilities in terms of tangible operational and business outcomes.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Key responsibilities**
* Lead technical discovery to understand a prospect’s applications, testing maturity, release workflow, toolchain, integrations, security needs, stakeholders, and decision criteria
* Deliver tailored product demos, workshops, architecture discussions, and technical presentations for QA, engineering, IT, and executive stakeholders
* Scope and run POCs with clear use cases, customer commitments, success criteria, milestones, risks, and a conversion plan
* Partner with Account Executives/Sales leadership to develop technical win plans, address objections, and progress enterprise opportunities
* Handle technical evaluations, RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, integration discussions, and solution\-design requests
* Advise prospects on test automation strategy, CI/CD integration, test reliability, regression efficiency, and implementation best practices
* Translate product capabilities into quantified customer value—for example, reduced regression effort, faster release cycles, lower test\-maintenance cost, improved automation coverage, and reduced production\-defect risk—and build credible ROI/value cases for buyers
* Create reusable demo environments, discovery frameworks, POC templates, solution briefs, and competitive/technical collateral
* Feed recurring customer needs, objections, gaps, and market insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams
* Ensure a structured technical handoff from closed\-won opportunities to implementation or customer\-success teams


**Ideal candidate profile**
* 4–7 years of overall experience, with meaningful early hands\-on work in software development, QA, SDET, test automation, or implementation
* 2–4 years in a customer\-facing technical role: Presales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Consultant, Technical Consultant, or similar
* Strong experience in QA/testing and automation, including practical familiarity with tools and concepts such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, API testing, CI/CD, Git, Jira, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, cloud testing, and test frameworks
* Can communicate confidently with QA leads, engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and executive sponsors
* Has led or materially contributed to tailored demos, POCs, technical discovery, solution proposals, and enterprise evaluations
* Comfortable navigating integrations, APIs, SSO/RBAC, security reviews, cloud/SaaS architecture, and enterprise buying processes
* Commercially aware: able to turn technical outcomes into a business case, quantify impact, and support sales teams through complex deal cycles
* High ownership and comfortable operating in an early\-stage SaaS environment


**Must\-have Skills**
 Pre\-sales, QA
   

  

**Good\-to\-have Skills**
 Value Selling, SDET

description:

**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking an experienced System Integration Specialist with 8\-10 years of expertise in designing, developing and supporting secure enterprise integrations across GCP, AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.

  

The successful candidate will bring strong hands\-on experience in multi\-system integration, cloud connectors, APIs, middleware, microservices and end\-to\-end integration flows, with practical exposure to SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), SAP Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG), EFB, Ab Initio, Kong Konnect and microservices\-based architectures.

  

The role will also support the integration of enterprise applications and data platforms with Large Language Models and GenAI services, ensuring that data exchanged with AI models remains secure, governed, traceable and compliant with enterprise standards.

  

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

1\. Leads cloud system design activities and/or reviews system designs to assure that solutions will exhibit expected levels of performance, security, scalability, security, maintainability, appropriate reusability and reliability upon deployment
  

2\. Manages automation initiatives of cloud infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, self\-service, infrastructure\-as\-code services, auto scale initiatives, and DevOps deployment
  

3\. Communicates with key stakeholders to influence the adoption of cloud\-native systems and helps to inform stakeholders on how to use platform capabilities effectively through appropriate venue
  

4\. Delivers consultative advice through advanced technical knowledge on system architecture and recommend solutions in alignment with systems engineering best practices
  

5\. Leads the collaboration with quality assurance and technical writers to complete development cycle
  

6\. Leads the collaboration with business stakeholders and product owners to scope and de\-risk development activities in advance
  

7\. Executes complex data analyses to make decisions on where to invest and iterate on efficiency and cloud management tools
  

8\. Drives a risk\-aware culture, and ensures efficient and effective risk and compliance management practices by adhering to required standards and processes
  

9\. Ensures efficient functioning of data storage and processing functions in accordance with company security policies and best practices in cloud security
  

10\. Identifies, analyses, and resolves complex infrastructure vulnerabilities and application deployment issues independently
  

11\. Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in cloud engineering best practices and industry standards
  

12\. Mentors other cloud engineers, helping to improve the team's abilities by acting as a technical resource


**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Enterprise and Multi\-System Integration (Must)**

* Design, develop and implement end\-to\-end integrations across enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, ERP systems, data platforms and cloud services.
* Define complete integration flows covering source systems, integration and middleware layers, transformation, orchestration, security, target systems and downstream consumption.
* Integrate heterogeneous systems using APIs, cloud connectors, middleware, event\-driven services, microservices and managed file\-transfer mechanisms.
  

**SAP CPI and CIG (Preferred)**

* Design, build and support integrations using SAP Cloud Integration, formerly CPI, within SAP Integration Suite.
* Configure integration flows, adapters, message mappings, routing, transformations, exception handling and monitoring.
  

**API Management and Kong Konnect (Desirable)**

* Design and implement RESTful APIs and, where relevant, SOAP, GraphQL and webhook\-based interfaces.
* Use Kong Konnect for API gateway, API management, service connectivity and governance requirements.
* Configure API routing, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, throttling, request validation and traffic\-management policies.
  

**Middleware, EFB and Ab Initio (Desirable)**

* Develop and manage integration solutions using enterprise middleware and integration platforms.
* Use EFB capabilities and standards applicable to the organisation’s integration landscape.
* Develop and support Ab Initio graphs, plans and data\-processing workflows for complex data integration requirements.
* Implement data extraction, validation, transformation, enrichment, reconciliation, and loading processes.
* Optimise Ab Initio and middleware workflows for performance, scalability and operational resilience.
  

**Microservices Architecture (Must)**

* Design integration services using microservices and domain\-oriented architecture principles.
* Develop and integrate independently deployable services with clearly defined interface contracts.
* Implement service\-to\-service communication using APIs, messaging and event\-streaming patterns.
* Apply design patterns such as API gateway, circuit breaker, retry and idempotency.
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Essential Experience**

* 8\-10 years of experience in enterprise system integration, middleware, API engineering or cloud integration.
* Strong experience designing complex end\-to\-end integration flows involving multiple source and target systems.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one major cloud platform (GCP or AWS preferred).
* Experience with API management, authentication, authorisation, versioning and lifecycle governance.
  

  

**Technology Experience**

Candidates should possess hands\-on experience or exposure to:


* SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
* SAP Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
* EFB(Enterprise File Broker\-Preferred)
* Ab Initio
* Kong Konnect
* Cloud identity, key\-management and secret\-management services
* Monitoring, logging and observability tools

title: Information Developer
description:
**Who are we?**



Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human\-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.



At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real\-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.



This intelligence powers our entire product suite.


* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.


 These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.



Our upcoming AI\-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.


* Seek is an AI\-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2\.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category.


Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise\-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.



Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome\-driven for every employee.



At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.



The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40\+ countries.


**Customers**: 700\+ enterprise customers, including 80\+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.


**Investors**: A total of \~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2\. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.


**Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:**


* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI\-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5\+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025\)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4\.6 on G2 Crowd, 4\.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super\-high CSAT of 99\.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software \- 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”


**These recognitions are matched by business performance:**


* Highest\-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
* Listed on the Financial Times \& Statista's High\-Growth Companies Asia\-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022\-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal


**Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion\-dollar company!**


**Are you ready for the next phase of your growth?**



We are looking for a stellar Information Development Manager who is passionate about turning complex technical knowledge into clear, elegant documentation that real people actually love to use. You thrive at the intersection of craft and collaboration — equally comfortable diving deep into API references as you are coaching a junior writer through their first big deliverable. You will be part of a close\-knit, motivated team where great writing is a first\-class citizen, and where documentation is built alongside the product — not bolted on at the end.


**What do you get to do?**


* Own the end\-to\-end documentation strategy for one or more product areas — from planning and authoring through review and publish — ensuring every piece of content is accurate, complete, and a joy to read
* Mentor and grow 2–3 Information Developers or Technical Writers on the team: onboarding them, reviewing their work with thoughtful feedback, and championing their career development
* Author a wide range of content — user guides, API references, tutorials, release notes, how\-to guides, and troubleshooting docs — always writing for the audience, not the spec
* Partner closely with engineering, product, design, and QA to embed documentation into the product development lifecycle from day one, influencing decisions rather than just documenting them
* Champion docs\-as\-code practices and contribute to improving the documentation build, review, and publish pipeline
* Build and maintain the team's style guide, templates, and content standards so every writer on the team is set up to do their best work
* Track documentation health — coverage, freshness, customer feedback — and proactively close gaps before they become problems
* Act as the documentation voice in sprint planning, spec reviews, and design critiques, making sure the user's need for clarity is never an afterthought


**What you need to have / bring to the table:**


* **5–7 years of hands\-on experience in technical writing** or information development within a software or technology environment — you have seen the full documentation lifecycle many times over
* Proven experience leading or mentoring 2–3 technical writers or information developers — you know how to give feedback that builds people up while making the work genuinely better
* Deep proficiency with industry\-standard authoring tools (MadCap Flare, Adobe FrameMaker, Oxygen XML, or equivalent) and a working knowledge of DITA or structured authoring principles
* Hands\-on experience with API documentation — REST, GraphQL, and/or SDK reference docs — you are comfortable reading code and working directly with engineers to get the details right
* Working knowledge of developer tooling: Git/version control, Markdown, static site generators (Docusaurus, MkDocs, etc.), and CI/CD pipelines — docs\-as\-code is not a buzzword to you, it is how you work
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and embedding documentation deliverables into sprint workflows
* Strong editorial judgment — you can take a wall of technical detail and turn it into something a user actually wants to read, and you can explain exactly why every structural decision you made was the right one
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; equally effective in a document review, a cross\-functional standup, or an executive readout


**Bonus if you bring:**


* Experience with localization workflows or managing multilingual documentation
* Background in content strategy or information architecture at an organizational level
* Familiarity with UX writing or in\-product content
* CPTC certification or equivalent
* Domain experience in cloud infrastructure, developer tools, fintech, or enterprise SaaS


**\#LI\#Onsite**

* We also provide uncapped incentives, bonus plans and opportunities to employees (especially those in GTM teams) to travel to meet our global customers

description:
**Title**
 Knowledge Management Coordinator
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Knowledge Management (KM) Coordinator in our India Proposal Hub reporting to the Knowledge Management Lead based in India. and will support in developing and maintaining a structured, searchable, and governed knowledge repository that enables teams to efficiently access proposal collateral such as standard approved content, methodologies, project experience, lessons learned, templates, and best practices.  Advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

* Excellent written English, grammar, punctuation, editing, and proofreading skills.

description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services.  This role supports the Corporate Communications function at Lennox, contributing to both
 **internal and external communication initiatives** 
 . The Post Graduate Trainee will assist in executing communication strategies through
 **content creation, social media support, and intranet management**

* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely publishing of updates and resources

* Work closely with HR, leadership, and business teams to gather inputs and develop communication materials
* Support coordination for campaigns, events, and organizational initiatives
* Build working relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery

* Excellent command of English (written and verbal)
* Basic understanding of social media platforms and content trends
* Ability to simplify complex information into engaging content
* Good organizational and time management skills
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills
* Creative mindset with a willingness to learn
* Adaptability and proactive approach
* Exposure to communications, content writing, or marketing (internship/academic)
