title: CAPEX Excellence specialist
description:
**Support CAPEX planning, execution and reporting**
 Join NKT in a role that connects CAPEX governance, system support, and business improvement across an international organization. You will own day\-to\-day support, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CAPEX tool, helping teams work with consistent data, reliable reporting, and clear processes. This is a valuable opportunity to contribute to the green transition by supporting investment decisions across the business. Are you motivated by combining systems, process standards, and user support in one role?
   

  

**Keep CAPEX operations stable and consistent**
 In this role, you will act as the main business contact for the CAPEX tool and related process standards. You will support users, coordinate incidents and improvement requests with, and help maintain common templates, workflows, and reporting standards. The role also includes governance of master data, backlog prioritization, UAT coordination, and communication around releases and changes. You will work closely with CAPEX project managers, finance, procurement, IT, and process owners to support reliable planning, execution, and tracking across sites and functions.
   

  

**Your Responsibility Will Be To**
* Provide first\-line functional support and coordinate further support when needed
* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities


 You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
   

  

**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
 We are looking for someone who is service\-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative\-taking, detail\-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* 5\+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management


**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
 NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long\-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
   

  

 “This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
   

  

 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
   

  

 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 30th September 2026\. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e\-mail.
   

  

 We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
   

  

 Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
   

  

**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high\-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low\-, medium\- and high\-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3\.6 billion in 2025\. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Systems Control Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
   

  

 Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous\-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.

* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.

Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).

title: Team Leader
description:
**Are you passionate about leading content operations and improving data quality for one of the world’s largest research databases?**
**Do you enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to solve complex content\-flow challenges and drive continuous improvement through data and automation?**
**About Our Team**
 WDOT (WORKs Domain Operations Team), part of Elsevier’s Research Data Platform (RDP) organization, is responsible for the completeness, quality, and end\-to\-end content flow of Scopus, one of the world’s largest abstract and citation databases. The team manages the operational standards, thresholds, and governance frameworks that determine what content enters Scopus, how quickly it is processed, and how fully it is covered. This includes content ingestion, Articles\-in\-Press (AiP) tracking, clustering and deduplication, citation correction, retractions, and content quality diagnostics. WDOT works closely with Content Sourcing (CSD), Publisher Relations (PRM), Source Data Management (SDM), and technology teams to keep Scopus complete, accurate, and trusted by the global research community.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Team Leader, you will manage a team of Process/Data Specialists responsible for the completeness, quality, and end\-to\-end content flow of Scopus. You will oversee operational performance across completeness standards, ingestion and production pipelines, clustering, deduplication, and quality diagnostics, ensuring targets are met and risks are escalated and resolved. You will serve as the senior escalation point for cross\-team issues, strengthen documentation and resilience to reduce single points of failure, and represent WDOT’s completeness and content\-flow priorities in cross\-domain governance forums.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead governance for Scopus completeness standards, quality benchmarks, and coverage\-gap closure.
* Oversee content ingestion and production workflows to ensure timely and accurate content flow into Scopus.
* Manage exceptions and escalations for records that fail completeness or quality checks, working with Content, CSD, PRM, SDM, and technology teams.
* Review Power BI dashboards and reporting metrics to ensure completeness, speed, coverage, and quality insights are accurate and actionable.
* Ensure discard, retraction, correction, citation\-accuracy, clustering, and deduplication processes are completed compliantly and on schedule.
* Lead, mentor, and develop Process/Data Specialists while setting clear goals, reviewing performance, and building an inclusive team culture.
* Act as the main escalation point for content\-flow issues, AiP delays, and completeness gaps requiring cross\-functional support.
* Drive process improvement, resource planning, automation, AI\-enabled data literacy, KPIs, and productivity initiatives for the completeness and content operations function.
* Proactive, assertive, and data\-curious, with the confidence to surface issues early, challenge the status quo, make informed decisions with incomplete information, persist through pushback, escalate when needed, and use data to identify what the numbers may indicate next.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any discipline with 5\+ years of relevant experience in content operations, data/content quality, or scholarly publishing.
* Strong understanding of bibliographic database completeness, content ingestion pipelines, metadata standards, and content\-quality governance frameworks.
* Working knowledge of clustering, deduplication, retraction/correction, citation matching, and content ingestion or production workflows is preferred.
* Proficiency with Power BI or similar dashboarding tools to support metrics governance, reporting, and performance tracking.
* Understanding of AI technologies and data literacy to support automation, data\-driven insights, and continuous improvement.
* Strong people leadership skills, with experience managing experienced individual contributors and guiding talent development.
* Ability to provide direction to stakeholders, peers, managers, and direct reports while ensuring clarity on priorities, goals, OKRs, and KPIs.
* Comfortable managing ambiguity, handling escalations, collaborating across functions, and partnering with senior management on strategy and execution planning.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
   

  

**Working for You**
* We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents. Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: Senior Engineer- System Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Activités visant à prouver la validité ou la faisabilité technique d’un concept par l’application de méthodologies scientifiques et techniques. Le travail dans cette famille a généralement pour objectif de démontrer, par le biais de tests ou d'analyses, les performances et le potentiel de mise en œuvre d'un concept.
   

  

 Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées. Influe sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'efficience de sa propre équipe. Contribue significativement à l'élaboration des priorités. Se fonde sur des pratiques et des politiques professionnelles façonnées par le rôle. Le rôle dispose d'une autonomie modérée, nécessitant un haut niveau de discernement opérationnel.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Activités conceptuelles ou théoriques portant sur l’étude/recherche et l’application de l’électricité, de l’électronique et de l’électromagnétisme.
* Développer des connaissances spécialisées dans sa discipline. Prodigue ses conseils en matière de meilleures pratiques et/ou de qualité. Est conscient des derniers développements techniques dans son propre domaine. Contribue à l'élaboration de stratégies et de politiques, et assure la mise en œuvre dans les limites de son domaine de responsabilités.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement pour prendre des décisions ou résoudre des tâches ou des problèmes moyennement complexes dans les domaines de l'exploitation, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication, de la technologie ou de l'ingénierie. Adopte une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes. Utilise son expérience technique et son expertise en analyse de données pour appuyer les recommandations. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources modérés. Explique les informations difficiles ou sensibles. S'efforce d'établir un consensus. Développe les compétences de persuasion nécessaires pour influencer les autres sur des sujets relevant de son domaine.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience avancée de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une maîtrise dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Maîtrise d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité démontrée d'analyse et de résolution des problèmes. Capacité démontrée à diriger des programmes/projets. Capacité à documenter, planifier, lancer et exécuter des programmes. Compétences établies en gestion de projet.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Customer Support Solutions Lead Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Join the Grid Automation Customer Support Center of Excellence (CoE) and play a key role in shaping the future of customer support and technical solutions across our global Grid Automation business.
   

  

 As a Customer Support Solutions Lead Engineer, you will act as a global technical expert supporting regional teams in the design, promotion, delivery, and lifecycle management of advanced Grid Automation solutions across Transmission, Distribution, Generation, and Industry applications.
   

  

 You will be at the intersection of technology, customers, engineering, product management, and operations, helping regional teams solve complex technical challenges while developing innovative and differentiated solutions that deliver measurable value to our customers.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on technical expertise, solution architecture, customer engagement, technical leadership, and knowledge sharing. You will work closely with regional engineering teams, Global Supply Chain, Quality, Product Management, R\&D, Sales, Tendering, and Operations to resolve critical customer issues and continuously improve our customer support offering.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to become a global technical reference for Grid Automation solutions, influence engineering standards and best practices, and contribute to the development of the next generation of digital and automated power networks.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Complex Grid Automation Solutions**
 Support GA regional teams in the development and execution of innovative and technically challenging customer projects.
   

  

* Design and review solutions for substation control, protection, monitoring, and automation.
* Assess customer requirements and determine the suitability of standard GA solutions, identifying where customization or specific development may be required.
* Develop innovative technical solutions that balance performance, flexibility, reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, and total cost of ownership.
* Define system engineering strategies covering:
+ System and network architecture
+ Interfaces with primary equipment
+ IED and SCADA communications
+ Physical and logical communication networks
+ Network redundancy and system availability
+ Protection and control functions
+ Data modeling and engineering databases
+ Maintenance and lifecycle management


**Essential**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or a related field.
* Strong experience leading the technical execution of complex Grid Automation, Substation Automation, Protection \& Control, or Power System projects.
* Solid knowledge of power system and substation control and protection applications across Transmission, Distribution, Generation, and/or Industry.
* Strong experience in:
+ Protection and control system design
+ System architecture
+ Engineering and validation
+ Commissioning and troubleshooting

title: DB Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**


Valor Paytech is seeking an experienced DB Engineer to ensure our databases remain available, secure, and stable. The Database Engineer will continuously test data integrity to guard against corruption and perform regular updates to keep pace with evolving database technologies, while supporting performance, scalability, and reliability across our environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Database Administration Maintenance**

* Monitor the health of database servers through both automated and manual processes.
* Perform environment setup and configuration, along with proactive monitoring and maintenance.
* Perform database administration and maintenance, including installation, configuration, backups, upgrades, and patching.
* Set up and maintain automatic backup and recovery mechanisms using cronjobs.
* Administer and maintain end\-user accounts, permissions, and access rights.

**Performance Optimization**

* Recommend and implement solutions for performance monitoring and tuning.
* Evaluate the performance of stored procedures, identify time\- and resource\-consuming areas, and provide input to application developers to address them.
* Analyze access patterns and propose the best combination of indexes, constraints, foreign keys, and queries.
* Review SQL code written by application developers to ensure compliance with coding standards, best practices, and maximum performance.
* Review, optimize, and develop queries based on requirements.

**Reliability Troubleshooting**

* Analyze problems, anticipate future problem areas, and implement solutions.
* Investigate and identify the root cause of software problems reported by stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot database and Linux server issues by analyzing logs and using command\-line utilities.
* Maintain scalability (clustering) and availability (replication), including working knowledge of Galera cluster.
* Proactively identify technical opportunities and enhancements while addressing major incidents in a timely manner.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation providing 24x7 support, including off\-hours maintenance windows.

**Data Governance Security**

* Manage and ensure the integrity, security, and retention of data.
* Create deployment and rollback scripts for all database objects, manually or auto\-generated.

**Collaboration Delivery**

* Support the development of long\- and short\-term requirements for database administration and design.
* Participate in the change control process for all planned application and technical activities.
* Work with report writers to provide the data needed for reports.
* Take on full roadmap items, work with other functional teams, and deliver high\-quality results on time.
* Direct the organization of requirements and data into a usable database schema, including development of ad hoc queries, scripts, and updates to existing queries.
* Work closely with the application development team, including query review and version control via GitLab.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline is required; equivalent experience may substitute for the education requirement.
* 3\+ years of experience with relational databases such as MariaDB, MySQL, NoSQL, and above.
* 3\+ years of experience with automation using shell scripting (Shell, Perl, Python, etc.).
* Working understanding of technologies including MariaDB/MySQL, NoSQL, and PostgreSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.).
* Working technical knowledge and experience with current Linux operating systems.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficient in relational databases, backup, and recovery.
* Comfortable with shell scripting and related scripting procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong hands\-on experience with MySQL; PostgreSQL is a plus but optional.
* Experience with Aurora/RDS, ProxySQL, and Percona / PMM / Grafana.
* Knowledge of Galera cluster for clustering, scalability, and replication\-based availability.
* Experience working with application development teams, including query review and GitLab.
* Strong exposure to Linux resource and process monitoring, and scripting basics (shell, Python, or similar).

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical Problem\-Solving Mindset
* Database Reliability Performance Tuning
* Automation\-First Approach
* Ownership Incident Response
* Collaboration with Development Teams

**Technical Environment**

**Databases:** MariaDB, MySQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra), Aurora/RDS

**Clustering Availability:** Galera Cluster, Replication

**Monitoring:** Percona, PMM, Grafana

**Proxy/Access:** ProxySQL

**Scripting:** Shell, Perl, Python

**Operating Systems:** Linux

**Version Control:** GitLab

title: ServiceNow- Process Mapping & Automation - Assistant Vice President
description:
****Job Description****
 Job Description
   

  

****Role Summary \& Role Description****
 The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.
   

  

 This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.
   

  

**Service Mapping \& CMDB Management**
* Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
* Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
* Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
* Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top\-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
* Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
* Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
* Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
* Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
* Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.


**Governance, BAU, Compliance \& Automation**
* Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
* Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).
* Contribute to KPI reporting, dashboards, and management updates on mapping coverage and quality.
* Contribute to ITAM automation by identifying repeatable asset management tasks and supporting automation enhancements that improve data accuracy, lifecycle visibility, and operational efficiency across the asset estate.
* Collaborate cross functionally to identify, prioritize, and deliver automation enhancements, ensuring solutions are scalable, platform aligned, and support BAU efficiency, governance, and audit readiness.


****Core/Must Have Skills****
 Strong understanding of Service Mapping concepts, CMDB, and dependency mapping.
   

  

 Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (Service Mapping, Discovery, CMDB).
   

  

 Experience with tag\-based service mapping and meta data driven mapping approaches, particularly in cloud environments.
   

  

 Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, databases, networks, cloud services).
   

  

 Familiarity with ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem).
   

  

****Good To Have Skills****
 ServiceNow Certification (CSA, CIS.SM)

 Understanding of MID Server setup, health monitoring, and discovery troubleshooting.

 Service mapping, CMDB, ServiceNow Discovery

If you know how to pitch pedagogy, understand the nuances of US state curricula, and thrive in a growth\-oriented environment, we want you on our team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Presales and Proposal Leadership** 



* **Drive the Narrative:** 
 Act as the lead pedagogical voice in RFP, RFI, and vendor bids, translating customers’ education needs into compelling, commercially viable value propositions.
* **Pitch and Present:** 
 Collaborate directly with the Sales, Pre\-sales and Marketing teams to design and deliver high\-impact presentations and product demos for prospective clients.
* **Solution Architecting:** 
 Develop strategic prototype solutions, learning frameworks, and scope\-of\-work outlines tailored to the specific needs of prospective buyers.



**K\-12 Strategy and Ecosystem Expertise** 



* **Market Alignment:** 
 Leverage a deep understanding of the US K\-12 EdTech landscape; including publishers, US charter schools, and large virtual learning organizations, to tailor our approach.
* **Curriculum Mapping:** 
 Ensure proposed solutions align seamlessly with varied US state standards (e.g., Common Core, NGSS, TEKS) and local district mandates.
* **Competitive Intelligence:** 
 Stay ahead of EdTech market trends, funding shifts, and pedagogical shifts to help position our solutions as industry\-leading.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Bridge the gap between our Pre\-sales, Sales, Account Management, AI, Product, and Content Development teams to ensure that what we sell can be effectively and profitably delivered.
* Mentor junior learning designers on the EdTech market trends and commercial implications of instructional design choices.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* **Experience:** 
 15\+ years of experience in K\-12 Learning Design, Instructional Design, or Curriculum Strategy, with a mandatory 5 years (minimum) spent working within Pre\-sales.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Proven experience in proposal writing, presales consulting, or bid management. You must possess a "sales and consulting mindset" and a track record of contributing to revenue\-generating wins.
* **US Curriculum Expertise:** 
 Exceptional, hands\-on familiarity with US and European K\-12 state curricula, assessment standards, and pedagogical frameworks.
* **Customer Insight:** 
 Deep understanding of how the K\-12 business operates, particularly the pain points, buying cycles, and needs of educational publishers, charter networks, and large\-scale digital schooling organizations.
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional writing and presentation skills. You can explain the "why" and "how" of a learning strategy to both external and internal stakeholders.
* **Education:** 
 Master’s degree in Education, Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Impact at Scale:** 
 Your work will directly influence the learning experiences of millions of students by securing partnerships with top\-tier education providers.
* **Cross\-Functional Growth:** 
 This role offers unparalleled visibility into the business side of EdTech, making it perfect for ambitious learning designers looking to step into strategic leadership.

 Learning \- Learning Delivery Operations

 Learning Operations Manager

 Any Graduation

 13 to 18 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 We are seeking a skilled and passionate Instructional Design Manager with a strong foundation in adult learning theory, instructional design best practices, and digital learning solutions. This role is responsible for leading the design and development of high\-impact learning experiences that are engaging, effective, and aligned to client goals. You will collaborate closely with learning strategists, delivery leads, content developers, and client stakeholders to bring learning programs to life — grounded in learning research and designed for measurable performance improvement. Also the lead would be responsible for managing a team of Operations Lead, Team Lead and Scheduling Analysts which can vary by location. Also responsible for monitoring the operations to achieve service level agreements and serve as an escalation point to resolve client issues. Ensure successful delivery of learning solutions and review their effectiveness and applicability.
   

  

**What are we looking for?**
* Working in ANZ shift
* Nice to have industry experience in Retail/FMCG
* 12–15 years of experience in instructional design, learning design, or related roles.
* Deep understanding of adult learning principles, instructional systems design (ADDIE, SAM), and design thinking.
* Experience designing learning in various formats: eLearning, VILT, ILT, mobile, performance support, etc.
* Familiarity with learning platforms (LMS, LXP), authoring tools (Articulate 360, Rise, Captivate, Vyond, etc.) and learning data analysis.
* Experience working in client\-facing roles or global delivery models is preferred. Experience of working with Australian clients is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to changing priorities, and meet deadlines. Roles and Responsibilities:
* Learning Design \& Development
* Lead the instructional design of learning solutions across modalities (e\-learning, VILT, ILT, microlearning, simulations, blended, etc.).
* Apply evidence\-based learning design principles including cognitive load theory, scaffolding, spaced learning, and practice\-based reinforcement.
* Conduct needs analysis and design intent sessions with SMEs, business stakeholders, and learning leads.
* Translate business goals and audience insights into structured, outcomes\-focused learning journeys.
* Ensure learning solutions are learner\-centric, inclusive, and accessible, aligned to the latest adult learning standards. Project Leadership \& Collaboration
* Lead small teams of designers and developers to deliver high\-quality learning programs on time and within budget.
* Work closely with learning experience designers, content developers, graphic/media teams, and platform owners to execute design plans.
* Manage the instructional integrity of the learning solution through regular reviews and checkpoints.
* Provide thought leadership on design approaches and formats that align with business needs, learning objectives, and technology platforms. Quality, Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
* Champion quality assurance processes, including peer reviews, storyboard walkthroughs, and client reviews.
* Integrate innovative learning formats including scenario\-based learning, gamification, adaptive learning, and GenAI\-assisted content where appropriate.
* Drive continuous improvement by incorporating learner feedback, performance data, and learning analytics into design iterations.
* Stay current with trends in instructional design, learning tech, GenAI tools, and L\&D industry standards. Client \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as the primary instructional design point of contact for internal teams and occasionally for external clients.
* Facilitate design discussions, present learning solutions, and respond to stakeholder feedback constructively and professionally.
* Translate stakeholder input into clear design revisions while maintaining instructional integrity and learning impact. People Development \& Team Support
* Provide coaching and guidance to junior instructional designers. Other responsibilities
* Organize scheduling tasks, resources and priorities.
* Work with Delivery Services Management, BI, Capability leads to create viable, cost\-effective schedules and programs to agreed guidelines.

title: Sr. SEO Specialist
description:
Job Title: Sr. SEO Specialist (SEO, AI Search \& GEO)

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly experienced **Sr**. **SEO Specialist** with **5\+ years of proven experience** in driving organic growth through **Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and AI Search Optimization**. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of traditional SEO, emerging AI\-powered search platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot), and semantic search principles.

This is a senior role requiring someone who can **develop and execute SEO strategies, manage high\-performing SEO accounts, collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes**. The candidate should possess excellent communication, analytical, and project management skills, with a proven track record of improving organic visibility, traffic, and conversions across diverse industries.

**Key Responsibilities**  
SEO Strategy \& Organic Growth

* Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies to improve organic traffic, search rankings, and lead generation.
* Define SEO roadmaps aligned with business objectives and client goals.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, search intent mapping, and topical authority planning.
* Build scalable content strategies using semantic SEO and entity\-based optimization.
* Monitor industry trends, search algorithm updates, and AI search developments.

AI Search \& Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

* Develop optimization strategies for AI\-powered search platforms including **ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, and Google AI Overviews**.
* Implement **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)** best practices to improve discoverability in AI\-generated responses.
* Optimize content using semantic search principles, structured data, E\-E\-A\-T, and entity optimization.
* Collaborate with content teams to create authoritative, AI\-friendly, and citation\-worthy content.
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI search trends and recommend innovative optimization techniques.

Technical SEO

* Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits and implement recommendations.
* Optimize website architecture, crawlability, indexation, internal linking, structured data, XML sitemaps, canonicalization, and Core Web Vitals.
* Work closely with developers to ensure SEO best practices are incorporated into website development.
* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and technical SEO tools.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for key clients regarding SEO strategy and performance.
* Conduct client meetings, strategy presentations, and quarterly business reviews.
* Translate technical SEO concepts into business\-friendly recommendations for stakeholders.
* Build strong client relationships through proactive communication and strategic consulting.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, designers, content writers, and account managers.

Reporting \& Analytics

* Monitor and analyze SEO performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, and other analytics platforms.
* Prepare detailed monthly and quarterly reports highlighting traffic, rankings, conversions, ROI, and business impact.
* Present insights and recommendations to senior management and clients.
* Identify opportunities through data analysis and competitor benchmarking.

**Required Skills**  
SEO \& Digital Marketing

* Technical SEO
* On\-page SEO
* Off\-page SEO
* Local SEO
* International SEO
* Semantic SEO
* Entity\-Based SEO
* Content Strategy
* Topical Authority
* Internal Linking
* Keyword Research \& Search Intent Analysis
* Schema Markup
* Core Web Vitals
* E\-E\-A\-T Optimization

AI Search \& GEO

* Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
* AI Search Optimization
* LLM Optimization
* Prompt Engineering (for SEO workflows)
* Knowledge of AI\-powered search behavior
* Content optimization for AI\-generated search experiences

Analytics \& Tools

* Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
* Google Search Console
* Looker Studio
* Ahrefs
* SEMrush
* Screaming Frog
* Google Tag Manager
* PageSpeed Insights
* Microsoft Clarity
* Hotjar
* Excel / Google Sheets (Advanced Reporting)

AI Platforms

Candidates should have hands\-on experience using:

* ChatGPT
* Google Gemini
* Claude
* Perplexity AI
* Microsoft Copilot

Soft Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to simplify technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strategic thinking with a results\-driven mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** in SEO and Organic Search.
* Proven experience managing enterprise or multi\-industry SEO projects.
* Experience leading and mentoring SEO teams.

Preferred Certifications

* Google Analytics Certification
* Google Ads Certification (Preferred)
* HubSpot SEO Certification
* Semrush / Ahrefs Certifications (Preferred)

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Organic traffic growth
* Keyword ranking improvements
* Lead generation and conversion growth
* AI Search visibility (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, etc.)
* Technical SEO health score
* Core Web Vitals improvements

* Team performance and project delivery

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate should have a **proven track record of delivering measurable SEO success**, leading high\-performing teams, and managing enterprise\-level clients. They should be equally comfortable discussing technical SEO with developers, presenting performance insights to C\-level stakeholders, and adapting strategies for the evolving landscape of AI\-powered search and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

title: Content Writer (Insurance & Finance Domain)
description:
**Content Writer (Insurance \& Finance Domain)**

**Location:** Mumbai (Hybrid)

**Office:** 6 Days a week (Mon\-Sat)

**Department:** Content \& Brand

**Reports to:** Creative Head

**About the Role**

We're looking for an experienced Writer who has experience writing impactful content across newsletters to short videos to Linkedin or Twitter.

You'll be writing about insurance and personal finance, a category most people find boring or confusing, and your job is to make it neither. The right person here has a strong creative instinct, does real research before they write, and can get the reader to act.

**What You'll Do**

Writing \- to turn dry financial concepts and industry updates into relatable, useful content people actually want to engage with.

* From newsletters to website content
* Write and manage content for Twitter and LinkedIn: threads, posts, hooks, hot takes on insurance/finance news, and founder\-voice content
* Write scripts for short\-form video content (Reels, Shorts) that simplify insurance/finance concepts creatively
* Write creative copy for campaigns, landing pages, ads, and brand marketing

**What We're Looking For**

* 2\-4 years of relevant experience, as proven creative writer, not just a content producer: show us work that has a voice, a hook, a point of view
* Genuine curiosity and research instinct: you dig into a topic before you write about it, not just paraphrase the first Google result
* Strong sense of empathy for the reader: you write from what confuses or worries a policy buyer, not what the company wants to say
* Exposure to finance, insurance, fintech, or another regulated/technical category is a strong plus, but a sharp writer who can learn the domain fast is equally welcome.
* Knowing how to smartly use AI tools for writing is a must.
* Experience working in early stage startups is a big plus

**What Your Portfolio Should Show**

* That you can break down complex topics into simple to read, relatable content.
* Examples of
* Newsletter, or website content.
* Twitter/LinkedIn posts or threads you've written (yours or for a brand)
* Short\-form script writing
* Additionally any creative marketing copy (ads, campaigns, landing pages)

**Why Join Us**

You'll be the creative voice for a brand that's trying to make insurance and finance genuinely useful and trustworthy for people who've been burned by jargon and mis\-selling.

**Content is core to Beshak, and hence the role is core part of what we do. Your role will bring direct impact on the revenue of the company. This is not a supporting role.**

You'll have real ownership across formats, from social to scripts to web content, and work directly with the Creative Head on what to focus on and when.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Product Operations Specialist-2
description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Product Operations Specialist\-2
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments sector. We power payments and provide products and services for individuals and industries all around the world. Our people, technology, data and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities.
   

  

 As a company, we know that our success is driven by the skills, experience, integrity and mindset of the talent we hire. We invite you to join our team to find out how you too can start something priceless.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Customer Communication Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring that Mastercard’s Cross\-Border Services Customers receive timely, accurate, and actionable information. This role bridges the gap between technical operations and customer\-facing communication, helping to streamline the process, ensure accuracy, provide high quality information, and enhance the overall customer experience.
   

  

**Role**
* Participate in a non\-standard work week Monday – Friday, one position working an early morning shift.

* Track and analyze customer feedback to improve communication quality, frequency, and effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate documentation of communications, communication processes and procedures.
* Support the archiving and lifecycle management of customer\-facing content.


**All About You**
* Able to understand Cross\-Border Services business with a solid understanding of the transaction processing flow.
* Able to prioritize, manage, and organize multiple tasks concurrently while meeting deadlines.

* Self\-motivated individual who works successfully, ethically, and cooperatively in a team atmosphere.

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

title: Solutions Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
 Supports the Commercial Solutions Manager in identifying, designing, prototyping, and implementing practical technology solutions that address business needs and drive measurable impact. Acts as a tech\-savvy business enabler who translates operational requirements into scalable, cost\-effective digital solutions using low\-code/no\-code tools, automation platforms, analytics, and structured problem\-solving approaches.
   

  

 Key Result Responsibilities
   

  

**Business Analysis \& Requirement Structuring**
* Work closely with business teams to document processes, pain points, and opportunity areas.
* Translate business needs into structured functional requirements and solution outlines.
* Identify automation and digitalization opportunities.


**Solution Design \& Prototyping**
* Design and build MVPs using low\-code/no\-code platforms, automation tools, dashboards, or workflow systems.
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts before full\-scale IT development.
* Ensure solution design considers scalability, performance, and integration needs.


**Scalability \& Performance Metrics**
* Define and track KPIs related to adoption, performance, cost savings, automation rates, and ROI.
* Analyze scalability indicators such as: Volume handling capacity, User growth impact, Process cycle time, Cost per transaction.
* Flag technical or operational bottlenecks early.


 Key Result Responsibilities\-Continued
   

  

**Process Optimization**
* Map and optimize workflows to eliminate inefficiencies.
* Apply structured problem\-solving methodologies.
* Recommend process improvements supported by digital tools.


**Data Analysis \& Insight Generation**
* Extract and analyze operational and commercial data.
* Use data to validate impact of implemented solutions.


**Governance \& Documentation**
* Maintain clear documentation of solutions, workflows, metrics, and dependencies.
* Ensure compliance with IT governance, data security, and architectural standards.
* Support handover to development teams when scaling beyond MVP stage.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Monitor solution performance post\-implementation.
* Suggest iterations and optimizations.
* Stay updated on emerging tools and cost\-efficient technologies.


**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field
* Strong Understanding of Business Process Mapping \& Optimization
* Strong Knowledge of Low\-Code / No\-Code Solution Development.
* Exposure to low\-code/no\-code tools, workflow automation platforms, or data visualization tools.


 Work Experience
   

  

* 1 year of experience in business analysis, solution analysis, digital transformation, or technology\-enabled operations.
* Experience working in structured IT or digital environments (aviation industry is a plus).

The DFMEA Facilitator will also work in developing and incorporating lessons learned into generic DFMEA templates for common products, and support implementation of industry leading DFMEA methods .
 



 The DFMEA Facilitator will collaborate to capture and institutionalize lessons learned, update generic DFMEA templates, and standardize best practices across global engineering locations. * Ensure project teams follow standard DFMEA procedures and apply the templates and tools effectively.
* Ensure DFMEA content quality, consistency of nomenclature, and normalization of scoring across all projects.

* Ensure project DFMEA document meets the required maturity level in accordance with each program gate.

**Company Description**

Its mission is to nurture innovative minds by consistently delivering engaging and affordable educational content.

Day\-to\-day responsibilities include creating clear and accurate solutions for textbooks and assessments, developing practice questions and tests, preparing explanatory notes and step\-by\-step solutions, and supporting the creation of video lectures and live Q\&A sessions. * Candidates should possess competencies in explaining complex concepts clearly, step\-by\-step reasoning, and structuring content for different academic levels and exams.
* Candidates should possess abilities in reviewing and proofreading mathematical content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to guidelines.
* Master’s degree or higher in Mathematics or a closely related field is preferred; strong performance in competitive exams or teaching experience is an advantage.
* Comfort with using digital tools for content creation (e.g., LaTeX, equation editors, learning platforms) and collaboration software.
* Excellent written English, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast\-paced, content\-focused environment.
* Commitment to learner\-centered education, openness to feedback, and willingness to work on\-site in New Delhi as part of a collaborative team.

title: Consultant – Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit)
description:
Position Code : PHFI\-CNST\-2683
   

  

 Position Title : Consultant – Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit)
   

  

 No. of Positions : 1
   

  

 Working Location : Delhi
   

  

 Duration of Position : 06 Months or co\-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier
   

  

**Brief On The Organization**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) is working towards building a healthier India. It is helping to address the limited institutional and systems capacity in India by strengthening education and training, advancing research and technology and facilitating policy and practice in the area of Public Health. PHFI is headquartered in New Delhi with national presence through its constituent units of regional Indian Institutes of Public Health (IIPHs) and Centers of Applied Research in core public health themes. The Foundation, established in 2006 as a public private initiative, is governed by an independent board comprising of senior government officials, eminent Indian and International academic and leaders, civil society representatives and corporate leaders. For more information, please visit the website w
 **ww.phfi.org** 
 .
   

  

**Project Brief**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) serves as a Sub\-Recipient (SR) under the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GFATM) for the period April 2024 to March 2027, to implement key capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program Phase V (NACP\-V). The project officially commenced on May 1, 2024\. PHFI is responsible for implementing activities under three major components:
   

  

* SR Activity Management HUB
* Capacity Building – Central Region
* Capacity Building – North Region


 As the SR for the SR Activity Management HUB, PHFI will manage and coordinate sub\-recipient activities and provide institutionalized oversight and technical support. This includes performance monitoring, financial management, risk mitigation, and facilitating capacity\-building interventions. The HUB plays a critical role in ensuring horizontal integration at the SACS and NACO levels and acts as a central technical agency for strengthening community systems (CSS), DISHA, and community\-led monitoring (CLM).
   

  

 In the Central and North Regions, PHFI will directly implement capacity\-building activities in line with the project agreement and work plans. These include training, technical assistance, and supportive supervision aimed at enhancing service delivery in HIV prevention, care, and support. The SR ensures effective resource management, collaboration with the Principal Recipient (PR) and stakeholders, and alignment of programmatic goals across all implementation sites.
   

  

 PHFI’s role across these three components emphasizes accountability, technical excellence, and a coordinated approach to achieving the goals of the HIV program under GFATM.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit) supports the planning, coordination, implementation, and monitoring capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) and other public health projects. The Associate Coordinator will also assist in monitoring project progress, facilitating communication among stakeholders, contributing to data analysis and report reporting.
   

  

**Deliverables**
* Support the planning, coordination, and implementation of national, regional, state, and district\-level capacity\-building activities, including training, workshops, orientations, and review meetings.
* Coordinate with National Program Divisions, State AIDS Control Societies (SACS), government departments, implementing partners, technical agencies, and other stakeholders to facilitate timely execution of project activities.
* Assist in developing, reviewing, updating, and disseminating training curricula, facilitator guides, participant handbooks, presentations, job aids, and other learning resources.
* Undertake data analysis (in STATA or R) and review of literature, as and when required, as part of the project.
* Prepare high\-quality technical reports, meeting minutes, concept notes, briefing papers, presentations, progress reports, donor reports, and other project documentation.
* Perform any other task as assigned by the project team and PI.

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients throughout the building lifecycle, from early feasibility and concept design through construction, commissioning, and ongoing asset management. The consultancy works on a broad range of projects, including high\-rise, residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, airports, transport infrastructure, retail, and entertainment venues. As a manufacturer\-neutral advisor, D\&B’s recommendations are driven by safety, performance, operational efficiency, and lifecycle value rather than equipment supply. The company’s objective is to help clients deliver safe, efficient, maintainable, and future\-ready buildings through independent specialist advice and engineering expertise.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Graduate Engineering Trainee will support engineering and consultancy activities related to vertical transportation and façade access systems. This full\-time hybrid role is based in New Delhi, with a mix of office work and some work\-from\-home flexibility. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting in technical analysis and design reviews, preparing calculations, drawings, and reports, and supporting project documentation and coordination. The trainee will contribute to feasibility studies, data collection, and performance assessments for lifts, escalators, façades, and access systems under guidance from senior engineers. The role also involves collaborating with project teams, attending client or design meetings as required, and learning industry standards, safety regulations, and best practices.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written reporting and effective collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
* Candidates should possess Analytical Skills to interpret technical data, perform basic calculations, and support engineering evaluations.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to help plan tasks, track progress, and support on\-time delivery of project milestones.
* Candidates should possess Mechanical Engineering knowledge, ideally with exposure to building services or systems engineering.
* Candidates should possess Manufacturing Engineering or related applied engineering skills that support understanding of equipment, materials, and fabrication processes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with CAD tools or engineering software is an advantage.
* Ability to learn quickly, follow structured processes, and pay close attention to technical detail and safety requirements.
* Interest in building design, vertical transportation, façade engineering, or construction consultancy is highly beneficial.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Technical Writer who can simplify complex technical concepts and create clear, accurate, and user\-friendly documentation for our products and technology ecosystem. The role will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to build and maintain high\-quality technical content.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Create and maintain product and technical documentation, including user guides, API documentation, release notes, FAQs, and knowledge\-base articles.
 



 • Translate complex technical concepts and product functionalities into clear and easy\-to understand content.
 



 • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, Developers, QA, and Customer Success teams to gather and validate technical information.
 



 • Develop documentation for APIs, integrations, workflows, configurations, and product features.
 



 • Create step\-by\-step guides, process documentation, troubleshooting guides, and how\-to articles.
 



 • Review and update existing documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency, and relevance.
 



 • Maintain documentation standards, terminology, structure, and content quality across products.
 



 • Understand user journeys and create documentation that enables customers and internal teams to effectively use the platform.
 



 • Support product launches by preparing documentation for new features and enhancements.
 



 • Incorporate feedback from customers, support teams, and internal stakeholders to continuously improve documentation.
 



 • Manage documentation through appropriate tools and maintain proper version control.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 • 2–5 years of experience in Technical Writing, Product Documentation, API Documentation, or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS/technology environment.
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 



 • Ability to understand and explain technical concepts in simple language.
 



 • Experience creating API documentation, user guides, knowledge\-base articles, and product documentation.
 



 • Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, REST APIs, webhooks, and software development concepts.
 



 • Familiarity with documentation tools such as Confluence, Notion, Git, Markdown, Swagger/OpenAPI, or similar platforms.
 



 • Strong research, analytical, and attention\-to\-detail skills.
 



 • Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
 



 • Experience working with B2B SaaS or e\-commerce products will be an advantage.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 




 You will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Business teams to ensure that Unicommerce's complex SaaS products and integrations are documented in a way that is accurate, scalable, and easy for customers and internal teams to understand.
 



  





**Why Join Unicommerce?** 




 • Work on products powering large\-scale e\-commerce operations.
 



 • Exposure to B2B SaaS, e\-commerce, APIs, integrations, OMS, WMS, and omnichannel commerce.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional product and technology teams.
 



 • Opportunity to build documentation practices for a growing SaaS ecosystem.

title: Associate, Knowledge Management, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work \- guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic, self\-motivated recent graduate to join our Knowledge Management (KM) team as a Knowledge Management Associate. This role sits within the Global AI and Knowledge Innovation Organization (GAIKO) and works alongside KM Business Partners to support the design, rollout, and adoption of knowledge management solutions across our consulting business units. This role is broad by design and will expose the ideal candidate to an array of knowledge management activities in support of our firm’s goal to enable practitioners with AI tooling.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 Support Business Partners' stakeholder meetings across KM initiatives, including scheduling, preparing materials, taking notes, and tracking follow\-up actions.
   

  

* Support the rollout of new KM tools and platform features, including facilitating user acceptance testing (UAT), consolidating feedback, creating user guides and process documentation, and serving as a point of contact for users during hypercare
* Design, build, and maintain SharePoint pages and sites in support of KM initiatives, applying consistent structure, navigation, and visual standards
* Update and maintain SharePoint pages and lists for key knowledge products as content, processes, and platform capabilities evolve
* Support content quality assurance, including tagging, document sanitization, and content organization
* Build strong working relationships across the KM team and with business unit stakeholders to ensure clear, consistent communication
* Demonstrate a willingness to assist with tasks outside the immediate role when it benefits the wider team.


**Qualifications**
* Recent university graduate (Bachelor's degree or above), or professional with 0–3 years of experience in knowledge management, content management, or a related field
* Bachelor's degree in a related area, or equivalent work/technical experience, in Business Studies, Business Administration, Management, Technology, or Library Sciences
* Internship or work experience with transferable skills preferred
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint required; SharePoint page design or site administration experience strongly preferred. Salesforce experience a plus
* Fluent English is essential, as this person will report to an English\-speaking global team. Additional languages (Portuguese, Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean) are a plus but not required
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing content quality and testing feedback
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Comfortable coordinating and engaging with multiple stakeholder groups, including senior management
* Practical, organized approach to managing testing cycles, documentation, and hypercare support
* Sound judgment and problem\-solving ability, with a track record of following through on tasks to completion
* Adaptable and responsive, with the ability to manage competing priorities and shifting timelines
* Able to work independently while keeping the wider team informed.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

 We are seeking an enthusiastic, self\-motivated knowledge management professional to join our growing KM Services team. As part of A\&M’s Global AI and Knowledge Organization, KM Services is at the center of an exciting firm\-wide transformation in how A\&M works and derives value from its intellectual property. The team is focused on building a mature knowledge management practice, including strengthening relationships with business stakeholders; breaking down siloes; and improving how consulting teams capture, organize, share, and find critical knowledge. This is a high\-visibility role for someone who wants to help business units get more value from their knowledge while also contributing directly to global KM and AI initiatives. The role will report to the EMEA \& India KM Services Director
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Partner with A\&M Business Units on KM Initiatives
* Own the day\-to\-day KM relationship for India business units, with the opportunity to expand the portfolio over time
* Serve as the primary liaison between assigned business units and the central KM team, identifying opportunities to extend each business unit’s use of KM services and maximize KM adoption and value
* Lead projects to build and refine business\-unit KM processes and tools, including coordinating timelines and partnering with KM services, KM technology, and other corporate groups on execution
* Monitor and provide routine support for business\-unit KM processes and tools (e.g., knowledge libraries, taxonomies, capture processes, search, and communities)
* Provide advice and recommendations to business units based on internal and external KM best practices.
* Contribute to KM Knowledge and Expertise
* Partner with KM colleagues to design and build global capabilities and tools (e.g., expert profiles, conversational knowledge search, agentic knowledge capture) and help extend them to new areas of the business
* Support KM team members on initiatives both within and beyond the immediate region, contributing to a cohesive global KM capability
* Share knowledge of processes, approaches, methods, and tools/platforms with team colleagues so the team can leverage its collective experience across the globe
* Provide insight into business needs, initiatives, and end\-user experience to help ensure global KM service offerings remain relevant and aligned to overall strategy

title: Content Writer
description:
**Hiring: Content Writer – EdTech \& SEO** 




  





 Company: MatchToCollege Web Private Limited
 



 Location: Gurgaon
 



 Work Mode: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 1–3 years
 



 Salary: Upto ₹6 LPA (depending on experience and skills)
 



  





**About MatchToCollege** 




 MatchToCollege is an AI\-powered higher education and career discovery platform helping students discover colleges, universities, courses, entrance exams and career opportunities.
 



  





**We are looking for a Content Writer who understands both content and SEO and can create accurate, engaging, student\-focused content that performs on Google.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create high\-quality, original and engaging content for
 **college/university listings, blogs, admissions campaigns, social media and marketing materials** 
 .
* Research and write content related to
 **courses, programs, admissions, eligibility, campus life, placements, student experiences and career opportunities** 
 .
* Develop SEO\-friendly
 **blogs, landing pages, FAQs, course descriptions, college pages and other website content** 
 .
* Create content around
 **MBA, BBA, MCA, BCA, B.Com, CAT, CUET, NEET, higher education, admissions, colleges, universities and careers** 
 .
* Conduct thorough research and ensure all education\-related information is
 **accurate, relevant and up to date** 
 .
* Write student\-focused content that is clear, informative and aligned with MatchToCollege's brand voice.
* Conduct
 **keyword research, search\-intent analysis and competitor/SERP research** 
 before developing content.
* Identify content opportunities based on
 **search volume, ranking potential, student queries and content gaps** 
 .
* Create SEO\-friendly
 **titles, H1/H2/H3 structures, meta titles, meta descriptions, FAQs and URL slugs** 
 .
* Optimise existing content to improve
 **Google rankings, impressions, CTR and organic traffic** 
 .
* Understand and monitor
 **Google Search Console data** 
 , including clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and indexing status.
* Identify basic
 **indexing, duplicate\-content, internal\-linking and technical SEO issues** 
 and coordinate with the SEO/technical team.
* Develop strategic
 **internal linking** 
 between relevant college, course, exam and article pages.
* Collaborate with admissions, marketing, academic, SEO and product teams to understand content requirements.
* Interview
 **faculty, students, alumni and industry professionals** 
 when required and convert insights into compelling content.
* Develop
 **social media copy, campaign content, emailers and video/YouTube scripts** 
 as required.
* Edit and proofread content for
 **grammar, clarity, consistency, readability and factual accuracy** 
 .
* Use AI\-assisted content tools responsibly for
 **research and drafting** 
 , while maintaining originality, accuracy and human editorial quality.
* Manage multiple content assignments and consistently deliver
 **high\-quality work within deadlines** 
 .



  





**🔍 SEO \& Technical Knowledge Required** 




  





 The candidate should have practical understanding of:
 



  





**Keyword Research** 



* Primary \& secondary keywords
* Long\-tail keywords
* Search volume
* Search intent
* Keyword difficulty
* Keyword mapping
* Competitor keyword research



  





**On\-Page SEO** 



* SEO titles
* Meta descriptions
* H1/H2/H3 structure
* URL slugs
* Internal linking
* Image optimisation
* FAQs
* Content optimisation



  





**Google Search** 



* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics / GA4
* Indexing and de\-indexing
* Search queries
* Impressions
* Clicks
* CTR
* Average position
* Organic traffic
* Ranking analysis



  





**Basic Technical SEO** 



* Sitemap
* Robots.txt
* Canonical tags
* Duplicate content
* Thin content
* Crawl/indexing basics



  





**🎓 Desired Skills** 



* Excellent written and verbal
 **English communication** 
 .
* Strong
 **research, storytelling and proofreading** 
 skills.
* Good understanding of
 **SEO and digital content** 
 .
* Ability to simplify complex academic information for
 **students and parents** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **student search behaviour and education\-related queries** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **WordPress/CMS** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **Google Search Console and Google Analytics** 
 .
* Familiarity with SEO/content tools such as
 **Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Keyword Planner, etc.**
* Ability to work with large volumes of content without compromising quality.
* Strong attention to detail and factual accuracy.
* Experience in the
 **education/college/EdTech sector** 
 will be an added advantage.



  





  





**⭐ What We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who only knows how to write good English.
 



  





**We want someone who thinks beyond writing:** 




 What is the student searching for?
 



 Why are they searching for it?
 



 What keywords have search demand?
 



 What is Google currently ranking?
 



 What information is missing?
 



 How can we create something more useful?
 



  





**For us, content is not just about publishing articles.** 




  





**Content \= Search Demand \+ Student Intent \+ Accuracy \+ SEO \+ Business Impact.** 




  





 📊 How We'll Measure Success
 



 Your performance will not be measured only by the number of articles published.
 



  





 We'll look at:
 



**Content Quality \+ Indexing \+ Rankings \+ Impressions \+ Clicks \+ CTR \+ Organic Traffic \+ Student Engagement**
