**Your Impact**
 You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management, continuous improvement, and operational health of the learning technology stack that powers learner experiences and program delivery.
   

  

 This includes supporting the LMS, key SaaS integrations (e.g., Marketo), reporting and data flows, and custom operational tooling.
   

  

 You will work closely with programming teams, vendors, and firm Learning Technology colleagues to gather requirements, identify enhancement opportunities, maintain platform reliability, and coordinate delivery of technical improvements. You will help define and maintain the product roadmap for the GSR learning technology ecosystem, recommending priorities and enhancements based on user needs, operational considerations, and platform opportunities. You will help with major roadmap decisions, strategic tradeoffs, and platform evolution initiatives will be developed in partnership with and syndicated through the Learning Technology team to ensure alignment with broader firm technology strategy. Your success requires strong technical judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder coordination, and the ability to balance operational excellence with continuous platform improvement in support of the Global Social Responsibility (GSR) mission\-driven learning programs.
   

  

 You will support platform performance, resilience, integrations, security, and vendor\-orchestrated delivery while partnering across program teams, firm functions, and external providers to deliver a high\-quality learner experience at scale.
   

  

 You will help define and maintain the technical product roadmap across the LMS, integrations, reporting, and operational tooling by gathering requirements, prioritizing enhancements, evaluating technical solutions, identifying automation and process improvement opportunities, assessing risks and dependencies, and contributing recommendations for future platform capabilities in partnership with the Learning Technology Product Manager.
   

  

 You will serve as the day\-to\-day steward of the GSR learning technology ecosystem by monitoring platform health, coordinating incident response, supporting root\-cause analysis, maintaining visibility into operational risks and dependencies, and driving continuous service improvement.
   

  

 You will support learner, program, and operational data flows by translating reporting requirements into technical solutions, improving data quality and reporting usability, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
   

  

 You will manage day\-to\-day platform operations, including configuration, integrations, release coordination, change management, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and lightweight technical enhancements while improving platform maintainability and supporting adoption of new capabilities.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for technology vendors by coordinating issue resolution, managing vendor\-delivered enhancements, monitoring service performance, supporting sourcing and renewal decisions, and ensuring alignment with firm technology governance, architecture, and security standards.

* Demonstrated ability to prioritize work, manage multiple initiatives, and drive delivery in a fast\-paced environment
* Product management skills, including requirements gathering, backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross\-functional coordination
* Strong technical aptitude with experience supporting platform operations, integrations, automation, reporting workflows, and continuous improvement
* Analytical problem\-solving skills with the ability to leverage data, metrics, structured analysis, and GenAI\-assisted tools to troubleshoot issues and implement practical solutions
* Sound judgment, adaptability, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, build productive partnerships, and escalate strategic decisions appropriately
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

 Your work will directly support the optimization of our technology value chain, enhance project outcomes, and strengthen our ability to deliver innovative solutions to customers worldwide.

You are comfortable navigating complex technical, industrial, or engineering environments and have a track record of facilitating collaboration and driving results across diverse teams.

 At Topsoe, we’re problem solvers. In every role, across every office, you’ll find people passionate about finding the right answers. For over 80 years, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, always focused on solving some of the world’s biggest challenges together. Working closely with Research and Development (R\&D) and cross\-functional teams, you will contribute to scaling innovative solutions within Low Carbon, Renewables, and Clean Air. Our team's success is built on strong technical expertise, a commitment to continuous improvement, and the drive to enhance capabilities, efficiency, and competitiveness across the global value chain.
   

  

**How You Can Apply**

 07\-10\-2026

 Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

title: Senior Associate, Knowledge Management, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. **The Team**
 At Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M), the Senior Associate, Knowledge Management drives data discoverability through AI by managing complex metadata ecosystems across cloud\-based platforms. Operating from our Delhi Global Capability Center (GCC), this professional ensures that high\-value professional services knowledge assets remain flawlessly structured, compliant, and searchable across diverse environments during continuous platform migrations and enrichment exercises. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between structured library taxonomy and cloud data architecture, managing metadata lifecycles across collaborative, storage, and data warehouse layers
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Vendor Assessment \& Enterprise Implementation: Advise on and actively participate in vendor assessments, evaluations, and enterprise\-wide implementations of taxonomy, ontology, and graph management systems
* Knowledge Graph Development: Design, build, and scale semantic knowledge graphs to map interconnected business concepts, industry verticals, and global advisory practices
* Taxonomy\-to\-Ontology Management: Transform flat data taxonomies into complex ontologies by defining, maintaining, and governing relationships, classes, and properties between distinct digital assets
* Multi\-System Metadata Management: Design, map, and enforce metadata schemas across fragmented repository layers including SharePoint Online, Snowflake, Box, and others as identified in day\-to\-day operations
* Metadata Migrations: Plan, execute, and validate metadata migrations between and within cloud platforms, ensuring zero data loss, schema alignment, and continuous asset taxonomy
* System Interoperability: Coordinate cross\-platform indexing to ensure assets stored across relational data warehouses (Snowflake), content repositories (Box), and collaboration hubs (Teams/SharePoint Online) remain structurally unified
* Data Cleansing \& Reconciliation: Audit existing datasets to correct broken inheritance, fill missing metadata fields, and harmonize legacy taxonomies with global master data standards


**Qualifications**
* Experience Level: 3–5 years of direct metadata, semantic web, or data migration experience is required; 5\+ years is highly preferred
* Education: Bachelor’s degree required. Completed or ongoing Master’s\-level coursework in Library \& Information Science (MLIS), Information Technology, Data Management, or a related technical discipline is highly preferred
* Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to effectively interface, interview, and collaborate with subject\-matter experts across a wide variety of consulting specializations (e.g., corporate restructuring, transaction advisory, private equity)
* Semantic Capabilities: Solid understanding of semantic web concepts (such as RDF, OWL, SKOS, or graph structures) to manage relational data modeling.
* System Expertise: Proven experience managing metadata structures within SharePoint Online (Managed Metadata Service), Snowflake (object tagging/data cataloging), and Box (custom metadata templates)
* Migration Tooling Collaboration: Familiarity collaborating with technical IT/infrastructure resources to manage mapping configurations via Sharegate or similar migration software (direct standalone administration of these engineering tools is not required)
* Coding/Scripting (Optional): Prior coding experience (such as SQL for Snowflake environments, PowerShell, or graph query languages like SPARQL/Cypher) is an asset but not required.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Product Marketing Manager — Customer Proof, Sales Enablement \& ABM
 
**Location:** 
  Gurugram, Haryana
 



**Reports to:** 
  Head of Marketing
 



**Type:** 
  Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
  4–7 years in B2B SaaS product marketing, content marketing, or sales enablement
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager who turns customer outcomes into revenue assets. This is a hands\-on, writing\-heavy, cross\-functional role sitting at the intersection of Delivery, Sales, Product and Marketing.
 



 You will own three things end\-to\-end: the customer proof engine (case studies and the content repository built on top of them), the sales enablement library, and ABM email campaigns that put that proof in front of the right accounts. If you enjoy interviewing customers, writing sharp narratives, and seeing your assets show up in live deals, this role is built for you.
 


 What You'll Own1\. Case Study Creation \& Distribution
 * Run the customer proof pipeline end\-to\-end — from identifying candidate accounts with Delivery, Customer Success and Sales, to interview, draft, approval and publication.
* Establish a repeatable nomination\-to\-publication process with a defined SLA and a committed monthly/quarterly output target.
* Conduct customer interviews and pull hard numbers from Delivery and Product so every story leads with quantified outcomes, not adjectives.
* Manage the client approval loop, including legal sign\-off, logo usage rights and anonymisation where needed.
* Build and maintain a central content repository — every asset tagged by industry, use case, persona, deal stage, region and product line, so Sales can find the right proof in under a minute.
* Repurpose each story into a full asset set: long\-form case study, one\-page PDF, slide for the pitch deck, LinkedIn carousel, email proof snippet, video testimonial cut, and website page.
* Build and publish case study pages on the website yourself — working hands\-on in the CMS to create pages, upload assets, apply on\-page SEO basics (titles, meta, alt text, internal links, schema) and keep the customer stories section current without waiting on a developer.
* Own the structure of the customer stories hub on the site — filters by industry and use case, gated vs. ungated logic, and the forms and CTAs that route enquiries into the CRM.
* Push distribution across owned and outbound channels — website, sales decks, nurture email, SDR sequences, social, PR and award submissions.


 2\. Sales Enablement Assets
 * Own the master pitch deck and its variants by vertical, persona and deal stage.
* Build and maintain the core enablement library: product one\-pagers, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection\-handling guides, pricing narratives, ROI/business\-case templates, and a reusable RFP and security\-questionnaire response bank.
* Partner with Product on launch narratives — translate features into positioning, messaging and proof points that a rep can actually say out loud.
* Run enablement sessions for AEs and SDRs on new assets, messaging updates and how to use each asset in the sales cycle.
* Own version control and governance so there is exactly one current version of every asset, and retire what is stale.
* Track asset usage and influence (HubSpot, deck\-sharing analytics, win/loss inputs) and kill or rebuild what isn't getting used.


 3\. ABM Campaign Emails
 * Work with Sales and the SDR team to define target account tiers and the buying committee within each.
* Write account\-specific and persona\-specific email sequences anchored on the most relevant customer proof — matching the right case study to the right account, industry and pain point.
* Build and manage sequences in HubSpot: personalisation tokens, dynamic content, branching logic, list hygiene and suppression rules.
* Design multi\-touch plays that combine email, LinkedIn, SDR calling and personalised assets into a single coordinated motion per account tier.
* Run structured A/B tests on subject lines, hooks, proof points and CTAs, and turn results into a documented messaging playbook.
* Report on reply rate, meeting conversion, account engagement and pipeline influenced — and feed those learnings back into positioning.


 What Success Looks Like
 
**First 90 days** 



* Content repository audited, structured and live, with the existing asset base tagged and searchable.
* First 2–3 case studies published under the new process, with the pipeline for the next quarter already identified.
* Master pitch deck refreshed and rolled out to the Sales team.
* Customer stories section live on the website, published independently, with the first stories up.



**First 6–12 months** 



* A predictable cadence of published customer stories with named owners at every stage.
* Sales enablement library with measurable adoption across the AE and SDR team.
* ABM email programme running as a repeatable engine, with attributed meetings and pipeline you can point to.


 What We're Looking For
 
**Must have** 



* 4–7 years in B2B SaaS product marketing, content marketing or sales enablement.
* Exceptional business writing — you can take a messy customer interview and turn it into a story a CXO will read to the end. A portfolio of published case studies or sales assets is required.
* Direct experience interviewing customers and working with enterprise sales teams.
* Hands\-on with a marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot strongly preferred) — building sequences, lists, workflows and reports yourself.
* Hands\-on with a website CMS (HubSpot CMS, WordPress or Webflow) — able to build, publish and update pages independently, with working knowledge of on\-page SEO.
* Comfortable operating cross\-functionally without formal authority, chasing inputs from Delivery, Product and Sales and still shipping on time.
* Strong project management instincts — you run a content calendar, not a to\-do list.



**Good to have** 



* Experience marketing to enterprise buyers in BFSI, retail or D2C.
* Exposure to AI, video or martech categories.
* Working knowledge of Figma, Canva or equivalent — enough to build a clean deck without waiting on design for everything.
* Experience with ABM platforms or intent data tools.
* Script writing for video assets.

description:

**Location:**

 1–4 years

 TheHireHub.AI is an AI\-driven recruitment platform founded in 2025 and headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana, India. The company automates the hiring process across sourcing, screening, engagement, and coordination, helping teams hire faster and more efficiently. The company operates with a focused team of approximately 2–10 employees, creating an environment where individual ownership, speed, and adaptability matter. TheHireHub.AI values innovation, efficiency, empowerment, and an inclusive workplace culture. This role offers close exposure to the founders and the opportunity to contribute directly to company\-building initiatives across strategy, operations, research, customer\-facing work, and execution.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Founder’s Office Associate will work closely with the founders to drive strategic, operational, and cross\-functional priorities for TheHireHub.AI. The role is designed for a skilled early\-career professional who can move comfortably between research, planning, execution, communication, and problem\-solving. You will help the founders organize priorities, prepare business insights, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure important initiatives move forward with speed and clarity. Success in this role means creating leverage for the founders, improving execution quality, and converting loosely defined opportunities into completed outcomes. The ideal candidate communicates confidently, manages multiple workstreams without losing detail, and takes ownership from start to finish. This is a high\-exposure role suited to someone who enjoys variety, learns quickly, handles ambiguity, and wants to understand how an AI recruitment software company is built and scaled.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own founder\-led projects from problem definition through execution, using structured plans, milestones, and stakeholder follow\-ups to deliver timely business outcomes.
* Prepare market, customer, competitor, and business research that helps the founders evaluate opportunities, refine priorities, and make informed decisions.
* Coordinate cross\-functional initiatives across product, sales, marketing, operations, and customer conversations, maintaining clear ownership and momentum.
* Build concise presentations, business updates, operating documents, and decision briefs that improve alignment and accelerate founder\-level decision\-making.
* Track key priorities, action items, and dependencies through reliable systems, escalating risks early and ensuring commitments are closed.
* Support customer, partner, and internal communication by preparing context, managing follow\-ups, and representing the company with professionalism and clarity.
* Identify recurring operational gaps and implement lightweight processes, templates, and dashboards that improve execution consistency as the company grows.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to simplify complex information, present clear recommendations, and interact confidently with founders, customers, and stakeholders.
* Proven multitasking and prioritization skills, with disciplined execution across multiple simultaneous workstreams, shifting priorities, and incomplete information.
* Comfortable using productivity, documentation, presentation, spreadsheet, project\-management, and collaboration tools to organize information and create visibility.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring 1–4 years of experience in a Founder’s Office or a comparable role involving business operations, strategy, project execution, or cross\-functional coordination. You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, organize information well, and can adapt your message for founders, customers, and internal teams. You are comfortable handling several priorities at once while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and follow\-through. You do not wait for perfect instructions; you clarify the objective, structure the problem, propose a path forward, and keep stakeholders informed. You can move between detailed execution and broader business context, understanding how individual tasks connect to company outcomes. You are skilled with common workplace tools for documents, presentations, spreadsheets, research, communication, and task tracking. You bring sound judgment, curiosity, discretion, and a bias toward action. Most importantly, you take ownership of outcomes rather than limiting yourself to assigned activities, and you are motivated by the opportunity to work closely with founders while helping build an ambitious AI recruitment software company.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work closely with the founders and gain broad exposure to strategy, operations, product, customers, and company\-building decisions from an early stage.

* Develop high\-value skills across structured problem\-solving, communication, prioritization, stakeholder management, and operating systems.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to founders and meaningful ownership across strategic and operational initiatives in an AI\-powered recruitment software company.
* A high\-learning, cross\-functional environment where strong performance creates opportunities to take on broader responsibilities and influence company\-building priorities.
* The opportunity to work from the Noida office with a focused early\-stage team and contribute to products shaping modern recruitment workflows.

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Consultant in the Skyhigh Customer Value team, you will play a critical role in ensuring customers maximize the value of our solutions. You will guide customers through their product adoption journey, ensuring seamless deployment, integration, and continuous optimization. This role will develop deep relationships with our largest customers and complete the technical onboarding process for our smaller customers. **Customer Adoption \& Expansion**

* Monitor solution performance, adoption and provide proactive recommendations to improve efficiency, security, and compliance.
* Participate in business reviews and conduct technical health checks to track progress and address gaps.
* Identify opportunities for expansion by assessing additional use cases, security.
* Assist with change management and internal advocacy within customer teams to drive long\-term adoption.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Manager, Sales, and Product teams to align solutions with customer objectives.


**Documentation, Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement**
* Document deployment procedures, configuration settings, and optimization strategies.
* Contribute to the internal knowledge base for Professional Services and TAM best practices.
* Mentor and coach other Technical Consultants and Technical Account Managers to enhance team expertise.
* Contribute to internal knowledge\-sharing initiatives, training programs, and best practice discussions.
* Provide feedback on customer pain points and feature requests to Product and Engineering teams.
* Stay up to date with industry security trends, emerging threats, and SSE product advancements.


**Background And Experience Required For a Technical Consultant**
* 7 to 10\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Technical Consultant, Solution Architect, Technical Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or similar).
* Ready to work on permanent EST shift
* Strong background in network security, cloud security, and SSE/SASE solutions.
* Experience with firewalls, proxies, CASB, DLP, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and SWG (Secure Web Gateway).
* Proficiency in network protocols, authentication mechanisms, and security frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with a customer\-first mindset.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for various audiences.
* Experience coaching and training customers to use technical products effectively.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts while prioritizing key customer needs.
* It would be great if you also have the following, but they are not required:
* Industry certifications such as CCNA Security, Comptia security\+, AWS/Azure Security, CCSK/CCSP or CISSP.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and managing multi\-region
* deployments.
* Experience working with PSA tools (Open Air, Financial Force etc.).
* Customer Value Career Path


**Career Progression In Customer Value**
 The natural progression for someone who has demonstrated full proficiency, and executed at a ratings level of ‘Above Target’ consistently would be to prepare a succession plan for a role as a Solution Architect, focused on the design of the integration of Skyhigh products in the customer environment to execute against their use cases and create value realization. Further growth opportunities may include moving into leadership roles such as Manager, Customer Value team based on expertise and career aspirations.
   

  

**Company Benefits And Perks**
 We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

 We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
   

  

**Our Commitment To You**
 At Skyhigh Security, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. title: Specialist - Pilot line Electrode & Mixing
description:
Purpose of the Role
   

  

 Own the technical process for Electrode operations Feeding/Mixing, slurry preparation and coating on the Pilot Line.
   

  

 Develop, validate, and standardize process parameters for each chemistry (e.g., LFP, NMC, or other emerging chemistries), and lead DOE studies to define robust process windows ahead of scale\-up to mass production. Act as the technical bridge between R\&D, Quality, and Production during chemistry changeovers and NPI trials translating formulation/design inputs into executable process specifications and control plans and troubleshooting process deviations using engineering root\-cause methods. Ensure process data is captured accurately in MES/SAP to support Cpk/SPC analysis and CAPA closure.
   

  

 Key Responsibility Areas

description:

 .

* Good communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Interest in vehicle electrical system integration, testing, validation, and debugging.

title: Creative & Content Strategist (US Client Facing)
description:
**Job Title:** Creative \& Content Strategist (US Client Facing)

**Company:** Arijentek Solution Private Limited

**Location:** Pollachi (India)

**Salary:** \[₹2,40,000to ₹5,00,000 per year (2\.4 LPA to 5\.0 LPA)]

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Working Hours:** Afternoon Shift, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST

**About Us**

At Arijentek, we build bridges between exceptional talent in India and growing businesses in the US. Our internal teams of developers, designers, and support staff work seamlessly to deliver high\-quality digital solutions. We are currently looking for a creative, highly organized strategist to serve as the dedicated link between our US clients and our execution teams.

**What You'll Do**

You will take full ownership of the client's creative design, concept generation, and monthly content calendar. Working directly with the US client team, you will gather content requirements and act as their dedicated day\-to\-day resource. You will coordinate with our internal team to bring your creative concepts to life, producing 20 core social posts each month, which must include four short\-form videos. You will also adapt and repurpose this content across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profiles.

In addition to creative work, you will provide account coordination, handle client approvals, schedule meetings, and participate in monthly optimization meetings and quarterly performance reviews. While you won't be leading technical marketing campaigns, you will assist our technical team with organic SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI\-search visibility strategies when necessary.

**Who We're Looking For**

We need a design\-focused creative who communicates flawlessly and can bridge the gap between a US client's vision and an offshore team's execution. You don't need to be a technical digital marketing expert, but you must have enough foundational knowledge of SEO, GA4, and conversion tracking to ensure your creative assets support broader marketing goals.

* Exceptional writers and communicators who are highly comfortable presenting to US stakeholders.
* Creative thinkers with a proven ability to design compelling digital assets and storyboard short videos.
* Highly organized individuals who can manage a complex publishing calendar and track project deadlines.
* Collaborative professionals who can assist with maintaining Google Business Profiles and local citations when needed.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal English: clear, precise, and professional.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating social media design, conceptual thinking, and video storyboarding.
* A working knowledge of modern search principles (organic SEO, AEO) and social media analytics.
* Experience managing client approvals and coordinating projects.
* Able to commute to and work from our Pollachi office for required in\-person days.

**Technical Requirements (Hybrid)**

* A dedicated, quiet home workspace with reliable high\-speed internet for your remote days.
* (Note: All necessary hardware and high\-speed internet will be provided at your dedicated workstation when in the office).

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** \[2\.4 LPA to 5\.0 LPA], based on experience and performance.
* **On\-Site \& Remote Flexibility:** Enjoy the best of both worlds with a balanced hybrid schedule at our Pollachi office.
* **Support \& Growth:** Clear guidelines, comprehensive onboarding, and the opportunity to lead creative direction for US clients.
* **Impact:** Join a mission\-driven team where your creative concepts directly shape our clients' digital presence and success.

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* This role requires working an afternoon shift from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST to ensure maximum overlap with our US clients. Are you completely comfortable and able to commit to this daily schedule?
* This role acts as the dedicated liaison bridging a US client's vision with our internal India\-based team of developers and designers. Can you share an example of how you have successfully managed cross\-functional communication and expectations?
* Please provide a direct link to your portfolio showcasing your digital design concepts, social media assets, and video storyboarding.
* While this is primarily a creative role, you will be supporting technical marketing teams with organic SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). Can you briefly explain your foundational knowledge of modern search principles and how you ensure your creative assets are SEO\-friendly?
* Are you able to reliably commute to our Pollachi office for the required on\-site days each week?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pollachi, Tamil Nadu

 Hospital Administration,

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation (VT) and Façade Access advisory services. The firm supports clients across the UK, Middle East, India, and other international markets throughout the full building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design to construction, commissioning, and asset management. D\&B provides expert guidance on lifts, escalators, moving walkways, and façade access systems, integrating safety, maintainability, and operational needs from the earliest design stages. The consultancy works across sectors such as high\-rise, residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, airports, transport, mixed\-use developments, retail, sports, and entertainment. As a manufacturer\-neutral advisor, D\&B’s recommendations are based on performance, safety, operational efficiency, and long\-term value for clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Graduate Engineering Trainee will support the design and advisory work for vertical transportation and façade access systems, contributing to projects across multiple building types and global markets. This full\-time hybrid role is based in Kochi, with a mix of office\-based work and some work\-from\-home flexibility. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting with technical analyses, preparing engineering calculations and reports, supporting traffic simulations and performance\-based designs, and contributing to tender documentation and design reviews. The trainee will help gather and interpret project data, coordinate with senior engineers and consultants, and assist in project planning and documentation. The role also involves learning relevant industry standards, participating in internal reviews, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver safe, efficient, and maintainable solutions.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering foundation, with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Solid Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret technical data, perform calculations, and support simulations or performance assessments.
* Effective Communication skills for clear written reports, documentation, and collaborative work with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Basic Project Management capabilities, such as task prioritization, time management, and supporting coordinated delivery across multiple projects.
* Interest in building services, vertical transportation, or façade access systems, and willingness to learn relevant standards and best practices.
* Proficiency in common engineering and office software (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint); familiarity with CAD or modelling tools is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Kochi, demonstrating reliability, self\-discipline, and collaborative attitude in both office and remote environments.
* Attention to detail, commitment to safety and quality, and a proactive approach to continuous learning and professional development.

A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
   

  

**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
 We are looking for an Account Executive to join the team.
   

  

**The Problem We're Solving**
 Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self\-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi\-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
   

  

 The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct\-tape together a few API calls and call it production\-ready.
   

  

**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**
* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self\-hosted models, custom tools, and agents


**AI Gateway** 
 is the control plane five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
   

  

 We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

 Ownership, ability to execute, hustle and think out of the box, data driven decision making, be comfortable with more unknowns than knowns.
   

  

**Perks of Working at TrueFoundry**

title: Account Executive / Account Manager, MM (India)
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
   

  

 As a hybrid Account Executive/Account Manager in our Mid\-Market segment (companies of 250 to 1,000 employees), based in our future Apollo Bangalore office, you drive net\-new outbound revenue across a territory of accounts and own the ongoing activation, expansion and renewal of a Tier 1/Tier 2 book you have already closed or inherited.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* Single point of contact end to end: outbound prospecting, discovery, demo, pricing, negotiation, procurement and close, then ongoing activation, expansion and renewal
* Own a combined territory of net\-new outbound accounts and an existing Tier 1/Tier 2 book \[size to confirm with RevOps — dedicated MM AE territories run 600\+ accounts, dedicated AM books are smaller and higher\-touch; expect a reduced blended number here]
* Partner closely with Sales Development Managers on outreach for the new\-business side, and with Customer Success, Support and Product on the account\-management side
* Based in Bangalore, open to in\-office presence once office opens


**Pipeline and sales process execution**
* Manage the entire sales process, new and existing, from first touch through discovery, demonstration, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal and close, inside an average cycle of 60 days or less
* Generate the large majority of new\-business pipeline through outbound prospecting into your territory, and manage the pipeline surfaced from within your existing book
* Run 4 or more meetings per day and 20 or more per week, combined across new\-business and account\-management work
* Develop a pipeline that is majority self\-sourced through outbound on the new\-business side \[confirm target mix — dedicated MM AE benchmark is 90% net\-new outbound; AM benchmark blends inbound and account planning], and consistently hold 3x pipeline coverage based on a 40% win rate
* Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly quotas for new\-business bookings and net revenue retention
* Own your schedule across research, initial meetings, platform demos, CRM hygiene, escalations, follow\-up meetings, business reviews and pricing calls
* Conduct customer meetings and account touches at a pace to be set by RevOps


**Sales strategy and deal management**
* Use a data\-driven approach to tier your account list, both for new\-business targeting and for identifying top expansion and at\-risk accounts within your book
* Run consultative discovery, asking layered questions and tying findings back to business outcomes, on new deals and existing accounts alike
* Communicate directly with Director and above contacts in Sales, Marketing and RevOps, and multi\-thread across departments
* Partner with Sales Development Managers on strategic outreach campaigns for the new\-business side
* Build detailed account plans for the top 20% of your book, focused on growth strategy and expansion opportunities
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of existing accounts' product usage to identify activation and adoption opportunities
* Articulate a clear view of your combined pipeline, deals and renewals at each stage, and forecast within a 10% margin
* Apply AI tooling to your own workflow to compress research, prep and follow\-up time across a broader scope of work than a single\-motion seat


**Mindset and culture**
* Thrive in a competitive environment, embracing challenges, enjoying objection handling and using setbacks as fuel
* Thrive with a high level of ambiguity and change while maintaining a customer\-centric approach at scale
* Take responsibility for successes and failures with a relentless drive to keep improving
* Be a self\-starter who stays motivated through repeated objections and repeated no on the new\-business side, and through slow\-moving accounts on the existing\-book side
* Sell as a team, proactively bringing leadership into deals and customer situations
* Bring genuine curiosity about sales technology, customer business models and industry trends
* Engage as your unique self in a diverse, inclusive and high\-performing team


**What We Are Looking For**
* 3\+ years of combined quota\-carrying net\-new closing and account management/expansion experience. Candidates with only one side of this (pure AE or pure AM) should show clear evidence of fast ramp on the other
* Top performer in current role, top 15% of the sales team, with stack rank known and nameable
* 100% or better attainment in at least three of the last four quarters, with an owned explanation for any miss
* 70% or more of new\-business pipeline self\-sourced through outbound \[confirm target mix for the hybrid seat]
* Deal and book economics consistent with Mid\-Market: cycle of 60 days or less, accounts of 250 to 1,000 employees
* A named consultative methodology applied day to day: MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Sandler, Challenger or Command of the Message
* Experience selling to and managing relationships with Director and above buyers in Sales, Marketing or RevOps
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Legal and Product teams
* Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve sales and account\-management productivity
* Coachable, and demonstrably so: you take feedback inside the conversation, not after it
* Based in Bangalore, India


 We are AI Native
   

  

 Apollo.io is an AI\-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.
   

  

 Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo
   

  

 At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we
 **take extreme ownership** 
 of our work,
 **move with focus and urgency** 
 , and
 **learn voraciously** 
 to stay ahead.
   

  

 We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to
 **own your role and make a real impact** 
 . Collaboration is at our core—we’re
 **all for one** 
 , meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage
 **bold ideas and courageous action** 
 , giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.
   

  

 Learn more here!

 We are looking for an analytical, commercially curious and execution\-oriented
 **Growth \& Business Development Intern**

 **AI products and technology services** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with the founder on market research, prospecting, customer acquisition, outbound campaigns, partnerships, product growth and new business opportunities across India, the US, Europe and other target markets.
 



 This is
 **not a social\-media\-only internship** 
 . The role combines research, business development, technology understanding, customer conversations, structured prospecting and analysis.
 



 You will have the opportunity to work across different markets and identify where ZetaVion's capabilities in AI, data, cybersecurity and engineering can solve meaningful business problems.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Research companies and industries that could benefit from ZetaVion's AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, engineering services or AI products.
* Identify potential customers across target markets including India, the US and Europe.
* Identify founders, CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, technology leaders, operations leaders, business heads and other relevant decision\-makers.
* Conduct structured account research to understand companies' technology environments, business priorities and potential needs.
* Make initial cold calls and conduct outbound outreach to introduce ZetaVion's capabilities, understand customer requirements and qualify opportunities.
* Build and maintain structured prospect, account and customer\-research databases.
* Support personalized email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Identify opportunities for AI automation, analytics, data engineering, cybersecurity and related technology services within target accounts.
* Identify potential customers and design partners for ZetaVion's AI products, including ZetaRecruiter.
* Prepare company\-specific research and briefing notes before customer meetings.
* Assist with discovery calls, product demonstrations, meeting notes and follow\-up communication.
* Develop content for LinkedIn, email campaigns, case studies, product communication and technology thought leadership.
* Conduct competitor, pricing, industry and market analysis.
* Track funnel metrics including outreach, responses, meetings, qualified opportunities, pilots, proposals and conversions.
* Test different customer segments, value propositions, messaging and acquisition channels.
* Research technology partnerships, vendor ecosystems and channel opportunities relevant to ZetaVion's offerings.
* Identify relevant conferences, industry events, startup programmes and business\-development opportunities.
* Document customer feedback and translate it into product, service and market insights.
* Support the development of proposals, presentations and customer\-facing business material.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in business, engineering, economics, marketing, computer science or a related discipline.
* Studying at a premier institute, or able to demonstrate equivalent excellence through startup work, leadership, measurable growth projects or entrepreneurial initiatives.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong online research, organization and analytical skills.
* Ability to understand business problems and communicate technology solutions clearly.
* Ability to write concise, personalized and persuasive business communication.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, CRM systems and productivity tools.
* Interest in technology and B2B business development.
* Curiosity about AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, cloud technologies and enterprise software.
* High ownership, reliability and willingness to work in an early\-stage environment.
* Willingness to speak with prospective customers through phone, email, LinkedIn and online meetings.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Previous startup, sales, business development, growth, consulting or market\-research experience.
* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting, outbound email, cold calling or CRM tools.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology, AI, cybersecurity, analytics, cloud or software services.
* Experience creating business content or managing founder\-led communication.
* Evidence of having generated leads, partnerships, community growth or other measurable commercial outcomes.
* Understanding of B2B sales funnels, experiments and conversion analysis.
* Ability to research technical topics and translate them into customer\-oriented business propositions.



**Success Measures** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* Quality and relevance of target accounts identified.
* Accuracy of decision\-maker and account research.
* Qualified customer conversations generated.
* Outreach response and meeting\-conversion rates.
* Quality of customer and market insights captured.
* Qualified product, services and partnership opportunities generated.
* Contribution to pilots, proposals, partnerships and paid customer conversions.
* Ability to identify new markets and commercial opportunities.
* Reliability, ownership and consistency of execution.



**What We Offer** 



* Direct collaboration with the founder.
* Hands\-on exposure to building the go\-to\-market function of an early\-stage technology company.
* Experience selling both
 **technology services and AI products** 
 .
* Exposure to AI, data analytics, data engineering, cybersecurity and enterprise technology.
* Opportunity to participate in customer discovery, product strategy, partnerships and B2B sales.
* Exposure to customers and prospects across India, the US and international markets.
* Opportunity to understand how new technology offerings are taken from capability to commercial opportunity.
* Internship stipend based on experience and availability.
* Performance incentives linked to clearly defined commercial outcomes.
* Potential conversion to a full\-time
 **Growth \& Business Development Executive** 
 role.
* ESOP eligibility upon conversion to qualifying full\-time employment, subject to the approved ESOP plan and applicable law.



**Application** 




 Please send your résumé and LinkedIn profile to
 **recruiting@zetavion.com** 
 .
 



 Please include a short response to the following:
 



**“Choose one area—AI, data analytics \& engineering, cybersecurity, or ZetaVion's AI products. If you had to identify 25 potential customers and generate the first five qualified conversations, how would you identify, prioritize and approach those companies?”**

With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare.  As we transition from a service\-oriented model to a product\-driven platform, we are expanding our hybrid Bengaluru based team. We are looking for an Outreach Specialist to contribute to our mission by helping us to engage and activate healthcare providers to participate in impactful and rewarding research opportunities. In this role you will make over 100 calls per day to healthcare providers. As Outreach Specialist you will be the voice of Konovo as you speak with Healthcare Providers across the globe about the opportunities to participate in healthcare market research that Konovo offers.
 



  





**How You’ll Make an Impact:** 



* Engage new healthcare professionals (doctors, nurses, technicians etc) to participate in paid market research via phone and email

* Deliver clear and effective written and verbal communication in English to both internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Ask a series of scripted questions over the telephone to determine whether research opportunities fit the prospective participant’s experience
* Use Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Salesforce to track efforts and communicate across departments

* Support operations team with independently managed phone\-based tasks such as reminder, confirmation, and scheduling calls to participants in research studies
* Ensure production
 
 goals of needed participants are met through effective execution
* Provide proactive feedback about production barriers to senior team members and problem solve to address them

**About Us**

We are a high\-growth startup building a premium brand in the interior and glass space. We are at an exciting stage where we are building a scalable, customer\-centric business with ambitious plans for growth. This is not a traditional corporate sales role—you will have the opportunity to work directly with the founders, take ownership, build relationships, close business and help shape our sales engine.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Sales professional with 2–5 years of experience who can handle both inside and field sales. You will identify opportunities, engage with customers, understand requirements, present solutions, coordinate internally and convert leads into revenue. You will work with homeowners, interior designers, architects, contractors and other stakeholders in the premium interior and glass ecosystem.

· Handle inbound enquiries and generate outbound leads through calls, WhatsApp and other channels.

· Understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.

· Maintain a structured sales pipeline and ensure timely, consistent follow\-ups.

· Convert enquiries into appointments, site visits and orders.

**Field Sales \& Relationship Building**

· Meet homeowners, architects, interior designers, contractors and potential customers.

· Conduct site visits, understand project requirements and present solutions professionally.

· Build relationships with architects, designers, contractors and channel partners.

· Identify new business opportunities and develop a strong local network.

· Negotiate, close and coordinate orders through completion.

**Sales Ownership**

· Own the sales process from lead generation to closure and achieve monthly/quarterly targets.

· Maintain accurate customer and sales data; track leads, conversions and lost opportunities.

· Work closely with operations and founders to ensure a smooth customer experience.

· Identify gaps in the sales process and proactively suggest improvements.

**What We're Looking For**

Must have:

· 2–5 years of sales experience with a proven ability to follow up and close customers.

· Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and relationship\-building skills.

· Comfortable with both phone\-based and face\-to\-face selling.

· Comfortable working in a target\-driven environment.

· Willingness to travel locally for client meetings and site visits.

· Good working knowledge of English and local communication languages.

· Interior design \| Glass / architectural glass \| Building materials \| Premium home improvement

· Modular kitchens / wardrobes \| Bathroom solutions \| Architecture / design products

**Ownership –** You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do.

**Hunger –** You want to build a career in sales and grow quickly.

**Resourcefulness –** You can figure things out even when processes are still being built.

**Customer focus –** You understand that closing a sale is only part of building a great business.

**Execution –** You follow through and don't let leads or commitments fall through the cracks.

**Learning mindset –** You are willing to learn the product, market and business quickly.

**High\-growth startup –** Join at an early and exciting stage of growth.

**Real ownership –** Build rather than simply execute a predefined job.

**Career growth –** Strong performers can take on larger accounts, territories, team responsibilities and leadership roles.

Job Title: B2B Sales Executive – Textile Sampling \& Swatch Cards

Department: Sales \& Business Development

Location: Manufacturing Unit \- Anekal, Bangalore

Shakuntala Sampling is looking for a proactive, client\-facing B2B Sales Executive to drive new business acquisition across textile manufacturers, fabric wholesalers, furnishing/curtain brands, garment export houses, and buying agencies.

In this role, you will identify high\-potential B2B accounts, conduct in\-person meetings with company decision\-makers (Marketing Heads, Owners, Merchandising Chiefs), present our sample book/hanger manufacturing capabilities, gather precise technical specifications, and coordinate seamless project onboarding.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Lead Generation \& Field Business Development

Prospect, map, and visit potential B2B clients across local textile markets, industrial parks, and trading hubs.

Target key decision\-makers across fabric weaving/knitting mills, home furnishing brands, upholstery distributors, and garment exporters.

Conduct 3 to 5 physical client meetings daily with physical demo kits to present sample book formats, waterfall hangers, and shade card designs.

Represent the company at regional textile trade fairs, exhibitions, and industry association meets.

2\. Client Briefing \& Technical Requirement Gathering

Collect comprehensive order specifications using the standard Client Brief Sheet (CBS):

Fabric types, GSM, stretch, and backing requirements.

Book dimensions, Kappa/MDF board thickness, and cover material (printed paper or buckram).

Swatch arrangement (step waterfall, sandwich card, hanging swatch, or book format).

Hardware accessories (eyelet buttons, side corners, binding rivets).

Calculate required fabric yardage and guide clients on the exact meterage needed for their production run.

3\. Coordination with Merchandising \& Design

Hand over complete technical briefs and client fabric samples to the Design and Merchandising teams for layout proofing and cost estimation.

Deliver quotes, negotiate pricing within approved margin thresholds, and secure client sign\-off on dummy/prototype samples.

Follow up on client purchase orders (POs) and advance payment collections.

4\. Fabric Intake Logistics \& Account Servicing

Coordinate the timely collection and delivery of bulk client fabric rolls to our factory.

Maintain regular communication with clients regarding production progress, dispatch dates, and delivery tracking.

Manage post\-delivery feedback and systematically track client collection launch calendars for seasonal re\-orders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

New Account Acquisition: 4–8 new active B2B clients onboarded per month.

Monthly Revenue Target: Consistent achievement of monthly book volume targets (contributing toward plant capacity).

Client Brief Accuracy: ≥95% error\-free brief handovers to Merchandising (zero order rework caused by missing sales specs).

Client Retention \& Repeat Rate: ≥70% repeat order capture across quarterly/seasonal collection cycles.

Daily Field Activity: Minimum 15–20 completed physical meetings/pitches logged per week.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

Experience: 1 to 3 years of successful B2B sales experience in:

Textile/fabric manufacturing, wholesale, or textile accessories, OR

Commercial printing, rigid box/packaging conversion, or sample book manufacturing.

Industry Knowledge: Basic familiarity with fabric types (woven, knits, jacquards, velvets, sheers) and paper/board packaging terminology.

Communication \& Negotiation: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi is a strong plus based on territory).

Mobility: Must possess a two\-wheeler/vehicle with a valid driving license for daily client visits.

Tools: Basic proficiency in MS Excel, WhatsApp Business, and standard CRM/mobile reporting tools.

**Summary**
-----------


As an Advisor Contracts at Gainwell, you will serve as an individual contributor responsible for leading the development, negotiation, interpretation and administration of complex contracts and associated governance across the enterprise. This role partners closely with legal, procurement, HR, and business stakeholders to manage contractual risk, ensure regulatory compliance, and drive standardized contract practices that support organizational and client objectives.


We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Advisor Contracts to support a U.S.\-based healthcare technology and services organization focused on contracts with vendors, state and local governments as well as commercial entities. This role will be responsible for independently managing complex commercial, healthcare, technology, vendor, and government\-related contracts throughout the contracting lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will possess exceptional English communication skills, strong contract interpretation and negotiation experience, sound business judgment, and the ability to operate independently while partnering closely with U.S.\-based legal, sales, procurement, delivery, and executive teams.


**Your role in our mission**
----------------------------


When joining Gainwell, you will:


* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a wide variety of agreements, including:


* Master Services Agreements (MSAs)
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Amendments and Change Orders
* Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
* Teaming Agreements
* Software, SaaS, and technology agreements
* Vendor and subcontractor agreements
* State, local and commercial healthcare\-related services agreements
* Lead contract negotiations with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and business partners.


* Analyze contractual risks and develop practical risk\-mitigation strategies.


* Interpret contract provisions and provide clear guidance to internal legal, contracts and business stakeholders regarding rights, obligations, and compliance requirements.


* Provide advice to and collaborate with U.S.\-based contract managers, attorneys and business leaders to resolve legal, commercial, operational, and compliance issues.


* Support proposal, bid, and procurement activities, including leading contract reviews associated with RFPs and government healthcare opportunities.


* Manage contracts for compliance with corporate policies, applicable laws, healthcare regulations, privacy requirements, and contracting standards.


* Maintain accurate contract records and manage contracts through contract lifecycle management systems.


* Track key contractual obligations, deliverables, renewals, notices, and expiration dates.


* Provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on contract processes and risk management.


* Build strong working relationships with internal and external business partners and serve as a trusted advisor to the business.


**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree (e.g., JD or MBA) preferred


* 15\-18 years of experience in contracts management, legal operations, or related fields


* Strong knowledge of US contract law, regulatory compliance, and risk management principles


* Proven ability to independently assess, review, negotiate and manage complex agreements and influence senior stakeholders


* Demonstrated ability to identify, interpret, summarize contractual terms and explain legal and business implications to non\-legal stakeholders.


* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, organization, decision\-marking and stakeholder management skills


* Demonstrated experience analyzing and summarizing complex contracts with minimal supervision.


* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with U.S.\-based executives and legal professionals.


* Experience managing multiple priorities and meeting demanding deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.


* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision while exercising sound judgment.


* Mastery of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and contract lifecycle management tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Years of experience supporting U.S. healthcare, healthcare technology, managed care, health plan, or Medicaid\-related contracts.


* Strong familiarity with healthcare privacy, data security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.


* Demonstrated experience supporting U.S. state government contracts, healthcare procurements, or large\-scale outsourcing agreements.


* Experience working within a multinational or global organization supporting U.S.\-based operations.


**Competencies**


* Proven contract drafting, review and negotiation capabilities


* Independent contract interpretation and issue spotting


* Executive\-level communication skills


* Business acumen and commercial judgment


* Risk assessment and mitigation


* Significant attention to detail


* Customer\-focused mindset


* Ability to influence without direct authority


* Self\-starter with strong ownership mentality


**What you should expect in this role**
---------------------------------------


* Remote, hybrid, or onsite work depending on business needs


* High level of ownership for contract strategy, compliance, and enterprise risk management


* Collaboration with legal, procurement, HR, and business leaders


* Opportunity to influence enterprise contract governance, compliance frameworks, and operational efficiency

You will not just manage tickets; you will own the end\-to\-end resolution ecosystem, drive frontline CS team performance, and build bulletproof processes to minimize post\-purchase friction. You will sit at the intersection of Customer Success, Logistics, Sales, and Procurement—ensuring every high\-stakes escalation is resolved with speed, authority, and accountability.

What You’ll Own:

**Escalation Command \& Resolution: Directly drive high\-risk, high\-value customer escalations, logistics delays, and material disputes to resolution. Serve as the final point of escalation before executive leadership.**

Team Leadership \& Performance: Lead, mentor, and monitor daily metrics for Customer Success Associates. Drive team SLAs across ticket resolution times, response quality, and customer retention metrics.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination: Work hand\-in\-hand with Logistics, Procurement, and Sales leads to eliminate systemic fulfillment bottlenecks and streamline refund/cancellation/exchange workflows.**

Process \& SOP Optimization: Continuously audit CS processes, escalation logs, and root\-cause data to build preventative SOPs and prevent repeat delivery failures.

**Strategic Reporting: Track daily/weekly escalation metrics, report retention insights directly to management, and turn customer feedback into actionable operational improvements.**

Leadership \& Escalation Handling: Proven track record of managing high\-pressure customer escalations and leading frontline support/CS teams.

**Language Proficiency: Fluent in English \& Kannada/Hindi/Telugu (Mandatory).**

Analytical \& Process\-Driven: Highly structured with expertise in tracking escalation metrics, managing CRMs, and driving data\-backed decisions in Google Sheets/Excel.

**Bias for Action: Unwavering ownership mindset—takes personal accountability for team outputs and root\-cause resolution.**
