 This individual contributes to the success of PepsiCo by supporting field sales and customers in collecting and submitting for processing multiple customer activation documents, including credit applications, resale certificates, W9 forms and contracts / beverage agreements. Additionally, this role is responsible to accurately attach customers to price groups, key accounts and ensure changes to sales methods and deliver days are processed as requested by sales. This role plays a large part in communication with other partner functions (MBS CIA, MBS DEA, Finance, Equipment and Resolution FSCs, pricing, AR, etc.) to resolve customer activation and maintenance issues as needed.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage SPA Box and provide 48hr SLA response to all requests, determining next steps and looping in partner functions as needed
* Partner with siloed functions to complete customer maintenance as requested by field, including but not limited to: Name, contact \& address updates, route maintenance, delivery frequency \& day changes, call day changes, route changes, sales method updates, location changes
* Collect and submit resale certificates (both for new customers and as maintenance on existing customers); ensure resale is accurately and timely updated by MBS CIA team
* Work with partner teams to complete inactivation, change of ownership processes
* Complete requests to Add POs
* Ensure customers are on correct payment method (charge, check, e\-check, PAD, etc.) by ensuring forms are complete, accurate and submitted timely via the correct process – both for newly set up customers as well as maintenance on existing customers
* Collect needed information for vendor packets / customer packets / Certificate or Memorandum of Insurance (COI / MOI) requests
* Complete updates to customers wiring for national Flag, Business Segments and Key Accounts, price groups as requested / needed
* Collect supplier W9s, review for completeness, and submit for supplier numbers (customers, sponsorship \& true suppliers all fall under this purview)
* Complete mass COF creations or change of ownerships as requested and aligned upon by FSC Sups / Sales leaders
* (West Division Only) Complete support for fairs
* Provide timely updates back to sales on all requests, whether completed or further information needed


**Qualifications**
* 5\-6\.5 years of experience as mid\-level analytics professional with experience, preferably in a leading consumer goods company
* Bachelors in finance or economics
* Strong knowledge of MS Office programs specifically Excel
* Have 1\+ years’ experience using SAP \& Oracle platforms
* Propensity to learn PepsiCo software systems
* Highly organized and responsive, with ability to work to SLAs and tight deadlines
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; proactively communicates using appropriate methods for situation and audience in clear, concise and professional manner
* Ability to provide superior customer service
* Language Skills – Fluent English
* Be flexible, organized and able to handle competing priorities
* Organization effectiveness
* Comfortability with asking questions / requesting additional information in order to ensure initial data is correct
* Ability to influence cross functional teams to achieve desired outcomes

title: Business Development Executive – Inside Sales (Digital Marketing Agency)
description:
Job title Business Development Executive – Inside Sales (Digital Marketing Agency)

Company RevSoc Digital LLP

Location Madhapur, Hyderabad (on\-site)

Experience 1–3 years

Employment type Full\-time

Reports to Founder \& CEO

This role exists to book first appointments: qualify every prospect and bring as many of them as possible to a confirmed first meeting with our leadership team.

About RevSoc

RevSoc Digital is a well\-known performance marketing agency in Hyderabad. We work with established brands across real estate, healthcare, education, B2B, e\-commerce, travel and manufacturing.

We are a Google Partner, rated 4\.7 on Google and 5\.0 on Clutch. Our work is measured by one thing: whether the marketing drives sales. Our services span Meta and Google Ads, programmatic (DV360\), SEO, social media and creative production.

Role Objective

Your single objective is to qualify prospects and bring them to the booking level, which means a confirmed first appointment with our leadership team. Success in this role is measured by how many qualified first meetings you book and how many of them actually happen.

You will not pitch pricing, write proposals or close deals. You will find the right businesses, start the conversation, confirm they are a real fit and get them into the first meeting. You are the start of our sales engine, and the size of our pipeline depends on you.

A prospect counts as qualified when you have confirmed:

* Need: they want to grow leads, sales or brand visibility through digital marketing
* Decision\-maker: you are speaking with the founder, owner, CMO or marketing head, or they will attend the meeting
* Budget readiness: they are open to investing in a professional agency retainer
* Timeline: they are looking to start or switch agencies in the near term
* Commitment: they have accepted a specific date and time for the first meeting

Key Responsibilities

* Prospect research: Build targeted lists of growth\-stage businesses in our focus verticals, such as real estate developers, hospitals and clinics, schools, D2C brands and B2B firms. Identify the decision\-makers at each one.
* Multi\-channel outreach: Run structured daily outreach through cold calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and email sequences to start conversations with founders and marketing heads.
* Qualification: Assess every prospect on need, authority, budget readiness and timeline before booking. Book only meetings that are worth the leadership team's time.
* Appointment booking: Convert qualified conversations into confirmed first meetings, with calendar invites, reminders and confirmation on the day to maximise show\-ups.
* Objection handling: Handle early objections such as "we already have an agency", "send me details", "we tried ads and it didn't work" or "call me later", and turn them into meetings.
* Follow\-up discipline: Nurture prospects who are interested but not ready, and re\-engage old enquiries, past proposals, dormant leads and no\-shows.
* Inbound lead handling: Respond quickly to inbound enquiries from our website, ads and referrals, then qualify and book them.
* Meeting handover: Brief the leadership team before every meeting on who the prospect is, their business, current marketing setup, pain points and what was discussed.
* CRM ownership: Log every call, message, status and next step in the CRM the same day, and keep the pipeline clean and accurate.
* Reporting and improvement: Share weekly numbers on activity, connect rates, meetings booked and show\-up rates. Test and suggest better scripts, channels and target segments.

Outreach Channels and Tools

You must have hands\-on, working clarity on every channel below. You should know how each one works, when to use it and how to combine them into one outreach sequence.

Channel / Tool What you should be able to do

Cold calling Reach decision\-makers, get past gatekeepers, open with a clear hook and close for the meeting on the call

WhatsApp Business Send professional first\-touch and follow\-up messages, share case studies, confirm and remind meetings

LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator Build lead lists with filters, send connection requests and InMails, engage with prospects' content and move chats to calls

Cold email Write short personalised emails, run multi\-step sequences, track opens and replies, and follow up on time

Zoho CRM (or HubSpot / similar) Manage leads, deals, tasks and follow\-ups, log every activity and pull pipeline reports

Prospecting and data tools Use tools such as Apollo, Lusha, Google Maps and company websites to find and verify contact details

Calendar and meeting tools Schedule meetings on Google Calendar, Google Meet or Zoom, and send invites and reminders

Multi\-touch sequencing Combine calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and email into a structured sequence across 2–3 weeks per prospect

How Success Is Measured

* Primary metric: number of qualified first appointments booked and attended each month
* Show\-up rate of booked meetings
* Share of your meetings that move to a proposal stage
* Daily outreach activity across calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and email
* CRM accuracy and timely follow\-ups

What We Are Looking For

Must have

* 1–3 years of experience in inside sales, pre\-sales, lead generation, appointment setting or business development
* Proven record of booking meetings with business owners or senior decision\-makers
* Hands\-on working knowledge of cold calling, WhatsApp Business, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, cold email and a CRM such as Zoho
* Confident, clear and persuasive spoken and written English
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls and hearing "no" without losing momentum
* Organised and disciplined with daily targets, follow\-ups and CRM updates

Good to have

* Experience in a digital marketing agency, SaaS or B2B services company
* Basic understanding of digital marketing: Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, leads, ROAS and cost per lead
* Fluency in Telugu and/or Hindi
* Experience selling to real estate, healthcare or education businesses
* Familiarity with tools such as Apollo, Lusha or email sequencing platforms

Why Join RevSoc

* Work directly with the founder and see how agency deals are won from the first call to signing
* Learn performance marketing from a team that runs campaigns for well\-known brands every day
* Clear growth path to a Senior Business Development or Sales Lead role
* Training in consultative selling, outreach strategy and digital marketing

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Job Description  

Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI\-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore


We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.


We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.


Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM \+ AI conversation \- shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.

  

**What this role is**


* You will lead India Presales and a team of \~10\-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid\-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.  
* 

**What work looks like**


* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.

* Be a CXO\-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.

* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.

* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10\-15\-member organization; build capability and future leaders.

* Create a winning market motion. Define solution\-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.

* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.

* Build AI\-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI\-native.

* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time

**Role expectations**


* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.

* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.

* Raise the talent bar. Build a high\-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.

* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.

* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.

**What we’re looking for**


* 12–15\+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.


* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross\-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.


**Why this role is different**


You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.

  

**About Darwinbox:**


Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.


Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Relationship Manager – Mutual Fund, Fixed Income & Wealth Solutions
description:
Location: Mumbai
 



 Job Type: Full\-Time / Remote
 



 Experience Level: 3–7 Years (BFSI, Wealth Management, Asset Management, or Mutual Fund Distribution)
 



 Comp Package: Competitive Base Salary \+ High\-Incentive Success Fee / Commission Structure
 



 \-\-\-
 



 About the Role
 



  





 Are you an experienced Mutual Fund Relationship Manager or Wealth Executive looking to transition into the high\-yield \*\*Fixed Income and Debt Capital Markets\*\* space?
 



  





 We are expanding our capital\-raising network and looking for a dynamic, self\-driven \*\*Relationship Manager\*\* to drive our \*\*Non\-Convertible Debenture (NCD) and Fixed Income issuances\*\*. In this role, you will leverage your client management skills and financial acumen to onboard small High\-Net\-Worth Individuals (sHNIs), affluent retail investors, seeking attractive, asset\-backed fixed yield returns.
 



  





 If you know how to build trust, explain fixed\-income structures, and close, this role offers uncapped earning potential!
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* \*\*Drive Capital Onboarding:\*\* Pitch and onboard investors for fixed income instruments, primary NCD issuances, and corporate debt opportunities.
 



 \* \*\*Network \& Relationship Management:\*\* Tap into warm networks, small\-HNI circles, business owners, and affluent retail clients looking for yield options higher than traditional fixed deposits.
 



 \* \*\*End\-to\-End Client Servicing:\*\* Educate clients on credit risk, coupon payouts, security structures, and redemption terms using institutional Information Memorandums (IMs) and term sheets.
 



 \* \*\*Pipeline Generation:\*\* Conduct 1\-on\-1 meetings, client briefings, and cross\-referrals through local Chartered Accountants (CAs), tax consultants, and financial planner networks.
 



 \* \*\*Compliance \& Documentation:\*\* Coordinate with our operations team to complete investor KYC, execution of subscription agreements, and bank escrow transfers smoothly.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



  





 \* \*\*Experience:\*\* 3 to 7 years as an RM in Mutual Fund AMCs, Broking Houses, Wealth Desks, or Independent Financial Advisor (IFA) networks.
 



 \* \*\*Track Record:\*\* Proven history of managing client portfolios and raising capital in the \*\*₹2 Lakhs – ₹10 Lakhs ticket range\*\*.
 



 \* \*\*Product Knowledge:\*\* Solid understanding of fixed income products, debt mutual funds, bond yields, NCDs, and fixed deposit alternatives.
 



 \* \*\*Communication:\*\* Exceptional verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills to build trust with affluent individual investors.
 



 \* \*\*Proactive Pitcher:\*\* Highly self\-motivated individual who can generate leads, handle client objections, and close deals independently.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 Why Join Us?
 



  





 \* 💰 \*\*Uncapped Incentive Plan:\*\* Earn industry\-leading success payouts (percentage\-based commissions) on every ticket size closed, over and above your base salary.
 



 \* 📈 \*\*High\-Demand Product:\*\* Fixed Income / NCDs offer predictable, secure yields that are currently in high demand among sHNI investors.
 



 \* 👥 \*\*Leadership Support:\*\* Direct access to founders and senior management to assist you on high\-value closing calls.
 



 \* 🚀 \*\*Fast\-Track Career Growth:\*\* Opportunity to lead a dedicated private wealth/debt distribution team as the portfolio grows.

 In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting\-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.
   

  

 While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3\. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn’t a typical Sales role.
   

  

 You will work on initiatives that genuinely transform how finance works in India, a type of work few roles offer.
   

  

 Build and nurture relationships with VIP customers actively trading options on CoinDCX. Engage users through calls and personalised communications, sharing updates on new listings, product launches, market developments and trading features to drive engagement, retention and satisfaction.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive VIP Trader Engagement: Build and own relationships with high\-value Options Traders through personalised engagement, delivering timely updates on options products, listings and market opportunities.
* Drive Product Penetration: Identify trader needs and lead cross\-sell and adoption of relevant CoinDCX options and derivatives products.
* Own Trading Growth \& Retention: Monitor trading activity and volumes, design targeted interventions to reactivate traders and deliver sustained trading engagement.
* Deliver Market \& Product Insights: Build trader trust by sharing actionable insights on options strategies, volatility, market trends, margin and product developments.
* Drive Trader VoC: Own the feedback loop with active traders and collaborate with Product, Research and Operations to design and deliver a superior options trading experience.


**You’ll Excel in This Role If You**
* Think like a trader: Stay curious about markets, options, volatility and trading behaviour.
* Learn fast, execute faster: Absorb new concepts quickly and turn learning into action.
* Think analytically: Use data to identify patterns, opportunities and trader behaviour.
* Own the outcome: Take end\-to\-end ownership of tasks and follow through with minimal hand\-holding.
* Have a bias for action: Move quickly, experiment, and iterate based on results.
* Communicate with clarity: Present insights and ideas in a simple, structured and actionable way.
* Stay customer\-obsessed: Understand the needs of options traders and continuously look for ways to improve their experience.


**You’ll Know You’re Winning When**
* Improved user retention: Contributed to initiatives that improve retention and reactivation of active Options Traders.
* Increased trading volumes: Delivered measurable growth in options trading activity and user volumes within the assigned cohort.
* Improved trader engagement: Built and executed targeted initiatives to increase engagement among high\-value Options Traders.
* Delivered actionable insights: Generated data\-backed insights on trader behaviour, churn, and product adoption to support growth initiatives.


**Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You**
* Build from the ground up : Be part of the first major experiment focused on VIP Options as a product.
* Own \& lead : Get meaningful ownership to shape initiatives, experiment with new ideas and drive outcomes.
* High\-impact exposure : Work closely with Options Traders, Product, Research and business teams to understand and build for a fast\-evolving market.
* Make your mark : Your work can directly influence how VIP Team builds and scales its Options business.


**Hiring Process**
 Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities


**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Key Account Manager - Dispensing
description:

Read on to know more about what’s in store for you!
   

  

**Job Title:** 
**Regional Dispensing Channel Manager – L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty Division (Mumbai, India)**
 Hello, we’re L’Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**A Day in the Life** 
 Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty and the National Dispensing and Medical Visits Manager, you will be responsible for the following Key Deliverables:
   

  

* Channel Strategy \& Business Development:
* Analyze market opportunities, potential, and gaps within the dispensing channel across the South and West regions.
* Analyse prescription potential of targets and the competitive, medical and regulatory environment.
* Drive RCPA (Retail Chemist Prescription Audit) compliance and execution across key pharmacies in the region.
* Define targets, their coverage and visit frequency.
* Develop and execute strategic Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with key dispensing clinics to drive sell\-out and achieve regional sales targets.
* Devise action plans, budgets, giveaways (promotional items and samples) and validate medical visit tools, for each target, in conjunction with marketing / and staff in charge of medical communication.
* Portfolio Promotion \& Negotiation: Present and negotiate commercial agreements, product bundles, and promotional strategies.
* Pilot performance based on criteria of prescriptions/recommendations and sales and analyse Return On Investment (ROI).
* Key Opinion Leader (KOL) \& Commercial Account Management:
* Maintain strong personal connections and strategic relationships with top dermatologists and key dispensing stakeholders in the region.
* Build and nurture strong commercial relationships with key decision\-makers, dermatologists, and clinic administrators within dispensing accounts in his/her region.
* Lead regional derm activation, engagement, and Advocacy agendas.
* Team Support \& Performance Enablement:
* Support Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Medical Representative teams in executing dispensing strategies.
* Monitor and review MR team performance, field effectiveness, and target achievement within the dispensing channel.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
* Liaison closely with the Medical Training and Communication teams to ensure seamless execution of medical detailing tools and training modules.
* Collaborate with regional sales and marketing teams to ensure synergy between commercial targets and medical/dispensing initiatives.
* Guarantee the excellence and professionalization of medical detailing:
* Makes sure field team has required digital tools and competences to engage with HCPs through all relevant channels (digital and face\-to\-face).
* Implement and guarantee the use of monitoring tools of CRM/CLM platform activity.
* Ethical Standards:
* Ensure training and respect of both internal and external ethical standards regarding relations with health professionals.
* Market Intelligence:
* Monitor account performance, track key commercial metrics, and maintain sharp awareness of competitor activities within the dermatology space.


**We Are Looking For**
 To succeed in this role, you should possess the following attributes:
   

  

**Key Competencies**
* Strong understanding of the dermatological and dispensing retail ecosystem.
* Excellent relationship\-building and stakeholder management skills with top HCPs/Dermatologists.
* High commercial acumen with experience in sales, key account management, or medical detailing leadership. Strong negotiation and business planning skills with a proven track record of driving revenue growth in clinic/dispensing environments.
* Ability to coach, influence, and drive performance across cross\-functional field teams.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education: MBA, Bachelor’s degree, B. Pharma/Life sciences
* Work Experience: Minimum 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, dermocosmetic, or medical sales, with exposure to key account management or field team leadership.


**What’s In It For You**
* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference


**Who We Are**
 For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
   

  

 With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
   

  

 Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche\-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make\-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor \& Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
   

  

 L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
   

  

 In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
   

  

 L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. L’Oréal closely prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of the individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
**Sales Development Representative** 




 Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India \| Experience: Mid Level (3\-4 years)
 



**About the Company** 




 Bizpay is a growing FinTech and payments SaaS company helping businesses operate more effectively through technology\-led financial solutions. As an organisation of 11–50 people, the company offers an environment where individual ownership, commercial judgment, and direct contribution are highly visible. This role will work within a focused revenue team and contribute directly to market reach, qualified pipeline, and growth. The company values people who can take responsibility for outcomes, learn quickly, and communicate confidently with business decision\-makers. Because the team is growing, this opportunity suits someone who wants meaningful ownership rather than a narrowly defined activity\-based role. You will engage with businesses, understand their priorities, and create relevant conversations for the sales organisation. The role is based onsite in Navi Mumbai and offers the chance to build a strong foundation in B2B SaaS and FinTech sales while working closely with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
 



**About the Role** 




 Own the top of the B2B SaaS sales funnel through targeted prospecting, qualification, meeting scheduling, and structured follow\-up. You will use LinkedIn, outbound email, cold calling, and prospecting tools to reach CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and other senior leaders. Success is measured by qualified prospects progressing to scheduled demos, with demos delivered by Account Executives and supported by strong SDR preparation. You will qualify business needs, provide useful context to the Account Executive, ensure prospects attend scheduled meetings, and continue follow\-ups after the demo to support opportunity progression. The role requires disciplined CRM usage, confident communication, strong data quality, and ownership of the prospect journey from first contact through post\-demo follow\-up.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain targeted prospect lists across relevant B2B segments, using account research and defined ideal\-customer criteria to improve outreach relevance and create stronger sales coverage.
* Execute multi\-channel outbound campaigns through LinkedIn, personalised emails, and cold calls, owning response quality, qualification, meeting conversion, and contribution to qualified pipeline.
* Engage confidently with CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and senior management by connecting business challenges to relevant SaaS and payments solutions.
* Research accounts and identify accurate decision\-makers, extracting phone numbers and email addresses through approved prospecting and data\-enrichment tools to improve contactability.
* Qualify prospects against agreed business, urgency, authority, need, and fit criteria, then schedule qualified demos for Account Executives with complete and accurate meeting context.
* Prepare Account Executives for scheduled demos by documenting prospect needs, stakeholders, use cases, objections, and agreed next steps in the CRM.
* Manage meeting confirmations, reminders, rescheduling, attendance, and timely follow\-ups so qualified prospects progress reliably through the sales process.
* Follow up with prospects after Account Executive demos, capture feedback and next steps, maintain momentum, and support conversion of qualified meetings into active opportunities.



**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Proven B2B SaaS outbound prospecting experience, with the ability to create qualified pipeline through disciplined LinkedIn outreach, email sequences, cold calling, and account\-based research.
* Strong executive communication skills, including confidence speaking with CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and other senior decision\-makers in concise, commercially relevant conversations.
* Practical experience building prospect lists and using LinkedIn, CRM platforms, email tools, databases, and contact\-enrichment systems to identify and verify business contacts.
* Strong understanding of qualification, discovery, objection handling, meeting scheduling, demo preparation, attendance management, and post\-demo follow\-up within a sales development process.
* Clear written communication for personalised email messaging, LinkedIn outreach, call scripts, meeting confirmations, follow\-ups, and concise Account Executive handoffs.
* Analytical and process\-oriented approach to measuring outreach, qualification, scheduled demos, attendance, post\-demo engagement, data quality, and pipeline contribution.



**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling FinTech, payments, HR technology, payroll, finance, or adjacent B2B SaaS solutions to mid\-market or enterprise organisations.
* Familiarity with sales engagement, CRM, LinkedIn automation, email verification, lead enrichment, and intent\-data tools used responsibly within outbound prospecting workflows.
* Existing understanding of CFO, HR, finance, or people\-operations priorities, enabling more relevant qualification and follow\-up with functional and executive stakeholders.



**What You'll Bring** 



* Three to four years of hands\-on experience in B2B SaaS sales development, outbound business development, lead generation, or a closely related role with measurable qualified\-meeting and pipeline outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to source accounts, identify relevant contacts, build prospect lists, qualify business needs, and execute consistent outreach across LinkedIn, email, and phone channels.
* Confidence communicating with senior business leaders, especially CFOs and HR heads, while adapting messaging to their priorities and earning credible demo conversations for Account Executives.
* Ownership mindset, resilience, and operating discipline: you follow through before and after demos, maintain accurate CRM records, and improve conversion through response and meeting data.



**Why Join Us** 




 Bizpay offers the opportunity to take visible ownership of revenue creation inside a growing FinTech and payments SaaS business. Your work will be closely connected to commercial outcomes, giving you direct exposure to sales strategy, customer needs, and the systems that turn market interest into qualified demos and pipeline. This is a role for someone who wants to do more than execute scripts. You will shape target lists, test messaging, qualify business problems, schedule meetings for Account Executives, and maintain momentum after demos. You will use performance data to improve qualification, attendance, and conversion. The onsite setup in Navi Mumbai supports close collaboration with sales leadership and faster learning through real customer conversations. You will also build valuable experience across B2B SaaS, payments, finance, and HR\-related business problems. The company provides a setting where initiative is visible, high\-quality execution matters, and strong performers can grow with the business as its market reach expands.
 



**What We Offer** 



* A visible revenue ownership opportunity within a growing FinTech and payments SaaS company, with direct responsibility for qualified demos, pipeline contribution, and prospect progression.
* An onsite, collaborative working environment in Navi Mumbai where you can learn closely with Account Executives and sales leadership through real prospect conversations.
* Competitive compensation and the opportunity to build deeper expertise in B2B SaaS outbound sales, executive engagement, qualification, demo coordination, and structured follow\-up.

title: Associate Manager/Manager, Government Partnership and Expansion
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?**
 The quality of school education available to low\-income students across India is abysmal — it decides, before they've had a real shot, whether they'll ever attend college or build a career. iTeach Schools was born in 2015 to break that pattern and build a level playing field for every child.
   

  

 We run free, high\-impact schools and a college\-to\-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai, known for world\-class professional development, a results\-driven culture, and student\-centric school design. More at www.iTeachSchools.org.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 iTeach is at an inflection point. In 2025, we set out to more than double our reach — from 4,500 to 10,000\+ students — by opening 10\-12 new schools over the next 5 years. That's a decade of growth in half the time, powered by strong municipal demand, solid funding, and a deep talent pipeline.
   

  

 The Growth \& Expansion Manager will drive that growth end to end: representing iTeach with government at every level, building the strategy for where we go next, and carrying each new Municipal Corporation from first conversation to a signed partnership. This role owns the machinery that turns growth intent into schools on the ground.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
**A: Expansion — Strategy and Execution**
* Build and drive iTeach's 3\-year expansion strategy across Municipal Corporations in Maharashtra and beyond, translating our 2030 growth goals into a concrete roadmap.
* Own the full expansion pipeline end to end — proposal drafting, pitching, tender release and management, through to final work order award.
* Lead on\-ground landscape studies with our government partnerships associates to scope space, infrastructure, and educational gaps, and identify the best\-fit opportunities for iTeach.
* Design and implement strategies to secure government funding to support new and existing schools.


**B: Government Liaisoning and Compliance**
* Build and hold relationships with administrative and political decision\-makers across 8\-10 Municipal Corporations, championing iTeach's mission at every level of government.
* Manage the Government Relations Associates to keep all iTeach schools compliant with government regulations and law.
* Maintain iTeach's standing as the Municipal Corporations' most trusted non\-profit school operator.


**C: Team and Planning**
* Set the annual implementation plan for the expansion vertical, including budget requirements.
* Manage and coach the Government Relations Associates supporting expansion work in each Municipal Corporation.


**Qualifications And Competencies**
* 5\+ years in the social sector or public\-facing roles, with at least 2 years managing people, ideally with exposure to government relations or public policy.
* A track record of building relationships with senior stakeholders and moving decisions forward in bureaucratic, often slow\-moving environments.
* Comfort owning ambiguity — this is a build\-as\-you\-go role inside a fast\-growing organization.
* Strong communication, presentation, and influencing skills; equally sharp writing a tender response and pitching a Municipal Commissioner.
* Preferred Languages: Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking Marathi and English.


**Location**
* Based in Mumbai. Willing to travel across Greater Mumbai, Mumbai, Pune and other Municipal Corporations in Maharashtra and beyond — as our footprint grows.


**Compensation and Benefits:** 
 We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 9\.5 \- 11 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top\-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good negotiation and convincing skills.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.

* Smart and presentable
* Proactive and energetic
* Result\-oriented
* Strong in communication

* Good at candidate sourcing

 QWR Interactive Solutions designs and manufactures head\-worn computing devices. We have shipped over 50,000 devices across 17 countries and we are India's only domestic full\-stack XR manufacturer. We sell to global consumer electronics brands who need a manufacturing partner, and to defence, enterprise and education customers who need XR solutions.
 



 About the role
 



 We are looking for a business development executive with 1 to 3 years of experience in B2B sales, lead generation or inside sales, ideally in technology, electronics, hardware or enterprise solutions.
 



 This is the role that fills the top of our pipeline. You will find the accounts, open the conversations, qualify what is real, and hand over opportunities that are worth a senior person's time.

 Research and build target account lists across electronics, XR, AV, system integrators, education, government and enterprise segments.
 



 Identify decision makers and run first\-level outreach across email, LinkedIn and phone.
 



 Qualify early\-stage leads by understanding use case, requirement fit, budget, timeline and who actually decides.
 



 Maintain accurate records in the CRM, including outreach logs, account notes, next steps and pipeline stage.
 



 Prepare first\-cut proposals, pitch decks and use\-case collateral with support from the wider team.
 



 Coordinate demos, product samples and proof\-of\-concept discussions between the customer and our internal teams.
 



 Follow up consistently. Most B2B deals are lost to silence rather than to a competitor.
 



 Support the team at trade shows, exhibitions and customer visits.
 



 Feed market observations back in, including what buyers are asking for and where we keep losing.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing or a related field.
 



 1 to 3 years in business development, inside sales, lead generation or account support in a B2B context.
 



 Strong written and spoken English. A large part of this role is written outreach to senior people.
 



 Comfortable with cold outreach and with being ignored nine times out of ten without losing momentum.
 



 Working knowledge of a CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or equivalent prospecting tools, and spreadsheets.
 



 Enough technical curiosity to understand a hardware specification and explain it back to a customer in plain language.
 



 Organised and consistent. This role rewards follow\-through more than brilliance.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 Experience selling electronics, hardware, AV, IT products or enterprise technology.
 



 Exposure to ODM or OEM business models.
 



 Experience with government or institutional tenders.
 



 XR or AR familiarity.
 



 Why QWR
 



 Sell a product built in\-house, not resold. You can take a customer to the factory floor.
 



 Real category position. \#1 in India by units shipped, and expanding into defence and industrial markets.
 



 Direct line to decision makers. This is a small team where your pipeline is visible to leadership every week.
 



  





**Hiring Process** 




 CV screening, a call with the hiring manager, then a practical exercise on a real prospecting brief and a discussion of your approach. We share feedback within 48 hours of every stage.
 



 How to Apply
 



 Apply here on LinkedIn, or send your CV to hr@questionwhatsreal.com quoting the role title in the subject line. If you have built a pipeline from scratch before, tell us how.
 


* QWR Interactive Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All applications are considered on merit, without regard to gender, religion, caste, age, disability or background.

description:
**About the Company:** 




 KOEL Fluid Dynamics Business Unit (earlier known as La\-Gajjar Machineries Private Limited) , is a premier provider of water pumping solutions and now a 100% wholly owned subsidiary of Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited (KOEL). Founded in 1935 in Ahmedabad by the visionary Mr. Laljibhai J. Gajjar, the company has evolved into an international leader through its renowned brand, Varuna Pumps. Our commitment to technical innovation led to the introduction of India's first oil\-based submersible pumps in 1991, and we have since expanded our portfolio to include over 1,000 models of energy\-efficient submersible pumps and motors.
 



 Key highlights of our operations include:
 


* Engineering Heritage: Over 80 years of expertise with a state\-of\-the\-art 100,000 sqm infrastructure.
* Market Leadership: Leading provider of agricultural and domestic pump sets, with an extensive reach of over 1,500 dealers and 500 plus authorized service centres across India.
* Global Presence: A government\-recognized Star Rated Export House exporting to more than 50 countries.
* Quality Standards: ISO 9001:2008 accredited production facility with CE and ISI certified products.
* Following our complete acquisition by KOEL in 2022, we continue to leverage our combined strengths to provide new\-age engineering solutions and expand our footprint in the global electric pump market. Feel free to peruse our website www.kirloskaroilengines.com for more details about our organization.



**AGM Sales (Small Engines/Gensets) \-Pune**




**Job Summary**

 :
 




 The incumbent will be responsible for Small Engines and Gensets and will drive volume growth and revenue expansion across the low\-to\-medium power segment (typically engines, portable generators and light industrial equipment). This role balances strategic channel management with active field\-level execution to penetrate retail, agricultural, construction, and residential markets.
 



**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Channel Network Expansion \& Governance** 



* **Partner Recruitment:** 
 Identify, evaluate, and onboard high\-performing retail dealers, multi\-brand distributors, and sub\-dealers to eliminate white spaces in the assigned territory.
* **Dealer Performance Management:** 
 Design, implement, and track monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for channel partners.
* **Inventory \& Stock Liquidation:** 
 Monitor dealer stock levels to prevent over\-stocking or stock\-outs; implement liquidation strategies for slow\-moving models.
* **Dealer Governance:** 
 Conduct periodic audits of dealer facilities to ensure compliance with branding standards, credit terms, and service capabilities.
* **Relationship Programs:** 
 Launch dealer loyalty programs, annual meets, and incentive schemes to maximize mindshare over competitors.



**2\. Market Penetration \& Field Business Development** 



* **B2B Bulk Accounts:** 
 Pitch directly to regional institutional buyers, including construction contractors, event rental companies, telecom tower sub\-vendors, and agricultural cooperatives.
* **Localized Marketing (BTL):** 
 Conceptualize and execute Below\-the\-Line (BTL) marketing activities, including van activations, village roadshows, market\-yard demos, and trade expo participations.
* **Competitor Intelligence:** 
 Continuously map competitor pricing structures, dealer margins, credit terms, and product feature updates to adjust regional positioning.
* **Influencer Engagement:** 
 Build strong professional networks with local electrical technicians, mechanics, and small\-scale consultants who influence end\-user buying decisions.



**3\. Techno\-Commercial Operations \& Lifecycle Management** 



* **Technical Application Sizing:** 
 Guide clients and dealers through load calculations, advising on fuel choices (petrol, diesel, LPG, or CNG) and phase configurations (single vs. three\-phase).
* **Pricing \& Margin Management:** 
 Structure commercial quotes, manage localized discounting approvals, and maintain healthy gross margins within corporate boundaries
* **Tender \& Bid Operations:** 
 Source, track, and lead the technical and commercial submission process for local municipal, institutional, or government supply tenders.
* **Product Feedback Loop:** 
 Collect and relay field performance data, recurring product issues, and market demand for new features back to the R\&D and product manufacturing team



**4\. Supply Chain, Recovery \& After\-Sales Alignment** 



* **Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP):** 
 Provide accurate, data\-backed rolling sales forecasts to manufacturing and logistics teams to optimize supply chain timelines.
* **Credit Control \& Collections:** 
 Take absolute ownership of the accounts receivable ledger. Enforce strict credit limits and execute timely collections from dealers to minimize Day Sales Outstanding (DSO).
* **Service Ecosystem Support:** 
 Coordinate with the regional service team to ensure dealers maintain an adequate inventory of genuine spare parts and fast\-moving consumables.



**Required Qualifications and Experience:**




**Academic \& Professional Background** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. An MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or International Business from a recognized institution is highly preferred.
* **Experience:** 
**Up to 12 years of core field experience in channel\-driven B2B or B2C sales of industrial capital goods.**
* **Domain Expertise:** 
**A proven track record in selling small internal combustion engines, portable generator sets, agricultural pump sets etc.**



**Technical Competencies** 



* **Small Engine Engineering:** 
 Deep understanding of 2\-stroke and 4\-stroke internal combustion engines, fuel injection systems, digital controllers, AVRs (Automatic Voltage Regulators), and alternator windings.
* **Channel Distribution Math:** 
 Mastery over distributor ROI calculations, primary vs. secondary sales dynamics, pipeline management, and trade margin structures.
* **ERP \& CRM Literacy:** 
 Proficiency in managing sales pipelines via CRMs (like Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho) and handling transactions via ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle).



**Behavioral \& General Competencies** 



* **High Mobility:** 
 Willingness and physical stamina to travel extensively within the assigned territory (
 **up to 50–60% of the time** 
 ), often to rural or semi\-urban industrial belts.
* **Negotiation \& Hustle:** 
 Strong interpersonal, persuasion, and closing skills, with a natural ability to connect with grass\-roots dealers as well as corporate procurement heads.
* **Data\-Driven Mindset:** 
 Ability to analyze regional market metrics, demographic data, and sales trends to build actionable territory growth plans.



 Reporting Structure
 


* **Reports to:** 
 Business Head
* **Direct Reportees:** 
 Sales Team

title: Community Lead (Managed Office)
description:
**About Us**
 Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators \- GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026\). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 76 operational centres spanning 8\.2 million square feet (as of December 2025\).
   

  

 WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.
   

  

 For more information, please visit our website.
   

  

**About Job**
 As a Lead for our Managed Offices, you will own the end\-to\-end client, operational and commercial experience for a portfolio of Managed Office clients. You will lead seamless onboarding and operational handovers, strengthen client and member relationships, drive workplace experience and engagement, identify revenue opportunities, and ensure operational, financial and compliance standards are met.
   

  

 This role works closely with Sales, Projects, Operations, Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams, and provides leadership to the Community Manager / MO POD where applicable, ensuring consistent delivery and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
   

  

**Skills \& Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business administration, marketing, operations, or a related field.
* 5–8\+ years of experience in hospitality, co\-working, managed offices, workplace experience, operations, account management or customer\-facing roles; experience leading teams or portfolios is preferred.
* Strong client management, stakeholder management and commercial acumen.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional projects, operational escalations and complex client requirements.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, billing, budgeting, revenue generation and business performance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficient in digital tools for ticketing, reporting, dashboards, communication and business reviews.
* A proactive, accountable and collaborative leader who can balance customer experience, operational excellence, people leadership and business outcomes. A passion for workplace experience, community.


**Responsibilities**
* Onboarding \& Transition Leadership
* Own the Managed Office onboarding and transition experience from pre\-move\-in through operational handover.
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Sales, Projects and Operations to ensure a seamless client handover and readiness.
* Ensure 100% completion of the Building Opening Checklist within stipulated timelines.
* Coordinate with Operations and Client Solutions teams to identify, track and close post\-move\-in snags within agreed timelines, including closure of critical snags within 60 days.
* Use move\-in feedback and internal stakeholder feedback to improve onboarding and handover processes.
* Account Management \& Member Experience
* Own relationships with client SPOCs and key stakeholders, acting as the escalation point for Managed Office accounts.
* Drive exceptional day\-to\-day workplace experience while balancing member experience and facilities management.
* Plan and execute quarterly engagement activities for all Managed Office clients and measure outcomes through client/member feedback.
* Drive an average MO NPS of 75 or above across the portfolio.
* Conduct quarterly community and operations audits for Managed Offices and PCI, maintaining a minimum compliance score of 90%.
* Proactively identify service gaps, trends and opportunities to improve client satisfaction and retention.
* Operations, Compliance \& Service Delivery
* Ensure spaces remain operationally ready, well maintained and aligned to WeWork standards through structured reviews and audits.
* Own operational dashboards, ticketing, issue resolution, walkthroughs, audits and service reviews for the portfolio.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation mechanisms across Community, Operations, Projects, Finance and other internal teams.
* Ensure timely closure and communication of operational issues and client commitments.
* Drive standardisation and continuous improvement of operating processes, ROEs and SOPs.
* Revenue \& Commercial Management
* Own upsell and additional revenue opportunities across events, F\&B, community support, technology, parking, customisation and other services.
* Ensure Workplace Experience services are positioned and pitched to all relevant clients.
* Partner with Sales and internal teams to convert client needs intovalue\-added solutions and commercial opportunities.
* Own billing, P\&L and topline audit management for the Managed Office portfolio, including invoice review, budget finalisation and post\-sales P\&L management.
* Work in tandem with the BOB owner from the MO/GCC teams to ensure financial accuracy, visibility and performance.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead, coach and develop the MO Community / CM POD, including hiring, role design, performance management and growth planning for client\-billed headcount.
* Drive team engagement and wellbeing, with a focus on building a high\-performing and collaborative culture.
* Own team learning and development through LMS completion, endorsements, training and a quarterly L\&D calendar.
* Conduct quarterly IDP progress checks and reporting for the team.
* Build capability within the team to independently manage client relationships, workplace experience, events and operational delivery.
* Innovation, Workplace Experience \& Strategic Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement through ROE/SOP 2\.0 and other process innovation initiatives.
* Create and develop an Event Management capability/wing to enable the team to drive events independently.
* Explore CXO/networking opportunities that strengthen client relationships and workplace experience.
* Develop PR\-as\-a\-service opportunities, including media time, interviews and podcasts, where relevant to clients and the business.
* Use client and operational insights to identify scalable solutions that improve experience and contribute to the bottom line.
* Communication, Reporting \& Stakeholder Management
* Provide structured portfolio updates covering client experience, operations, revenue, P\&L, risks, compliance and key actions.
* Maintain strong communication across Sales, Projects, Operations,
* Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams.
* Present business reviews and insights to senior stakeholders and clients as required.
* Ensure timely escalation of risks, service issues and commercial opportunities.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.
   

  

 Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

 ***brand worlds***
 through content strategy, design, production and distribution. We work closely with brands to create a clear, consistent and meaningful presence across social media platforms, e\-commerce marketplaces and physical brand experiences.
 



  






 ABOUT THE ROLE
 




 We are looking for a Business Development Executive who can
 **grow** 
 Samaa Vision through two equally important paths: identifying promising brands that could benefit from our work, and uncovering valuable opportunities.
 



  





 The role involves building relationships with partner agencies, creative professionals, industry collaborators, communities and other potential sources of business.
 **You should be curious** 
 enough to discover opportunities that may not be immediately visible and commercially aware enough to recognise which ones are worth pursuing.
 



  





 This is not simply a high\-volume outreach role. It requires strong research, good brand judgement, relationship\-building skills and the
 **ability to connect the right people, brands and opportunities.** 
 You will initiate conversations,
 **nurture relationships** 
 , follow up consistently and work closely with the Founder throughout the business\-development and client\-acquisition process.
 



  






 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



1. Research and identify brands that could benefit from Samaa Vision’s services.
2. Study prospective brands, their positioning, content, digital presence and
 **growth potential.**
3. Build and maintain a relevant pipeline of prospective clients.
4. Reach out to brands through email, LinkedIn, calls and other appropriate channels.
5. Write personalised outreach messages based on each brand’s requirements and potential.
6. Follow up professionally and consistently when prospective clients do not respond immediately.

 **alignment** 
 with Samaa Vision.

9. Identify opportunities through referrals, partnerships, collaborations, and industry events.

11. Track outreach activity, responses, meetings and conversions.
12. **Contribute ideas** 
 for improving the company’s business\-development and client\-acquisition processes.



  






 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



1. Approximately 1–2 years of relevant experience in business development, lead generation, sales or client acquisition.
2. Strong research and lead\-generation skills.
3. Clear written and verbal communication.
4. A good understanding of brands, content and digital presence.
5. The ability to recognise a brand’s potential and identify where it may require support.
6. **Good judgement, attention to detail and a strong sense of taste.**
7. Confidence in initiating conversations with prospective clients.
8. Patience and persistence when following up with leads.

10. Strong organisation and data analysis skills.
11. Working knowledge of Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

 WORK DETAILS

 Full\-time

 On\-site

 Goregaon East, Mumbai
 



**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Friday
 



**Working Hours:** 
 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

 Saturday and Sunday
 



  






 SALARY
 




 ₹27,000–₹33,000 gross per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
 



  





 This is a fixed\-salary position with no commission or incentive component.
 



  





 The selected candidate will undergo a three\-month probation period. A written performance review will be conducted at the end of probation before confirmation of permanent employment.

4. The final candidate will receive a formal employment offer.



  





**Apply here:**

 Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. Information submitted during the application process will be used solely for recruitment and candidate evaluation.
 



  





 Thank you!

The Proposal Content Designer plays a critical role in supporting the Commercial Sales Division by shaping and telling the story behind our most important pursuits. Engaging early alongside Proposal Managers, sales stakeholders, and peer content roles, this position helps develop the narrative through\-line and win themes, then owns the visual translation of that story — designing executive summaries, pitch decks, orals materials, infographics, and leave\-behinds that make complex solutions, ROI, and Data Axle differentiators immediately clear to client audiences. Depending on the pursuit, this role may shape the story largely independently or as one contributor on a collaborative pursuit team. * Build and maintain a reusable library of templates, layouts, graphics, and design components; establish design standards and a simple intake process so routine responses do not start from zero.

title: Executive – Accounts (Reconciliation Specialist)
description:
**Job Summary:** 

The Accounts Receivable \& Payable Executive will be primarily responsible for managing customer billing, collections, and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate and timely recording of receivables. The role involves close coordination with internal departments, customers, and vendors to maintain smooth cash flow operations. While the position covers both receivables and payables, the primary focus will be on Accounts Receivable and Reconciliation.

Job Role and responsibilities:

Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Accounts Receivable (Primary Focus)

* Generate and process customer invoices in line with agreed billing schedules and terms.
* Monitor and manage customer accounts to ensure timely collection of payments.
* Perform regular customer account reconciliations to resolve discrepancies between company and client ledgers.
* Track outstanding balances, identify overdue accounts, and follow up proactively with clients for payment status.
* Record receipts accurately in ERP/Accounting systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Tally, or NetSuite). **Work closely with the Sales, Operations, and Credit Control teams to resolve billing disputes or unallocated payments.**
* Prepare and maintain the Accounts Receivable aging report and present periodic collection summaries.
* Support month\-end and year\-end closing processes by ensuring all receivable transactions are updated and reconciled. Reconciliation (Core Function)
* Perform bank reconciliations, customer ledger reconciliations, and inter\-company reconciliations on a regular basis.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies in AR/AP accounts promptly.
* Ensure all entries are properly supported with documentation and comply with accounting standards.
* Maintain a clean and accurate reconciliation tracker for audit and reporting purposes. **Assist in process improvement initiatives for automation and efficiency in reconciliation activities. Accounts Payable (Secondary Focus)**
* Process vendor invoices and ensure accurate recording in the accounting system. **Perform vendor reconciliations and resolve mismatches or pending balances.**  Coordinate with procurement and operations for timely invoice approvals and payment processing. **Support payment runs and ensure compliance with company policies and timelines.**
* **Skills \& Qualifications : Bachelor’s degree in Commerce / Finance / Accounting.**

2–4 years of experience in Accounts Receivable / Reconciliation roles.

**Exposure to both AR \& AP cycles, with emphasis on reconciliation and collection management** 

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and reconciliation processes. **Hands\-on experience with ERP/accounting software (SAP, Oracle, Tally, or similar).** 

Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail. **Good communication and stakeholder management skills.**

Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

title: Business Development
description:
About Nitai Technologies

Nitai Technologies OPC Pvt Ltd is a web and technology solutions company specializing in **website development, mobile app development, e\-commerce solutions, software development, and digital marketing**.

We are looking for an energetic and target\-oriented **Business Executive** to join our sales and business development team.

Key Responsibilities

* Make **cold calls** to prospective customers and businesses.
* Handle and follow up with leads received through **IndiaMART, Meta Ads, website enquiries, WhatsApp, and other sources**.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable website, software, app, and digital marketing solutions.
* Schedule and conduct **product/service demos** for potential clients.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with leads through **phone calls, WhatsApp, and email**.
* Convert qualified leads into customers and achieve monthly sales targets.
* Generate **new leads** through calling, online research, networking, referrals, and other business development activities.
* Maintain and update lead information and follow\-up status in the company's CRM/lead management system.
* Prepare quotations and coordinate with the technical team wherever required.
* Build and maintain good relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Track sales opportunities from initial enquiry to closure.
* Stay updated about the company's services and understand basic technical concepts to explain them effectively to customers.

Key Skills Required

* Good **communication and convincing skills**.
* Comfortable with **cold calling and sales conversations**.
* Good follow\-up and lead\-management skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and explain solutions clearly.
* Basic knowledge of **websites, mobile apps, software, e\-commerce, or digital marketing** will be an advantage.
* Comfortable using **WhatsApp, email, Google Sheets/CRM, IndiaMART, and Meta lead platforms**.
* Ability to work with monthly sales and lead\-conversion targets.
* Self\-motivated, energetic, and willing to take initiative.
* Good Hindi and English communication skills.

Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate should be:

* Confident while speaking with new customers.
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls.
* Persistent with follow\-ups.
* Target\-oriented and focused on conversions.
* Able to generate business independently rather than relying only on incoming leads.
* Interested in technology and digital services.

Key Performance Areas

Performance will primarily be measured on:

* Number of calls and customer interactions
* Lead follow\-ups
* Demo conversions

About the Role

IDEASHACKS is looking for a **sales\-focused, target\-driven Business Development Executive** to grow our Pan\-India Virtual Office business.

Your primary job is to **sell Virtual Office services to businesses across India and acquire coworking spaces that can become our Virtual Office partners.**

You will be responsible for making calls, following up with leads, closing sales, onboarding partners and maintaining accurate records.

**This is a sales job.**

It is **not** an MIS, Power BI, data analytics, reporting or back\-office operations job.

We need someone who is comfortable with **targets, variable income, rejection, repeated follow\-ups and asking customers to make a purchase.**

What You Will Do1\. Sell Virtual Office Services

* Call leads generated through our marketing and sales channels.
* Understand what the customer needs, such as GST registration, business registration or a business address.
* Explain our Virtual Office plans, pricing and process.
* Follow up with prospects through calls, WhatsApp and email.
* Handle objections and negotiate within approved pricing.
* Convert interested prospects into paying customers.
* Maintain your sales pipeline and work towards monthly targets.
* Follow up until the lead is converted, lost or clearly closed.

**Your responsibility is not just to talk to leads. Your responsibility is to convert them into revenue.**

2\. Acquire Virtual Office Partners Across India

We are building a Pan\-India network of coworking spaces and service providers.

You will:

* Find coworking spaces in different Indian cities.
* Call owners and operators to discuss Virtual Office collaborations.
* Explain our partnership model and commercial terms.
* Negotiate and onboard suitable partners.
* Coordinate agreements, documentation and activation.
* Maintain a database of prospective and active partners.
* Follow up until the partner is fully onboarded and ready to serve customers.

You will be expected to **actively build the partner network, not wait for partners to approach us.**

3\. Manage Every Lead Properly

You must maintain accurate records of every lead you handle.

For each lead, you should know:

* What the customer needs.
* Whether the customer is qualified.
* What was discussed.
* What the next action is.
* When you need to follow up.
* Whether the lead converted, is still active or is lost.

You will use our **CRM/Excel trackers** to maintain this information.

**No lead should be forgotten because you failed to update the tracker or follow up.**

4\. Coordinate Customer Onboarding

After closing a sale:

* Coordinate KYC and required documents.
* Coordinate agreements and e\-stamps.
* Coordinate with the relevant coworking partner.
* Ensure the customer receives the promised Virtual Office service.
* Track the case until delivery and activation.
* Follow up with internal teams and partners if anything is delayed.

You are responsible for ensuring that your **closed sales move towards successful delivery.**

5\. Renewals and Existing Customers

* Contact customers before their Virtual Office expires.
* Explain renewal terms.
* Follow up on renewal payments.
* Coordinate renewal documentation.
* Maintain renewal records.
* Identify opportunities for additional services.

6\. Basic Records and Coordination

You will maintain basic sales and customer records, including:

* Lead status.
* Follow\-up dates.
* Customer details.
* Partner details.
* Agreement status.
* Payment status.
* Delivery status.

You do **not** need advanced Excel, Power BI, SQL or data analytics skills.

You **do** need to be organised enough to manage your own pipeline without constant reminders.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for someone who:

* Has hands\-on sales or business development experience.
* Is confident making calls to strangers and business owners.
* Can speak professional English.
* Can explain a service clearly and ask for the sale.
* Is comfortable with daily calling and repeated follow\-ups.
* Can handle rejection and continue working.
* Can negotiate and close deals.
* Is comfortable working with monthly sales targets.
* Is willing to work on a fixed salary \+ variable incentive structure.
* Can manage multiple leads without losing track.
* Takes responsibility for results, not just activities.
* Can maintain basic CRM/Excel records.
* Can work independently after learning the process.

Who Should NOT Apply

Please do not apply if you are primarily looking for:

* MIS Executive
* Data Analyst
* Business Analyst
* Power BI Developer
* Data Analytics
* Reporting Executive
* Back\-office Operations
* Documentation\-only roles
* Non\-sales coordination roles

**We are not hiring someone to prepare reports. We are hiring someone to generate sales.**

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following is relevant:

* B2B Sales
* Inside Sales
* Business Development
* Real Estate Sales
* Coworking Sales
* Virtual Office Sales
* SaaS Sales
* Business Services Sales
* Partner / Channel Acquisition

Candidates who have **personally sold a product or service and worked against targets** will be preferred.

How Your Performance Will Be Measured

Your performance will be measured through:

* Virtual Office revenue generated.

* Partner acquisition and activation.
* Timely customer onboarding.
