title: Strategic Account Director – PSU/Government
description:
**Location**
------------


New Delhi, India


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Remote


**Department**
--------------


All Cost CenterSalesSales Rep


  
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**


If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.


**About the Role:**
  

Kong is the AI Connectivity Company. We build the infrastructure that lets enterprises govern APIs and AI traffic at scale — and that infrastructure is becoming critical to how India's government and public sector modernize their systems.
  

We're hiring an Account Executive to own a defined patch of PSU (Public Sector Undertaking) and Government accounts across India. You'll work the full government buying cycle — tenders, GeM listings, System Integrator relationships, empanelment — to bring Kong's platform into major public\-sector modernization programs.

  

  

This role is based in Delhi and reports to a Country Manager.  



  

**What You'll Do:**


* **Own the sales cycle, government\-style.** Lead deals from first conversation through RFP response, technical and financial bid submission, and contract award. Track PQ (pre\-qualification) criteria, EMD requirements, and L1 bidding dynamics. Keep your pipeline accurate to what's actually documented in the tender process — not what looks good in a forecast.
* **Work the ecosystem, not just the account.** Government and PSU deals rarely close direct. Build real relationships with the System Integrators (SIs) and OEM partners who carry the technical bid, and make sure Kong is positioned — and empanelled — before the tender drops.
* **Navigate multiple stakeholders.** IT Secretaries, CTOs and CIOs at PSUs, nodal officers, procurement and finance committees — each has different priorities and a different definition of "done." Map them accurately and plan around all of them.
* **Build account plans for your patch.** Identify which departments and PSUs are actively modernizing, where their budget cycles sit, and what a realistic path to close looks like. Then execute against it.
* **Get fluent in the platform and the landscape.** Know Kong's API and AI governance platform well enough to defend it in a technical bid, and know where competitors are already empanelled.
* **Meet your number.** Consistently hit quota. Government cycles are long — consistency across quarters matters more than any single deal.
* **Bring in the rest of Kong early.** Loop in sales engineering, legal, and the channel team before compliance and certification requirements (STQC, data residency, MeitY empanelment) become a bottleneck late in the deal.
* **Travel.** Expect real time in government offices and PSU sites across India. This is a relationship business, and relationships in this sector are built in person.

**What You'll Bring:**


* **8\-12 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology sales, with direct experience selling into Indian government departments or PSUs.** This isn't optional — the public\-sector buying process is different enough that generalist enterprise experience alone won't carry you.
* **A track record of consistently hitting quota** (typically in the ₹2–5 Cr / $300K–$750K range) sold through longer, multi\-stakeholder government cycles.
* **Working knowledge of India's government tendering lifecycle** — GeM, RFP/RFI processes, technical and financial bids, PQ criteria, EMD — and how empanelment with bodies like MeitY or NIC actually works in practice.
* **Established relationships with System Integrators and OEM partners** active in India's public\-sector technology space.
* **Process discipline and patience.** Government deals move on their own timeline. You bring structure to that timeline — you don't try to force it.
* **Executive presence with senior government officials and PSU leadership**, along with the judgment to know when to push and when to wait.
* **Ownership with collaboration.** You run your patch, but you know when to pull in your manager, sales engineering, or a partner. In the public sector, this isn't a solo sport.

  

\#LI\-SP1


**About Kong:**


Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI\-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

description:
* Delhi, INDIA, India
* Not Remote
* Sales
* JOB219038


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function:**


The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in identifying, developing, and expanding adoption of da Vinci procedures in Benign Gynecology across North \& East India. Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.


This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. It combines clinical selling, market development, surgeon pathway execution, customer value creation, and cross\-functional program leadership. The SSM will work through the local commercial organization and directly engage priority customers where specialist expertise is required.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**


**1\. Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedure Utilization**


* Develop and execute the India specialty strategy for Benign Gynecology, aligned with regional priorities and commercial objectives.


* Identify and prioritize procedure growth opportunities, including benign hysterectomy, endometriosis, myomectomy, ovarian cystectomy, and other relevant procedures within the specialty.


* Apply established da Vinci adoption and procedure readiness methodologies in assigned specialties, territories, and target accounts.


* Analyze procedure, surgeon, account, and market trends to prioritize opportunities, address adoption barriers, and guide field execution.


* Partner with local Clinical Sales and Capital Sales teams to develop account\-specific plans that increase utilization of installed systems and create future system opportunities.


* Lead strategic market development activities that build awareness, clinical confidence, and sustainable procedure adoption.


**2\. Convert High\-Volume Laparoscopy Centers into da Vinci Programs**


* Identify and prioritize high\-volume laparoscopic centers in Benign Gynecology that have the clinical leadership, procedure volume, infrastructure, and strategic intent to build a robotic surgery program.


* Develop conversion strategies that articulate the clinical, operational, and economic value of da Vinci surgery to surgeons, hospital executives, and other decision\-makers.


* Partner with Capital Sales, Key Accounts, and hospital stakeholders to help qualified high\-volume laparoscopic centers procure a da Vinci system and establish a sustainable program.


* Support the complete program\-building journey, including opportunity assessment, executive alignment, surgeon onboarding, care\-team readiness, initial case\-series support, patient pathway development, and post\-launch growth planning.


**3\. Develop Surgeons, KOLs, and Centers of Excellence**


* Identify and develop surgeon champions and Key Opinion Leaders for priority procedures in partnership with Marketing and Professional Education.


* Create development plans for high\-potential surgeons from initial adoption through sustainable utilization, advanced procedure adoption, teaching capability, and peer influence.


* Collaborate cross\-functionally to establish suitable case observation sites, mentor sites, training centers, and peer\-learning platforms.


* Coordinate appropriate case observation, on\-site support, simulation or laboratory learning, advanced training, and peer\-to\-peer education in accordance with approved processes.


* Bring relevant clinical and workflow value during the initial surgeon case series and support continuous improvement as experience develops.


* Develop and lead regional specialty education and market development programs that can scale adoption.


**4\. Build Clinical, Operational, and Economic Value**


* Work with surgeon champions, care teams, and internal partners to identify and develop credible clinical, operational, and economic value evidence.


* Understand customer success measures within the operating room and across the patient pathway, and translate them into account\-specific value discussions.


* Partner with relevant internal functions to develop value\-focused steering committees, executive reviews, and customer action plans.


* Conduct hospital, department, and practice executive presentations that support informed decision\-making and program expansion.


* Use approved evidence, customer data, and value tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.


**5\. Elevate Specialty Sales Competency**


* Coach, counsel, and train Clinical Sales representatives and managers on Benign Gynecology anatomy, procedure pathways, customer needs, clinical value, and consultative selling approaches.


* Provide field feedback that strengthens representatives’ ability to engage Benign Gynecology specialists and position applicable advanced technologies.


* Identify area\-level capability gaps and coordinate competency\-building programs with Clinical Sales Directors and other relevant leaders.


* Create practical field tools, talk tracks, account\-planning guidance, and best\-practice sharing to improve execution consistency.


* Model high\-quality clinical selling and influence through joint field visits, customer engagements, and opportunity reviews.


**6\. Lead Cross\-Functional Initiatives and Market Intelligence**


* Serve as the market intelligence liaison for Sales, Marketing, Professional Education, and Training teams by providing timely insights on customers, competitors, procedure trends, adoption barriers, and unmet needs.


* Leverage specialty resources to support scalable launches of new procedures, products, advanced technologies, and customer programs.


* Align with Sales Leadership and Marketing on surgeon training resources, training effectiveness, procedure volume outcomes, and advanced technology adoption.


* Collaborate effectively in a complex matrix organization and influence decisions without direct authority.


* Responsibly manage company resources and budgets to support strategies with the strongest commercial and customer impact.


* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of plans, activities, opportunities, and outcomes in approved company systems.


### **Qualifications**


**Skills/Job Requirements:**


* Minimum 8 years of relevant medical device, surgical, clinical sales, or healthcare market\-development experience.


* Proven track record of individual sales excellence and successful introduction or adoption of new technologies.


* Strong clinical selling capability and the ability to build credibility with surgeons, hospital executives, and highly educated customer groups.


* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, prioritize opportunities, and deliver results in an environment of change.


* Proven ability to influence peers and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority.


* Effective communication and presentation skills across a broad organization and diverse customer audiences.


* Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret market, procedure, surgeon, and account trends.


* Knowledge of the operating room environment and a solid clinical foundation to understand healthcare value.


* Ability and willingness to travel extensively across India, including overnight travel, based on business needs.


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in one or more Indian languages is advantageous.


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification required.


* Relevant postgraduate qualification in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field is preferred.


* Experience in minimally invasive surgery, robotic\-assisted surgery, benign gynecology, hysterectomy, endometriosis, myomectomy, or surgical capital equipment.


* Experience developing surgeon champions, KOLs, case observation sites, training programs, or centers of excellence.


* Experience building a new clinical market, converting established surgical practices, or launching a hospital program.


* Previous people\-management experience or demonstrated readiness for broader leadership responsibility.


* Experience working with large hospital groups, academic institutions, or complex accounts in India.


### **Additional Information**


Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.


U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.


Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).


For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.


This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
  

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
  

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
  

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

title: Accounts & Finance Executive – CA Inter
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Accounts \& Finance Executive – CA Inter**

**Department:** Accounts \& Finance  
**Location:** Howrah, West Bengal  
**Industry:** Plastic Recycling \& Manufacturing – Plastic Flakes \& PET Granules  
**Reporting To:** Head – Accounts \& Finance / Finance Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** CA Inter with minimum 3 years of Articleship experience

**1\. JOB PURPOSE**

To manage and support day\-to\-day accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, audit, financial reporting and other finance\-related activities of the manufacturing unit.

The position will be responsible for ensuring accurate accounting records, timely statutory compliance, proper documentation and effective coordination with auditors, consultants, vendors, customers and internal departments.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Accounting \& Bookkeeping**

* Handle day\-to\-day accounting transactions and ensure proper accounting entries.
* Maintain and verify purchase, sales, receipt, payment and journal entries.
* Review ledger accounts and identify accounting discrepancies.
* Perform regular bank reconciliation and vendor/customer reconciliation.
* Maintain proper supporting documents for accounting transactions.
* Assist in monthly, quarterly and annual closing of books.
* Assist in preparation of Trial Balance, Profit \& Loss Account and Balance Sheet.
* Verify outstanding receivables and payables.
* Monitor advances, expenses and other balance\-sheet items.
* Ensure proper accounting classification and documentation.

**B. GST \& Indirect Tax Compliance**

* Assist in preparation and filing of GST returns.
* Review GST input tax credit and reconcile purchase records with applicable GST data.
* Assist in GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B preparation.
* Perform GST reconciliation and identify mismatches.
* Verify GST applicability on purchase and sales transactions.
* Coordinate with GST consultants for notices, assessments and other matters.
* Maintain proper GST\-related records and supporting documents.

**C. TDS \& Direct Taxation**

* Calculate and verify TDS deductions.
* Assist in timely filing of TDS returns.
* Verify TDS ledgers and reconcile TDS with relevant records.
* Assist in preparation of tax computations and income\-tax\-related information.
* Coordinate with tax consultants during assessments, audits and other proceedings.
* Maintain proper documentation for tax compliance.

**D. Audit**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors and tax auditors.
* Prepare audit schedules and supporting documents.
* Provide required information and explanations to auditors.
* Assist in statutory audit and tax audit activities.
* Follow up on audit observations and assist in implementing corrective actions.
* Maintain proper audit working papers and documentation.

**E. Manufacturing Accounting**

* Coordinate with Production, Purchase, Stores and Sales departments for finance\-related information.
* Verify purchase invoices, material receipts and related accounting documents.
* Assist in inventory accounting and reconciliation.
* Monitor stock\-related accounting records.
* Assist in manufacturing cost analysis.
* Review consumption, production and material\-related financial information.
* Assist in identifying accounting variances and unusual transactions.

**F. Accounts Receivable \& Payable**

* Monitor customer outstanding balances.
* Prepare receivable ageing reports.
* Coordinate with the sales team for collection\-related information.
* Verify vendor bills and supporting documents before processing.
* Monitor vendor outstanding balances.
* Perform vendor reconciliation.
* Assist in payment planning and preparation.

**G. MIS \& Management Reporting**

* Prepare regular MIS reports for management.
* Prepare expense, sales, purchase, receivable and payable reports.
* Assist in budget\-versus\-actual analysis.
* Prepare financial data for management review.
* Identify unusual variations and communicate them to the reporting manager.

**H. Internal Control \& Compliance**

* Ensure accounting transactions are supported by appropriate documents.
* Follow company approval and authorization procedures.
* Assist in strengthening internal financial controls.
* Identify discrepancies, duplicate entries or unusual transactions.
* Maintain confidentiality of financial and company information.

**I. ERP / Accounting Software**

* Work on ERP/accounting software used by the company.
* Ensure timely and accurate posting of transactions.
* Generate accounting reports as required.
* Maintain proper master data and accounting records.
* Support implementation or improvement of accounting processes in ERP.

**J. Other Finance Activities**

* Assist in preparation of financial statements.
* Support management during statutory inspections and audits.
* Coordinate with external consultants wherever required.
* Maintain proper records for financial and statutory purposes.
* Perform other finance and accounting duties assigned by the reporting manager.

**3\. ELIGIBILITY**

**Educational Qualification**

**Mandatory:**

* CA Inter qualified.

**Preferred:**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates who have completed both groups of CA Intermediate will be preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum **3 years of CA Articleship experience**.
* Practical exposure to accounting, audit and taxation is required.
* Experience with a manufacturing company or manufacturing audit will be an advantage.

**Industry Preference**

Experience in any of the following will be advantageous:

* Manufacturing
* Plastic industry
* Recycling industry
* Trading \& manufacturing
* Industrial products
* Engineering/manufacturing units

**4\. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

The candidate should have practical knowledge of:

* General Accounting
* Journal Entries
* Ledger Scrutiny
* Bank Reconciliation
* Trial Balance
* Profit \& Loss Account
* Balance Sheet
* GST
* TDS
* Income Tax
* Audit
* Inventory Accounting
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* MIS Reporting
* Financial Reconciliation

title: Global Salesforce Process Owner - Salesforce COE
description:
Date: Sep 23, 2026
Location:
IVGSSPL Kolkata, IN
Req ID: 1771
Company: Indorama Ventures GSSPL
Description:
**Our organization**:
Indorama Ventures is a global sustainable chemical company operating across multiple verticals such as Combined PET, Fibers, and Integrated Oxides \& Derivatives. The Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Kolkata, India supports worldwide operations through centralized IT, Finance and Business process services.


**Position Overview**


We are seeking a senior, business\-oriented Salesforce professional to own the end\-to\-end functional process design for our Salesforce process


Acting as the functional process owner, you will lead discovery and design decisions, establish common process standards, resolve cross\-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need through solution delivery and measurable outcomes.


This high\-impact role is accountable for the functional integrity of the process landscape, the quality and readiness of business requirements, business acceptance of delivered capabilities, process adoption, and continuous improvement. Delivery teams will own technical design and execution; this role will own the business process intent, functional outcomes, and design decisions.

  

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**


**Functional Process Ownership \& Design**


* Own the end\-to\-end functional process design for Salesforce\-enabled commercial capabilities, from lead and opportunity management through quoting, contracting, order hand\-off, and customer lifecycle management.
* Define and maintain global process principles, target\-state process models, decision rights, business rules, controls, roles, personas, and hand\-offs across functions and regions.
* Lead structured discovery and design workshops, challenge local requirements, resolve process conflicts, and secure accountable business sign\-off on functional designs.
* Assess process gaps and improvement opportunities using business outcomes, data, risk, control, customer experience, and adoption considerations.
* Maintain clear traceability from strategic objective and business need through process design, requirement, delivered capability, control, and measurable benefit.

**Functional Design Authority \& Governance**


* Act as the functional design authority for Salesforce Sales Cloud and related commercial capabilities, ensuring designs align with enterprise process principles, platform guardrails, and the target operating model.
* Set the functional direction and approve key process decisions while partnering with architects and delivery teams on solution options, feasibility, integrations, data implications, and non\-functional constraints.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and process fragmentation by promoting standard capabilities, reusable patterns, and disciplined exception governance.
* Define functional acceptance criteria, oversee business validation and UAT readiness, and provide final functional acceptance for releases.
* Ensure process controls, data ownership, compliance requirements, and auditability are embedded in functional designs.

**Demand Prioritization \& Delivery Partnership**


* Shape and prioritize the functional demand pipeline with Business Product Owners and the Salesforce Platform Owner based on strategic alignment, business value, risk, dependency, and process maturity.
* Own the quality and readiness of epics, process requirements, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria before work enters delivery.
* Provide timely functional decisions, clarify intent during delivery, manage scope trade\-offs, and ensure delivered capabilities remain aligned with approved process designs.
* Partner with release, testing, data, integration, and change teams to confirm business readiness, adoption plans, process controls, and benefit measures.

**Process Architecture, Documentation \& Adoption**


* Create and maintain authoritative process architecture and functional documentation, including current\- and target\-state maps, capability models, business rules, controls, role and persona maps, decision logs, and functional specifications.
* Communicate process direction, design decisions, impacts, and trade\-offs clearly to senior leaders, process owners, regional stakeholders, and delivery teams.
* Partner with change and learning teams to define role impacts, operating procedures, training needs, adoption measures, and post\-release reinforcement.
* Monitor process performance, user feedback, data quality, control effectiveness, and realized benefits to drive a prioritized continuous\-improvement roadmap.
  

**What We're Looking For**
**Educational Qualifications**


**Education \& Certifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an advantage.
* Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant certification is preferred and should be supported by strong practical understanding of platform capabilities and constraints.
* Process\-management, business\-analysis, Lean Six Sigma, or agile product certification is an advantage.

**Nice to Have**


* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist certification.
* Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud or Service Cloud.

**Experience**


**Core Skills \& Experience**


* 8\+ years of experience in business process ownership, process design, product management, or senior business analysis, including substantial responsibility for Salesforce\-enabled commercial processes.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex end\-to\-end functional process design across multiple functions, regions, or business units, with authority to drive standardization and resolve competing requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud and the sales lifecycle, including lead, account, opportunity, pipeline, customer, forecasting, and quote\-to\-order processes; Salesforce CPQ experience is advantageous.
* Experience in a manufacturing or complex commercial environment, with a practical understanding of global process variation, controls, customer experience, data ownership, and integration hand\-offs.
* Proven ability to translate strategy and business outcomes into target\-state processes, policies, business rules, functional requirements, decision frameworks, and measurable success criteria.

* **Audit support** – Maintain accounting records and provide required documents for internal, statutory, GST and other audits.

* **Compliance \& internal controls** – Ensure transactions are properly authorized, supported by documents and recorded accurately.
* **Reconciliation** – Perform regular reconciliation of bank, customer, vendor, GST, TDS, advances and other relevant accounts.
* **Coordination with departments** – Coordinate with **HR, Purchase, Store, Billing, Project/Site, Plant, Dispatch and Management** for accounting\-related matters.
* **Confidentiality** – Maintain confidentiality of company financial information, employee salaries, vendor rates, customer details, project costs and management reports.

title: Head of Sales
description:
**About Vidyalai** 




 Vidyalai delivers 1\-on\-1 online tutoring for international curriculum \- IB, IGCSE, A\-Levels, AP, SAT and ACT and Australian boards. Our students are spread across the Gulf, Southeast Asia, Australia, US and Europe, and our buyers are parents making a considered, high\-value decision about their child's academic outcome.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You own two things: turning enquiries into enrolled students who stay, and the team that does it. We have six counsellors today and we are looking for someone to take the function over properly, grow it, and make revenue predictable enough that we can plan against it.
 



 You will be responsible not just for managing the existing sales team, but for building a predictable, scalable sales organization that consistently delivers revenue growth.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





 • Net collected revenue, quarterly..
 



 • Track and improve conversions.
 



 • The team \- Hiring, ramping, coaching and curing, if required. You will be directly accountable for their performance..
 



 • Coaching from call recordings. We record every counselling call. We expect you to listen to a sample each week and give counsellors feedback on actual moments in their calls, with the timestamp. .
 



 • CRM discipline. Stage definitions, hygiene, and forecasts that hold up..
 



  





**What we are looking for:** 




  





 • \>5 years of strong sales experience, 1\+ years of sales\-team leadership experience.
 



 • Experience in Consultative, high\-ticket, considered purchases. Education, healthcare, financial services, premium services or B2B..
 



 • Strong understanding of sales funnels, conversion optimisation and CRM systems.
 



 • A coach, not just a manager. You can take a mediocre counsellor and make them good. You can point to people you've done it to..
 



 • Data\-native: You reason from conversion data and call evidence rather than from a playbook you brought with you..
 



 • Willingness to be hands on: We are not looking for someone who wants to sit above the work. To deeply understand the work, we expect you to do it yourself also \- calls, closing, objection handling etc..
 



  





 Please do not apply if you do not meet the above criteria.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Kochi, Kerala (on\-site preferred)
 



**Compensation:** 
 Competitive package based on experience and role fit.

title: Email Marketing Specialist
description:
**About the role:** 




 Rocky Mountain Media is hiring an Email Marketing Specialist focused primarily on
 **generating qualified leads (b2b) through cold email outreach.** 
 This is a lead\-gen\-first role, your main job is filling our pipeline with prospects who convert into clients. You'll also support general administrative tasks, but email marketing and outreach performance is the core of what you're measured on.
 



**What you'll do:** 




*Email Marketing \& Lead Generation (primary focus):* 



* Build and run cold outreach campaigns end\-to\-end using
 **Apollo** 
 — list building, sequencing, sending, follow\-ups
* Own deliverability: mailbox warm\-up, sender reputation, domain health across multiple sending accounts, so campaigns actually land in inboxes
* Research and build targeted prospect lists based on our ideal client profile
* Write and continuously test email copy/subject lines/sequences to improve open and reply rates
* Manage replies and move interested prospects into the pipeline, coordinating scheduling through
 **Outlook**
* Track campaign performance (opens, replies, meetings booked, deals sourced) and report on what's working
* Continuously refine targeting and messaging based on results, this role owns outcomes, not just sending volume



*Administrative Support (secondary):* 



* Inbox and calendar coordination
* CRM/pipeline updates as leads move through the funnel
* General ad hoc administrative tasks as needed



**Compensation structure:** 



* Base pay for day\-to\-day outreach and admin work
* **Commission on any contract that closes from a lead you generated,** 
 structure to be discussed, but this role has real upside tied directly to outbound performance, not just activity



**What we're looking for:** 



* **Strong, hands\-on Apollo experience is essential,** 
 this is a lead\-gen role first, and Apollo is the core tool. We need someone who already knows how to build sequences, manage deliverability, and read campaign data, not someone learning it on the job
* Proficiency with
 **Outlook** 
 for scheduling and correspondence
* Strong written communication, you're writing the copy that gets replies, so this needs to be a real strength, not an afterthought
* Motivated by outcomes, since commission is tied to closed contracts, we're looking for someone who wants outreach performance to translate directly into their own income
* **Bonus:** 
 experience with
 **GoHighLevel (GHL)**



**Ideal candidate mindset:** 




 Someone who treats cold outreach as a numbers\-and\-optimization game, not just a task to complete, testing, iterating, and genuinely caring about reply and close rates because their own commission depends on it.

* Monitor daily sales and take corrective action when required.
* Drive primary and secondary sales growth.
* Ensure proper product availability and visibility in the market.

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with distributors.
* Monitor distributor stock, sales, collections, and outstanding payments.
* Ensure proper stock rotation and minimize expiry and damages.
* Review distributor performance regularly

* Identify new business opportunities and potential customers.

* Conduct regular market visits and competitor analysis.
* Gather market feedback regarding pricing, products, schemes, and competitor activities.

* Monitor daily field activities and productivity.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.

* Improve outlet productivity and sales conversion.
* Ensure proper implementation of company schemes and promotional activities.
* Monitor product placement, visibility, and merchandising standards.

* Maintain accurate records of sales, stock, distribution, collections, and market coverage.
* Analyze territory\-wise sales performance.
* Track target versus achievement and prepare action plans for gaps.

**7\. Collection \& Outstanding Management**

* Monitor customer and distributor outstanding payments.
* Coordinate with distributors and customers for timely collections.
* Ensure sales are conducted within approved credit limits and company policies.
* Escalate overdue accounts to the reporting manager.

**8\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence**

* Monitor competitor products, prices, schemes, promotions, and distribution strategies.
* Collect market intelligence and share relevant information with management.
* Identify changing customer and market requirements.

description:

**Company:** COSYSTA  
**Position:** Chief Executive Officer – International \& Domestic Operations  
**Department:** Executive Management  
**Location:** India / International  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Board of Directors / Managing Director

About the Role

COSYSTA is looking for an experienced and business\-oriented **CEO – International \& Domestic Operations** to lead the company's overall business operations across India and international markets.

The CEO will be responsible for building and managing the operational structure, developing strategic partnerships, driving revenue, expanding international markets, managing domestic operations, and creating a scalable organization.

This is a **leadership \+ business development \+ operations management** role for a person who can take ownership of business growth and build strong teams and market networks.

Key Responsibilities1\. Domestic Operations – India

* Lead and manage COSYSTA's overall domestic operations.
* Develop business strategies for different Indian markets.
* Identify new business opportunities and customer segments.
* Build and manage regional teams, consultants, partners and branch operations.
* Develop relationships with businesses, institutions and strategic partners.
* Monitor sales, projects, revenue and operational performance.
* Establish SOPs and systems for smooth day\-to\-day operations.
* Coordinate with technology, marketing, sales and project teams.
* Track KPIs and ensure teams achieve agreed business targets.

2\. International Operations

* Develop and execute COSYSTA's international expansion strategy.
* Identify suitable countries and cities for market expansion.
* Build international consultant, partner and branch networks.
* Develop relationships with international clients and business partners.
* Coordinate international sales and business development activities.
* Understand local market requirements and business opportunities.
* Support international project acquisition and delivery.
* Establish scalable processes for managing multiple international markets.
* Represent COSYSTA in international business meetings and partnerships.

3\. Business Development

* Create and execute domestic and international business development strategies.
* Generate B2B and B2C business opportunities where applicable.
* Build strategic partnerships and channel networks.
* Develop corporate relationships and key accounts.
* Lead negotiations with major clients and partners.
* Create new revenue channels and business models.
* Monitor competitors, market trends and emerging opportunities.

4\. Consultant \& Partner Network

* Build COSYSTA's consultant network.
* Recruit, onboard and manage business consultants.
* Develop clear consultant responsibilities, targets and incentive structures.
* Support consultants with sales, marketing and technical resources.
* Develop branch\-investor and business\-partner opportunities.
* Monitor partner performance and business contribution.
* Maintain long\-term relationships with high\-performing partners.

5\. Project \& Operations Management

* Ensure successful execution of COSYSTA projects.
* Coordinate between clients, consultants, developers and project teams.
* Monitor project timelines, quality and profitability.
* Establish project management standards and reporting systems.
* Identify operational problems and implement solutions.
* Improve productivity and reduce unnecessary operational costs.

6\. Team Leadership

* Build and manage high\-performing management teams.
* Recruit senior employees and key operational personnel.
* Define roles, responsibilities and KPIs.
* Conduct regular performance reviews.
* Develop leadership within regional and international teams.
* Create a professional, accountable and growth\-oriented company culture.

7\. Financial \& Business Performance

* Monitor revenue, expenses and profitability.
* Prepare operational and business growth plans.
* Work with finance teams on budgets and forecasts.
* Monitor market\-wise and branch\-wise performance.
* Improve operational efficiency and profitability.
* Present business performance reports to the Board/Managing Director.

8\. Technology \& Digital Transformation

* Work closely with the technology team to improve COSYSTA's digital systems.
* Identify opportunities for automation and AI implementation.
* Ensure internal business processes are digitally organized.
* Support development of platforms and tools required for consultants, branches, clients and management.
* Use data and analytics for business decision\-making.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

The CEO will be evaluated based on measurable business outcomes, including:

* Domestic revenue growth
* International revenue growth
* New market expansion
* Number and quality of strategic partnerships
* Consultant/partner network growth
* Client acquisition
* Project profitability
* Operational efficiency
* Customer satisfaction
* Team performance
* Business process implementation
* Overall company growth

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with:

* Strong business leadership experience.
* Experience managing domestic and/or international operations.
* Excellent business development skills.
* Strong negotiation and communication abilities.
* Experience building teams and partner networks.
* Strategic thinking and entrepreneurial mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple business functions.
* Willingness to travel for business development when required.
* Strong understanding of technology\-driven businesses.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.

Preferred Experience

**Experience:** 8\+ years preferred in business management, operations, business development, technology, consulting, or a related field.

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* IT / Technology
* SaaS
* Digital Services
* Consulting
* International Business
* Franchise / Branch Operations
* B2B Business Development
* Strategic Partnerships
* Startup / Entrepreneurship

Leadership Expectations

The CEO is expected to operate as a **business owner and strategic leader**, not only as an administrator.

The person should be capable of:

**PLAN → BUILD → MANAGE → SCALE**

* Plan market strategy
* Build teams and networks
* Manage operations
* Scale domestic and international business

Compensation

**Salary / Compensation:** Negotiable based on experience and business leadership capability.

Performance\-based incentives, revenue\-linked incentives and other benefits may be considered based on the final role structure.

Why Join COSYSTA?

* Opportunity to lead domestic and international operations.
* Opportunity to build new markets from the ground up.
* High level of decision\-making responsibility.
* Work closely with the company's leadership.
* Build international business networks.
* Opportunity to create and implement new business models.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.

Application

Candidates should submit their **CV/Resume along with a brief description of their leadership experience, international/domestic business experience, and major business achievements.**

description:
**Role Overview**

The Security Architect is a cross\-domain cybersecurity authority responsible for designing and positioning end\-to\-end security architectures spanning Network Security, End User Computing (EUC) Security, and Data Centre Security. The role serves both ISP clients (managing telco\-grade security infrastructure) and MSI customers (enterprise security transformation). A strong commercial mindset and pre\-sales ability are essential to position security as a value driver rather than a cost centre.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Architect holistic security solutions covering perimeter, internal segmentation, endpoint, cloud, and identity layers
* Design network security solutions: NGFW, IPS/IDS, SD\-WAN security overlays, DDoS protection, and carrier\-grade NAT/CGN security
* Architect End User Computing security — endpoint protection platforms (EPP), EDR/XDR, VDI security, email security, and web proxy/filtering
* Design Data Centre security: micro\-segmentation, East\-West firewall controls, WAF, privileged access management (PAM), and Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA)
* Position and architect SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and SSE solutions — Zscaler, Prisma Access, Cato Networks
* Develop SOC design frameworks, SIEM architecture (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar), and SOAR playbooks
* Lead security assessments, gap analyses, and compliance mapping (ISO 27001, NIST, PCI\-DSS, GDPR, NCA ECC in KSA/UAE)

* Maintain strong OEM relationships with Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Microsoft, Zscaler, and Milestone PSIM/VMS

title: Network Architect
description:
**◆ Role Overview**

The Network Architect is the most versatile technical authority in the Solution Engineering team, covering the full spectrum of IP networking from ISP backbone design to enterprise SD\-WAN, NFV, SASE, and GPON/FTTH access deployments. This role is critical to the MSI business where integrated network solutions are central to large deal pursuits. The architect must combine CCIE\-level depth with the commercial acumen to shape multi\-vendor network proposals for carrier, enterprise, and government customers.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Architect carrier\-grade IP/MPLS backbone, metro Ethernet, and Service Provider edge networks
* Design enterprise campus and branch networks: Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS), Switching (RSTP, EVPN\-VXLAN), and network automation
* Architect SD\-WAN solutions — Cisco Catalyst SD\-WAN (Viptela), VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet SD\-WAN, and Nokia Nuage for large enterprise and ISP overlay deployment
* Design NFV/SDN architectures using OpenStack, ONAP, Kubernetes CNFs, and virtual CPE (vCPE) platforms
* Architect SASE frameworks — positioning Secure SD\-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, and FWaaS as integrated cloud\-delivered services (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Fortinet SASE)
* Design GPON / XGS\-PON / FTTH networks — OLT, ONT/ONU sizing, OSP design, splitter ratios, and integration with BSS/OSS provisioning

title: Fiber Optics Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

The Fiber Optics Architect is the domain expert for all physical\-layer optical infrastructure design — from Outside Plant (OSP) cable route design and FTTH access network planning to high\-capacity DWDM/OTN transport architecture. This role is pivotal to the MSI business where fiber infrastructure underpins every managed service and connectivity deal. The architect must bridge field\-level technical depth with the ability to produce bankable, customer\-ready designs and cost models.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Design Outside Plant (OSP) fiber networks: aerial, underground, duct\-based, and submarine — route surveys, cable sizing, and splicing plans
* Architect FTTH/FTTB/FTTC/FTTx networks — PON architecture (GPON/XGS\-PON), ODF planning, distribution point units (DPU), and ONT selection
* Design high\-capacity DWDM and OTN transport networks for metro and long\-haul using Ciena, Nokia 1830, or Fujitsu platforms
* Produce fiber route maps, splice diagrams, loss budgets, and optical power budgets for acceptance testing
* Develop BoQ for civil works, cable, equipment, and integration costs — critical for MSI project bids
* Conduct OTDR interpretation, power meter testing, and light source characterisation — both in design review and site acceptance
* Advise on dark fibre IRU/lease strategies for ISP backbone buildouts
* Support pre\-sales: technical presentations on fiber solution value, coverage maps, rollout timelines, and ROI models
* Coordinate with civil/structural engineering teams on duct sizing, joint chambers, and data centre entry requirements

* OSP design tools: AutoCAD, ArcGIS, QGIS, or specialist network GIS (ESRI/OSPInsight) for route planning
* Optical link budget calculations: span loss, OSNR, chromatic dispersion (CD), polarisation mode dispersion (PMD), non\-linear effects
* DWDM: ROADM architecture, WSS, optical amplifiers (EDFA/Raman), coherent modulation formats (DP\-QPSK, 16QAM)

* Conduct site survey assessments and interpret propagation models (Okumura\-Hata, COST 231, 3GPP models)
* Design 5G NR (SA/NSA) architectures — C\-RAN, O\-RAN, Massive MIMO, beamforming, and mmWave considerations
* Architect In\-Building Solutions (IBS): passive DAS, active DAS, Remote Radio Units (RRU), and small cell deployments
* Develop RF planning outputs using tools such as Atoll, Planet EV, iBwave, or equivalent
* Support OEM partnerships with Ericsson, Nokia, ZTE, Comba, CommScope, and Kathrein
* Produce BoQ, site specifications, integration plans, and RF KPI acceptance documents for delivery teams
* Represent solutions in pre\-sales: RF design presentations, coverage simulation walk\-throughs, and spectrum strategy advisory
* Advise on ICCC and smart city connectivity infrastructure — public safety LTE, FirstNet equivalents, and critical communications

**◆ Technical Expertise — Hands\-On Requirements**

* Hands\-on RF planning: Atoll / Planet EV / iBwave — coverage prediction, frequency planning, and interference analysis reports
* Technology stack: 2G/3G/4G LTE / 5G NR — all layers from physical (PHY) to network architecture

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Company:** Cosysta  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala / Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Role:** Leadership – Technology \& Product Engineering

About Cosysta

Cosysta is a technology company focused on building modern software products, AI\-enabled solutions, digital transformation platforms, web applications, mobile applications, and custom technology solutions for clients in India and international markets.

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** who can take complete ownership of Cosysta’s technology function and build a scalable engineering organisation.

Role Overview

The CTO will be responsible for the overall technology strategy, software architecture, engineering quality, product development, technical delivery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology team development at Cosysta.

This is not purely a management position. The CTO should be capable of reviewing architecture, solving difficult technical problems, guiding developers, interacting with clients, estimating projects, and ensuring successful delivery.

Key ResponsibilitiesTechnology Strategy \& Leadership

* Define and execute Cosysta’s long\-term technology roadmap.
* Select appropriate technologies, platforms, frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and development standards.
* Ensure technology decisions support scalability, security, performance, profitability, and business growth.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, cloud computing, SaaS, and modern application development.
* Work closely with the CEO, CMO, CFO, and other leadership members on company strategy.

Software \& Product Architecture

* Design and review scalable software architectures.
* Lead architecture decisions for web, mobile, SaaS, enterprise, AI and cloud\-based applications.
* Establish coding standards, development practices and documentation standards.
* Conduct technical reviews of critical projects.
* Reduce technical debt and improve maintainability of products.

AI \& Emerging Technologies

* Lead the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into Cosysta products and client solutions.
* Evaluate LLMs, AI APIs, RAG systems, AI agents, automation tools and related technologies.
* Identify commercially viable AI products and services.
* Ensure responsible, secure and cost\-efficient implementation of AI systems.

Engineering Team Leadership

* Build and manage a high\-performing technology team.
* Recruit developers, technical leads, AI engineers, QA engineers and DevOps professionals as required.
* Mentor junior and senior developers.
* Conduct technical interviews and skill evaluations.
* Define individual and team KPIs.
* Establish accountability for quality, timelines and delivery.

Project \& Client Delivery

* Take technical ownership of major client projects.
* Participate in technical discussions with clients.
* Convert business requirements into appropriate technical solutions.
* Support project estimation, timelines and resource planning.
* Identify technical risks before project commencement.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed scope, quality and deadlines.
* Support the sales team during technical presentations and proposal discussions.

Development \& Quality Assurance

* Establish development workflows including:
* Git and version\-control standards
* Code reviews
* CI/CD
* Automated testing
* QA processes
* Release management
* Documentation
* Monitor application performance and reliability.
* Ensure proper testing before production releases.
* Implement processes to minimise bugs and production failures.

Cloud, Infrastructure \& DevOps

* Oversee cloud infrastructure and deployment architecture.
* Manage or supervise platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel or equivalent infrastructure.
* Improve deployment automation and infrastructure efficiency.
* Monitor infrastructure and cloud expenditure.
* Establish backup, disaster recovery and business\-continuity procedures.

Cybersecurity \& Data Protection

* Establish security standards for Cosysta and client projects.
* Ensure secure coding practices.
* Protect company source code, intellectual property and customer data.
* Implement access\-control and credential\-management policies.
* Ensure appropriate security reviews for production systems.
* Support compliance requirements where relevant.

Technology Operations

* Maintain proper documentation for all major technology systems.
* Ensure company repositories, domains, hosting, cloud accounts, APIs and technology assets remain under proper organisational control.
* Maintain technology vendor relationships.
* Introduce tools and automation that improve developer productivity.

Expected Technology Exposure

The ideal candidate should have strong experience across several of the following areas:

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* Python
* REST APIs
* Modern databases
* PostgreSQL / MySQL
* MongoDB or NoSQL technologies
* Cloud infrastructure
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Vercel
* Docker
* Git / GitHub
* CI/CD
* SaaS architecture
* Mobile application development
* AI/ML integration
* LLM APIs
* RAG and AI\-agent architecture
* Cybersecurity
* DevOps
* System design and scalable architecture

The CTO is not expected to personally code every project but must possess enough technical depth to **review, challenge, guide and take responsibility for technical decisions**.

Required Experience

* Preferably **8\+ years of software development / technology experience**.
* Strong experience in software architecture and engineering leadership.
* Previous experience leading developers or technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience delivering commercial software projects.
* Strong understanding of modern web and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and technical decision\-making ability.

Experience in a startup, software services company, SaaS company or product\-development organisation will be highly valuable.

Preferred Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are hands\-on technology leaders rather than purely administrative managers.
* Can build a technology department from an early stage.
* Understand both software engineering and business requirements.
* Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Can communicate technical matters clearly to non\-technical clients.
* Have experience working with international customers.
* Understand project cost, engineering productivity and commercial viability.
* Can create reusable technology frameworks rather than rebuilding everything from scratch.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured through areas such as:

* On\-time technology delivery
* Project quality
* Reduction in production bugs
* Development productivity
* Technology\-team performance
* Architecture quality
* System uptime and reliability
* Infrastructure cost optimisation
* Client satisfaction on technical delivery
* Security and compliance
* Successful implementation of AI capabilities
* Development of reusable technology assets and products

First 90\-Day Expectations

During the first three months, the CTO will be expected to:

* Conduct a complete audit of existing Cosysta technologies, source code, infrastructure and active projects.
* Review the technical capabilities of the existing development team.
* Establish coding, Git, QA, documentation and deployment standards.
* Prepare Cosysta's technology roadmap.
* Identify critical technology risks.
* Recommend the required engineering team structure.
* Improve project estimation and technical delivery systems.
* Establish security, backup and access\-control procedures.
* Develop an AI integration roadmap for Cosysta products and services.
* Build a scalable technology foundation capable of supporting international expansion.

Reporting Structure

The CTO will be part of the **Core Leadership Team of Cosysta** and will work closely with:

* Chief Executive Officer / Managing Leadership
* Chief Marketing Officer
* Chief Financial Officer
* Operations / Project Management Team

The CTO will have authority over the company's engineering, technical architecture, development standards and technology\-delivery functions.

Ideal Candidate

Cosysta needs a **builder CTO** — someone who can move comfortably between boardroom discussions, client meetings, system architecture, code reviews and engineering\-team mentoring.

The objective is not simply to manage developers, but to build a **high\-quality, scalable and commercially strong technology organisation capable of serving international clients and developing Cosysta's own technology products**.

title: Presales Engineer
description:
**About Covlant** 

  






 Covlant is building the AI\-native quality layer for modern software teams. Most engineering organizations face the same trade\-off on every release: run the entire regression suite and wait hours for feedback, or run a subset and risk letting defects slip into production. Covlant removes that trade\-off.
 




  






 Our AI\-driven impact testing platform analyzes every pull request against a deep map of the entire codebase to understand exactly what changed and what that change affects. It then selects the right tests from a team's existing suites to cover the impacted code paths. Where coverage is missing, Covlant's quality agents generate and validate new tests, so only meaningful, trustworthy tests are run. Engineers and QA teams stay in control through a clear review experience that shows what was tested, what passed or failed, and why.
 




  






 The result is faster feedback loops, leaner regression cycles, lower test\-maintenance overhead, and greater confidence in every release. Covlant fits into the tools teams already use across their CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
 




  






 We're an early\-stage company working with enterprise engineering and QA teams, and we're growing our team in Bangalore. Joining Covlant now means shaping how the product is positioned, sold, and adopted, working closely with founders, Product, and Engineering, and helping define a new category in software quality.
 




  




**Role \- Presales Engineer** 

  






 Covlant is hiring a customer\-facing Presales Engineer to lead technical discovery, tailored demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and solution design for enterprise prospects evaluating our software testing and quality\-engineering platform.
 




  






 The ideal candidate combines a strong technical foundation in QA space with customer\-facing solutioning experience. They should be able to engage credibly with engineering and QA teams, understand complex testing challenges, and articulate Covlant’s capabilities in terms of tangible operational and business outcomes.
 




  




**Key responsibilities** 

  




* Lead technical discovery to understand a prospect’s applications, testing maturity, release workflow, toolchain, integrations, security needs, stakeholders, and decision criteria.
* Deliver tailored product demos, workshops, architecture discussions, and technical presentations for QA, engineering, IT, and executive stakeholders.
* Scope and run POCs with clear use cases, customer commitments, success criteria, milestones, risks, and a conversion plan.
* Partner with Account Executives/Sales leadership to develop technical win plans, address objections, and progress enterprise opportunities.
* Handle technical evaluations, RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, integration discussions, and solution\-design requests.
* Advise prospects on test automation strategy, CI/CD integration, test reliability, regression efficiency, and implementation best practices.
* Translate product capabilities into quantified customer value—for example, reduced regression effort, faster release cycles, lower test\-maintenance cost, improved automation coverage, and reduced production\-defect risk—and build credible ROI/value cases for buyers.
* Create reusable demo environments, discovery frameworks, POC templates, solution briefs, and competitive/technical collateral.
* Feed recurring customer needs, objections, gaps, and market insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Ensure a structured technical handoff from closed\-won opportunities to implementation or customer\-success teams.



  




**Ideal candidate profile** 

  




* 4–7 years of overall experience, with meaningful early hands\-on work in software development, QA, SDET, test automation, or implementation.
* 2–4 years in a customer\-facing technical role: Presales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Consultant, Technical Consultant, or similar.
* Strong experience in QA/testing and automation, including practical familiarity with tools and concepts such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, API testing, CI/CD, Git, Jira, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, cloud testing, and test frameworks.
* Can communicate confidently with QA leads, engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and executive sponsors.
* Has led or materially contributed to tailored demos, POCs, technical discovery, solution proposals, and enterprise evaluations.
* Comfortable navigating integrations, APIs, SSO/RBAC, security reviews, cloud/SaaS architecture, and enterprise buying processes.
* Commercially aware: able to turn technical outcomes into a business case, quantify impact, and support sales teams through complex deal cycles.
* High ownership and comfortable operating in an early\-stage SaaS environment.

**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
 At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next\-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
 **Together, we advance your career.**
 The Field Application Engineer position will be the technical interface for AMD’s embedded products with embedded customers in the INDIA region. As an Engineer, the role will be responsible for technical support for AMD’s embedded products, particularly FPGA and embedded x86 products. In this position, the individual will help AMD drive a new era of embedded computing by engaging with large INDIA end customers to demonstrate how AMD technology can be used to address the needs of their business. The role will provide technical support for AMD’s embedded pipeline with a special focus on pre\-sales and development support activity as opportunities transition from opportunity to deployment. Building confidence with key customer influencers and overcoming technical objections will be critical for success in the role. Post\-sales technical support is also required as the account encounters technical issues. The role will be expected to handle technical escalations that may occur and accelerate resolutions. The Engineer must have a strong technical knowledge base and skill\-set but be equally effective in communication with both customers and internal AMD stakeholders. Must be proficient in troubleshooting in embedded platform, system and module\-level design evaluations \& developing reference designs.
   

  

**The Primary Focus Of The FAE Will Be To**
* Develop technical relationships with target end customer accounts
* Win new embedded opportunities at end customers by establishing technical solutions based on AMD technology
* Work with AMD internal teams across AMD Business Units to build technical presentations and documentation to be delivered in the field
* Deliver technical presentations and sales pitches to influence new AMD sales with customers and partners.


 This position will require a broad technical understanding of embedded applications, especially in the communications segment. The position may require specialized knowledge of microprocessor and FPGA architectures, embedded knowledge including operating systems, BIOS \& firmware is a plus.
   

  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS \& Desired Skills/Exeperience**
* The preferred candidate should have a combination of relevant academic and professional experience. The minimum qualifications associated with this position are Bachelor Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering with 10\+ years of experience, or advanced degree with 8\+ years of experience.
* Solid hands\-on experience with Vivado Design Suite and/or ISE
* Deep level knowledge of FPGA architecture
* Familiarity with various protocols and interfaces like Ethernet, PCIe, DDR etc
* Must demonstrate excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to manage complex problems involving multi\-disciplined, cross\-functional teams
* High energy, results driven mentality with strong people/leadership skills.
* This position requires an individual with excellent organizational and communication skills with a good balance of hardware, architecture and software expertise. Must be a team player with excellent collaborative skills and superior written and oral communication skills


*Benefits offered are described:* 
 AMD benefits at a glance.
   

  

*AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

title: Partner Engineer, Google Cloud, GSI
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a partner management or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience translating customer objectives into Cloud solutions across multiple domains.
* Experience in managing GSI or other channel partners as a technical alliance lead or engineer.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders, and working cross\-functionally, in a collaborative environment.
* Experience building business partnerships with partners and customers in an architecture or solution delivery role.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience conducting partner technical engagements.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As a Global System Integrators (GSI) Partner Engineer, you will partner with GSI Partner development and Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our GSI partners. You will serve as the GSI partner’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs\-of\-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win with the GSI Partner and assist to define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud.
   

  

 You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones as a technical generalist, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the GSI partner technical strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through assisting and guiding the GSI partner to develop and deliver complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers with GSI partners; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Plan and support the GSI Partner in building, developing and enhancing their Google Cloud practice.
* Be the technical point\-of\-contact for GSI partner for product and solution enquires, working in conjunction with Product and Support specialists within Google Cloud platform (GCP).


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Sr. Application Engineer I
description:

Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302348
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 – Experience: 11\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 – SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 – Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 – Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.

 Job responsibilities

* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 – Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.

 – Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 – Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.

 What we offer

 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:**

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Sr. Consultant
description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 OpenText enables the digital world as the global leader in Enterprise Information Management, both on\-cloud and off\-cloud. We embrace all things digital and are committed to being the Best Place to Work for our Employees in over 140 locations around the world.We obsess over our customers to ensure they are wildly successful in embracing the Digital World. Our customers entrust us with their most valuable information, we need to be their most trusted partner. What we do, we do well. What we create, we do purposefully to impact the world. If you believe in this and are enthusiastic about enabling the Digital World, then let OpenText turn your career vision into reality.

 The Open Text Professional Services team is comprised of more than 3,000 consultants who function as trusted advisors, managing long\-lasting relationships with more than 100,000 customers around the world. They are responsible for the delivery of business solutions from pre\-sales to post implementation. Our teams of experts help organizations solve issues, create value, improve business performance, and work more effectively in an increasingly digital world.
   

  

 As a Sr. Consultant at OpenText Professional Services team you will play a key role in creating and delivering strategic, impactful, and integrated digital solutions for clients using a combination of OpenText technologies. This role offers an opportunity to leverage your expertise in OpenText xECM configuration, knowledge of SAP business processes and integration to deliver seamless solutions that bridge the world of information and business application.
