* Planning and conducting business workshops with business and IT stakeholders of the client to elicit and document business and technical requirements for complex digital solutions.
* Architecting the OpenText solution, combining xECM functionalities \& SAP Integration, based on client’s functional and non\-functional requirements, and considering current state and future roadmap of the client.
* Creating comprehensive documentation that supports the implementation and evolution of the solution through all stages of SDLC \- Business Requirements, Functional Specification/Solution Blueprint, High\-level and Low\-level Design, Deployment and Configuration guides etc.
* Working collaboratively with program/project management team within OpenText and on\-client side to assist in task planning \& assignment for solution implementation, acceptance, and rollout.
* Collaborating with architects/developers/testers as a project team to implement the solution as per the proposed design with utmost quality.
* Assessing the current solution and impact of proposed changes to provide recommendations for release changes \& migrations.
* Basic configuration of the OpenText xECM components and Integration with SAP
* Analyzing and debugging of complex functional, design and implementation issues related to the solution and preparation of RCA. Mentoring and guiding technical architects and senior developers within the team with professional and technical advice.


**One Last Thing**
* Graduate/Postgraduate with 5\+ years of professional experience in designing medium to complex digital enterprise solutions in area of xECM for SAP.
* Excellent consulting skills – engagement, articulation, elicitation and influencing.
* Excellent customer\-facing skills \- stakeholder management, relationship building and negotiation – with strategic focus.
* Software configuration and programming knowledge, e.g., ABAP Programming, Data Dictionary, OOABAP, Fiori \& Development RICEF objects
* Project experience in the SAP environment, SAP HCM/SuccessFactors, SAP Hybris C4C and/or Salesforce is additional advantage.
* Prior experience in SAP S/4 HANA and Fiori/UI5 is an additional advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentations skills
* Willingness to travel within India and globally.


 OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

title: Field Application Engineer, Verification
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Field Application Engineer, Verification
* Senior Applications Engineer, RTL Signoff
* Customer Success Engineer, Verification Solutions
* Technical Application Engineer, Design Verification
* Solutions Engineer, Verification and Low Power


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years deep in RTL verification flows and you have learned that the hardest problems are rarely the ones in the datasheet. They show up three weeks before tapeout when a CDC violation surfaces in a corner case no one thought to model, or when a low power domain interaction breaks in ways the testbench never caught. You live for those moments because solving them well is what keeps chips from respinning.
   

  

 You are equally comfortable reading SystemVerilog assertions, walking a customer through a SpyGlass run, and sitting with an R\&D team to explain why a methodology needs to flex for a real design. You do not wait for someone to hand you a script. You write it, test it, and then show the customer how to own it themselves.
   

  

 Working across time zones does not faze you. Neither does jumping into a customer war room when a project is stuck. You know that adoption is not about features, it is about trust, and trust comes from showing up, understanding the problem, and delivering something that actually moves the schedule forward. At Synopsys, you will work with semiconductor teams building the chips that power everything, and what you enable will matter.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Work directly with semiconductor design teams across the region to deploy and optimize Synopsys verification solutions including VC SpyGlass, VCS, VC LP, VC Formal, and Verdi
* Debug complex RTL signoff issues in customer designs, CDC violations, lint errors, RDC problems, low power UPF conflicts, and formal property failures, and turn those into repeatable methodology improvements
* Partner with Synopsys R\&D and product validation teams to develop new flows, reproduce customer issues, and drive tool enhancements that solve real tapeout blockers
* Lead technical engagements during critical project phases, onsite or remote, ensuring customers hit their verification milestones and tapeout schedules
* Gather requirements from customer feedback and design challenges, translate them into flow improvements, and work with product teams to prioritize and track delivery
* Coordinate with account managers and technical account managers to shape customer strategies, drive tool adoption, and support business growth across your accounts
* Train customer engineering teams on verification methodologies, tool usage, and best practices that reduce verification cycle time and improve signoff quality


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to close CDC, lint, and low power signoff weeks or months faster by deploying the right methodology at the right time in their flow
* Reduce customer respins by catching critical RTL issues early, before they reach gate\-level or silicon
* Drive adoption of Synopsys verification tools across new projects and teams, expanding footprint and deepening technical relationships with key accounts
* Influence Synopsys product roadmaps by surfacing real customer pain points and working with R\&D to deliver features that matter
* Build repeatable flows and reference methodologies that scale across multiple customer projects and design teams
* Strengthen customer confidence in Synopsys solutions by being the engineer they call when something breaks and needs to get fixed now
* Contribute to the success of chips powering AI, automotive, mobile, and cloud infrastructure by ensuring verification does not become the bottleneck


 What You'll Need
   

  

* BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or Microelectronics with 3\-5 years of hands\-on industry experience in ASIC design or verification
* Strong command of VHDL, Verilog, and SystemVerilog RTL, and a solid understanding of ASIC design and verification flows from RTL to tapeout
* Proven experience with RTL signoff flows including linting, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), Reset Domain Crossing (RDC), and property checking using static and formal verification tools
* Hands\-on work with low power verification techniques using UPF or CPF, and experience debugging power intent issues in real designs
* Exposure to simulation and verification methodologies including directed tests, constrained random testing, assertions, coverage\-driven verification, and gate\-level simulation (GLS)
* Working knowledge of Synopsys EDA tools such as VC SpyGlass, VCS, VC LP, VC Formal, FishTail, or Verdi is a strong plus
* Comfort working in ambiguity, you can take a vague customer problem, ask the right questions, and turn it into a clear technical plan


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a verification challenge, and sketch out a solution approach on the whiteboard that the team actually believes in
* You are the kind of engineer who does not just report a tool issue, you create a minimal reproducible test case, propose a workaround, and follow up until it is resolved
* Working across global teams and time zones does not slow you down, you coordinate effectively, keep stakeholders aligned, and do not let details fall through the cracks
* You know how to explain a complex CDC violation or formal proof failure to a design lead in a way that makes sense without oversimplifying the technical reality
* You build relationships by being reliable, when you say you will deliver a flow or a debug session, it happens
* You are curious about what is coming next in chip design, AI workloads, automotive safety, advanced nodes, and you want to be part of enabling it


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Customer Success Group, a global team that partners directly with semiconductor companies to solve high\-value verification and design problems. The team works closely with R\&D, product validation, account management, and technical account managers to drive adoption of Synopsys solutions and ensure customer projects succeed through tapeout. You will be part of a regional applications engineering team supporting customers across India, collaborating with engineers worldwide, and contributing to methodologies that scale across the business.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Assistant Manager - Ops
description:
**About The Team**
 Meesho Mall is Meesho’s branded commerce business, focused on building a trusted destination for branded products across categories for users.
   

  

 We are chasing a goal to acquire wallet share of a user on branded items. It is a rocket\-ship within Meesho that has been growing super fast YoY.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Distributor Lead Generation \& Market Mapping
+ Identify and map high\-potential distributors across FMCG, Personal Care, Home, Fashion and other relevant categories.
+ Build a strong pipeline through market visits, referrals, industry networks, trade associations and cold outreach.
+ Continuously expand Meesho's distributor network across priority geographies.


****End\-to\-End Distributor Acquisition****
* Own the complete distributor onboarding lifecycle—from first contact to commercial closure.
* Conduct in\-person meetings with distributor owners and decision\-makers to pitch the Meesho opportunity.
* Evaluate distributor capabilities including infrastructure, financial strength, serviceability and operational readiness.


****Commercial Negotiation \& Closure****
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms with distributors.
* Drive stakeholder alignment across brands, distributors and internal teams to ensure timely closures.
* Resolve onboarding bottlenecks and accelerate go\-live timelines.


****Network Expansion \& Activation****
* Partner with brands to identify priority expansion markets.
* Ensure newly onboarded distributors are operationally ready and successfully activated.
* Track onboarding funnel, conversion metrics and activation milestones.


****Stakeholder Management****
* Build strong relationships with distributor owners, promoters and senior leadership.
* Collaborate with Brand, Operations, Supply Chain and Analytics teams to execute expansion plans.
* Act as the primary point of contact throughout the onboarding journey.


****Market Intelligence****
* Develop a strong understanding of regional distributor ecosystems.
* Track competitor distributor strategies, market dynamics and expansion opportunities.
* Bring insights that improve Meesho's distributor acquisition strategy.


**What You Will Need**
* Experience
+ 2\-6 years of experience in Business Development, Distributor Development, Channel Sales, Supply Expansion or Merchant Acquisition.
+ Experience working with FMCG, consumer brands, retail distribution, B2B commerce or marketplaces is preferred.


**Preferred Backgrounds**
* Distributor/channel development roles in FMCG companies.
* Professionals with experience onboarding distributors, dealers, wholesalers or large retail partners.


****Skills \& Attributes****
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable engaging with business owners, promoters and senior decision\-makers.
* High ownership with the ability to independently drive closures.
* Excellent communication in English, Hindi and regional languages (preferred based on territory).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Working knowledge of Excel and CRM tools.


****Travel Requirement****
* Extensive travel is mandatory.
* Candidates should be comfortable spending approximately 75% of their time (3 out of every 4 weeks) travelling across cities and states to identify, evaluate and onboard distributors.
* Flexibility to relocate temporarily based on business priorities is an added advantage.


****Why Join Us?****
 This role offers the opportunity to build supply infrastructure at national scale. If you enjoy solving real\-world business problems, travelling extensively, negotiating with entrepreneurs, and creating long\-term impact by building networks from scratch, this role provides a unique platform to do so.
   

  

**About Us**
 Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
   

  

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor \- our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**
****Our Mission****
 Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e\-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
   

  

 We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state\-of\-the\-art tech infrastructure, and pan\-India logistics network through trusted third\-party partners.
   

  

 Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi\-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e\-commerce ecosystem.
   

  

****Culture and Total Rewards****
 Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people\-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
   

  

 Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non\-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
   

  

 We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity\-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee\-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness\-related perks.
   

  

 To support work\-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
   

  

 At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the
 **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016** 
 , we uphold the following principles:
   

  

* Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* Accessible Workplace: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non\-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* Career Growth: We provide adequate training post\-recruitment and pre\-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* Support \& Confidentiality: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability\-related information.
* Awareness \& Inclusion: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.


 Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.
   

  

 Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

description:

 FJ12 \|

 10\+ years \|

 Flexible, with travel as required
   

  

**Suggested level**
 Senior Consultant / Presales Architect
   

  

**Experience**
 10\+ years in IT, including strong ServiceNow consulting, process design, solutioning, and presales experience
   

  

**Primary Focus**
 Platform architecture, integration, security, data, automation, technical estimation, and end\-to\-end presales, service design, and value realization
   

  

**Key domains**
 ITSM, ITOM, SPM/ITBM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management as relevant
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Lead the end\-to\-end solutioning of ServiceNow opportunities—from client discovery and solution design through estimation, proposal, bid defence, and transition to delivery. The role converts business and service\-management needs into a practical platform roadmap, implementation approach, managed\-services model, and measurable value case
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead qualification, discovery workshops, solution design, estimation, proposal development, demonstrations, bid defence, and delivery handover.
* Assess client processes, platform maturity, pain points, governance, data readiness, user experience, and transformation priorities.
* Design fit\-for\-purpose solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management.
* Translate requirements into process designs, user journeys, platform capabilities, integrations, scope, roadmap, and operating model.
* Define assumptions, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, effort, team structure, commercials, and delivery approach.
* Create RFP responses, statements of work, solution narratives, estimates, benefit cases, and executive presentations.
* Work with technical, delivery, commercial, partner, and client teams to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, commercially sound, and delivery\-ready.
* Develop reusable propositions, estimation models, workshop assets, and industry\-specific ServiceNow solutions.


 Presales \& Solution Expertise
   

  

* Strong IT service management process design experience and practical knowledge of ITIL\-aligned operating models.
* Deep functional knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, and Strategic Portfolio Management / ITBM, with broader awareness of adjacent ServiceNow workflows.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow implementation, development, upgrades, maintenance, platform administration, and technical architecture.
* Hands\-on knowledge of ServiceNow scripting and configuration, including JavaScript, Glide APIs, client and server\-side components, security rules, flows, notifications, import sets, and custom applications.
* Deep integration knowledge covering REST, SOAP/WSDL, JSON, MID Server, Integration Hub, authentication patterns, error handling, monitoring, and integration support
* Experience defining service catalogs, request models, CMDB governance, service mapping outcomes, asset processes, metrics, SLAs, dashboards, reporting, and Performance Analytics requirements.
* Understanding platform implementation lifecycle, upgrades, release governance, testing, training, organizational change, adoption, and managed\-service operations.
* Proven experience estimating functional scope and identifying cost drivers, risks, dependencies, exclusions, and conditions required for a credible commercial model.


**Qualifications / Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 10\+ years of IT experience with significant ServiceNow consulting, process transformation, solutioning, or presales responsibility.
* 5\+ years of IT service management process design experience and strong exposure to ServiceNow implementations or transformations.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator preferred; one or more relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials strongly preferred.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred; process, architecture, agile, project, change\-management, or business\-analysis certification is advantageous.
* Experience in at least 2\-3 end\-to\-end ServiceNow implementation or major transformation and multiple complex presales pursuits is preferred.


**Soft Skills \& Success Measures**
* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, estimation, decision\-making, and structured problem\-solving capability.
* Quality\-oriented mindset with disciplined production of proposals, architectures, estimates, assumptions, and delivery\-ready artifacts.
* Collaborative team players who can mobilize matrix teams, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

 the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.
   

  

 In a world where you can be anything,
 **Be Infoblox** 
 .
   

  

**Sales Engineer – APJ**
 We have an opportunity for a Sales Engineer \- APJ to join our APJ sales team, reporting to the Senior Director, Sales Engineering and PSS. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor to our customers and partners, providing presales consultation, solution recommendations, and hands\-on support to help identify business challenges and propose effective technical designs and solutions. Collaborating closely with sales, channel and cross\-functional teams to drive revenue growth through high\-touch presales engagements and end\-to\-end technical guidance throughout the entire sales cycle \- from initial discovery to successful deal closure. At Infoblox, you will thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment that values excellence, continuous learning, and career development.
   

  

**Be a Contributor \- What You’ll Do**
* Lead customer value discovery to uncover critical pains with Inside Sales Representatives, desired outcomes, and decision criteria; translate these into measurable hypotheses, KPIs, and executive win\-themes that guide the sales strategy
* Diagnose the customer’s current state and design the desired future state architecture, mapping Infoblox capabilities to quantified business outcomes, risk reduction, and time\-to\-value
* Build executive\-ready ROI/TCO models and qualified business cases that articulate economic impact, cost of inaction, productivity gains, and operational risk mitigation
* Plan and execute PoV engagements with clear success criteria tied to outcomes; baseline current performance, instruction telemetry, and validate value hypotheses with agreed metrics
* Drive a mutual evaluation plan with the account team and champion, aligning to Meddicc/Meddpicc elements (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria/Process, Paper Process, Identified Pain, Champion, Competition)
* Present value narratives to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including C\-level audiences, using clear storytelling that connects architecture choices to financial and operational results
* Differentiate against competitors using value\-based messaging – emphasize measurable outcomes, total economic impact, and unique risk coverage rather than feature parity
* Collaborate on pricing and packaging anchored in delivered value; recommend right\-sized scopes, phased value realization, and reference architectures that accelerate adoption
* Maintain rigorous SFDC hygiene and cadence: document value hypotheses, PoV success criteria, metrics status, economic buyer access, and next best actions throughout the cycle
* Capture validated outcomes and customer references; contribute quantified value stories, templates, ROI calculators, and playbook assets back to the field for reuse
* Leverage AI\-enabled presales workflows across discovery, solutioning, and execution: account research, call note summarization, action\-item extraction, competitive analysis, RFP/RFI drafting, demo/storyline generation, and PoV telemetry analysis tied to value metrics
* Build and maintain reusable AI prompt libraries, templates, and governed knowledge bases to ground outputs in approved content; continuously refine prompts for accuracy and tone
* Enable the field on best practices by sharing playbooks, AI use case, reusable assets, and lessons learned that measurably improve response speed, deal quality, and cycle time


**Be Prepared \- What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in sales engineering or customer\-facing presales technical presales role, preferably within a direct sales environment
* Strong hands\-on expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity technologies
* Demonstrated ability to run value selling motions end to end: discovery, diagnosis, quantification (ROI/TCO), PoV proof, executive business case, and value realization handoff
* Proven experience designing and conducting PoV engagements with outcome\-based success criteria and telemetry\-driven valuation
* Working proficiency with value\-based selling frameworks (eg. MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN) including access to the economic buyer and clear definition of metrics and decision criteria
* Practical experience with AI tools in presales (eg. LLM copilots, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, summarization, translation, and data analysis) to accelerate discovery notes, RFP/RFI responses, demo storylines, competitive battlecards, and PoV telemetry analysis
* Strong operational discipline with SFDC and presales processes; consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets and improving win rates through value\-based approaches and AI\-enabled productivity
* Exceptional communication and executive storytelling skills; able to simplify complex technical concepts and link them to business and financial outcomes
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, start\-up environment, with a proactive and hands\-on approach to problem\-solving and cross\-functional collaboration


**Be Successful \- Your Path**
**First 90 Days:** 
 Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work. Stand up AI\-assisted value discovery guides, an approved prompt library grounded in corporate content, and standard PoV success criteria and dashboards for your key segments.
   

  

**Six Months:** 
 Work autonomously in sales engagement and technical discussion, conducting PoC/PoV independently, and use functional teams to provide additional support. Deliver multiple quantified business cases and PoVs that validate outcomes against baseline metrics; demonstrate measurable improvements in proposal/RFP turnaround and MEDDICC completeness via AI workflows.
   

  

**One Year:** 
 Own your domain, mentor the next newcomer, create and recommend new product features and enhancements, speaking in webinars, marketing events and/or writing technical blogs, and meet or exceed your annual targets. Be recognized for advancing value selling excellence, codifying AI\-enabled presales practices, and capturing customer outcome stories that raise win rates and shorten cycle times.
   

  

**Belong—** 
**Your Community**
 Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here. Click here to learn more about life as a Bloxer.
   

  

**Be Rewarded —** 
**Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**
* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options.
* Learning opportunities, career\-mobility programs, and leadership workshops.
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy.
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations.
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match.


 Ready to
 **Be the Difference?**
*Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis*

title: Business Development Manager - Wallet, Payments and Commerce
description:
**Summary**
 At Apple, we bring together exceptional people to achieve their life’s best work.
   

  

 The people here at Apple don’t just build products— they craft the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry\-leading environmental efforts. Imagine what you could do here. When you join Apple, you help us leave the world better than we found it. A job at Apple is unlike any other you’ve had. You will be challenged. You will be inspired. And you’ll be proud! At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish!
   

  

**Description**
 Apple is looking for a Business Development Manager to help grow and drive payment services as a part of Wallets, Payments \& Commerce.
   

  

 The individual will handle strategic commercial negotiations, partnerships, business development areas, as well as platform integration of Issuers, Acquirers and POS vendors for different Apple Pay product offerings onto the Apple Pay platform in India.
   

  

 This is a role that works cross functionally with Technical Project Manager leads, Apple Pay Engineering, Operations, Privacy, Compliance, Legal and Product Marketing. Externally, it works with Banks, payment regulator, payment networks, acquirers, merchants, integrators, credential managers and software/hardware vendors to help define and deliver a wide variety of exiting Wallet solutions.
   

  

 The individual will manage all aspects of the partner relationship including; early engagement, account and project management, new product and feature introductions, commercial and contractual matters.
   

  

 As a key member of the team, the incumbent will help sell a vision of the Wallet experience and consumer benefits to senior executives, successfully negotiate, close deals and lead the tactical execution to quickly grow our business in a sustainable way. He/she will work closely with our strategic partners to help develop best practice Wallet deployments and ensure that they are our primary development partners for new Wallet features. Internally, the individual will work with Apple product and engineering teams to influence product roadmap and provide feedback received from partners in the field
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Establish, develop and grow strong business relationships with payment providers, banks, international and domestic payment networks etc
* Close commercial and contractual terms terms with partners in India
* Stay apprised of changing payments \& regulatory landscape to make certain that the global strategy is aligned to meet local market needs
* Monitor performance of implemented solutions to establish outstanding service for customers and to find opportunities for partner improvements
* Drive engagement of payment solutions ensuring all product and compliance requirements are met
* Help drive substantive and measurable change in adoption rate, usage, penetration and scale
* Manage multiple parties and projects from initiation to completion while providing consistent updates and communication to business leadership.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 9\-12 years of work experience in a large payments organisation, a bank, an established fintech, network or allied industry
* Deep knowledge of the Indian Payments Industry and regulatory landscape
* Ability to influence, sell concepts and actively drive execution across stakeholders with an innate ability to negotiate business \& technical terms across partners.
* Has a track record of quickly learning \& build credibility based on your knowledge and work as self\-starter in a fast paced environment navigating ambiguity.
* Expertise building business cases around market opportunities and partnerships \- including strategy, market segmentation, competitive analysis, and financial analysis.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to develop strong working relationships inside and outside of Apple.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative opportunities, and drive appropriate performance tracking and analysis.
* Domestic Travel Required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA from a premier B\-school with extensive knowledge of NFC payments, UPI, device tokenisation, payment networks, point of sale, transit, in store merchant solutions, Access \& Identity solutions.
* Expertise and experience in managing large, complex partnerships ideally spanning multiple markets with a proven track record of building strong partnerships centred around ideally in the Financial Services sector.


 At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
   

  

 Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

title: Business Development Manager
description:

 Go\-To\-Market (GTM) planning and technical competency scaling.

* GTM Strategy \& Execution: Jointly plan and execute GTM activities with partners to generate high\-quality pipeline \& ensure deal registrations in favor of Ingram Micro.

* Experience: 5\+ years in Business Development or Channel Management (Cloud/IT).

title: Channel Sales Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Brief Job Description:**
 The Partner Manager is responsible for sales growth through managed reseller and distributor partners to help maximize channel sales opportunities across the region.
   

  

 The main contribution of this role is driving aggressive revenue growth of Mission\-Critical infrastructure solutions from Vertiv’s Rack and Edge based products, including UPS, Rack/Row based Cooling, Power Distribution and IT Management portfolios.
   

  

**Mission\-critical Infrastructure Solutions Include**
* Hardware – 1\-phase and 3\-phase uninterruptible power supplies, racks, power distribution, thermal management (air and liquid cooling) and remote IT management.
* Software – power \& thermal management control, remote access \& control of IT assets, user based access \& visualization management, protocol interface \& standards for IT / facilities management / DCIM / BMS systems.
* Services – extended warranty, commissioning and maintenance packages, as well as mechanical / electrical installation, project management, integration, assembly and ancillary services specific to critical infrastructure environments.


**Customer Focus**
* Account focus will be on a diversified IT reseller \& distribution segment, with focus on projects requiring infrastructure to support white space IT hardware and High Performance Computing applications, housing AI compute chipsets and servers.
* End users and technology service providers, ranging from SME space to global Blue Chip companies and government entities covering a full breadth of market verticals.
* Channel Partners, ranging from server OEMs to large IT resellers, working in tandem with our Electrical Distributionpartner network.


**Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each: \-**
**(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)**
* Create and manage agreed partner business (growth) plans. Setting targets for Partner Incentive Agreements and working to achieve / exceed agreed sales targets and KPI commitments.
* Identify, recruit, onboard and progress partners through the Vertiv Partner Program.
* On site cadence to develop the technical competency of each partner and support sales enablement, whilst utilizing resources including Application Engineering, Marketing and Sales Support.
* Along with other joint resources, roll out promotional activity, product launches and plan partner events, such as technology workshops and seminars.
* Monthly and Quarterly business reviews with stakeholders.
* Perform site surveys to scope and qualify customer technical and commercial requirements.
* Selecting product mixes, developing solutions and managing quotations.
* Facilitating bid management, through Vertiv’s Quote to Order process: Provide effective qualification of opportunities, use of Vertiv’s configuration / quote tools, and work to manage customer expectations through Vertiv’s Application Engineering team to provide technically and commercially comprehensive bids.
* Extensive and professional use of CRM tools. Supporting Vertiv’s management standards ensuring high quality, accurate input to pipeline management and forecasting.
* Manage all additional account management functions such as operations, stock control and contact management.
* Support demonstrations, planning and accompanying partners / end users both domestically and internationally.
* Channel conflict management.
* Deal registration and Special Price Request (SPR) management.
* Lead and coordinate marketing plans, promotions and product launches, along with channel field marketing functions.
* Champion Vertiv tools and programs such as the Vertiv Partner Program, Partner Portal and Vertiv Solution Designer.
* Identify, develop and maintain relationships with Vertiv funded heads in the reseller network.


**Qualifications: \-**
**Required/ Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in an applicable technology or business field, with demonstrated business aptitude.
* Excellent people management and relationship building skills.
* Excellent presentation and verbal / written communication skills, delivered in person and via virtual settings.
* Exceptionally strong channel development and management experience of at least 5\+ years in similar or related positions with strong understanding of regional resellers and partners in the region.
* Outstanding, demonstratable track record in achieving sales targets.
* International English at advanced level.
* Significant experience managing sales, or multiple component products / programs.
* Experience in use of PowerBI reports to impart customer insight and facilitate internal reporting requirements.
* Familiarity with sales channels including IT Distribution, Electrical Distribution, Value Added Resellers, System Integrators, and Electrical \& Mechanical Contractors is essential.
* Familiarity with technology verticals including IT cloud services, communication / telecom, collocation and enterprise is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with server OEM \& ODM market leaders, their technologies, capabilities, go\-to\-market routes, and strategies is highly preferred.


**Additional / Preferred Qualifications**
* Demonstrating Ethics and Integrity: Increase Vertiv’s market share and achieve / exceed budget figures in line with company ethics and policy. You follow through with promises. You use ethical considerations to guide decision and actions, conforming with regulatory compliance and ITC.
* Building and Maintaining Relationships: You negotiate adeptly with individuals and groups. You are effective at managing conflict and confrontations skillfully. You know how to build and maintain working relationships with co\-employees and external parties.
* You are a driven self\-starter with a sense of urgency: an ability to plan, organize and manage time effectively, whilst developing / executing strategic business plans. You are analytical and enjoy problem solving.
* Contribute to teamwork and knowledge sharing inside the team and organization: maintain and update reporting systems, run scheduled and ad\-hoc analysis, lead and participate in team meetings and share your experiences, share new knowledge you gather about the market, competitors and challenges you perceive we face.
* Focus on self\-growth and development: keep an open mind and learn from some of the best experts in the industry, participate in Vertiv meetings and events to acquire knowledge of where the market is going, keep up to date with technical developments, participate in company trainings and apply the knowledge in your day\-to\-day work.
* Be innovative: bring your own ideas of improvements inside the team, look at each process and task with the goal of constantly improving it to bring more value to the customer, to you, the team, and the organization.


**Physical \& Environmental Requirements: \- (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)**
* None


**Time Travel Needed**
* 70% travel expected on average, with prolonged peaks on occasion.


**About Us**
**The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles \& Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.**
**OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:** 
 Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.
   

  

**OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**
* High\-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength


**VERTIV BEHAVIORS**
* Own it
* Act with urgency
* Foster a customer\-first mindset
* Think big and execute
* Lead by example
* Drive continuous improvement
* Learn and seek out development
* Promote transparent \& open communication


**About Vertiv**
 Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

title: Sales Operations Associate
description:
**About Qubix Technologies** 




 Qubix Technologies is a leading provider of Audio Visual (AV), Information Technology (IT), Information Communication Technology (ICT), and Lighting solutions with a legacy dating back to 1984\. We design, build, and support immersive technology ecosystems for living, working, education, hospitality, large venues, and experience spaces across India and the Asia\-Pacific region. Our capabilities span multi\-discipline technology design consulting, system integration, managed services, project execution, and ongoing support — all aimed at delivering seamless, future\-ready audiovisual experiences.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Sales Operations Associate to work closely with our Business Development and Project teams. The role will involve supporting the Business Development team with pricing and commercial requirements, coordinating internally to ensure timely information flow, and working with the Project team on various coordination activities.
 



 This role is ideal for someone with a strong analytical mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work across multiple teams in a fast\-paced project environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work closely with the Business Development team to support pricing, quotations, and commercial requirements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect product, technical, costing, and project\-related inputs required for proposals.
* Assist in preparing pricing sheets, quotations, BOQs, and other commercial documents.
* Maintain pricing data, quotation records, trackers, and other sales\-related documentation.
* Support the Business Development team with proposal revisions, pricing updates, and customer requirements.
* Coordinate with Project teams for project\-related information, updates, documentation, and other operational requirements.
* Ensure timely follow\-up and closure of pending inputs across teams.
* Maintain clear communication between Business Development, Projects, Procurement, Design, and other internal teams.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably from a reputed engineering institution.
* Strong academic background with excellent numerical and analytical ability.
* 0–2 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, Pre\-Sales, Commercial Operations, or a related role. Freshers with strong academic profiles may also be considered.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel and working with numbers/data.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Ability to work with different teams and follow up effectively to meet deadlines.
* Strong willingness to learn and understand technical and commercial aspects of projects.



  





**Life at Qubix** 




 Qubix Technologies is led by Rhythm Arora (CEO \& CTO) (linkedin.com/in/rhythmarora) and Ritika Arora (COO) (linkedin.com/in/ritika\-arora\-a0468132\). The company is driven by a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning, where strong teamwork and clear communication are key to delivering successful projects.
 



 At Qubix, you’ll work on diverse and meaningful technology projects, gain hands\-on exposure to real\-world AV systems, and grow alongside experienced professionals in a supportive environment. We offer competitive compensation, opportunities for skill development, and a workplace where your contributions are valued.

title: Customer Success Business Partner - Anaplan

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 


  
 **Anaplan is looking for a highly driven and dynamic Customer Success Business Partner (CSBP)** 
  
 **to join the Customer Success team in Bangalore, India.** 
*The CSBP will be primarily responsible for the successful deployment, enablement, adoption, and ongoing health of our customers and their Anaplan solutions* 
 . Acting as a trusted advisor for customers, the CSBP will work alongside our Partners and Professional Services team to drive customer outcomes and ensure Anaplan delivers high ROI. As the primary customer contact for any platform challenges, the CSBP will handle critical issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
   

**This is what you will do at Anaplan** 
* **Manage a portfolio of customers with the primary goal of driving adoption, expansion, retention and maximizing ROI**
* Act as a 
 *trusted adviser* 
  to our customers throughout the value delivery life cycle, helping them achieve business objectives and transform their processes using Anaplan.
* Work with customers to understand pain points and guide them on how Anaplan solutions can address their specific needs
* Build and present Success Scorecards during QSRs (Quarterly Success Reviews) with Executive sponsor and senior stakeholders
* Grow the Anaplan footprint by conducting workshops to build customer mindshare on new use cases and solutions resulting in upsell or cross sell opportunities.
* Own key relationships with customers and proactively maintain high levels of engagement with a focus on increasing customer satisfaction and loyalty
* Act as the voice of customer to our internal stakeholders, including flagging and managing risks, advocating for their needs and ensuring alignment on objectives.
* Identify renewal risk and work with Renewal managers and Account executives on a mitigation plan
* Advise customer on developing a Center of Excellence or similar governance structure to enable customers self\-sufficiency on Anaplan
* Develop customer success assets and playbooks and help drive customer references and case studies


**Your Qualifications** 
* 8\+ years of work experience in customer success, presales or management consulting
* **Prior experience with Enterprise performance management (EPM), Enterprise Planning \& Analytics is a must**
* **Highly preferable to have experience in Anaplan; If not any of the relevant EPM / Planning tools such as Oracle EPM, SAP IBP / SAC, OneStream, Kinaxis, O9 etc.**
* Bachelor’s degree, with focus on business, finance, marketing, operations, supply chain. CA/MBA a plus.
* Excellent communication skills with an ability to interact with C suite and other stakeholders in a consultative setting
* Familiarity with value selling and ability to do discovery with customers
* Experience understanding, translating, and optimizing client processes is a plus
* Subject matter expertise in planning and modelling with specialisation in either Supply Chain, Finance or Sales is a plus



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. **The Practice\- A Brief Sketch:**


Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept\-to\-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.


You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.

**Digital Thread**

**Digital Thread** focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.

* Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.

**Connected Twins**

**Connected Twins** build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.

* Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.

**Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role**

title: AI Native Product Marketer
description:
**AI\-Native GTM / Product Marketing Operator**




  





**About Facilio**




  





 Facilio is the agentic platform transforming how large buildings manage their physical operations. We are the AI\-native operating layer for buildings on a mission to make buildings operationally efficient.
 



  





 Today, 150\+ enterprise customers across hospitals, universities, retail chains, landmark venues and large real estate portfolios use Facilio to drive cost efficiency, service quality, compliance and operational performance.
 



  





 With a growing presence across the US, UK, Middle East and Australia, Facilio is backed by leading global investors including Accel, Tiger Global, Dragoneer and Brookfield Growth.
 



 We aim to bring agentic AI to the physical world — moving enterprise operations from systems that record and manage work to intelligent systems that understand, decide and act.
 



  





**Build the next generation of GTM at Facilio.**




  





 At Facilio, we're building an AI\-first enterprise SaaS platform for teams that run physical operations. As AI changes how products are built, sold and marketed, we’re rethinking what a modern marketing team should look like too.
 



  





 We're looking for someone early in their career who understands
 **Product Marketing** 
 but thinks beyond traditional marketing execution.
 



  





 The old model:
 



**Marketer → thinks of an idea → uses AI → creates the asset → distributes it** 




  





 The model we're building:
 



**Understand the GTM objective → identify what needs to happen → orchestrate AI agents \+ existing systems → review \& steer the output → learn from the result → improve the system.** 




  





 This role builds and owns that shift for the PMM function. Think of it as a GTM engineer's systems fluency, aimed specifically at product marketing judgment.
 



  





**What you'll do**




  




* Understand our
 **products, customers, ICPs and GTM motions** 
 deeply enough to identify what marketing should actually do — not just execute briefs.
* Take existing PMM workflows (case studies, social posts, enablement docs, battlecards, email sequences) and rebuild them as connected mini\-agents — triggered by real events in our systems, not by someone opening a chat and typing a brief
* Define what each agent should draft autonomously vs. where it must stop and hand off to a human — this is a marketing judgment call, not just a technical guardrail
* Use AI not just to create content, but to
 **identify opportunities, generate ideas, make recommendations and trigger the next action** 
 .
* Review and QA agent output against real marketing standards: does this case study lead with the right proof point for this funnel stage? Does this battlecard actually counter the objection or just restate our positioning?
* Build systems that can take something like a product update or customer signal and determine what messaging, content, enablement or GTM action should follow.
* Bring strong judgement to the output:
 **what is worth saying, who should hear it, when, through which channel, and why.**
* Continuously measure what works and improve the underlying workflow, agent or system — not just the individual output.



  





**What you'll need to bring**




  





**1\. PMM fundamentals** 




 You understand positioning, messaging, ICPs, personas, buyer journeys, content, launches, customer stories and sales enablement — and know what good looks like.
 



**2\. GTM judgement** 




 You can look at a product, customer or market signal and figure out
 **what should happen next** 
 . You understand that the same story, proof point or message won't work equally well across every persona or funnel stage.
 



**3\. AI / agent orchestration** 




 You don't just ask Claude or ChatGPT to write faster. You instinctively ask:
 **Can this workflow be automated? Can an agent do this? What context should it have? What systems should it connect to? Where should a human stay in the loop?** 




**4\. Systems thinking** 




 You enjoy breaking messy, repetitive workflows into inputs, decisions, actions and feedback loops — and turning them into scalable systems.
 



**5\. Execution ownership** 




 You're still a doer. You can take an idea from
 **problem → system → output → measurement** 
 , rather than waiting for someone else to define the work for you.
 



  





**Who this is for**




  




* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in Product Marketing, B2B SaaS marketing, GTM, growth or a closely related role.
* Someone who is

title: Electrical Estimation Engineer
description:
Role \- Electrical Estimation Engineer
   

  

 About the Role We are seeking an experienced Electrical Estimation Engineer to support the preparation of accurate and competitive cost estimates for modular construction projects. The role involves electrical quantity take\-offs, technical calculations, rate analysis, vendor coordination, and cross\-functional collaboration to ensure commercially viable and technically compliant bids.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Electrical Estimation \& Quantity Take\-Off
   

  

 Prepare detailed electrical quantity take\-offs (QTO) from project drawings, Design Approval Reports (DAR), and other design documents.
   

  

 Perform electrical load calculations, lighting calculations, wiring calculations, and other technical calculations required for estimation.
   

  

 Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, earthing, conduits, cable trays, cables, panels, switches, sockets, and associated accessories.
   

  

 Use Kreo software and other estimation tools for quantity extraction and cost estimation.
   

  

 Cost Estimation
   

  

 Prepare detailed electrical cost estimates based on project specifications, drawings, and client requirements.
   

  

 Support project\-level P\&L analysis by providing accurate cost estimates and detailed cost breakdowns.
   

  

 Evaluate project scope, identify cost\-saving opportunities, and develop commercially competitive estimates while ensuring project profitability.
   

  

 Support the preparation of tender submissions, commercial proposals, assumptions, exclusions, and cost summaries.
   

  

 Vendor \& Procurement Coordination
   

  

 Raise RFQs and RFIs for technical clarifications and material pricing. Coordinate with the Procurement team to obtain vendor quotations and pricing. Liaise directly with vendors and suppliers to obtain competitive quotations, clarify technical
   

  

 specifications, and evaluate commercial offers. Compare quotations and recommend the most suitable materials and vendors for estimation
   

  

 purposes.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

 Coordinate with Civil Site teams to ensure electrical estimates align with construction methodology and project execution requirements.
   

  

 Collaborate with design and engineering teams to understand design revisions and assess their impact on project costs.
   

  

 Resolve technical and commercial queries during the estimation and tendering stages.
   

  

 Estimation Database Management
   

  

 Maintain and regularly update the electrical estimation database with current material and vendor rates.
   

  

 Update new line items, cost data, and historical pricing to improve estimation accuracy. Ensure estimation templates and cost databases remain current and aligned with market
   

  

 conditions.
   

  

 Qualifications Bachelor's Degree Electrical Engineering. 2\-6 years of experience in electrical estimation for building construction, MEP, EPC, PEB, modular, or prefab construction projects.
   

  

 Required Skills Electrical Quantity Take\-Off (QTO) BOQ preparation Electrical load, lighting, and wiring calculations Electrical cost estimation and rate analysis RFQ/RFI preparation and vendor coordination Procurement support and quotation evaluation Kreo software (preferred) Microsoft Excel (Advanced) Strong analytical, commercial, and problem\-solving skills Excellent coordination and stakeholder management abilities Ability to work under tight tender deadlines while maintaining accuracy
   

  

 Preferred Experience Experience in modular, prefab, industrial, commercial, institutional, or residential construction
   

  

 projects. Knowledge of electrical estimation standards, industry best practices, and construction
   

  

 methodologies. Experience working closely with engineering, procurement, project execution, and site teams. Familiarity with multidisciplinary coordination in fast\-paced construction projects.
   

  

* Role \- Electrical Estimation Engineer
+ About the Role
+ Key Responsibilities
- Electrical Estimation \& Quantity Take\-Off
- Cost Estimation
- Vendor \& Procurement Coordination
- Cross\-Functional Coordination
- Estimation Database Management

 Candidates with hands\-on experience in C\&I Open Access / PPA advisory / power trading / renewable project development / BESS / energy consulting will be preferred.

 This is a high\-ownership role working closely with the Founder. description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Détient globalement l'activité de contrôle de projet et définit des spécifications fonctionnelles cohérentes et des processus globaux communs pour la mise en œuvre des projets. Activités menées pour mieux comprendre ou répondre à terme aux attentes du client Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux.
   

  

 Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.).
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Apporte une expertise technique et développe des solutions techniques (configuration, estimation des performances, économie, etc.) dans le cadre du processus pré\-ITO (demande d'achat) tout en assurant l'interface avec l'équipe commerciale. Possède une compréhension approfondie des marchés pertinents et de la valeur économique des clients, ce qui contribue à des stratégies d'adjudication gagnantes. Pour inclure « ITO » : Analyse technique du besoin client : définition et optimisation des produits ; du cadre (description) ; du programme ; du schéma industriel ; des coûts, compte tenu des contrats et politiques internes ainsi que des procédures. Calcul des performances et de l'efficacité des installations, des systèmes et des équipements. Documentation des spécifications techniques et des éléments de coût pour les phases ultérieures d'exécution du contrat. Cela inclut également la partie OTR (« de la commande jusqu'au versement ») où les ingénieurs s'emploient à personnaliser les produits et à les implémenter en fonction des besoins spécifiques des clients.
* Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Transmet les attentes en matière de performances et peut gérer des problèmes sensibles.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

* Expected to participate in pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302348
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 – Experience: 11\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 – SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 – Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 – Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 – Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 – Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 – AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 – Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 – Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 – Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 – Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 – Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
