* Experience in operating environments in retail, hospitality, restaurant or other industries to understand and identify labor challenges that Legion solves
* Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g. Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)


**ABOUT LEGION**
 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
   

  

 Our award\-winning AI\-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee\-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor\-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
   

  

 Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
   

  

 If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
   

  

**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
 There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig\-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.
   

  

 Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
   

  

 For more information, visit https://legion.co
   

  

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**
 At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a hybrid employer in Bucharest, Romania, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry\-specific survey data.
   

  

 We strive to make competitive offers, allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
   

  

 Benefits include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch at Legion


**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
 Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti\-discrimination laws.
   

  

**DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION**

*Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.*
**How We Determine What We Pay**
*As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry\-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. title: Manager, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Product Management
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard Merchant Cloud and Acceptance represent core strategic priorities for the Asia Pacific region. Our mission is to empower acquirers, merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), and payment facilitators by delivering seamless, best\-in\-class experiences across both digital and in\-person commerce. We aim to position Mastercard Merchant Cloud as the leading platform for acceptance.
   

  

 As an integral part of Mastercard’s regional growth strategy, this role will support sales initiatives across Asia Pacific. Key responsibilities include conducting market research and benchmarking, contributing to go\-to\-market planning, supporting solution commercialization, and engaging in client\-related activities. The individual will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams—including Product, Operations, Delivery, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and other internal partners—to drive execution and deliver strategic outcomes.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Support the identification and assessment of potential opportunities for Merchant Cloud across APAC through data analysis and insight generation.
* Conduct customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify indicators of expansion, cross\-sell, or product adoption potential
* Analyze transaction characteristics and market data to support identification of relevant customer segments
* Develop and maintain analytical frameworks and reporting models including opportunity sizing approaches, funnel and conversion analytics, and pipeline coverage metrics for internal monitoring and decision\-support purposes.
* Build and maintain integrated analytical datasets and internal insight packs by combining data sources for internal analysis.
* Integrate diverse data inputs to generate analytical insights and structured outputs that may indicate high\-potential customers segments and support internal prioritization discussions.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to provide analytical support and validate data assumptions; does not involve participation in commercial decision\-making or execution.
* Provide data backed insights, benchmarking and analytical inputs to support value propositions by relevant team, ensuring Mastercard’s differentiation in the Merchant Cloud and Acceptance space.
* Analyse client trends and develop reports and dashboards to provide visibility and support internal decision\-making and performance monitoring.
* Partner with internal technology and core payments teams to support pipeline generation through various data sources, reporting and opportunity sizing models.


**All About You**
* Experience in payments, fintech, or e\-commerce in APAC, ideally with exposure to acquirers, PSPs, merchants, or acceptance ecosystems.
* Strong data analysis capability, including advanced Excel (mandatory) and Tableau or Power BI (preferred).
* Proven ability to work with multi\-source datasets and synthesize them into clear, practical outputs.
* Experience supporting multi\-market proposition launches, including pipeline dashboards, account\-level analysis, and business insights that inform commercial decision\-making.
* Ability to translate data into simple, compelling narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, self\-starter mentality, and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and the ability to create structure within a matrix organization.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P\&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power\-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 \- Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 \- Personal Insurance, AINS 23 \- Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 \- General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.

* We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and share your updated resume at praveen@nam\-info.com* 




  





**Role: Delivery Manager** 




**Work Location: Pune (Hinjewadi Phase 2\) — Local Pune Candidates Only** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid** 




**Client: Inferyx (Full\-time)** 




**Total Experience: 9\+ Yrs** 




  





**Interview Mode: 2 Virtual Rounds \+ 1 Face\-to\-Face Round** 




  





**About Inferyx** 




 Inferyx is a next\-generation Data Orchestration Platform enabling enterprises to build scalable Data Lakes using Medallion Architecture (
 *Bronze → Silver → Gold* 
 ) across various domains including BFSI, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Inferyx accelerates data engineering delivery through a low\-code orchestration engine, reducing data pipeline build times by up to 60% compared to traditional approaches.
 



  





 We are aggressively expanding our India footprint and looking for a seasoned Delivery Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of our client delivery programs.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 As the senior delivery owner for Inferyx’s enterprise client accounts, you will inherit an active, operational engagement and serve as the single point of accountability for delivery health, stakeholder management, and client satisfaction. You will operate with high autonomy, manage technical complexity, and ensure delivery excellence—enabling our executive leadership to focus on nationwide growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Inferyx data platform, including medallion architecture implementation, sprint governance, and Go\-Live milestones.
* Lead daily/fortnightly scrum calls, sprint reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain delivery health by tracking sprint velocity, proactively managing risks, resolving blockers, and escalating only critical exceptions to executive leadership.
* Ensure all contractual SLAs, delivery milestones, and quality standards are consistently met or exceeded.
* Maintain and update the Client Delivery Runbook, RACI matrix, and issue logs, presenting monthly summaries to Inferyx leadership.



  





**2\. Stakeholder \& Relationship Management** 



* Act as the primary senior relationship manager between Inferyx and client teams (Project Managers, Architects, and Business Owners).
* Conduct fortnightly on\-site visits to client locations to participate in steering committees, executive reviews, and architecture sessions.
* Manage delivery escalations professionally, converting challenges into opportunities to strengthen client trust.
* Identify and cultivate internal client champions to advocate for Inferyx platform adoption and expansion across other business units.



  





**3\. Program Governance \& Reporting** 



* Drive structured program governance using weekly status reports, risk registers, RAID logs, and monthly steering dashboards.
* Maintain a transparent, metric\-driven single source of truth for delivery status that is executive\-ready at all times.
* Prepare and present monthly delivery review decks to Inferyx’s Head of Technology, COO, and CEO.
* Track key delivery KPIs, including sprint velocity, defect rates, deployment frequency, and Client NPS.
* Manage Production incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement sustainable action plans to minimize incident recurrence.
* Manage Change Requests (CRs) professionally—scoping, pricing, and negotiating without damaging client relationships.



  





**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Platform Adoption** 



* Partner with Inferyx engineering and pre\-sales teams to ensure the platform is deployed to its maximum capability at the client site.
* Identify expansion opportunities within client accounts for new business units, additional data domains, or advanced medallion layers.
* Participate in architecture reviews, data model walkthroughs, and pipeline design sessions, applying technical depth to ask the right questions.
* Translate client feedback into actionable insights for internal product teams to shape the Inferyx product roadmap.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Onboarding** 



* Successfully onboard into the engagement via a structured 4–6 week handover from the outgoing delivery lead.
* Mentor and manage junior delivery resources or Business Analysts assigned to the account.
* Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for repeatable delivery processes.
* Contribute to Inferyx's overall delivery methodology through best practices, reusable frameworks, and lessons learned.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




**Essential (Must Have)** 



* Experience: 9 to 13 years of total experience in technology delivery, program management, or client\-facing delivery roles within enterprise IT.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Data platforms—Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or Data Orchestration tools.
* Architecture: Practical understanding of Medallion Architecture, Lakehouse concepts, or multi\-layer data processing (
 *Bronze / Silver / Gold* 
 ).
* Agile Governance: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and velocity tracking).
* Location \& Mobility: Must be currently residing in Pune (or local to Pune) and willing to visit client sites in Hinjewadi Phase 2 on a fortnightly basis.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; proven capability to navigate complex corporate structures and manage stakeholders up to the C\-suite level.



  





**Preferred (Good to Have)** 



* Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, GCP BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.
* Experience working in a product startup or scale\-up environment, demonstrating adaptability in fast\-paced setups.
* Understanding of BFSI data domains (e.g., reconciliation, settlement, regulatory reporting) or Telecom data domains.
* Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
* Track record of building delivery playbooks, SOPs, and scaling delivery processes from scratch.

title: Inside Sales Engineer

**Inside Sales Engineer** 




  





**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra, India
 



**Experience:** 
 2\-4 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Testo India Pvt. Ltd. is the hiring organization for this Inside Sales Engineer role in Pune. The position supports customers through responsive enquiry handling, technically informed quotation preparation, lead qualification, and structured commercial follow\-up. The company context provided for this opportunity centers on customer engagement and disciplined sales coordination. This role will work closely with prospective and existing customers to understand requirements, provide accurate responses, and maintain momentum from initial enquiry through payment completion. The successful candidate will contribute to a dependable customer experience by keeping information current, coordinating internally, and ensuring every commercial interaction is followed through. This is an opportunity to join an organization where inside sales execution directly supports revenue conversion, customer satisfaction, and the quality of the sales pipeline.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As an Inside Sales Engineer, you will manage the commercial journey from incoming enquiry to quotation, customer follow\-up, and payment coordination. You will qualify leads, handle customer conversations over the phone, prepare accurate quotations, and maintain dependable sales records. The role combines technical understanding with structured sales execution, requiring timely responses, strong customer handling, and close coordination with internal stakeholders. Your ownership of enquiries and follow\-ups will improve response quality, support conversion, accelerate collections, and give the sales team reliable visibility through accurate reports and system updates.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Prepare accurate quotations by translating customer requirements into clear commercial responses, enabling faster decision\-making and reducing avoidable revisions during the sales process.
* Qualify incoming leads and enquiries through structured conversations, identifying need, urgency, fit, and next steps so the sales pipeline remains focused on viable opportunities.
* Handle customer enquiries over the phone with clarity and responsiveness, resolving routine questions or routing technical and commercial issues to the right internal stakeholder.
* Own customer follow\-up across open enquiries and quotations, maintaining timely communication that improves engagement, supports conversion, and prevents opportunities from becoming inactive.
* Coordinate payment follow\-up with customers and internal teams, tracking commitments and outstanding amounts to support healthier collections and predictable order closure.
* Update reports and sales records consistently, providing accurate visibility into enquiry status, quotation progress, follow\-ups, and payment actions for effective team decisions.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong telephone communication and customer\-handling skills, with the ability to understand requirements, explain solutions clearly, and maintain professional interactions across varied customer situations.
* Experience preparing quotations and managing sales enquiries, including gathering information, validating details, coordinating internally, and issuing accurate responses within agreed timelines.
* Lead qualification and follow\-up discipline, with the ability to prioritize opportunities, record next steps, and move prospects through the pipeline using structured communication.
* Working proficiency with CRM, ERP, quotation, or sales\-reporting systems, ensuring customer information, enquiry stages, actions, and outcomes remain accurate and current.
* Commercial ownership and attention to detail, particularly for payment follow\-up, pricing information, documentation accuracy, reporting discipline, and timely escalation of exceptions.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Engineering education or exposure to technical products, enabling more confident conversations with customers and better translation of requirements into relevant quotations.
* Experience in B2B inside sales, industrial products, instrumentation, measurement solutions, or a related technical commercial environment.
* Familiarity with structured sales processes, order coordination, receivables follow\-up, or customer relationship management systems.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 2–4 years of experience in inside sales, sales coordination, customer handling, enquiry management, quotation preparation, or a closely related technical commercial role.
* A Bachelor of Engineering degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related field, combined with the ability to understand and communicate customer requirements.
* Confident phone communication, organized follow\-up habits, attention to detail, and the discipline to maintain accurate reports and customer records.
* A customer\-focused and commercially responsible mindset, with the persistence to coordinate quotations, payment actions, and internal dependencies through closure.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 This role gives you direct ownership of the activities that connect customer interest with business outcomes. You will not only respond to enquiries; you will shape how efficiently opportunities are qualified, quoted, followed up, and converted. Your customer conversations will influence trust and responsiveness, while your quotation accuracy will reduce friction in the buying process. By maintaining disciplined payment follow\-up, you will also contribute to healthier collections and stronger commercial closure. Accurate reporting will give the sales team a reliable view of pipeline movement and priorities. The position is well suited to someone who enjoys combining technical understanding, customer interaction, and organized execution. Working from the Pune location, you will collaborate with internal stakeholders and customers in an onsite environment where timely communication and ownership matter. Joining Testo India Pvt. Ltd. offers the opportunity to build deeper expertise in technical inside sales while making a measurable contribution to customer experience, sales conversion, and operational visibility.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* An onsite Inside Sales Engineer opportunity in Pune with ownership across enquiries, quotations, customer communication, payment follow\-up, and sales reporting.
* A role that combines engineering understanding with practical commercial responsibilities, supporting growth in technical inside sales and customer relationship management.
* The opportunity to contribute visibly to enquiry conversion, customer satisfaction, collections discipline, and sales\-team decision\-making through accurate execution.

Team members collaborate closely with clients to design practical, high\-impact automation solutions that align with real\-world industrial needs.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, hybrid Sales and Marketing Intern role based in Pune, with some flexibility for work from home. The intern will support daily sales activities by identifying prospective clients, assisting with outreach, and following up on inquiries under the guidance of senior team members. They will help prepare marketing materials, update digital content, and assist in executing campaigns to promote automation solutions and services. The role includes coordinating with internal teams, maintaining basic customer records, and providing support during client meetings, demos, and training sessions. The intern will also contribute to market research, competitor analysis, and reporting on sales and marketing performance.

* Enrollment in or completion of a degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

**Job Description**
**Senior Manager – Renewables**
 Accenture Utilities
   

  

**Location**
 New Delhi, India
   

  

**Experience**
 15\+ Years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a seasoned Senior Manager to lead high\-impact advisory engagements across India's clean energy ecosystem. The ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise in renewable energy, a strong consulting track record, and the credibility to engage CXOs, developers, investors, and policymakers across the full energy transition value chain.
   

  

**DEEP DOMAIN EXPERTISE**
**Stakeholder \& Sector Exposure**
 Demonstrated experience engaging CXOs, project developers, institutional investors, and policymakers across:
   

  

* Solar PV – utility\-scale, C\&I, and rooftop segments
* Wind – onshore dynamics and offshore emerging trends
* Hybrid Projects – solar \+ wind \+ BESS integrated configurations
* Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) – technology, economics, and market positioning
* Green Hydrogen and derivatives – ammonia, methanol, and offtake structures
* Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) – trading, compliance, and value chain
* Carbon Markets – voluntary and compliance carbon credits, project origination
* Open Access \& Captive Power – regulatory navigation and commercial models
* Corporate PPAs \& Green Power Procurement – structuring and negotiation
* Energy Transition Strategies – decarbonization pathways, net\-zero planning


**Regulatory \& Policy Landscape**
 Exposure to India's evolving energy regulatory framework is preferred, including:
   

  

* SECI auction processes and bid structures
* ISTS policies, open access frameworks, and waiver mechanisms
* Renewable Purchase Obligations (RPO) – state\-wise compliance tracking
* Electricity Act amendments and their commercial implications


**Strategy \& Consulting Capabilities**
 Proven ability to lead and deliver across the full consulting lifecycle:
   

  

* Market assessment and opportunity sizing
* Growth strategy and market entry advisory
* Commercial due diligence for transactions and investments
* Business case development and financial modelling
* Investment attractiveness studies and sector benchmarking
* Decarbonization roadmap design
* Net\-zero strategy and science\-based target alignment
* Operating model design for energy businesses
* Policy impact assessments and regulatory advisory


**COMMERCIAL \& FINANCIAL ACUMEN**
* Working knowledge of project finance fundamentals in the renewable energy context
* Understanding of RE project economics – tariff structures, IRR/NPV drivers, debt structuring
* Ability to critically review financial models and investment cases


**GOOD TO HAVE**
**ESG \& Climate Frameworks**
* Familiarity with net\-zero frameworks, GHG Protocol accounting, and ESG reporting standards
* Experience with climate risk assessment methodologies


**Energy Data \& Digital Tools**
* Hands\-on exposure to energy data analytics, smart grid systems, and ADMS platforms
* Working knowledge of AI\-based energy forecasting and IoT applications in renewables
* Proficiency with power system modelling tools such as PLEXOS or equivalent
* Experience with weather data analysis, demand forecasting, and SLDC integration protocols


**Power Market Instruments**
* Understanding of power market mechanisms – DAM, TAM, G\-DAM, derivatives, and banking
* Hands\-on familiarity with RE PPAs, SECI tenders, RTC, FDRE, and CFD contractual clauses


*Confidential – For Internal Recruitment Use Only*

title: GeM executive

**Job Description – GeM Executive** 




**Company:** 
 Savi Vision Private Limited
 



**Industry:** 
 Audio\-Visual (AV) System Integration
 



**Job Title:** 
 GeM Executive / GeM Portal Executive
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time

 2–4 years of relevant GeM experience
 



**About Savi Vision Private Limited** 




**Savi Vision Private Limited**

 **Audio\-Visual (AV) System Integrator** 
 providing end\-to\-end AV solutions to customers, institutions and government organizations.
 



 As a
 **System Integrator** 
 , Savi Vision works with multiple AV brands and technology partners to design, supply, install and support customized AV solutions. The GeM Executive will therefore be responsible for managing GeM opportunities involving
 **multi\-brand products, complete AV solutions, system integration, installation, commissioning and related services** 
 .
 



**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a
 **detail\-oriented and experienced GeM Executive** 
 to manage the company's day\-to\-day activities on the
 **Government e\-Marketplace (GeM)** 
 .
 



 The candidate will be responsible for identifying relevant GeM opportunities, understanding bid requirements, coordinating with OEMs/authorized distributors and internal technical teams, preparing commercial and technical submissions, and ensuring timely and compliant bid/order processing.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of
 **GeM portal operations, tender/bid documentation, BOQ, compliance requirements and government procurement processes** 
 , along with good coordination and communication skills.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. GeM Portal Management** 



* Manage and maintain
 **Savi Vision's GeM Seller profile** 
 and related portal activities.
* Maintain and update applicable product/service listings, credentials, certifications and company information.
* Monitor portal notifications, bid enquiries, orders, amendments and other relevant updates.
* Ensure accuracy and timely updation of information submitted on GeM.



**2\. GeM Bid \& Tender Management** 



* Regularly search and identify
 **relevant GeM bids, tenders and procurement opportunities** 
 for AV and system integration projects.
* Study tender documents, eligibility criteria, technical specifications, BOQ, commercial terms and submission requirements.
* Evaluate opportunities from both
 **commercial and technical compliance** 
 perspectives.
* Prepare and submit bids within the prescribed timelines.
* Coordinate with management for bid approval and commercial decisions.
* Track bid status, results, clarifications, amendments and deadlines.



**3\. OEM \& Channel Partner Coordination** 




 Since Savi Vision is a
 **System Integrator** 
 , the candidate will be required to coordinate closely with:
 


* OEMs and authorized distributors for product availability and pricing.
* OEM partners for
 **authorization letters, technical compliance, datasheets, certifications, warranty details and other bid\-related documents** 
 .
* Multiple brands to prepare suitable technical and commercial solutions as per tender requirements.
* Internal technical teams for solution design, BOQ preparation and technical compliance.



**4\. Technical \& Commercial Bid Preparation** 



* Prepare technical compliance sheets against tender specifications.
* Coordinate preparation of
 **BOQ, scope of work, product specifications and solution proposals** 
 .
* Ensure that quoted products and solutions comply with tender requirements.
* Prepare commercial quotations in coordination with the sales, procurement and management teams.
* Identify deviations or clarification points before bid submission.
* Ensure all required declarations, undertakings and supporting documents are complete and properly submitted.



**5\. Order \& Project Coordination** 



* Process and monitor
 **GeM purchase orders/contracts** 
 received by the company.
* Coordinate with sales, procurement, logistics, service and project teams for order execution.
* Monitor delivery schedules and required documentation.
* Coordinate with OEMs/distributors for timely supply of products.
* Support the team in ensuring timely
 **installation, commissioning and handover** 
 wherever applicable.
* Track order completion, acceptance, invoicing and payment\-related documentation.



**6\. Compliance \& Documentation** 



* Ensure that all GeM bids and transactions are handled in accordance with applicable GeM requirements and tender conditions.
* Maintain proper records of:
* Bids submitted
* Technical documents
* Commercial submissions
* OEM authorization documents
* Purchase orders
* Invoices and delivery documents
* Bid results and correspondence
* Maintain a systematic database of completed and ongoing bids.



**7\. Government Client \& Bid Coordination** 



* Coordinate with concerned government departments/buyers regarding GeM\-related queries, clarifications and order\-related matters.
* Follow up on submitted bids, orders, acceptance, delivery and documentation.
* Coordinate internally to ensure timely responses to buyer queries and requests.



**8\. Reporting** 



* Prepare regular
 **GeM bid and tender status reports** 
 for management.
* Maintain reports covering:
* Opportunities identified
* Bids submitted
* Bids under evaluation
* Orders received
* Bid outcomes
* Upcoming deadlines
* Provide management with timely updates on important GeM opportunities.



**Key Requirements** 




**Education:** 




 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.
 



**Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience handling
 **GeM portal operations, government tenders or e\-procurement** 
 , preferably in AV, IT, digital signage, electronics, system integration or a related industry.
 



**Required Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on knowledge of
 **GeM Seller Portal** 
 .
* Good understanding of GeM bids, tenders and bid submission procedures.
* Experience in preparing
 **technical compliance sheets and commercial bids** 
 .
* Ability to understand product specifications, BOQ and tender documents.
* Strong coordination skills with
 **OEMs, distributors, internal technical teams and management** 
 .
* Good knowledge of MS
 **Excel, Word and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.



**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates with experience in
 **AV System Integration, digital signage, professional displays, video conferencing, interactive displays, audio systems, automation or related technology solutions** 
 will be preferred.
 



 Experience in dealing with
 **multiple OEM brands rather than a single manufacturer's product portfolio** 
 will be an added advantage.
 



**Key Performance Areas (KPIs)** 



* Number of relevant GeM opportunities identified.
* Timely and accurate bid submissions.
* Compliance with tender requirements.
* Coordination with OEMs/channel partners for required documentation.
* Order conversion and successful execution.
* Timely response to buyer queries and amendments.
* Accuracy of GeM documentation and records.
* Timely submission of reports to management.



**Ideal Candidate** 




 The ideal candidate should be
 **organized, responsible, commercially aware and highly attentive to detail** 
 . The person should be comfortable working with tender documents, coordinating with multiple OEMs and internal departments, and managing several GeM opportunities simultaneously.
 



 A candidate who understands the difference between
 **OEM supply and system integration** 
 and can build complete multi\-brand AV solutions against government tender requirements would be particularly suitable for this role.

title: Category Manager – Partnerships & Distribution
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: US Proposal Specialist / Proposal Writer
description:
**US PROPOSAL SPECIALIST** 




  





 Acro Service Corporation, Bid and Proposal Team
 



  





**Experience: 3\+** 
 Years
 



**Shift:** 
**Night Shift (7:30 PM \-4:30 AM IST)** 




**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 68 (Onsite)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Acro Service Corporation (Acro) is seeking an experienced Proposal Specialist to join its Bid and Proposal team, supporting Acro's US staffing, MSP, VMS, and workforce solutions business from India. The Proposal Specialist is a hands\-on individual contributor and full member of the proposal team, responsible for managing assigned Complex and Express RFx opportunities from initial review through final submission. This is a fast paced, high ownership role covering the full response lifecycle, from initial solicitation assessment and Go No Go input through response planning, strategy sessions, content development, reviews, and final compliance and submission.
 



 Complex RFx are large, formal solicitations, typically from state and local governments and large commercial buyers, that require a full response plan, strategy sessions, and multiple contributors. Express bids are smaller, quick turn solicitations that one person can typically assess, assemble, and submit within a few days.
 



 The role calls for strong project management, judgment, and follow through: anticipating what is needed next, following up independently with contributors, and moving assigned responses forward without continuous direction, while working within Acro's proposal SOPs and escalating when a leadership decision is required. Solicitations carry strict compliance and submission requirements, and a single missed instruction can disqualify a bid, so close reading and attention to detail are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



1. **Manage assigned Complex and Express RFx responses from beginning to end.** 
 Review the solicitation, build the compliance checklist and response plan, coordinate meetings and inputs, develop the response from approved Acro content tailored to the issuer's requirements, and drive it through final submission.
2. **Contribute to Go No Go and response strategy.** 
 Conduct the initial opportunity review, facilitate assigned strategy discussions, and recommend relevant Acro capabilities, experience, and proof points.
3. **Apply proposal and workforce solutions expertise.** 
 Build working knowledge of Acro's staffing, MSP, VMS, RPO, technical and consulting, and related services; use standard content only where it actually answers the requirement; and escalate pricing, contractual, legal, or significant solution decisions to the appropriate owner.
4. **Project manage assigned responses within the proposal SOP.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, reviews, and approvals; anticipate bottlenecks; and apply the team's checklists, templates, and quality controls consistently.
5. **Manage proposal meetings and SME contributions.** 
 Facilitate kickoff, strategy, working, and review sessions, and obtain complete input from leadership, business development, operations, finance, legal, and subject matter experts, following up persistently until it is received.
6. **Develop, tailor, and integrate proposal content.** 
 Draft and edit clear, accurate, persuasive content aligned to the evaluation criteria, and integrate input from multiple contributors into one consistent response.
7. **Ensure compliance, quality, and submission readiness.** 
 Track every mandatory requirement, form, and submission instruction, and conduct thorough final compliance and quality reviews before submission.
8. **Track and interpret solicitation changes.** 
 Monitor amendments, addenda, and Q\&A, summarize their impact, and update the response accordingly.
9. **Maintain proposal content, references, and document control.** 
 Keep proposal content, templates, references, and past performance current, and maintain SharePoint organization, version control, and RFx Tracker status for assigned bids.
10. **Support continuous improvement and team priorities.** 
 Recommend practical process and content improvements, contribute to business development collateral, and collaborate on other team responses during peak periods.



  





**Requirements** 








* Demonstrated experience managing bids or proposals from solicitation review through content coordination, compliance, production, approvals, and final submission.
* Ability to manage both quick turn and complex responses with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and shifting deadlines.
* Experience facilitating proposal kickoff, strategy, and review meetings and converting decisions into actions and content.
* Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to interpret requirements and evaluation criteria, identify gaps and risks, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written English with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, and the ability to adapt tone and level of detail to different buyers.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, including experience with compliance matrices and formal submission requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to obtain information from busy subject matter experts and drive accountability respectfully.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, tables, and templates, and working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours and communicate clearly and promptly with U.S. based colleagues.
* Familiarity with U.S. government procurement portals, SAM.gov, and cooperative contracts is strongly preferred.

title: Tech S and T- Tech Strategy - Senior consultant-GDSF04
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
 EY's Technology Strategy \& Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting\-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business\-led, tech\-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
   

  

**Scope of engagements**
 We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
   

  

* reset, reimagine and re\-think their business and operating models with tech\-enabled, cutting\-edge solutions that re\-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance


 We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world\-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst \& Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high\-profile clients with range of services including:
   

  

* Tech Strategy \& Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5\-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps \& blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy \& management
* M\&A due\-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services


**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**
* Understanding the business strategy \& vision and translating them into enterprise\-wide technology vision \& strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech\-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1\) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2\) analysing enterprise\-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3\) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise\-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross\-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights


**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**
* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end\-to\-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business \- IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture\-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS\-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self\-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point\-of\-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C\-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier\-1 B\-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 5\+ years of relevant experience in large\-scale, enterprise\-wide transformations
* Min. of 5\+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e\-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep\-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models \& organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT \- business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re\-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next\-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end\-to\-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies


**The following are preferred, but not required:**
* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier\-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C\-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).


**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day\-to\-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive\-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell\-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long\-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: App Sales Executive
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 
 App Sales Executive
 
 to lead and manage our network of sales partners who promote and sell the 123Greetings Pro Subscription to agencies and businesses. This is a hands\-on sales leadership role. You will guide, support, and motivate our sales partners as they work through the agency lists we assign, reach out to leads and make sales calls yourself, lead the onboarding calls with agency clients, help partners close more deals, and step in personally on high\-value or complex negotiations. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and skilled negotiator, confident at closing, and knows how to get the best out of a sales team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales Partner Team Leadership** 




 ●       Manage, guide, and support the company's network of sales partners.
 



 ●       Set clear activity and conversion goals for each partner and hold them accountable.
 



 ●       Coach and mentor partners on outreach, pitching, objection handling, and closing.
 



 ●       Guide partners as they onboard the agencies from the lead lists assigned to them.
 



 ●       Keep the team motivated and engaged across the partner network.
 



 ●       Run regular check\-ins, performance reviews, and training sessions.
 



  





**Communication \& Negotiation** 




 ●       Act as the main point of contact between the company and its sales partners.
 



 ●       Communicate product updates, pricing, offers, and sales guidance clearly to partners.
 



 ●       Lead or support negotiations on higher\-value and complex deals.
 



 ●       Handle escalations, objections, and non\-standard requests from prospects.
 



  





**Deal Closing \& Sales Execution** 




 ●       Reach out to leads and make sales calls directly, working the assigned agency lists alongside the partner team.
 



 ●       Actively support partners across the sales process, stepping in wherever needed to move deals forward.
 



 ●       Step in directly to help close key deals and convert priority agencies into paying customers.
 



 ●       Lead the onboarding calls with agencies as they are brought onto the Pro Subscription.
 



 ●       Review and strengthen partners' pitches and follow\-up to improve close rates.
 



 ●       Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing agency clients.
 



 ●       Keep the pipeline moving from first contact through to a signed subscription.
 



  





**Sales Process \& Enablement** 




 ●       Own the day\-to\-day sales process: lead assignment, follow\-up cadence, and conversion tracking.
 



 ●       Provide partners with sales scripts, materials, and best practices, and keep them up to date.
 



 ●       Identify what is working and roll out successful approaches across the whole network.
 



 ●       Ensure all outreach is professional, ethical, and in line with company guidelines.
 



  





**Performance Tracking \& Reporting** 




 ●       Track partner activity and conversions and review performance against targets.
 



 ●       Share regular sales updates and recommendations with leadership.
 



 ●       Spot underperformance early and put clear improvement plans in place.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 ●       1\-3 years in sales, with at least a year managing or leading a sales team.
 



 ●       Proven track record of closing deals and consistently hitting sales targets.
 



 ●       Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
 



 ●       Experience coaching, developing, and motivating salespeople or partners.
 



 ●       Comfortable leading from the front and closing deals personally.
 



 ●       Confident at building relationships with clients and partners.
 



 ●       Organised, with strong follow\-up and pipeline management habits.
 



 ●       Experience in B2B or subscription sales is a strong plus.
 



  





**Required Skillset** 




 ●       Negotiation
 



 ●       Deal closing
 



 ●       Advanced Excel (tracking, reporting, and dashboards)
 



 ●       Stakeholder management
 



 ●       Communication and presentation
 



 ●       Sales pipeline and CRM management
 



 ●       Coaching and team leadership
 



 ●       Relationship building
 



 ●       Cold outreach and prospecting
 



 ●       Objection handling
 



 ●       Reporting and sales data analysis

description:
**Job Title**
 Technical Consultant
   

  

**About Skyhigh Security**
 Skyhigh Security is a dynamic, fast\-paced, cloud company that is a leader in the security industry. Our mission is to protect the world’s data, and because of this, we live and breathe security. We value learning at our core, underpinned by openness and transparency.
   

  

 Since 2011, organizations have trusted us to provide them with a complete, market\-leading security platform built on a modern cloud stack. Our industry\-leading suite of products radically simplifies data security through easy\-to\-use, cloud\-based, Zero Trust solutions that are managed in a single dashboard, powered by hundreds of employees across the world. With offices in Santa Clara, Aylesbury, Paderborn, Bengaluru, Sydney, Tokyo and more, our employees are the heart and soul of our company.

title: Performance Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Experience:** 
 3\-5\+ years
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Country Lead
 



  





**Hello. We’re Blood.** 




  





**Our purpose is to revolutionize periods.** 




  





**Who are we?** 




 Blood is a challenger brand in the period care space. We exist to challenge taboos, push boundaries, and help people with periods to bleed unapologetically. Our focus on deeply understanding our users drives our innovation in creating products that are both high performing, and better for their bodies and skin.
 



  





 Blood is the creator of the world’s first Sanitary Pad made from Corn, and is the parent brand of MenstruHeat (menstrual cramp relief).
 



  





 We’re scaling fast across Asia, with our core markets in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and our newest market, India. Selling online and across more than 7,000 retail stores \- making more than 12 million periods better so far.
 



  





 Today was good. Tomorrow will bleed better.
 



  





**Why India, why now** 




 India is the biggest period care opportunity on earth and one of the least served. Most of the market still runs on skin\-irritating products designed decades ago. Quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) has torn down the distribution wall that used to keep challenger brands out for years.
 



  





 We can now reach millions in months, instead of decades.
 



  





 We've proven product\-market fit across markets in Southeast Asia, and India is where we prove it at an even larger scale. You'd join at the first inning, and help write our India story together.
 



  





**Who we’re looking for:** 



1. If hearing RoAS, CVR and CTR gets you excited
2. You’re hungry for growth and believe in always iterating to produce better work
3. You love analyzing numbers and taking action from your insights



  





 As a Performance Marketing \& Growth Manager at Blood, you will be responsible for planning, strategizing, and execution of paid growth campaigns to drive ad performance across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, and Amazon, alongside other channels and media networks.
 



 You'll own the connective tissue between "the product is listed" and "the product is found, chosen, and bought," running ad funnels, protecting profitability, and coordinating tightly with sales on CRO and operations on inventory.
 



  





 You must have hands\-on ad buying experience with Quick Commerce. A good eye for effective advertising headlines, promo mechanics and creatives will help immensely. At the same time, you are expected to move fast and be comfortable operating at an analytical, yet tactical, level and be deeply grounded in consumer insights.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* **30% \- Ads \& Performance Marketing** 
 \- Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (sponsored search, banners, keyword bidding) across quick commerce platforms; optimize for RoAS, ACoS, CTR, CVR, and sales velocity; drive top\-of\-search visibility and category rank
* **25% \- Marketplace Strategy** 
 \- Plan visibility boosts for mega sale events, coordinate new launches with ad acceleration; manage budgets for incremental growth via structured ad funnels in order to achieve sales target \& market share.
* **20% \- Budget allocation and media planning** 
 \- Allocate monthly performance budgets across channels and marketplaces; Track daily spends and performance to ensure profitability and goal alignment
* **10% \- Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 
 \- Work with the creative team on ad assets; coordinate with the marketplace team on promotions,A/B testing inputs and working on SOV growth.
* **10% \- Data \& Analytics** 
 \- Analyze platform dashboards and SKU\-level performance; build weekly RoAS and profitability reports; identify hero SKUs and track competitor pricing and promotions
* **5% \- SKU \& Category Optimization** 
 \- Improve listing visibility through keyword and search\-term strategy; optimize titles, keywords, and creatives; manage pricing against contribution margins



  





**Ideal candidate:** 



* 3\-5\+ years running growth marketing / performance marketing for a D2C or e\-commerce brand, ideally with quick commerce experience in India
* Hands\-on with Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, and Amazon ad platforms \- sponsored search, keyword bidding, category ads
* Track record scaling paid revenue profitably (RoAS/ACoS\-driven, not just spend\-driven) for a consumer brand
* Startup mindset \- comfortable with ambiguity, builds systems from scratch rather than inheriting one
* Data\-driven with strong Excel/Sheets skills and comfort across platform ad dashboards
* Good to have : P\&L understanding capability

description:
At Exito, we focus on creating bespoke solutions that focus on thought leadership, collaboration, re\-education and building new business opportunities. Our conferences and summits reach global markets across the EMEA \& APAC regions where we engage with various CXO's and Business
   





 Leaders across industries in tech and non\-tech spaces.
   





  





 As a social media marketing professional, your role involves developing, implementing, tracking, and optimizing our social media campaigns across all relevant channels. You would also be required to deliver clear and concise content to keep our target audience engaged.
   





  





**Responsibilities \& Scope of Work** 
  





  





**Content Planning \& Execution** 
  




* Build and run monthly content calendars for the Exito corporate brand and event pages across LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and YouTube.
* Write platform\-native copy (posts, carousels, captions, threads, short\-form video scripts) for a C\-suite B2B audience.
* Plan launch\-week, countdown, live\-event, and post\-event content for each conference.
* Label every piece of content by its goal (delegate, sponsor, or brand) and write to that audience.



**Event Promotion** 
  




* Promote speakers, agendas, and sessions in coordination with the conference production team.
* Run live coverage on event days, including real\-time posts, stories, and highlights.
* Repurpose event recordings and speaker clips into short\-form assets.



**Community \& Engagement** 
  




* Manage comments, DMs, and mentions within agreed response times.
* Grow followers and engagement on LinkedIn, the priority channel for our audience.
* Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and partners on co\-branded and tagged content.



**Analytics \& Reporting** 
  




* Track reach, engagement, follower growth, click\-through, and registration influence per platform.
* Maintain UTM tagging conventions so social traffic is attributable to analytics.
* Produce weekly and monthly performance reports with clear recommendations.



**Research \& Coordination** 
  




* Monitor competitor event pages and ads (including Meta Ad Library) for positioning and creative trends.
* Track trends in enterprise tech, BFSI, cybersecurity, and digital transformation for timely content.
* Brief the design team on visual requirements and review creatives before publishing.
* Support the paid\-ads team with organic insights and audience learnings.



  

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  



  





**Must\-Have** 
  




* 0–2 years of social media experience, preferably B2B, events, media, or tech.
* Strong written English suited to a senior professional audience.
* Hands\-on experience with LinkedIn company page management.
* Working knowledge of native analytics (LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite) and Google Analytics.
* Understanding of UTM parameters and basic campaign tracking.



**Good\-to\-Have** 
  




* Experience promoting conferences, webinars, or B2B events.
* Familiarity with scheduling tools (Buffer, Hootsuite, Meta Business Suite, or similar).
* Basic Canva skills for quick edits.
* Exposure to CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho) or email marketing.
* Interest in enterprise technology and IT industry trends.


 Benefits
   

  


 \- International Exposure
   





 \- Travel opportunities to different cities \& countries
   





 \- Quarterly incentives
   





 \- Hands\-on training
   





 \- Diverse growth opportunities
   





  





**Job Type:** 
  





 1\. Full time \& On\-site
   





 2\. 5 day work week

**3\. Analytics \& Reporting**

* Translate raw data and platform analytics into actionable insights to continuously improve content performance and strategy.

* **Technical Skills:** 
 Proficiency in mobile video editing tools (CapCut, InShot) and graphic design platforms (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite).
* **Tools:** 
 Experience with social media management software (e.g., Later, Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Buffer) and native platform analytics.
* **Soft Skills:** 
 Exceptional copyeditor and storyteller with a sharp eye for visual aesthetics. Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment and pivot quickly when trends change.



**Preferred Qualifications (Nice\-to\-Haves)** 



* Experience with paid social media advertising (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads).
* Basic photography or lighting skills for on\-the\-fly content capture.
* A proven track record of growing a social media channel or executing a viral campaign (links to a portfolio or case studies are highly encouraged).

title: Junior Associate, Brand Marketing
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 At Razorpay, marketing isn’t just about storytelling, it’s about driving real growth. We’re looking for a marketing intern who’s excited by numbers, obsessed with funnels, and curious about what makes users click, convert, and come back. You’ll work with the team that works on acquisition and retention across the Razorpay ecosystem; designing experiments, running campaigns, and learning how data and creativity come together to drive business results.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns aimed at acquiring and retaining users.
* Help segment audiences, track journeys, and learn what goes behind lifecycle marketing.
* Collaborate with product, design, and analytics teams to bring campaigns to life across owned and paid channels.
* Support campaign analysis and learn how to interpret metrics like CTR, VTR, and retention rates, and use them to improve performance.
* Research market trends and customer behavior to fuel future campaigns.
* Experiment fearlessly, test ideas, tweak copy, play with formats, and learn what actually moves the needle.


**What You Bring**
* A strong curiosity about how marketing works, not just what looks good, but what performs well.
* Enthusiasm to learn the data\-driven side of marketing, from acquisition funnels to retention strategies.
* A creative spark \- you love solving problems and thinking of fresh ways to engage users.
* A self\-starter mindset \- proactive, organised, and ready to learn by doing.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
 You’ll get hands\-on experience with campaigns and learn the blend of creativity and data that defines Razorpa
   

  

 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \& Twitter
