**About the Role \-** 




 We are looking for someone to
 **own and scale the student acquisition engine at The LIT School** 
 . This role sits at the intersection of growth strategy, performance marketing, consumer behaviour, data, and business outcomes, with ownership across the student acquisition funnel — from generating demand and qualified leads to driving applications, admissions, and ultimately enrolments.
 



 The ideal candidate will be highly data\-driven, commercially oriented, and comfortable operating in a high\-growth environment. They should be able to move beyond campaign execution to understand what drives student and parent demand, which audiences convert, where the funnel breaks, and how marketing investments translate into measurable enrolment outcomes.

**Student Acquisition \& Funnel Ownership** 



* Own the complete acquisition funnel from
 **Lead → Qualified Lead → Application → Interview → Offer → Enrolment** 
 .
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion and reduce drop\-offs at every stage of the funnel.
* Own and maintain the
 **CRM\-based acquisition funnel** 
 , ensuring accurate tracking of leads from initial enquiry through enrolment.
* Use CRM data and insights to identify opportunities to improve lead quality, follow\-up efficiency, and overall conversion.
* Develop strategies to drive qualified demand and improve overall enrolment outcomes.
* Partner closely with Admissions and Outreach to optimise marketing beyond lead volumes.

* Develop and execute acquisition strategies across paid and organic channels.
* Identify new acquisition channels, partnerships, and growth opportunities beyond traditional paid marketing.
* Manage channel strategy, campaign planning, budget allocation, and scaling.
* Continuously evaluate channel performance and identify opportunities for growth and optimisation.

 **CAC, CPL, CPQL, application conversion, offer\-to\-enrolment conversion, and acquisition ROI** 
 .

* Build robust dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide clear visibility into campaign, channel, and funnel performance.
* Establish strong attribution and ROI frameworks to guide marketing investments and channel strategy.



  





**Experimentation \& Conversion Optimisation** 



* Drive a structured culture of experimentation across audiences, creatives, messaging, landing pages, campaigns, and acquisition channels.
* Identify funnel gaps and develop experiments to improve conversion at each stage.
* Analyse experiment outcomes and scale initiatives that demonstrate measurable impact.
* Continuously optimise campaigns based on performance and downstream enrolment outcomes.



  





**Brand, Content \& Creative Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Brand, Content, and Creative teams to develop and scale high\-performing campaigns.

* Ensure communication is aligned with student aspirations, parent decision\-making, and LIT School's positioning.

**Admissions \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Build continuous feedback loops between Marketing, Admissions, and Outreach teams.

* Identify insights from admissions and outreach teams to improve targeting, messaging, and acquisition strategy.

description:
**Entity**

**Title** 
 : \- Consultant/ Manager/Analyst – Marketing \& Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI)
   

  

**Job location** 
 : \- Any out of 6 AI locations
   

  

**About S\&C \- Global Network (GN)** 
 : \- Accenture GN’s Data \& AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data \- insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities \- from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling – to outperform the competition.
   

  

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
 As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k\+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward\-thinking consultants provide analytically\-informed, issue\-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
   

  

**What You Would Do In This Role**
 A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day\-to\-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.
   

  

 As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.
   

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (GCP CDP)**
* Architect \& Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise\-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Build Production\-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
* Model for Insight \& Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360\-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.
* Champion DevOps \& MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager.
* Deploy \& Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real\-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms.
* Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real\-time inference.
* Collaborate \& Innovate: Work within a multi\-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering.
* Ensure Governance \& Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically.


**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (RTCDP)**
* Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage
* Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc.
* Provide deep domain expertise in our client’s business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry
* Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
* Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations \- Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc.
* Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer
* Assess and audit the current state of a client’s marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution
* Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client.
* Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation.
* Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the client’s needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools.
* Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end\-to\-end QA testing for integrations.
* Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration
* Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
* Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing
* Perform technical analysis \& design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard.


**Key Duties and Responsibilities: (Agentic AI)**
* Architect the core interaction logic and decision\-making frameworks for enterprise\-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP.
* Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi\-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities.
* Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real\-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision\-making.
* Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents.
* Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources.
* Leverage Gemini models' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem\-solving in marketing contexts.
* Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain\-of\-Thought, Few\-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents.
* Implement and leverage grounding \& evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications.
* Develop and deploy AI\-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini.
* Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components.
* Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access.
* Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems.
* Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques.
* Create insights presentations and client\-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations.
* Mentor and guide junior resources, fostering a collaborative and growth\-oriented team environment.
* Demonstrate strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively convey complex concepts and insights to stakeholders.
* Develop strong relationships with clients at all levels, understanding their specific challenges and opportunities.


**Other Roles And Responsibilities**
* Business intelligence expertise for insights, actionable recommendations.
* Project management expertise for sprint planning
* Provide hands\-on support and platform training for our clients.
* Data processing, data engineer and data schema/models expertise for CDPs to work on data models, unification logic etc.
* Work with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Technical Architects, DBAs to achieve project objectives \- delivery dates, quality objectives etc.


**RTCDP** 
 (specific skills)
   

  

* At least 2\+ years of relevant work experience of implementing CDP solutions with deep understanding of identity resolution methods with minimum 1 year in Adobe RTCDP
* At least 2\+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics
* At least 2\+ years of experience working in an agency environment
* At least 2 years of experience working as Subject matter expert in Adobe Marketing Cloud Stack
* Experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target is a plus.
* Experience with Campaign Management tools like Adobe Journey Optimizer or/and Adobe Campaign is a plus.
* Experience with Adobe Marketing Cloud tools like Adobe Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), DAM is a plus
* Experience in Postman APIs is a plus
* Strong hands\-on with advanced JavaScript and jQuery. Able to develop custom tags/scripts using tag managers


**Agentic AI** 
 (specific skills)

title: Braze Solution Architect
description:
**Role Summary**
 This role is a critical investment in scaling McAfee's customer engagement capabilities and ensuring the platforms, data, and processes needed to support lifecycle marketing and personalization are built for the future. A dedicated Messaging Operations Technical Lead will provide the technical leadership needed to establish platform standards, optimize integrations and data flows, drive automation, and create scalable operational frameworks that enable global teams to execute efficiently and consistently. By serving as the bridge between Marketing, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Data teams, this role will reduce operational complexity, accelerate time\-to\-market, improve platform adoption and governance, and ensure McAfee fully realizes the value of its investment in Braze and future customer engagement capabilities.
   

  

 This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India, development center. You will be required to be on\-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on\-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
   

  

**Position Details**
**About The Role**
* You will serve as the technical owner of Braze, leading customer engagement capabilities across email, push notifications, in\-app messaging, and emerging channels while establishing scalable customer journey frameworks, audience structures, and campaign architecture standards.
* You will define scalable approaches for implementing customer journeys, audience segmentation, personalization, and experimentation within Braze and the broader customer engagement ecosystem.
* You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to drive platform enhancements and implement customer engagement capabilities that align with business goals and industry best practices.
* You will oversee customer data requirements, event frameworks, audience enablement strategies, and integrations across CDPs, data warehouses, internal systems, and third\-party marketing technologies while ensuring data quality and reliability.
* You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and recommending optimal approaches for lifecycle marketing, personalization, and testing initiatives.
* You will serve as the primary Braze subject matter expert, providing technical leadership, developing standards and training programs, mentoring teams, evaluating new platform capabilities, and driving automation and governance initiatives that improve platform performance and operational effectiveness.


**About You**
* You should have a bachelor's degree and 5\-9 years of experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Engagement Platforms, or Marketing Automation, including at least 3 years of hands\-on experience with Braze solution design, architecture, implementation, and platform management.
* You should have experience designing and supporting enterprise\-scale customer engagement ecosystems, with deep expertise in Braze Canvas architecture, audience segmentation, customer journey design, data modeling, personalization, event\-based triggering, cross\-channel orchestration, messaging operations, and platform governance.
* You should have a strong background working with customer data platforms (CDPs), data warehouses, APIs, and marketing technology integrations, along with a solid understanding of customer identity resolution, data schemas, event frameworks, and audience management principles.
* You should have experience working with SQL, JSON, APIs, webhooks, and broader marketing technology ecosystems, and should have established governance frameworks, scalable execution models, and operational processes that drive efficiency and consistency.
* You should preferably hold a Braze certification and have experience with CDP technologies such as Adobe Experience Platform, Segment, mParticle, or Tealium, as well as familiarity with cloud data environments including Snowflake, Databricks, or Azure and customer journey analytics platforms.
* You should think like a solution architect, thrive at the intersection of marketing, technology, operations, and customer experience, and excel at translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* You should be a trusted advisor who proactively drives process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement while effectively influencing cross\-functional stakeholders and balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution when needed.


**Company Overview**
 McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

 We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.
   

  

 We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Bonus Program

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off

 We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

title: AI Native Product Marketer
description:
**AI\-Native GTM / Product Marketing Operator**




  





**About Facilio**




  





 Facilio is the agentic platform transforming how large buildings manage their physical operations. We are the AI\-native operating layer for buildings on a mission to make buildings operationally efficient.
 



  





 Today, 150\+ enterprise customers across hospitals, universities, retail chains, landmark venues and large real estate portfolios use Facilio to drive cost efficiency, service quality, compliance and operational performance.
 



  





 With a growing presence across the US, UK, Middle East and Australia, Facilio is backed by leading global investors including Accel, Tiger Global, Dragoneer and Brookfield Growth.
 



 We aim to bring agentic AI to the physical world — moving enterprise operations from systems that record and manage work to intelligent systems that understand, decide and act.
 



  





**Build the next generation of GTM at Facilio.**




  





 At Facilio, we're building an AI\-first enterprise SaaS platform for teams that run physical operations. As AI changes how products are built, sold and marketed, we’re rethinking what a modern marketing team should look like too.
 



  





 We're looking for someone early in their career who understands
 **Product Marketing** 
 but thinks beyond traditional marketing execution.
 



  





 The old model:
 



**Marketer → thinks of an idea → uses AI → creates the asset → distributes it** 




  





 The model we're building:
 



**Understand the GTM objective → identify what needs to happen → orchestrate AI agents \+ existing systems → review \& steer the output → learn from the result → improve the system.** 




  





 This role builds and owns that shift for the PMM function. Think of it as a GTM engineer's systems fluency, aimed specifically at product marketing judgment.
 



  





**What you'll do**




  




* Understand our
 **products, customers, ICPs and GTM motions** 
 deeply enough to identify what marketing should actually do — not just execute briefs.
* Take existing PMM workflows (case studies, social posts, enablement docs, battlecards, email sequences) and rebuild them as connected mini\-agents — triggered by real events in our systems, not by someone opening a chat and typing a brief
* Define what each agent should draft autonomously vs. where it must stop and hand off to a human — this is a marketing judgment call, not just a technical guardrail
* Use AI not just to create content, but to
 **identify opportunities, generate ideas, make recommendations and trigger the next action** 
 .
* Review and QA agent output against real marketing standards: does this case study lead with the right proof point for this funnel stage? Does this battlecard actually counter the objection or just restate our positioning?
* Build systems that can take something like a product update or customer signal and determine what messaging, content, enablement or GTM action should follow.
* Bring strong judgement to the output:
 **what is worth saying, who should hear it, when, through which channel, and why.**
* Continuously measure what works and improve the underlying workflow, agent or system — not just the individual output.



  





**What you'll need to bring**




  





**1\. PMM fundamentals** 




 You understand positioning, messaging, ICPs, personas, buyer journeys, content, launches, customer stories and sales enablement — and know what good looks like.
 



**2\. GTM judgement** 




 You can look at a product, customer or market signal and figure out
 **what should happen next** 
 . You understand that the same story, proof point or message won't work equally well across every persona or funnel stage.
 



**3\. AI / agent orchestration** 




 You don't just ask Claude or ChatGPT to write faster. You instinctively ask:
 **Can this workflow be automated? Can an agent do this? What context should it have? What systems should it connect to? Where should a human stay in the loop?** 




**4\. Systems thinking** 




 You enjoy breaking messy, repetitive workflows into inputs, decisions, actions and feedback loops — and turning them into scalable systems.
 



**5\. Execution ownership** 




 You're still a doer. You can take an idea from
 **problem → system → output → measurement** 
 , rather than waiting for someone else to define the work for you.
 



  





**Who this is for**




  




* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in Product Marketing, B2B SaaS marketing, GTM, growth or a closely related role.
* Someone who is
 **curious about how things work and obsessed with making them better** 
 .
* Someone who experiments with AI tools and wants to go beyond prompting into
 **building workflows, agents and systems** 
 .
* Someone who can move between
 **customer thinking, product understanding, marketing judgement and technology** 
 .
* Someone who would rather build a system that eliminates 10 hours of recurring work than become really good at doing those 10 hours.



  





**What this role is NOT**




  




* Not a content writer who occasionally uses AI tools
* Not a pure automation/RevOps builder with no marketing instinct
* Not someone who needs an idea handed to them before they can execute — the whole point is they (and their agents) originate ideas

title: Digital Coaching Business Strategist / Digital Coaching Community Builder
description:
Digital Coaching Business Strategist / Digital Coaching Community Builder — ExpertsBIO 🎯
   


 Remote \| ₹24–60 lakh/year realistic earning \| Base \+ uncapped commission
 



  





**About ExpertsBIO** 





 India's performance marketing partner built exclusively for coaches. For 8 years we've worked with 100\+ coaches, managed crores in ad spend, and built revenue engines for some of the most recognised names in Indian coaching.
 





 Here's why this role exists. Too many coaches are getting scammed and left without the help they actually need. We're building a genuinely value\-driven community to change that. We want someone capable enough to run this on their own — and that's the point: you get to be an intrapreneur, building your own thing, but coached by people who've already done it for hundreds of coaches over 8 years, with the contacts and the playbook to match. We run on performance, not salaries and comfort. If that's your language, keep reading.
 




  





**The Role — in plain terms** 





 You'll run a free online community where coaches come to learn and grow. Your job is to genuinely help them — fix their offer, sort out their business model, guide their funnel — so they get real results and come to trust you. Because they trust you, you'll then guide the right coaches into our paid programs and tools, and earn commission on every sale. As the community grows, you find new things to offer them and make more. You build the audience, you help them, you sell to them — all of it is yours.
 




  





**What You'll Actually Do Day to Day** 



* Grow and run the community — bring coaches in, keep them engaged, make it a place they show up for.

**What We're Looking For** 



* Proof you've already helped coaches scale — real numbers, not claims.
* Deep grasp of coaching business models and the funnels that work in this industry.
* Full\-stack literacy: enough command of copywriting, media buying, design, video editing and scripting, UI/UX, and AI to 
 *teach* 
  coaches and get them results.

**What We're Not Looking For** 



* If you need a fixed salary to feel secure, this is not for you.
* If you've never worked with coaches or info\-products, this isn't the right fit.
* If you want to clock in and be chased for output, please don't apply.

* Base: ₹4\.2–12 lakh/year (₹35,000–₹1,00,000/month), based on track record.

**Who Thrives Here** 





 The person who 
 
*wants* 
  ₹24–60 lakh a year and has the fire to pull it off. Who's excited that their income is tied to what they build, not what they're handed. If that's you, we'll give you the audience, the offers, and the room to make serious money.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
**About the Role** 




 Scale.jobs is a hybrid AI \+ human job application platform. Real humans, backed by automation, apply to jobs on behalf of job seekers so they can spend their time interviewing instead of filling out forms. We're a Techstars '24 company, profitable, serving job seekers across the US, Canada, UK, Germany, and Australia. Millions of applications processed so far.
 



  





 You'd be our SEO person. Not one of several \- the one. You own organic growth end to end: strategy, execution, and the number we look at every month.
 



  





 Here's why the timing is interesting. A growing share of our customers now find us through ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews instead of ten blue links. The classic playbook still matters, but the ground underneath it is moving. We want someone who's paying attention to that.
 



 You'll get direct CMS access. You're expected to ship on\-page changes yourself, not queue everything behind a developer. Code\-level work goes to engineering with a clear spec you wrote.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



1. **On\-page.** 
 Keyword research, mapping, and intent analysis across blogs, landing pages, and programmatic pages. Primary and secondary keywords assigned per URL so two pages never fight each other. Titles and metas written for clicks, not just relevance. Heading structure, internal linking, topic clusters, killing orphan pages. Schema (Article, FAQ, JobPosting, Breadcrumb, Organization) plus OG and Twitter cards.
2. **AI search (GEO/AEO).** 
 Structure content so AI engines can extract and cite it \- clean Q\&A blocks, tight definitions, claims backed by schema. Track our citation share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. Watch where competitors are getting surfaced and close the gap.
3. **Technical.** 
 Semrush audits triaged by revenue impact, not error count. Robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, crawl budget, index coverage. Core Web Vitals. Site architecture, breadcrumbs, pagination, mobile rendering, redirects, duplicate content. When you can't ship it yourself, you write the spec \- repro steps, affected URLs, expected outcome.
4. **Content.** 
 Blogs and newsletters that actually bring traffic and leads. Revamping old underperforming posts, which is often better ROI than net\-new. Editing and formatting pages in basic HTML.
5. **Off\-page.** 
 Outreach, guest posts, resource\-page placements. Converting unlinked brand mentions into links. Competitor backlink gap analysis. Reddit and niche job\-seeker communities \- real participation, not spam. Backlink health monitoring. And digital PR around launches, which is completely greenfield here, so you'd be building it from zero.
6. **Reporting.** 
 Own the dashboard across GSC, GA4, and Semrush. Monthly report that ties organic performance to signups and revenue. Recommendations, not a metrics dump.



  





**We'll vibe if you…** 



* Have 4 years of hands\-on SEO. Actual execution, not agency oversight.
* Can plan and run on\-page and off\-page strategy without someone handing you a brief
* Do keyword research, mapping, and intent analysis in your sleep
* Are comfortable editing and formatting pages in basic HTML
* Write titles and metas that earn the click
* Write genuinely good long\-form content \- blogs, newsletters \- without needing a second editor
* Know your way around Semrush audits
* Can look at Semrush \+ GSC \+ GA4, find the real problem, and either fix it or spec it clearly
* Actually get GEO/AEO \- how content gets written, structured, and surfaced in AI answers
* Optimize blogs and pages as per the competitor analysis and market trends.
* Report performance with recommendations attached, not just charts
* Are opinionated about prioritization and can defend why one fix beats twenty others
* Find the AI search shift interesting rather than annoying



  





**Bonus points:** 
 SaaS or marketplace SEO. Multi\-region work (hreflang, geo\-targeting \- we serve five markets). Programmatic SEO at scale. Basic SQL or spreadsheet modeling. Familiarity with Next.js and how rendering affects crawlability. Digital PR or founder\-led distribution.
 



**Tools:** 
 GSC, GA4, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sheets, and whichever AI visibility tracker we land on.
 



  





**What's in it for you** 



* **Full ownership.** 
 You're not executing someone else's SEO strategy. It's yours.
* **You ship.** 
 Direct CMS access, no waiting three sprints for a title tag change.
* **Profitable company.** 
 We're not burning the runway. That means a real budget for tools and links, and no pressure to chase vanity numbers for a deck.
* **A genuinely new problem.** 
 AI search optimization has not settled the playbook yet. Whatever you figure out here is yours to take anywhere.



  





 To fast\-track your application, email
 **hr@scale.jobs** 
 with the subject line
 **"SEO Specialist Application"** 
 . Include your portfolio and your current and expected compensation.

description:
**Growth Marketing Manager — Demand Gen \& Marketing Automation** 




**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**About Verdantis** 




 Verdantis is an AI\-native enterprise software company building MRO360 (AI\-native MRO inventory optimization and EAM) and Verdantis MDM (master data management and governance), selling into large global enterprises with a primary focus on North America. We're scaling fast and rebuilding how we generate and convert pipeline, using AI as a core operating tool, not an add\-on.
 



**The Role** 




 We're looking for someone to own demand generation end\-to\-end: paid advertising, outbound, ABM, and the automation layer connecting them. This isn't a role where campaigns are handed to you to execute. You'll own a pipeline number, and you'll have real say over the tools, workflows, and systems used to hit it. If manual, one\-off campaign work bores you and you'd rather build something that compounds, this is your role.
 



 You're joining at a moment where the function needs to be rebuilt, not just staffed, so expect ambiguity and expect to create your own roadmap rather than wait for one.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* **Paid \& outbound channels:** 
 Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and outbound sequencing, with full ownership of strategy, execution, and optimization
* **Pipeline volume:** 
 Build and scale demand generation so qualified pipeline grows without linearly scaling spend
* **Lead quality \& ICP fit:** 
 Tighten targeting, scoring, and qualification so what comes in is actually sales\-ready, not just volume for its own sake
* **Personalization at scale:** 
 Use AI and automation, including enrichment, intent signals, and AI\-assisted messaging, to make outbound and ABM feel 1:1 at a scale a human alone couldn't sustain
* **Attribution \& measurement:** 
 Build the reporting and attribution layer needed to know what's actually working. This doesn't exist today, so you're building it from scratch
* **Tooling \& stack decisions:** 
 Propose and own the marketing technology and automation stack within an agreed budget, choosing what to use based on what the work needs
* **Cross\-functional alignment:** 
 Work closely with sales and SDRs to make sure pipeline generated actually converts, and feed learnings back into targeting and messaging



**What We're Looking For** 



* 3 to 6 years in demand generation, growth marketing, or ABM, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS
* Proven ownership of a pipeline or lead generation number, not just campaign execution under someone else's strategy
* Genuinely fluent with AI tools for marketing, able to speak concretely about workflows you've built, such as enrichment, scoring, and personalized outreach working together, not just using AI for copywriting
* Comfortable with marketing automation and workflow tools, and willing to build hands\-on rather than delegate it
* Strong with paid channels (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads) and outbound tooling
* Self\-directed. You'll be given outcomes to hit, not a task list. We need someone who defines the how
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a lean team



  




* **Nice to Have**
* Experience selling into enterprise or North American buyers
* Familiarity with intent data platforms
* Basic scripting or advanced no\-code workflow building
* Experience in MDM, EAM, MRO, or adjacent enterprise software categories

 As the Regional Delivery Lead for Biddable Media, you will be directly accountable for campaign quality, execution standards, and operational governance across offices — acting as the senior\-most point of escalation for day\-to\-day delivery issues and ensuring every team, in every city, meets the same bar of execution.

title: Meta Marketing Manager | DTC / E-commerce
description:
Meta Marketing Manager \| DTC / E\-commerce
 



 Location: Remote
 



  





 We're hiring a Meta Marketing Manager to own and scale B2C paid social performance across our two ecommerce brands, ScavengerHunt.com and Let's Roam. You'll own the full performance loop — strategy, creative, launch, testing, analysis, and iteration — driving profitable growth in Contribution Margin. This is a hands\-on role: you'll manage campaigns directly in Meta Ads Manager, use AI tools to rapidly develop and test high\-performing creative, and directly impact revenue, CAC, and ROAS.
 



 Brands
 


* ScavengerHunt.com
* LetsRoam.com



 About Let's Roam
 



 Let's Roam is a startup (est. 2016\) that helps people explore the world and connect with each other. Our culturally immersive scavenger hunts help people connect with their environment through team challenges and interactive games, while our corporate virtual team building events offer a fun and sophisticated way of bringing companies together and stay engaged with one another while living in a remote work environment. We plan on growing fast and you will have the opportunity to grow with us.
 



 About You
 



 We're looking for a highly hands\-on Meta performance marketer who combines deep paid social expertise, strong DTC commercial instincts, and advanced AI\-assisted creative production. This is not a traditional media\-buying role. We want someone who can take a campaign from strategy → AI\-assisted creative → launch → test → profitable scale. You should be an advanced user of AI creative tools like Claude or ChatGPT, using AI as a core part of your creative workflow to dramatically increase testing velocity and volume. You will own Meta strategy, creative production, and performance reporting across two consumer brands.
 



 Project/Role DescriptionMeta Strategy \& Growth
 


* Own day\-to\-day Meta strategy, execution, and optimization across two B2C brands.
* Develop profitable evergreen, promotional, and seasonal campaigns with long\-term scalability.
* Own campaign structure, budgets, bidding, targeting, and scaling decisions.
* Monitor performance daily and quickly scale, optimize, or pause campaigns and ads based on profitability.
* Identify growth opportunities across products, audiences, geographies, and occasions.
* Develop structured testing roadmaps for campaigns, audiences, offers, and landing pages.
* Diagnose performance across creative, campaign structure, offer, landing page, and conversion funnel.



 AI Creative Strategy \& Production
 


* Own the Meta creative testing strategy across both brands.
* Develop new hooks, concepts, offers, messaging angles, and creative hypotheses based on performance data and customer insights.
* Use AI to rapidly create and iterate static ads, UGC concepts, short\-form video, scripts, copy, and creative variations.
* Analyze winning and losing ads to understand why they performed and determine the next iteration.
* Monitor creative fatigue and continuously introduce new concepts and variations.
* Build an AI\-enabled creative workflow that increases both speed and volume without sacrificing quality.



 Reporting \& Performance Insights
 


* Monitor and communicate performance on a daily and weekly basis.
* Translate data into clear insights: what happened, why it happened, and what we should do next.
* Analyze results by campaign, product, geography, audience, and creative.
* Evaluate creative metrics including Hook Rate, CTR, CPC, CVR, CPA, ROAS, and Contribution Margin.
* Present performance, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.



 Key Competencies and SkillsMeta Ads Expertise
 


* 5\+ years of hands\-on Meta performance marketing, paid media, or user acquisition experience.
* Proven success scaling B2C/DTC ecommerce Meta campaigns at significant budget levels, including personally managing $50K\+/month in spend.
* Experience with lower\-AOV products, experiences, tours, activities, or purchases under $100 strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Meta's current Advantage\+, automation, bidding, and campaign ecosystem.
* Hands\-on experience with Meta Conversions API, server\-side tracking, attribution, and conversion troubleshooting.



 AI\-Enabled Creative Skills
 


* Hands\-on experience using generative AI for performance creative, including imagery, UGC concepts, video, scripts, and copy.
* Experience building AI\-enabled and automation\-first marketing workflows that improve creative velocity, optimization, or reporting.
* Strong performance creative instincts with the ability to identify winning hooks, angles, messaging, and formats.



 Analytical \& Reporting Skills
 


* Deep understanding of Contribution Margin, MER, ROAS, CAC/CPA, AOV, CVR, and Revenue.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable recommendations.
* Strong direct\-response copywriting, communication, and creative briefing skills.
* Experience presenting campaign performance and strategy to senior stakeholders.



 DTC / Ecommerce Commercial Instincts
 


* Strong understanding of the full ecommerce funnel, including CRO, landing\-page testing, offers, and checkout performance.
* Experience managing multiple brands, accounts, or acquisition programs simultaneously.
* Proven ability to scale nationally while maintaining profitability.
* Highly organized, fast\-moving, and comfortable taking full ownership in a remote environment.



  





**Apply Now: We are interested in knowing the Meta campaigns you've scaled profitably, along with creative you've produced or directed — including any AI\-assisted work. Let's build the future of exploration together.** 




*This is an independent contractor position at Let's Roam. You will be working closely with our team in daily meetings and frequent check\-ins.* 




  





 You are expected to work under Denver, MT hours for this role.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Performance Marketing Manager (Digital Marketing)** 




  





**Location** 
 : Pitampura, Delhi (Onsite – Full\-Time)
 



**Ad Budget Managed:** 
 ₹30K – ₹1 Lakh/month (Google \+ Meta)
 



**Experience:** 
 3\+ Years
 



**Website:** 
 linkedin.com/company/gryd\-co
 



  





 If your idea of performance marketing goes beyond simply running ads and hitting publish,
 



 we'd love to meet you. We are seeking a Performance Marketer who understands the full
 



 lifecycle of paid campaigns, makes decisions backed by data, and takes complete ownership
 



 from strategy and execution to measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**ABOUT GRYD CO.** 




 Gryd Co. is India's only jewellery\-focused creative agency. With 5 years in the field and 80\+
 



 brand partnerships across the country, we help jewellery brands build stronger visibility, sharper
 



 positioning, and lasting brand presence.
 



 We are growing fast and we need a high\-performance marketer to drive paid growth for our
 



 premium jewellery clients — someone who doesn't just run campaigns, but owns the
 



 performance function with pride.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 Full\-cycle performance role: from campaign strategy to optimisation to reporting — you own it all.
 



 You will strategise, execute, and optimise paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook \& Instagram)
 



 and Google Ads (Search, Display \& Shopping) for premium jewellery brands. You manage
 



 monthly ad budgets between ₹30K and ₹1 Lakh across platforms — not just running ads, but
 



 building structured, insight\-led campaigns that drive measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**WHAT WE MEAN BY 'PERFORMANCE MARKETER'** 




 A performance marketer at Gryd is someone who:
 



 • Understands and builds campaign architecture — not as an executor, but as a strategist
 



 who knows when to follow best practices and when to break them
 



 • Can identify audience signals, creative fatigue, and funnel drop\-offs and act on them
 



 proactively
 



 • Handles budget allocation with precision and confidence — not guesswork or over\-spend
 



 • Sets a clear optimisation hypothesis for every test — no random changes, no open loops
 



 • Reviews their own campaign data, tracks their own KPIs, and holds themselves to a
 



 performance standard before anyone else does
 



 • Treats every underperforming campaign as data, not as failure
 



 • Never blames the creative team, the platform, or the client brief — they optimise or they
 



 learn
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Campaign Strategy \& Execution** 




 • Strategise and execute paid campaigns on Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram) and Google
 



 Ads (Search, Display \& Shopping)
 



 • Manage monthly ad budgets of ₹30K–₹1 Lakh across Google and Meta — with full
 



 accountability for spend efficiency
 



 • Build structured campaign architecture: audience segmentation, funnel mapping, ad set
 



 organisation
 



 • Own and optimise campaigns end\-to\-end — not just run them
 



  





**Accountability \& Reporting** 




 • Monitor and own performance metrics: ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPA, conversion rate
 



 • Build performance reports with clear insights and actionable recommendations — not just
 



 data dumps
 



 • Share weekly performance reviews: what worked, what didn't, and what's changing
 



 • Maintain dashboards, campaign documentation, and audit trails
 



  





**Testing \& Optimisation** 




 • Design and execute A/B tests across creatives, audiences, landing pages, and copy with
 



 clear hypotheses
 



 • Identify patterns in performance data and translate them into optimisation actions
 



 • Conduct competitor and trend research to stay ahead of the curve
 



 • Raise blockers early — waiting until a campaign fails before flagging it is not acceptable
 



  





**Tracking \& Infrastructure** 




 • Ensure accurate tracking via GA4, GTM, and Meta Pixel / Events Manager
 



 • Coordinate with creative and performance teams for timely asset delivery
 



 • Proactively flag tracking issues, attribution discrepancies, and data gaps
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  




* 3\+ years experience in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads
* Exposure to D2C, lifestyle, or premium ecommerce brands
* Demonstrated ability to strategise campaigns — not just execute
* Experience managing high\-ticket or jewellery/luxury brands
* Hands\-on experience managing ₹30K– ₹1L/month budgets
* Familiarity with CRM / sales tools (HubSpot, Zoho, etc.)
* Strong understanding of campaign structure,targeting, budgeting, and funnels
* Network in the jewellery or creative industry
* Working knowledge of GA4, GTM, Meta Events Manager
* Experience with shopping campaigns and product feed optimisation
* Radical ownership over your campaigns and outcomes
* Self\-directed — needs zero hand\-holding
* Strong analytical and reporting skills Clear communication and structured thinking



  





**WHY GRYD CO.?** 




 • India's only jewellery\-focused creative agency — a niche that sells itself
 



 • 80\+ brand portfolio — you are optimising something with proven credibility and results
 



 • Direct access to the founding team — no layers, no politics, just execution
 



 • Real ownership of a performance function — not a cog in a large marketing machine
 



 • A company that is actively growing — your contribution shapes what comes next
 



 • High\-trust environment — if you deliver, you are given more runway, not more oversight

 Full\-time, Immediate Joiner

**About Atraski** 




 Atraski is a national integrated services powerhouse designed to bridge the gap between creative vision and commercial execution. We operate through a "Hub \& Spoke" model, delivering excellence across four specialised pillars:
 


1. **At Buzz** 
 is our flagship marketing and digital growth arm.
2. **Atraski Studios** 
 is the vertical is our high\-end content house.
3. **Atraski Experiences** 
 is our on\-ground activation wing, realities through high\-stakes corporate summits, immersive product launches, and large\-scale brand activations.
4. **Atraski Technology Transformations (ATT)** 
 is the tech vertical.



**The Mission** 




 We are seeking a Process\-First Account Manager for At Buzz who has successfully managed a portfolio of brands in a high\-pressure agency environment. This is not just an execution role—you are the architect of the Content Infrastructure. You must build the systems that allow our creative talent to thrive and deliver excellence to our clients consistently.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Vision to Execution (The Core)** 




**Strategic Calendar Planning:** 




 Create the Monthly Social Media Calendar before the month begins. This must be a Visual Grid Strategy that balances engagement, education, and sales.
 



**Mood Boarding:** 




 Create detailed Mood Boards for every campaign or shoot. You need to visualize the aesthetic, color palette, lighting, and vibe of the brand and get it approved by the client before production starts.
 



**Detailed Designer Briefing:** 




 Act as the translator between the Client and the Creative Team. Provide highly detailed briefs to Graphic Designers and Video Editors (specifying fonts, timestamps, audio, and reference links) to minimize revisions.
 



**2\. Hands\-On Execution** 




**Canva Pro Mastery:** 




 Use Canva Pro for creating quick layouts, stories, presentations, and urgent static creatives without depending on the design team for minor tasks.
 



**Mobile Video Editing:** 




 Edit on the fly using VN/CapCut—stitching BTS footage, syncing audio beats for Trending Reels, and adding subtitles or text overlays quickly.
 



**3\. Inter\-Departmental Coordination** 




**Performance Marketing Team:** 




 Ensure the ads team receives high\-quality, high\-converting creatives on time.
 



**Influencer Team:** 




 Brief them on the brand language so they hire the right creators.
 



**Tech, SEO \& Strategy:** 




 Coordinate website banners and long\-term roadmaps.
 



**Finance \& Delivery (The Gatekeeper):** 




 Confirm to the Finance Team that all deliverables are completed and approved so that invoices can be raised.
 



**4\. Client Servicing** 




 Act as the Single Point of Contact (POC) for your accounts.
 



 Lead monthly/weekly status calls and present performance reports.
 



 Manage client expectations and approvals.
 



 Take care of the client growth.
 



**Candidate Requirements** 




**Experience:** 




 1–2 years in a Marketing/Creative Agency. You must have handled a portfolio of 6–8 active retainers simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
 



**Expansion Exposure:** 




 Proven track record in an agency that scaled its operations. You understand how to maintain quality control even when the volume of content and number of clients increase.
 



**Process Skills:** 




 Advanced ability to develop Creative Workflows, Approval SOPs, and Briefing Structures from the ground up to minimize revisions and delays.
 



**Technical Proficiency:** 




 Expert\-level knowledge of Canva Pro, VN/CapCut (for quick edits), and Google Workspace (Sheets/Slides for reporting).
 



**Mindset:** 




 A "Systems\-Thinker" who values stability, discipline, and professional accountability over chaos. You don't just "fix" problems; you build systems to prevent them.

title: Senior SEO/GEO & Online Reputation Management (ORM) Executive
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Senior SEO \& Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist to manage executive search presence and corporate brand reputation.
 



  





 The role involves developing and executing advanced SEO, SERP management, executive digital branding, and reputation management strategies. Candidates should have strong hands\-on experience in Reverse SEO, including managing challenging search results through credible content strategies, entity\-based SEO, and authoritative digital assets.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have experience beyond traditional SEO, with a strong understanding of Knowledge Graphs, digital PR, C\-suite personal branding, entity optimization, and advanced SERP management.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute data\-driven reverse SEO strategies to suppress negative, outdated, or unfavorable third\-party search results for branded and high\-profile executive keywords.
* Monitor Google SERP volatility, track target keyword movements, and conduct algorithmic gap analyses against high\-DA news publications.
* Formulate proactive defense architectures to protect executive and corporate brand queries from negative search capture.
* Build, optimize, and rank high\-authority digital properties (executive microsites, custom domains, Medium, Substack, LinkedIn Newsletters, Crunchbase, verified directories).
* Implement advanced Schema.org structured data (Person, Organization, sameAs, founder, alumniOf) to train the Google Knowledge Graph and secure rich Google Knowledge Panels.
* Supervise internal linking, domain consolidation (301 redirects, canonicalization), and crawl budget management across owned digital assets.
* Collaborate with PR desks to execute high\-impact sponsored content, editorial features, and executive interviews across Tier\-1 business and mainstream media.
* Audit and guarantee technical indexing, crawlability, and follow\-through authority of all published PR content.
* Guide content teams on producing authoritative thought\-leadership content that reinforces positive semantic associations while strictly avoiding controversial trigger words.
* Track real\-time sentiment, brand mentions, and SERP shifts using enterprise tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Brand24/Talkwalker).
* Prepare executive\-ready weekly SERP shift reports detailing position changes across Page 1 and Page 2 for key personal and corporate search queries.
* Perform deep diagnostic entity audits to identify and fix negative contextual associations in Google Knowledge Vault.
* Structure high\-equity digital asset networks that build long\-term domain authority and rank insulation.
* Coordinate rapid\-response content publishing during emerging online reputation crises.
* Ensure full compliance with search engine guidelines while maximizing algorithmic displacement impact.



  





  





**Requirements** 



* 4\+ years of core SEO experience, with at least 2\+ years dedicated to Online Reputation Management (ORM) or executive personal branding.
* Proven Track Record: Demonstrable case studies where you successfully displaced or pushed down high\-authority media links (DA 75\+) from Google Page 1\.
* Modern Algorithm Expertise: Deep understanding of Google’s modern quality systems (Helpful Content System, SpamBrain, E\-E\-A\-T, and Entity\-First Search).
* Technical SEO Proficiency: Mastery of canonical tags, indexation controls, crawl budget optimization, server redirects (301s), and Schema markup implementation.
* Understanding of Media \& Platforms: Clear understanding of how platforms like Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, Medium, and Tier\-1 digital PR affect Google's Knowledge Vault.
* Tools Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and SERP tracking platforms.
* Deep familiarity with digital PR syndication, wire distribution services, and sponsored authority placements.
* High degree of discretion, confidentiality, and maturity in managing sensitive corporate and executive information.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
KAN Universal is hiring a hands\-on Digital Marketing Specialist to generate qualified enquiries and improve the complete marketing system.

The role is not limited to running ads. The right person should understand where the real bottleneck is and work systematically to improve it:

**Traffic → Conversion → Lead Handling → Retention / Remarketing**

***Role Objective***

Bring the right audience to KAN Universal, convert that traffic into qualified enquiries, and build a consistent content engine that supports trust, engagement and demand generation.

***Core Areas of Work***

**PPC \& Google Ads**

Plan, launch and optimise search and performance campaigns. Manage keywords, budgets, bidding, ad copy, targeting and conversions.

**Meta Ads**

Run lead\-generation, awareness, retargeting and creative\-testing campaigns across Meta platforms.

**SEO**

Support keyword research, on\-page optimisation, content opportunities, Search Console monitoring and organic visibility.

**Content Strategy \& Calendar**

Plan a practical content calendar aligned with marketing objectives, customer questions, campaigns, seasonal moments and lead\-generation goals.

**Content Quality \& UGC**

Guide and manage content quality across brand posts, short\-form videos, customer stories and UGC. Ensure content is relevant, clear, on\-brand and useful to the target audience.

**Creative Collaboration**

Work hands\-on with the graphics team: share briefs, review drafts, improve messaging and ensure every creative supports the campaign objective.

**Conversion Optimisation**

Improve landing pages, offers, calls to action, forms and user journeys so more relevant visitors become enquiries.

***Key Responsibilities***

* Build and optimise Google Ads, PPC and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Track leads, cost per lead, conversion rates, campaign spend and return on investment.
* Diagnose whether poor results are caused by traffic quality, landing\-page conversion, lead handling or follow\-up.
* Create and manage a monthly and weekly content calendar.
* Plan the overall content strategy across organic social, paid creatives, UGC, educational content, testimonials and campaign\-led content.
* Write clear creative briefs and work closely with the graphics team from idea to final output.
* Review content for quality, brand fit, clarity, visual consistency and relevance before publishing.
* Coordinate UGC: identify useful customer stories or creator content, guide the brief, and ensure the final output meets the desired quality standard.
* Research keywords, competitors, audiences and customer intent.
* Improve campaign creatives, ad copy, targeting, landing pages and offers through regular testing.
* Set up and monitor relevant tracking through GA4, Google Search Console, pixels and conversion events.
* Create simple, clear reports: what happened, why it happened and what should be done next.
* Support remarketing and retention efforts for people who have already interacted with the business.
* Take ownership of marketing outcomes rather than only completing assigned tasks.
* What We Are Looking For
* Practical experience with PPC, Google Ads, SEO and Meta Ads.
* Experience creating content calendars and planning content around clear business objectives.
* A strong eye for content quality, messaging, hooks, visual direction and brand consistency.
* Comfort working directly with designers, editors, creators or a graphics team.
* Understanding of UGC and the ability to assess whether it feels credible, useful and aligned with the brand.
* A clear understanding of lead generation and performance marketing.
* Ability to explain campaigns in detail: objective, audience, budget, actions taken, metrics and results.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with numbers.
* Ability to identify the actual bottleneck before suggesting a solution.
* Curiosity, ownership and the habit of learning independently.
* A bias toward testing, measuring and improving.
* Preferred Tools \& Skills
* Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager
* GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager
* Keyword research and SEO tools
* Content\-planning tools and social\-media scheduling platforms
* Pixel, event and conversion tracking
* Landing\-page and conversion\-rate optimisation
* Excel or Google Sheets reporting
* What Success Looks Like
* A consistent increase in qualified enquiries.
* Better lead quality at an efficient cost.
* A content calendar that is planned, timely and connected to business goals.
* Stronger, more consistent content across organic posts, paid creatives and UGC.
* Clear visibility into which campaigns, content formats and channels are working.
* Faster identification and correction of funnel bottlenecks.
* Ongoing improvements in traffic, conversion, lead handling and remarketing.
* A marketer who thinks like an owner: diagnoses first, acts with purpose and learns from results.

***Ideal Candidate***

This role suits someone who enjoys solving practical problems, not simply running campaigns or posting content. You should be able to explain what you personally did, why you did it, what result it produced and what you learned when something did not work.

Pay: Up to ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Paid Search Specialist
description:
**About Darkroom**
------------------

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a **Senior Paid Search Specialist** \- a performance\-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross\-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI (some of these platforms don’t have ad services yet). Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.


Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.


You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high\-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.


This is a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands\-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end\-to\-end.


Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.
* Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.
* Obsession with the paid search advertising action, bid system, and market dynamics to best convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.
* Keen to develop innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search.
* Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.
* Manage between 6\-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Google, YouTube, Bing, and the emerging AI sSearch Platforms (Koah, Kontext) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $20,000 \- $3M.
* Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third\-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month\-over\-month and solve for attribution.
* Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.
* Understand industry\-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e\-commerce marketing funnel.
* Implement real\-time, proactive, and reactionary ad\-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up\-or\-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).
* Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.
* Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.
* Understand full\-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e\-commerce equation.
* Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.
* Willingness and openness to learn and understand e\-commerce P\&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

**What you'll need to be successful:**
--------------------------------------

* Mastery of the e\-commerce marketing funnel —\> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.
* 4\+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, Google in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).
* 3\+ years minimum managing paid search advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k\+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.
* Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative
* Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert
* Background in data\-derived decision\-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results
* Experience with all core e\-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM)

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
--------------------------------------


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Performance marketing travel
description:
We are hiring: Travel Performance Marketing and Lead Generation Specialist
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing and Lead Generation Specialist with proven experience in the travel industry.
   

  

 """This is not a generic digital marketing role."""
   

  

 We are specifically looking for someone who understands how travel customers search, enquire and make booking decisions, and has hands\-on experience generating travel leads through Meta Ads and Google Ads.
   

  

 Role: Travel Performance Marketing and Lead Generation Specialist
   

  

 Location: Delhi NCR
   

  

 Work Model: Hybrid, 4 days work from office
   

  

 Industry Experience: Travel industry experience is mandatory
   

  

 Experience: Hands\-on experience in Meta Ads and Google Ads with a proven track record of generating travel leads
   

  

 Salary: No bar for the right candidate
   

  

 What will you do?
   

  

 You will be responsible for generating and scaling qualified leads for our travel brand across domestic and international travel products.
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be to plan, execute, monitor and optimise Meta and Google campaigns for destinations, holiday packages, group tours, international trips, domestic holidays and other travel products.
   

  

 Key responsibilities:
   

  

 Plan and execute lead generation campaigns on Meta Ads and Google Ads specifically for travel products
   

  

 Develop destination\-specific campaign strategies based on customer intent, seasonality, travel trends and target audiences
   

  

 Generate high\-quality leads for domestic and international holiday packages
   

  

 Create and manage campaigns for different destinations, packages, offers and travel segments
   

  

 Identify the right audience based on destination, travel intent, demographics, interests and customer behaviour
   

  

 Continuously test different audiences, creatives, ad copies, offers and campaign structures
   

  

 Monitor CPL, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, lead quality, booking rates and overall campaign ROI
   

  

 Optimise campaigns not just for lead volume but for qualified enquiries and actual bookings
   

  

 Work closely with the sales team to understand lead quality and identify why leads are or are not converting
   

  

 Analyse the complete customer journey from advertisement to enquiry to booking
   

  

 Manage retargeting campaigns for website visitors, previous enquiries and engaged audiences
   

  

 Set up and monitor Meta Pixel, Google conversion tracking, events and other relevant tracking systems
   

  

 Manage and optimise advertising budgets across campaigns and destinations
   

  

 Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action quickly
   

  

 Research competitors, travel market trends, customer behaviour and emerging destinations to identify new campaign opportunities
   

  

 Prepare regular performance reports and provide clear insights on campaign performance
   

  

 What does a Lead Generation Specialist actually do in a travel company?
   

  

 The job is not simply to generate thousands of leads.
   

  

 A good travel lead generation specialist understands that a person enquiring for a Ladakh trip, Bali holiday, Thailand package or a Europe tour has different intent, budget, travel preferences and booking timelines.
   

  

 Your job is to identify the right audience, reach them with the right travel product and offer, generate the enquiry and continuously optimise the campaign so that the sales team receives genuine potential customers.
   

  

 You will be expected to understand metrics such as cost per lead, cost per qualified lead, lead\-to\-booking conversion, customer acquisition cost and campaign ROI.
   

  

 The ultimate objective is to help the business generate more qualified travel enquiries and bookings while maintaining efficient acquisition costs.
   

  

 Social Media Marketing experience will be an added advantage
   

  

 We would prefer candidates who can also contribute to the brand's social media growth.
   

  

 Experience in the following will be a plus:
   

  

 Instagram and Facebook marketing
   

  

 Travel content strategy
   

  

 Social media calendars
   

  

 Destination\-based content
   

  

 Reels and short\-form travel content
   

  

 Organic audience growth
   

  

 Travel offers and promotional campaigns
   

  

 Social media analytics
   

  

 Working with designers, video editors and content creators
   

  

 Who are we looking for?
   

  

 Someone who has already worked in the travel industry and understands the travel customer.
   

  

 You should have hands\-on experience running Meta and Google campaigns for a travel company, travel agency, tour operator, holiday brand, DMC or a similar travel business.
   

  

 You should be comfortable working with sales teams, analysing lead quality and making campaign decisions based on actual business outcomes.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who takes ownership of performance, experiments with new strategies and understands that successful travel marketing ultimately needs to contribute to enquiries and bookings.
   

  

 Travel industry experience is mandatory.
   

  

 If you have experience generating and scaling quality travel leads through Meta and Google and believe you can make a measurable impact on our business, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

 Salary is no bar for the right candidate.
   

  

 Apply now or share your profile with us.

title: Head of Digital Marketing

With stores in Gurgaon and Punjabi Bagh, and a growing e\-commerce platform at ibabyxpress.com, we're on a mission to become India's most trusted destination for premium baby essentials.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on Digital Marketing Head to own and scale iBaby's entire digital presence — from performance marketing and e\-commerce growth to SEO, brand building, and content. This is a leadership role for someone who can think in strategy but isn't afraid to get into the weeds — setting direction, building a small team, managing budgets, and being directly accountable for revenue and growth metrics across online and offline channels.

**Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Own the digital marketing roadmap and P\&L across SEO, paid media, social, content, email/CRM, and marketplace channels.

* Build, mentor, and manage a lean team of specialists/executives and external agencies/freelancers as needed.
* Manage and allocate the digital marketing budget across channels for maximum ROI.



  





**Performance Marketing \& E\-commerce Growth** 



* Plan and oversee paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and marketplace advertising (Amazon/Flipkart, if applicable).
* Own Shopify store strategy — CRO, landing pages, collections, product listings, and checkout funnel optimization.
* Track and improve key funnel metrics: traffic, AOV, conversion rate, repeat purchase rate, and customer LTV.



  





**SEO \& Organic Growth** 



* Set and oversee the SEO strategy — on\-page, off\-page, technical, and local SEO.
* Ensure the team executes keyword research, content optimization, link\-building, and technical audits effectively.
* Oversee local SEO and business listing management (Google Business Profile, Justdial, Sulekha, IndiaMART, etc.), including NAP consistency and review management across locations.



  





**Content \& Brand** 



* Define content strategy across the website, blog, and social channels in line with brand positioning.
* Collaborate with content writers, designers, and photographers/videographers to build a consistent brand voice.
* Guide social media strategy and influencer/partnership marketing where relevant.
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Set up and monitor dashboards using Google Analytics, GSC, and SEO/paid tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, etc.).
* Present monthly/quarterly performance reviews to leadership with clear insights and recommendations.
* Use data to continuously test, iterate, and optimize across channels.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with founders/leadership on brand and business strategy.

**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).
* 5–8\+ years of experience in digital marketing, with at least 2\+ years in a leadership/managerial capacity.
* Proven track record of driving measurable growth for a D2C/e\-commerce brand.
* Strong command of SEO, Google Ads/Meta Ads, Shopify, and analytics tools (GA4, GSC, SEMrush/Ahrefs).
* Experience managing budgets, teams, and/or agency relationships.
* Strong business acumen — comfortable discussing strategy, P\&L, and ROI with leadership.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and people\-management skills.
* Hands\-on mindset — willing to dive into execution when needed, not just strategy.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience in the baby/kids, parenting, or lifestyle retail category.
* Familiarity with CRM/retention tools (WhatsApp marketing, email automation).
