 This is a senior, high\-judgment role. You will not be writing at volume. You will be expected to bring clarity to complexity, make strategic tradeoffs in messaging, and help users understand Payoneer’s value within seconds.
   

  

 You will work closely with Product Marketing, Web, Growth, Design, Analytics, Legal and senior stakeholders to define how Payoneer sounds across its most critical website surfaces.

 Launches and Website\-Led Campaigns
   

  

* Lead website copy for product launches, feature releases, and pricing or packaging updates

 Must\-Have

* Experience working closely with designers, product marketers, and senior stakeholders

 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with payments, payroll, global hiring, compliance, or financial infrastructure products

* Experience mentoring or reviewing work of junior writers
* Stakeholders trust you with high\-visibility, high\-impact website narratives

**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
 If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

title: Account Manager - AEO, GEO & SEO
description:
**About Us**
 Seventh Triangle is a Shopify Premier Partner martech and commerce agency led by former D2C founders. We run performance, retention, SEO/AEO/GEO, CRO and Shopify development for 40\+ D2C brands across India, the UK, US, Australia and Middle East. We work in short sprints, decide on data, and are accountable to clients for revenue, not rankings.
   

  

**The role**
 You will own the AEO and GEO programme for D2C brands: getting them answered, cited and recommended in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, on top of a sound SEO foundation. This is not a "run the keyword report" seat. You are the client's single point of contact, you write the strategy, you direct the content, and when something goes off track it is yours to fix and yours to explain. We expect you to know which prompts a brand needs to win and which sources the AI engines are citing instead before you brief a single page.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Be the primary contact for your accounts: daily sync up, weekly check\-ins, monthly reviews that lead with organic revenue and AI citation share
* Write the AEO and GEO strategy for each brand: the prompt set to win, the sources being cited today, and the content and third\-party work it takes to become one of them
* Put the SEO foundation in first: technical health, crawlability for AI bots, entity and structured data, page intent, and what breaks on Shopify themes
* Own the content plan and its quality: answer\-first page structures, FAQ and knowledge base content, comparison and category pages. Write the briefs, edit the drafts, and fix them yourself when they will not get cited
* Build the brand's third\-party footprint (reviews, Reddit, Quora, listicles, comparison sites) because that is what the engines corroborate against
* Set up and run prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI Overviews, and AI referral reporting in GA4, so share of voice is a number the client can see move
* Brief content, tech and analytics with the right detail for each, track delivery weekly, and prioritise across accounts when the team is stretched, telling the affected client before they ask


**What This Role Is Not**
* A keyword research and reporting role
* A content writing seat with no client ownership
* A pure technical SEO or link\-building role
* Paid media or performance marketing


**What We Expect From You**
* 3 to 6 years in SEO or organic growth, at least 2 of them agency\-side across multiple accounts
* Been the client's point of contact yourself, including running reviews and delivering bad news
* At least 3 AEO or GEO change you personally shipped, with a before and after you can show
* A clear explanation, in your own words, of how AI engines choose what to cite and why that differs from how Google ranks a page
* Strong copy and editing sense: you can write an answer\-first page, fix a weak brief, and tell within a minute whether a draft will be cited
* Solid technical SEO grounding and hands\-on GA4, Search Console and Semrush or Ahrefs
* A prompt\-tracking method you have built or used to measure brand mentions across AI engines
* Fluent written and spoken English for international clients

description:
**About The Opportunity**
**Role:** 
 Revenue Management

 Deputy Manager/ Manager
   

  

**Location:**

 Senior Manager \- Revenue Management
   

  

**About The Function**
 With a deep understanding of Indian consumers' travel preferences, the Holidays team offers a vast range of holiday packages for destinations across the world.
   

  

 MMT Holidays is a leading name in the leisure travel space, serving over 3 lakh passengers annually. Our offerings span both domestic and international markets, catering to travellers across more than 50 destinations. With a strong focus on delivering exceptional travel experiences, we are a trusted choice for holiday packages.
   

  

 As part of this function, Revenue Management team plays a strategic role in unlocking growth and maximizing profitability. By leveraging data, market signals, and crossfunctional collaboration, the team drives pricing strategies, monitors category performance, and identifies opportunities to enhance conversion and revenue outcomes. It sits at the intersection of analytics and business, enabling data\-led decisions that shape the future of our Holidays business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As part of Holidays Revenue team, you will be responsible for handling revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for the role is an independent, self\-starter, quick\-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at crossfunctional collaboration, combine creativity with organisational skills, manage deliverables to tight deadlines, and have the ability to deliver high\-quality work under time constraints.
   

  

**What Will You Be Doing**
**P\&L and Revenue Management**
* Define \& drive the short term and long\-term growth agenda of the business while influencing various cross functional teams.
* Manage the business P\&L and devise strategies to achieve revenue goals.
* Tactically manage active revenue levers to achieve the daily margin, conversion and transaction goals.
* Lead discussions on the relevant banking and non\-banking alliances and execute tactical marketing campaigns.
* Track performance parameters and keep a tight control on business KPI numbers.
* Deep dive into competitor pricing data and use signals to improve category pricing.
* Deep dive onto demand signals / traffic data to decipher business and marketing strategy.
* Collaborate with marketing to devise and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns.
* Understand new markets \& segments – the trends/customer behavior and work with marketing, supply and product to maximize conversion basis those trends.
* Follow a stringent action plan and collaborate with the product team to increase platform conversion for the holidays category.
* Work with product teams to automate / improve pricing, business reporting and alerting mechanisms.
* Collaborate with operations team to devise and ensure smooth post\-sale processes.


**Data\-Driven Decision Making**
* Analyze large datasets to uncover meaningful trends and generate insights that drive business decisions.
* Build and run business experiments to validate hypotheses and test new initiatives.
* Conduct scenario modeling and forecasting to support strategic planning.
* Own reporting for the category and create automated dashboards and tools to track business performance.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Work closely with key internal stakeholders to align on priorities and drive execution.
* Communicate effectively across teams, manage multiple workstreams, and deliver under tight timelines


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MBA from a reputed institute with 5–7 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer\-facing, technology\-enabled business—preferably in the e\-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high\-growth, data\-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.


**Key Success Factors For The Role**
* A sharp business acumen with a mindset focused onmaximizing ROI, revenue, and overall business impact.
* Strong passion for data with an exceptional ability to break down and solve complex business problems using structured thinking and analytics.
* Excellentcommunication, interpersonal, and influencing skills, with the ability to manage and align multiple stakeholders effectively.
* A high\-energy team player with a positive attitude, strong ownership, and a collaborative approach to driving results in a dynamic environment.

 This position reports to the Senior Manager, Digital Marketing, is part of the Global Digital Marketing team within the Global Marketing and is a fully remote role.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in**

Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Leica Biosystems can provide.

description:
**Company Description** 





**Manaaf™️** 
 is a lifestyle modest fashion group in India, Southeast Asia as a direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) brand focused on delivering on\-trend, curated fashion tailored to meet the refined and modern needs of contemporary modern women. We are looking for an experienced
 
 Freelance Content Editor \& Brand Creative/Strategist for D2C,
 
 someone who understands
 
 D2C brand storytelling and knows how to make people stop scrolling and find the right audience to scale a brand in terms of customers
 
 . 
 



  





 🎨 Position:
 
 Content Editor \& Brand Creative/Strategist for D2C ( Freelance/ Contract)
 




 📍 Location: Park Street, Kolkata, India
 



 📅 Availability: In\-office/Hybrid
 



 Paid: Stipend will be decided based on portfolio/experience
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This contract role for a Freelance Content Editor \& Brand Creative/Strategist for D2C is a hybrid position based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with flexibility for partial work from home. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include editing and refining brand content across digital platforms, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with Manaaf™’s voice and values. The role involves collaborating on brand storytelling, developing content concepts for campaigns, and shaping messaging that resonates with modern and modest women in India and Southeast Asia. The editor and strategist will work closely with marketing, design, and product teams alongside with the founder to plan content calendars, review copy for product launches, and optimize content for engagement across web, email, and social channels.
 



  





**Skills Required** 



* Strong proficiency in video editing softwares such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro,etc.
* Deep understanding of Social media, marketing, Advertising videos — pacing, hooks, captions, transitions, and what makes content perform organically.
* A genuine eye for luxury and lifestyle aesthetics — clean, minimal, elevated visual storytelling.
* Ability to maintain consistent brand identity across multiple content formats without losing the brand's emotional tone.
* Experience editing for D2C brands — particularly fashion, lifestyle, or women\-focused brands.
* Strong understanding of colour grading, sound design, and caption styling within short form video.
* Comfort working independently with minimal hand\-holding — taking a brief and delivering beyond it.
* Ability to handle both indoor studio content and outdoor location shoots comfortably.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Ability to manage and organize digital content with strong Content Management skills.
* Demonstrated Editorial experience, including refining brand tone, structure, and narrative flow.
* Proficiency in Web Content Writing and Writing, with a focus on clear, concise, and audience\-focused messaging.
* Strong Research skills to understand target audiences, modest fashion trends, and competitive positioning.
* Experience or interest in fashion, lifestyle, or D2C brands, particularly in India and Southeast Asia.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup within the Kolkata metropolitan area, collaborating both in\-person and remotely.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across creative and business teams.
* Prior experience in brand strategy with D2C brands, content planning, or creative direction is an advantage.



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Content editing for Social Media Reels, Advertising , marketing ads, founder videos, UGC content, and social media posts — maintaining consistent brand identity throughout.
* Working closely with the founder to understand the brand story, voice, and aesthetic and translating that into every piece of content.
* Attending and assisting in indoor and outdoor shoots in and around Kolkata when required.
* Suggesting creative directions, hooks, transitions, and storytelling approaches that align with the brand identity and perform on Instagram.
* Keeping up with Social media trends, audio trends, and Reels best practices — and knowing when to use them and when not to.
* Delivering edits that are clean, intentional, and on\-brand — not templated or generic.
* Contributing to brand strategy and content planning conversations when required.

**Video Editor**

 You’ll work across different kinds of content, from brand and social videos to

 . We’re looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, has a strong design eye, and is interested in how products and technology are communicated visually.

* Edit videos from raw footage to final output, with a strong focus on
 **storytelling, pacing, and visual quality** 
 .
* Work closely with the team on concepts, scripts, storyboards, and how an idea should translate into video.
* Create
 **product and tool explainer videos** 
 that make complex features easier to understand.
* Create

* Turn static product screens into polished sequences for demos, launches, presentations, and social content.
* Work with typography, transitions, sound design, music, subtitles, and other elements required to make the final edit feel complete.
* Repurpose existing footage and content into different formats and shorter cuts when required.
* Experiment with
 **AI\-powered video, image, voice, and creative tools** 
 where they can improve the workflow or final output.
* Collaborate with designers, product teams, and other stakeholders to understand what needs to be communicated rather than simply executing an edit.
* Maintain consistency and quality across different videos and visual formats.



  





**What we’re looking for** 



* **Adobe Premiere Pro is a must.** 
 You should be comfortable using it as your primary editing tool and have a good understanding of the wider
 **Adobe Creative Suite** 
 .

 **UI/UX and graphic design**

 Please make sure you have an
 
**updated portfolio or showreel** 

 showcasing your recent and relevant work. We’d particularly love to see work involving
 
**video editing, storytelling, product videos, UI animations, explainers, motion, or visually interesting experiments** 

 .

title: Export Marketing Executive
description:
Next Naturals is India’s leading manufacturer of tropical fruit purees and concentrates and IQF fruits and vegetables. Our head office is based out of Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Our company does a wide variety of assorted fruit pulps such as mango pulp, guava pulp and avocado pulp, in addition to our fresh range of frozen fruits and vegetables such as peas, sweetcorn and papaya. We are a committed export house, focusing on the B2B segment and HORECA segment.
 



  





**JOB PROFILE:** 




 We are seeking a proactive and results\-driven Export Marketing Executive to focus on lead generation and new market development in export markets (GCC Area, USA and Asian Market). The primary responsibilities will include cold calling, emailing potential clients, building and maintaining relationships, and identifying new business opportunities in the international markets. 
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of global trade dynamics, excellent communication skills, and a passion for driving business growth. 
 



  




* **Lead Generation** 
 : Proactively identify, research, and generate new leads in international markets through cold calling, emailing, and other outreach strategies.
* **Market Research** 
 : Conduct in\-depth research to identify potential export markets, trends, and customer needs, and assess competitive landscapes.
* **Client Outreach** 
 : Initiate and maintain contact with potential customers to understand their needs and introduce the company’s product portfolio.
* **Relationship Building** 
 : Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, ensuring consistent follow\-up to nurture leads into opportunities.
* **New Market Development** 
 : Explore and develop new geographic regions, uncovering opportunities for the company's products in untapped export markets.
* **Sales Pipeline Management** 
 : Maintain an updated database of leads and prospects, track all interactions, and report on progress and outcomes using CRM tools and Google sheets
* **Product Knowledge** 
 : Develop an in\-depth understanding of the company’s products and services to effectively communicate the benefits to potential clients.
* **Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with the sales, marketing, and logistics teams to ensure smooth and efficient operations in expanding into new markets.
* **Reporting:** 
 Provide regular reports and insights on sales activities, lead generation, and market trends to the business development manager.
* **Export Documentation:** 
 Creation of export documentation for export shipments as and when required.
* **Marketing** 
 : Attending and exhibiting at different food exhibitions to develop company presence, generate leads and understand new market developments



  





 Requirements 
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, International Trade, or related field.
* Proven experience in business development, sales, or lead generation, preferably in export markets.
* Strong knowledge of international trade, export regulations, and global market trends.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in cold calling, emailing, and using CRM tools for lead management.
* Ability to work independently, with a proactive and results\-oriented mindset.

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING CONTENT CREATOR \& EDUCATOR 
 




  






 We're looking for a marketer who has actually run campaigns and can talk about them on camera in a way people stop scrolling for. You'll turn digital marketing trends, brand stories, tools and AI shifts into content that builds an audience, and you'll teach the concepts behind them to learners.
 




  






 EMPLOYMENT: Full\-time
 





 EXPERIENCE: 2–5 yrs hands\-on digital marketing
 





 LOCATION: Kochi · On\-site
 




  






 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 




  






 Create content that travels
 





 • Script, present and publish Reels, Shorts and YouTube videos on digital marketing trends, brand case studies and campaign breakdowns.
 





 • Spot trends early and turn them into content within hours, not weeks.
 





 • Write hooks, thumbnails and captions built for retention and shares.
 




  






 Teach marketing
 





 • Take live and recorded lectures on core concepts: paid ads, SEO, social media, content, analytics and funnels.
 





 • Run tool walkthroughs (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, SEO tools).
 





 • Cover upcoming AI trends in digital marketing and how marketers should use them.
 




  






 Guide careers
 





 • Make career\-guidance videos: job opportunities, roles, salaries, skills in demand, interview prep and portfolio tips.
 





 • Host Q\&As, webinars and live sessions with learners and followers.
 




  






 Own the numbers
 





 • Track views, watch time, saves, shares and follower growth; double down on what works.
 





 • Plan a weekly content calendar with the marketing and design team.
 




  






 MUST HAVE
 





 Paid marketing experience is non\-negotiable. We'll ask you to walk us through a real campaign you ran: budget, targeting, creatives, what failed and what you changed.
 





 • Hands\-on paid marketing: Has run live campaigns with real budgets on Meta Ads and/or Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube). Understands campaign structure, audiences, bidding, A/B testing and metrics like CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA and ROAS.
 





 • Strong on\-camera presence: Speaks fluently and confidently, with energy and clarity, without reading from a script. Comfortable with both short\-form and long\-form video.
 





 • Malayalam proficiency: Speaks Malayalam fluently and naturally on camera.
 





 • Storytelling: Can turn a brand campaign, case study or industry update into a story with a clear hook, tension and takeaway.
 





 • Up to date on trends and AI: Follows platform updates, algorithm changes and AI in marketing (generative AI for copy and creatives, AI\-driven ad products, AI search) and has a point of view on them.
 





 • Can teach: Explains complex marketing concepts simply and can structure a lecture or session from basics to advanced.
 





 • Understands short\-form content: Knows what makes Reels and Shorts perform: hooks in the first 3 seconds, pacing, retention, trends and platform algorithms.
 





 • A portfolio: Links to videos, social profiles, campaigns you ran, or recorded teaching sessions.
 




  






 ADDED ADVANTAGE
 





 • An existing audience: Your own Instagram, YouTube or LinkedIn following, or content of yours that has gone viral.
 





 • Practical SEO knowledge: Keyword research, on\-page optimisation, technical SEO basics, content SEO, and working knowledge of Google Search Console and GA4\.
 





 • Mobile video editing: Can shoot and edit quick\-turnaround content on a phone using apps like CapCut, VN, InShot or Instagram Edits.
 





 • Teaching or training background: Past experience as a trainer, faculty member, mentor or in edtech.
 





 • Agency or multi\-brand exposure: Has handled campaigns across different industries and budgets.
 





 • AI content tools: Hands\-on with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, HeyGen, ElevenLabs or Runway for scripting, visuals and video.
 




  






 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS
 





 • A consistent publishing rhythm across Instagram and YouTube, with at least one series that has a recognisable format.
 





 • Measurable growth in reach, watch time and followers, plus content that clearly beats the account's average.
 





 • A set of lectures delivered on paid ads, SEO and AI in marketing, with good learner feedback.

The brand blends modern silhouettes, refined detailing, and high\-quality fabrics to create pieces that feel both effortless and premium. Collections are designed to bridge the gap between trend and timelessness, offering versatile and flattering options for daily wear. As a growing startup, Kean.Club is driven by creativity, attention to detail, and a clear vision to build a distinctive premium fashion label.
 



  






 As a Performance Marketing Executive at Kean.Club, you will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns across Meta and Google platforms.
 




  






 This is a results\-driven role.
 




  






 You will be measured on ROI, cost efficiency, lead quality, and campaign scalability — not just impressions or clicks.
 




  






 You will collaborate closely with Social Media Executive, Content Writer, Designers, and the Sales team to align paid campaigns with business goals.
 




  





 Requirements
 



  




* 1–4 years of hands\-on experience managing paid ad campaigns.
* Proven track record of generating leads, conversions, or sales through Meta and Google Ads.
* Strong understanding of full\-funnel performance strategy (TOF, MOF, BOF).
* Skills and measurable results matter more than formal education. Degree is not mandatory with proven performance outcomes.
* Experience managing campaign budgets and optimising for CPA/ROAS.
* Strong analytical ability and reporting discipline.


- 


 Responsibilities
 



  




* 1\. Campaign Strategy \& Setup Plan and execute campaigns on Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. Structure campaigns based on business goals (lead generation, sales, awareness). Define targeting, creatives, and funnel strategy.
* 2\. Optimization \& Scaling Monitor daily performance and optimize campaigns. Improve CTR, reduce CPA, and increase ROAS. Conduct A/B testing for creatives, audiences, and copy. Scale winning campaigns strategically.
* 3\. Analytics \& Reporting Track campaign metrics including CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and Conversion rate. Submit structured weekly performance updates. Prepare detailed monthly performance reports with insights and next\-step recommendations.
* 4\. Collaboration \& Funnel Alignment Work with content and design teams for ad creatives. Align landing pages with campaign objectives. Ensure tracking setup using Meta Pixel, Google Tag, and conversion tracking tools.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
The Head of Marketing will
 **make the Sturlite brand the company's core differentiator** 
 and the engine that fire\-powers the next phase of growth. Working directly with the Promoters and the leadership team, the role owns the complete marketing charter – brand, category, channel, digital and insights – with a high degree of independence and accountability for business outcomes, not just marketing outputs.
 



 In practical terms, the role must:
 


* Build a brand that commands
 **preference and pricing power** 
 in categories that are highly commoditised and dominated by large national players.
* Use brand equity to
 **de\-risk and accelerate new category launches** 
 – so that Wires \& Cables and Switches win channel confidence and consumer trust faster than they could on their own.
* Create
 **pull in new geographies** 
 so that sales expansion into new states and markets is brand\-led, not scheme\-led.
* Define a
 **coherent brand architecture** 
 across Sturlite, Voltedge, Zeovolt and Araya Health that the organisation can scale for years.



 What Success Looks Like
 



**First 6–12 months** 



* A clear brand strategy, positioning and brand architecture, signed off by the Promoters and understood across the organisation.
* Baseline brand health measures (awareness, consideration, preference) established for priority categories and markets.
* A repeatable launch playbook in use for new categories, with Wires \& Cables and Switches marketing plans live in priority markets.
* A lean, capable marketing team and agency roster in place, with an annual plan and budget linked to revenue goals.



**In 24–36 months** 



* Measurable gains in awareness and preference in core and expansion markets, reflected in channel pull and price realisation.
* New categories contributing a meaningful and growing share of revenue, with brand as a visible driver of adoption.
* A strong electrician and influencer franchise that works across the full product portfolio.
* Sturlite recognised by channel partners and consumers as a multi\-category electrical brand, not only a lighting company.



 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Brand Strategy, Positioning \& Architecture** 



* Own the Sturlite brand – purpose, positioning, promise and identity – and make it a genuine point of difference against national and regional competitors.
* Define the brand architecture across the corporate brand, category brands (Voltedge) and adjacent businesses (Zeovolt, Araya): when to lead with the master brand, when to build a sub\-brand, and how equity transfers across categories.
* Build the communication architecture and ensure consistency across every consumer, influencer and trade touchpoint – from TVCs and digital to retailer signage, packaging and product literature.
* Plan and deploy ATL, BTL, digital and retail investments for maximum brand\-building impact within a disciplined budget.



**2\. New Category Launches \& Portfolio Marketing** 



* Lead go\-to\-market for new categories – Wires \& Cables, Switchgear and Switches \& Accessories – covering positioning, pricing inputs, launch communication, channel activation and post\-launch tracking.
* Build a standard launch playbook with Product, Sales and Supply Chain so that every launch is on time, well\-supported in market and measured against clear targets.
* Protect and grow Lighting – the base business – with full rigour while building cross\-category leverage (bundling, shared counter presence, cross\-selling through existing partners).
* Identify portfolio gaps and new category opportunities using consumer, channel and competitive insight.



**3\. Geography Expansion** 



* Partner with Sales leadership to prioritise expansion markets and build market\-entry marketing plans for new states and under\-penetrated regions.
* Design region\-specific and vernacular communication that builds brand familiarity ahead of and alongside distribution expansion.
* Deploy visibility, merchandising and activation programmes that help new distributors and retailers sell Sturlite from day one.
* Track market\-level brand health and share, and reallocate investment to where it works.



**4\. Influencer, Channel \& Trade Marketing** 



* Build and scale the electrician, contractor, architect and builder engagement programme – a key purchase influencer in electrical categories – across the full portfolio.
* Drive General Trade marketing – schemes, retailer engagement, counter share, visibility and secondary sales programmes – with clear ROI measurement.
* Develop marketing approaches for Modern Trade, E\-commerce and institutional/B2B (projects, builders, government) channels as they scale.
* Equip the sales force with the tools, content and narratives needed to sell new categories confidently.



**5\. Digital, Content \& E\-commerce** 



* Lead digital brand building – social, content, search, performance marketing and marketplace presence.
* Build a content engine that educates consumers and influencers on product safety, quality and differentiation (e.g. copper purity, FR/ZHFR standards, certifications).
* Use digital and data to generate demand and leads, and to measure and optimise spend continuously.



**6\. Insights \& Marketing Effectiveness** 



* Build a structured understanding of consumers, influencers and channel partners across categories and regions – purchase drivers, barriers and switching triggers.
* Track competitors' launches, pricing, promotions and communication, and translate insight into action.
* Institute brand health tracking and marketing ROI measurement; own the marketing budget and present performance to the Promoters and leadership team.



**7\. Promoter Partnership, Team \& Ecosystem Leadership** 



* Work as a trusted partner to the Promoters – bring a strong point of view, challenge constructively, and translate their vision into a brand and marketing roadmap.
* Own the marketing charter end\-to\-end with independence – set priorities, make decisions and be accountable for results.
* Build, lead and develop a high\-performing marketing team (brand, category, trade, digital, creative), growing it in step with the business.
* Select and lead creative, media, digital, research and activation agencies; hold them to clear business outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Finance to ensure marketing is fully integrated with the business plan.



 Key Performance Indicators
 


* **Brand health:** 
 awareness, consideration and preference in core and expansion markets; share of voice.
* **Business impact:** 
 revenue and market share growth; price realisation versus competition; GT, MT and E\-commerce growth.
* **New categories:** 
 launch timelines met; category revenue and distribution against plan; repeat and cross\-category purchase.
* **Geography expansion:** 
 brand awareness and retail penetration in new markets; time to break\-even for new markets.
* **Influencer franchise:** 
 active electrician/influencer base and engagement across categories.
* **Effectiveness:** 
 marketing ROI, cost per lead/acquisition, budget discipline.



 Candidate Profile
 



**Must\-haves** 



* **15–20\+ years** 
 in marketing, including
 **5\+ years leading brand or category marketing** 
 in FMEG, Electricals, Consumer Durables, Consumer Electronics or FMCG with strong channel exposure.
* A proven record of
 **building a brand that became a business differentiator** 
 – with evidence of impact on share, pricing or growth.
* Hands\-on experience of
 **launching and scaling new categories** 
 and
 **taking a brand into new geographies** 
 .
* Deep understanding of General Trade, distributor/dealer/retailer ecosystems and influencer\-led purchase (electricians, contractors, architects).
* Experience managing agencies and significant marketing budgets with a sharp ROI focus.
* Strong commercial and analytical skills; comfortable talking P\&L, not just campaigns.



**Strongly preferred** 



* Experience working
 **directly with promoters or founders** 
 in a promoter\-led or high\-growth company.
* Exposure to building a marketing function or brand from an early stage, with lean resources.
* Experience with multi\-brand or multi\-category brand architecture.
* Background in Wires \& Cables, Switches \& Switchgear, Lighting, Fans or Home Appliances.



 Who Will Thrive Here
 



 This role is for a builder, not a caretaker. The person we are looking for:
 


* **Has a go\-getter, owner mindset** 
 – takes charge of the charter, sets the pace and gets things done without waiting for direction.
* **Works with independence and judgement** 
 – comfortable making decisions, backing them, and being accountable for outcomes.
* **Partners well with Promoters** 
 – builds trust quickly, communicates with clarity and candour, and can align strong views into one direction.
* **Is strategic and hands\-on in equal measure** 
 – can shape the brand vision in the boardroom and work a retail counter or an electrician meet the same week.
* **Thrives in pace and ambiguity** 
 – energised by a fast\-growing, entrepreneurial environment where processes are still being built.
* **Leads through people** 
 – attracts strong talent and builds a team that can scale with a Rs 4,000 Cr business.

title: Senior Content Marketing Manager
description:
**About SpotDraft**
 SpotDraft is on a mission to enable legal and business teams to velocity\-bind their growth. Our AI\-native contract management platform is fundamentally redefining legal operations — and our brand narrative demands storytelling that is sharp, human, and unmistakable.
   

  

 We are searching for a
 **Sr. Content Marketing Manager** 
 to architect and execute how SpotDraft communicates across markets. In this role, you will bridge analytical rigour with high\-caliber editorial craft, transforming primary industry data, customer insights, and emerging market trends into authoritative content engines. The ideal candidate blends deep editorial sensibilities with a quantitative approach to distribution, seamlessly pivoting between long\-form flagship reports and sharp, conversion\-focused messaging.

title: Product Director
description:

**Who We Are.**
 Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world\-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end\-to\-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional\-level clients.
   

  

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**
 As Product Director, you will play a key role in shaping and scaling Axi’s global product strategy across our trading ecosystem.
   

  

 This is a broad product leadership role covering client experience, trading experience, growth, partner platforms, onboarding, engagement, retention, and operational scalability. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Trading, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Sales, Operations, and regional teams to define priorities, drive execution, and deliver product experiences that create measurable value for our clients and the business.
   

  

 You will help translate business strategy into a clear product roadmap, strengthen product discipline, and ensure teams are focused on the highest\-impact opportunities.
   

  

**Your EDGE Assignment/You Will**
* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across key areas of Axi’s global product ecosystem.
* Lead product planning across trading experience, client lifecycle, growth, partner platforms, onboarding, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
* Translate company priorities and commercial objectives into clear product strategies, measurable outcomes, and prioritised delivery plans.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Trading, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and regional stakeholders to deliver product initiatives end\-to\-end.
* Use client insights, product analytics, trading behaviour, funnel metrics, market research, and competitor analysis to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.
* Drive improvements across the full client lifecycle, including acquisition, onboarding, activation, trading engagement, funding, account management, reporting, retention, and reactivation.
* Work with Trading, eFX, Middle Office, Risk, and Operations teams to ensure product decisions are grounded in execution quality, trade lifecycle, platform performance, regulatory expectations, and operational resilience.
* Lead prioritisation across competing initiatives, balancing client value, business impact, compliance, risk, technical feasibility, delivery capacity, and long\-term scalability.
* Define success metrics and ensure product initiatives are measured against adoption, engagement, revenue impact, retention, conversion, operational efficiency, and client outcomes.
* Coach and guide Product Managers, helping them improve product thinking, stakeholder management, prioritisation, commercial awareness, and execution quality.
* Build a strong product culture based on ownership, clarity, client focus, data\-led decisions, commercial impact, and continuous improvement.


**Are you the one?**
* You have strong product leadership experience, with a proven track record of owning and scaling complex digital products across web and/or mobile platforms.
* You have experience leading product strategy, roadmap planning, discovery, delivery, launch, measurement, and continuous optimisation. You have worked in fintech, trading, investing, brokerage, payments, financial services, platform, marketplace, or similarly complex digital environments.
* You understand how product decisions influence acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, revenue, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
* You are comfortable operating in a regulated environment where product decisions must balance growth, client experience, risk, compliance, and operational resilience.
* You can translate complex business, technical, trading, operational, and regulatory requirements into clear product priorities and scalable product experiences.
* You are data\-led, commercially sharp, and confident using analytics, customer insights, market research, experimentation, and performance metrics to make product decisions.
* You have strong stakeholder management skills and can influence senior leaders while maintaining product discipline and focus.
* You have experience coaching or managing Product Managers and improving the quality of product thinking and execution.
* You communicate clearly, operate with strong ownership, and bring a bias towards action.


**Axi's bag of delights**
* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities, such as professional training and certifications and soft skills development.
* 18 annual leave days per year.
* 12 sick days leave per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health Insurance.


**Axi's interview journey**
* Talent Acquisition Interview (45 minutes)
* Final Interview (45 minutes)

title: Principal Solution Consultant - General Insurance Industry
description:
**Summary**
 The Principal Solution Consultant is a high\-impact, strategic leadership role essential to Guidewire’s India Market Entry \& Penetration. You will be a pivotal member of the India Go\-to\-Market (GTM) engine, working in lockstep with Field Leadership to transform Guidewire from a global leader into a dominant local force.
   

  

 You are a "Market Pioneer" responsible for translating Guidewire’s global SaaS value proposition into a winning strategy for Indian Tier\-1 and Tier\-2 insurers. Your mission is to disrupt the status quo held by legacy incumbents like by proving Guidewire’s superior agility in the General Insurance industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 Guidewire’s Go to Market organization is focused on scaling AI‑powered innovation, expanding into new markets and product categories, and ensuring every customer is successful and referenceable through structured, data‑driven execution and tight cross‑functional alignment.
   

  

 As a Principal Solution Consultant, you sit at the intersection of this vision and our India growth strategy, serving as the senior field‑facing authority on how Guidewire’s platform, cloud services, and ecosystem can unlock value for Indian insurers.
   

  

 Operating as a key member of the regional GTM leadership team, you will design and execute market‑entry and expansion plays for India, partnering closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, and our partner ecosystem. You will champion local market needs back into our global roadmap while coaching and scaling an India‑based Solution Consulting team. This is a high‑impact, highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable in the boardroom, on customer sites, and in the details of complex insurance workflows.
   

  

**Core Objectives**
* Go\-to\-Market Strategy: Co\-own and execution of the Indian GTM strategy.
* Strategic Deal Lead: Own the functional "Win Theme" for major prospects, moving beyond feature lists to business outcomes.
* Market Challenger: Effectively position Guidewire as the modern SaaS alternative to legacy incumbents.
* Executive Advisor: Have the gravitas to engage with C\-suite stakeholders (CEO, CTO, Business Unit Leaders).
* Thought Leadership: Act as the voice of the Indian market, specifically regarding industry trends, to influence global product roadmaps.
* You’ll work closely with Indian customers, SI Partners, internal product and field teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to achieve the above objectives. You’ll also support the development of our local team and help scale our operation across the market.


**Key Responsibilities**
* GTM Strategy \& Execution: Partner with Field Leadership to refine the India penetration plan. Identify high\-propensity targets, define regional "Win Themes," and tailor the global sales playbook for the Indian context.
* Strategic Market Research: Conduct "boots\-on\-the\-ground" discovery to identify unique Indian functional gaps (e.g., specific IRDAI compliance workflows, UPI\-based real\-time claims, or localized Health TPA models) vs Guidewire’s "Out\-of\-the\-Box" (OOTB) features.
* Competitive Intelligence: Build a detailed "Battlecard" against local incumbents. Identify their architectural weaknesses in the Indian market and train the wider field team on how to exploit them.
* End\-to\-End Deal Ownership: Lead the functional sales cycle, from initial discovery and RFI/RFP management to final selection and contract alignment.
* Field Leadership Collaboration: Act as the primary technical/functional advisor to the Regional Sales Director and Managing Director. Provide the "solution air cover" needed to close the first wave of lighthouse customers.
* Consultative Discovery: Uncover the "pain behind the pain" in a prospect’s current operations (e.g., rigid legacy codebases, slow speed\-to\-market for new products).
* Solution Design: Partner with Account Executives to build a cohesive business case, ensuring all functional risks are mitigated.
* Product Localization Advocacy: Collate recurring requirements from Indian prospects and present a prioritized "India Roadmap" to Global Product Management.
* Team Leadership: Develop the India\-based Solution Consulting team by coaching them on advanced storytelling, competitive positioning, and executive presence.
* Ecosystem Integration: Work with the Guidewire Marketplace and local partners to demonstrate a "frictionless" insurance experience (e.g., integrating with the India Stack, UPI, and AI\-driven fraud detection).


**Product \& Domain Expertise**
* India P\&C Mastery: Deep expertise in the Indian General Insurance market.
* Competitive Displacement: Proven ability to position modern SaaS against legacy core insurance solutions. You must be able to articulate why a modern cloud platform beats a "One\-Size\-Fits\-All" legacy suite.
* Digital Ecosystem (India Stack): Knowledge of how to leverage Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker within the insurance lifecycle to create a frictionless, paperless customer journey.
* Guidewire Cloud Value: Ability to sell the "Evergreen" nature of SaaS—proving to Indian CIOs that they will never have to perform a painful 2\-year legacy upgrade again.


**Professional Experience**
**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* 12\+ Years in Enterprise Pre\-Sales/Solution Consulting: A proven track record of leading functional sales cycles for complex, high\-value SaaS or Core Systems (Policy, Billing, Claims).
* Market Entry Expertise: Experience working in a "pioneer" or "early\-hire" capacity for a global technology firm entering the Indian market is highly desirable.
* Competitive Displacement: Demonstrated success in unseating legacy or entrenched incumbents (specifically TCS BaNCS, SAP, or Oracle) within the Indian Financial Services sector.


**Domain \& Technical Mastery**
* Indian P\&C Specialist: Deep functional expertise in general insurance. You should understand the nuances of the Indian "Grid" system, TPA integrations, and IRDAI product filing requirements.
* Cloud/SaaS Evangelist: While Guidewire experience is a plus, you must have a strong grasp of Cloud\-native architectures (AWS/Azure) and the ability to sell the business value of "Evergreen" software over traditional on\-premise and custom build models.
* Digital Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, eSign) and how these technologies are being leveraged to digitize the insurance value chain.


**Leadership \& Strategic Skills**
* Field Partnership: Experience working as a "Strategic Right Hand" to Sales VPs or Managing Directors to build and execute a Go\-to\-Market (GTM) plan.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional "C\-Suite" communication skills; the ability to challenge the thinking of a CEO/CIO and move them from a "safe" legacy choice to a transformative platform.
* Consultative Storytelling: Mastery of "The Challenger Sale" or similar methodologies—turning dry product features into a compelling business narrative that addresses specific Indian market pain points.


**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
   

  

 Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**Director, Product Management – Core Data and Decision Intelligence**
**Target in India \| L7**
**About Us**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.
   

  

 Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
   

  

 Target is investing in the next generation of
 **intelligent store experiences** 
 that connect operational, digital and physical environments to create smarter outcomes for guests, team members and the business.
   

  

 Our Core Intelligence Product teams are building the foundational capabilities that enable Target’s stores to
 **understand what is happening, anticipate what matters, recommend the right actions, and continuously learn from outcomes** 
 .
   

  

**About the Job – Director, Product Management, Core Data and Decision Intelligence**
 As Director of Product Management for
 **Core Intelligence** 
 , you will help define and build the intelligence foundation powering the future of Target’s store operations and experiences.
   

  

 You will lead a portfolio of highly technical products that bring together signals from operational systems, store environments and enterprise platforms; transform those signals into trusted context; and use data science, AI and intelligent systems to generate actionable recommendations at scale.
   

  

 Your work will enable Target to move beyond static rules and fragmented signals toward
 **context\-aware, continuously learning intelligence** 
 that can power multiple Store products, workflows and experiences.
   

  

 Based in Target in India, you will lead Product Managers and partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams to identify high\-value problems, develop reusable intelligence capabilities and translate technology investments into measurable outcomes for Target’s stores.
   

  

**Intelligence Product Vision \& Strategy**
* Define and execute the product vision and strategy for a portfolio of foundational Core Intelligence capabilities.
* Shape how operational and physical signals are transformed into trusted context, insights and recommendations that power Store experiences.
* Build scalable, reusable intelligence capabilities that can serve multiple products, workflows and operational domains.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI/ML, predictive intelligence, recommendation systems, simulation and emerging technologies to solve complex Store problems.
* Translate enterprise and Stores priorities into clear product strategies, investment choices, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Balance near\-term business value with development of durable intelligence capabilities that can scale across Target.


**Product Discovery \& Intelligence Capability Development**
* Develop a deep understanding of Target’s store operating environment and identify opportunities where intelligence can meaningfully improve decisions and experiences.
* Establish strong discovery mechanisms across Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations to move from problems to hypotheses, experiments and scalable solutions.
* Drive rapid experimentation, simulation and learning to validate opportunities before scaling investments.
* Build feedback loops that allow intelligence capabilities to learn from outcomes and improve over time.
* Ensure intelligence products are designed for trust, explainability, interoperability, scalability and long\-term extensibility.


**Product \& Organizational Leadership**
* Lead and develop Product Managers across a portfolio of highly technical intelligence products.
* Create clear product ownership, accountability, success metrics and decision rights across the portfolio.
* Build a strong Product organization in Target in India with deep technical, strategic and business acumen.
* Coach Product Managers to lead through customer problems, discovery, evidence and outcomes rather than requirements and delivery.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, ownership and continuous learning.
* Establish product operating mechanisms that enable empowered teams while maintaining alignment across a complex ecosystem.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Influence**
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams.
* Influence senior leaders and partners across geographies without relying on direct authority.
* Translate complex technical and intelligence concepts into clear product and business narratives.
* Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities to create alignment around strategic investments.
* Help establish clear boundaries and interfaces between reusable Core Intelligence capabilities and the experiences they power.


**About You**
* 4\-year college degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree in technology, engineering, data science, business or a related field is a plus.
* 8\+ years of Product Management experience, preferably across highly technical, data\-intensive, AI/ML, platform or enterprise products.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and leading complex product portfolios.
* Experience leading and developing Product Managers.
* Strong understanding of data\-driven products, AI/ML concepts, recommendation systems, intelligent platforms or related technology domains.
* Proven ability to translate complex technology into customer and business outcomes.
* Strong systems thinking and ability to connect multiple capabilities into a coherent product strategy.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influence skills.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and solving problems where neither the solution nor the path is obvious.

title: Lead Generation & GTM Leader

 MathCo is looking for a seasoned Lead Generation \& GTM Leader to own and scale our emerging verticals outbound engine — generating qualified pipeline across both existing client accounts (mining) and net\-new logos. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role that sits at the intersection of strategic go\-to\-market thinking and hands\-on execution.
 



 You will build, manage, and mentor a team of lead generation and outbound specialists, deploying data\-driven prospecting strategies, campaign frameworks, and partnership ecosystems to fuel MathCo's growth in analytics and AI services. You will work closely with delivery leaders, portfolio owners, and the broader GTM team to ensure the right accounts are prioritized, the right messages land, and the sales pipeline moves efficiently.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Outbound Engine \& Pipeline Generation** 



* Own the end\-to\-end outbound lead generation engine — from target account identification and lead database build to campaign activation, M1 meeting generation, and pipeline qualification.
* Drive a rigorous outreach cadence across digital, event, and partner channels to generate M1 meetings at scale — with a clear conversion target from outreach to qualified meeting.
* Lead the mining motion for existing clients — identifying white space within current logos, mapping stakeholders, and coordinating with farming leaders to unlock new revenue streams.

**Strategy, Intelligence \& Measurement** 



* Define and refine the target account list across verticals — using analytics maturity signals, competitive intelligence, spend indicators, and stakeholder mapping to prioritize accounts with the highest MathCo fit.
* Own GTM analytics: track and report on input metrics (outreaches, campaigns, in\-person M1s) and outcome metrics (M1 generation, M1→M2 conversion, funnel velocity, pipeline value) weekly and monthly.
* Continuously optimize campaign themes, outreach content, and targeting strategies based on conversion data — partnering with Scout and delivery leaders on content and best practices.
* Monitor competitor presence in target accounts and brief internal stakeholders on displacement opportunities and engagement risks.



  





**Industry Focus** 




 Proven lead generation experience in one or more of the following verticals is required:
 



* **B2B / Technology**
* **Manufacturing \& Industrial**
* **BFSI**
* **HiTech \& Emerging Tech**

* Prior experience at an analytics, data science, or AI services company is strongly preferred — with a clear understanding of how analytics solutions are positioned and sold to enterprise buyers.
* Proven track record of building and running high\-volume outbound engines — managing reachout campaigns, meeting generation programmes, and conversion funnels at scale.
* Experience working within or alongside a partnership ecosystem (cloud hyperscalers, data platforms) as a channel for lead generation and pipeline co\-creation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a matrixed environment — collaborating with delivery leaders, portfolio managers, alliance teams, and senior stakeholders to align pipeline priorities.



  





**Skills \& Capabilities** 



* Outbound strategy \& execution: campaign design, multi\-channel prospecting, cadence management, and persona\-based outreach at enterprise scale.
* Data\-driven GTM: comfortable with funnel analytics, conversion benchmarking, and using insights to continuously optimise pipeline strategy.

* Team leadership: experience hiring, coaching, and holding a team accountable against measurable pipeline KPIs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Commercial acumen: understands enterprise buying cycles, knows how to keep deals warm across long sales cycles, and can engage credibly with senior client stakeholders.

 📊

**INPUT METRICS** 



* Outreach volume per week / month
* Campaigns activated per quarter
* Account penetration \& functional coverage



  





**OUTCOME METRICS** 



* Leads/Prospects \- meetings generated
* Pipeline value created \& revenue contribution

title: Category Management - Jewellery
description:
**About the role:** 




 We are looking for a Category Management professional – Jewellery to own and scale the Jewellery category at FirstClub.
 



 This role will involve building the right assortment, identifying and onboarding brands/vendors, driving category growth, managing pricing and margins, and ensuring strong availability and customer experience. The ideal candidate combines commercial understanding, strong analytical skills, vendor management capabilities, and a sharp understanding of consumer trends in Jewellery.

* Own the overall P\&L and growth charter for the Jewellery category.
* Develop category strategy across assortment, pricing, promotions, availability and customer experience.

* Define and track key category metrics such as revenue, margins, conversion, ASP, sell\-through, availability and repeat purchase.



**2\. Assortment \& Selection** 



* Build a differentiated and relevant Jewellery assortment based on customer needs and market trends.
* Identify assortment gaps and opportunities across segments, price points, styles and occasions.

* Own category pricing strategy and ensure competitive pricing across key products.
* Plan and execute category\-level promotions and campaigns.

**5\. Data \& Analytics** 



* Use category and customer data to identify trends, opportunities and business risks.
* Build regular dashboards/reports to track category performance.
* Translate data into actionable insights around assortment, pricing, inventory, customer behaviour and vendor performance.
* Conduct competitor and market benchmarking.



**6\. Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Growth, Marketing, Supply Chain, Catalog, Product, Finance and Operations teams.
* Coordinate new launches, campaigns, inventory planning and category initiatives.
* Drive projects end\-to\-end with strong ownership and execution focus.



  





**What we're looking for:** 



* 3–6 years of experience in Category Management / Buying / Merchandising / Business Management, preferably in Jewellery, Fashion, Lifestyle, Beauty or a related consumer category.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work with large datasets.
* Experience in vendor/brand management and commercial negotiations.
* Strong understanding of category metrics, margins, pricing and assortment planning.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with BI/analytics tools is a plus.

title: Head - Voice of Customer
description:
At Swish, we want to build a strong understanding of what customers want, what they love, and what makes them unhappy — and use that understanding to continuously improve the food and experience we offer.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head – Voice of Customer to build this function from the ground up.
 



 You will own Swish's Voice of Customer program end\-to\-end — from understanding what customers want before we launch a product, to capturing feedback after launch, identifying recurring problems, and working with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to fix them.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**Build Swish's Voice of Customer Engine** 




  





 Design and run an always\-on customer feedback system across the customer journey, covering pre\-launch research, new product feedback, negative\-rating triage, customer immersions, interviews, targeted outreach and surprise audits. Decide what we need to learn, from whom, how frequently and through which channel, using the right mix of qualitative and quantitative research.
 



  





**Turn Feedback Into Action** 




  





 Go beyond collecting feedback to identify the actual problem, understand its root cause and determine whether it is a one\-off, product or category\-level issue. Work closely with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to turn customer feedback → root cause → action → measurable improvement. The role will be measured on issues resolved and outcomes improved, not the number of calls or insights generated.
 



  





**Prioritise Research \& Drive Decisions** 




  





 Build the framework to determine which categories and SKUs need deeper research, when to trigger audits, when patterns need escalation and where the VoC team's time and resources should be invested. Bring customer evidence into decisions around new launches, recipe changes, relaunches, taste, quality, portioning, pricing, packaging and assortment.
 



  





**Build \& Lead the VoC Team** 




  





 Hire, coach and manage the initial VoC team, set clear goals and operating cadences, and build strong capabilities in customer conversations, probing, research and root\-cause identification. Create a team that is accountable for outcomes rather than activity.
 



  





**Continuously Improve the System** 




  





 Own and improve the questionnaires, interview frameworks, sampling, feedback channels, tracking, reporting, escalation mechanisms and research methodology as the business grows.
 



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 8\+ years of overall experience, with 3–4\+ years of people management experience.
* Experience building and running customer research, insights or CX programs in\-house, rather than only managing external agencies.
* Experience in consumer internet, food\-tech, FMCG or another high\-frequency consumer business.
* Experience running customer research or feedback programs at operational scale — not just occasional market research projects.
* Someone who has owned a business/customer metric end\-to\-end, rather than only producing reports or insights for another team.
* Experience working closely with Operations, Category/Product, Quality and other cross\-functional teams to drive changes based on customer feedback.



  





**We Particularly Value** 




  




* Someone who has built a function from scratch — team, processes, tools and operating cadence.
* Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research.
* Strong understanding of customer interviews, surveys, ratings/reviews and customer feedback analysis.
* Experience managing calling or field teams and understanding operational metrics such as connect rates, response rates, call fatigue and script adherence.
* Experience in food, FMCG, QSR or other categories where taste, freshness, quality, portioning and value directly influence customer satisfaction.



  





**What Good Looks Like** 




  





**In the first 6–12 months, you should have:** 




  




* Built a functioning VoC team and operating cadence.
* Created a reliable system to capture and prioritise customer feedback.
* Established clear feedback loops across categories and products.
* Identified recurring customer problems and driven them to resolution.
* Built a strong mechanism for feeding customer insights into launches, product changes and category decisions.
* Demonstrated measurable improvement in relevant customer metrics such as ratings, complaints, repeat issues or product\-level satisfaction.

title: Sr. Technical Product Manager-Networking and Switches
description:
We are seeking a deeply technical product leader to take ownership of our extensive Networking and Switches portfolio: secure console servers, managed and unmanaged PoE Ethernet switches, media converters, industrial connectivity, and serial extension solutions. This product line is central to our customers' operations across datacom, industrial, and secure government environments. We are looking for a technical authority who will drive portfolio optimization, OEM/ODM vendor management, and rigorous quality assurance, sitting at the intersection of deep hardware engineering, and product lifecycle execution. This role can be based in our Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India offices to allow for direct, hands\-on access to our hardware labs, though remote (US) arrangements will be considered for exceptional candidates.
 



  





  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high\-margin lines to scale.
* OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root\-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.
* Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.
* Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands\-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.
* Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.
* Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End\-of\-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
* Cross\-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.



  





  





**Core Technical Expertise** 



* Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802\.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802\.1X and ACLs.
* Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP\+, RJ\-45, single\-mode vs. multi\-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate\-matching mechanics.
* PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802\.3af, 802\.3at, intelligent detection and backward\-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.
* Harsh\-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN\-rail or panel\-mount deployment.
* Out\-of\-Band Management and Connectivity Protocols: Console server architectures, secure out\-of\-band access, terminal emulation, serial\-over\-IP encapsulation, and USB extension technology.
* Security, Authentication, and Compliance Implementation: How standards are physically and logically implemented in networking gear, including TPM 2\.0, FIPS 140\-2/3 validated cryptographic modules, TAA\-compliant supply chains, and NERC CIP supporting features; AAA frameworks (TACACS\+, RADIUS, Kerberos, 802\.1X) and VPN technologies (OpenVPN, IPsec) as applied to secure out\-of\-band platforms; plus ZTP, RESTful API, and SNMP/LLDP/NTP integration.
* Serial and Signal Extension Technologies: Classic serial interfaces (RS\-232, RS\-422, RS\-485\) and V.35/Coax signal conversion, along with the electrical principles of signal attenuation, impedance matching, and long\-distance copper extension.
* OT and Industrial Serial Practice: Modbus ASCII/RTU over RS\-422/485, and serial line conditioning including bias, termination, isolation (e.g., 2\-kV), and surge protection.



  





  





**Who Will Succeed in This Role** 



* You are a hands\-on technical leader who is just as comfortable reading a market trend report as you are hooking up a serial cable to debug a spanning\-tree loop in the lab.
* You have experience managing OEM/ODM relationships and know how to hold external engineering teams accountable to strict quality and firmware standards.
* You understand that in an extensive hardware portfolio, strategy is realized through rigorous execution, BOM optimization, and reliable technical sustainment
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.



  





  





**EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.
