* Single point of contact end to end: outbound prospecting, discovery, demo, pricing, negotiation, procurement and close, then ongoing activation, expansion and renewal
* Own a combined territory of net\-new outbound accounts and an existing Tier 1/Tier 2 book \[size to confirm with RevOps — dedicated MM AE territories run 600\+ accounts, dedicated AM books are smaller and higher\-touch; expect a reduced blended number here]
* Partner closely with Sales Development Managers on outreach for the new\-business side, and with Customer Success, Support and Product on the account\-management side
* Based in Bangalore, open to in\-office presence once office opens

**Pipeline and sales process execution**
* Manage the entire sales process, new and existing, from first touch through discovery, demonstration, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal and close, inside an average cycle of 60 days or less
* Generate the large majority of new\-business pipeline through outbound prospecting into your territory, and manage the pipeline surfaced from within your existing book
* Run 4 or more meetings per day and 20 or more per week, combined across new\-business and account\-management work
* Develop a pipeline that is majority self\-sourced through outbound on the new\-business side \[confirm target mix — dedicated MM AE benchmark is 90% net\-new outbound; AM benchmark blends inbound and account planning], and consistently hold 3x pipeline coverage based on a 40% win rate
* Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly quotas for new\-business bookings and net revenue retention
* Own your schedule across research, initial meetings, platform demos, CRM hygiene, escalations, follow\-up meetings, business reviews and pricing calls
* Conduct customer meetings and account touches at a pace to be set by RevOps

**Sales strategy and deal management**
* Use a data\-driven approach to tier your account list, both for new\-business targeting and for identifying top expansion and at\-risk accounts within your book
* Run consultative discovery, asking layered questions and tying findings back to business outcomes, on new deals and existing accounts alike
* Communicate directly with Director and above contacts in Sales, Marketing and RevOps, and multi\-thread across departments
* Partner with Sales Development Managers on strategic outreach campaigns for the new\-business side
* Build detailed account plans for the top 20% of your book, focused on growth strategy and expansion opportunities
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of existing accounts' product usage to identify activation and adoption opportunities
* Articulate a clear view of your combined pipeline, deals and renewals at each stage, and forecast within a 10% margin
* Apply AI tooling to your own workflow to compress research, prep and follow\-up time across a broader scope of work than a single\-motion seat

**Mindset and culture**
* Thrive in a competitive environment, embracing challenges, enjoying objection handling and using setbacks as fuel
* Thrive with a high level of ambiguity and change while maintaining a customer\-centric approach at scale
* Take responsibility for successes and failures with a relentless drive to keep improving
* Be a self\-starter who stays motivated through repeated objections and repeated no on the new\-business side, and through slow\-moving accounts on the existing\-book side
* Sell as a team, proactively bringing leadership into deals and customer situations
* Bring genuine curiosity about sales technology, customer business models and industry trends
* Engage as your unique self in a diverse, inclusive and high\-performing team


  

**What we are looking for**
* 3\+ years of combined quota\-carrying net\-new closing and account management/expansion experience. Candidates with only one side of this (pure AE or pure AM) should show clear evidence of fast ramp on the other
* Top performer in current role, top 15% of the sales team, with stack rank known and nameable
* 100% or better attainment in at least three of the last four quarters, with an owned explanation for any miss
* 70% or more of new\-business pipeline self\-sourced through outbound \[confirm target mix for the hybrid seat]
* Deal and book economics consistent with Mid\-Market: cycle of 60 days or less, accounts of 250 to 1,000 employees
* A named consultative methodology applied day to day: MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Sandler, Challenger or Command of the Message
* Experience selling to and managing relationships with Director and above buyers in Sales, Marketing or RevOps
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Legal and Product teams
* Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve sales and account\-management productivity
* Coachable, and demonstrably so: you take feedback inside the conversation, not after it
* Based in Bangalore, India
### **We are AI Native**



Apollo.io is an AI\-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.


### **Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo**



At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we **take extreme ownership** of our work, **move with focus and urgency**, and **learn voraciously** to stay ahead.



We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to **own your role and make a real impact**. Collaboration is at our core—we’re **all for one**, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage **bold ideas and courageous action**, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.



If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

title: Specialty Sales Manager, Benign General Surgery
description:
* Bengaluru, INDIA, India
* Not Remote
* Sales
* JOB219035


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function:**


The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in identifying, developing, and expanding adoption of da Vinci procedures in Benign General Surgery across South \+ West India. Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.


This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. It combines clinical selling, market development, surgeon pathway execution, customer value creation, and cross\-functional program leadership. The SSM will work through the local commercial organization and directly engage priority customers where specialist expertise is required.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**


**1\. Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedure Utilization**


* Develop and execute the India specialty strategy for Benign General Surgery, aligned with regional priorities and commercial objectives.


* Identify and prioritize procedure growth opportunities, including hernia repair, cholecystectomy, and other relevant benign general surgery procedures within the specialty.


* Apply established da Vinci adoption and procedure readiness methodologies in assigned specialties, territories, and target accounts.


* Analyze procedure, surgeon, account, and market trends to prioritize opportunities, address adoption barriers, and guide field execution.


* Partner with local Clinical Sales and Capital Sales teams to develop account\-specific plans that increase utilization of installed systems and create future system opportunities.


* Lead strategic market development activities that build awareness, clinical confidence, and sustainable procedure adoption.


**2\. Convert High\-Volume Laparoscopy Centers into da Vinci Programs**


* Identify and prioritize high\-volume laparoscopic centers in Benign General Surgery that have the clinical leadership, procedure volume, infrastructure, and strategic intent to build a robotic surgery program.


* Develop conversion strategies that articulate the clinical, operational, and economic value of da Vinci surgery to surgeons, hospital executives, and other decision\-makers.


* Partner with Capital Sales, Clinical Sales, Key Accounts, and hospital stakeholders to help qualified high\-volume laparoscopic centers procure a da Vinci system and establish a sustainable program.


* Support the complete program\-building journey, including opportunity assessment, executive alignment, surgeon onboarding, care\-team readiness, initial case\-series support, patient pathway development, and post\-launch growth planning.


**3\. Develop Surgeons, KOLs, and Centers of Excellence**


* Identify and develop surgeon champions and Key Opinion Leaders for priority procedures in partnership with Marketing and Professional Education.


* Create development plans for high\-potential surgeons from initial adoption through sustainable utilization, advanced procedure adoption, teaching capability, and peer influence.


* Collaborate cross\-functionally to establish suitable case observation sites, proctors, training centers, and peer\-learning platforms.


* Coordinate appropriate case observation, on\-site support, simulation or laboratory learning, advanced training, and peer\-to\-peer education in accordance with approved processes.


* Bring relevant clinical and workflow value during the initial surgeon case series and support continuous improvement as experience develops.


* Develop and lead regional specialty education and market development programs that can scale adoption.


**4\. Build Clinical, Operational, and Economic Value**


* Work with surgeon champions, care teams, and internal partners to identify and develop credible clinical, operational, and economic value evidence.


* Understand customer success measures within the operating room and across the patient pathway, and translate them into account\-specific value discussions.


* Partner with relevant internal functions to develop value\-focused steering committees, executive reviews, and customer action plans.


* Conduct hospital, department, and practice executive presentations that support informed decision\-making and program expansion.


* Use approved evidence, customer data, and value tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.


**5\. Elevate Specialty Sales Competency**


* Coach, counsel, and train Clinical Sales representatives and managers on Benign General Surgery anatomy, procedure pathways, customer needs, clinical value, and consultative selling approaches.


* Provide field feedback that strengthens representatives’ ability to engage Benign General Surgery specialists and position applicable advanced technologies.


* Identify area\-level capability gaps and coordinate competency\-building programs with Clinical Sales Directors and other relevant leaders.


* Create practical field tools, talk tracks, account\-planning guidance, and best\-practice sharing to improve execution consistency.


* Model high\-quality clinical selling and influence through joint field visits, customer engagements, and opportunity reviews.


**6\. Lead Cross\-Functional Initiatives and Market Intelligence**


* Serve as the market intelligence liaison for Sales, Marketing, Professional Education, and Training teams by providing timely insights on customers, competitors, procedure trends, adoption barriers, and unmet needs.


* Leverage specialty resources to support scalable launches of new procedures, products, advanced technologies, and customer programs.


* Align with Sales Leadership and Marketing on surgeon training resources, training effectiveness, procedure volume outcomes, and advanced technology adoption.


* Collaborate effectively in a complex matrix organization and influence decisions without direct authority.


* Responsibly manage company resources and budgets to support strategies with the strongest commercial and customer impact.


* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of plans, activities, opportunities, and outcomes in approved company systems.


### **Qualifications**


**Skills/Job Requirements:**


* Minimum 8 years of relevant medical device, surgical, clinical sales, or healthcare market\-development experience.


* Proven track record of individual sales excellence and successful introduction or adoption of new technologies.


* Strong clinical selling capability and the ability to build credibility with surgeons, hospital executives, and highly educated customer groups.


* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, prioritize opportunities, and deliver results in an environment of change.


* Proven ability to influence peers and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority.


* Effective communication and presentation skills across a broad organization and diverse customer audiences.


* Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret market, procedure, surgeon, and account trends.


* Knowledge of the operating room environment and a solid clinical foundation to understand healthcare value.


* Ability and willingness to travel extensively across India, including overnight travel, based on business needs.


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in one or more Indian languages is advantageous.


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification required.


* Relevant postgraduate qualification in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field is preferred.


* Experience in minimally invasive surgery, robotic\-assisted surgery, benign general surgery, hernia, cholecystectomy, or surgical capital equipment.


* Experience developing surgeon champions, KOLs, case observation sites, training programs, or centers of excellence.


* Experience building a new clinical market, converting established surgical practices, or launching a hospital program.


* Previous people\-management experience or demonstrated readiness for broader leadership responsibility.


* Experience working with large hospital groups, academic institutions, or complex accounts in India.


### **Additional Information**


Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.


U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.


Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).


For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.


This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
  

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
  

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
  

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

title: Data Engineer III
description:
**About the Team – Global Campaign Tracking (GCT)**

Global Campaign Tracking (GCT) is a mission\-critical enterprise data platform that powers digital acquisition marketing across American Express Consumer and Commercial businesses in global markets. The platform captures, processes, and delivers digital interaction data to enable campaign attribution, acquisition reporting, and marketing analytics, helping optimize marketing ROI and campaign performance.


GCT serves as the authoritative source for customer targeting, offer eligibility, and digital acquisition insights. It also supports partner commission and affiliate settlement processes through daily data feeds to external agencies. Additionally, the platform provides trusted data to downstream systems for analytics, machine learning, enterprise reporting, and real\-time risk decisioning, making it a foundational component of the American Express digital acquisition ecosystem.


**Role Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Data Engineer III** to design, build, and enhance scalable data platforms that power critical business capabilities across digital acquisition marketing. This role requires a strong engineering mindset, deep expertise in distributed data processing, and a passion for building reliable, high\-performance data solutions.


As part of the GCT engineering team, you will work closely with product managers, architects, software engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop modern data pipelines, optimize platform performance, and deliver high\-quality data products that support real\-time and batch analytics.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering.
* Strong programming experience with **Java** and/or **Python** .
* Hands\-on experience with **Apache Spark** and distributed data processing.
* Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines on cloud platforms.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with relational and distributed databases.
* Experience working with **Apache Airflow** or similar workflow orchestration tools.
* Experience with version control using Git and modern CI/CD practices.
* Strong understanding of software engineering principles, testing, and code quality.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **Databricks** and Delta Lake.
* Experience with AWS services such as S3, EMR, Lambda, ECS, EC2, IAM, and CloudWatch.
* Experience building event\-driven or streaming applications using Kafka or similar technologies.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data lineage.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Exposure to marketing analytics, digital acquisition, clickstream, or customer analytics platforms.
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools.
Familiarity with DevSecOps and secure software development practices.  
* 

**What Success Looks Like**

* Deliver reliable, scalable, and high\-quality data engineering solutions.
* Build production\-ready pipelines that meet performance and availability goals.
* Improve platform efficiency through engineering innovation and automation.
* Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, and operational excellence.
* Collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Take ownership of features from design through production support.
* Contribute to the team's technical direction and mentor fellow engineers.
Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, and optimize the platform.  
* 

**Key Technologies**

* Java
* Python
* Apache Spark
* Databricks
* SQL
* Apache Airflow
* AWS (S3, EMR, Lambda, ECS, EC2, IAM, CloudWatch)
* Delta Lake
* Git \& GitHub
* Jenkins / CI\-CD
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Kafka
* REST APIs
* Redis
* Unix/Linux
* Monitoring \& Observability Tools
* Agile / Scrum

  
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.


As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.


  
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:


* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Data Engineer II, Prime Video Advertising
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Prime Video is a first\-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios\-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add\-on subscriptions such as Apple TV\+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM\+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.  

  

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?  

  

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast\-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.  

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill\-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!  

  

We are seeking a highly skilled and technically adept Data Engineer to join our PVA Data Engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable, fault\-tolerant data pipelines and infrastructure to support data\-driven insights. Leveraging native AWS technologies and Amazon’s internal tools, you will handle data ingestion, transformation, integration, and ensure high standards of data quality through validation, cleansing, and deduplication.
  

  

You will also be responsible for architecting high\-performance, scalable, and cost\-efficient big data processing and storage solutions, automating infrastructure with CI/CD principles, and optimizing data models to drive efficient ETL processes. You will be interfacing with several key services and APIs, write code and build applications in a scalable manner to extract, process, ingest unstructured data in a streaming, batch and asynchronous fashion.  

  

Your role will also focus on data governance, ensuring compliance with policies, implementing access controls, encryption, retention, and audit mechanisms. Additionally, you will work on continuous improvement by automating processes and adopting the latest data engineering technologies. Collaboration with Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers (BIEs), Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Product Managers (PMs), and functional managers will be key to delivering tailored data solutions.  

  

You'll also manage diverse technologies such as Python, EMR, Spark, Iceberg, Airflow, and many AWS data services like Glue, Athena, Redshift to build a scalable platform that supports analytics and experimentation. The ideal candidate must be customer\-obsessed with a passion for advertising, able to synthesize a variety of technologies, and effectively lead complex projects.  

  

In this position, your attention to detail and dedication to high\-quality, well\-documented data products will empower stakeholders to make better, data\-driven decisions.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault\-tolerant data pipelines using AWS technologies and internal Amazon tools to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with BIEs, Data Scientists, PMs, and SDEs to understand data requirements and deliver customized data solutions.
* Automate infrastructure deployment with CI/CD pipelines and ensure streamlined processes for deployment and maintenance.
* Ensure data quality through robust validation, cleansing, and deduplication techniques.
* Implement data governance standards, including access control, encryption, data retention, deletion policies, and audit mechanisms to ensure compliance and security.
* Continuously improve and optimize data pipelines and infrastructure, staying up to date with emerging technologies and implementing automation and monitoring tools.
* Build a scalable and reliable data platform supporting analytics and experimentation for intuitive, self\-service data products.
* Write high quality code and build scalable applications that interface with critical services and APIs to extract and process unstructured data
* Work with a range of data technologies, including Python, EMR, Spark, Iceberg, Airflow, and many AWS data services like Glue, Athena, Redshift to create end\-to\-end pipelines that consolidate data from disparate systems.

  

About the team  

Prime Video Advertising \- Data, Measurement and Insights(“PVA\-DMI”) team is a central data and analytics team within the PV\-Ads org that plays a pivotal role in fueling the worldwide growth of Amazon’s video advertising business. We own data platform, reporting, dashboards, measurement, and analytical solutions for PV Ads.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 3\+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with SQL
* Knowledge of professional software engineering \& best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
* Knowledge of distributed systems as it pertains to data storage and computing
* Knowledge of batch and streaming data architectures like Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Storm, Beam
* Experience as a data engineer or related specialty (e.g., software engineer, business intelligence engineer, data scientist) with a track record of manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large datasets
* Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
* Experience with Apache Spark / Elastic Map Reduce

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non\-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key\-value stores, graph databases, column\-family databases)
* Master's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets

**Job Summary**
---------------

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long\-term growth and stability.
  

  

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.


**About our Wealth and Retail Banking business**  

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.
  

  

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross\-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
  

  

We’re investing USD $1\.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

• Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life\-stages.
  

• Build long\-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  

• Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  

• Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  

• Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

• Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  

• Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  

• Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented, international environment.
  

• Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.


**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.


Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.


Together we:


* **Do the right thing** and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together** , we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
Job Description
**Manager Strategy \& Operations**
**Clear’s Vision**
==================


Clear makes software for the CFO's office. We started with tax compliance in India and now sell in 11 countries. Governments around the world are introducing rules that require businesses to report their invoices to the tax authority and exchange them over government\-designated networks. 29 countries have mandates coming into force between now and 2030\. Each mandate means enterprises have to change how their finance systems work, usually against a fixed deadline, and they need a vendor to do it for them.  

  

**Where we are as of today:**  

* 3,700\+ enterprise customers
  
* Live or ready in 11 countries, up from 3 a year ago. We expect 25\+ by early 2027\.
  
* Government accreditation in India, Saudi Arabia, UAE, France and Oman
  
* 6M\+ invoices processed a week in Saudi Arabia alone, at 99\.9% success
  
* Targeting profitable growth with 40%\+ revenue CAGR over the next three years
  


Our international business will be larger than our India business within the year. We have also started working in markets well ahead of their mandate dates, currently the Philippines and Spain.
Alongside the compliance business we have begun building AI products on top of the finance data we already hold for customers. CFO Studio and Agent Studio let finance teams build agents that do actual work rather than produce reports.
This is the bigger opportunity for us over the next few years. We already hold compliance data for a few thousand enterprises, which puts us in a reasonable position to take on more of the work that runs a CFO's office.
**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


This role sits in the CEO's office and reports to the Chief of Staff to the CEO.  

  

**What you will be responsible for**
**Running programmes through to a decision.** You will be given something loosely defined — that we take too long to open a new market, or that our win rate in Europe is not improving. You work out what the goal should be, who needs to be involved and what the plan is, then run it until a decision is made and implemented.
**Operating cadence and reporting.** Weekly and monthly reviews across markets and business lines, with one set of numbers that everyone works off. A large part of this is noticing when something is going wrong early enough that it can still be acted on, rather than reporting it once the quarter has closed.
**New market work.** For countries whose mandates are 18 to 24 months away, we need to understand the size of the opportunity, the partner and regulatory landscape, and what has to be ready and by when. You would be doing this research yourself.
**Analysis on open questions.** Pricing, partnership models, cross\-sell, where the next increment of GTM budget should go. We would want a recommendation you have thought through and can argue for, rather than a summary of what other people think.  

  

**Role Scope**
The scope is to cover any kind of programs pertaining to Strategy and Operations. The list of programs is not constant and keeps evolving as new problems are uncovered or changing priorities. To give examples of a few programs are \-  

* **Business strategy \-** Going through the historical patterns and identifying strategic levers \& initiatives to grow sales
  
* **Rhythms and rituals \-** These would include business review rhythms, pipeline reviews, interlocks with other non\-sales functions, etc.
  
* **Customer segmentation \-** Segment customers into logical cohorts and orient sales/ sdr/ marketing towards high value cohorts.
  
* **KPI planning \-** Defining the right KPIs for the sales / sdr teams \- output and inputs
  
* **Sales enablement \-** Defining the training needs based on wins/ losses and running a structured program to upgrade the wider sales team
  
* **Process streamlining and automation \-** Critically evaluating the as\-is process of sales (external as well as internal) and implement tools for automation to drive productivity
  


**Competencies Required**  

* Analytical Acumen \- Ability to drive meaning out of numbers. This has multiple components:
	+ Data accuracy \- ensuring data is always accurate and reliable
	+ Insights \- leveraging data to generate insights for the leaders
	+ Actions \- leveraging insights to recommend high impact actions.
  
* Strategic Thinking \- Ability to take step\-back from regular operations work and think long\-term for the business. This implies \- Building independent point of views on strategic decisions \- such as partnership or cross\-sell motion, etc.
  
* Program Management \- ability to manage multiple programs via impact\-based prioritisation and keep relevant stakeholders always informed. This also includes forecasting risk (pre\-morterm) and taking corrective actions.
  
* Process, Playbook \& Technology first Mindset \- ability to think of processes in the form of scalable playbooks which can be implemented and sales can be enabled on. This also means having a technology and AI first first mindset to maximise automation vs manual work.
  
* Sales Acumen \- Ability to understand how B2B sales motion works, what are the deal success factors, what are the top metrics tracked, how sales folks behave, etc.
  


**Qualification Pre\-Requisite**  

* Proven 1\-3 years of experience for the Program Manager role

  

* Should have worked in a technology startup before or premier Consulting firm with projects in the technology/ software industry
  
* Exposure to B2B Sales is preferable but not mandatory

Job Description – R\&D Executive

**Industry:** QSR / Food \& Beverage  
**Experience:** 1–4 years

**Reporting To:** R\&D Manager / Head of R\&D

Job Summary

We are looking for an **R\&D Executive** to support the development, testing, standardization, and commercialization of food products for our QSR business. The role will focus on developing innovative, consistent, cost\-effective, and scalable products while maintaining food safety and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities1\. Product Development

* Develop new food products, recipes, sauces, marinades, fillings, snacks, beverages, and other QSR products.
* Conduct kitchen trials and prepare prototypes based on product briefs.
* Modify existing recipes to improve taste, texture, yield, cost, and consistency.
* Conduct sensory evaluation and incorporate feedback into product development.

2\. Recipe Standardization

* Prepare and maintain standardized recipes and product specifications.
* Define ingredient quantities, preparation methods, cooking parameters, yields, and portion sizes.
* Develop SOPs for preparation, cooking, storage, handling, and serving.
* Ensure products can be consistently replicated across QSR outlets.

3\. Costing \& Commercialization

* Calculate recipe and product costs.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising product quality.
* Work with Procurement to evaluate alternative ingredients and suppliers.
* Support product scale\-up from laboratory/kitchen trials to commercial production.

4\. Quality \& Food Safety

* Ensure new products comply with applicable food safety and quality requirements.
* Work closely with the Quality/QA team on product specifications and testing.
* Support shelf\-life studies and stability evaluations.
* Identify and resolve product quality issues during trials and commercialization.

5\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with **Operations, Procurement, Quality, Production, Marketing, and Supply Chain** teams.
* Conduct trials at stores or central kitchens when required.
* Train operations teams on new product preparation and handling procedures.
* Collect feedback from stores and customers and recommend improvements.

6\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain R\&D trial records, recipes, specifications, costing sheets, and trial reports.
* Prepare product development reports and presentation materials.
* Maintain records of approved and discontinued products.
* Track project timelines from concept to launch.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in **Food Technology, Food Science, Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field**.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in **QSR, food manufacturing, product development, central kitchen, or FMCG food R\&D**.
* Good knowledge of food ingredients, processing, cooking methods, and food safety.
* Basic understanding of food costing and recipe standardization.
* Good sensory evaluation and problem\-solving skills.

Key Skills

* Product development \& innovation
* Recipe formulation and standardization
* Food costing
* Sensory evaluation
* Food safety \& hygiene
* Ingredient knowledge
* Trial planning and execution
* Documentation and SOP preparation
* Vendor/ingredient evaluation
* Cross\-functional coordination
* MS Excel / PowerPoint
* Communication and presentation skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Successful development and launch of new products
* Product quality and consistency
* Achievement of target food cost
* Timely completion of R\&D projects
* Reduction of product/process\-related issues
* Successful commercialization and scale\-up
* Compliance with food safety and quality standards

title: Senior Regional Sales Enablement Manager– APAC
description:
**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

 The Regional Sales Enablement Partner \- APAC (RSEP) is a sales practitioner and enablement leader responsible for the readiness, coaching, and performance of Genesys' APAC field and partner sales organization. Bringing firsthand sales experience to the role, the RSEP builds trusted relationships with regional sales leaders and cross\-functional partners to diagnose performance gaps, then designs and facilitates the coaching, training, and readiness programs that close them.
   

  

 The RSEP is as comfortable in a live coaching conversation with a seller or manager as they are advising senior leadership on regional go\-to\-market priorities. They apply sales methodology expertise, data, and AI\-enabled tools to sharpen judgment and scale impact — and they show up in the field, role\-playing, shadowing calls, reviewing deals, and reinforcing skills in the flow of work. Ultimately, the RSEP is a trusted advisor and an adjunct member of the regional sales leadership team, measured on tangible improvements in seller performance and pipeline outcomes.
   

  

 The RSEP is part of a global enablement team: some programs are built centrally at the global level, and the RSEP is responsible for tailoring and localizing them for APAC's markets, languages, and selling motions, while also feeding regional field insight back into how those global programs are designed. The RSEP is expected to operate fluently in both directions — shaping what gets built globally and making sure it lands regionally.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements:**
* 5\+ years of experience working with Sales team (technology/SaaS strongly preferred), plus 5\+ years in sales enablement, coaching, or sales performance roles, including experience leading enablement for a region or business unit; bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven track record coaching and developing sellers and front\-line sales managers — through call/deal reviews, live shadowing, and structured 1:1 coaching — with measurable improvement in skills and results.
* Strong facilitation skills, with confidence leading in\-person and virtual sessions for sellers, managers, and partners across diverse APAC audiences, languages, and time zones.
* Deep fluency in enterprise sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Value Selling, or similar), with the ability to embed it into everyday selling behavior rather than simply introduce it.
* Demonstrated credibility as a trusted advisor to sales leadership and cross\-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), with the executive presence and influence\-without\-authority to shape decisions at senior levels.
* Data\-driven approach — comfortable analyzing pipeline, conversion, and performance data (CRM, Clari, conversation\-intelligence tools) to diagnose gaps and demonstrate enablement impact.
* Experience in a cloud/SaaS company, ideally supporting complex, multi\-persona sales motions across direct and partner/channel teams.
* Experience operating as part of a global, matrixed enablement team — tailoring centrally\-built global programs for regional nuance while feeding field insight back into global program design.
* Comfort leveraging AI\-enabled tools to support coaching preparation, content development, and performance analysis, with a growth mindset toward new AI\-supported approaches to enablement.
* Proficiency with the sales and enablement tech stack (CRM, Seismic, LMS/Lessonly or similar) and standard business tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Self\-motivated, organized, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast\-changing, matrixed environment.
* Fluency in languages outside of English a plus, particularly APAC regional languages.


**Key Responsibilities:**
 The Regional Sales Enablement Partner spends the majority of their time directly engaged with sellers, managers, and leaders in the field — coaching, facilitating, and diagnosing performance gaps — while also shaping the regional enablement strategy that those activities feed into. Success in this role is measured by improvement in seller skill, pipeline quality, and win rate.
   

  

**Sales Coaching \& Skill Development**
* Deliver 1:1 and team\-level coaching to sellers and front\-line sales managers to reinforce methodology and close specific skill gaps.
* Facilitate engaging, high\-impact enablement sessions — in person and virtual — including role\-play, negotiation practice, discovery and objection\-handling drills, and certification workshops.
* Support new hire ramp to accelerate time\-to\-productivity and build early confidence.
* Design and deliver skills\-based training aligned to the moments that matter most in a seller's day\-to\-day motion.


**Strategic Advisory \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to APAC sales leadership and cross\-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), proactively surfacing performance gaps and enablement opportunities grounded in data and field insight.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to pinpoint knowledge and skills gaps, validating findings with data before recommending action.
* Bring firsthand field credibility into planning conversations, informing GTM and enablement priorities with real signal from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback.
* Represent APAC's needs and constraints to the global enablement team, providing field\-tested input that shapes how global programs are designed and where regional tailoring will be needed.
* Partner with global enablement peers and instructional designers to localize and adapt global programs for APAC's sellers, partners, and languages.


**Global Program Contribution \& Regional Readiness**
* Tailor and localize globally\-built enablement programs — content, methodology, and delivery format — for APAC's markets, languages, buyer dynamics, and selling motions, ensuring global programs actually change seller behavior in region.
* Own the quarterly readiness plan that brings global programs to APAC field and partner sales, translating global priorities and regional performance data into a prioritized, localized coaching and training calendar.
* Feed regional field insight — from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback — back into the global team to inform how future global programs are designed and where global consistency vs. regional flexibility is needed.
* Apply AI\-enabled tools to accelerate content localization, personalize coaching plans, and synthesize field feedback at scale.
* Maintain a consistent through\-line between global enablement strategy and regional execution — flagging where global programs need adaptation and closing that loop with the global team.


**Performance Insights \& Optimization**
* Partner with Sales Ops/RevOps to track how coaching and enablement activity moves pipeline creation, conversion rates, and seller productivity.
* Partner with first line managers to identify skill and performance trends, then convert them into targeted coaching interventions.
* Report enablement and coaching impact to leadership in clear, data\-backed, executive\-ready terms.


**Professionalism \& Team Contribution**
* Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism in relationships with sellers, partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Contribute to broader Enablement Team initiatives and continuously develop personal coaching and facilitation craft.
* Travel: \~20% (key meetings/events \+ Annual Sales Kickoff).

title: Program Manager
description:
**What Makes This Role Different**
----------------------------------


This is not a traditional project\-management role focused only on schedules, meetings, and status reports.


At Mirabilis Design, the Program Manager works across the full business cycle, from **product development and bug resolution to customer evaluations, sales opportunities, support activities, and marketing programs**. For someone interested in developing into a future **Program Leader, Product Manager, Operations Leader, or Business Leader**, this role offers significant learning and responsibility.


You will have visibility into what is happening across the organization and will play a key role in keeping teams aligned, identifying issues early, and ensuring that important commitments move forward.


The role provides direct exposure to:


* Engineering and product development
* Customer requirements and technical evaluations
* Sales opportunities and commercial priorities
* Marketing campaigns, events, and programs
* Product releases and support activities
* Senior management decision\-making


You will not simply report progress. You will help **drive progress**.


For someone who wants to understand how a technology company operates end\-to\-end and build experience across product, operations, customers, and business, this is an excellent opportunity.


**Location:** Chennai, India, Hybrid or Remote as applicable  

**Experience:** 3\+ years of relevant experience, or recent MBA with strong internship experience  

**Function:** Program Management / Operations / Cross\-Functional Execution


**About the Role**
------------------


Mirabilis Design is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and execution\-focused **Program Manager** to help coordinate activities across product development, customer support, product evaluations, sales, and marketing.


This is a highly cross\-functional role with visibility across the organization. The Program Manager will work with engineering, sales, marketing, customer\-facing teams, and management to ensure that assignments are clearly understood, properly owned, progressing according to plan, and completed on time.


The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex activities, following through on commitments, identifying risks early, and ensuring that teams remain aligned.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


The Program Manager will coordinate and track activities across multiple areas of the business, including:


* Product development and release activities
* Bug identification, prioritization, tracking, and resolution
* Customer support and technical follow\-up
* Product evaluations, trials, and customer deliverables
* Sales opportunities and related internal actions
* Marketing programs, campaigns, webinars, events, and content activities


You will be responsible for ensuring that every important activity has clear ownership, timelines, dependencies, and measurable progress.


A key part of the role is not simply tracking whether an assignment has been made, but confirming that it is actually progressing as expected.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* Coordinate activities across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and customer\-facing teams
* Maintain visibility into open assignments, priorities, deadlines, and dependencies
* Follow up with team members to confirm progress and completion
* Obtain regular feedback to verify that programs are progressing according to plan
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, resource conflicts, and execution risks early
* Escalate issues before they become major schedule or customer problems
* Track customer evaluations, support requirements, product issues, and related internal actions
* Ensure important customer and sales commitments receive timely follow\-up
* Help coordinate product releases, bug fixes, demonstrations, evaluations, and marketing initiatives
* Provide concise **daily progress updates** and structured **weekly management reports**
* Highlight accomplishments, risks, delayed activities, dependencies, and actions requiring management attention
* Continuously improve internal processes for planning, tracking, communication, and execution

**Who We Are Looking For**
--------------------------


Candidates should have one of the following backgrounds:


* **3\+ years of experience** in program management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, or a similar role


**OR**


* A **recent MBA graduate** with strong and relevant internship or prior work experience in technology, product management, operations, consulting, engineering, or program management

**Desired Skills**
------------------


The successful candidate should have:


* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to work across technical and business teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to identify problems and bottlenecks before they impact delivery
* Confidence working with engineering, sales, marketing, customers, and senior management
* Ability to summarize complex activities into clear management updates
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving technology environment


Experience in semiconductors, electronics, EDA, software products, aerospace, automotive, or other engineering\-focused industries is an advantage.

Champion continuous improvement within the program by capturing lessons learned after major releases and translating them into actionable improvements for future AEP and journey optimization efforts

**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Digital \& Innovation group at USP is seeking a Product Manager who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long\-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-256760 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 23, 2026 CATEGORY: Sales \& Marketing Operations
**Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients**
============================================


At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**
====================


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration will lead the accurate, timely, and compliant administration of field incentive compensation plans and compensation cycles. The role will oversee end\-to\-end IC operations, including data and eligibility validation, crediting and calculation review, payment readiness, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation, while ensuring strong quality controls and adherence to approved plan rules and processes.


The Manager will lead and develop a team of IC professionals, providing day\-to\-day direction, prioritizing work, reviewing deliverables, resolving complex operational issues, and driving accountability for quality and timelines. The role will serve as a key escalation point for IC administration issues and will identify opportunities to strengthen controls, simplify processes, improve data quality, and increase operational efficiency and scalability.


This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and partners closely with onshore business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams across Incentive Compensation, Field Effectiveness, data management, analytics, technology, and other supporting functions. The role will also coordinate IC administration projects and key business events—including new plan implementation, annual planning cycles, field realignments, product launches, mid\-cycle changes, and platform enhancements—while maintaining strong governance, documentation, audit readiness, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Responsibilities**

**IC Operations and Delivery Management**

* Manage the accurate and timely administration of assigned field incentive compensation (IC) plans and compensation cycles, in accordance with approved plan rules, established processes, and business timelines.
* Oversee day\-to\-day execution across data intake, eligibility validation, crediting, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, payout coordination, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation.
* Review team deliverables and quality\-control results to ensure data accuracy, payment readiness, process adherence, and timely resolution of issues.
* Monitor payout trends, processing timelines, data\-quality issues, field inquiries, and potential outliers; escalate material risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
* Support the operational implementation of new IC plans, realignments, product launches, mid\-cycle changes, annual planning cycles, and system enhancements.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead, coach, and mentor a team of IC professionals, including direct and/or indirect reports; provide guidance on priorities, technical questions, problem resolution, and quality expectations.
* Allocate work, track team capacity and deliverables, and ensure activities are completed within agreed timelines and service\-level expectations.
* Provide performance feedback and support team members’ development in IC processes, data analysis, platform usage, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and detail\-oriented working environment focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Act as an escalation point for complex data issues, calculation questions, field inquiries, and operational challenges.

**Governance, Documentation, and Process Improvement**

* Adherence to IC processes, internal controls, legal guidance, privacy requirements, applicable industry regulations, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Creation, maintenance, and periodic review of SOPs, QC checklists, business\-rule documents, process flows, exception logs, approvals, and records of critical discussions and decisions.
* Identify recurring process gaps, control risks, data\-quality concerns, and manual effort; lead practical improvements to enhance accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
* Support testing of IC platform enhancements, reports, automation opportunities, and process changes; ensure appropriate documentation and implementation readiness.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality, documentation quality, and data integrity across IC activities.

**Stakeholder and Project Coordination**

* Partner with onshore business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams, to clarify requirements, provide status updates, resolve issues, and align on timelines.
* Manage assigned IC administration projects and workstreams using Planner or other project\-management tools; track milestones, dependencies, risks, action items, and delivery status.
* Communicate operational updates, key issues, and plan\-administration insights clearly to internal stakeholders and leadership.
* Support the Senior Manager or functional lead in preparing operational reports, project updates, and materials for key stakeholder discussions.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5–8 years of experience in incentive compensation administration, sales operations, compensation operations, commercial operations, finance operations, analytics, or a related field.
* Experience leading projects, workstreams, or junior team members in a deadline\-driven operational environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant bio/pharmaceutical, healthcare, consulting, or commercial operations experience.
* Demonstrated experience in field IC administration, including plan implementation, eligibility, crediting, calculation validation, payment processing, reporting, reconciliations, and inquiry resolution.
* Experience coaching, mentoring, reviewing work, or managing direct and/or indirect reports.
* Strong ability to analyze complex data, investigate issues, monitor payout and operational trends, and make practical recommendations.
* Proficiency with industry\-leading incentive compensation administration platforms; experience with reporting, data, and automation tools is preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, and accountability for team deliverables, issue resolution, risk escalation, and timely completion of commitments.
* Strong organizational, project\-management, problem\-solving, written, verbal, and stakeholder\-communication skills.
* Commitment to accurate execution, strong controls, confidentiality, and continuous process improvement.
* Willingness to be hands\-on on projects
* Good to have IC health checks, plan modeling and design, contest design, goal setting experience

title: GFCC Detect/Report Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Welcome to JP Morgan Chase. Are you a compliance specialist, passionate about risk mitigation and safeguarding the financial institutions and customers from the financial crime ? You have found the right team.


As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real\-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best\-in\-class.


The GFCC Alert Triage position is part of the firm's India AML Alert Triage team within AML Investigations. The Triage team dispositions alerts consistent with the Global AML Standards, provides an initial assessment of potential Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing as well as other nefarious activity and recommends alerts for escalation and further review or closure as false positives


Responsibilities:


* Collect and document data, including: alerting activity, account information, transactional data, KYC information, politically exposed person (PEP) status, adverse media as well as counterparty and any other required information to assist in the investigation
* Review and analyze underlying data gathered opposite Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Terrorist Financing (TF), Human Trafficking and other red flags to assess whether the alert should be recommended for escalation or to be closed with no further action
* Fully document all alerts, including supporting data, analysis as well as escalation or close recommendation rationale within the case management system in a timely manner and consistent with the firm's quality standards
* Build relationships with AML Investigations units and effectively communicate and transfer information for case investigations
* Collaborate with India and US colleagues to share processing and AML knowledge to enhance AML Investigation process flows
* Process work items in the order of priority and aligned with SLA priorities. Escalate issues in a timely manner and demonstrate courage and integrity by doing the right thing all the time.
* In conjunction with manager and consistent with overall department objectives, establish and execute on annual development goals. You would participate in special projects, quality improvement initiatives and other similar exercises


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Qualified graduate with minimum of 6 years' of relevant experience in Global Financial Crime Compliance
* Familiarity with the firm's internal systems and processes or similar processes at other institutions, and proficiency in MS Office (Outlook/Word/Excel/PowerPoint)
* You are a self\-starter, capable of working under minimum supervision, able to multi\-task and meet deadlines in high\-pressure environment
* You are a result\-oriented team player with strong problem solving ability.
* You have exceptional research and analytical skills with the ability to analyze large amounts of data, decipher higher risk attributes (transactional, geographical, product, customer type, etc.) and develop well\-reasoned recommendations and strong documentation skills to clearly articulate alert disposition
* You are adaptable to change and demonstrate strong interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills.
* You adhere to and standards, controls and policy.


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:


The following additional items will be considered but are not required for this role

* CAMS Certification


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

title: Senior Lead - Market & Product Strategy
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role In Nutshell**
 Product Strategy team is responsible for identifying short\-term \& long\-term opportunities across developer markets \& product lines to accelerate Browserstack’s revenue growth \& to develop the vision for BrowserStack with a strong strategy plan \& hypotheses backed by data. Reporting to Senior Manager, Product Strategy, this individual will work closely with other Product, Marketing \& Sales Heads.
   

  

**Desired Experience**
* The ideal candidate will bring 5\+ years’ experience with at least 2\+ years’ experience in product management, Growth and/or product strategy.
* Has superior strategic, analytic, and problem\-solving skills, and is capable of clearly communicating a long\-term vision across the company and clients.
* Is integrated into the developer or saas market ecosystem stay current on competitive and market trends, and brings those insights to inform Product strategy
* Natural collaborator, with excellent communication skills and strong executive presence. Must be disciplined and comfortable with ambiguity, possessing the maturity and capability to interact and influence across multiple levels and a global matrixed organization
* Exhibit relevant and consistent leadership behaviours in team management, customer communications, and internal interactions with peers, senior management, clients, and third\-party vendors.
* Ability to structure, manage, and coordinate multiple complex cross\-functional projects and processes with multiple stakeholders at both senior and junior levels


**What will you do?**
* Conduct in\-depth research and analysis of market trends, competitor landscape, and customer needs and formulate data\-driven strategies to enhance product revenue and market share.
* Lead key select projects or major work streams related to BrowserStack’s overall product strategy to ultimately drive recommendations to the Executive Committee
* Identify, prioritise, structure, and manage complex issues that drive product priorities and demonstrate bottom\-line results including long\-term monetisation and commercialisation strategies
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, to ensure seamless implementation of finalised Strategies
* Take ownership of the entire strategic initiative lifecycle, from conceptualisation and formulation to execution and outcome assessment. Ensure that strategies are effectively implemented and measure success against predefined metrics, with a focus on achieving tangible dollar benefits.
* Work with limited direction, usually within a complex and often ambiguous environment, to drive rigorous, fact\-based recommendations to executives, functional, or regional management


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience
