title: Technical Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.  

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.  

  

In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.  

  

The Eurofins network generated EUR 7\.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

 **Job Description**  

* ➢Identify potential new customers and build relationships with current customers.
* ➢ Establish, develop, and close business while exceeding sales targets and objectives by developing customer relationships and closing business opportunities.
* ➢ Develop strategies for penetrating new accounts and growing relationships with end users and distributors.
* ➢ Research and understand prospects’ business plans (both tactical/technical and strategic/business).
* ➢ Understand prospect’s buying/decision process and business cycles that can affect these processes.
* ➢ Manage the sales process for focused customers.
* ➢ Collaborate with the customers and keep the management updated on new marketplace dynamics.
* ➢ Providing timely and detailed information on market needs, buying trends and competitive information.
* ➢ Support specific Marketing Programs, lead generation campaigns, and targeted sales activities.
* ➢ Responsible for collection of outstanding payments
* ➢ Proactive and outgoing to meet face to face meeting target.
* ➢ Searching \& signup of new Distributors in various regions.
* ➢ Individual Contributor Role.

 **Essential Skills**

* ➢ Must be willing to travel up to 70% of the time.
* ➢ Proven track record selling in the respective territory.
* ➢ Ability to multitask and manage complex sales cycles to completion.
* ➢ Must be able to work independently with a passion to sell.
* ➢ A disciplined and proven Customer\-Centric Sales Process.
* ➢ Demonstrated sales account management experience with a track record of exceptional achievement.
* ➢ Demonstrated ability calling on and closing sales with key buyers and decision makers within the organization

**Experience**:

* ➢ 2 to 10 years of sales experience
* ➢ Food Industry \- Diagnostics kits sales experience is must.
* ➢ Sea Food Industry sales experience preferred.

  

**Qualifications** **Qualifications**


Bachelor’s degree in science supported by Food Diagnostic test kits sales experience. MBA will be preferred.

title: Sales & Brand Partnerships - Films, OTT & TV - Delhi NCR
description:
Work From Office opportunity, in Delhi NCR handling North India Market. 5 Days working, Monday to Friday, 10:00 am to 7:00 pm. The top budget for this role is 18 LPA \+ PLI \+ Sales Commissions, please apply accordingly.


This is a full\-time opportunity where you will work representing SkyBlue Cinematix from your Delhi NCR, supporting in\-film and out\-of\-film brand integrations, product placements (PPL), brand associations, and sponsorships across a diverse slate of films.


We are looking for professionals who bring experience from media houses, advertising agencies, or similar environments, with a strong background in sales, brand partnerships, or business development—particularly in media sales, branded content, or advertising across TV, OTT, or digital platforms.


The ideal candidate will have:

* Strong local relationships with brands and agencies
* The ability to independently drive partnerships and revenue
* An entrepreneurial mindset with the capability to build and scale local business operations


If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. Please apply and explore this exciting opportunity with us.

**About SkyBlue Media Group**


We are an international media company with operations across Malaysia, Dubai, and India, specializing in creating impactful brand experiences across diverse media platforms. Over the past 15\+ years, we have established a strong reputation for innovation, scale, and effectiveness in the OOH and entertainment marketing space.


Our Markets \& Expertise

* **Malaysia – OOH Media Leadership**  

With over 15 years of experience, we are one of Malaysia’s leading OOH media companies, offering a nationwide portfolio of outdoor and transit advertising formats. Our strong partnerships in cinema, retail, and outdoor environments ensure unmatched visibility and brand recall.
* **Dubai – Transit Media Exclusivity**  

Through SB Mobility Media LLC, we hold the exclusive 5\-year rights from Dubai’s Roads \& Transport Authority (RTA) to manage bus and transit media. This includes bus exteriors, shelters, stations, and MUPIs, making us a leading player in transit advertising across the UAE.
* **India – Entertainment \& Content Integrations**  

Expanding into the world’s largest film and OTT markets, we are establishing our Mumbai\-based operations focused on in\-film brand integrations, OTT partnerships, and branded entertainment solutions. Supported by our AI\-driven placement and analytics platform, we connect brands with audiences through story\-driven content integrations that deliver measurable impact.


To know more about us our websites at \- https://www.skybluemedia.my/ I https://skybluemedia.ae/

**Role Overview**


If you’ve ever seen your favourite superstar sipping a cola, speaking on a phone, or enjoying a snack on screen — know that it wasn’t by chance, it was by choice. Your choice. You were the one instrumental in making sure the talent showcased the brand, and in closing the deal that brought that brand into the heart of the story.


At Sky Blue Media, we believe in creating these moments with purpose. As Sales, Business Development \& Brand Partnerships resource, you will play a decisive role in shaping how brands appear in films and beyond. This is where business development meets creativity — forging partnerships with production houses, agencies, and brands to deliver integrations that are impactful, seamless, and memorable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Map your market (your region) for various brands, and their agencies.
* Understand brand’s positing and upcoming campaigns.
* Identify and develop **new business opportunities** for in\-film brand integrations, co\-branded promotions, and other media alliances.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with various **brand’s top management and their agency’s SPOCS.**
* Understand the film project, its scope, nuances, star casts, its plot and films setup (Theatrical films, OTT projects or TV serials)
* Conceptualize creative **brand solutions** aligned with film storylines and target audiences.
* Regularly and diligently, stay connected with brands and agencies to pitch **SkyBlue Cinematix** and the projects.
* Collaborate with internal teams to **create and pitch compelling proposals, presentations**, and case studies.
* Work closely with media planning and buying teams to align integrations with larger campaign strategies.
* **Negotiate and finalize deals** ensuring win\-win outcomes for both brand and production stakeholders.
* Stay updated with industry trends, film releases, OTT content pipelines, and brand marketing calendars.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure smooth delivery of brand integrations and campaigns.
* **Track performance metrics, prepare post\-integration reports**, and ensure client satisfaction and retention.
* **Conceptualize and pitch** bold, customized partnership models that fuse brand storytelling with cinematic moments.
* Collaborate with internal creative, marketing, legal, and production experts to deliver seamless, integrated experiences on and off screen.
* Track the pulse of entertainment trends, OTT innovation, and consumer engagement formats to keep our offerings unmatched.
* Work with internal teams (e.g., creative, marketing, sales) to develop and execute joint campaigns and create co\-branded marketing materials.

**Ideal Profile**

* **5 \-10 years** of proven success in business development, sales, brand partnerships, brand solutions or strategic partnerships within media, entertainment, or advertising.
* A deal\-closer with a track\-record of securing multi\-crore, multi\-film/franchise partnerships.
* Deep relationships with Brand managers, agencies, and production houses — your phonebook is an industry goldmine.
* Independent hustler who thrives on accountability, targets, and creating impact.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills that inspire confidence and excitement.
* MBA/PG in Marketing, Media, or Business preferred.

**Why Join Us?**


This is an exciting opportunity to grow your skills and make a significant contribution to our team. You'll work in a supportive and collaborative environment that values creativity and professional development.

*In\-case you are not actively scouting for opportunities, feel free to share this Job Description within your professional network, someone in need may benefit from it. Candidates can write back with their updated resume at* *careers@skybluegroup.com**.*

 This role will help Lenovo DWS accelerate its AI\-first portfolio by:

title: Brand Category Manager
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Chief of Staff, Partners' Office
description:
**About Graviton** 




 Graviton Research Capital is a proprietary trading firm built on quantitative research and low\-latency engineering. We trade our own capital across global equities, futures, and derivatives markets, combining statistical modelling, machine learning and high\-performance systems to compete at the fastest end of electronic markets.
 



 Research and engineering sits at the core of the firm. Strategies are built, tested and deployed by small teams working close to the market, supported by an in\-house stack spanning signal research, execution and exchange connectivity. Our Gurgaon office houses a large share of that work. We run flat. Decisions are made by the people closest to the problem, and we have kept the management layer deliberately thin as we've grown.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Graviton is scaling globally, and we're building the culture and systems to make that growth durable. As Chief of Staff, you'll be pivotal in turning the Partners' vision into concrete plans and real follow\-through. It's a force\-multiplier role: equal parts strategic thinking, sharp execution, and people leadership, working directly with the Partners and senior leaders to drive clarity, performance and cohesion across the firm.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Much of this role runs through our research, engineering and trading teams. You won't manage them, but you will need to understand their work well enough to tell a real constraint from a stale assumption, and to represent their reality accurately to the Partners.
 



  





**Turn priorities into plans** 



* Work with the Partners to convert firm\-level priorities into concrete plans, with clear ownership, timelines and a clear definition of what success looks like.
* Run the operating cadence: annual and quarterly planning, goal\-setting and the reviews that keep both honest.
* Frame the big decisions before they land. Lay out the options, pull the data, write the memo and drive to a call.
* Work with research and engineering leads to keep firm\-level priorities and team roadmaps pointed in the same direction, surfacing conflicts between them early.
* Maintain a clear picture of what the technical organisation is working on: what's live, what's blocked and what has quietly stalled.



  





**Own the follow\-through** 



* Take on the cross\-functional initiatives that have no natural home, the ones spanning research, engineering, trading and business operations.
* Run the Partners' meeting rhythm end to end: agendas, pre\-reads, decisions recorded and actions closed. Nothing important gets quietly dropped.
* Build the lightest systems that keep a flat firm coordinated and resist the process for its own sake.



  





**Write for the firm** 



* Draft the memos, strategy documents and all\-hands narratives that carry the Partners' thinking across Graviton.
* Turn long, messy discussions into one page that people actually read and act on.
* Speak for the Partners in rooms they can't be in and bring back the signal that matters.



  





**Build the business functions** 



* Build and lead the firm's procurement, brand and communications, and workplace functions, hiring the people to run them as they mature.
* Put in place the vendor, contracting and spend discipline a firm operating across multiple regions needs.
* New offices, new markets, new functions and new systems. The work nobody owns yet is yours to pick up and make real.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 8–10 years across engineering, trading or high\-growth technology companies, including sustained close work with senior leadership.
* A strong instinct for structure. You take ambiguous problems, impose an order on them, and keep them moving without being asked twice.
* Unusually good writing. You can take a long, unresolved discussion and turn it into a page that settles it.
* Comfort with data and technical detail. You can pull the numbers yourself, press on what they actually show, and hold your own with researchers and engineers.
* Experience building a function from scratch and hiring the people to run it, not just running one that already exists.
* Sound judgment and discretion. You'll see sensitive information about people, performance and strategy well before anyone else does.
* A preference for being useful over being visible.



  





**An Added Advantage** 



* A technical background: a degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or physics, or time spent writing production code or doing quantitative research.
* Familiarity with how trading systems are built and operated, including research pipelines, backtesting, execution, latency and exchange connectivity.



  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Competitive compensation.
* Annual international team offsite.
* Best\-in\-class health insurance for you and your family.
* Daily catered breakfast and lunch, plus a well\-stocked kitchen.
* 30 days of annual leave, in addition to market holidays.
* Regular social events, clubs and after\-work parties.



**Equal Opportunity** 




 Graviton Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered on merit, without regard to gender, religion, caste, disability, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law.

title: Manager, IT Business & Product Management
description:
**Our Digital Transformation**
 The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca\-Cola Company (TCCC) system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Manager, IT Business \& Product Management** 
 will help connect business priorities with technology solutions that deliver measurable value in Manufacturing IT environment. This role acts as a trusted partner to business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, vendors, and service providers. The role is responsible for translating business needs into product priorities, roadmaps, portfolio decisions, and technology outcomes, while supporting effective escalation management and value realization. This position is ideal for a business\-facing information technology professional who understands how to balance customer needs, operational priorities, workplace technology, manufacturing environments, vendor delivery, financial discipline, and digital transformation. The successful candidate will bring strong product management capability, practical technology fluency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive results in a cross\-functional manufacturing environment. This role helps ensuring technology products and services are aligned to business capability needs, governed effectively, and continuously improved through data, insight, and collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, and technology partners.
   

  

**What You Will Do For Us**
* Lead business engagement by partnering with business stakeholders to understand priorities, pain points, operational needs, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvement.
* Translate business requirements into product priorities, technology outcomes, roadmap plans, and investment recommendations that support measurable business value.
* Develop and manage product roadmaps aligned to business capability needs, portfolio priorities, operational readiness, and financial planning.
* Own product outcomes, adoption, user value, business impact, and product\-related escalations for assigned technology services or capabilities.
* Use governance, prioritization methods, and performance insights to improve product outcomes, business alignment, and decision\-making.
* Assess the business and product impact of incidents, ensuring appropriate stakeholder communication, escalation support, and alignment with vendors and technical resolution teams.
* Support change prioritization, release readiness, business adoption, governance decisions, and stakeholder alignment for technology changes.
* Support business capability development and digital product evolution through value\-based investment decisions and coordination across delivery, architecture, finance, and operations teams.
* Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers that support product delivery, roadmap execution, workplace technology, manufacturing solutions, or business outcomes.
* Coordinate with management teams, vendors, and service providers to resolve issues, support service quality, and improve delivery performance.
* Use business, product, adoption, financial, operational, and value realization metrics to determine priorities and influence portfolio decisions.
* Apply artificial intelligence insights and data\-driven analysis to support prioritization, product decisions, service improvement, and business value creation.
* Ensure product priorities and delivery decisions align with governance, risk, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology standards.
* Support business case development, investment planning, portfolio prioritization, value realization, and management of operating expense and capital expenditure budgets.
* Influence product portfolio priorities, business capability investment, and strategic technology planning within the relevant business and technology scope.
* Bring awareness of manufacturing systems and applications to support operational environments, business continuity, and practical technology decision\-making.


**Requirements And Qualifications Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience working in Information Technology, preferably in business\-facing technology, product management, workplace technology, manufacturing technology, service delivery, or a related environment.
* Practical knowledge of end\-user and workplace technology services, including personal computers, deskside support, Microsoft and Apple operating systems, remote desktop protocol, virtual desktop infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Knowledge of output management solutions, including multifunction printers, secure print, label printers, and network printers.
* Familiarity with manufacturing systems, manufacturing applications, or technology used to support production or bottling environments.
* Experience in product management, business relationship management, roadmap planning, portfolio management, and agile delivery.
* Experience leading a team or workstream, motivating others, driving execution, and delivering results in a cross\-functional environment.
* Proven ability to develop information technology solutions that address complex business problems and enable measurable outcomes.
* Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to translate stakeholder needs into product priorities, technology requirements, and actionable plans.
* Experience coordinating with management, vendors, service providers, and technology partners to support delivery quality, service performance, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology governance, prioritization, change readiness, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and service management practices.
* Ability to use data, metrics, analytics, and financial indicators to guide prioritization, measure adoption, and support continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and automation concepts, with the ability to apply insights appropriately to product management, decision\-making, and service improvement.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience supporting business cases, investment planning, operating expense budgets, capital expenditure budgets, and value realization.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across levels and functions.
* Structured, organized, pragmatic, and practical working style with strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and sound decision\-making.
* Full professional English proficiency, including clear written and verbal communication.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Company:** Cosysta  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala / Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Role:** Leadership – Technology \& Product Engineering

About Cosysta

Cosysta is a technology company focused on building modern software products, AI\-enabled solutions, digital transformation platforms, web applications, mobile applications, and custom technology solutions for clients in India and international markets.

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** who can take complete ownership of Cosysta’s technology function and build a scalable engineering organisation.

Role Overview

The CTO will be responsible for the overall technology strategy, software architecture, engineering quality, product development, technical delivery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology team development at Cosysta.

This is not purely a management position. The CTO should be capable of reviewing architecture, solving difficult technical problems, guiding developers, interacting with clients, estimating projects, and ensuring successful delivery.

Key ResponsibilitiesTechnology Strategy \& Leadership

* Define and execute Cosysta’s long\-term technology roadmap.
* Select appropriate technologies, platforms, frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and development standards.
* Ensure technology decisions support scalability, security, performance, profitability, and business growth.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, cloud computing, SaaS, and modern application development.
* Work closely with the CEO, CMO, CFO, and other leadership members on company strategy.

Software \& Product Architecture

* Design and review scalable software architectures.
* Lead architecture decisions for web, mobile, SaaS, enterprise, AI and cloud\-based applications.
* Establish coding standards, development practices and documentation standards.
* Conduct technical reviews of critical projects.
* Reduce technical debt and improve maintainability of products.

AI \& Emerging Technologies

* Lead the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into Cosysta products and client solutions.
* Evaluate LLMs, AI APIs, RAG systems, AI agents, automation tools and related technologies.
* Identify commercially viable AI products and services.
* Ensure responsible, secure and cost\-efficient implementation of AI systems.

Engineering Team Leadership

* Build and manage a high\-performing technology team.
* Recruit developers, technical leads, AI engineers, QA engineers and DevOps professionals as required.
* Mentor junior and senior developers.
* Conduct technical interviews and skill evaluations.
* Define individual and team KPIs.
* Establish accountability for quality, timelines and delivery.

Project \& Client Delivery

* Take technical ownership of major client projects.
* Participate in technical discussions with clients.
* Convert business requirements into appropriate technical solutions.
* Support project estimation, timelines and resource planning.
* Identify technical risks before project commencement.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed scope, quality and deadlines.
* Support the sales team during technical presentations and proposal discussions.

Development \& Quality Assurance

* Establish development workflows including:
* Git and version\-control standards
* Code reviews
* CI/CD
* Automated testing
* QA processes
* Release management
* Documentation
* Monitor application performance and reliability.
* Ensure proper testing before production releases.
* Implement processes to minimise bugs and production failures.

Cloud, Infrastructure \& DevOps

* Oversee cloud infrastructure and deployment architecture.
* Manage or supervise platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel or equivalent infrastructure.
* Improve deployment automation and infrastructure efficiency.
* Monitor infrastructure and cloud expenditure.
* Establish backup, disaster recovery and business\-continuity procedures.

Cybersecurity \& Data Protection

* Establish security standards for Cosysta and client projects.
* Ensure secure coding practices.
* Protect company source code, intellectual property and customer data.
* Implement access\-control and credential\-management policies.
* Ensure appropriate security reviews for production systems.
* Support compliance requirements where relevant.

Technology Operations

* Maintain proper documentation for all major technology systems.
* Ensure company repositories, domains, hosting, cloud accounts, APIs and technology assets remain under proper organisational control.
* Maintain technology vendor relationships.
* Introduce tools and automation that improve developer productivity.

Expected Technology Exposure

The ideal candidate should have strong experience across several of the following areas:

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* Python
* REST APIs
* Modern databases
* PostgreSQL / MySQL
* MongoDB or NoSQL technologies
* Cloud infrastructure
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Vercel
* Docker
* Git / GitHub
* CI/CD
* SaaS architecture
* Mobile application development
* AI/ML integration
* LLM APIs
* RAG and AI\-agent architecture
* Cybersecurity
* DevOps
* System design and scalable architecture

The CTO is not expected to personally code every project but must possess enough technical depth to **review, challenge, guide and take responsibility for technical decisions**.

Required Experience

* Preferably **8\+ years of software development / technology experience**.
* Strong experience in software architecture and engineering leadership.
* Previous experience leading developers or technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience delivering commercial software projects.
* Strong understanding of modern web and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and technical decision\-making ability.

Experience in a startup, software services company, SaaS company or product\-development organisation will be highly valuable.

Preferred Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are hands\-on technology leaders rather than purely administrative managers.
* Can build a technology department from an early stage.
* Understand both software engineering and business requirements.
* Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Can communicate technical matters clearly to non\-technical clients.
* Have experience working with international customers.
* Understand project cost, engineering productivity and commercial viability.
* Can create reusable technology frameworks rather than rebuilding everything from scratch.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured through areas such as:

* On\-time technology delivery
* Project quality
* Reduction in production bugs
* Development productivity
* Technology\-team performance
* Architecture quality
* System uptime and reliability
* Infrastructure cost optimisation
* Client satisfaction on technical delivery
* Security and compliance
* Successful implementation of AI capabilities
* Development of reusable technology assets and products

First 90\-Day Expectations

During the first three months, the CTO will be expected to:

* Conduct a complete audit of existing Cosysta technologies, source code, infrastructure and active projects.
* Review the technical capabilities of the existing development team.
* Establish coding, Git, QA, documentation and deployment standards.
* Prepare Cosysta's technology roadmap.
* Identify critical technology risks.
* Recommend the required engineering team structure.
* Improve project estimation and technical delivery systems.
* Establish security, backup and access\-control procedures.
* Develop an AI integration roadmap for Cosysta products and services.
* Build a scalable technology foundation capable of supporting international expansion.

Reporting Structure

The CTO will be part of the **Core Leadership Team of Cosysta** and will work closely with:

* Chief Executive Officer / Managing Leadership
* Chief Marketing Officer
* Chief Financial Officer
* Operations / Project Management Team

The CTO will have authority over the company's engineering, technical architecture, development standards and technology\-delivery functions.

Ideal Candidate

Cosysta needs a **builder CTO** — someone who can move comfortably between boardroom discussions, client meetings, system architecture, code reviews and engineering\-team mentoring.

The objective is not simply to manage developers, but to build a **high\-quality, scalable and commercially strong technology organisation capable of serving international clients and developing Cosysta's own technology products**.

Pay: ₹21,772\.93 \- ₹70,116\.86 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Director - HRBP (Tech)
description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being India's most successful D2C food\-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de\-licious fresh meat and seafood! Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on...
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Director HRBP (Tech) will own the people agenda for Licious' Product, Analytics, Engineering and Data teams, a span of roughly 200 people building the technology that powers India's most loved meat and seafood brand. You will own the full HRBP charter for Tech: raising the talent bar, lifting talent density, shaping how people experience Licious every day and building the leadership ecosystem this company will need as it scales. Alongside the HRBP mandate you will own a critical COE charter for the wider organisation, with Performance Management being a strong possibility, giving you the chance to shape practice well beyond your own business unit.
 



  





 This role demands someone who is equally at home in a leadership review and in a 1:1 with an engineer two weeks into the job. Tech at Licious is growing fast, the environment moves quickly and the answers are rarely sitting in a playbook. You will need to think like a business leader, build credibility quickly with a sharp and analytical set of stakeholders, use data as your default language and be comfortable building things from scratch, iterating in the open and holding your point of view when it matters.
 



  





**Have you got an awesome appetite for?** 




  





**Talent Bar and Talent Density** 



* Raising the talent bar across Product, Analytics, Engineering and Data by partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition on role design, calibration and interview rigour.
* Building a clear and honest view of talent density across the function: knowing where the strength sits, where the gaps are and what it will take to close them.
* Driving internal development, mobility and succession so critical roles have credible internal successors and not only external pipelines.
* Owning workforce planning for Tech, keeping headcount, skills and structure aligned to the product and engineering roadmap.



**Employee Experience and Org Connectedness** 



* Shaping how people experience Licious through continuous listening: surveys, skip levels, focus groups and the informal channels that surface the real signal.
* Building belonging across product and engineering pods so people feel part of one org and one mission rather than a set of separate teams.
* Translating listening data into action plans with named owners, clear timelines and follow through people can actually see.
* Partnering on rituals, forums and communication that keep Tech connected to the business, the consumer and the food.



**Leadership Ecosystem and Capability Building** 



* Building the leadership ecosystem Licious needs to execute and scale: identifying, developing and coaching managers and senior leaders across Tech.
* Coaching leaders through team design, difficult conversations, performance calls and their own growth.
* Partnering with L\&D to build manager capability, so first time managers and experienced leaders both get what they need.
* Keeping the organisation transformation ready by anticipating structure, capability and culture needs ahead of time rather than reacting to them.



**COE Ownership** 



* Owning a company wide COE mandate alongside the HRBP charter, with Performance Management being a strong possibility.
* Building or reshaping the performance philosophy, cycle design, calibration approach and the manager enablement that has to go with it.
* Driving adoption across business units, holding a consistent bar and making the process something managers find genuinely useful.
* Measuring the impact of the COE charter through data and improving it every cycle.



**Business Partnership and Culture** 



* Partnering with Tech leadership as a real thought partner on org design, capability, culture and business priorities.
* Driving culture as an outcome rather than a slogan: making Licious values visible in how decisions get made, how feedback travels and how people are recognised.
* Using people data to spot attrition risk, engagement dips and structural issues early, and bringing solutions rather than dashboards.
* Handling employee relations and sensitive matters with fairness, speed and discretion.



  





**We hope that you have..** 



* Bring 10 to 14 years of HR experience with strong HRBP depth, including meaningful time partnering Product, Engineering, Analytics or Data teams.
* Have owned an HRBP charter for a span of 150 people or more, ideally in a high growth consumer tech, ecommerce or product led environment.
* Bring real COE experience, ideally Performance Management, whether that meant building a framework from scratch or fixing one that had stopped working.
* Have a clear point of view on talent density and can talk specifically about how you raised the bar, what changed as a result and what it cost you to get there.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and leadership transitions, and can hold a team steady while the org around it is still taking shape.
* Have used listening mechanisms seriously: you know how to run them, how to read what they are really saying and how to convert them into visible action.
* Are data fluent and can build a case with numbers in a room full of analytical people who will ask you exactly where the number came from.
* Are a credible coach to senior leaders and can push back on a founder or a function head without damaging the relationship.
* Bring a strong bias for execution: you build, ship, measure and improve instead of waiting for the perfect plan.
* Are excited about building the people engine for a brand that is changing how India eats, and are ready to be hands on to do it.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
At Meolaa, tech talent is our bottleneck. We're building D2C infrastructure, data pipelines, marketplace integrations, and systems that need to scale from ₹1Cr to ₹100Cr ARR. We need someone who understands what good engineering looks like, can source in a competitive market, and moves fast without hiring people who'll slow us down.
 



 The role is Tech Recruiter.
 



 The reality is you own the engineering hiring roadmap, and you own quality.
 



  





 What does that actually mean?
 



 It means on Monday you're convincing a Backend engineer why Meolaa's problem is more interesting than the Stripe offer they just got.
 



 On Tuesday you're breaking down the CTO's roadmap into hiring needs how many DevOps engineers do we need for Q2?
 



 On Wednesday you're doing final interviews and making the call on your top 3 candidates.
 



 On Thursday you're handling competing offers and negotiating with engineers who have leverage.
 



 On Friday you're presenting hiring pipeline health to the CTO, candidate quality, time\-to\-hire, pipeline depth.
 



 No two weeks look the same. Every week you're moving the needle on team composition.
 



  





 What You'll Own

 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲

* Know the difference between a good engineer and a good interviewer
* Build sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-fill roles (DevOps, ML engineers)



 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘵𝗿𝗼𝗹
 


* Screen candidates technically enough to know good from mediocre
* Brief your interview team on who's coming and what to probe
* Debrief after interviews and make hiring recommendations (not just pass candidates through)
* Own candidate experience make Meolaa a place people
 *want* 
 to work
* Flag red flags early if someone's a flight risk, you should see it



 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
 


* Own hiring timelines CTO says "I need a DevOps engineer by Month 3," you own that
* Maintain pipeline health 3–4 candidates in process for each open role
* Manage competing offers and counter\-offer strategically
* Keep candidates warm through the process — silence kills pipelines
* Own time\-to\-hire metrics and identify bottlenecks



 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗿𝘂𝗶𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆
 


* Work with the CTO to understand hiring needs before they feel the pain
* Build job descriptions that don't sound like every other startup post
* Coordinate with People Ops on compensation bands, offers, onboarding
* Track retention of hires you've made if they leave in 6 months, you know why
* Be a thought partner to engineering leadership on hiring strategy



 𝗢𝗻𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 \& 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
 


* Own first 90 days for engineering hires smooth onboarding, clear expectations
* Follow up on new hires at 30/60/90 days catch problems early
* Build relationships with engineers so they feel supported
* Flag flight risks and help leadership retain key people
* Track why people leave and feed insights back to improve hiring



  





 You might be the one if
 


* You have 3–6 years of tech recruiting experience
* You've filled engineering roles and built engineering teams
* You understand technology well enough to have real conversations with engineers
* You know the difference between full\-stack and backend, and why it matters
* You've sourced engineers outside LinkedIn (communities, GitHub, referrals)
* You've dealt with competing offers and know how to retain talent
* You can read a resume and know if someone's actually good or just has buzzwords
* Prior experience in D2C, startups, or consumer tech is a strong plus
* You know Bangalore's tech talent market — where they are, what they care about, what they're paid
* You think like a matchmaker you're matching people to problems they care about, not just filling positions



  





 Why Meolaa?
 



 We're building tech that's not trivial. D2C platform, marketplace integrations, supply chain visibility, data pipelines — engineers here solve real problems. That's attractive to good engineers. Your job is to find them and convince them this is more interesting than another FAANG role.
 



 You'll have a CTO who actually cares about hiring right. You'll have budget. And you'll have autonomy to source aggressively without permission at every step.

 This is a quality hiring role at a company that values engineering.

 Our mission at Zillow is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. As part of Zillow Group’s Talent Acquisition team, you’ll help shape the future of our organization by attracting and hiring top talent. We are a collaborative, data\-informed, and candidate\-focused team that serves as the first impression of Zillow Group’s culture, values, and vision.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Technical Recruiter** 
 to help build high\-performing engineering and technology teams in a fast\-paced, product\-driven environment. This role is ideal for someone who understands technology hiring beyond job descriptions—someone who can engage deeply with engineering leaders, understand complex technical talent requirements, and build thoughtful strategies to identify and close exceptional talent.
   

  

**You Will Get To**
* Own the full\-cycle recruiting process for technical roles, from intake and calibration through sourcing, interviewing, offer negotiation, and close.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to clarify role requirements, align on hiring strategy, and provide ongoing market and pipeline insights.
* Build and engage diverse technical talent pipelines through proactive sourcing and thoughtful candidate outreach.
* Deliver a high\-quality candidate experience by guiding candidates through interviews, communicating clearly and consistently, and supporting offer discussions through acceptance.
* Use recruiting data and funnel insights to track progress, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive better hiring outcomes over time.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* 5–8 years of recruiting experience, with significant experience hiring for software engineering and technology organizations.
* Proven experience recruiting within technology product companies, SaaS, cloud, consumer technology, fintech, marketplaces, or other engineering\-led organizations.
* Ability to engage credibly with senior engineers and technical leaders and understand technology stacks, engineering environments, and technical career paths.
* Demonstrated success in passive candidate sourcing and talent mapping, particularly for difficult\-to\-fill roles.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence Hiring Managers and challenge assumptions when required.
* Experience managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high bar for candidate quality and experience.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use recruiting data to make decisions and improve outcomes.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Comfortable working in an environment that values ownership, speed, ambiguity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency with recruiting systems and tools such as Workday, Gem, and LinkedIn
* Proven expertise with AI tools to create dashboard and automate recruiting processes.


**Additional Information:**
* This is a hybrid role, 3 days work from office
* Working hours are 2 pm to 11 pm IST
* Candidates currently based in Bangalore will be considered

**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity**
 With 5,400 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune\-100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.
   

  

 At StoneX, we offer you the opportunity to be part of an institutional\-grade financial services network that connects companies, organizations, and investors to the global markets ecosystem. As a team member, you'll benefit from our unique blend of digital platforms, comprehensive clearing and execution services, personalized high\-touch support, and deep industry expertise. Elevate your career with us and make a significant impact in the world of global finance.

 Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Position Purpose:** 
 We are seeking a commercially minded
 **Senior Recruiter** 
 to join our Talent Acquisition team in Bangalore. This role will manage a diverse portfolio of hiring across both
 **technical (Engineering, Infrastructure, Data, Product)** 
 and
 **non\-technical (Operations, Finance, Risk, Corporate Functions)** 
 roles.

**Primary duties will include:**

* Support campus hiring initiatives, walk\-in drives, and employer branding activities as required. When time permits.

**Qualifications**

 :
   

  

* 5–10 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally within an enterprise or fast\-paced environment.
* Proven experience recruiting across both technology and corporate/non\-technical roles.
* Strong sourcing capability and experience hiring niche technical skillsets.
* Demonstrate experience utilizing AI\-enabled tools to enhance productivity and outcomes, or a strong aptitude and willingness to learn and adopt emerging AI technologies within a fast\-paced business environment.
* Experience partnering with global stakeholders across multiple geographies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational capability.
* Experience using ATS systems (Oracle, iCIMS or similar).

**What makes you stand out:**
* Experience hiring for enterprise engineering roles (e.g., .NET, React, Cloud, DevOps, Data).
* Experience supporting global hiring.
* Strong data\-driven mindset with the ability to analyze hiring metrics and identify trends.
* Experience building proactive talent communities and pipelining strategies.
* Exposure to diversity hiring initiatives or employer branding campaigns.


**Education / Certification Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (HR, Business, or related field preferred).


**Working environment:**
* Hybrid – (4 days in our Bangalore office per week)

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**About the team**
------------------

Our mission at Zillow is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. As part of Zillow Group’s Talent Acquisition team, you’ll help shape the future of our organization by attracting and hiring top talent. We are a collaborative, data\-informed, and candidate\-focused team that serves as the first impression of Zillow Group’s culture, values, and vision.
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.


**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Technical Recruiter** to help build high\-performing engineering and technology teams in a fast\-paced, product\-driven environment. This role is ideal for someone who understands technology hiring beyond job descriptions—someone who can engage deeply with engineering leaders, understand complex technical talent requirements, and build thoughtful strategies to identify and close exceptional talent.  

  



**You Will Get To**
-------------------

* Own end\-to\-end technical recruiting for complex and high\-impact engineering roles, from intake through offer and close.
* Partner with Engineering leaders and Hiring Managers to understand business priorities, team structures, technical requirements, and talent gaps.
* Translate technical requirements into effective talent strategies and sourcing plans, rather than relying solely on inbound applications.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines of high\-quality engineering talent across relevant technology ecosystems.
* Conduct meaningful candidate conversations and demonstrate the ability to understand and assess technical experience, career progression, scope, and impact.
* Use a combination of direct sourcing, market mapping, referrals, networking, research, and talent communities to identify passive candidates.
* Develop a strong understanding of the competitive technology talent landscape, including companies, skills, compensation trends, and candidate motivations.
* Partner with Hiring Managers throughout the interview process to ensure speed, quality, consistency, and an exceptional candidate experience.
* Drive offer strategy and close senior and highly sought\-after technical talent, understanding motivations beyond compensation.
* Use recruiting data and market insights to identify bottlenecks, improve conversion, and influence hiring decisions.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
**Who you are**
---------------

* 8–12 years of recruiting experience, with significant experience hiring for software engineering and technology organizations.
* Proven experience recruiting within technology product companies, SaaS, cloud, consumer technology, fintech, marketplaces, or other engineering\-led organizations.
* Ability to engage credibly with senior engineers and technical leaders and understand technology stacks, engineering environments, and technical career paths.
* Demonstrated success in passive candidate sourcing and talent mapping, particularly for difficult\-to\-fill roles.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence Hiring Managers and challenge assumptions when required.
* Experience managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high bar for candidate quality and experience.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use recruiting data to make decisions and improve outcomes.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Comfortable working in an environment that values ownership, speed, ambiguity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency with recruiting systems and tools such as Workday, Gem, and LinkedIn
* Proven expertise with AI tools to create dashboard and automate recruiting processes.

**Additional Information:**

* This is a hybrid role, 3 days work from office
* Working hours are 2 pm to 11 pm IST
* Candidates currently based in Bangalore will be considered

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.  



  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.  



  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.  



  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

  

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

 We are looking for a Senior Recruiter to own end\-to\-end hiring for technical roles across TechGrit and our client engagements. This is an individual\-contributor role for someone who can work independently: take a requirement from intake to offer with minimal supervision, manage multiple open roles in parallel, and act as a trusted hiring partner to delivery leaders and clients. You will build pipelines for hard\-to\-fill technical profiles, keep candidate quality high, and bring structure and data to how we hire.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**End\-to\-End Recruitment** 




 •      Own the full recruitment cycle independently — requirement intake, JD creation, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and pre\-joining follow\-up.
 



 •      Manage 8–12 concurrent open positions across technology stacks (.NET, Java, MERN, Cloud/DevOps, QA, Data, AI/ML, Mobile) and seniority levels up to Architect and Engineering Manager.
 



 •      Conduct first\-level technical and cultural screening to ensure only well\-matched profiles reach technical panels and clients.
 



 •      Drive offer closure — compensation discussions, counter\-offer handling, and notice\-period management to minimise drop\-offs.
 



**Sourcing \& Pipeline Building** 




 •      Source actively through Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, Hirist, job boards, referrals, and professional communities; run boolean and X\-ray searches for niche skills.
 



 •      Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring and hard\-to\-fill roles so that shortlists can be shared within 48–72 hours of a new requirement.
 



 •      Coordinate with external recruitment partners and interview\-panel vendors — share briefs, review submissions, and track vendor performance.
 



**Stakeholder \& Client Management** 




 •      Partner with delivery leaders and hiring managers to understand role needs, calibrate profiles, and advise on market availability and compensation.
 



 •      Present candidates to clients with clear, well\-structured profile summaries and manage client interview scheduling and feedback loops.
 



 •      Work across India and US time zones as needed to support client\-facing hiring.
 



**Process, Data \& Candidate Experience** 




 •      Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in the ATS / hiring tracker and report weekly on pipeline status, time\-to\-fill, source effectiveness, and offer\-acceptance rates.
 



 •      Prepare candidates for technical and client interviews so they present their experience accurately and confidently.

 The Sales Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for accelerating profitable growth across the India market by originating, shaping, and closing complex opportunities for HeadFirst Global's GCC and workforce solutions. The role engages confidently with senior client stakeholders, translating business and workforce challenges into differentiated, outcome\-led propositions that demonstrate measurable value, return on investment, and long\-term partnership potential. Working closely with the VP \- Sales and cross\-functional leaders, the role develops territory and account strategies, applies disciplined sales processes, maintains a high\-quality pipeline and forecast, and navigates multi\-stakeholder buying cycles from initial engagement through commercial negotiation and handover. The Senior Sales Executive brings strong market judgement, consultative and value\-selling capability, commercial acumen, and customer advocacy to strengthen client trust, expand strategic relationships, and consistently deliver revenue and margin objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and execute territory, segment, and target\-account strategies aligned to India growth priorities, ideal customer profiles, and revenue objectives.
* Originate and qualify high\-value opportunities through executive networks, referrals, strategic partnerships, market intelligence, events, and focused outreach.
* Build trusted relationships with C\-suite, procurement, HR, talent, finance, and operational stakeholders, mapping influence, decision criteria, and buying dynamics.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex opportunities, from discovery and opportunity strategy through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and transition to delivery.
* Consistently achieve or exceed revenue, gross\-margin, new\-logo, pipeline coverage, and conversion objectives while protecting commercial quality.
* Represent HeadFirst Global as a credible market voice at senior client forums, industry events, and strategic networking platforms.



  





**Client Engagement \& Solutions:** 



* Lead executive\-level discovery to uncover strategic priorities, operational pain points, risk considerations, decision criteria, and measurable success outcomes.
* Apply consultative and value\-based selling methods to connect HeadFirst Global's capabilities with client outcomes, including productivity, compliance, scalability, experience, cost optimization, and speed to value.
* Orchestrate cross\-functional solution design with Sales, Customer Success, Talent Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, ensuring propositions are differentiated, deliverable, and commercially sound.
* Develop and present compelling business cases, proposals, and executive presentations that articulate value, return on investment, commercial logic, and implementation confidence.
* Lead complex negotiations across scope, commercials, service levels, risk, and contract terms, maintaining client trust while protecting margin and governance standards.
* Act as a customer advocate by bringing client insight into solution development, mobilizing internal support, and setting clear expectations that enable long\-term value realisation



  





**Pipeline Management \& Reporting:** 



* Maintain rigorous CRM discipline, complete opportunity data, and clear next\-step ownership across all active accounts and deals.
* Build and manage a balanced, stage\-appropriate pipeline with sufficient coverage, prioritizing opportunities by strategic fit, value, probability, timing, and margin potential.
* Apply the agreed sales methodology and qualification framework consistently, using evidence\-based deal reviews to identify risks, remove blockers, and improve conversion.
* Provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts, clearly articulating assumptions, dependencies, decision paths, and recovery actions.
* Use data, market intelligence, and AI\-enabled sales tools to improve account prioritization, research, outreach personalization, pipeline insight, and forecast quality while applying appropriate judgement and data safeguards.
* Provide actionable insight on market trends, competitors, buying behaviour, customer needs, and proposition gaps to inform commercial strategy and portfolio development.



  





**Governance \& Collaboration:** 



* Operate within the delegation of authority, pricing, margin, contractual, compliance, and ethical frameworks; escalate exceptions early and with clear recommendations.
* Lead internal deal governance for priority opportunities, aligning stakeholders on win strategy, solution, commercials, risks, approvals, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate a disciplined handover to Customer Success and delivery teams, ensuring commitments, assumptions, risks, success measures, and stakeholder expectations are documented and understood.
* Partner effectively across functions and geographies to mobilize expertise, remove barriers, and present one integrated HeadFirst Global experience to the client.
* Share winning practices, market insight, and constructive coaching with colleagues, contributing to continuous improvement in sales capability, process, and performance.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Substantial B2B solution\-sales or business\-development experience, preferably in staffing, MSP, RPO, GCC, workforce solutions, technology\-enabled services, or professional services.
* Demonstrated record of winning new logos, meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets, and closing complex, multi\-stakeholder opportunities.
* Strong proficiency in sales strategy, territory and account planning, consultative and value selling, opportunity qualification, commercial negotiation, and disciplined sales\-process execution.
* Advanced pipeline management and forecasting capability, with strong CRM discipline and the ability to convert data into practical deal and portfolio decisions.
* Credibility and confidence engaging C\-suite and senior functional leaders, with excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, articulate return on investment, understand pricing and margin implications, and balance customer value with organizational outcomes.
* AI fluency, including effective and responsible use of AI\-enabled tools for research, account intelligence, prospecting, personalization, proposal development, productivity, and sales analysis; able to validate outputs and protect confidential data.
* Strong customer\-advocacy orientation, with evidence of representing the customer voice internally, resolving barriers, and building relationships that support retention, expansion, and referrals.
* Sound understanding of the India commercial and workforce landscape, including relevant client buying dynamics, market trends, and regulatory considerations.
* High levels of ownership, resilience, judgement, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast\-growing, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field; relevant advanced study or professional sales certification is advantageous.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* The opportunity to shape commercial growth across India's major metropolitan markets and represent a differentiated GCC and workforce solutions portfolio.
* A high\-impact senior individual\-contributor role with access to executive stakeholders, strategic opportunities, and international expertise.
* A collaborative, ambitious, and customer\-led culture that values performance, ownership, innovation, and responsible use of technology.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and clear opportunities for continued professional and leadership development.

title: Junior Recruiting Coordinator – International Recruitment
description:
**Adler \& Pfau India Private Limited \| Mumbai \| Full\-time** 




**Experience: 0–2 years \| Fresh graduates welcome** 




  




 About us
 
 Adler \& Pfau connects skilled professionals in India with employment opportunities in Germany. Through our Wings49 platform and our recruiting partners, we support candidates from their initial interest through recruitment, preparation and relocation.
 



 We are looking for an organised and motivated colleague in Mumbai to help coordinate our daily recruitment activities. You do not need extensive recruiting experience. We will provide training, clear processes and practical guidance.
 



  




 Your role
 
 You will research suitable vacancies, contact potential candidates and keep recruitment activities moving. You will coordinate communication between candidates, employers, recruiting partners and our internal teams.
 



 Your initial focus will be technical and skilled trades, including welders, electricians and mechanical technicians.
 



  




 Your responsibilities
 * Research vacancies in Germany through LinkedIn, employer websites and other agreed job portals. Record the source, location, requirements and relevant contact person.
* Use LinkedIn Recruiter and other approved tools to identify potential candidates, including professionals with German\-language skills. Introduce relevant opportunities and explain how to register on Wings49\.
* Review matches suggested by Wings49 and conduct initial candidate conversations using a structured checklist. Confirm interest in the specific job and location, availability, language background and motivation.
* Collect missing information, prepare standardised CVs and document the required candidate permission before sharing information with an employer.
* Present suitable candidates through the agreed channel, normally the channel where the vacancy was found. Share our standard service catalogue and follow up using approved templates.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate candidate preparation with our licensed recruiting partners in India.
* Keep candidate records, employer contacts, communication, next steps and deadlines up to date in Wings49 and our CRM so colleagues can continue the work when needed.
* After a successful placement, coordinate the handover to our Relocation team for individual support and cost clarification.



  




 What we are looking for
 * Good written and spoken English.
* Strong organisation, attention to detail and reliable follow\-up.
* Confidence speaking with candidates and communicating professionally by email and LinkedIn.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, online platforms and digital tools.
* Willingness to learn recruiting processes, CRM software and responsible use of AI tools.
* Respectful handling of personal information and an honest, transparent approach to candidates.
* Based in Mumbai or able to work from Mumbai.



 Fresh graduates are welcome. An internship or initial experience in recruitment, customer service, sales support or administration would be helpful.
 



**German\-language skills, technical qualifications and international recruiting experience are not required.** 




  




 Training and support
 
 You will work with clear checklists, message templates and guidance from an assigned manager. Technical assessments, legal or visa questions, contractual commitments and pricing exceptions will be handled by the responsible specialists or management.
 



 Your responsibility is to coordinate the process carefully, identify missing information and raise questions early.
 



  




 What we offer
 * A practical start in international recruitment.
* Training in LinkedIn Recruiter, Wings49 and CRM\-based recruitment coordination.
* Collaboration with colleagues and recruiting partners in India and Germany.
* The opportunity to take on more responsibility as your skills develop.
* Fair, competitive compensation aligned with the role, your experience and the local market in Mumbai.
* Salary development linked to performance, growing skills and increased responsibility.



  





 We want to be transparent about salary expectations: our connection to Germany does not automatically mean above\-market salaries in India. We aim to offer fair pay, a supportive working environment and opportunities to build a long\-term career with us.
 



  




 What success looks like
 
 Accurate records, suitable candidate introductions, timely follow\-up and well\-prepared interviews. We value the quality of your work and the candidate experience, rather than simply the number of messages sent.

description:
