**Location:** 
  West Delhi, New Delhi \- On\-site
 



**Experience:** 
  3–5 years (preferably in telesales / call center / D2C / BPO setup)
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-time
 



  





**About SIVAARA** 




 SIVAARA is a fast\-growing health \& wellness company building a strong presence in South India through performance\-driven telesales and COD operations.
 



  





 We run a high\-intensity, metric\-focused operation:
 


* Large volume of 
 **incoming leads** 
  every day
* **Multi\-language telesales team** 
  (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, etc.)
* Strong focus on 
 **discipline, accountability, performance, and culture**
* Structured processes for 
 **sales, logistics, inventory, HR, and compliance**



  





 We already have clear SOPs and systems for most departments. Now we want a dedicated 
 **HR Executive** 
  who can own the people side of SIVAARA and build a strong HR function end\-to\-end.
 



  





**Role Overview – What You’ll Own** 




 You will be the only
 **full\-time HR Manager** 
  fully dedicated to SIVAARA operations.
 



 Your job is to make sure:
 


* The 
 **right people** 
  join us
* The 
 **right culture** 
  is maintained
* The 
 **right systems** 
  are followed daily



  





 You’ll work closely with the 
 **Founder** 
  and handle HR across Sales, Logistics, Inventory, MIS, QA, and Support teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. 
 **Hiring \& Manpower Planning** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for:
* Telesales agents (multiple languages)
* Team Leaders / Managers
* NDR / Verification / Retention teams
* Logistics, Inventory, MIS, and Support roles
* Build and manage a 
 **steady hiring pipeline** 
  so that:
* We never run short of agents
* Replacements are planned in advance
* Coordinate with local consultants, job portals, walk\-ins, and referrals.
* Create 
 **clear JD templates, screening criteria, and selection processes** 
  for each role.



  





 2\. 
 **Onboarding, Training \& Confirmations** 



* Design and run a 
 **structured onboarding process** 
 :
* Documentation, background checks (where required)
* Explaining SIVAARA’s processes, culture, and expectations
* Coordinate with Training / Operations to:
* Track agents through training, test call period, and probation
* Maintain clear records of:
* Joining dates, training status, confirmation status, and exits



  





 3\. 
 **Attendance, Discipline \& HR Operations** 



* Own daily 
 **attendance, late\-coming, and absenteeism tracking**
* Ensure all policies are actually followed:
* Shift timings
* Breaks
* Phone submission / data security norms
* Leave policies
* Prepare and share discipline reports with Operations \& Management.
* Co\-ordinate with accounts/finance for 
 **monthly payroll inputs** 
 :
* Present days, LOP, incentives data (from MIS/Operations)



  





 4\. 
 **Performance, Incentives \& HR Analytics** 



* Work with MIS / Operations to:
* Understand key performance metrics (DR, AOV, sales, productivity, etc.)
* Map them to incentive policies already designed
* Ensure 
 **incentive policies are communicated clearly** 
  to all teams.
* Help management identify:
* Top performers for growth and promotions
* Consistently low performers for PIP or exits
* Share 
 **monthly HR dashboards** 
 : headcount, hiring vs attrition, probation status, PIP list, etc.



  





 5\. 
 **Policy, Compliance \& Documentation** 



* Implement and maintain:
* Appointment letters, NDAs, HR policies, warning letters, exit formats, etc.
* Handle:
* Confirmations, warnings, suspension letters, exits and full \& final coordination
* Ensure:
* Basic compliance with labour laws, working hours, and internal policies
* Assist management in implementing:
* POSH policy
* Grievance redressal mechanisms



  





 6\. 
 **Culture, Conduct \& Conflict Management** 



* Maintain a 
 **high\-performance, respectful, and no\-politics environment** 
 .
* Act as a 
 **neutral point of contact** 
  for:
* Employee grievances
* Escalations within teams
* Identify negative behavior patterns early (toxicity, repeated policy breaks, attitude issues) and work with Operations to address them.
* Support in 
 **recognition programs** 
 :
* “Agent of the month”

* Referral incentives

 **years of HR experience** 
 , preferably with:
* Call centers / BPOs / telesales processes
* D2C / COD\-based businesses (bonus)
* Are comfortable working in a 
 **high\-volume, fast\-paced sales environment** 
 .
* Are strong in:
* **Recruitment** 
  (frontline \+ mid\-level)

* **Policies, letters, and documentation**
* Can speak 
 **Tamil/Hindi or English** 
  fluently (other South Indian languages are a plus).
* Are assertive, fair, and consistent
* You’re friendly but firm
* You can say “no” when needed
* Are comfortable working closely with the 
 **Founder**

title: Head of Talent
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, and Kaaiser.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent, whether for a company, a university system, or a country, is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most of them are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.
   

  

 Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.
   

  

 This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You are the person who translates talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.
   

  

 You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation that Manifest expects every function to become, and proving that Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and new people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a materially harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is the advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.
   

  

 The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a materially different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.
   

  

**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade**
 Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that a talent function can operate with the same rigor, and the same voice at the table, as finance or product. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions, and how talent leadership earns a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like, for Manifest and for the industry watching how Manifest does it.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine**
* Own the hiring strategy and standard across every brand, every geography, and every level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default, not the exception
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold every part of the function accountable to it


**Talent Operations And The Employee Experience**
* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the same rigor a business its size requires


**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession**
* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support, not a support function
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness rather than a gap discovered under pressure
* Set the standard for what a high\-performing team looks like at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes that standard repeatable rather than dependent on any one leader


**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment**
* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, capacity, capability, and retention, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan rather than reacting to it
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable and as credible as revenue


**Talent AI and Infrastructure**
* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support, all running on AI rather than layered with it afterward
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function instead of several
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products


**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership**
* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally, as part of how the company is known in its markets, not just how it hires into them
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people, so talent becomes a discipline every executive is fluent in, not a function they delegate to


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first months, you have formed a clear, specific point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, on where the leadership bench is strong and where it needs building, and on what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath all of it needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and with the executive team as someone who understands their commercial reality, not just their headcount requests.
   

  

 By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning rather than a reaction to it, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people across every brand. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible and as data\-driven as finance's.
   

  

 In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and more than one business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as a set of interconnected systems and bets, workforce planning, leadership development, hiring, infrastructure, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.
   

  

 You have built high\-performing teams before, and you know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and a team that performs because the systems, the bench, and the standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, forecasting capacity and capability gaps before they become urgent, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.
   

  

 You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and you know the difference between AI as a feature bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.
   

  

 You have a real point of view on talent and you are comfortable being the voice that carries it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and you hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic, while still being the kind of leader they would choose to work for again.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as industries are reshaped by AI. Manifest is backed by $91M from Tiger Global, Square Peg Capital, Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital, and others. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically: Manifest sells the world an AI\-native way of moving talent across borders. Talent, the function, is where that standard either becomes real inside the company, in the teams it builds and the workforce plan it runs, or stays a claim on a careers page. This role decides which one it is.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

title: Senior Talent Operations Specialist
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, FlowAI, Kaaiser and Edugo.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Talent Operations touches the entire distance between the day someone accepts an offer and the day they eventually leave, onboarding, payroll, policy, workplace, travel, global mobility, the data and systems that hold all of it together. Most companies split this work across several dedicated teams. Manifest asks a small, sharp team to hold all of it at a standard that doesn't slip, and increasingly, to run it on AI and automation as the default way of working, not a talking point bolted onto an old process.
   

  

 This matters beyond keeping the trains running. Talent Operations is the function every employee touches constantly and every executive assumes just works, until it doesn't. And for a company that grows partly through acquisition, this function is where a good deal quietly becomes a bad one or a genuinely smooth integration, because onboarding, payroll, and systems migration are where new employees actually experience whether the acquisition was handled with care.
   

  

 This role owns a real slice of that map, allocated as you join, and is built for someone who can move fluidly across it rather than specializing narrowly in one lane. You bring data and AI\-native tools to bear on operational work that most companies still run manually, which is exactly what lets a team this size hold a scope this wide.
   

  

 You own making the operational backbone of the employee experience run the way Manifest's own product does: systemized, data\-informed, and genuinely good.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most Talent Operations roles let you go deep in one lane and stay there, payroll people stay in payroll, onboarding people stay in onboarding. This one deliberately doesn't. You're a true generalist across the full employee lifecycle, which means a faster learning curve, far more exposure than a specialist track ever offers, and real involvement in acquisition integration work most people in this function don't get near until much later in their careers.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem means your generalist range gets used across five brands and multiple geographies, not one company's steady\-state operations. Every acquisition, every new market, every policy that has to work across jurisdictions is a chance to actually use the breadth you bring, not a complication to work around.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Employee Lifecycle Operations**
* Own onboarding and offboarding end to end, making both feel deliberate rather than administrative
* Own employee contract management with the accuracy and care that a growing, multi\-country team requires
* Build the muscle memory that makes lifecycle transitions consistent regardless of which brand or market someone sits in


**Policies, Compliance, and Rewards**
* Own policy design and compliance across every jurisdiction Manifest operates in, treating this as a genuine standard, not a formality
* Partner on compensation, benefits, and payroll accuracy, understanding that this is the part of the employee experience with zero tolerance for error
* Own rewards and recognition programs that actually reflect the culture Manifest wants, not a generic points system


**Workplace, Travel, and Employee Support**
* Own the systems behind business travel, global mobility, and the talent helpdesk that employees rely on when something isn't working
* Be the person who makes navigating Manifest's operational systems feel simple, even when the underlying complexity, multiple brands, multiple countries, isn't
* Partner closely with the workplace function so the physical and operational experience of working at Manifest feels like one coherent thing, not several disconnected systems


**Data, Systems, and AI\-Native Operations**
* Own the platforms, data, and automations that run Talent Operations, treating this as core infrastructure, not an afterthought
* Bring genuine AI fluency to how operational work gets done, identifying where automation should replace manual process rather than just supplement it
* Own talent analytics and insights that give the Talent team, and the business, an honest, current read on the state of the employee experience


**Project and Vendor Management**
* Own cross\-functional Talent Operations projects end to end, including the operational side of acquisition integrations as Manifest grows
* Manage vendor relationships with real discipline, holding external partners to the same standard Manifest holds itself
* Run projects the way a strong operator does: scoped clearly, tracked honestly, delivered on the timeline you committed to


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where Talent Operations is today. We'll calibrate the specifics to your actual ownership areas once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first weeks, you've learned the real shape of Talent Operations at Manifest, met the people and systems behind each area you own, and formed a genuine point of view on what's working well and what needs a better process behind it.
   

  

 By mid\-period, the areas you own run visibly smoother, employees experience less friction navigating them, and you've brought real automation or data thinking to at least one process that used to run entirely by hand.
   

  

 In the long term, you're the person other members of the Talent team turn to when something spans more than one area of Talent Operations, because you're one of the few people who can see the whole map, not just a single lane of it.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You've worked across multiple areas of Talent or HR Operations before, not just one specialty, and you're genuinely energized by breadth rather than wishing you could narrow your focus. You think in systems and processes, and you have real project management instincts, you scope things properly, track them honestly, and finish what you start.
   

  

 You're authentically data\-driven, comfortable pulling and interpreting your own numbers rather than waiting for someone else to hand you a dashboard, and you use that data to actually change how something runs, not just to report on it. You're genuinely AI\-native in your own practice, you've used AI tools to automate or improve operational work yourself, and you instinctively look for where a manual process should become an automated one.
   

  

 You're comfortable with a role whose exact ownership isn't fully fixed until you join, and you'd rather find out what needs you most and move than have it all mapped out in advance.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of how wide this role's scope is and your first reaction was not "that's a lot to hold," it was "that's exactly the kind of range I want in a role." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 150\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $91M raised. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically: Manifest grows in part by acquiring other companies, and every acquisition is a test of whether Talent Operations can absorb new people, new systems, and new complexity without the employee experience taking the hit. This role is one of the people who makes sure it doesn't.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

 As a Great Place to Work certified in 72 countries, our culture thrives on diversity, equity, and inclusion. We value your unique perspective and believe that your talent is the missing piece that completes our vision for a brighter, digitally driven tomorrow.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 In this role, you will search, screen, and select the right candidates for high\-level positions that are key to TP's success. You will be the starting point for determining whether candidates are a match, fully qualified, and passionate about the position.
 



  





 Your role in executive recruitment will be very competitive. You may need to actively interact with candidates who are already in high demand or under contract with other employers, making negotiation skills critical for success. You will help streamline the recruiting process to ensure suitable candidates are appointed within appropriate time frames and provide support to global talent sourcing teams.
 



  





 You will be the point of contact for hiring managers, implement the search process, and liaise with hiring managers regarding candidate pipelines and suggestions. The role is heavily analytical, requiring strong project management, time management, communication, and negotiation skills with both candidates and upper management.
 



  





**The Responsibilities \& Duties** 



* Bring skills in executive and leadership Talent Acquisition, focusing on Niche Talent Sourcing for global recruitment processes (including Head\-Hunting, Talent Mapping, and Lead generation).
* Leading end\-to\-end recruitment mandates across multiple business and support verticals.
* Assess stakeholders' most pressing needs and organizational goals.
* Strategize ways to build talent pipelines and execute research, referral generation, and sourcing approaches using various channels, presenting detailed candidate profile summaries at the closing date.
* Act as the first interviewer for candidates, staying deeply in touch with hiring managers' needs to save them valuable time.
* Assess job descriptions and additional assessments based on intake calls with hiring managers.
* Develop sustainable candidate talent pools and define strategies for healthy pipelines.
* Participate in compensation negotiations and discussions with candidates, working closely with businesses to determine terms.
* Advise stakeholders on best recruiting practices and outside\-the\-box solutions.
* Follow up with hiring managers to obtain up\-to\-date input on potential hires.



  





**The Qualifications** 



* Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, HRMS, ATS tools, and MS Office (especially MS Excel) is mandatory.
* BPO industry experience preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or MBA.
* Experience with significant executive and leadership placement firms is a plus.
* Professional networking skills are a must.
* Critical thinker and problem\-solver.
* Team player with outstanding time\-management skills.
* Precise and detail\-oriented, prepared for an ever\-changing, fast\-paced environment.
* Confidentiality and trust when conducting background checks and handling sensitive information.
* Persistent and persuasive with top recruits.
* Interpersonal skills with an interest in conversing with people from unique backgrounds.
* Highly organized and thorough.



  





**Pre\-Employment Screenings** 




 By TP policy, employment in this position will be contingent on your successful completion of and passage of a comprehensive background check, including global sanctions and watchlist screening.
 



  





**Important \| Policy on Unsolicited Third\-Party Candidate Submissions** 




 TP does not accept candidate submissions from unsolicited third parties, including recruiters or headhunters. Applications will not be considered, and no contractual association will be established through such submissions.
 



  





**Culture \& Belonging** 




 At TP, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and lifestyles and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other differences.

description:

 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an HR Business Partner for India, you'll work closely with the Director of People – APAC to support our Bangalore based teams through a period of rapid growth. You will enable leaders to achieve their business goals through their people \- building the capacity of the organization to attract, develop, and retain talent while ensuring every decision holds up against India's statutory and regulatory framework.
   

  

 This role combines strategic HRBP partnership with hands\-on ownership of India\-specific compliance, employee relations, and operational rigor. You'll be a trusted advisor to business leaders and a steady, empathetic presence for employees, while working closely with Payroll \& Compliance, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to deliver a consistent employee experience.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Business Partnership
   

  

* Conduct regular cadence meetings with your assigned business unit(s), acting as the primary People point of contact for leaders and employees.
* Provide compensation and leveling guidance to business unit leaders, in partnership with Total Rewards, anchored to India market benchmarks and internal equity.
* Analyze workforce trends and metrics \- attrition, hiring, promotions, engagement \- in partnership with the People Operations team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Drive business unit organizational design and talent strategy to achieve business objectives, including headcount planning and role scoping.


 Employee Relations \& Compliance
   

  

* Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues; conduct thorough, objective, and well\-documented investigations.
* Maintain in\-depth, current knowledge of Indian labor law \- including the Shops and Establishments Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, POSH Act, and the New Labour Codes as they come into force \- to reduce legal risk and ensure regulatory compliance across Karnataka and any other state of operation.
* Partner with Payroll \& HR Compliance and external legal counsel as needed on statutory matters, notices, and filings.
* Own or contribute to background verification (BGV) exception handling and RAG\-based risk assessment for your business unit, in line with company policy.
* Provide day\-to\-day performance management guidance to managers \- coaching, counseling, career development, and disciplinary action \- consistent with Indian employment norms and documentation standards.
* Work closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, flagging gaps between global policy and India\-specific legal requirements.


 Talent, Training \& Culture
   

  

* Identify training needs for business units and individual coaching needs for people managers; monitor and follow up on training and upskilling objectives.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for your business unit, partnering with Onboarding \& Ops on a smooth, compliant employee lifecycle.

* Help build and refine India People Ops systems and processes \- you'll help write a policy when one doesn't yet exist.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience as an HRBP, with a strong point of view on how HRBPs move a business forward; experience at a fast\-growing technology or insurance company is a plus.
* In\-depth working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance \- PF, ESI, gratuity, statutory bonus, Karnataka Shops \& Establishments Act, and the New Labour Codes. Prior exposure to a multi\-state India compliance footprint is a strong plus.
* Experience managing complex employee relations cases, including conducting investigations and resolving disputes; experience partnering with Underwriting, Engineering, or another regulated business function is a plus.
* Working knowledge of multiple HR disciplines \- organizational design, learning and development, compensation, HR technology, and data management.
* Exposure to a matrixed or multi\-country People team structure (e.g., partnering across India, Singapore, or the US) is a plus.
* You are an empathetic listener who can build trust quickly and hold it, even in difficult conversations.
* You are data\-driven \- able to back up your recommendations to client groups with solid data and clear reasoning.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, first\-principles environment and see the ambiguity of a scaling company as an exciting challenge rather than a blocker.
* You are a strong communicator, comfortable representing the People function to senior stakeholders.
* You have a genuine passion for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate qualification in HR or a related field is preferred.

title: Human Resources Director
description:
**About Flipkart** 




  





 Flipkart is India's leading e\-commerce marketplace, serving 500 million\+ registered customers and enabling millions of sellers, logistics partners, and brands. We are building the commerce infrastructure of India — powered by technology, data, and an unrelenting focus on the customer. Our people are the engine behind this mission.
 



  





**Role Context** 




 The Director – HRBP for OneTech is a strategic leadership role at the intersection of people, technology, and organizational effectiveness. This leader will serve as the primary HR partner to senior Engineering and Product leadership — shaping the talent and culture agenda for the teams building Flipkart's core technology platforms.
 



 This is not a traditional HR role. It demands a strategic, execution\-oriented, and data\-fluent HR leader who can influence at the CXO level, navigate organizational complexity at scale, and drive people agendas that directly accelerate engineering velocity and product outcomes.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Business Partnership** 



* Serve as a trusted thought partner to Engineering VPs, Product heads, and their leadership teams — present in business reviews, roadmap planning, and leadership forums.
* Translate business and technology strategy into people priorities: talent, structure, culture, and capability roadmaps aligned to 1–3 year engineering and product goals.
* Understand how product orgs operate — squads, platforms, roadmaps, — and bring HR interventions that map to how engineering actually works.



  





  





**Organizational Design \& Effectiveness** 



* Lead org design across engineering and product functions: platform team structures, squad models, span of control, layer optimization, and role architecture that scales with growth.
* Drive workforce planning in partnership with Finance and TA — headcount modelling, skills gap analysis, and build\-buy\-borrow decisions across technology stacks and domains.
* Facilitate restructuring, team integrations (post\-M\&A), and transformation programs within the vertical.



**Talent Strategy \& Leadership Development** 



* Own the talent agenda for engineering and product: succession planning, high\-potential identification, critical role coverage, and retention of senior engineers and PMs.
* Partner with L\&D to design leadership development pathways for tech leads, senior ICs, engineering managers, and directors.
* Drive a differentiated EVP narrative tailored to attract senior engineering and product talent in a competitive market.



**Culture, Engagement \& DEI** 



* Champion a high\-performance, inclusive engineering culture — using engagement data to diagnose friction and design targeted interventions.
* Lead DEI action planning within client groups, with measurable outcomes on representation across engineering levels and product leadership.
* Act as a culture anchor during periods of change — leadership transitions, org restructures, M\&A integration.



**Performance \& Total Rewards** 



* Anchor the annual performance cycle for the function — calibration, differentiation, and quality of feedback, including IC vs. management tracks.
* Partner with Compensation to design benchmarking, off\-cycle corrections, and incentive structuring for specialized roles (Staff/Principal engineers, Distinguished architects, senior PMs).



**Employee Relations** 



* Handle complex ER matters within the function — investigations, disciplinary actions, and sensitive people issues — with discretion and sound judgment.
* Ensure HR practices comply with applicable labour laws and internal governance frameworks.



**People Analytics \& HR Operating Model** 



* Use workforce and engagement data to generate insights and drive evidence\-based decisions — attrition risk, org health signals, span/layer diagnostics.
* Continuously sharpen HR operating rhythms: governance cadences, HRBP\-to\-business touchpoints, and HR service delivery for the function.
* Represent OneTech HR requirements in cross\-functional CoE forums (policy design, HRIS improvements, comp frameworks).



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Experience** 



* 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 10\+ years as a senior HRBP directly supporting large Engineering or Product organizations.
* Demonstrated success partnering with CXOs and senior technical leaders in a fast\-paced, high\-growth technology or e\-commerce environment.
* Experience managing HR for organizations with significant engineering headcount (500\+) and product\-led business models.
* Prior exposure to M\&A integration, org transformation, or post\-restructuring stabilization in a tech context is strongly preferred.



**Functional Capabilities** 



* Deep HRBP expertise: org design, talent management, performance, compensation, ER, and culture — with specific fluency in how these apply to engineering orgs.
* Ability to speak the language of engineering and product: understands agile ways of working, platform thinking, IC career ladders, and tech hiring dynamics.
* Strong proficiency in workforce analytics and HR metrics; comfortable with data\-driven storytelling to senior technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and HR compliance relevant to large technology organizations.



**Leadership \& Personal Attributes** 



* Executive presence: capable of holding a room with senior engineering leaders, pushing back constructively, and influencing without authority.
* High learning agility — able to quickly absorb context across diverse technology domains and connect dots across business units.
* Operates with discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
* Collaborative but decisive; brings clarity and calm during periods of ambiguity and change.
* Resilient, self\-aware, and genuinely invested in the growth of the teams they support.



  





  





**Why Flipkart** 



* Shape the people agenda for the engineering teams building India's commerce, payments, and supply chain infrastructure.
* Partner with leaders solving problems at a scale few technology organizations in India operate at.
* Work in an HR function with CoE depth, real data maturity, and a genuine seat at the business table.
* Competitive compensation, ESOP participation, and a high\-velocity growth environment.
* A culture that values directness, intellectual curiosity, and impact over hierarchy.

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.
   

  

 The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.
   

  

 This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.
   

  

 ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.
   

  

 Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.
   

  

 Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.
   

  

 QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.
   

  

 Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.
   

  

 Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.
   

  

 Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.
   

  

 Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.
   

  

 L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System

title: Trainer - India
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
 Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000\-year data gap” — the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments — kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes — to capture the high\-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more \[here]
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and deliver on a learning curriculum for the Operations team that aligns with Instawork’s business objectives and scales with a growing organization; coordinate and administer training
* Develop a comprehensive onboarding program that encourages new team members to provide premier support for Instawork’s customers and internal stakeholders, as well as prepare them for an intensive operational role managing high volume and nuanced customer requests
* Collaborate with management to create training plans, develop training modules, and facilitate real\-time training for Operations new hires and continuing education for tenured specialists
* Manage the efficacy of new hire onboarding through continuous process planning, execution, and identifying metrics for the Operations learning curriculum
* Establish methods for measuring and reporting on learner engagement, comprehension, and practical application
* Provide consistent visibility through written status and ongoing reporting, summarizing learner developmen
* Develop learning exercises with specific examples of interactions that promote empathy and obsession with the customer experience
* Create and assist with managing content for the Operations for the internal customer Knowledge Base and external customer Help Center


**Who You Are**
* 6\+ months of experience leading and creating support training programs
* 6\+ months leading remote or diverse teams, preferably in the technology services industry
* Experience creating content for and publishing within a Content or Learning Management System
* Proven ability to utilize different strategies to engage learners through presentation, facilitation and mentorship, as well as use of online and offline training concepts
* Demonstrated success managing long\-term projects and ongoing reporting for deliverables
* Proven ability to motivate, influence and work effectively at all organizational levels using different methods of communication
* Experience collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones and languages and cultures strongly preferred Learning Management System (LMS) administration experience preferred


**Preferred Languages**
* Fluent in English and at least one of the following regional languages: Marathi, Telugu, or Kannada.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

description:

 Superleap is redefining the category by creating a "System of Intelligence" that is flexible, fast, and AI\-native. Our mission is to disrupt the CRM category by providing a 10x superior product and service that handles enterprise complexity at scale.

title: Transformation Program Manager
description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting\-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.


**Your Role**
-------------


The role owns the end\-to\-end shaping, mobilisation and delivery of enterprise transformation – process reengineering, operating model change, digital and data platforms, and the change management that makes the new way of working stick – with accountability for measurable business value, not go\-live sign\-off.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*


* **Stakeholder leadership and CXO communication**: operate as the single point of confidence for the CEO/CXO group. Brief leadership with clarity, candour and a clear ask; report honestly including bad news; and hold alignment across function heads, plant and market leadership, finance, procurement, HR and partner executives who do not report to you. Surface resistance early and distinguish genuine business objection from turf protection.
* **Program shaping and value ownership –** convert leadership intent into a sequenced roadmap, funding envelope and defensible business case; stay accountable for benefit realisation well beyond deployment
* **Multi\-vendor ecosystem leadership –** run consortia of consultants, system integrators, OEMs and specialist partners under different commercial constructs. Own RFP to award, SOW/NFA, SLA and penalty frameworks, milestone\-linked invoicing and change control. Eliminate seams between vendors, hold each to outcomes rather than effort, and act decisively – including descoping or exiting a non\-performer mid\-program
* **A****doption, not just deployment –** define adoption metrics up front and be judged on them: usage, process compliance, data quality, cycle time and cost outcomes after go\-live. Own the change architecture – communication, leadership cascades, champion networks, training, hypercare and sustainment \& **Governance and financial control –** run a disciplined review rhythm with owner\-and\-date closure; control budgets, phased fund release, commitment\-versus\-spend and forecast\-at\-completion; enforce a single source of truth and auditable decision trails
**Your Profile**
----------------


* 14–20 years overall, with at least two enterprise transformation programs personally led end to end – typically ₹100 crore\+ in value, 18–36 months, enterprise\-wide impact \& Five or more delivery partners running concurrently, with ownership of the commercial and performance relationship.
* Sustained exposure to CXO and board forums – not through a sponsor, but as the person in the room answering the questions \& Delivery across multiple cultures – multi\-country, post\-merger integration, or a genuinely diverse multi\-state Indian footprint spanning corporate, plant and field
* Scope extending well beyond IT – process, organisation, commercial and behavioural change explicitly owned \& Accountability for a business number – cost, working capital, cycle time, service level or revenue – with evidence of delivered versus promised
* A program taken through serious trouble – a failing vendor, slipped go\-live, funding freeze or organised pushback – with a candid account of the recovery

-----------------------------------------


* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.

* Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description** **Strategic Mandate**


As the Engineering Manager, you will lead and grow the engineering organization behind Nielsen's Databricks\-based data and AI ecosystem — directly managing the Data Platform team and the AI/Data Engineering team. You are accountable for translating executive strategy into a single, unified roadmap that spans GenAI/data engineering and platform governance, ensuring these two disciplines operate in lockstep to drive shared business value. Beyond technical direction, you own people leadership, delivery accountability, and budget/FinOps stewardship for the combined Databricks program, and you are the primary point of escalation and executive stakeholder engagement when priorities, risks, or trade\-offs span both teams

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**

* Org \& People Leadership: Directly manage the AI/Data Engineering and Data Platform teams; own hiring, mentoring, performance management, career development, and career planning.
* Unified Technical Strategy: Shape a single, prioritized engineering plan that brings together GenAI and data\-engineering priorities with platform, governance, and FinOps commitments.
* Delivery \& Execution Accountability: Set OKRs, manage program/sprint cadences, and own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for the combined engineering organization — resolving cross\-team dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and delivery risks.
* Governance \& Risk Oversight: Provide senior oversight of Unity Catalog governance, data security, and platform reliability commitments (99\.99%), ensuring org\-wide compliance, audit readiness, and consistent governed AI enablement (e.g., Databricks Genie, AI/BI, etc).
* Emerging Technology Strategy: Partner with Strategy and Architecture to define standards and governance frameworks for emerging Databricks/AI capabilities, and run a structured evaluation process (POCs, security/architecture review, phased adoption) before they graduate into standard practice.
* Technology Trend Championing: Stay technologically upfront — track industry and Databricks/AI trends, personally trial promising capabilities, and champion adoption of what fits, balanced against a prioritized backlog and delivery commitments.
* FinOps \& Budget Ownership: Own the Databricks budget planning \& tracking, finops governance, headcount planning, and vendor/licensing decisions, bringing in cost\-efficiency accountability and "Strategic Foresight" targets on cloud spend.
* Executive \& Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary interface between the engineering organization and senior leadership, Finance, HR, and Product stakeholders — translating business priorities into technical direction and reporting progress upward.
* Culture \& Community: Champion a unified community of practice across data engineering and platform engineering, ensuring consistent engineering standards, mentorship, and knowledge sharing across both teams.

  

**Qualifications** **Expertise \& Technology Stack**

* Leadership Experience: 10\+ years in data/software engineering, including 3\+ years directly managing engineering leads, managers, or senior ICs across distributed teams.
* Databricks \& Data Platform Fluency: Strong working knowledge of the Databricks ecosystem (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Databricks Workflows, Databricks SQL) sufficient to evaluate architecture trade\-offs and coach technical leads, without requiring day\-to\-day hands\-on coding.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Working understanding of GenAI application patterns (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie, etc) to guide governed AI enablement decisions across both teams.
* People \& Org Development: Proven track record of hiring, performance calibration, career pathing, and building high\-performing, retention\-focused engineering teams.
* Program \& Delivery Management: Experience running OKRs/roadmaps, capacity planning, and cross\-team dependency management across multiple engineering disciplines.
* FinOps \& Budget Management: Experience owning cloud/platform budgets and driving cost\-efficiency accountability across teams.
* Analytical \& Influencing Skills: Ability to synthesize technical trade\-offs surfaced by multiple leads into a single executive narrative, and to influence decisions without dictating implementation details.
* Technology Curiosity: A demonstrated habit of tracking industry and Databricks/AI trends, hands\-on experimentation to validate fit, and driving pragmatic adoption rather than chasing hype.

  

**Additional Information** **Requirements \& Qualifications**

* Experience: 10\+ years in data/software engineering, with 3\+ years in an Engineering Manager or People Manager role overseeing senior/lead engineers delivering large\-scale data or AI platforms.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Proven track record of managing engineering leads responsible for large\-scale, governed data and AI platform delivery.
* Preferred: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional / Platform Architect, or a formal people\-leadership/management certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be able to represent the combined engineering organization to executive leadership and translate confidently across both technical domains and non\-technical stakeholders


Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.  

  

The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.  

  

This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.  

  

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.  

ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.  

Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.  

Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.  

QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.  

Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.  

Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.  

Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.  

Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.  

Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.  

L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager II
description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future

 **Job Description** **Strategic Mandate**


As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**

* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking

  

**Qualifications** **Expertise \& Technology Stack**

* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking

  

**Additional Information** **Requirements \& Qualifications**

* Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.


Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.
