title: Operations Manager
description:
Join us as a Operations Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be successful as a Operations Manager, must be subject matter expert providing a world class range of operational and transactional services for the benefit schemes that are provided to Barclays employees; engaging with key stakeholders within the Rewards \& Performance centres of excellence, external suppliers, and colleagues within the Benefits employee helpdesk.
   

  

**About Human Resources (HR)**
 The Barclays HR purpose is “making Barclays a great place to work”. From recruitment to retention, skills development to talent management, Barclays HR supports them all. The HR Function is made up of 1,500 people globally including centres of expertise specialising in diversity and inclusion; employee relations; learning; resourcing; reward and performance; and HR operations.
   

  

 We want to create the best possible experience for our colleagues \- whether they’re experienced professionals or just starting out. We offer them plenty of opportunities to develop and get the most from their careers.
   

  

 HR Operations provide their support through Global HR Service Centres, consisting of approximately 350 colleagues based across India, UK, US and APAC.
   

  

 ­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­
   

  

 Overall purpose of role
   

  

 Subject Matter Expert providing a world class range of operational and transactional services for the benefit schemes that are provided to Barclays employees; engaging with key stakeholders within the Rewards \& Performance centres of excellence, external suppliers, and colleagues within the Benefits employee helpdesk.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

  

* Subject Matter Expert in Pensions and Benefits and how they operate, working towards pre\-defined targets.
* Operating best\-in\-class end to end processes and controls.
* To lead on the delivery of Benefits and Rewards impacting projects incorporating change and business migration to agreed timescale, quality, ensuring objectives are delivered and improvements achieved.
* To deliver Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators.


**Operational Processing and Service Excellence**
* Develop, manage and maintain Benefits operational procedures and practices.
* Ensure that Benefit operational servicing and processing meets the needs of the customer and the business through stakeholder discussion.
* Responsible for query escalation and complaint handling for queries relating to Benefits and prompt root cause analysis of issues/planning and on\-time delivery of rectification activities as required.
* To liaise with the Reward Transaction Cycle to define and administer the benefits incorporating legislative, system, operational and business changes, communications to customers and testing, as required.
* Co\-ordinate and report all Benefit risks in line with HR guidelines including compliance with legislation, ensuring robust plans are in place and executed to time/quality.
* Analyse and report on Benefit related MI and any business opportunities or themes supported by the data.


**Operational Change Management**
* Identify opportunities to develop the service in line with the Benefit provision, Policy guidance, best practise and operational efficiencies.
* Work in partnership with the wider HR Operational and Control teams to shape and develop the customer experience and deliver Benefit related business objectives.
* Work in partnership with governing bodies or Reward Policy team to ensure implementation and delivery of legislative and policy change.
* Make operational change decisions based on an evaluation of risk, cost, resource availability, customer service and overall impact on Benefit operational servicing \& processing model.
* Operate and evaluate implemented process, procedure and policy change and feedback to relevant parties.
* Support transitional change activity to either embed new operational services or migrate services to other areas of HR Operations.


 Stakeholder Management and Leadership
   

  

  

* Lead on specific benefit related projects as required.
* Responsible for the provision of progress updates to Line Management and Stakeholders, identifying and reporting areas of Risk and escalating issues in a timely manner.
* Establishing day to day relationships with peers within HR business and customer to manage the smooth transition of the project from inception through to live, supporting the project in the realisation of anticipated benefits.


 Decision\-making and Problem Solving
   

  

  

* Build trust through credible use of facts and data and possesses ability to creatively resolve problems and issues at pace.
* Analyse problems and evaluate options prior to decision making \- commit to a course of action after identifying and assessing alternatives based on logical assumptions, facts, resources, constraints and organisational values.


**Risk and Control Objective**
 Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, Enterprise Wide Risk Management Framework and internal Barclays Policies and Policy Standards.
   

  

 Person Specification
   

  

  

* SME in Pensions and Benefits operation
* Proven ability to effectively manage multiple priorities/projects, ensuring consistent delivery to a high standard and customer satisfaction.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills with the ability to influence and build commitment amongst senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrate resilience \- reacts positively to changes and maintains poise, focus and flexibility when encountering difficulties or obstacles.
* Possess a demonstrable ability to effectively engage with stakeholders, whilst being able to clearly communicate requirements and liaise with peers who are required to support the delivery.


**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications**
* Degree qualified or with equivalent professional qualifications or demonstrable experience in lieu of this
* Experience of Benefits, governance, controls and risk management.
* Excellent people management skills in relation to performance, motivation, development and delivery
* Customer Service experience – ability to deal with a varied customer base, including business customers \& senior stakeholders, and explain complex queries clearly


**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**
* Preferably degree qualified in a numerate or HR\-related discipline
* Experience of working within a HR operational and service delivery environment
* Generalist HR experience within complex organisations


 Purpose, Values
 **and Mindset**
 We deploy finance responsibly to support people and businesses, acting with empathy and integrity, championing innovation and sustainability, for the common good and the long term.
   

  

 Our values underpin everything we do: Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship.
   

  

 Respect
   

  

 We harness the power of diversity and inclusion in our business, trust those we work with, and value everyone's contribution.
   

  

 Integrity
   

  

 We operate with honesty, transparency and fairness in all we do.
   

  

 Service
   

  

 We act with empathy and humility, putting the people and businesses we serve at the centre of what we do.
   

  

 Excellence
   

  

 We champion innovation, and use our energy, expertise and resources to make a positive difference.
   

  

 Stewardship
   

  

 We prize sustainability, and are passionate about leaving things better than we found them.
   

  

 Our Mindset shapes how we take action, living by our Values, driven by our Purpose, always with our customers and clients at the heart of what we do; our Mindset is to Empower, Challenge and Drive.
   

  

 Empower
   

  

 Trust and support each other to deliver. Make decisions with those closest to the topic. Include diverse perspectives. Celebrate success and learn from failure.
   

  

 Challenge
   

  

 Question whether things can be done better. Use insights based on data to inform decisions. Be curious about how we can adapt and improve. Speak up and be open to alternative viewpoints.
   

  

 Drive
   

  

 Focus on outcomes. Deliver with pace. Be passionate and ambitious about what we do. Take personal responsibility. Actively build collaborative relationships to get things done.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with pensions and benefits experience.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design and implement programmes and initiatives that support the growth and development of the bank’s employees and leaders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of training and development programmes and initiatives, including creation and execution of training sessions, workshops, and other learning opportunities.
* Collaboration with HR and hiring managers to analyse the current and future development needs of the organisation.
* Design and delivery of classroom and digital based training content, programmes and associated User Experience.
* Management of onboarding programmes including training, onboarding materials, introduction meetings and providing support throughout the onboarding process.
* Analysis of data and metrics to measure success of talent development programmes and initiatives.
* Development and implementation of coaching and mentoring programmes, train the trainer programmes for facilitators and relevant educational materials.
* Develop and implement talent pipelining processes, identifying, managing, progressing and promoting talent capability across the bank with succession management and career progression’.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Head of Talent
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, and Kaaiser.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent, whether for a company, a university system, or a country, is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most of them are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.
   

  

 Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.
   

  

 This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You are the person who translates talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.
   

  

 You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation that Manifest expects every function to become, and proving that Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and new people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a materially harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is the advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.
   

  

 The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a materially different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.
   

  

**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade**
 Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that a talent function can operate with the same rigor, and the same voice at the table, as finance or product. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions, and how talent leadership earns a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like, for Manifest and for the industry watching how Manifest does it.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine**
* Own the hiring strategy and standard across every brand, every geography, and every level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default, not the exception
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold every part of the function accountable to it


**Talent Operations And The Employee Experience**
* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the same rigor a business its size requires


**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession**
* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support, not a support function
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness rather than a gap discovered under pressure
* Set the standard for what a high\-performing team looks like at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes that standard repeatable rather than dependent on any one leader


**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment**
* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, capacity, capability, and retention, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan rather than reacting to it
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable and as credible as revenue


**Talent AI and Infrastructure**
* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support, all running on AI rather than layered with it afterward
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function instead of several
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products


**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership**
* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally, as part of how the company is known in its markets, not just how it hires into them
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people, so talent becomes a discipline every executive is fluent in, not a function they delegate to


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first months, you have formed a clear, specific point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, on where the leadership bench is strong and where it needs building, and on what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath all of it needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and with the executive team as someone who understands their commercial reality, not just their headcount requests.
   

  

 By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning rather than a reaction to it, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people across every brand. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible and as data\-driven as finance's.
   

  

 In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and more than one business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as a set of interconnected systems and bets, workforce planning, leadership development, hiring, infrastructure, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.
   

  

 You have built high\-performing teams before, and you know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and a team that performs because the systems, the bench, and the standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, forecasting capacity and capability gaps before they become urgent, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.
   

  

 You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and you know the difference between AI as a feature bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.
   

  

 You have a real point of view on talent and you are comfortable being the voice that carries it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and you hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic, while still being the kind of leader they would choose to work for again.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as industries are reshaped by AI. Manifest is backed by $91M from Tiger Global, Square Peg Capital, Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital, and others. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically: Manifest sells the world an AI\-native way of moving talent across borders. Talent, the function, is where that standard either becomes real inside the company, in the teams it builds and the workforce plan it runs, or stays a claim on a careers page. This role decides which one it is.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

* Demonstrated ability to own and deliver cross\-functional projects from start to finish, influencing peers and stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.

* Proven ability to translate business needs into functional requirements and system specifications.


* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted and influential voice in planning discussions.

**Desired Skills and Attributes**

  
 



* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.


* A collaborative team player with a passion for learning and continuous improvement.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. title: Senior Manager - HR Transformation
description:
**Senior Manager \- People Excellence (HR Transformation)** 




  





 Location \- Gurgaon
 



  





**About Urban Company** 




 Urban Company is a tech\-enabled home services marketplace. Customers use our platform to book services, such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, which are delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




 People Excellence runs the operating backbone of People Success, for a full time workforce and a large contractual workforce across India and international markets.
 



 This is the transformation seat in that team. As UC scales, how the People function plans, measures and delivers has to be rebuilt around systems, automation and AI rather than manual effort. Owning that shift is the job. You will run it as a portfolio of projects: rebuilding how the company plans manpower and cost, automating work that today takes days, putting real analytics behind People decisions, redesigning core employee processes, and preparing the organisation for regulatory change. Each one is yours from diagnosis through design to adoption.
 



 The role reports to the Director, People Excellence, and works closely with the CHRO and business leadership.
 



  





**Why this role is different** 




 Real problems, owned end to end, with high impact and visibility. You pick what matters, build the case, and see it through to adoption.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 



* Own the transformation roadmap for People Excellence: diagnose where the function loses time, accuracy or credibility, build the business case, and sequence the work by impact
* Lead the automation and AI charter end to end, from problem definition and solution design through build with internal tech teams or vendors to adoption on the ground
* Redesign core People processes around the experience they should deliver rather than the way they currently happen, and drive the change management that makes a redesign stick
* Own People analytics: the dashboards, metric definitions and data that leadership actually makes decisions on
* Drive workforce and cost planning: the annual AOP, monthly budget versus actual analysis, and the manpower models behind both
* Run the mid\-year and annual performance management cycles for the organisation, working with People Success leadership
* Lead regulatory change readiness, starting with the new labour codes, translating legislation into process alongside consultants and internal legal
* Do the analysis yourself. This is a hands\-on role: you will pull the data, build the model and write the recommendation rather than briefing someone else to
* Own data accuracy across People systems, defining the controls that make HR data trustworthy for the People Success partners who rely on it day to day, and for Finance, leadership and auditors



  





**What we'll need:** 



* MBA with 4\-5 years of experience in HR transformation, HR operations, project management, analytics or automation
* Ownership of cross\-functional projects end to end, with outcomes you can point to
* Strong problem solving: able to break an open\-ended problem down, and comfortable working with data to get to the answer
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to choose what matters when everything looks urgent
* Ability to influence without authority, across Finance, Tech, Legal and business teams
* Hands on with Microsoft Excel and Google suite; experience with HRMS platforms (Darwinbox a plus) and a real appetite for applying AI tooling to operational problems
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the presence to hold a room with senior stakeholders
* Super organized yet agile to adapt to UC's way of working



  





**Folks you will work with:** 




 We understand that the people you work with and learn from is the single most important determinant of how much you enjoy working at a place. In fact, this defines the culture in many ways. Here is a list of UC folks you can expect to work with and collaborate with:
 


* Utkarsh Bindal, VP: Ex. Airtel, Bira91, MDI
* Chetna Wadhwa, Director: Ex. Rivigo, MDI, DCE



  





**What can you expect:** 



* A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities \- we hire folks for a career opportunity, not just the role.
* Energy and hustle of a startup with processes and depth of a big organization
* Expect to work with people you can learn from and are invested in your growth



  





*At Urban Company we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.*

title: Business Process Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Analyzes and reports on pay\-for\-performance incentive outcomes, identifies data trends and root causes, and drives process improvements in a high\-volume, regulated environment. Partners with stakeholders to deliver accurate insights, ensure data quality, optimize processes, and enhance employee and leader experience through data\-driven decision\-making. Requires solid analytical, reporting, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Process Analysis \& Improvement
	+ Analyze incentive compensation processes to identify inefficiencies, defects, and opportunities for standardization
	+ Perform root cause analysis on data issues, payment discrepancies, and recurring errors
	+ Recommend and help shape implementation of process improvements to reduce rework and improve quality
	+ Monitor process performance and identify patterns or trends requiring escalation or resolution
	+ Partner with developers, consultants, and stakeholders to analyze processes, validate solutions, and guide implementation through enablement of scalable improvements Data Validation \& Insight Generation
	+ Validate monthly and quarterly incentive data to ensure accuracy and completeness
	+ Develop and deliver reporting that highlights trends, anomalies, and key performance insights
	+ Identify risks and patterns within large data sets and translate findings into actionable recommendations
	+ Contribute to the development of tools, controls, and workflows that enable scalable, high\-quality process execution
* Stakeholder Partnership \& Issue Resolution
* Partner with program consultants and business stakeholders to resolve data and process issues
	+ Manage inquiries by identifying underlying issues and driving resolution
	+ Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences
	+ Appropriately escalate system issues with supporting analysis and context Process Execution \& Operational Support
	+ Execute core incentive processes with a high degree of accuracy, accountability, and timeliness
	+ Maintain documentation, templates, and process standards to support consistency and scalability
	+ Support onboarding, training, and change\-related activities for process updates
	+ Contribute to audit, compliance, and remediation efforts as needed
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate
* 1\+ years HR or Compensation experience
* 2\+ years of customer\-facing written communications skills including empathy and clarity
* Experience analyzing data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes
* Experience using Microsoft PowerPoint
* Solid critical thinking and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate data into insights
* Demonstrated ability to manage work independently and track deliverables accurately
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., data manipulation, pivot tables, analysis)
* Solid organizational, time management, and prioritization skills
* Ability to understand and navigate complex processes and systems

 **Preferred Qualification:**

* Experience with incentive compensation processes or Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) tools (e.g., Varicent)
* Experience with reporting, dashboards, or data visualization tools
* Experience with process mapping, workflow documentation, or continuous improvement concepts (e.g., Lean)

* Ability to independently learn and navigate complex systems, validate outputs, and self\-audit work for accuracy

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. description:

Stakeholder Management
  
o Define end\-to\-end transition plan including scope, timeline, recruitment plan, and risk mitigation plan to ensure smooth execution of HR transition activities
  
o Ensure continuous interaction with Client to understand Client’s requirements; must be able to influence and advise Client on complex processes related to employee transfer and recruitment
  
o Consult with internal and client stakeholders to identify and resolve any issues to avoid or minimise any disruption to service delivery
  
o Demonstrate flexibility within established process to meet Client’s requirements; navigate complex situations and make decisions in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to obtain agreed outcome that works for JLL and for the Client
  
  

Ad\-hoc Projects/Initiatives
  
o Instigate and lead process improvement projects as and when required
  
o Support new business, expansion and transformation as and when required
  
  

Candidate Specification
  
Experience
  
o Prior experience managing staff outsourcing in MNC environment; must be able to manage complex regional and global transitions to timeline and within budget
  
o Experience managing projects/programs with multiple priorities and executive level stakeholders
  
o Proven experience delivering HR activities and initiatives, consulting with multiple stakeholders to meet defined deadlines
  
o Experience dealing with multiple countries and cultures
  
  

Task Skills
  
o Analyse HR\-related data and prepare required reports/updates
  
o Ability to interpret and explain HR policies, procedures, or regulations and provide consultative advice to internal and client stakeholders
  
o Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  
o Good command of verbal and written English to influence, advise, and convey information effectively
  
  

Personal Skills
  
o Demonstrate critical thinking and decision making to reach mutually desirable outcome
  
o Be humble, agile and open to learning new technology and ways of working
  
o Ability to interact with a variety of stakeholders at all levels
  
o Analytical and complex problem\-solving skills
  
o People and service focussed with ability to collaborate effectively
  
o Ability to meet tight schedules and deliver high quality of work
  
o High level of communication and interpersonal skills
  
o Ability to excel in culturally diverse team across different geographies
  
  

Systems
  
o Microsoft Office
  
o Workday, Monday.com
  
  

Qualifications / Education
  
o Bachelor’s degree required, a Master’s degree preferred
  
o Minimum 8\-10 years of progressive experience within HR
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

 Position Details

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Manager – Corporate Payroll to lead and manage end\-to\-end payroll operations across our corporate and manufacturing workforce. The role requires expertise in payroll processing, statutory compliance, labor law regulations, and payroll governance while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and timely salary disbursement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience managing payroll for both white\-collar and blue\-collar employees, contract manpower, and shift\-based operations within a manufacturing environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Payroll Management
   

  

 Manage end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing for corporate.Ensure accurate processing of salaries, incentives, overtime, shift allowances, production incentives, reimbursements, and statutory deductions.Validate attendance inputs including biometric records, leave, shifts, overtime, and holiday data.Process Full \& Final Settlements (F\&F), gratuity, leave encashment, bonuses, and other employee payouts.Ensure payroll timelines are met with complete accuracy and confidentiality.Coordinate with Finance for salary disbursement, payroll accounting, and reconciliation.
   

  

 Statutory Compliance
   

  

 Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory regulations including:Provident Fund (PF)Employee State Insurance (ESIC)Professional Tax (PT)Income Tax (TDS)Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)Payment of Bonus ActPayment of Gratuity ActFactories ActContract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act (CLRA)Minimum Wages ActShops \& Establishment Act (where applicable)Ensure timely filing of statutory returns, challans, and maintenance of statutory registers.Coordinate payroll\-related statutory audits and labor inspections.Work closely with external consultants and government authorities for compliance matters.
   

  

 Plant \& Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

 Collaborate with Production, Time Office, Security, Plant HR, and Operations teams for attendance reconciliation.Resolve employee payroll queries, discrepancies, and grievance cases within defined timelines.Partner with HR Business Partners and departmental stakeholders to ensure payroll data accuracy.
   

  

 Payroll Governance \& Process Excellence
   

  

 Ensure payroll SOPs, controls, and audit mechanisms are consistently followed.Identify opportunities to automate payroll processes and improve operational efficiency.Drive payroll compliance, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.Maintain complete confidentiality of employee payroll data.
   

  

 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

 Prepare monthly payroll MIS and dashboards covering:HeadcountPayroll costOvertime analysisAttendance trendsAbsenteeismContract manpower costSalary variance reportsStatutory compliance statusGenerate management reports and workforce cost analytics for HR and business leadership.Support budgeting, manpower planning, and annual compensation exercises with payroll insights.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, Human Resources, or a related discipline.MBA/PGDM in HR or Finance will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Experience**
 6–10 years of progressive payroll experience.Exposure to multi\-location payroll operations will be preferred.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

 Strong knowledge of payroll processing and statutory compliance.Hands\-on experience with HRMS and Payroll systems such as Keka, SAP, Spine, Oracle, or similar platforms.Advanced MS Excel skills including:Pivot TablesXLOOKUP/VLOOKUPPower Query (preferred)Data reconciliationAdvanced formulas and reportingWorking knowledge of payroll audits and statutory documentation.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) will be responsible for managing the post\-sales customer lifecycle for BizChat's Omnichannel Communication portfolio, including WhatsApp Business (WABA), RCS, SMS, Email, Voice, and other CPaaS solutions. The role will focus on driving customer onboarding, adoption, retention, and business value realization while building strong relationships with key customer stakeholders. The CSM will act as a trusted advisor, ensuring customers maximize platform utilization and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of additional CPaaS products across the existing customer base.
 








**Reporting to : Regional Head Customer Success.** 




**Grade : Deputy Manager / Manager** 




**Location : Hyderabad /Chennai/Bangalore** 









**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewal for assigned accounts.
* Drive customer activation, adoption, and utilization of WhatsApp Business, RCS, Email, SMS, Voice, and other CPaaS solutions.
* Ensure customers go live within defined timelines and achieve desired business outcomes.
* Monitor customer health, engagement, and usage trends to proactively identify and mitigate churn risks.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and provide recommendations to improve platform adoption, utilization, and business outcomes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customer escalations and work with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key business and technology stakeholders within customer organizations.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Support, and Operations teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* **Drive cross\-selling and adoption of additional CPaaS products such as SMS, RCS, Email, Voice, Smartflo, Truecaller, and emerging communication solutions within existing customer accounts.**
* Identify upsell opportunities and support account expansion initiatives to increase customer wallet share and platform usage.
* Develop and execute customer success plans focused on retention, growth, expansion, and value realization.
* Capture customer feedback and provide inputs to Product and Business teams for continuous improvement.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




**Adoption, Retention \& Customer Health (65%)** 



* Customers go\-live within SLA
* Monthly active accounts
* WhatsApp verification/logo adoption
* Reduction in non\-pulsing accounts
* Growth in platform utilization and messaging traffic



**Retention \& Customer Health (30%)** 



* Customer retention rate
* Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
* Churn reduction
* Customer health score
* Renewal success rate



**Cross\-Sell Growth \& Expansion (25%)** 



* Cross\-sell revenue achievement
* Number of accounts adopting additional CPaaS products
* Upsell revenue achievement
* Multi\-product adoption within customer accounts
* Growth in customer wallet share
* Expansion in messaging and communication volumes



**Customer Experience \& Operations (10%)** 



* CSAT/NPS
* SLA adherence
* Escalation management
* CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3–7 years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS, CPaaS, Telecom, or Enterprise Account Management.
* Strong customer relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with WhatsApp Business, RCS, SMS, Email, Voice, or digital engagement platforms is preferred.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to identify cross\-sell and growth opportunities within existing accounts.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams.



  





**Success Profile** 




 A customer\-focused and commercially driven professional who can drive customer adoption, retention, and growth while building trusted customer relationships. The ideal candidate will proactively identify opportunities to expand the use of CPaaS portfolio, increase customer lifetime value, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their omnichannel communication investments.
 



 Candidate should be willing to work in the market visiting customers. .

title: Technical Success Manager- ANZ
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Technical Success Manager (TSM) to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, Technical Success Management within the Customer Success department. You will serve as a strategic technical advisor, deeply understanding customer goals to align our solutions and drive long\-term satisfaction. By building strong stakeholder relationships and providing proactive recommendations, you will ensure our customers realize the full value of the Zscaler platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**
* Understand customer goals, technical challenges, and business needs to align Zscaler solutions and drive overall satisfaction
* Build deep relationships with key stakeholders, conduct periodic reviews, and identify strategic growth opportunities
* Anticipate technical hurdles, provide proactive recommendations, and implement risk mitigation strategies
* Master Zscaler products and services to contribute best\-practice content for internal and customer\-facing Knowledge Bases
* Collaborate across Sales, Support, and Product teams to ensure a seamless and high\-impact customer experience


**Who You Are (Success Profile)**
* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**
* 5\+ years of experience in customer\-facing roles with a proven blend of technical expertise and account management
* Demonstrated experience leading product feature implementations and driving best\-practice adoption
* Proficiency with operating systems including Linux, Unix, and Free BSD
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting network issues using tools like Ping, Traceroute, and MTR
* Solid understanding of core networking protocols such as HTTP, SMTP, FTP, and DNS


**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem\-solving
* Experience leading discovery discussions, building high\-level and low\-level designs (HLD/LLD), and managing large\-scale migrations
* In\-depth understanding of enterprise infrastructure and cloud security technologies including SASE, SSE, and ZTNA
* Expertise in open\-source system administration and authentication protocols like SAML, LDAP, and OAuth


 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
   

  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement

 \| For media queries, contact: press@peepal.co
 



  





**About Zing** 




 Zing is your personal trading assistant and technical analysis tool, built directly for your charts. It is a plug\-and\-play Chrome extension that works across your favourite web trading platforms, with no coding or complex setup required.
 



 Zing offers a library of curated strategies, real\-time market signals, and one\-click execution with targets and stop\-losses built in and sent directly to your broker. Whether you're placing your first or thousandth F\&O trade, Zing is designed to help traders make more informed decisions.
 



 Zing is currently in beta and is building a new experience for advanced traders.

 **Partnerships Manager**

 • Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of projects — scoping, timelines, installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and customer handover.

title: Operations Support Manager
description:
**Support Operations Manager — New Products** 




 Function: Operations · Location: Bangalore · Experience: 2–5 years
 



  





**How we hire** 




 Real humans read this. No cover letters.
 



 Send a short note on
 **one process you automated with AI** 
 — what you built, what broke, what it saved.
 



  





**The role** 




 We run a portfolio of consumer apps with 300M\+ users, and this role is for everything we launch next.
 



 You own support for every new product we ship: the queue, the quality, the team, the numbers. At its core this is a support job — early users, real complaints, refunds, bugs, angry reviews.
 



 What makes it different is how you run it. AI is the default here, not an experiment. Every recurring query gets automated; humans handle only what genuinely needs judgement. You'll write prompts and build no\-code workflows — but no product code.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Support for every launch.** 
 From day zero: SOPs, canned responses, escalation paths, AI flows. Day\-one users get real answers, not silence.
* **The numbers.** 
 First\-response time, resolution time, CSAT, backlog. You report them weekly and you defend them.
* **The team.** 
 Lead a small group of support agents — hiring, training, rostering, quality reviews, daily priorities. Keep the team small and sharp by automating everything that doesn't need a human.
* **AI\-first by default.** 
 A new product has no ticket history to mine — you'll build on informed guesses, watch the first 500 conversations closely, correct fast.
* **Voice of the first users.** 
 Weekly, with numbers: what's confusing, what's broken, what people actually want.
* **The hard cases.** 
 Payment disputes, safety and abuse reports, bans, anything legal\-sensitive. These stay with you and never run unsupervised.



  





**What we look for** 



* **2–5 years in customer support or support ops** 
 , including time as the senior person on a queue.
* **Daily hands\-on AI user.** 
 Not “I've used ChatGPT” — show us something you automated end to end.
* **You've led or trained agents.** 
 Even two or three people counts.
* Comfort with a blank page. A new product means no process, no data, no precedent.
* Strong on numbers. You can explain a CSAT drop, not just report it.
* Clear written English \+ fluent Hindi. More Indian languages is a real edge.
* Judgement under pressure. Err toward the user, but spot fraud.

title: Client Implementation & Service - Team Lead
description:
Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and delivery\-focused Team Lead to manage end\-to\-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
   

  

 What you will be responsible for
   

  

* Lead assigned onboarding projects from requirement gathering through solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Manage, coach, and develop onboarding specialists; allocate work, set priorities, monitor progress, and provide timely guidance.
* Establish project plans, roles, milestones, dependencies, controls, and success criteria for each implementation.
* Lead discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to confirm reconciliation requirements, scope, assumptions, and delivery approach.
* Review and approve fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee analysis and validation of cash, position, transaction, and market\-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Direct data analysis and mapping for non\-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL, technology, and deployment teams to establish scalable processing solutions.
* Oversee account, reconciliation shell, lead\-account, match\-rule, workflow, and static\-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Plan and oversee functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go\-live readiness reviews.
* Act as the escalation point for complex reconciliation exceptions, configuration issues, delivery risks, client concerns, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and coordinate sustainable corrective and preventive actions with business, operations, and technology partners.
* Maintain oversight of project plans, open\-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, status reports, decisions, and implementation documentation.
* Provide concise reporting to management and stakeholders on delivery status, milestones, risks, controls, capacity, and critical decisions.
* Ensure procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, control evidence, and handover documentation are complete, current, and audit\-ready.
* Oversee post\-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues, risks, and actions are tracked through closure.
* Maintain a robust operational\-risk and control environment, including adherence to maker\-checker controls, information\-security standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor workload, quality, productivity, service levels, project capacity, and delivery performance; implement corrective action where required.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, strengthen controls, improve client experience, and reduce manual effort through automation and workflow improvements.
* Lead team training, cross\-skilling, succession planning, knowledge management, and continuous capability development.
* Support system enhancements, strategic initiatives, operating\-model improvements, audit activities, and management reporting as required.


 What we value
   

  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation, investment operations, and the investment\-management lifecycle.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows, and administrative functions.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT\-message validation, file analysis, ETL data mapping, and production implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end onboarding projects while managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Proven people\-leadership capability, including work allocation, coaching, performance support, knowledge development, and quality oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to lead root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.
* Effective stakeholder\-management, influencing, negotiation, and escalation skills across global teams.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with experience maintaining audit\-ready evidence and addressing operational or implementation risks.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive\-reporting skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical and operational matters into clear decisions, actions, and status updates.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on delivery quality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and working knowledge of project\-tracking, workflow, data\-visualization, and process\-documentation tools.


**Education And Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 or more years of relevant experience in middle office, reconciliation, investment operations, client onboarding, system implementation, or a related function.
* Prior experience leading a team, workstream, or complex implementation within a high\-volume, global operating environment.
* Practical expertise using TLM/TLP or another recognized reconciliation platform.

**Additional Skills**

title: Account Manager- South
description:
Lead the safe, reliable, compliant and cost\-effective operation and maintenance of multiple industrial water and wastewater treatment sites. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for plant performance, contractual KPIs, customer satisfaction, workforce capability, maintenance systems, budgets, vendors, statutory compliance and continuous improvement across the assigned portfolio.
 



 The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership to site managers and multidisciplinary teams, standardize O\&M practices across locations, and ensure timely resolution of critical operational and customer issues.
 



 2\. Scope of Responsibility
 


* Oversee multiple O\&M contracts and treatment facilities operating on a continuous shift basis.
* Provide governance and technical direction for WTP, ETP, STP, RO and ZLD facilities, including associated pumping, clarification, filtration, sludge handling, evaporation and drying systems.
* Manage mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, automation and process performance through site teams and specialist support functions.
* Own service delivery in line with contract terms, agreed budgets, customer specifications, environmental requirements and internal standards.



 3\. Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Multi\-Site Operations \& Performance
 


* Take overall ownership of day\-to\-day O\&M performance across all assigned sites and ensure uninterrupted availability of critical water systems.
* Review plant operating parameters, water quality, throughput, recovery, uptime and consumption trends; initiate corrective action for deviations.
* Conduct structured site reviews and risk\-based visits, with focused support for underperforming or critical facilities.
* Coordinate rapid technical support for breakdowns, chronic problems and process upsets to minimize downtime and customer production impact.
* Drive process optimization, debottlenecking, reliability improvement and operating\-cost reduction without compromising safety, quality or compliance.
* Ensure effective shift deployment, escalation protocols and management coverage across sites.



 B. Treatment Process \& Technical Oversight
 


* Provide technical governance for raw\-water treatment, clarification, filtration, cooling\-water systems, ETP, STP, RO, UF/NF where applicable, MEE, ATFD, filter press, clarifier, thickener, oil skimmer and complete ZLD systems.
* Monitor influent and effluent quality, RO recovery and rejection, membrane performance, chemical dosing, sludge generation, evaporation efficiency and final discharge or reuse quality.
* Guide root\-cause analysis and sustainable resolution of process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and automation issues.
* Ensure calibration and documentation of instruments, gauges and measuring devices as per schedule and audit requirements.
* Maintain current technical knowledge and promote adoption of proven operating and maintenance practices.



 C. Maintenance \& Reliability
 


* Establish and govern preventive, predictive, condition\-based, time\-based and breakdown maintenance programs.
* Ensure maintenance planning, work\-order discipline, shutdown planning, spares management and equipment\-history records are effective at every site.
* Review critical equipment health for pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, dosing systems, dewatering equipment, membranes, evaporators, dryers, MCCs, VFDs, PLC/SCADA and field instruments.
* Lead failure investigations, root\-cause analysis and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive equipment reliability, reduced repeat failures and optimized maintenance cost.



 D. Safety, Environment \& Compliance
 


* Be accountable for a goal\-zero safety culture across the assigned sites.
* Ensure compliance with HSE/EHS requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, SOPs, risk assessments, PPE, chemical handling, lockout/tagout and emergency preparedness.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and environmental events are reported, investigated and closed with effective corrective actions.
* Conduct and monitor safety audits, toolbox talks, hazard\-register reviews and statutory inspections.
* Maintain environmental, legal and customer compliance records in audit\-ready condition.



 E. Contract, KPI \& Customer Management
 


* Establish and review site KPIs in line with contract requirements, including plant availability, water quality, throughput, recovery, downtime, consumption, cost, safety and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare consolidated monthly MIS, performance dashboards, variance analysis and recovery plans for management and customer reviews.
* Lead customer meetings, technical discussions and escalation management; ensure timely closure of observations and commitments.
* Protect contractual performance and billing by ensuring KPI evidence, service records, approvals and monthly documentation are complete and timely.
* Identify contract risks, scope gaps and change requirements, and escalate them with clear technical and commercial justification.



 F. Budget, Cost \& Commercial Control
 


* Prepare and manage annual and monthly O\&M budgets for the assigned portfolio.
* Monitor actual expenditure against budget and control manpower, chemicals, energy, spares, maintenance and subcontracting costs.
* Develop savings initiatives through process optimization, chemical and energy reduction, improved reliability and resource productivity.
* Plan critical spares, consumables, annual maintenance and shutdown requirements based on operational risk and contract obligations.
* Support timely customer billing, certification and resolution of performance\-linked deductions or commercial issues.



 G. Team Leadership \& Capability Building
 


* Lead site managers, engineers, supervisors, technicians, operators and support teams across locations.
* Define accountability, review staffing and shift structures, and ensure deployment matches plant criticality and skill needs.
* Recruit, onboard, coach, train and develop site teams; maintain skill matrices and succession plans for critical roles.
* Set clear performance expectations and conduct structured reviews, while promoting discipline, ownership and collaboration.
* Ensure technically competent manpower is available to troubleshoot critical equipment and process issues.



 H. Systems, Standardization \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Standardize SOPs, checklists, log sheets, maintenance practices, reporting formats and escalation mechanisms across sites.
* Ensure critical work instructions are practical, pictorial and available in a language understood by the workforce where required.
* Use performance data to identify systemic issues, benchmark sites and replicate best practices.
* Coordinate effectively with Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, HR, Finance and corporate support functions.
* Promote digital tools such as CMMS/SAP, dashboards and MS Office applications for planning, documentation and performance control.



 4\. Key Performance Indicators
 



**KPI Area** 




**Measures** 




**Safety \& Compliance** 




 Zero injuries; closure of audit findings; statutory and environmental compliance
 



**Plant Performance** 




 Availability, uptime, throughput, treated\-water quality and adherence to operating targets
 



**Process Efficiency** 




 Recovery, chemical consumption, energy consumption, water reuse and sludge or reject management
 



**Reliability** 




 Breakdown frequency, repeat failures, preventive\-maintenance compliance and downtime
 



**Commercial** 




 Budget adherence, cost savings, billing documentation and reduction of performance deductions
 



**Customer** 




 Satisfaction, escalation closure, review effectiveness and completion of commitments
 



**People** 




 Manpower productivity, training completion, skill coverage and retention of critical capability
 



 5\. Qualification \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental or a related engineering discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant O\&M experience, preferably in industrial water and wastewater treatment, utilities, heavy industry, metals, chemicals or similar process industries.
* Proven experience managing multiple sites, large contracts or a geographically distributed O\&M portfolio.
* Demonstrated hands\-on exposure to water and wastewater treatment and ZLD operations, together with multidisciplinary maintenance management.
* Experience in customer\-facing roles, budgeting, vendor management, workforce leadership, KPI governance and management reporting.



 6\. Required Technical Knowledge
 


* Water treatment processes: clarification, filtration, disinfection, demineralization and membrane systems.
* Wastewater and reuse systems: ETP, STP, RO, sludge handling and ZLD, including MEE and ATFD where applicable.
* Mechanical systems: pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, valves, piping and rotating equipment.
* Electrical and instrumentation: HT/LT interfaces, MCC/PCC, VFDs, PLC/SCADA, transmitters, analyzers, control valves, interlocks and calibration.
* Maintenance systems: preventive, predictive, condition\-based and breakdown maintenance; root\-cause analysis; spares planning.
* HSE, environmental compliance, statutory requirements, quality systems and audit documentation.
* Working knowledge of CMMS/SAP, MS Office and data\-based reporting tools.



 7\. Leadership Competencies
 


* Ownership and accountability across multiple operating locations.
* Strong planning, prioritization and decision\-making under operational pressure.
* Customer orientation with confident technical and commercial communication.
* Analytical problem\-solving and disciplined closure of corrective actions.
* Ability to coach teams, build trust and create a safety\-focused performance culture.
* Effective cross\-functional coordination, negotiation and stakeholder management.
* High integrity, adaptability and willingness to travel frequently.



 8\. Decision\-Making Authority
 


* Operational decisions required to protect safety, compliance, equipment and continuity of service.
* Deployment of manpower and resources within the approved organization structure and budget.
* Prioritization of maintenance, spares and technical support based on plant criticality.
* Vendor and service\-provider recommendations in accordance with company procedures.
* Escalation of contractual, commercial, safety and compliance risks to appropriate management.



 9\. Candidate Profile
 



 A hands\-on, results\-oriented O\&M leader who can manage a diverse portfolio of water and wastewater treatment plants, strengthen site leadership, build reliable operating systems and maintain strong customer confidence. The candidate should combine process knowledge with maintenance discipline, commercial awareness, people leadership and an uncompromising approach to safety and compliance.

title: Process Excellence Leader
description:

 Delivery Experience Excellence (DXE) \- Leader
 



**Location:** 
 IBC Knowledge Park, Bengaluru
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head \- Support
 



**Team Name:** 
 Delivery Experience Excellence
 



**About the Team and the Role** 




 The Delivery Experience Excellence team at Ather is responsible for driving a passionate, customer\-centric culture across the post\-purchase lifecycle, governing standard operating systems, and ensuring a consistent brand experience across all physical and digital customer touchpoints.
 



 This role is for a Lead \- Delivery Experience Excellence who will be the strategic custodian of the end\-to\-end customer delivery journey, building process governance frameworks, leading national service and retail audits, and deploying Lean Six Sigma methodologies to eliminate execution gaps and elevate NPS/CSAT across all regions and retail partners.
 



**Responsibilities** 




 ● Own customer experience outcomes across all service journeys and channels, acting as the primary voice of the customer in leadership forums.
 



 ● Define, implement, and govern standardized SOPs and service policies to establish simple, executable, and scalable service operating systems.
 



 ● Set up and execute structured audits—including EC/SC visits, ticket sampling, call audits, and service job reviews—to identify gaps between documented processes and actual execution.
 



 ● Drive continuous improvement and structured process excellence initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma (DMAIC) methodologies.
 



 ● Eliminate repeat customer pain points through systematic root cause analysis and the deployment of long\-term upstream fixes.
 



 ● Partner cross\-functionally with Operations, Product, Technology, and Training teams to implement experience enhancements.
 



 ● Define, track, and manage experience\-led KPIs and dashboards, presenting performance trends and strategic insights to senior leadership.
 



  





**Experience and Qualifications** 




 ● B.Tech / B.E or equivalent degree; MBA in Operations, SCM, or Service Management is preferred.
 



 ● 12 to 18 years of progressive experience in Service Excellence, Customer Experience (CX), Operations Excellence, or Quality.
 



 ● Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification is highly preferred.
 



 ● Extensive experience managing dealer, franchise, or retail network audits in large\-scale, multi\-location service environments.
 



  





**Must Have Competencies** 




 ● Expert mastery of Customer Journey Design and mapping to architect seamless, brand\-consistent end\-to\-end service delivery experiences.
 



 ● Advanced proficiency in Process Governance, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) formulation, and establishing robust compliance metrics.
 



 ● Demonstrated expertise in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) utilizing structured Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC) frameworks to eliminate process variations.
 



 ● Advanced capability in Stakeholder Management and Zonal Operations Coordination to drive consensus and process compliance across diverse retail partners.
 



  





**Good to Have Competencies** 




 ● Familiarity with Salesforce, Dealer Management Systems (DMS), and advanced ticketing platforms to track operational KPIs.
 



 ● Experience in data visualization and dashboard modeling using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik to track performance trends.
 



 ● Technical understanding of electric vehicle (EV) charging ecosystems and smart vehicle diagnostic frameworks.
 



 ● Knowledge of training needs identification (TNI) to support front\-line service personnel upskilling.

 At Ather, we've built India's first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience.  The Ather story doesn't write itself \- our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same.
