title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
About Marklytics
 



 Marklytics builds compliance software that helps manufacturers meet a new wave of product\-transparency regulation. The flagship product is VOLT TRAIL, a Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform for EV batteries. It is built around EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 and India's BPAN framework. The wider platform also covers lifecycle assessment (LCA), product traceability and regulatory reporting for batteries, steel, aluminium and other materials.
 



  





 The role
 



 You will own new business with automotive OEMs, battery manufacturers and their supply chains. The EU battery passport deadline of February 2027 is creating urgent demand, and your job is to turn that urgency into signed contracts. You'll report into leadership and work directly with the CEO and CTO on strategy, key accounts and complex deals. The CEO will shape commercial direction with you, and the CTO will back your technical conversations. Buyers include compliance, sustainability, procurement and IT.
 



  





 What you'll do
 



 •⁠ ⁠Build and run a pipeline of enterprise accounts across Europe, Asia and India, from first outreach to signed PO.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Qualify opportunities and respond to RFQs and RFPs. You'll coordinate technical content with pre\-sales and commercial terms with leadership.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Run discovery with regulatory, ESG and supply\-chain teams, and map their obligations to our platform.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Lead commercial negotiation on SaaS, on\-premise and implementation contracts.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Grow existing clients into new product lines, sites and materials.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Keep the pipeline and forecasts accurate in Apollo/CRM, and report on them weekly to the CEO and CTO.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Represent Marklytics at industry events, OEM supplier days and partner meetings, including with AWS.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Feed market and customer insight back into product and positioning.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



 Must have
 



 •⁠ ⁠4–8 years in B2B sales, in automotive, manufacturing, industrial, SaaS or any other B2B sector.
 



 •⁠ ⁠International sales exposure: you've sold to clients outside India (Europe, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, the Middle East or the US) and managed deals across time zones and cultures.
 



 •⁠ ⁠A track record of closing large deals with long sales cycles and several decision\-makers.
 



 •⁠ ⁠The confidence to learn a regulated, technical product quickly and explain it clearly to both compliance heads and CFOs.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Excellent written and spoken English. You'll co\-own proposals and client communication.
 



 Nice to have
 



 •⁠ ⁠Experience in automotive, EV or battery supply chains, or with Tier\-1 or Tier\-2 suppliers.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Exposure to sustainability, ESG or compliance software.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Familiarity with RFQ processes at global OEMs.
 



 •⁠ ⁠An existing network in the automotive or manufacturing ecosystem.

title: Key Account Manager – School Partnerships & Revenue
description:
**Lean Hyphen \| Hyderabad \| Employee or independent consultant** 




  





 Lean Hyphen partners with schools to deliver a structured Student Growth System through future skills, applied learning and student development programs. We seek people with school relationships who can personally win accounts and remain responsible for their commercial progress through payment and renewal.
 



  





**The mandate** 



* Own an agreed portfolio of Hyderabad schools from opportunity generation to signed partnership, implementation coordination, payment follow up and renewal. Build direct relationships with school owners, management and principals. Each account has one named commercial owner, whether the engagement is employment or consulting.



  





**Responsibilities for either route** 




 ·  Open doors through your existing network, referrals and direct outreach; build a qualified school pipeline.
 



 ·  Meet decision makers, diagnose school needs, organize demonstrations, shape proposals and lead commercial discussions within approved pricing and terms.
 



 ·  Secure documented school approvals and signed agreements; coordinate a clear handoff to the delivery team without losing commercial ownership.
 



 ·  Follow up on invoices and payments with school stakeholders, resolve account issues with delivery and finance, and pursue renewals or expansion. All school payments go directly to Lean Hyphen.
 



 ·  Keep assigned accounts, contacts, next steps, deal values, contract status and expected payment dates visible in Lean Hyphen’s CRM; escalate stalled deals and overdue payments.
 



  





**How we measure success** 




  





 Collected revenue from assigned schools, new signed schools, conversion of qualified opportunities, on time collections, renewals, account expansion and accurate CRM updates. Account lists, targets and review cadence are agreed at the start of the engagement.
 



  





**Choose your engagement route** 




**Employee** 
  Full time, field based. Reports directly to the CEO. Owns an assigned territory and school portfolio, including prospecting beyond existing relationships. Salary and performance incentives will be agreed during hiring.
 



**Independent consultant** 
  Works directly with the CEO on a defined school portfolio or territory with documented account attribution and agreed activities. Must be able to personally advance introductions through closing and payment follow up. Fees, eligible accounts, payment milestones, term, expenses and conflict rules will be set out in a separate written agreement. Consultants cannot promise unapproved pricing or bind Lean Hyphen to terms.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 ·  Existing access to Hyderabad K–12 school decision makers and a record of personally converting school relationships into paid partnerships.
 



 ·  Experience selling education services, curriculum, assessments, publishing, STEM or school technology is valuable. Employees should generally bring 5 to 8 years of relevant institutional sales experience; consultants should show comparable deal outcomes.
 



 ·  Strong presentation, negotiation and follow through; ability to coordinate internal teams while keeping accountability for the school relationship.
 



 ·  Willingness to share verifiable examples of schools personally opened, contracts closed, collections followed up and renewals retained.
 



  





**How to apply** 





 State whether you are applying as an employee, a consultant, or open to both. Share your résumé or profile, Hyderabad school network, and two or three partnerships you personally won, including approximate contract value and your role through payment. Employee applicants should add current and expected CTC and notice period. Consultant applicants should describe their proposed school coverage

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
Senior Growth Manager
 
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports To:** 
 Business Head / Founder
 


 About Bazaar.in
 
 Bazaar.in helps brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers liquidate surplus and slow\-moving inventory while offering consumers quality products at attractive prices.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are seeking a hands\-on
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for
 **strategizing and executing initiatives that grow sellers, business buyers, consumers, GMV and revenue** 
 . The candidate will manage the complete growth funnel from identifying acquisition opportunities and onboarding sellers to driving customer acquisition, conversion, repeat purchases and marketplace performance.
 



 This is a cross\-functional role requiring the ability to move between
 **strategy and execution** 
 , identify growth opportunities from data, run experiments, coordinate teams and take accountability for measurable business outcomes.
 


 Seller Growth \& Acquisition
 * Build and execute strategies to acquire brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers.
* Generate seller leads through outbound sales, digital campaigns, referrals, events and partnerships.
* Manage strategic negotiations and seller onboarding.
* Ensure KYC completion, catalogue activation, competitive pricing and inventory availability.
* Improve seller activation, retention and contribution to marketplace revenue.


 B2B Growth \& Business Development
 * Acquire retailers, resellers, corporate buyers, institutional buyers and bulk purchasers.
* Build and manage a qualified B2B sales pipeline.
* Match buyer requirements with relevant marketplace inventory.
* Develop partnerships and outbound campaigns for high\-value and category\-specific inventory.
* Negotiate commercial terms and manage strategic accounts.
* Increase bulk orders, repeat purchases and revenue from active business buyers.


 B2C Marketing \& Customer Growth
 * Develop and execute performance marketing, social media, SEO, content, influencer and partnership strategies.
* Plan campaigns around deals, categories, inventory and customer segments.
* Manage marketing budgets and improve CAC, ROAS and conversion rates.
* Increase qualified website traffic, new customers, first purchases, average order value and repeat purchases.
* Develop CRM, remarketing, loyalty and referral programmes.
* Identify and improve drop\-offs across product discovery, product pages, cart and checkout.


 Marketplace \& Revenue Growth
 * Take ownership of marketplace growth across supply, demand and conversion.
* Align seller inventory with customer demand.
* Drive
 **GMV, revenue, order volume, sell\-through and contribution margin** 
 .
* Improve merchandising, pricing, promotions and product visibility.
* Identify high\-growth categories, sellers, products and customer segments.
* Analyse sales, marketing, seller and customer data to identify growth opportunities.
* Design and execute growth experiments and measure their impact.
* Work with catalogue, operations, technology and finance teams to remove growth bottlenecks.



 The GMV, revenue, sell\-through and contribution\-margin responsibilities already form part of the existing role, so this broader growth framing is consistent with the original scope rather than creating an entirely different position.
 


 Growth Strategy \& Execution
 * Develop short\-term and long\-term growth plans for Bazaar.in.
* Translate company growth objectives into executable sales and marketing initiatives.
* Identify new acquisition channels, partnerships and revenue opportunities.
* Prioritise initiatives based on business impact, cost and scalability.
* Run growth experiments across seller acquisition, customer acquisition, conversion and retention.
* Track results and continuously optimise initiatives based on data.
* Maintain a clear growth pipeline covering initiatives, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.


 Team Leadership
 * Lead and manage sales and marketing team members.
* Set measurable targets across seller acquisition, B2B sales, customer growth, GMV and revenue.
* Establish CRM, reporting, forecasting and performance\-review processes.
* Coordinate closely with catalogue, operations, finance and technology teams.
* Create accountability for execution and achievement of growth targets.


 Key Performance Indicators
 * Qualified and activated sellers
* Seller activation and retention
* B2B pipeline value and conversion
* Active B2B buyers and repeat business
* New B2C customers acquired
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* ROAS
* Website traffic and conversion rate
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Repeat\-purchase rate
* Inventory sell\-through
* Order volume
* GMV
* Revenue
* Contribution margin
* Growth experiment performance
* Team target achievement



 These metrics are largely already present in the existing JD, including CAC, ROAS, traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat purchases, sell\-through, GMV and revenue.
 


 Candidate Profile
 * 3\-7 years of experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, retail, sales, marketing or growth roles.
* At least 2\-3 years of experience managing sales, marketing or growth teams.
* Proven experience in driving customer acquisition, seller/vendor acquisition, business development or marketplace growth.
* Strong understanding of B2B sales cycles, digital marketing, CRM, conversion optimisation and marketplace economics.
* Ability to combine
 **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** 
 .
* Strong commercial, negotiation, analytical and leadership skills.
* Comfortable working with growth metrics including CAC, ROAS, conversion, AOV, GMV and revenue.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, analytics tools, advertising platforms and Excel.
* Data\-driven, target\-oriented and comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.


 What We Offer
 
**Ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace performance.** 




 The role provides direct exposure to company leadership and strategy, significant responsibility for business growth, fixed compensation with performance\-linked incentives, and career progression based on measurable business outcomes.
 



 The biggest change I would make compared with the current document is therefore
 **not rewriting the entire role** 
 , because the existing responsibilities are already very growth\-oriented. I would change the title to
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 , rewrite the opening around
 **ownership of Bazaar.in's growth** 
 , and add the dedicated
 **Growth Strategy \& Execution** 
 section so candidates understand that this person is expected to
 *decide what should drive growth and then make it happen* 
 , rather than simply manage separate sales and marketing activities.

title: CustomerTech - MobileTech - IT Delivery - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title:** 
**Manager II, IT Delivery**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross\-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* A technically orietnted leader who is familiar with AWS, CI/CD Pipelines (Github) TDD/BDD practices, user level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb. Familiarity leading a MS Dynamics team is a plus.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, Github Co\-Pilot is a plus
* Previous people leadership experience.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: IT Project Manager
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

*Enterprise Information Systems (EIS) PMO \| Career Level: Professional Contributor III (P3\)*

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**


Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate, and advance faster than ever.


As an IT Project Manager at the P3 level, you will own medium\-to\-complex projects end\-to\-end: shaping the business case, driving planning and execution, and delivering measurable outcomes on time and within budget. You will operate with real independence, determining the best path to the objective while partnering closely with business sponsors, technical teams, vendors, and Micron leadership.


This role is positioned for a project manager who has moved beyond executing defined tasks and is trusted to lead through ambiguity, influence stakeholders without formal authority, mentor less experienced team members, and build the independent judgment needed for driving project outcomes

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Project Initiation**

* Develop project charters that clearly define objectives, scope, benefits, and success criteria.
* Identify stakeholders and build RACI matrices that establish clear decision rights from day one.
* Define high\-level scope, milestones, and timelines aligned to the business case and Micron’s strategic roadmap.
* Identify cross\-domain dependencies early and connect the problem to project and PMO outcomes, not just deliverables.
* Support vendor selection and partner engagement through scoping conversations and early commercial input.

**Project Planning**

* Establish project governance, including sponsors, core team, and extended project team, and drive effective kickoff activities.
* Facilitate business and technical requirements gathering across functional and technical stakeholder groups.
* Establish and maintain project management artifacts, ensuring a well\-governed and transparent tracking of project progress, risks, and dependencies
* Forecast project spend, SOWs, and POs, and support financial planning and budget tracking throughout the lifecycle.
* Support executive reviews and stage\-gate approvals with decision\-ready materials, not just status updates.

**Project Execution \& Closure**

* Manage project scope, quality, schedule, and deliverables, adapting the plan as new information emerges.
* Track development, SOE, and UAT milestones, and translate progress into clear, decision\-ready status for leadership.
* Proactively manage risks, issues, and escalations by bringing recommendations and options, not just problems.
* Provide consistent and accurate status reporting to PMO and leadership teams.
* Facilitate lessons learned and drive formal project closure and approval.

**Leadership and PMO Excellence**

* Lead cross\-functional project teams and build shared alignment around the project vision.
* Resolve conflicts constructively and manage resource allocation across the project team.
* Provide mentorship to less experienced team members and contribute to continuous improvement in PMO process efficiency.
* Actively adopt AI\-enabled tools and workflows to improve planning, reporting, and delivery efficiency.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**
-----------------------------

* 5\+ years of Project Management experience, including ownership of medium\-to\-complex, cross\-functional projects.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently under project or sub\-function objectives, determining the best method to deliver rather than requiring step\-by\-step direction.
* Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies, applied to fit the project context.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce decision\-ready updates for sponsors and leadership.
* Strong change management capabilities and experience facilitating stakeholder alignment without formal authority.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity, reporting, or analytics tools applied to project or portfolio management.
* Experience mentoring junior project team members
* Inclusive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with technical, non\-technical, vendor, and leadership teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* PMP certification.
* Experience managing enterprise\-wide, cross\-functional programs spanning multiple sites or geographies.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or equivalent certifications/professional experience. Related disciplines considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of project management experience in enterprise technology, infrastructure, security, digital workplace, platform migration, application delivery or related programs

**How Success Is Measured:**
----------------------------


Success in this role is measured through strong delivery against P3 expectations, including independent decision\-making, governance leadership, stakeholder influence, analytical rigor, AI\-enabled PMO excellence, coaching, integrity, and measurable project outcomes.

**Career Growth:**
------------------


Strong, sustained performance against the P3 competency bar, particularly independent decision\-making, governance leadership, and coaching, is the primary pathway to expanded scope and future progression.

title: Specialist, Bid Centre of Excellence
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Title
  
  

Specialist, Bid Centre of Excellence
  
Reporting to
  
Assistant Manager, Bid Centre of Excellence
  
Key stakeholders
  
Head of Solution \& Proposals, Proposal Managers/Directors, Bid Coordinators, Sales Enablement and Operations Leads, Subject\-Matter\-Experts
  
Direct reports
  
Not applicable
  
Duties \& responsibilities
  
What this job involves –
  
* Work collaboratively with the Sales Leads and proposal manager to provide support for varied presales solution aspects, including bid\-response.
* Lead the kick\-off calls, coordinate with department heads to identify specific stakeholders for individual bids, and act as the main contact\-point for process execution.
* Manage the bid portals and provide regular updates to Bid Managers/Directors on projects in the pipeline.
* Complete first baseline draft RFP response, pulling baselines from proposal databases \& baselines libraries. Would need to edit or re\-write the responses to provide the best suited response. Gradually, start developing RFP’s end to end, while actively engaging with Sales Lead or Project Managers and/or Account Team.
* Own the development of tailored CVs/Bios/Case studies working with the business lines and SMEs.


o Engage with all organizational SMEs to ensure that their inputs are incorporated in a timely manner.
  
* Undertake research on customer and opportunity and gather competitive information to feed into bid\-evaluation process and responses.
* Contribute to the development of slides for bid presentations in PowerPoint, in coordination with the proposal manager, bid coordinator, and graphic design specialists.
* Assist in preparing qualification and client proposal materials by bringing the best of the practice and delivering high quality client development materials.
* Identify unique questions \& responses in completed bids, and update the baselines with new content or coordinate with KM colleagues to have this closed


Performance objectives
  
* Ability to understand company’s service lines, business dynamics, and value proposition, and showcase the same through accurate, comprehensive and well\-written draft responses
* Ability to share ideas, display proactiveness, ownership of individual tasks, contribute to team projects, and ensuring closure in strict timelines
* Teamwork, timeliness, quick learning, resourcefulness, ability to ideate – would be the key traits
* Should be open to support during peak hours or after\-office hours to contribute towards urgent client submissions


Key skills
  
* Experience in Proposal Management / Support from a reputed firm
* Content writing, content/knowledge management
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communications skills
* Proficient with MS Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
* High attention to detail with consistent high\-quality deliverables
* Able to work on strict turnaround times, and have a problem\-solving approach
* Functional experience of MS Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel); proficiency in formatting/design will be a plus
* Good to have:


o SharePoint – Creating lists/libraries/sites
  
o Experience in Real Estate industry, especially construction or project management
  
Employee specification
  
* Post\-Graduate, with excellent academic credentials
* 6\-8 years of relevant experience from a professional services firm, including proposal editing and writing


If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

Ability to manage up to 10 projects simultaneously and provide guidance \& leadership to all e\-Invoicing project teams.

Makes decisions on scope and approach to deliver value to the client.
  

  

Participates in resolutions of critical and complex design and implementation issues across projects.
  

  

Demonstrates understanding of the impact of the range of software issues affecting consultant s area of specialization.
  

  

Provides work directions and leadership to assigned projects including scheduling, assignment of work, and review of project efforts.
  

  

Ensures that all project members understand their role, expected deliverables, and task completion dates.
  

  

Proactively resolves dependencies with other projects and activities.
  

  

Monitors project milestones, critical dates, and dependencies to identify potential issues that could jeopardize the project schedule.
  

  

Implements strategies to resolve schedule issues.
  

  

Keeps management aware of the major issues.
  

  

Assesses variances from the project plan, analyzes them, gathers metrics, and develops and implements changes as necessary to ensure that the project remains within specified scope (e.g. original SoW and all approved changes), budget (e.g. time and cost), and quality objectives.
  

  

Develops and enhances a productive working relationship with the client, project team members, partners, and other key entities.
  

  

Provides the project team constructive feedback as it pertains to project performance.
  

  

Leads efforts that extend and enhance the project management discipline.
  

  

Occasional travel may be required.
  

  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
  

  

Expert knowledge of product development, information systems, software development lifecycles, facilitation and influencing, and project management methods.
  

  

Expert ability to apply advanced project management methodology (e.g. Agile, Waterfall) and tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet) to all projects.
  

  

Expert knowledge of project planning, execution, controlling, and closing.
  

  

Expert ability to estimate, plan, and track complex, technical, and dependent tasks.
  

  

Performs work without supervision. Handles highly complex issues and problems utilizing independent judgement.
  

  

Excellent interpersonal, organizational, time management, decision making, team building, presentation and oral and written communications skills.
  

  

Have strong problem solving, risk assessment and negotiation skills with experience in managing project dependencies.
  

  

Results oriented, customer focused, and exhibit good interpersonal skills.
  

  

Proficiency in Microsoft office packages.
  

  

EDUCATION AND TRAINING:
  

  

5\+ years of experience within E\-invoicing / EDI domain.
  

  

5\+ years of experience managing client teams within a professional services firm or equivalent experience.
  

  

5\+ years of Consulting or related leadership experience.
  

  

Functional and technical understanding of finance systems and processes (SAP/Oracle).
  

  

Strong operational management, project management, consulting, technology and process improvement skills.
  

  

In\-depth knowledge of E\-Invoicing regulations, technologies, tax compliance and financial processes, and best practices.
  

  

Professional PMP certification is preferred or equivalent combination of education and/or experience.


  

15 years full time education

The Delivery Assurance Manager will drive high\-quality, consistent, and predictable delivery across the organization by combining strong Quality Assurance leadership with a structured Delivery Assurance framework. Our products are a part of some of the most iconic buildings around the world– from the world’s tallest tower, Burj Khalifa in Dubai, to the Oculus at the World Trade Center Transit Hub in Manhattan. title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Lead Site Reliability Engineer**

  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**
---------------------

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer, you will join one of our Product Areas and become part of a collaborative team focused on operating and improving our Azure\-based SaaS platform. You’ll work with experienced engineers and cross\-functional colleagues to help ensure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence for both onboarding and running client environments.


This role is a launchpad for your development as an SRE—combining hands\-on engineering, automation, monitoring, and platform support—with strong mentorship and continuous learning opportunities built in.  



  

**What you will be responsible for**

* Work hands\-on across platform and infrastructure SRE activities — cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/container platforms, CI/CD, and production systems — not just reviewing or delegating this work, but building and operating it directly.
* Define, own, and report on SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs for critical services; manage error budgets and use them to drive concrete engineering and release decisions.
* Actively participate in cost optimization efforts across cloud and platform infrastructure, identifying and implementing efficiency and rightsizing opportunities (FinOps practices).
* Lead the design and implementation of strategies to ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of critical systems and services.
* Manage incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for system outages and performance issues, ensuring timely resolution and prevention of future incidents.
* Develop and maintain monitoring, alerting, and automation systems to enhance service reliability and reduce manual intervention, including automation and AI\-driven engineering approaches (e.g. AI\-assisted anomaly detection, automated remediation, AI\-supported incident triage) to reduce toil and speed up resolution.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and product teams to optimize application performance and system infrastructure.
* Drive initiatives for capacity planning, resource management, and scalability to meet growing business needs.
* Implement continuous improvement processes to enhance the reliability and efficiency of systems and services.

  

**What we value**

* Mentor and guide junior site reliability engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and knowledge\-sharing, while remaining personally hands\-on with the underlying systems.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, providing leadership during critical incidents and ensuring minimal downtime.
* Create and maintain documentation for incident management, system configurations, and operational processes.
* Drive the adoption of industry best practices, tools, and technologies — including automation and AI\-driven engineering tooling — to enhance system reliability and operational performance.

  

**BENEFITS**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work\-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.


Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.  



  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.  



  

**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer 1
description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**


At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**


When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

**Senior Site Reliability Engineer 2**

### **Our Mission \& Vision**

**At ModMed, we are placing doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty\-specific cloud platform. We envision a world where the software we build increases medical\-practice success and improves patient outcomes.**

### **The Role: Impact at Scale**

**As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer II, you are a senior\-level architect of reliability. You don’t just maintain systems; you think big to shape the future of our cloud operations. In this role, you will be a strategic partner in ensuring our AWS infrastructure is world\-class, cost\-effective, and inherently secure.**

**You will innovate boldly by leading complex technical initiatives and aligning passion with purpose as you mentor the next generation of engineers. Your work ensures that when a doctor reaches for our software, it is fast, reliable, and ready to help them do good.**

### **How You’ll Drive Success**

* **Strategic Cloud Ownership: Design and lead the deployment of secure, scalable AWS infrastructure. You’ll optimize for high availability and fault tolerance, ensuring our business\-critical applications thrive.**
* **Advanced Observability: Champion a culture of data\-driven decisions by enhancing our DataDog ecosystem. You’ll ensure we have proactive detection and deep visibility into every corner of our AWS environments.**
* **CI/CD Leadership: Lead the evolution of our deployment velocity. You will optimize robust pipelines using Jenkins, making "deploying with confidence" a daily reality for our engineering teams.**
* **Kubernetes Orchestration: Manage and optimize our containerized world at scale. You’ll drive improvements in scalability and deployment consistency that save time for everyone.**
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Champion: Be the expert voice for Terraform or Ansible, automating complex cloud operations to eliminate manual toil and improve efficiency.**
* **Security \& HIPAA Stewardship: Safeguard our patients' and doctors' trust by ensuring all operations meet rigorous security and compliance standards (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2\).**
* **Mentorship \& Cultural Leadership: You aren't just a technical lead; you are a coach. You will foster a collaborative environment where you mentor junior engineers and have fun while solving hard problems.**

### **What You’ll Bring**

* **Experience: 6–9 years of deep experience in SRE or Cloud Engineering, with a proven track record of managing large\-scale AWS environments.**
* **AWS Mastery: Extensive experience with EC2, S3, Lambda, and RDS, with a focus on cost\-optimization and resource utilization.**
* **The SRE Toolkit: Proficiency in Kubernetes, DataDog, and Jenkins.**
* **Coding \& Automation: Strong scripting skills (Python or Bash) and professional expertise in IaC tools like Terraform.**
* **Problem\-Solving Prowess: A proactive, "ownership" mindset. You don't just fix problems; you architect systems so they don't break in the first place.**
* **Clear Communication: The ability to translate complex technical strategies into clear goals for cross\-functional teams and leadership.**

**Nice\-to\-Haves:**

* **AWS Professional\-level Certifications.**
* **Experience with serverless architectures or cloud\-native data tools (Kafka, Kinesis, Redshift).**
* **Prior experience in healthcare technology or high\-security environments.**

### **Why Join ModMed?**

* **Lead the Strategy: At the SRE 2 level, you have a seat at the table to help shape our technical roadmap.**
* **Direct Healthcare Impact: Your work directly enables better patient outcomes by keeping the "intelligent heart" of medical practices running smoothly.**
* **Innovation \& Autonomy: We encourage you to innovate boldly. If there is a better way to do things, we want you to lead the charge.**
* **A Culture of Excellence: Work with a team that values customer delight and doing good as much as they value clean code and 99\.99% uptime.**

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

* Meals \& Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches \& dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well\-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work\-life balance,
* Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
* Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company\-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.

**PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

**ModMed Technologies India Private Limited** follows a strict, merit\-based and transparent recruitment process conducted only through official and authorized channels.  

  

**We do not:**

* Charge any fees, processing charges, or amount by any nomenclature, whether as a fee or deposit at any stage of the recruitment process;
* Authorise any individual, employee, or third party to collect any such payments (regardless of nomenclature) to offer or facilitate or recruitment opportunities; or
* Conduct hiring via informal messaging apps or personal email IDs.

  

All official communication is made only through verified channels, our website, and recognised recruitment platforms.  

  

We strongly advise candidates not to share personal/financial information or make any payments in response to suspicious communications. Any such instances may be reported to us at hrcompliance@modmed.com .  

  

**ModMed Technologies India Private Limited** will not be responsible for any loss arising from fraudulent or unauthorised communications.

title: Manager, Enterprise Partnership
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
 **Manager, Enterprise Partnership** 
 to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role at the intersection of
 **advertising, data, commerce, and fintech** 
 . You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.
   

  

 The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency\-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**Agency Relationship \& Business Development**
* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams.
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data\-led, commerce\-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency\-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.


**Advertiser \& Revenue Development**
* Identify high\-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities.
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories.
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.


**Consultative \& Solution Selling**
* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction\-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning audience intelligence, transaction\-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement.
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory\-led selling.


**Agency GTM**
* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency\-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.


**Campaign Success \& Account Growth**
* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.


**Market Intelligence \& Product Feedback**
* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured primarily through:
   

  

**Agency penetration:** 
 Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.
   

  

**Active advertisers:** 
 Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.
   

  

**Quality advertisers:** 
 Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.
   

  

**Advertiser retention:** 
 Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.
   

  

**Pipeline creation:** 
 Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.
   

  

**Revenue:** 
 Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.
   

  

**Strategic relationships:** 
 Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long\-term partnerships.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 5–8 years of experience in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising.
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early\-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.


**Strong Plus**
* Experience working at an ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function.
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.

title: FDE Lead
description:
**FDE Lead – Forward Deployed Engineering** 




**About GreyLabs AI** 




 GreyLabs AI is building the voice operating system for India’s BFSI ecosystem. Our Agentic Voice AI platform helps banks, insurers, NBFCs, and fintechs automate and humanize millions of customer conversations across sales, collections, customer service, and compliance in multiple Indian languages.
 



 In under two years, we’ve scaled to
 **75\+ BFSI enterprise clients** 
 including RBL Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank, SBI Life Insurance, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, and Motilal Oswal Financial Services, processing hundreds of millions of conversations. We recently raised
 **₹85 Crores in Series A funding** 
 led by Elevation Capital and Z47\.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We’re hiring an
 **FDE Lead** 
 to own strategic enterprise deployments and help shape the forward deployment function at GreyLabs AI.
 



 This is a
 **player\-coach role** 
 where you’ll lead complex customer engagements, act as the senior technical point of contact for strategic accounts, and mentor FDEs on technical execution and customer management.
 



 You’ll work closely with
 **banking ops leaders, CTO offices, product heads, Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success** 
 to drive deployments from solution design through go\-live and production.
 



 The role demands
 **strong technical depth, customer ownership, mentoring ability, and the commercial instinct** 
 to understand what enterprise customers actually need and translate that into scalable solutions.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**Own Strategic Enterprise Accounts** 



* Take end\-to\-end technical ownership of
 **high\-value, strategic, and complex enterprise accounts** 
 .
* Act as the senior technical point of contact for key customers across banks, insurers, NBFCs, and fintechs.
* Lead architecture and integration discussions, technical workshops, solution reviews, and executive\-level customer conversations.
* Build strong relationships with CTO offices, engineering teams, business heads, operations leaders, and product stakeholders.
* Understand customer business problems and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive complex deployments from requirement discovery through integration, go\-live, and production stabilization.
* Participate in pre\-sales conversations where technical complexity, integrations, or enterprise requirements warrant senior involvement.
* Own customer escalations and drive them to resolution while maintaining trust and long\-term relationships.



**Mentor and Enable FDEs** 



* Mentor FDEs on technical problem\-solving, customer communication, solution design, and deployment execution.
* Review solution approaches, architecture decisions, and integration designs before implementation or go\-live.
* Coach FDEs through complex customer situations and technical escalations.
* Share learnings from strategic accounts to improve how the broader FDE team approaches similar deployments.
* Raise the technical and execution standards across the FDE function without becoming a bottleneck for the team.



**Systematize What Works** 



* Reduce time\-to\-go\-live across the portfolio by identifying recurring friction points in every implementation and fixing the root cause \- not just the instance.
* Build reusable assets that make the team faster without cutting corners: integration playbooks, reference architectures, implementation templates, internal tooling.
* Establish clear delivery standards, milestones, review mechanisms, and escalation criteria.
* Identify patterns across strategic accounts and turn them into repeatable deployment practices.



**Close the Loop with Tech** 



* Turn field patterns into product input. Individual FDEs surface insights; you make sure those insights are prioritized, structured, and acted on.
* Identify where platform gaps are slowing deployments and advocate for fixes that improve every future deployment, not just the current one.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to influence platform improvements based on real customer needs.



**Stay Technical When It Matters** 



* Review customer integrations before they go live, weigh in on architectural decisions where the stakes are high, and write code when the situation genuinely calls for it.
* Be the person who can read a production issue, understand what broke and why, and make a judgment call \- not just escalate it.
* Stay hands\-on with APIs, integrations, data flows, workflows, and production troubleshooting.



**What We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Haves** 



* **5\-8 years of experience** 
 in technical roles, with a meaningful portion in customer\-facing delivery \- forward deployment, solutions engineering, implementation leadership, or technical consulting.
* Experience owning
 **complex enterprise accounts and technical deployments** 
 end\-to\-end.
* Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience with system integration: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns, data pipelines \- you can review an integration design and spot the problem before it reaches production.
* Comfortable in front of enterprise stakeholders at multiple levels \- from engineering teams to business ops leads \- and experienced enough to know that what the customer asks for and what they need are often different things.
* Track record of improving delivery: reduced onboarding timelines, reusable frameworks, or repeatable processes you built that made a team faster, not just a single engagement better.
* Experience
 **mentoring technical ICs/FDEs** 
 and helping them develop their technical and customer\-facing capabilities.
* Strong ownership mindset \- you hold yourself accountable for customer outcomes across strategic accounts, not just individual tasks.



**Strong Signals** 



* You’ve led complex FDE, implementation engineering, solutions, or customer engineering engagements \- ideally at a SaaS company deploying into enterprise environments with real integration complexity.
* You’ve been the
 **senior technical owner for strategic enterprise accounts** 
 , managing ambiguity and driving outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
* You’ve been the senior technical voice in a customer escalation, held the relationship, resolved the issue, and come out with more trust than you went in with.
* You’ve built something field\-specific \- a playbook, a reusable integration, an internal tool \- that measurably improved the team’s next five engagements.
* You’ve mentored engineers/FDEs and helped them independently handle increasingly complex technical and customer situations.
* You understand BFSI \- not necessarily as a domain expert, but enough to move quickly in environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and enterprise procurement timelines are real constraints.
* You find voice AI, conversational systems, and real\-time customer interaction infrastructure genuinely interesting \- not just a category you’ve landed in.



**Why GreyLabs AI?** 



* Work at the intersection of
 **AI, voice, and enterprise technology** 
 .
* Own high\-impact customer deployments from solutioning to production.
* Work across
 **Engineering, Product, Solutions, Sales, and Customer Success** 
 .
* Build scalable systems rather than simply solving individual customer problems.
* Work with
 **75\+ BFSI enterprise clients** 
 and production AI systems operating at significant scale.

Talent has no labels here, and everyone is welcome to grow and thrive with us.*

title: Head - Partner Success and Performance Management (PSS08110)
description:

The organisation is focused on scalable growth, strengthening its partner ecosystem, and leveraging data to enhance business performance and governance.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **Head \- Partner Success and Performance Management** 
 role exists to establish disciplined partner governance, transparent reporting, and structured engagement across the complete partner ecosystem. This leadership position is responsible for converting MIS into actionable insights, running governance cadences, securing action closure, and improving service, customer, and business outcomes. The role reports directly to the
 **Head CX** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design a common governance framework covering partner segmentation, KPIs, SLAs, review frequency, escalation paths, and decision rights.
* Create differentiated engagement models based on partner size, criticality, performance, geography, and customer impact.
* Maintain a central partner repository including scope, contracts, locations, contacts, SLAs, scorecards, review history, and open actions.
* Own a single source of truth for partner MIS; ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and on\-time publication.
* Build automated dashboards for volumes, TAT, SLA, ageing, quality, productivity, cost, customer experience, escalations, and action closure.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports with trends, root causes, risks, exceptions, and management actions using Advanced Excel and Power BI/Tableau.
* Partner with Data and Technology teams to automate extraction, alerts, and scorecards, reducing manual reporting.
* Establish and run operational huddles, weekly reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews with defined agendas and participants.
* Prepare fact\-based review packs covering performance trends, customer feedback, risks, decisions, and improvement actions.
* Document actions with accountable owners, timelines, and outcomes; maintain rigorous follow\-through and escalation until closure.
* Define partner\-specific scorecards aligned to business commitments and customer expectations.
* Identify performance deviations early and initiate recovery plans before they affect customers or commercial relationships.
* Benchmark partners and recommend load allocation, incentives, penalties, probation, capability building, or exit based on sustained results.
* Govern partner categories including sales partners, service centres, logistics partners, and contact\-centre partners with tailored KPIs and recovery plans.
* Convert dashboards, reviews, audits, and VOC into corrective and preventive action plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.
* Track actions centrally, escalate overdue or recurring gaps, and validate effectiveness through operating data and customer outcomes.
* Embed reporting, SOP, system, SLA, and governance requirements during partner onboarding and expansion.
* Identify partner capability and training needs; coordinate targeted interventions and measure post\-training improvement.
* Build and lead the Partner Success Office; align Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams.
* Present consolidated partner performance, risks, and recommendations to the CSOO and leadership team.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Analytics or related discipline; MBA preferred. Certifications in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Business Analytics, or Power BI are advantageous.
* Experience: 10\-14 years in Partner Success, Partner Operations, Performance Management, Service Operations, Customer Experience, or Business Operations; with 4\+ years in leadership roles.
* Leadership: Experience managing high\-volume, multi\-location, SLA\-driven partner ecosystems and senior partner stakeholders; leading cross\-functional teams and reporting to senior leadership.
* Technical Expertise: Partner governance and relationship management; KPI/SLA design; MIS automation; Advanced Excel; Power BI or Tableau; working knowledge of SQL; performance scorecards; WBR/MBR/QBR management; RCA and CAPA; NPS/CSAT analytics.
* Soft Skills: Strategic, analytical, disciplined in action closure, strong executive communication, negotiation, stakeholder influence, and business/commercial acumen.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead the central governance and performance management function for a large, complex partner ecosystem impacting millions of customers.
* Drive measurable improvements in SLA, TAT, quality, productivity, NPS/CSAT, and partner performance scores.
* Shape and embed data\-driven partner governance frameworks and automated reporting tools with high stakeholder visibility.
* Collaborate across Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to influence business outcomes.
* Operate at the intersection of customer experience and operational excellence within a fast\-growing technology\-enabled service platform.

title: Control Manager - Program - Controls Room - Program Management & Governance Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team's objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk\-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing, and monitoring firmwide risk\-based intelligence across all lines of business and corporate functions. As a Control Manager Program Vice President, you will be a key member of the team, leading cross\-functional delivery for firmwide programs that impact Control Management.


As a Control Manager Program Vice President within the Controls Room organization, you will translate enterprise requirements into executable project strategies, integrated roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. You will serve as a senior delivery and governance leader, aligning stakeholders across lines of business, product, and technology; proactively identifying and mitigating delivery, operational, and control risks; and driving disciplined execution against milestones, quality standards, and service\-level agreements.


You will also own User Acceptance Testing governance for in\-scope programs by establishing the UAT strategy, readiness standards, entry and exit criteria, and consolidated reporting. Working across business and technology teams, you will ensure end\-to\-end testing is appropriately planned, staffed, and executed, and that UAT scope, defects, and results remain aligned with program objectives and control effectiveness outcomes. Join our collaborative, high\-impact team and help strengthen how Control Management delivers complex firmwide change.
