title: Manager, Knowledge Management Services, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work \- guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic, self\-motivated knowledge management professional to join our growing KM Services team. As part of A\&M’s Global AI and Knowledge Organization, KM Services is at the center of an exciting firm\-wide transformation in how A\&M works and derives value from its intellectual property. The team is focused on building a mature knowledge management practice, including strengthening relationships with business stakeholders; breaking down siloes; and improving how consulting teams capture, organize, share, and find critical knowledge. In addition to supporting people\-to\-people and people\-to\-content use cases, the team has a critical role in building the data and information layer needed to power business\-relevant AI agents and tools. The successful candidate will own the KM relationship for a portfolio of India business units, partnering closely with those businesses to improve their existing KM processes, understand their evolving needs, and connect them to the global KM strategy and toolkit. This is a high\-visibility role for someone who wants to help business units get more value from their knowledge while also contributing directly to global KM and AI initiatives. The role will report to the EMEA \& India KM Services Director
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Partner with A\&M Business Units on KM Initiatives
* Own the day\-to\-day KM relationship for India business units, with the opportunity to expand the portfolio over time
* Serve as the primary liaison between assigned business units and the central KM team, identifying opportunities to extend each business unit’s use of KM services and maximize KM adoption and value
* Lead projects to build and refine business\-unit KM processes and tools, including coordinating timelines and partnering with KM services, KM technology, and other corporate groups on execution
* Monitor and provide routine support for business\-unit KM processes and tools (e.g., knowledge libraries, taxonomies, capture processes, search, and communities)
* Provide advice and recommendations to business units based on internal and external KM best practices.
* Contribute to KM Knowledge and Expertise
* Partner with KM colleagues to design and build global capabilities and tools (e.g., expert profiles, conversational knowledge search, agentic knowledge capture) and help extend them to new areas of the business
* Support KM team members on initiatives both within and beyond the immediate region, contributing to a cohesive global KM capability
* Share knowledge of processes, approaches, methods, and tools/platforms with team colleagues so the team can leverage its collective experience across the globe
* Provide insight into business needs, initiatives, and end\-user experience to help ensure global KM service offerings remain relevant and aligned to overall strategy
* Support the growth and evolution of the KM team by applying KM best practices in ways that strengthen the success of the overall KM support model
* AI Risk \& Audit
* Identify internal and external KM trends and best practices; communicate and promote these to business\-unit KM contacts
* Champion KM best practices and encourage knowledge sharing and adoption of new tools throughout the region and firm


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in a knowledge management role
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent work/technical experience in Business Studies, Business Administration, or Management
* Experience leading projects from inception to completion, including collaborating with stakeholders on timelines and expectations and handling change management
* Experience in a professional services or consultancy firm
* Proven experience working with professionals of all staff classes, up to C\-level
* Experience with KM technology (e.g., SharePoint libraries, AI\-enabled search and discovery tools)
* Fluent English required. Additional languages (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean) are a plus but not required
* Consultative approach when partnering with the business
* Experience with KM and content management approaches (e.g., communities, skills and experience platforms, document libraries, taxonomy and metadata, search, curation, content analytics)
* Analytical reasoning and solution\-focused problem solving, with the ability to connect the dots and scale KM efforts across a portfolio of business units
* Capable of synthesizing information and driving results in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to balance multiple projects and prioritize effectively
* Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to present complex ideas and solutions to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated history of operating with urgency, responsiveness, and a client\-first focus
* Exceptionally close attention to detail
* Resilience and an ability to persevere in order to break down resistance and accomplish long\-term goals


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Paid Media Manager/ Senior Manager
description:
A
 **Digital Marketing agency** 
 is hiring for the profile of
 **Paid Media Manager/ Senior Manager.** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



  





**Experience:** 
 4\-8
 
 years
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Ownership of Client Portfolio** 




 \-Own a portfolio of 5–6 clients across paid media and be accountable for their overall account health and performance.
 



 \-Have a clear understanding of each client's business objectives, media KPIs, budgets, funnel, target audiences and commercial priorities.
 



 \-Ensure every account has a clear performance plan, optimization roadmap and growth agenda. Maintain a daily pulse on account performance, identifying deviations, opportunities and risks before they become issues.
 



 \-Take ownership of performance outcomes rather than simply reporting numbers.
 



  





**2\. Performance \& Optimization** 




 \-Drive performance across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and other relevant paid media platforms.
 



 \-Monitor budgets, pacing, CPL/CPA/ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, funnel movement and other relevant business KPIs.
 



 \-Go beyond platform metrics to understand lead → MQL → SQL → business outcome wherever applicable.
 



 \-Diagnose the root cause of performance issues and develop clear corrective action plans.
 



 \-Continuously identify opportunities for:
 



 Campaign restructuring
 



 Budget reallocation
 



 Audience expansion
 



 New platforms
 



 New campaign formats
 



 Automation Experimentation
 



 Creative testing
 



 Landing\-page optimization
 



 Funnel optimization
 



 \-Ensure accounts are constantly evolving and are not being managed on a BAU/maintenance basis.
 



  





**3\. Technical \& Tracking Ownership** 
 This is a critical part of the role.
 



 \-Own the technical health of paid media accounts.
 



 \-Ensure pixels, conversion tracking, events, audiences and platform integrations are correctly implemented and functioning.
 



 \-Work closely with analytics, technology, CRM and client teams on:
 



 Meta Pixel / CAPI
 



 Google Ads Conversion Tracking
 



 GA4
 



 Google Tag Manager
 



 LinkedIn Insight Tag
 



 Offline conversion imports
 



 CRM integrations
 



 Lead tracking
 



 UTM governance
 



 Attribution and funnel tracking
 



 \-Regularly conduct tracking and account\-health audits.
 



 \-Identify discrepancies between platform, analytics and CRM data and drive resolution.
 



 \-Ensure tracking issues are identified proactively, rather than after performance has been impacted.
 



  





**4\. Strategic Thinking \& Proactiveness** 




 \-Be the first person to identify an opportunity, not the person waiting for a brief.
 



 \-Bring new media ideas, platforms, formats, audiences, partnerships and technology opportunities to clients.
 



 \-Build proactive recommendations based on:
 



 Market trends
 



 Competitor activity Search behavior
 



 Platform developments
 



 Audience insights
 



 Performance data
 



 Business priorities
 



 \-Challenge briefs constructively when the data indicates a different approach.
 



 \-Build quarterly/annual growth roadmaps for key accounts.
 



 \-Ensure every client has a pipeline of tests and innovations, rather than only optimization of existing campaigns.
 



  





**5\. Client Management** 




 \-Become a trusted paid\-media partner for clients and not merely an execution contact.
 



 \-Lead regular performance discussions and translate data into clear business recommendations.
 



 \-Present performance, insights, challenges and action plans confidently to senior client stakeholders.
 



 \-Set the right expectations around performance, timelines, dependencies and outcomes.
 



 \-Proactively flag risks and communicate them with a solution, not just a problem.
 



 \-Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through additional platforms, services or strategic interventions.
 



  





**6\. Team Leadership** 




 \-Lead and mentor the paid media team working across the client pod.
 



 \-Plan and priorities the team's daily and weekly workload.
 



 \-Review campaign strategy, optimizations, reports and recommendations before they reach the client.
 



 \-Build strong ownership and accountability within the team.
 



 \-Identify capability gaps and coach team members on platform, analytical and strategic skills.
 



 \-Ensure quality, accuracy and timelines across all deliverables.
 



 \-Create a culture where the team thinks ahead rather than waits for instructions.

title: Brand Category Manager
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Operations Director
description:
**Overview**
**170\+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.** 
 At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
   

  

 Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our team of industry subject matter experts.
   

  

 The Operations Director – Pinkerton India leads end\-to\-end service delivery across Pinkerton’s EPIC portfolio (Embed, Protect, Investigate, Consult) to ensure outstanding client outcomes, rigorous accountability, and optimal cost\-to\-value. This role orchestrates multi\-service operations, vendor/partner networks, and internal teams to deliver on\-time, in\-scope, and within\-budget results. The Director drives a culture of ownership, safety, integrity, vigilance, and excellence while scaling processes, enhancing quality, and meeting or exceeding contractual SLAs and KPIs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Serve as the senior operations point of contact for client accounts in India, aligning scope, priorities, and SLAs with Pinkerton’s EPIC model.
* Coordinate services and operational/administrative support needs; oversee dispatch, scheduling, and reporting across assignments and programs.
* Answer and triage escalations from clients, Directors, and Operations Coordinators, ensure swift, transparent communication and resolution.
* Communicate assignment/project expectations, timelines, risks, and success criteria to all parties; maintain impeccable documentation.
* Design, standardize, and enforce SOPs, operational playbooks for consistent delivery across regions and service lines.
* Manage workflows end\-to\-end; assign agents and specialist resources to specific assignments based on capability, compliance, and cost.
* Track program milestones and deadlines; monitor the status of assigned projects and initiate course\-corrections proactively.
* Utilize scorecards to measure activities and outcomes (e.g., Deployable Assets programs), driving continuous improvement.
* Track results and issue reports on completed work, non\-conformities, corrective and improvement plans; own CAPA closure.
* Ensure deadlines are met for scheduling, dispatching, audits, and post checks; verify outcomes (vendor hour approvals, virtual/onsite post checking).
* Send and manage external partner self\-assessments and security questionnaires using approved web\-based tools; drive timely completion and remediation.
* Lead root\-cause analyses, implement preventive actions, and institutionalize lessons learned across teams and vendors.
* Build and govern a high\-performing vendor ecosystem (including Global Alliance Members where applicable) with clear rate cards, SLAs, and compliance obligations.
* Negotiate, onboard, and performance\-manage vendors; conduct QBRs, enforce service credits, and manage escalations to protect client outcomes and margin.
* Optimize vendor utilization, travel/logistics, and deployment patterns to balance speed, quality, risk, and cost.
* Own operational budgeting, forecasting, and margin protection; drive cost\-per\-outcome efficiency without compromising quality or safety.
* Implement demand planning, capacity models, and pricing/quoting discipline; monitor variance and initiate corrective actions.
* Improve invoice accuracy, WIP hygiene, and cycle times; partner with Finance on revenue recognition and profitability.
* Ensure compliance with PSARA, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Shops \& Establishments, PoSH, client codes of conduct, and data privacy/information security requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness; coordinate internal/external audits and remediation plans.
* Champion agent safety through virtual and on\-site post checks, journey management, and incident reporting protocols.
* Hire, coach, and develop a high\-performing operations team; set clear goals and hold teams and vendors accountable.
* Foster a culture of integrity, vigilance, excellence, transparency, and client\-obsession; recognize strong performance and address underperformance promptly.
* Drive change management and cross\-functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, Legal, HR, and Regional Ops.
* All other duties, as assigned.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred. 12–15 years of progressive experience in corporate security/operations or adjacent services, including multi\-vendor orchestration and client service delivery. Experience with escalation/crisis management, incident response coordination, and audit/quality systems. Certifications preferred: CPP, PSP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent.
   

  

* Accountability and ownership mindset; data\-driven decisioning; strong financial acumen.
* Vendor negotiation, rate\-card governance, and performance management.
* Program/Project management, capacity planning, and resource optimization.
* Risk assessment, SOP design, and continuous improvement (Kaizen/CAPA/RCA).
* High integrity, vigilance, and excellence aligned to Pinkerton values.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional Indian languages an advantage.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence at executive level.
* Proven leadership of national programs with measurable SLA/KPI achievement and cost optimization.
* Strong knowledge of India regulatory environment (PSARA, CLRA, Shops \& Establishments, PoSH) and client compliance expectations.
* Proficiency with scheduling/dispatch platforms, CRM/ITSM tools (e.g., Salesforce/ServiceNow), and collaboration suites.
* Advanced Excel; reporting/BI (Power BI/Tableau) for scorecards and operational insights.
* Web\-based tools for self\-assessments/security questionnaires; audit and document control systems.


**Working Conditions**
 With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
   

  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.


 Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country\-specific law.

title: AI Offering Manager, DWS
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
   

  

 Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked \#153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full\-stack portfolio of AI\-enabled, AI\-ready, and AI\-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992\) (ADR: LNVGY).
   

  

 This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

* Experience launching enterprise software or AI\-enabled products/services from concept to market.
* Experience working with cross\-functional global teams and multiple stakeholders.

* Familiarity with enterprise AI ecosystems such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, Google Gemini, ServiceNow AI, Salesforce AI, AWS AI, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of APIs, integrations, cloud services, data platforms, and enterprise architecture concepts.
* Knowledge of ITSM, Digital Employee Experience (DEX), Endpoint/UEM, Workplace Automation, or Service Desk is an advantage.


**Product Management Skills**
* Product roadmap creation and prioritization.
* Customer journey mapping and requirements gathering.
* Business case development and pricing strategy.
* Agile product development and release management.
* Portfolio lifecycle management and KPI ownership.


**Leadership Collaboration**
* Excellent stakeholder management across business and technical teams.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority in a global matrix organization.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA or Master's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering.
* AI or Product Management certifications are a plus.
* Experience working with global technology partners (Microsoft, ServiceNow, Google, AWS, Salesforce, NVIDIA, etc.) is highly desirable.


**Business Impact of the Role**
 This role will help Lenovo DWS accelerate its AI\-first portfolio by:
   

  

 \~AI Portfolio Growth: Build differentiated AI\-native workplace offerings and intelligent managed services.
   

  

 \~Revenue Acceleration: Create scalable offerings that drive global pipeline, attach rates, and recurring services revenue.
   

  

 \~Innovation Leadership: Bring emerging AI capabilities into Lenovo's commercial portfolio through Lenovo IP and strategic partnerships.
   

  

 \~Sales Enablement: Develop repeatable productized offerings, demos, pricing, and GTM assets for global sellers.
   

  

 \~Customer Outcomes: Improve digital employee experience through AI agents, automation, analytics, and intelligent workflows.
   

  

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

title: Business Head - Cross Sell Personal Loan
description:
**Objective** 




 This role exists to own the end\-to\-end growth, profitability, customer lifecycle, and transformation agenda of the Cross Sell \- Personal Loan business. The incumbent is accountable for delivering business growth through a combination of customer portfolio monetization, CRM excellence, digital channels, sales distribution, product innovation, analytics\-led decision\-making and operational rigor
 



**Key Responsibilties** 



1. **Business Growth \& P\&L Ownership** 
 \- Own Cross Sell \- Personal Loan strategy, disbursements, portfolio growth, profitability, and overall business performance.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**Job Description – Growth Manager**

**Build the Pipeline. Start Conversations. Win Clients.**

**Location:** The Iconic Corenthum, Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience:** 2\+ years  
**Compensation:** **₹40,000–₹65,000/month fixed \+ performance incentives**  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time \| On\-site

**Working Days \& Timings:** Monday – Saturday, 11am – 8pm

**About Recruiting Genie**

Recruiting Genie is a founder\-led People \& Talent Solutions company, helping startups, SMEs and growing businesses since 2018\.

We work across **Talent Acquisition, Talent Management and Virtual Assistance**, with clients in India and international markets.

We are looking for a **Growth Manager** who can take ownership of building RG's business pipeline and turning opportunities into clients.

**This role is NOT for everyone.**

We are **not looking for someone who waits for leads, sends routine follow\-ups or spends the day updating a CRM.**

We are looking for a **hunter** who enjoys finding the right companies, reaching decision\-makers, starting conversations and creating business opportunities from scratch.

**What you'll own**

**1\. New Business – India**

· Build relationships with founders, business owners and decision\-makers across Noida/NCR.

· Identify companies that could benefit from RG's Talent Acquisition and Talent Management services.

· Generate opportunities through LinkedIn, cold calling, email, networking, referrals and local business communities.

· Conduct discovery conversations and understand business requirements.

· Develop proposals and move qualified opportunities towards closure.

**2\. US Business – Virtual Assistance**

· Build a prospect pipeline of US\-based businesses.

· Identify founders and decision\-makers who may need flexible remote support.

· Conduct targeted LinkedIn, email and outbound campaigns.

· Start conversations around Executive \& Administrative, Customer \& Operations, Research, Data/CRM and other VA support.

· Qualify opportunities and drive them towards discovery calls and conversion.

**3\. Growth \& Relationships**

· Experiment with new channels, industries and approaches to generate business.

· Build a strong network of founders and business owners.

· Attend relevant events and create offline opportunities.

· Develop referral and partnership opportunities.

· Track your pipeline, activity and conversions — and continuously improve them.

**4\. Be Part of the Brand**

You may also participate in short videos, founder/business conversations and other content that supports RG's visibility and lead generation.

You don't need to be a content creator. **You do need to be confident, articulate and comfortable representing RG.**

**We're looking for someone who...**

· Has **2\+ years of genuine business development/client acquisition experience**.

· Has sold B2B services, recruitment/staffing, consulting, SaaS, agency or similar solutions.

· Is comfortable approaching people who don't know you.

· Can make cold calls without hesitation.

· Can write a good LinkedIn message without sounding like a salesperson.

· Can speak confidently with founders and senior decision\-makers.

· Is commercially curious and understands that **pipeline creation is their responsibility**.

· Can work without being spoon\-fed leads, scripts or daily instructions.

· Handles rejection well and keeps moving.

· Is energetic, outgoing and naturally enjoys conversations.

· Can turn conversations into meetings, opportunities and eventually revenue.

**Who should NOT apply**

This role may not be suitable if you:

· Expect the company to provide a ready\-made lead database.

· Prefer only handling inbound enquiries.

· Consider calling and prospecting someone else's responsibility.

· Are comfortable doing follow\-ups but don't enjoy creating opportunities.

· Need detailed instructions for what to do every day.

· Are primarily looking for a comfortable 9\-to\-6 routine.

· Measure your work by the number of calls/messages rather than business outcomes.

**What success looks like**

Within the first few months, we expect you to have built a **healthy prospect pipeline, established relationships with decision\-makers, created qualified opportunities and started converting them into paying clients.**

Your primary KPI is simple:

**Can you create new business for Recruiting Genie?**

**Why join RG?**

You'll have the opportunity to:

· Work directly with a founder\-led business.

· Build business across **India \+ the US market**.

· Sell multiple B2B solutions rather than a single product.

· Own your territory, pipeline and growth experiments.

· Build relationships with founders and business leaders.

· Grow into a larger commercial leadership role as RG scales.

**Apply**

If you believe **you can create business without waiting for someone to hand you leads**, we'd like to meet you.

Please send your resume along with a short response to:

**“If you joined Recruiting Genie tomorrow with zero leads, how would you generate your first 10 qualified prospects?”**

We'd rather see **how you think** than read another generic job application.

Our email: team@recruitinggenie.in

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.00 per month

title: Manager – ERP Implementation/Transformation Readiness, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryāna, India
  

Date Posted: Sep 24, 2026

  

**About Alvarez \& Marsal**


Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.

  

**The Team**


Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –


* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance
**How you will contribute**


We are seeking an experienced Manager – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation. The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.


Key Responsibilities
  

Expertise across one or more of the following areas


1\. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment


* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current\-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.

2\. Finance Process Readiness


* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period\-end and year\-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet\-driven, highly customized, or non\-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future\-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.

3\. Finance Master Data \& Chart of Accounts Readiness


* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data. Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master\-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.

4\. Functional Readiness


* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori\-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean\-core readiness assessments.

5\. Data Migration Readiness


* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open\-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.

6\. Integration \& Technology Readiness


* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with: MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.

7\. Reporting \& Management Information Readiness


* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.

8\. Controls \& Compliance Readiness


* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation\-of\-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future\-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.

9\. Stakeholder \& Program Leadership


* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.

10\. Team Leadership


* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.
**Qualifications**
* 6–11 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Finance processes and their ERP enablement.
* Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts, financial master data, organizational structures, reporting, controls, and data migration.
* Experience working with Finance leadership and senior business stakeholders.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and complex transformation workstreams.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Your journey at A\&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
**Culture \& Values**
---------------------


At Alvarez \& Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------


It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A\&M policy statements and additional information by region here.


**Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters**
----------------------------------------------------


Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

description:
**Job Title**
 Technical Consultant
   

  

**About Skyhigh Security**
 Skyhigh Security is a dynamic, fast\-paced, cloud company that is a leader in the security industry. Our mission is to protect the world’s data, and because of this, we live and breathe security. We value learning at our core, underpinned by openness and transparency.
   

  

 Since 2011, organizations have trusted us to provide them with a complete, market\-leading security platform built on a modern cloud stack. Our industry\-leading suite of products radically simplifies data security through easy\-to\-use, cloud\-based, Zero Trust solutions that are managed in a single dashboard, powered by hundreds of employees across the world. With offices in Santa Clara, Aylesbury, Paderborn, Bengaluru, Sydney, Tokyo and more, our employees are the heart and soul of our company.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security Is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you. We embrace a hybrid work model, creating the flexibility and freedom you need from your work environment to reach your potential. From our employee recognition program, to our ‘Blast Talks' learning series, and team celebrations (we love to have fun!), we strive to be an interactive and engaging place where you can be your authentic self.
   

  

 We are on these too! Follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter@SkyhighSecurity.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Consultant in the Skyhigh Customer Value team, you will play a critical role in ensuring customers maximize the value of our solutions. You will guide customers through their product adoption journey, ensuring seamless deployment, integration, and continuous optimization. This role will develop deep relationships with our largest customers and complete the technical onboarding process for our smaller customers. By leveraging your technical expertise and customer\-centric approach, you will drive operational success, best\-practice adoption, and long\-term customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Technical Consultants directly guide our customers throughout their product adoption journey, ensuring they achieve their security and network transformation goals.
   

  

**Deployment and Execution**
* Implement SWG, CASB, ZTNA, DLP, and other SSE security solutions based on the Solution Architect’s design.
* Configure security policies, user access controls, and enterprise integrations.
* Perform policy migration and optimization to ensure compliance and best practices.
* Conduct pilot testing, UAT, and final production rollout.
* Deliver technical training and enablement to customer teams to effectively manage the product.


**Customer Engagement \& Support**
* Provide ongoing technical guidance and troubleshooting support for complex issues.
* Lead best practice workshops and enablement sessions to upskill customer teams.
* Provide continuous education and coaching to customers on existing and new features to ensure they maximize the value of the solution.
* Provide context and help to the Support team to ensure that service requests are addressed and effectively communicated to the customer.
* Manage and escalate customer concerns internally when necessary.


**Customer Adoption \& Expansion**
* Act as the technical point of contact post\-deployment, ensuring customers fully adopt, optimize, and expand their SSE solution.
* Monitor solution performance, adoption and provide proactive recommendations to improve efficiency, security, and compliance.
* Participate in business reviews and conduct technical health checks to track progress and address gaps.
* Identify opportunities for expansion by assessing additional use cases, security.
* Assist with change management and internal advocacy within customer teams to drive long\-term adoption.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Manager, Sales, and Product teams to align solutions with customer objectives.


**Documentation, Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement**
* Document deployment procedures, configuration settings, and optimization strategies.
* Contribute to the internal knowledge base for Professional Services and TAM best practices.
* Mentor and coach other Technical Consultants and Technical Account Managers to enhance team expertise.
* Contribute to internal knowledge\-sharing initiatives, training programs, and best practice discussions.
* Provide feedback on customer pain points and feature requests to Product and Engineering teams.
* Stay up to date with industry security trends, emerging threats, and SSE product advancements.


**Background And Experience Required For a Technical Consultant**
* 7 to 10\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Technical Consultant, Solution Architect, Technical Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or similar).
* Ready to work on permanent EST shift
* Strong background in network security, cloud security, and SSE/SASE solutions.
* Experience with firewalls, proxies, CASB, DLP, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and SWG (Secure Web Gateway).
* Proficiency in network protocols, authentication mechanisms, and security frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with a customer\-first mindset.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for various audiences.
* Experience coaching and training customers to use technical products effectively.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts while prioritizing key customer needs.
* It would be great if you also have the following, but they are not required:
* Industry certifications such as CCNA Security, Comptia security\+, AWS/Azure Security, CCSK/CCSP or CISSP.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and managing multi\-region
* deployments.
* Experience working with PSA tools (Open Air, Financial Force etc.).
* Customer Value Career Path


**Career Progression In Customer Value**
 The natural progression for someone who has demonstrated full proficiency, and executed at a ratings level of ‘Above Target’ consistently would be to prepare a succession plan for a role as a Solution Architect, focused on the design of the integration of Skyhigh products in the customer environment to execute against their use cases and create value realization. Further growth opportunities may include moving into leadership roles such as Manager, Customer Value team based on expertise and career aspirations.
   

  

**Company Benefits And Perks**
 We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement


 We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
   

  

**Our Commitment To You**
 At Skyhigh Security, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Skyhigh Security will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

****Job Description****
**About TaskUs:** 
 TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next\-generation customer experience to fast\-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud\-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest\-growing sectors, including social media, e\-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride\-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.

 It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

**What We Offer:** 
 At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well\-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your teammates and the other departments.
   

  

 Being a
 **Team Leader** 
 , you will manage the day\-to\-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses \- so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience \- which is the main thrust of your department.
   

  

 You must be adept at creating reports of your team's performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.
   

  

 So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Leader?
   

  

****Requirements:****
 So, what are we looking for?
   

  

 We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader. Someone with at least one (1\) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 10 \+ teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company. We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above\-average technical know\-how.
   

  

 If you have previous experience working on the phone, email and live chat customer support roles, then that's a plus in your favor. If you're familiar with E\-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts \- then we definitely want to talk to you.

 TaskUs is an Equal Opportunity Employer

****DEI:****

Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
   

  

 We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
 **https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**

We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Global Salesforce Process Owner - Salesforce COE
description:

**Description**
**Our organization** 
 :
   

  

 Indorama Ventures is a global sustainable chemical company operating across multiple verticals such as Combined PET, Fibers, and Integrated Oxides \& Derivatives. The Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Kolkata, India supports worldwide operations through centralized IT, Finance and Business process services.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a senior, business\-oriented Salesforce professional to own the end\-to\-end functional process design for our Salesforce process
   

  

 Acting as the functional process owner, you will lead discovery and design decisions, establish common process standards, resolve cross\-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need through solution delivery and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 This high\-impact role is accountable for the functional integrity of the process landscape, the quality and readiness of business requirements, business acceptance of delivered capabilities, process adoption, and continuous improvement. Delivery teams will own technical design and execution; this role will own the business process intent, functional outcomes, and design decisions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Functional Process Ownership \& Design**
* Own the end\-to\-end functional process design for Salesforce\-enabled commercial capabilities, from lead and opportunity management through quoting, contracting, order hand\-off, and customer lifecycle management.
* Define and maintain global process principles, target\-state process models, decision rights, business rules, controls, roles, personas, and hand\-offs across functions and regions.
* Lead structured discovery and design workshops, challenge local requirements, resolve process conflicts, and secure accountable business sign\-off on functional designs.
* Assess process gaps and improvement opportunities using business outcomes, data, risk, control, customer experience, and adoption considerations.
* Maintain clear traceability from strategic objective and business need through process design, requirement, delivered capability, control, and measurable benefit.


**Functional Design Authority \& Governance**
* Act as the functional design authority for Salesforce Sales Cloud and related commercial capabilities, ensuring designs align with enterprise process principles, platform guardrails, and the target operating model.
* Set the functional direction and approve key process decisions while partnering with architects and delivery teams on solution options, feasibility, integrations, data implications, and non\-functional constraints.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and process fragmentation by promoting standard capabilities, reusable patterns, and disciplined exception governance.
* Define functional acceptance criteria, oversee business validation and UAT readiness, and provide final functional acceptance for releases.
* Ensure process controls, data ownership, compliance requirements, and auditability are embedded in functional designs.


**Demand Prioritization \& Delivery Partnership**
* Shape and prioritize the functional demand pipeline with Business Product Owners and the Salesforce Platform Owner based on strategic alignment, business value, risk, dependency, and process maturity.
* Own the quality and readiness of epics, process requirements, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria before work enters delivery.
* Provide timely functional decisions, clarify intent during delivery, manage scope trade\-offs, and ensure delivered capabilities remain aligned with approved process designs.
* Partner with release, testing, data, integration, and change teams to confirm business readiness, adoption plans, process controls, and benefit measures.


**Process Architecture, Documentation \& Adoption**
* Create and maintain authoritative process architecture and functional documentation, including current\- and target\-state maps, capability models, business rules, controls, role and persona maps, decision logs, and functional specifications.
* Communicate process direction, design decisions, impacts, and trade\-offs clearly to senior leaders, process owners, regional stakeholders, and delivery teams.
* Partner with change and learning teams to define role impacts, operating procedures, training needs, adoption measures, and post\-release reinforcement.
* Monitor process performance, user feedback, data quality, control effectiveness, and realized benefits to drive a prioritized continuous\-improvement roadmap.


**Educational Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an advantage.
* Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant certification is preferred and should be supported by strong practical understanding of platform capabilities and constraints.
* Process\-management, business\-analysis, Lean Six Sigma, or agile product certification is an advantage.


**Nice to Have**
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist certification.
* Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud or Service Cloud.


**Experience**
**Core Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in business process ownership, process design, product management, or senior business analysis, including substantial responsibility for Salesforce\-enabled commercial processes.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex end\-to\-end functional process design across multiple functions, regions, or business units, with authority to drive standardization and resolve competing requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud and the sales lifecycle, including lead, account, opportunity, pipeline, customer, forecasting, and quote\-to\-order processes; Salesforce CPQ experience is advantageous.
* Experience in a manufacturing or complex commercial environment, with a practical understanding of global process variation, controls, customer experience, data ownership, and integration hand\-offs.
* Proven ability to translate strategy and business outcomes into target\-state processes, policies, business rules, functional requirements, decision frameworks, and measurable success criteria.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and decision\-making skills, including the confidence to challenge stakeholders, manage exceptions, and obtain senior\-level alignment.
* Experience governing demand and backlogs, assuring requirement quality, supporting UAT and release readiness, and measuring adoption and business benefits in an agile delivery environment.
* Excellent analytical, process\-modelling, documentation, and executive communication skills; proficiency with tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Sufficient technical fluency to evaluate Salesforce solution options and data or integration implications while maintaining clear accountability boundaries with architects and delivery teams.


**Behavioral Skills**
**Leadership \& Behavioral Skills**

title: Manager, IT Business & Product Management
description:
**Our Digital Transformation**


The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca\-Cola Company (TCCC) system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.

**Role Overview**


The **Manager, IT Business \& Product Management** will help connect business priorities with technology solutions that deliver measurable value in Manufacturing IT environment. This role acts as a trusted partner to business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, vendors, and service providers. The role is responsible for translating business needs into product priorities, roadmaps, portfolio decisions, and technology outcomes, while supporting effective escalation management and value realization. This position is ideal for a business\-facing information technology professional who understands how to balance customer needs, operational priorities, workplace technology, manufacturing environments, vendor delivery, financial discipline, and digital transformation. The successful candidate will bring strong product management capability, practical technology fluency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive results in a cross\-functional manufacturing environment. This role helps ensuring technology products and services are aligned to business capability needs, governed effectively, and continuously improved through data, insight, and collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, and technology partners.

**What You will do for us**

* Lead business engagement by partnering with business stakeholders to understand priorities, pain points, operational needs, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvement.
* Translate business requirements into product priorities, technology outcomes, roadmap plans, and investment recommendations that support measurable business value.
* Develop and manage product roadmaps aligned to business capability needs, portfolio priorities, operational readiness, and financial planning.
* Own product outcomes, adoption, user value, business impact, and product\-related escalations for assigned technology services or capabilities.
* Use governance, prioritization methods, and performance insights to improve product outcomes, business alignment, and decision\-making.
* Assess the business and product impact of incidents, ensuring appropriate stakeholder communication, escalation support, and alignment with vendors and technical resolution teams.
* Support change prioritization, release readiness, business adoption, governance decisions, and stakeholder alignment for technology changes.
* Support business capability development and digital product evolution through value\-based investment decisions and coordination across delivery, architecture, finance, and operations teams.
* Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers that support product delivery, roadmap execution, workplace technology, manufacturing solutions, or business outcomes.
* Coordinate with management teams, vendors, and service providers to resolve issues, support service quality, and improve delivery performance.
* Use business, product, adoption, financial, operational, and value realization metrics to determine priorities and influence portfolio decisions.
* Apply artificial intelligence insights and data\-driven analysis to support prioritization, product decisions, service improvement, and business value creation.
* Ensure product priorities and delivery decisions align with governance, risk, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology standards.
* Support business case development, investment planning, portfolio prioritization, value realization, and management of operating expense and capital expenditure budgets.
* Influence product portfolio priorities, business capability investment, and strategic technology planning within the relevant business and technology scope.
* Bring awareness of manufacturing systems and applications to support operational environments, business continuity, and practical technology decision\-making.

**Requirements and Qualifications Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience working in Information Technology, preferably in business\-facing technology, product management, workplace technology, manufacturing technology, service delivery, or a related environment.
* Practical knowledge of end\-user and workplace technology services, including personal computers, deskside support, Microsoft and Apple operating systems, remote desktop protocol, virtual desktop infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Knowledge of output management solutions, including multifunction printers, secure print, label printers, and network printers.
* Familiarity with manufacturing systems, manufacturing applications, or technology used to support production or bottling environments.
* Experience in product management, business relationship management, roadmap planning, portfolio management, and agile delivery.
* Experience leading a team or workstream, motivating others, driving execution, and delivering results in a cross\-functional environment.
* Proven ability to develop information technology solutions that address complex business problems and enable measurable outcomes.
* Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to translate stakeholder needs into product priorities, technology requirements, and actionable plans.
* Experience coordinating with management, vendors, service providers, and technology partners to support delivery quality, service performance, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology governance, prioritization, change readiness, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and service management practices.
* Ability to use data, metrics, analytics, and financial indicators to guide prioritization, measure adoption, and support continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and automation concepts, with the ability to apply insights appropriately to product management, decision\-making, and service improvement.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience supporting business cases, investment planning, operating expense budgets, capital expenditure budgets, and value realization.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across levels and functions.
* Structured, organized, pragmatic, and practical working style with strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and sound decision\-making.
* Full professional English proficiency, including clear written and verbal communication.
* Bottler, manufacturing, consumer goods, or operational technology experience strongly preferred.

title: Help Desk Analyst
description:
**About York Solutions** 




 With over 25 years of experience, we are a technology consulting firm that uses a non\-transactional, value\-based approach to provide clients with custom technology and workforce solutions to achieve business, technology, and operational goals. Using a strategic partnership approach with our clients, York Solutions focuses on fostering a long\-term, trust\-based relationship.
 



  





 At York Solutions, we believe technology is about empowering people. Our team is built on collaboration, accountability, integrity, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional service to both our consultants and clients. We are looking for a customer\-focused
 **Help Desk Analyst** 
 who enjoys solving problems, takes pride in delivering outstanding user experience, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Help Desk Analyst is responsible for preparing, deploying, shipping, receiving, and supporting laptop computers for consultants working with York Solutions' clients. This role combines technical support with logistics and customer service, ensuring every consultant receives a fully configured device and a smooth onboarding experience.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, technically proficient, and enjoys helping others succeed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Device Imaging \& Configuration** 



* Image and configure Windows laptops using standard corporate deployment tools.
* Install approved software, security applications, and client\-specific configurations.
* Perform quality assurance testing to ensure devices are deployment\-ready.
* Maintain imaging documentation and deployment procedures.
* Troubleshoot imaging and hardware issues.



  





**End User Support** 



* Assist new hires with initial laptop setup.
* Guide users through logging into their laptops using credentials provided by the client's IT department.
* Troubleshoot login, MFA, VPN, and basic Windows issues.
* Escalate issues requiring client IT involvement while maintaining ownership of the user experience.
* Provide clear, professional communication throughout the onboarding process.



  





**Shipping \& Receiving** 



* Prepare laptops and accessories for shipment.
* Coordinate shipping with carriers to ensure timely delivery.
* Receive returned equipment and inspect for damage.
* Perform asset recovery, data sanitization (when applicable), and reimage returned devices.
* Track shipments and maintain accurate inventory records.



  





**Asset Management** 



* Maintain accurate inventory of laptops, accessories, and peripherals.
* Update asset management systems with device assignments and returns.
* Monitor inventory levels and notify management of replenishment needs.
* Ensure compliance with client and company asset management policies.



  





**Documentation** 



* Create and maintain support documentation.
* Record incidents, service requests, and resolutions.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles and process improvements.



  





**Requirements** 



* Associate degree in Information Technology or equivalent work experience.
* 3\-5 years of Help Desk, Desktop Support, or IT Support experience.
* Experience imaging Windows laptops.
* Knowledge of Windows 11 and Microsoft 365\.
* Familiarity with Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), or similar identity platforms.
* Basic networking knowledge.
* Experience using ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk, Freshservice, or similar).
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.
* Ability to safely lift, carry, and move laptop shipments and related equipment weighing up to 18 kg (40 lbs).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting enterprise laptop deployments.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, or similar endpoint management tools.
* Experience with asset management systems.
* CompTIA A\+ or similar certification.
* Experience supporting remote users.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Exceptional customer service mindset.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Problem\-solving mentality.
* Dependable and accountable.
* Team\-oriented with a collaborative approach.
* Comfortable working independently while knowing when to escalate issues.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Laptops are deployed accurately and on schedule.
* New users experience smooth onboarding with minimal downtime.
* Asset records remain accurate and current.
* Support tickets are resolved efficiently and professionally.
* Positive feedback from consultants, clients, and internal teams.
* Continuous identification of opportunities to improve processes and documentation.



  





**Why Join York Solutions?** 




  





 At York Solutions, you'll be part of a team that values:
 



  




* **People First:** 
 We build lasting relationships through trust and respect.
* **Service Excellence:** 
 We strive to exceed expectations in every interaction.
* **Collaboration:** 
 We work together to solve problems and support one another.
* **Integrity:** 
 We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 We embrace learning, innovation, and process improvement.
* **Accountability:** 
 We take ownership of our work and deliver on our commitments.



  





 If you're passionate about technology, enjoy helping people, and want to make a meaningful impact in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 To learn more about our company, visit:
 
 www.yorksolutions.net
 




  





**York Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:
RSA provides trusted identity and access management for 12,000 organizations around the world, managing 25 million enterprise identities and providing secure, convenient access to millions of users. RSA specializes in empowering security\-first organizations in financial services, healthcare, energy, technology services, and other industries to thrive in a digital world, delivering complete capabilities for modern authentication, access, lifecycle management, and identity governance. Whether in the cloud or on\-premises, RSA connects people with the digital resources they depend on everywhere they live, work, and play.
   

  

 For decades, RSA has pioneered many of the encryption, authentication, and identity federation technologies that still power the internet. And now RSA is transforming the industry yet again, paving the way for the future of digital identity through the RSA Unified Identity Platform; next\-generation hybrid and cloud solutions; the first ever and only multi\-functional, password less hardware authenticator; and a frictionless, mobile\-optimized experience for the modern workforce.
