title: ServiceNow- Process Mapping & Automation - Assistant Vice President
description:
****Job Description****
 Job Description
   

  

****Role Summary \& Role Description****
 The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.
   

  

 This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.
   

  

**Service Mapping \& CMDB Management**
* Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
* Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
* Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
* Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top\-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
* Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
* Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
* Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
* Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
* Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.


**Governance, BAU, Compliance \& Automation**
* Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
* Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 As a Senior Consultant in Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) and PingFederate, you will support the design, implementation, and optimization of identity solutions aligned to clients’ digital transformation and security objectives. You will contribute to complex IAM engagements across delivery execution and solution strategy, working with cross\-functional teams to help clients strengthen consumer trust, improve access experiences, and secure sensitive data. This role offers the opportunity to work across platforms, technologies, and client environments in a fast\-paced cyber practice.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant on the Identity \& Access Management (IAM) team, you will be responsible for…
   

  

* Supporting end\-to\-end CIAM engagements, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and production support
* Designing and implementing IAM capabilities across authentication, federation, registration, multi\-factor authentication, adaptive access, and identity lifecycle management
* Integrating IAM platforms and protocols with applications, directories, and identity sources using tools such as PingFederate, PingOne, PingAccess, and Transmit Security
* Translating business and technical requirements into scalable identity solutions and contributing to architecture, proof\-of\-concept, and advisory activities
* Developing delivery artifacts including process flows, test plans, configuration documentation, and implementation support materials


**The team**
 Deloitte's Identity \& Access Management (IAM) practice, within Cyber Risk Services, enables trust and safety across digital products and consumer\-facing platforms. We protect users, consumers, and patients from harm by helping clients establish consumer confidence — ensuring they know with whom they are dealing and securing access to sensitive data.
   

  

 Our team delivers full\-spectrum IAM services: from customer identity lifecycle and federation, to enterprise provisioning, access certification, role management, and IAM road map strategy. We partner closely with clients undergoing digital transformation, supporting both implementation and strategic advisory engagements.
   

  

**Location: HYD/BLR/CHN/PUN**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance, Business, or a related quantitative discipline

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Identity and Access Management
* 2\+ years of hands\-on customization experience with Transmit Security and/or Ping Identity tools, including PingFederate, PingOne, or PingAccess
* Experience implementing authentication and federation protocols, including Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and WS\-Federation
* Experience working with Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security (SSL/TLS), and Linux environments
* Experience using Java, .NET, or scripting languages for IAM integrations and customizations

* Experience delivering IAM engagements in a consulting services environment
* Experience with Okta, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or Saviynt
* Experience with web and application servers, including Internet Information Services (IIS), WebSphere, WebLogic, JBoss, or Apache Tomcat
* Experience supporting IAM road map, strategy, or vendor selection activities
* Experience developing or delivering training, proof\-of\-concept activities, or both for IAM solutions
* Industry certifications such as Ping Identity, Okta, ForgeRock, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Project Management Professional (PMP), or cloud security certifications

title: IAM Operations Engineer
description:
As an
 **IAM Operations Engineer at Topsoe** 
 , you will play a key role in the daily operation, monitoring, support, and troubleshooting of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform and its integrations.
   

  

 Your work will help ensure that identity lifecycle processes and access\-management services remain available, reliable, and compliant throughout the employee journey—from
 **joiner to mover to leaver** 
 . You will also help bring IAM platform ownership in\-house as we transition responsibilities from our external partner.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Take ownership of the daily operations of Topsoe’s IAM platform and its integrations.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and connections with enterprise systems such as SAP.
* Handle L2/L3 support escalations from the L1 Service Desk and resolve incidents effectively.
* Troubleshoot provisioning, deprovisioning, access\-request, and access\-review issues.
* Investigate failed or delayed identity transactions and analyze access models and connectors.
* Coordinate complex investigations with development, architecture, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Support testing, deployment, rollback, access reviews, audits, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* You will also help educate L1 support colleagues, improve first\-contact resolution, and maintain clear standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.


**What You Will Bring**
 You have experience operating IAM platforms and supporting identity lifecycle processes in a structured, service\-oriented environment. You are analytical, methodical, and comfortable investigating technical issues with both business and security implications.
   

  

**We Are Looking For**
* Experience operating IAM platforms, preferably SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
* A good understanding of provisioning flows, connectors, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Experience with IT Service Management, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* The ability to prioritize incidents based on business and security impact.
* Clear documentation skills and experience maintaining operational procedures.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and scripting.


**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have**
* SailPoint certification or a willingness to pursue certification.
* Experience working in a global organization with distributed teams.
* Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and operational performance management.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.
* An ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience supporting access reviews, audit controls, or compliance activities.


**Your new team**
 You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and help build the foundation for Topsoe’s future IAM operations. Together, the team will take on responsibilities currently managed by our external partner and develop effective ways of working for long\-term operational ownership.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative and security\-focused environment where your work will have a direct impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape.
   

  

**You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM capabilities.
* Help ensure reliable identity and access services across the organization.
* Improve operational processes, monitoring, and support practices.
* Support the onboarding and stabilization of new applications.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of the IAM team.
* Be part of Topsoe’s ongoing digital transformation.


**How You Can Apply**
 If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
   

  

 Please contact Stefan Schuller, on email sslr@topsoe.com, if you want to know more about the position.
   

  

**Application deadline: 18\-10\-2026** 
 .
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
   

  

 To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
   

  

*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
**About Us**
 Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
   

  

 Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
   

  

 We offer world\-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low\-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
   

  

 We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

You will gain hands\-on exposure to enterprise security platforms, network infrastructure, troubleshooting methodologies, and operational processes used to support global customers.
   

  

 You will support the Network Security team in monitoring, managing, and troubleshooting enterprise network security solutions. You will assist in firewall administration, load balancer operations, VPN support, network security monitoring, incident management, and service delivery activities while developing a strong foundation in network security technologies and best practices.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Firewall Operations: Support the management and monitoring of next\-generation firewalls including Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, and Check Point. Assist with firewall policy reviews, access requests, rule analysis, and configuration validation. Monitor firewall logs and security events to identify network security issues and potential threats.
* Network Security Monitoring: Monitor security alerts, system health, and network events across security platforms. Investigate alerts and support incident resolution activities within agreed service levels. Assist in analysing traffic flows, security logs, and connectivity issues.
* VPN and Secure Connectivity Support: Support administration and troubleshooting of VPN technologies including IPSec VPN, SSL VPN, GlobalProtect, and remote access solutions. Assist users and support teams in resolving secure connectivity issues.
* Incident and Problem Management: Monitor queue across various ITSM platforms (Service Now, NGSD, etc.). Participate in troubleshooting network security incidents and perform preliminary root cause analysis. Support the preparation of incident reports and technical documentation. Collaborate with senior engineers during major incident investigations.
* Change and Service Management: Support change implementations related to firewalls, load balancers, and security infrastructure. Use ITSM tools such as ServiceNow (SNOW) for incident, request, and change management activities. Ensure all support activities are documented accurately.
* Network Troubleshooting: Assist in troubleshooting routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and network security issues. Perform log analysis and packet\-flow reviews under guidance from senior engineers.
* Collaboration and Learning: Work closely with network, security, and service management teams. Participate in technical reviews, customer support activities, and operational meetings. Stay updated with emerging technologies, security threats, and industry best practices.

* Good understanding of troubleshooting methodologies.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a willingness to support critical network services.
* Basic Understanding Of following concepts:
* Network Security Fundamentals

* SDWAN
* SASE
* VPN Technologies
* OSI and TCP/IP Models
* Routing and Switching Concepts

* Palo Alto Firewalls

title: Infra Managed Service Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 As an Application Tech Support Practitioner aligned to the ITAM practice, you will be the data\-quality and lifecycle steward for the client's Hardware Asset Management and Configuration Management Database estate on the Now Platform. Your typical day will involve executing Discovery and inventory reconciliation, maintaining asset and CI records, driving HAM workflow tickets (procurement → receive → deploy → maintain → retire → dispose), running CMDB Health remediation, and producing scheduled governance reports. You will work under moderate supervision and own an assigned CI class group or hardware category as the SME to L1 and L3 teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 HAM
   

  

 Execute the end\-to\-end hardware asset lifecycle on ServiceNow HAM/HAM Pro\-on Order, In Stock, In Use, In Maintenance, Retired, Disposed states\-for end\-user devices, data center equipment, network gear, and consumables.
   

  

 Maintain alm\_asset and alm\_hardware records: asset tags, serial numbers, ownership, location, cost\-centre, depreciation, and warranty/lease attributes.
   

  

 Process and fulfil IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) tickets, hardware refresh/reclamation, transfer orders between stockrooms, and disposal orders with full audit\-trail documentation.
   

  

 Understand HAM / CMDB normalization concept\-resolve unnormalized models, manufacturer aliases, and EOL/EOSL dates; drive normalization to ≥95% target.
   

  

 Perform scheduled and ad\-hoc inventory audits (including Mobile Agent/barcode scanning); reconcile physical vs. system records and remediate ghost/missing assets.
   

  

 Track lease and warranty data, raise renewals 60\-90 days in advance, and feed refresh planning into Procurement.
   

  

 Maintain stockroom, bundle, consumable, and model\-category data per defined policy.
   

  

 CMDB
   

  

 Maintain CI hygiene across CMDB CI classes within scope.
   

  

 Apply and tune Identification \& Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules\-identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source precedence, and inclusion rules\-for assigned CI classes; resolve duplicate\-CI and overloaded\-CI exceptions.
   

  

 Drive and configure CMDB Health remediation against Completeness, Compliance, and Correctness KPIs in CMDB Workspace; clear orphan/stale/duplicate CI failures before the failure threshold is reached.
   

  

 Configure and process CI attestation, Data Certification, and CMDB Workspace Data Manager retirement/delete policies for stale CIs.
   

  

 Maintain CI relationships per the Common Service Data Model (CSDM 5\.0\)\-Foundation, Ideation \& Strategy, Design \& Planning, Build \& Integration, Service Delivery, Service Consumption, and Manage Portfolios domains.
   

  

 Build and schedule operational reports and Performance Analytics widgets covering CMDB Health %, Hardware Normalization %, Asset Refresh due, Stockroom inventory, and Audit findings.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 3\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow/others administration with at least 2 years on HAM and/or CMDB.
   

  

 Demonstrated working knowledge of HAM lifecycle states, asset/model/category data model, stockrooms, transfer orders, purchase orders, receiving slips, asset bundles, and disposal orders.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB tables, CI classes, and CSDM concepts.
   

  

 Hands\-on with IRE identification rules, reconciliation rules, and at least one duplicate\-CI deduplication exercise.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB Health (Completeness, Compliance, Correctness) and dashboard remediation.
   

  

 ITIL v4 process awareness\-Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management, Service Request.
   

  

 Import Sets/Transform Maps fundamentals; ability to read JavaScript/Glide script for basic edits.
   

  

 Strong written and oral communication in English; ability to run client status calls.
   

  

 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

 ServiceNow Modules
   

  

 HAM, HAM Pro, ITAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM, Performance Analytics, Mobile Agent, CMDB Workspace, Hardware Asset Workspace, Now Assist for ITAM (awareness).
   

  

 Educational Qualification:
   

  

 15 years of full\-time education
   

  

 Flexible to work in any shift, including rotational shifts, based on business requirements

title: IAM Operations Analyst
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**IAM Operations Analyst \- Application \& Tool Support**
 Today’s world is fuelled by vast amounts of information, which means that data is even more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and therefore everyone in EY Information Security has an important role to play. Join a global team of almost 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond when things go wrong. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.
   

  

 Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defence, application security and technology service solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security\-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through secure solutions and information systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Identity and Access Management (IAM) organization, a part of Information Security, enables over 330,000 individuals across 140\+ countries to access systems and information securely. As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for, a complex Active Directory (AD) environment, hybrid cloud deployment, mobile computing, policy driven security, SSO, identity lifecycle management, and federation focusing on multiple protocols.
   

  

 We offer opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career receiving support, coaching and feedback from colleagues around the world. This role will give you an opportunity to work with some of the best talent in the industry!
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* The IAM Application \& Tool Support Analyst is responsible to support and maintain internal IAM Applications and Tools in an efficient, secure manner. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, providing enhanced support services for users and groups across various platforms, including Microsoft Active Directory, Azure/Entra ID and Exchange using SailPoint IIQ, AADC, Shared Folder Management Tool, PowerShell Scripts, MS Power platform and other supporting technologies.
* Act as second and third tier (Levels 2 \+ 3\) technical support for end\-user inquiries and issues; effectively resolving or escalating incidents and problems related to identity and access management services implemented across multiple environments and technology platforms.
* Establish and maintain data governance standards to ensure data quality, integrity, consistency, and compliance across reporting and analytics platforms. Continuously identify opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency by leveraging AI, automation, data insights, documented business rules and reporting logic to implement solutions supporting best practices that enable scalable and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using MS Power platform, Excel, AI and other reporting tools. Analyse large datasets to identify trends, risks, exceptions, and opportunities for process improvement. Transform business requirements into meaningful data visualizations and actionable insights. Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities to ensure reporting accuracy.
* Conduct operation\-level troubleshooting activities to identify and implement efficient incident resolution action that minimizes end user and/or system downtime.
* Conduct proper root cause analysis and make recommendations to improve IAM processes or prevent future occurrence of end user access issues.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Moderate analytical skills are required to probe for understanding and appropriately address IAM user and group management issues in a hybrid environment.
* Good understanding of Windows File share access management and access control.
* Ability to make sound decisions in addressing end\-user’s access and other security related issues and to recommend improvements to address security issues or gaps.
* Making general decisions without guidance and direction in problem solving following best practices based upon a solid knowledge of the IAM functions, processes and procedures.
* Driving the priority and time management of own efforts to support/resolve assigned activities and communicate results and findings to end users and management as necessary.


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* Advanced knowledge and experience in Microsoft Active Directory user and group management. Basic knowledge of MS Azure/Entra ID, AADC, Exchange/Outlook, Windows File Share access and Sailpoint (OneAccess) technologies integrated with automated user/group provisioning to effectively provide enhanced IAM support.
* Advanced knowledge of EY’s desktop environment (PC applications, standard software, mobile devices, Telephony, network, servers and general connectivity) as well as security access functions provided by Information Security
* Knowledge of Data Analytics, Reporting, and Dashboard Development with experience using MS Power Platform, Excel, and related technologies to support business decision\-making, operational reporting, and audit requirements for identity data.
* Experience in developing and supporting business solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI), with the ability to leverage AI, automate processes, improve operational efficiency, and deliver data\-driven solutions for stakeholders.
* Time management skills to prioritize workload and work through assignments and activities with efficiency and minimal supervision
* Basic consultative skill to effectively questioning and conduct core issue analysis, select and apply appropriate standards, methods, tools and applications to independently resolve complex incidents and problems.
* Solid advanced interpersonal skills to deals effectively with individual, group, or situational conflicts through direct interaction with end users. Able to support peers within IT teams in collaborative activities as well as effectively support training and mentoring assignments to IAM Administrators and others as needed.
* Strong oral communication skills in the English language to work effectively with end users and IT peers.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Approximately 3 to 5 years of Security Administration or Identity Provisioning experience in support of IT products or security administration and working knowledge of large IT organization operations.


**What We Look For**
 We’re looking for someone who can collaborate globally with different regions and cultures. Problem\-solves, thinks creatively and has an open mind to new insights. Focus on customer service and building positive relationships with colleagues both across teams and globally. A highly motivated, diligent, and driven individual who seeks development and improvement opportunities and deliver quality services.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.
   

  

 EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client\-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Benefits**

* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work\-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career \& Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.


**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

  

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

 Full\-Time

 The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of computers, networking infrastructure, internet connectivity, CCTV, biometric systems, printers, servers, and other IT\-enabled systems.

* Monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, routers, switches, access points, and other networking equipment.

* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and networking vendors for service\-related problems.

* Ensure proper network access and connectivity across classrooms, offices, laboratories, and other facilities.

* Maintain records of service calls, complaints, downtime, and resolution status.

 7\. Backup \& Data Management
 


* Assist in maintaining regular backups of important institutional data.
* Monitor backup status and report any failure or data\-access issue immediately.

 8\. MIS \& Reporting
 


* Prepare regular IT status reports for management.
* Maintain records of complaints, resolutions, downtime, maintenance, and pending issues.

* Maintain proper documentation of all IT\-related activities.

* Timely preventive maintenance of IT infrastructure.
* Accuracy and regular updating of IT asset registers.
* Timely coordination and follow\-up with service providers.
* Reduction in recurring technical issues and downtime.

 .

 Skyhigh Security Is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you.  We are on these too! Follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter@SkyhighSecurity.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Consultant in the Skyhigh Customer Value team, you will play a critical role in ensuring customers maximize the value of our solutions. You will guide customers through their product adoption journey, ensuring seamless deployment, integration, and continuous optimization. This role will develop deep relationships with our largest customers and complete the technical onboarding process for our smaller customers. By leveraging your technical expertise and customer\-centric approach, you will drive operational success, best\-practice adoption, and long\-term customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Technical Consultants directly guide our customers throughout their product adoption journey, ensuring they achieve their security and network transformation goals.
   

  

**Deployment and Execution**
* Implement SWG, CASB, ZTNA, DLP, and other SSE security solutions based on the Solution Architect’s design.
* Configure security policies, user access controls, and enterprise integrations.
* Perform policy migration and optimization to ensure compliance and best practices.
* Conduct pilot testing, UAT, and final production rollout.
* Deliver technical training and enablement to customer teams to effectively manage the product.


**Customer Engagement \& Support**
* Provide ongoing technical guidance and troubleshooting support for complex issues.
* Lead best practice workshops and enablement sessions to upskill customer teams.
* Provide continuous education and coaching to customers on existing and new features to ensure they maximize the value of the solution.
* Provide context and help to the Support team to ensure that service requests are addressed and effectively communicated to the customer.
* Manage and escalate customer concerns internally when necessary.


**Customer Adoption \& Expansion**
* Act as the technical point of contact post\-deployment, ensuring customers fully adopt, optimize, and expand their SSE solution.
* Monitor solution performance, adoption and provide proactive recommendations to improve efficiency, security, and compliance.
* Participate in business reviews and conduct technical health checks to track progress and address gaps.
* Identify opportunities for expansion by assessing additional use cases, security.
* Assist with change management and internal advocacy within customer teams to drive long\-term adoption.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Manager, Sales, and Product teams to align solutions with customer objectives.


**Documentation, Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement**
* Document deployment procedures, configuration settings, and optimization strategies.
* Contribute to the internal knowledge base for Professional Services and TAM best practices.
* Mentor and coach other Technical Consultants and Technical Account Managers to enhance team expertise.
* Contribute to internal knowledge\-sharing initiatives, training programs, and best practice discussions.
* Provide feedback on customer pain points and feature requests to Product and Engineering teams.
* Stay up to date with industry security trends, emerging threats, and SSE product advancements.


**Background And Experience Required For a Technical Consultant**
* 7 to 10\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Technical Consultant, Solution Architect, Technical Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or similar).
* Ready to work on permanent EST shift
* Strong background in network security, cloud security, and SSE/SASE solutions.
* Experience with firewalls, proxies, CASB, DLP, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and SWG (Secure Web Gateway).
* Proficiency in network protocols, authentication mechanisms, and security frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with a customer\-first mindset.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for various audiences.
* Experience coaching and training customers to use technical products effectively.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts while prioritizing key customer needs.
* It would be great if you also have the following, but they are not required:
* Industry certifications such as CCNA Security, Comptia security\+, AWS/Azure Security, CCSK/CCSP or CISSP.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and managing multi\-region
* deployments.
* Experience working with PSA tools (Open Air, Financial Force etc.).
* Customer Value Career Path

title: L2 Support Engineer - Managed Services
description:
Role Summary
   

  

 The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End\-to\-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3\-tier and cloud\-native environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.
* Configure and fine\-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.
* Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.
* Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third\-party dependency, in both 3\-tier and cloud\-native (microservices/containerized) environments.
* Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.
* Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.
* Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.
* Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto\-remediation triggers, ticket auto\-creation).
* Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.
* Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).
* Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.
* Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Observability Platform Skills
   

  

* 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1\-2 years working hands\-on with Datadog.
* Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service\-level troubleshooting.
* Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).
* APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.
* Synthetics: designing multi\-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.
* RUM: correlating front\-end performance and errors with backend traces.
* Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log\-based metrics.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.
* Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.


 Application and Architecture Understanding
   

  

* Solid understanding of 3\-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter\-service communication patterns.
* Ability to correlate application\-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.
* Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).
* Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.
* Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.
* Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.
* Comfortable leading discussions during high\-pressure major incidents.
* Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


 Work Details
   

  

* Level: L2 (Mid\-level, Managed Services)
* Shift: 24x7 rotational shifts, with on\-call/escalation coverage as needed
* Reporting To: L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead


 Interested can reach us at \+91 7305206696/ saranyadevib@talentien.com

* Coordinate disaster recovery activities, recovery validation, and periodic failover testing.

* Participate in production support, major incident resolution, and after\-hours support as required by the operating model.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience with SailPoint application integration, connector configuration, application onboarding, and identity lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience administering enterprise SailPoint environments and supporting production operations.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, particularly Oracle Linux and RHEL.
* Hands\-on experience with Tomcat administration, JVM tuning, log analysis, certificate management, file systems, and cron scheduling.
* Experience remediating infrastructure and application vulnerabilities using OCI Security Scanning, Tenable, Qualys, or comparable platforms.

* Integration experience with HR systems, Active Directory/LDAP, SAP, MDM, WMS, and SaaS applications through standard connectors, APIs, or secure file interfaces.
* Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and production\-support skills.


 Education \& Certification

* Additional Linux, cloud, security, ITIL, or IAM certifications are advantageous.


**Preferred Technical Exposure**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Linux shell scripting, REST APIs, web services, JDBC, SCIM, and directory integrations.
* Monitoring, ticketing, source control, CI/CD, and enterprise change\-management tools.

* Risk awareness and disciplined change execution.

* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and operational resilience.

description:

 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries and 46\+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content.  Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
 



  





 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands\-on, execution\-focused role responsible for the successful implementation, deployment, and operational handover of core IT infrastructure projects across Cyncly’s global environment.
 



  





 This position focuses on the Infrastructure Project and Operations—taking infrastructure designs and turning them into stable, secure, and scalable production systems. The Engineer will primarily be involved in configuring, deploying, and optimizing solutions encompassing cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), network systems, servers, storage, and virtualization technologies. A strong background in project execution and rigorous adherence to best practices and security standards is essential for success.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Infrastructure Delivery \& Deployment** 




  




* Execute and deliver complex infrastructure projects, ensuring solutions are deployed successfully, on time, within budget, and adhere to technical specifications.

**Support and Documentation** 




  




* Provide L3\-L4 troubleshooting and technical expertise to resolve complex, escalated infrastructure issues and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
* Maintain comprehensive and accurate documentation of all infrastructure configurations, deployment procedures, and support guides.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in infrastructure and cloud engineering.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

* In\-depth, hands\-on experience with:
* Cloud Platforms: Configuration and deployment within Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Server Administration: Expertise in both Windows Server and Linux operating systems.
* Virtualization: Proven experience with platforms like VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper\-V.
* Networking: Strong understanding of network protocols, routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall management.

* Knowledge of DevOps principles, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, methodologies.
* Experience in supporting backup and disaster recovery solutions.



  





**Working for us:** 




 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
 



  





 Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
 



  





 We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
 



  





 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop\-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well\-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands\-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Participate in site\-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift\-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge\-to\-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time\-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine\-to\-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long\-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time\-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time\-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi\-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443\.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third\-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node\-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.

title: Logistics & Freight Manager
description:
**About Origin**
 Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general\-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi\-trade platform combines purpose\-built hardware with real\-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high\-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%\+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent\-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Logistics \& Freight Manager will build and run Origin's global import and export operations to enable production as per the manufacturing plan and the movement of finished robots to live construction sites across the countries in Pipeline. The role owns end\-to\-end freight execution across air, ocean, and in\-land modes — inbound components, sub\-assemblies, and capital equipment from suppliers across India, China, Taiwan, South\-East Asia, the US, and Europe; outbound robots, spares, and RMA units to customer sites and overseas entities. It also owns the customs, documentation, and trade compliance layer beneath both flows, along with forwarder and customs\-broker management, freight rate negotiation, and freight spend. This role acts as the commercial and compliance bridge between Supply Chain, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Production, Finance, and the US deployment team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end import operations — shipment planning, booking, document validation, customs clearance, and final delivery to plant or warehouse — for components, sub\-assemblies, tooling, and capital equipment
* Own end\-to\-end export operations including shipping bill filing, certificates of origin, and destination\-specific certification for US and other markets
* Manage customs clearance through CHA partners — bill of entry filing, duty assessment, examination, out\-of\-charge — and drive clearance cycle time to under 3 days from document handover, with zero avoidable holds
* Own HS classification for all BOM items and finished goods; maintain a governed, auditable classification master and ensure correct duty determination (BCD, IGST, cess, anti\-dumping, FTA preferential rates with valid origin documentation)
* Maintain regulatory registrations and filings — IEC, AD Code registration at all working ports and ICDs, DGFT and ICEGATE transactions, licences and authorisations — and keep an audit\-ready record set for every consignment
* Evaluate and administer duty\-saving and deferment schemes — Advance Authorisation, EPCG, MOOWR bonded manufacturing, RoDTEP, duty drawback — and track benefit realised against entitlement
* Own dangerous goods movement for lithium\-ion battery packs and battery\-powered equipment — UN 38\.3 test summaries, IATA DGR and IMDG documentation, packing instructions, and DG\-certified forwarder selection
* Define export packaging and crating standards for high\-value, fragile, and oversized equipment — lashing, shock and tilt indicators, moisture protection — and drive zero transit damage on robot dispatches
* Build and manage the partner panel across all modes — 3\-5 evaluated freight forwarders, customs house agents, transporters, and courier partners per mode — through structured RFQs, rate benchmarking, and negotiated rate cards, contracts, and SLAs
* Drive freight cost optimization (15\-20% opportunity) through consolidation, mode shift, lane redesign, packaging optimization, and duty\-scheme utilization, with savings quantified and validated with Finance
* Maintain a live shipment tracker, lead\-time master, and logistics risk dashboard — lane, port, carrier, regulatory, and geopolitical exposure — with alternate routing and backup partners identified for every critical lane
* Implement forwarder and CHA performance scorecards (on\-time performance, clearance turnaround, documentation accuracy, damage rate, billing hygiene) and run quarterly business reviews
* Manage cargo insurance coverage and drive damage, shortage, and loss claims to closure
* Write and maintain SOPs, escalation matrices, and checklists; support the scale\-up to 200 units per year without logistics appearing as a cause of build or deployment schedule slip


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce, or a related field
* 4\-8 years of experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or shipper\-side EXIM operations
* Hands\-on ownership of both import and export operations — not one side only — with demonstrated experience across all three modes: air, ocean, and in\-land freight
* Strong working knowledge of Indian customs procedure and documentation — bill of entry and shipping bill filing, HS classification, duty structure, ICEGATE, and Incoterms 2020
* Proven track record of negotiating freight rates and managing forwarder, CHA, and transporter relationships across multiple lanes
* Hands\-on global lane exposure (mandatory exposure beyond India — China and US preferred)
* Working knowledge of trade compliance obligations — licences, registrations, product certification, and audit requirements
* Ability to build and defend a freight and landed\-cost model in Excel or Google Sheets, and to run the function from data rather than instinct
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the confidence to escalate and negotiate with carriers, brokers, and customs authorities


**Preferred Experience**
* Previous experience in logistics or EXIM at Automobiles, Electric Vehicles, Automation, Industrial Equipment, Capital Goods, Robotics, Drones, or Aerospace organizations
* Experience shipping dangerous goods, particularly lithium\-ion batteries, and handling over\-dimensional or high\-value cargo
* Familiarity with duty\-saving and bonded schemes — MOOWR, EPCG, Advance Authorisation, SEZ, or FTWZ operations
* Exposure to China, Taiwan, South\-East Asia, US, and EU trade lanes and their supplier ecosystems
* Exposure to ERP or logistics management systems (SAP, Oracle, Zoho, Odoo, Tally) and shipment visibility platforms
* Certification such as CHA, IATA DGR, CSCP, or an equivalent trade\-compliance qualification
* Comfortable with low\-volume / high\-mix shipping rhythm and startup environments where the process has to be built, not inherited


**Preferred Skills**
* Freight rate benchmarking and negotiation
* Customs documentation and HS classification
* Multi\-modal routing and mode\-shift analysis
* Trade compliance and duty\-scheme management
* Dangerous goods and export packaging standards
* Landed\-cost and freight spend modeling
* Logistics risk management and contingency planning
* Vendor score carding and quarterly business reviews
* Strong Excel and data management skills

title: Global Treasury Operations, Manager
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 An experienced individual for our Markets Operations who demonstrates subject matter expertise in one or more responsibilities of the operation that includes the execution of Global Treasury investment portfolio and/or liability management related workflows, supports Funding and Collateral Transformation products in line with market deadlines and internal SLAs. The individual works independently with regard to accomplishing responsibilities, strives to provide excellent client service and supports Risk Excellence culture of State Street. The individual should possess extensive knowledge and experience on securities, settlements, rates, treasury products, and related financial attributes. Will require to work closely with Business teams, Functional teams, Business Risk, Compliance and Technology teams on day\-to\-day basis to ensure seamless BAU. A large element of the role is transformation of the function, from operating model changes to a new technology infrastructure to reduce risk, create efficiency and improve service delivery. The role will be needed to drive the transformation whilst remaining focused on BAU so as to not compromise on service.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of State Street. As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high\-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data\-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client\-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 As an Officer you will
   

  

* Liaise with front office, compliance, finance, claims, and IT teams to support the full trade lifecycle.
* Responsible for Markets participation in programs such as ISO 20022, TD\+1, and other bank wide initiatives.
* Provide Trade Support for Asset Management and Liability Management teams of Global Treasury
* Actively participate in the Peer Repo project and implementation
* Monitor exception reporting and provide necessary insight on resolution
* Monitor derivative and investment portfolio valuations and report on exceptions
* Investigate recon variances and provide root cause analysis
* Provide trade support and static data set up for Funding and Collateral Transformation team
* Monitor and perform collateral management functions in accordance with approved policies and procedures
* Oversee daily activities and help junior team members with subject matter expertise, trainings and understanding the core business operations
* Proposes and works to implement workflow changes, leading to improved productivity
* Work directly with the business and other Global Treasury stakeholders to provide information and/or operational solutions as needed
* Work proactively on updating job aids and procedures, making sure that team is adhering to the newly adopted processes
* Support the “Risk Excellence” culture within the business
* Work well with all GTO members and GT/GM stakeholders as demonstrated by being responsive to requests, striving for excellent client service
* Execute Funds \& Securities Transfers for Repo/Reverse Repo activities.
* Perform or approve cash/GL processing.
* Take a leadership role in broader based projects as a subject matter expert.
* Responsible for KRI/Operating Metrics reporting and other overarching team related responsibilities.
* Focus on the control environment to drive a strong risk \& control culture across the global teams to ensure processes are robust \& compliant.
* Partner with Technology and partake in Markets Operations to deliver a best\-in\-class E2E workflow solution, removing manual touchpoints and increasing STP
* Support applicable Change the Bank and Run the Bank Projects impacting the team, from inception; providing SME support, testing and monitoring into Production.
* Ensure vendor oversight and hold them accountable to high standards of delivery. Stay abreast of all regulatory and market changes and ensure adherence and no impact to service standards as a result of these changes.
* Partner with ERM and compliance colleagues globally to ensure Markets Operations remains disciplined with respect to adherence to resiliency strategy, control assurance etc.
* Support audits and ensure adherence to operational risk and compliance policies.
* High level of personal commitment to each task, can\-do attitude, and a drive to deliver.
* Proactive approach to problem solving, delivering results and finding better ways.


**What We Value**
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
   

  

* Strong risk mitigation, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Ability to think critically and resolve complex problems
* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency
* Stay updated on industry regulations and best practices related to FX Confirmation, Settlement operations.


**What You'll Bring To The Role**
* Front\-to\-back knowledge of the Treasury product related Confirmation, Settlement, systems, markets and instruments
* Hands\-on experience in managing FICC, NSCC, Repo, reverse repo, DTC and FED settlements
* Working knowledge in Settlement/Payment department \& understanding payment life cycle
* Familiarity with systems such as Markitwire, Summit, In\-trader, MCH, Hogan , IBS, Bloomberg, FXALL, SWIFT


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce
* Good knowledge in Back\-office confirmations and settlement
* Knowledge of Global Markets, custody, cash management and payment systems
* Good Communication Skills both written and oral
* 10\+ years of experience in Treasury/Investment operations/Financial Services industry


**Additional Requirements**
* Knowledge of Macros, Artificial intelligence, Automation tool etc
* Shift Timings: NAM \- 6pm to 3am IST
* Persona: 4 days' work from office

Join us in shaping the future.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.
