title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Production Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kanakapura. This role oversees daily production operations to ensure output meets quality, safety, and delivery standards. Responsibilities include organizing and monitoring production schedules, coordinating resources and materials, and aligning team activities with production plans. The Production Supervisor guides and supports production staff, conducts shift briefings, resolves operational issues, and enforces safety and compliance procedures. The role also involves tracking performance metrics, identifying process improvements, and collaborating with management to meet production targets and optimize efficiency.
 



  





**Job Summary** 

  
 




  





 The Production Supervisor will oversee daily operations of the offset printing and packaging department, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and safety protocols are met. This role involves managing shop\-floor staff, coordinating with other departments, and driving continuous improvement in press and packaging operations.
 
  
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 

  
 




**Production Planning \& Execution** 

  
 



* Plan, schedule, and supervise daily offset printing and packaging operations to meet production targets and delivery deadlines.
* Allocate manpower, machines, and materials efficiently across shifts.
* Monitor job progress and resolve bottlenecks in press runs, finishing, and packing lines.



  





**Quality Control** 

  
 



* Ensure printed and packaged products meet quality standards (color accuracy, registration, finishing, packaging integrity).
* Conduct regular quality checks and coordinate with QC teams to minimize rejections and rework.
* Investigate quality complaints and implement corrective actions.



**Team Supervision** 

  
 



* Supervise, train, and motivate press operators, packaging staff, and helpers.
* Assign duties, monitor performance, and conduct shift briefings.
* Manage attendance, discipline, and performance evaluations of team members.



  





**Machine \& Process Management** 

  
 



* Oversee offset press operations (e.g., sheet\-fed/web offset), die\-cutting, folding, binding, and packaging equipment.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules with the maintenance team to reduce downtime.
* Optimize processes to reduce waste, material costs, and cycle time.



  





**Safety \& Compliance** 

  
 



* Enforce workplace safety standards and ensure proper use of PPE.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, ISO standards, and statutory regulations.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard\-free production floor (5S practices).



**Reporting \& Coordination** 

  
 



* Maintain production records, downtime logs, and shift reports.
* Coordinate with planning, procurement, design/pre\-press, and dispatch teams for smooth workflow.
* Report daily/weekly production output, efficiency, and issues to management.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 



* Diploma/Degree in Printing Technology, Graphic Arts, Packaging Technology, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of offset press operations, pre\-press workflow, and post\-press/packaging processes.
* Familiarity with color management, ink/substrate properties, and finishing techniques (lamination, die\-cutting, folding, gluing).



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 

  
 




  




* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities on the shop floor.
* Knowledge of production planning and lean manufacturing/5S practices.
* Basic computer skills (MS Office, ERP/production software).
* Effective communication skills for cross\-department coordination.
* Ability to work in shifts and handle production pressure.



  





**Working Conditions** 

  
 



* Factory/shop\-floor environment; may require standing for extended periods.
* Rotational shift work, including weekends/holidays as per production needs.

description:
**Who are we looking for**

The Global Head of Cross\-product Operations within Markets Operations is responsible for activities and shared services supporting State Street Markets and Global Treasury businesses. The role partners across business lines, product\-aligned Markets Operations teams, Global Delivery, Technology, and Corporate functions to deliver scalable operational services that support business growth, risk management, and strategic priorities.

  

The role oversees key product\-agnostic functions including


* **Regulatory Reporting \-** Leads the global regulatory reporting function, ensuring accurate, timely, and complete trade and transaction reporting across jurisdictions and products. Drives regulatory compliance, control enhancement, and reporting transformation through process optimization and technology enablement.
* **Collateral Management \-** Oversees the global collateral management function, including margin processing, dispute management, collateral settlements, and reconciliations across financing and derivatives products. Ensures effective counterparty risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence through robust controls and process efficiency.
* **Static Data** / **DBM** \- Provides strategic oversight of client and counterparty reference data, account setup, settlement instructions (SSI), and data governance across Markets Operations. Ensures data integrity, operational scalability, and seamless support for trade processing, settlement, and regulatory obligations.

Driving operational excellence, consistency, scalability, and strong risk and control practices across Markets Operations.

  

The Global Head of Cross\-product Operations will lead teams across India, other global hubs, and co\-trading locations, and will be a member of the Markets Operations Management Group, reporting directly to the Global Head of Markets \& Treasury Operations and Client Onboarding.

  

**Why is this role important to us**

The Cross\-product Operations team plays a critical role in the success of State Street Markets and Global Treasury by providing shared operational services that support business growth, operational excellence, and effective risk management.

  

The Head of Cross\-product Operations is responsible for driving consistency, scalability, and operational excellence across key product\-agnostic functions, while strengthening risk and control practices, enhancing operational resilience, and supporting the evolving needs of the business.

  

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to deliver operational efficiencies, foster a strong risk and control environment, and build scalable solutions that support future growth and regulatory change.

  

**What will you be responsible for**

As the Global Head of Cross\-product Operations, you will be responsible for delivering seamless, efficient, and scalable post\-trade operational support across Regulatory Reporting, Collateral Management, and Static Data for State Street Markets and Global Treasury businesses.

  

The role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for Cross\-product Operations and ensuring the organization continues to evolve through operational excellence, process optimization, technology enablement, automation, and strong risk management. The successful candidate will lead global teams across locations, drive consistency and scalability across shared services, and ensure the operating model remains aligned to business growth, regulatory requirements, and client needs.

  

* Lead and oversee the Regulatory Reporting, Collateral Management, and Static Data functions across Markets Operations.

* Collaborate with Global Delivery, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other Corporate functions to proactively resolve issues, drive organizational effectiveness, and deliver sustainable solutions.
* Establish and maintain a robust risk and control framework, ensuring effective risk identification, mitigation, operational resilience, business continuity, and compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.
* Monitor operational performance through meaningful KPIs, KRIs, governance forums, and management reporting to drive informed decision\-making and accountability.
* Champion a culture of risk excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across the organization.
  

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* 18\+ years of leadership experience in capital markets, operations, risk management, finance, or a related discipline.
* Deep expertise in capital markets products, post\-trade operations, operational risk, regulatory reporting, and related operating models.
* Demonstrated success leading large global teams and delivering operational excellence in complex financial services environments.
* Proven track record of strengthening risk and control environments and managing regulatory and operational risk.

title: Operations Associate — Fleet Manager
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**Location**: Bengaluru (On\-site) \+ multi\-city coordination  

  

**Instawork Robotics Lab (IRL)**  

  

Robots are getting smarter, but they still can’t reliably do the everyday physical tasks people do — chopping vegetables, stocking shelves, assembling parts. The bottleneck is data. UC Berkeley’s Prof. Ken Goldberg calls it the “100,000\-year data gap”: the chasm between the massive text datasets used to train language models and the tiny amount of real\-world, physical\-dexterity data available to train robots. The entire robotics industry collected only \~100,000 hours of training data in 2024 and \~1 million in 2025 — and even the \~20 million hours projected for 2026 is still less than 0\.04% of what is ultimately needed. IRL exists to close that gap. Using Instacore — a wearable multi\-camera and sensor system (head, chest, and wrist cameras plus IMUs and a compute pack) — our field teams capture synchronized, high\-diversity egocentric data of real people doing real tasks across real commercial environments: kitchens, warehouses, hotels, retail, and light manufacturing. That data is quality\-checked, anonymized, and delivered to the world’s leading robotics companies and foundation\-model labs to teach robots how to operate in the messy physical world. In India, we run the on\-ground engine of this mission — a growing fleet of Instacore rigs, Field Officers and Data Collectors, regional hubs, and the operations and finance backbone that keeps it all running at quality and scale.  

  

**Role Overview**  

  

The Operations Associate – Fleet Manager keeps the Instacore fleet moving. You own visibility and control over where every rig is, what condition it is in, and whether it is ready to record — making sure faulty rigs get back to the hubs fast, SD cards are rotated and fully accounted for, and Field Officers have the travel and logistics they need to be in the right place at the right time. When the fleet flows, recordings flow — and closing the data gap depends on it.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

1\. Fleet Tracking — Maintain a live, accurate view of every rig across cities and hubs (deployed, in\-transit, idle, faulty, in\-repair), tracked at serial\-number level.  

2\. Faulty Rig Recovery — Ensure faulty rigs are pulled from the field and returned to hubs quickly; coordinate with QC / Hardware for repair or replacement; minimize downtime and idle assets.  

3\. SD Card Rotation — Manage the SD\-card pool end to end: issue, collect, track, and rotate cards so data is offloaded promptly and clean cards are always available in the field; prevent loss.  

4\. Travel Desk Coordination — Work closely with the travel desk to arrange Field Officer bookings, travel, and accommodation so deployments happen on time and cost\-effectively.  

5\. Hub \& Inter\-City Coordination — Coordinate inbound/outbound movement of rigs between hubs and field; ensure the right rigs reach the right cities to match the pipeline.  

6\. Loss \& Reconciliation — Run daily reconciliation of rigs and SD cards; follow up relentlessly on overdue or missing assets; escalate cleanly when needed.  

7\. Reporting — Share daily fleet status (working / faulty / idle counts, in\-transit, recovery TAT) with ops leadership; keep trackers current in Google Sheets.  

8\. Cross\-Functional Work — Partner with ICs/FOs, Inventory, QC/Hardware, and the Travel desk to remove blockers and keep utilization high.  

  

**Skills \& Requirements**  

  

**Mandatory**  

  

* 0–3 years in operations, logistics, fleet, or inventory coordination
* Strong tracking discipline; comfortable with Google Sheets (filters, lookups, basic formulas)
* High ownership and follow\-through; able to coordinate across many people and teams at once
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, on\-ground operations environment

  

**Preferred**  

  

* Experience with asset / inventory / serialized\-device tracking or field logistics
* Experience coordinating travel or vendor logistics

  

**Personal Qualities**  

Organized · Proactive · Relentless follow\-up · Calm under pressure · Ownership mindset**Our Values**


* **Empathy, Trust \& Candor**  

We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* **Bias for Action**  

We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* **Always Be Learning**  

We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* **Act Like an Owner**  

We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**



Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!



Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.



Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.  

  

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

The Site Operations role not only provides administrative and coordination support but also helps advance key site priorities through a focus on leadership effectiveness, strategic alignment, and organizational health advancing global initiatives and translating them at the ground level in consultation with the local R\&D Lead Team.

 **Your Responsibilities: \-**

 **Strategic Partnership \& Site Leadership**

* Serve as strategic advisor and thought partner to the R\&D Site Lead \& Lead Team shaping how strategic initiatives translate into concrete site\-level action
* Partner with the leadership team and enable the site's strategic planning and prioritization efforts by facilitating discussions, tracking key initiatives, and helping ensure leadership attention is directed toward critical priorities
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions and support business case development for strategic site capabilities, including opportunities to enhance IAC’s role as an AI hub within the R\&D, partnering on the AI COP
* Build and sustain direct working partnerships with R\&D executive and functional lead team members, acting as a trusted point of contact on their behalf for site\-level priorities, cross\-functional dependencies, and follow\-through

**Executive Communications \& Organizational Narrative**

* Provide support and enable successful delivery of flagship site events such as R\&D Connect Week —from theme and content architecture through post\-event communications to the larger audiences (internal \& external)
* Facilitate and support senior leadership engagement initiatives including townhalls, and speaker preparation
* Provide communications support for the Site Lead by helping craft executive briefings, leader emails, and broader site communications that are impactful, engaging, and people\-centric
* Build and protect a consistent communications narrative that ties site activity back to a central R\&D theme across the year

**Organizational Health**

* Work closely with the HSE Lead and team, providing coordination and operational support while acting as an integral member of the team.
* Champion site culture enhancement ideas that include employee engagement initiatives, cross\-functional team building activities, and serving as the R\&D ERG Liaison in partnership with the EBS ERG Leadership.
* Lead organizational change management (OCM) on site, through major transitions, pairing structured process with communication that helps people make sense of what's changing and why
* Partner with R\&D Lead Team to collate talent advancement and the STA (short\-term assignment) pipeline for talent across the site

**Governance, Project \& Team Leadership**

* Project manage operational initiatives to delivery representing the local R\&D Lead Team and global functional leaders
* Schedule and facilitate R\&D Lead Team meetings, floor initiatives and cross\-functional governance forums, capture minutes, key decisions \+ action points
* Own the site's project portfolio dashboard and reporting cadence for leadership and global stakeholders
* Maintain oversight of site operations (logistics, visitor and delegate management, calendar and travel support for visiting leaders), ensuring consistent quality and timeliness
* Potentially own and execute site\-based projects

 **What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

  

* Minimum 10\+ Years of relevant experience working in a global environment or supporting a global environment, specifically in animal/human health R\&D

 **What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

  

* Proven experience operating as a strategic partner to leaders in a global, matrixed organization
* Executive presence and the discretion to handle highly confidential, sensitive matters
* Exceptional written communication — able to write convincingly and authentically
* Track record of driving execution across functions without formal authority
* Comfort leading through ambiguity and building structure or governance where none previously existed

 **Additional Information:**

  

* Based in Bangalore, India, at the IAC site, expected to complete 30 days/Quarter of in\-office presence.
* Frequent partnership with global, cross\-time\-zone stakeholders across the US and Europe
* Proficiency across the MS Office suite; comfortable adopting AI and new\-age content tools

title: Senior Manager, Operations Management
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Are you a passionate and results\-driven professional eager to ensure the highest quality in software products? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Operations Management, responsible for leading testing initiatives and providing both technical expertise.  

7EDGE is a Digital Product Engineering Company based in Bengaluru, India. Our core expertise lies in crafting modern applications with cloud\-native services, specializing in microservices and serverless architecture tailored to the requirements of enterprises and startups alike. We deliver unparalleled solutions to industries and companies across the globe. As the company is expanding rapidly, we are looking to grow our Operations Management by hiring talented individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to our success.  

In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise and problem\-solving skills to:* Own consolidated P\&L — gross margin, revenue realisation, and billable utilisation — across multiple business units simultaneously.
* Govern revenue mix across BUs, actively managing concentration risk and holding each BU lead accountable to revenue commitments and GTM plans.
* Translate annual business goals into measurable OKRs for diverse direct reports and govern achievement throughout the year.
* Lead technology delivery teams — defining structure, driving outcome\-based delivery, and leveraging AI to improve team productivity.
* Develop and empower direct reports who are themselves managers, through coaching, delegation, and succession planning.
* Communicate business performance — including underperformance and recovery plans — proactively and directly to the CEO and leadership.


This role presents a valuable opportunity to apply your technical expertise in leading high\-impact projects, while also contributing to the professional growth of your team. If you are ready to take on this dynamic and fulfilling position, we encourage you to submit your application.  

RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Performance \& P\&L Ownership* Own consolidated business performance across multiple BUs or delivery functions — directly accountable for gross margin targets, revenue realisation, and billable utilisation.
* Build and maintain a real\-time system for monitoring financial health across all functions simultaneously.
* Identify margin or revenue risks early — before they become critical — and take corrective action with speed.
* Produce consolidated P\&L reports and present them to the CEO and senior leadership with confidence and specificity.


Revenue Diversification \& Multi\-BU Governance* Govern revenue mix across multiple BUs — actively managing concentration risk and driving healthy diversification.
* Hold per\-BU leads accountable to revenue commitments and go\-to\-market plans through structured governance cadences.
* Lead technology delivery teams with direct accountability for their structure, performance, and outcomes.
* Drive the shift from effort\-based to outcome\-based delivery and leverage AI to improve team and delivery productivity.


Annual Aspiration Translation \& OKR Governance* Translate annual business plans and company goals into measurable OKRs for diverse direct reports across functions.
* Facilitate both top\-down goal cascading and bottom\-up alignment throughout the year.
* Report goal status honestly to CEO and leadership — including when things are off track — and present proactive recovery plans.
* Maintain a regular review cadence that keeps all direct reports aligned to annual commitments.


People Leadership \& Empowerment* Lead through direct reports — not around them. Set clear goals, delegate with genuine freedom, and stay connected without micromanaging.
* Involve the team in key decisions before finalising, especially where they hold more detail than you do.
* Develop direct reports through regular coaching, in\-the\-moment feedback, and structured growth plans.
* Maintain succession plans for critical roles and build trust across both delivery and operations functions.


Accountability, Resilience \& Communication* Take full personal ownership of outcomes — flag problems proactively, always with a recovery plan in hand.
* Stay composed under pressure and stabilise the team rather than passing stress downward.
* Communicate hard truths clearly and directly to the CEO and direct reports without softening the message.
* Build a team environment where problems are raised early — not hidden — through psychological safety and trust.

  

REPORTING LINE* You will be reporting to the CEO.

  

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS* 8\+ years of experience in operations or business management.
* Demonstrated ownership of P\&L — revenue and gross margin — across more than one business unit or delivery function simultaneously.
* Direct reports who are themselves managers leading their own teams (not individual contributors).
* Experience governing 2 or more functions simultaneously, each with different KPIs, and holding each lead accountable to outcomes.
* Proven experience leading a technology delivery team with direct accountability for its structure, performance, and outcomes.
* Strong financial acumen — ability to discuss specific margin percentages, utilisation rates, and revenue targets without being prompted.

  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION* Experience in a digital product engineering, technology services, or SaaS delivery environment.
* Track record of translating company goals into function\-level OKRs and governing achievement throughout the year.
* Practical experience driving the shift from effort\-based to outcome\-based delivery in technology teams.
* A clear, informed perspective on how AI changes service delivery operations and team productivity.
* Experience presenting consolidated performance reports to a CEO or equivalent — including underperformance and recovery plans — with honesty and clarity.
* An MBA or equivalent post\-graduate qualification is an advantage but not required.

  

PERKS/BENEFITS* Personalized learning opportunities to enhance your career.
* Competitive salary structure aligned with industry standards.
* Comprehensive health insurance and wellness programs.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued.
* Regular team\-building events, company outings, and engaging workplace activities.
* A culture of appreciation with Peer and Spot Recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

title: Regional Operation Lead
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Regional Operation Lead – India location
  
Work Dynamic (Integrated Facilities Management) – India Bangalore
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Staying at the forefront of operational excellence
  
You’ll be the part of the visionary and strategist for our regional plans. As such, you’ll must understand the clients’ business needs inside and out. You’ll also be the go\-to person for the operations—including standard procedures, system reports and relevant technologies.
  
  

Putting clients first—always
  
Client satisfaction is second nature to us, that’s why you’ll make sure that we build and maintain good working relationships with our stakeholders. You’ll be the single point of contact for our regional service delivery. As such, you must develop deep understanding of the clients’ key business drivers influencing their decision making process and how such decisions relate to their requirements for our services. You’ll also see to it that our clients’ outsourcing needs and our own objectives for the account are perfectly in sync. Apart from these, you’ll also be at the forefront of account operations, taking charge of all the resources—including technology, manpower and standard operating procedures—needed to run the operations smoothly and seamlessly.
  
  

Devising win\-win solutions for all parties
  
You’ll be a steward to our clients, looking after their financial interests by developing property budgets and forecasts based on their finance calendar. You’ll play a pivotal role in helping our clients achieve their financial goals—be they revenue, expenses, debtor or growth targets. As you tend to our clients’ best interests, so should you represent ours by being on the lookout for opportunities to cross\-sell our other services. Collecting fees from clients and tracking outstanding payments also fall on your shoulders.
  
Being a big\-picture thinker and innovation\-forwardYou’ll determine the needs, requirements and constraints of our resources to ensure all operation needs can be successfully delivered. You’ll need to ensure our team represent our clients’ best interests—from inception to completion—in a professional and ethical manner.
  
  

Do you know how to drive innovation forward? You’ll better make use of this know\-how in taking advantage of the role of JLL technology—including Canopy, Corrigo, Azara, LCAM, Onsite and any new initiatives as they arise—in the delivery of the contracts.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**  

We uphold excellence in everything we do—and we’re always on the lookout for people who share our values. To fit this role, you should be a:
  
  

Seasoned expert
  
You have at least eight years’ experience in facilities account management under your belt. Likewise, you are a pro at handling complex account structures and client sensitivities. You are also an ace on the technical and financial know\-how of running a service delivery team.
  
  

Critical thinker
  
Does problem solving come naturally to you? In this role, you will need to come up with strategies in applying holistic approaches and long\-term solutions for complex problems. You’ll also need excellent organisational skills to prioritise work and meet tight deadlines.
  
  

Compassionate leader
  
Teamwork is a vital aspect of our brand, and we’ll expect you to value this as well. You’ll be the team’s anchor in difficult days and their proud leader in times of success. Most important, you’ll lead by example, and promote open, constructive and collaborative relationships at all levels.
  
  

Operation Readiness
  
Be the single point of contact for assigned portfolio for the Head of CRE and support regional initiatives by driving implementation and delivery.
  
Comply with all requirements of the contract and meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
Drive a service excellence culture within the delivery and operational management teams. Create an environment within the team that drives continuous improvement and innovation.
  
Ensure the processes and procedures within the account (be they client or JLL owned) are monitored and updated as per the Master Services Agreement (MSA)
  
Work in conjunction with the Regional Account Director and Account Director to develop a strategic business plan for the delivery of the services and be responsible for the delivery of that plan as required.
  
Ensure the integrity of the data within the various systems being used to manage the account, including maintenance of system drawings.
  
Ensure all contractual and ad\-hoc reports are delivered on time
  
Ensure contractors and their staff are on/off boarded and inducted appropriately and that all permitting and working requirements are adhered to. Ensure that contractor staff at all times meet the standards and expectations of the Client and JLL
  
Monitor Planned Preventive Maintenance plan in conjunction with local laws, regulations, and standards. Regularly engage with JLL’s COE team to ensure that schedules are compliant as per the above.
  
Ensure minor repairs \& works are supervised appropriately and that services are delivered on time, in a safe manner, and within budget
  
Ensure participation in any planned or unplanned power shutdowns and support the engineering team as required
  
Ensure participation in any planned or unplanned building evacuation and ensure the BCP is up to date and enacted.
  
Ensure all safety procedures, including Crisis Management and Emergency Procedures, are maintained at all times.
  
Support the Moves, Adds and Changes (MAC) team to ensure that space planning and churn activities are undertaken as per the MSA and client demand
  
Financial Management
  
Be responsible for relevant portfolio’s agreed financial targets including revenue, expenses, debtor and savings targets, and keeping within the GMP price, including raising all relevant Change Requests
  
Be responsible for the delivery and expenditure of the supply chain and accountable of the quality of services delivered
  
Participate and set the budgets for the delivery of services and ensure compliance to those budgets.
  
Participate in regular reforecasting activities
  
Ensure all financial reports are accurate and timely as per the agreed timeline set out under the agreement. Ensure costs are managed within appropriate budgets
  
Ensure all client billing is completed as per the required timeline and follow\-up outstanding amounts to ensure collection within contract terms
  
Ensure the supply chain is paid as per payment terms within the individual agreements
  
Human Resource Management
  
Be responsible for monitoring and managing the performance of the subordinate staff. Ensure each member of staff within the team has a personal development plan and it is reviewed on a 6 monthly basis
  
Be responsible for the structure of the team and manage any recruitment or performance management issues in\-line with JLL processes and procedures
  
Provide support for succession planning to direct reports
  
Engage in the remuneration process at required intervals as dictated by the JLL business
  
Risk Management
  
Drive a risk conscious culture within the team and ensure that all works meet local and JLL standards for risk identification and mitigation
  
Ensure compliance with all Health, Safety, Environment and Risk Management policies and procedures.
  
Ensure all incidents are reported as per the Bank’s and JLL internal reporting procedures
  
Ensure that a suitable emergency escalation process is in place and that Emergency call\-Out \& Rectification Services are conducted swiftly and efficiently. Ensure communications are escalated both within JLL and the client organization
  
Leadership/Self\-Management
  
Actively encourage an environment that supports openness, teamwork, collaboration, performance excellence and personal success.
  
Develop the team through performance assessments and training, managing staff workload through correct resourcing and developing a succession plan for key team members and on\-site Vendors
  
Gains respect of senior leaders in the Bank
  
Gains respect of JLL people and clients.
  
Key Performance Measures
  
This will be measured through the Compliance of MSA and Super KPI and meet the account targets; implementation of Best Practices; Customer satisfaction Survey; achieve Saving and energy Savings targets; along with other ad hoc client\-reports; and meet the annual goal settings.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  

Apply today!
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Security Operation Supervisor (OT Specialization)
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com .


**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

  

The Security Operations Supervisor (OT Specialization) leads the day\-to\-day work of a team of security operations analysts and serves as the senior technical escalation point for threats affecting both our corporate IT estate and our operational technology environments, including battery energy storage sites and the systems that support them. Based in Bengaluru, this role supervises cybersecurity analysts, quality of triage and investigation, and the professional growth of the analyst team, while personally handling complex detection, hunting and incident response work. The Supervisor partners closely with the global cybersecurity team, IT infrastructure, service desk, service and operations engineering, product security and, where required, customers and external incident response partners. The ideal candidate has hands\-on security operations depth, real exposure to industrial control system and OT environments, and a genuine interest in coaching analysts and improving how a security operations team works. Key tools and platforms include Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, endpoint detection and response, SOAR and automation platforms, OT monitoring technologies, threat intelligence services and IT service management tooling.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

**Security Monitoring, Detection and Incident Response**

  

* Direct network monitoring and intrusion detection analysis using computer network defense tools such as intrusion detection and prevention systems, firewalls, proxies and host\-based security systems.
* Oversee log\-based, identity\-based and endpoint\-based threat detection to identify and contain threats originating from multiple sources.
* Drive cloud\-centric detection coverage for the cloud environments and services the organization uses, including Azure, AWS and GCP workloads.
* Correlate activity across assets (endpoint, network, identity, applications) and environments (on\-premises, cloud, OT) to identify patterns of anomalous activity, attacks and unauthorized use.
* Review alerts and sensor data escalated by analysts, validate findings and produce formal, technical incident reports for technical and management audiences.
* Act as incident commander or senior responder for high\-severity incidents, coordinating containment, eradication and recovery activities across teams and time zones.
* Provide users and internal stakeholders with incident response support, including mitigating actions to contain activity and facilitating forensic analysis where necessary.
* Work with threat intelligence and threat\-hunting teams, translating intelligence into detection content, hunting hypotheses and response playbooks.
* Research emerging threats, adversary tradecraft and vulnerabilities to support the identification and classification of incidents.
* Support the creation and testing of business continuity and disaster recovery plans, including running exercises, publishing results and driving remediation of deficiencies.
Perform security standards testing against systems before implementation to confirm they meet security requirements.  
* 

  

**Operational Technology (OT) Security**

  

* Own monitoring, detection and response for operational technology environments, including battery energy storage sites, site controllers, historians, engineering workstations and remote access paths used to support them.
* Tune and maintain OT\-specific detection content, including rules for unauthorized configuration changes, unexpected protocol use, rogue devices and abnormal control traffic.
* Onboard and validate telemetry from OT monitoring and asset discovery platforms into the SIEM, and maintain accurate OT asset and network context for responders.
* Maintain and exercise OT incident response playbooks that account for safety, availability and physical process constraints, including scenarios where containment actions cannot disrupt energy delivery.
* Monitor and review privileged and vendor remote access into OT networks, escalating misuse or policy deviations.
* Work with service and operations engineering, product teams and site personnel to validate alerts, confirm expected activity and agree on safe response actions.
* Track OT vulnerabilities and advisories, assess applicability to deployed systems and coordinate risk\-based mitigation with engineering owners.
Support alignment of OT monitoring and response practices with recognized frameworks and standards such as IEC 62443, NIST SP 800\-82 and applicable customer or regulatory requirements.  
* 

  

**Supervision and Development of Analysts**

  

* Supervise a team of security operations analysts, including day\-to\-day task assignment, shift and on\-call scheduling, workload balancing and handover quality across regions.
* Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular one\-on\-ones, provide continuous feedback and contribute to goal setting, performance reviews and career development plans.
* Coach analysts on investigation technique, evidence handling, documentation quality and escalation judgment, and review a sample of closed cases for accuracy and completeness.
* Build and maintain a skills matrix and training path for the team, covering IT, cloud and OT monitoring, and identify gaps to be closed through training or hiring.
* Deliver regular internal training sessions on intrusion detection and prevention, incident response procedures, threat intelligence analysis, log analysis and OT fundamentals.
* Run tabletop exercises, purple team activities and detection drills to test analyst readiness and improve response quality.
* Participate in recruiting, interviewing and onboarding of new analysts, including mentoring during ramp\-up.
* Manage the relationship with managed detection and response or outsourced monitoring partners, reviewing their output quality and holding them to agreed service levels.
Foster a culture of ownership, knowledge sharing and psychological safety, so analysts raise concerns early and learn from incidents without blame.  
* 

  

**Detection Engineering, Automation and Tooling**

  

* Work with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms to manage and tune the system, create and maintain detection content and actively watch for alerts.
* Own the detection engineering backlog, from use case definition through rule development, testing, documentation and measurement of effectiveness.
* Drive down false positives and alert fatigue through tuning, enrichment and suppression logic, with measurable targets reported to leadership.
* Design and maintain security orchestration, automation and response (SOAR) playbooks that automate repetitive triage, enrichment and containment tasks.
* Ensure log source coverage and data quality across IT, cloud and OT, identifying blind spots and driving onboarding of missing telemetry.
Map detection coverage to MITRE ATT\&CK for Enterprise and ATT\&CK for ICS, and use the results to prioritize new content.  
* 

  

**Process, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

  

* Maintain standard operating procedures, runbooks and escalation matrices for the security operations team, and keep them current as tooling and the environment change.
* Track and report operational metrics such as alert volume, time to triage, time to contain, escalation accuracy and detection coverage, with regular reporting to cybersecurity leadership.
* Lead post\-incident reviews, capture lessons learned and drive corrective actions to closure with the responsible owners.
* Manage projects to implement new security tooling or to develop new security policies and procedures, including scope, timeline and stakeholder communication.
* Apply change management practices when introducing new controls or processes, including change plans and management of business impact.
Support audit, compliance and customer assurance activities by providing evidence of monitoring, detection and response capability.  
* 

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, cybersecurity, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 4 years in a security operations, incident response or threat detection role.
* Minimum 2 years of experience supervising, leading or mentoring analysts, including shift coordination, quality review and coaching. Formal people management experience is welcome but a strong technical lead background will also be considered.
* Minimum 2 years of hands\-on experience with industrial control system or operational technology environments, such as battery energy storage, power generation, utilities or manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience with SIEM platforms, including writing and tuning detection content and building dashboards and reports. Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and KQL is strongly preferred.
* Practical experience with endpoint detection and response, network detection, identity protection and email security tooling.
* Working knowledge of cloud security concepts and the security capabilities of major cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP, including detection of cloud\-native attack techniques.
* Familiarity with industrial protocols and OT architecture concepts, such as Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850, OPC and the Purdue model, and the ability to read a basic network or one\-line diagram.
* Experience with risk assessment, incident response and security audits.
* Experience with regulatory compliance and information security management frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800\-53 or COBIT.
* Advanced analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting capabilities, with sound judgment under time pressure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to write clear incident reports and explain technical risk to non\-technical stakeholders.
Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation and to support incidents outside standard business hours when required.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* Master's degree in cybersecurity, information security or a related technical field.
* OT or ICS security certification such as GICSP, GRID or GCIP.
* Security operations or incident response certification such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA or Microsoft SC\-200\.
* Management or governance certification such as CISSP, CISM or CISA.
* Experience with OT monitoring and asset visibility platforms such as Dragos, Claroty, Nozomi or Tenable OT.
* Experience building SOAR automation, for example with Logic Apps, and scripting in PowerShell or Python.
* Familiarity with DevOps security practices and the ability to integrate security checks into a DevOps pipeline.
* Experience supporting a follow\-the\-sun or globally distributed security operations model.
* Digital forensics or malware analysis experience.
Exposure to the energy storage, renewable energy or utility sector, and to customer\-facing security obligations in service agreements.  
* 

  

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

  

* Team leadership and analyst development, including coaching, feedback and workload management.
* Threat detection and incident response judgment, with strong decision\-making that weighs the relative costs and benefits of possible actions and selects the most appropriate one.
* OT and safety awareness, understanding where availability and physical process safety constrain security actions.
* Technical breadth across firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, SIEM, SOAR, endpoint and identity security tooling.
* Influence and stakeholder management, with the ability to shift the opinions, plans or behavior of teams outside direct authority.
Process discipline and continuous improvement, turning incidents and metrics into lasting change.  
* 

  

Business alignment, consistently applying an understanding of organizational mission, values and goals to security decisions.

title: Associate Manager, Global Operations Support

description:

* Establish robust maker\-checker controls, approval limits, merchant\-category restrictions, transaction limits and segregation of duties across the card lifecycle.
* Design preventive and detective controls for inappropriate spend, duplicate claims, split transactions, personal usage, cash withdrawal and other policy exceptions.
* Ensure cardholder, approver, administrator and programme\-owner responsibilities are clearly defined, communicated and evidenced.

* Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and risk assessments, ensuring actions are resolved within agreed timelines.
* Define service levels and performance measures for issuers, service teams and internal stakeholders, and lead regular governance reviews.
* Identify opportunities to increase compliant P\-Card usage, reduce low\-value purchase\-order and invoice volumes, and improve the employee and supplier experience.
* Deliver measurable benefits through process simplification, automation, improved visibility, reduced processing effort and stronger spend control.
* Plan resources and manage implementation capacity, budget and third\-party costs within approved parameters.
* Lead and develop the implementation team, promoting accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and strong risk ownership.
* Embed a sustainable business\-as\-usual model, including ownership, support arrangements, control monitoring, change management and continuous improvement.
* Embed resilience, access, data protection, fraud prevention and contingency controls in the programme design.

* Proven experience leading a multi\-market P\-Card or Corporate Card implementation, expansion or major transformation from design through stabilisation.
* Strong knowledge of the card lifecycle, issuer operations, expense management, settlement, reconciliation, accounting and exception handling.
* Demonstrated experience designing and operating P\-Card governance, policies, transaction controls, approval limits, segregation of duties, fraud prevention and audit trails.

 Position Summary
   

  

 As an experienced Manager, you will oversee the delivery of enterprise\-scale change management solutions, lead cross\-functional teams, drive client conversations, and mentor junior practitioners. You will collaborate to understand overarching change requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end\-to\-end change management delivery, including resource estimations and strategic planning, to ensure successful outcomes.

* Serve as a senior trusted advisor to client executives and project leadership, bringing deep OCM expertise, industry perspective, and leading practices to shape transformation strategies, challenge assumptions, guide key decisions, and translate complex organizational challenges into pragmatic, outcome\-oriented solutions. Anticipate cross\-workstream implications, risks, and adoption barriers, and align stakeholders around effective mitigation strategies.

* Outline and guide design of change strategy components, including organization architecture, go\-to\-market journey, deployment approach, and end\-user onboarding experience.
* Manage resource allocation on projects and their utilization during the entire change management lifecycle.
* Design tailored organizational change architectures that address complex transformational requirements.
* Champion the responsible use of generative AI, automation, and digital tools to improve delivery efficiency, accelerate analysis, and enhance the quality and scalability of client solutions.
* Regularly track status of change management project plan deliverables to ensure alignment with organizational timelines/objectives, and report out to senior client/project leadership.
* Lead/manage one or more teams responsible for developing and deploying change programs for technical implementations, digitalization and emerging technology initiatives.
* Liaise with leads from other workstreams and subject matter experts (SMEs).
* Perform quality assurance across project deliverables to ensure they meet Deloitte and client quality standards.
* Regularly manage, mentor, and evaluate team of junior practitioners to support their career progression.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client/project leadership, anticipate project risks/watch items and propose mitigation strategies to client teams, to remove roadblocks for the development team.
* Lead and manage business development efforts, including Statements of Work (SOW), proposal development/sales pursuits, client presentations, etc.
* Lead and contribute to practice developmental growth and innovation through initiatives including culture building, internal community involvement, eminence, recruiting, whitepapers, etc.


**The team**
 Our Human Capital team helps Deloitte client service teams support value creation through people's performance. We guide teams in reimagining work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise, and help in transforming HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today's world, you will help provide insights and enable delivery to address questions such as: How do organizations access, develop, and motivate their workforce? What should the AI strategy be for the HR function? Do they have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to help make work better for humans and humans better at work.
   

  

 The Organization Workforce \& Change practice focuses on transforming the organization to support its business strategy. This involves helping our clients move from where they are today to where they need to be in the future. This could include changing the organization’s culture, modernizing specific functions, and redesigning the organization structure. It will require a combination of change management actions to execute the transformation. To enable our success, it will be critical to use data and insights to inform better ways of working together.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 10 \- 15 years of hands\-on experience in industry or consulting in learning and development/organization design/organization change management/digital and cloud solutions space

* Plan and manage complex projects and ensure timely work delivery

title: Assistant / Deputy Manager – OFR Export Operations
description:
**About Ocean Freight Operations**
 The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an integral part of Ocean Freight Export Operations/ Documentation, an incumbent role in ensuring the efficiency of Export processes within the specified region. The role of OFR (Ocean Freight Operations) involves supporting the intricacies of ocean\-bound cargo movements. It involves coordinating with various processes, including vessel scheduling, cargo documentation, interaction with ocean carriers to constantly strive for optimizing efficiency, regulations, and maintaining high standards of service.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Excellence:**
* Ensure cost\-effective and high\-quality export ocean freight operations.
* Assist in procuring and managing cargo capacity efficiently, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation.
* Responsible for the smooth execution of export shipments, adhering to customer requirements, country regulations, and customs trade practices.
* Ensure regulatory compliance related to AMS, ACI, ISF, and FMC filing.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including auto rating, auto costing, timely and accurate cost estimation, billing, ESI \& E\-Booking, milestone updating, and file closure.
* Achieve set operational performance targets.
* Proactively address and manage operational irregularities.
* Efficiently handle customer complaints and plug potential revenue leakages.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.
* Adhere to agreed SOP/COP for releasing documents to customers (Cash/Credit).
* Manage the vendor payment process and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate with Gateway Operation Team for CFS stuffing containers \& consol.
* Collaborate with PCM team for carrier rates filing.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the ocean freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Enhance customer satisfaction by delivering exceptional services.
* Manage relationships with carriers, suppliers, and the network.
* Interface with the sales team and customer service team.


**Customer \& Network Support:**
* Enhance customer satisfaction through best\-in\-class services.
* Record complaints concerning all export shipments.
* Address and resolve network\-related issues.
* Maintain regular communication with sales and support teams.


**COMPETENCIES**
**Functional Competencies**
* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.


**WHO CAN APPLY?**
**Must Have**
* 2\-3 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for Executive/Sr. Exec.
* 4\-5 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for AM/DM
* Bachelor’s degree in any field.
* Proven experience in running smooth operations processes.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.


**Preferred**
* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.


**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

title: Type Test Manager – HV Switchgear
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Type Test Manager will serve as the primary technical authority for the organization and execution of type tests for Gas\-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and Air\-Insulated Switchgear (AIS) circuit breakers. This role spans the entire testing lifecycle—from initial planning and budget coordination to lab management and final documentation. The position will be a key technical liaison for Tendering and Project teams, ensuring products meet the highest international standards and customer expectations while overseeing mechanical test lab operations.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
**Type Testing Excellence**
* Strategic Planning: Lead the coordination of type test activities for GIS and AIS products, including the development of comprehensive test programs and physical test layouts.
* External Liaison: Manage relationships with external test laboratories and witnessing agencies to secure quotations, schedule test slots, and ensure alignment on test protocols.
* End\-to\-End Execution: Oversee the internal supply chain for testing, including budget management, Bill of Materials (BOM) accuracy, production order releases, and logistics for test samples.
* Travel to Labs in India and Abroad
* Technical Compliance: Execute type tests in collaboration with witnessing agencies, ensuring all procedures adhere to international standards and internal quality requirements.
* Documentation \& Approval: Maintain meticulous, traceable type test records and reports. Provide technical clarifications to support customer approvals and queries.


**Lab Operations \& Strategic Management**
* Facility Oversight: Manage the daily operations of GIS and AIS mechanical test laboratories, including load planning and resource scheduling.
* Maintenance \& Upgrades: Develop and execute periodic maintenance plans for lab equipment. Proactively identify opportunities for facility upgrades, prepare budget proposals, and manage the procurement of new tools and technologies.
* Process Improvement: Proactively identify and drive opportunities for continuous improvement in designs, testing processes, and digital tools.


**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Professional Experience: 10\+ years of progressive experience specifically in the type testing of High\-Voltage (HV) switchgear.
* Technical Standards: In\-depth proficiency in international HV switchgear standards, specifically IEC and IEEE.
* Design Tools: Proficiency in CAD tools, including Creo Parametric and AutoCAD, for managing test layouts and technical documentation.
* Communication: Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively with global, cross\-functional teams.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Ownership: A self\-starter with a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision, taking end\-to\-end accountability for tasks.
* Analytical Rigor: Strong problem\-solving skills with a structured, data\-driven approach to technical and operational challenges.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a high\-pressure, project\-driven environment.
* Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to influence stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
* Quality Focus: High level of accountability for quality, on\-time delivery, and strict compliance with global standards.
* Lab Collaboration Expertise: Proven experience in coordinating and executing type tests with internationally recognized laboratories (e.g., KEMA, CESI) and leading Indian testing institutes (e.g., CPRI, ERDA). Deep understanding of their respective protocols, quotation processes, and testing capabilities.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Finance - Team Head
description:
**Job Description\- Team Head, Finance Service Delivery** 




**Position Overview** 




 The Team Head\- Finance Service Delivery will have overall accountability for leading a high\-performing finance operations team and delivering accurate, timely, controlled and value\-focused services to clients. The incumbent will own service delivery, operational governance, financial controls, stakeholder engagement, risk management and continuous improvement. As the senior finance contact for the engagement, the role will be expected to anticipate client needs, resolve complex issues, drive service excellence and build a scalable delivery model. The position requires a qualified CA or CMA with substantial finance operations experience, strong commercial judgement and a proven record of leading teams in a demanding client\-service environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Service delivery ownership:** 
 Assume end\-to\-end accountability for the finance service portfolio, consistently meeting or exceeding service\-level, quality, accuracy and turnaround\-time commitments.
* **Client leadership:** 
 Serve as the senior point of contact for client stakeholders, understand business priorities, provide transparent updates and build trusted, long\-term relationships.
* **Team leadership:** 
 Build, lead and retain a high\-performing finance team through clear accountability, effective work allocation, performance management, coaching, competency development, succession planning and adequate backup coverage.
* **Finance operations:** 
 Direct and review accounts payable, employee expenses, general ledger accounting, journal entries, account reconciliations, corporate card processing, month\-end close and suspense account management.
* **Financial control and risk:** 
 Establish and enforce a robust control environment covering approvals, supporting documentation, general ledger coding, segregation of duties, reconciliations, access controls and timely closure of exceptions.
* **Governance and reporting:** 
 Lead operational governance forums; review dashboards, ageing, capacity, productivity, quality and risk indicators; and present clear insights, decisions required and recovery plans to management and clients.
* **Escalation management:** 
 Take ownership of critical service issues and escalations, mobilize cross\-functional support, complete root\-cause analysis and ensure timely implementation of sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* **Transformation and value creation:** 
 Develop and execute a continuous\-improvement roadmap covering standardization, automation, digitization, productivity enhancement, cost efficiency and control strengthening.
* **Compliance and audit:** 
 Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax and regulatory requirements, internal policies and client procedures, including GST and withholding tax where relevant; lead timely closure of audit observations.
* **Transition and change:** 
 Lead migration and stabilization of new finance processes, including due diligence, process documentation, risk assessment, control design, knowledge transfer, resource planning and operational\-readiness sign\-off.
* **Cross\-functional partnership:** 
 Partner effectively with clients, auditors, tax, procurement, technology, treasury, vendors and other internal functions to deliver integrated solutions and timely decisions.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 15 year of relevant experience in finance and accounting, including at least 5 years in a leadership role with responsibility for people, controls and client service delivery.
* Demonstrated breadth across accounts payable, employee expenses, general ledger, reconciliations, month\-end close, management reporting, controls and audit support
* Strong track record of improving service performance, strengthening controls, managing senior stakeholders and delivering transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting a bank, financial institution or other highly regulated organization is strongly preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of ERP, accounting, payment and expense platforms; experience with SAP, Oracle, SAP Concur and related workflow or reporting tools is desirable



  





**Competencies** 



* Strong executive presence, commercial judgement and confidence in engaging senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to build accountable teams, manage performance and create a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous learning.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making capability, including sound judgement under pressure.
* Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* High standards of integrity, accuracy, accountability and client confidentiality.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, complex change and demanding deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with strong capability in data interpretation and management reporting

title: Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration Lead
description:
Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
   

  

 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration Lead will provide senior leadership for the accurate, timely, compliant, and scalable administration of field incentive compensation programs. The role will lead delivery across internal and external teams in AIN and India, while managing relationships across a complex set of internal teams and functional groups.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role responsible for end\-to\-end IC administration and operations, including cycle delivery, data and calculation controls, payment readiness, governance, platform operations, and continuous improvement. The role will serve as a trusted operational partner to Amgen’s U.S. Commercial organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Key Integrator: Act as the main point of contact and representative in India for the Incentive Compensation Administration team.
* Talent Development: Train, develop, and manage talent to meet organizational needs.
* Incentive Compensation Administration and Operational Leadership
+ Lead the accurate, timely, and compliant administration of approved IC plans and compensation cycles, ensuring plan rules, governance requirements, internal controls, and business timelines are consistently met.
+ Oversee end\-to\-end operational delivery across data intake, eligibility validation, crediting, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, payout coordination, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation.
+ Monitor operational performance, payout trends, processing timelines, data\-quality issues, field inquiries, and potential outliers; escalate material risks and drive appropriate corrective actions with stakeholders.

* Operational Excellence, Governance, and Delivery:
+ Lead end\-to\-end IC program operations, ensuring quality, scalability, and operational efficiency while establishing clear delivery priorities, service levels, quality controls, and accountability across the team and vendor partners.
+ Establish and enforce governance standards by ensuring robust documentation practices, traceable audit trails, and effective control mechanisms across incentive compensation operations.
+ Lead operational management of the IC technology platform, partnering with IT, vendors, and IC stakeholders to support platform enhancements, integrations, testing, and effective implementation of approved changes.
+ Serve as the senior subject matter expert for IC operational data and administration, providing guidance and actionable solutions for data\-related challenges, calculation questions, and complex field inquiries.

* Automation, Technology, and Continuous Improvement:
+ Lead identification, prioritization, testing, and implementation of automation opportunities that strengthen IC administration, controls, accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
+ Support the evaluation and adoption of approved AI\-enabled and digital solutions by providing IC administration domain expertise and validating operational readiness, controls, and outputs.

* Lead the identification and prioritization of process improvements across IC administration, documentation, reporting, data controls, and vendor ways of working.
* Stakeholder and Delivery Management: Partner with global stakeholders to clarify operational requirements, coordinate decisions and delivery milestones, resolve issues, communicate progress, and ensure IC administration delivers a reliable field experience.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree \& 10\+ years of experience in Incentive Compensation administration and operations.
* Bachelor’s degree \& 12\+ years of experience in Incentive Compensation administration and operations.
* 3\+ years of leadership experience directly managing people, teams, projects, programs, and directing the allocation of resources.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Relevant sales force effectiveness, sales operations, and field platforms and systems (i.e. CRM, sales operations enablement, reporting) in the bio/pharmaceutical industry and/or consulting experience.
* Analytical Skills: The ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data\-driven decisions is crucial. This includes proficiency in statistical analysis and familiarity with tools like Excel, SQL, and data visualization software.
* Technical Proficiency: Knowledge of relevant software and technologies, such as sales planning and operations platforms (targeting, alignment and roster management, incentive compensation), sales CRM, and other field\-specific tools, is important.
* Critical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to diagnose complex IC operational issues, assess risk, and implement practical, compliant solutions.
* Project Management: Ability to lead cross\-functional teams to manage IC administration initiatives, platform enhancements, annual cycles, and process improvements.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with stakeholders to ensure alignment and support for initiatives
* Communication: Effective communication is key, both in writing and verbally. This includes the ability to present data and findings clearly to stakeholders and team members.
* Oral, written and presentation skills to explain complex concepts and controversial findings clearly to a variety of audiences, including senior management
* Comfortable challenging the status quo and bringing forward innovative solutions
* Ability to identify areas for process and systems innovation and implement change that will enhance the overall effectiveness of the team
