title: Director, Delivery Success Support
description:
**About the Team**
 Customer Experience \& Integrity (CXI) is one of DoorDash's core operations teams. We ensure that when challenges arise in the last mile, there's always someone ready to make things right. Our team designs, manages, and operates DoorDash's global network of support centers, with the ultimate goal of delivering a consistently exceptional customer experience.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're hiring a Director, Delivery Success to lead CXI's highest\-volume, highest\-impact operational function. Delivery Success handles all live delivery contacts across the Customer and Dasher experiences Solving problems in the moments that matter most for our Customers and Dashers!
   

  

 This is a role for someone who is a relentless customer advocate and thrives creating scalable solutions in a complex environment. You'll own a globally distributed team spanning internal and partner sites and build a tiered capability model that grows associates from customer delivery basics through full customer, Dasher and Merchant expertise. You will create the strategy and drive the operational rigor that keeps millions of deliveries on track every day.
   

  

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will...**
**Own the Strategy**
* Define and execute the operating model for Delivery Success as CXI's core live\-operations function, covering all delivery\-related contacts across Customers and Dashers.
* Build and own a tiered capability progression
* Design and implement a skill\-based pay progression framework tied to tier advancement and demonstrated capability.
* Lead annual and quarterly planning cycles for Delivery Success, partnering with WFM, Finance, and S\&O to drive quality, and align headcount, cost, and capacity to volume forecasts.
* Build the long\-term vision for how automation and BPO integration reduce Tier 1 volume while enabling internal teams to focus on higher\-complexity work.

* Partner with BPO teams to maintain high\-quality human interactions for contacts that require live support, driving network shape while also ensuring automation adoption for eligible contact types.
* Manage the operational pipeline through tiers of complexity, ensuring smooth progression, appropriate routing, and clear escalation paths to Edge Case Management.
* Build scalable playbooks, governance structures, and feedback mechanisms that allow the team to operate consistently across locations and time zones.
* Create and facilitate a high performance environment where site leads and functional managers drive and are accountable to performance targets with clear metrics, regular calibration, and direct feedback.


**Influence Across the Organization**
* Partner with Product, S\&O, and Finance to surface operational insights that drive upstream improvements in delivery reliability and contact reduction.
* Represent Delivery Success in cross\-functional forums, providing data\-driven input on staffing, automation readiness, and quality.
* Serve as the operational authority on live delivery support for senior CXI leadership.


**Lead a High\-Performing Team**
* Lead and develop senior operational leaders across the internal sites, fostering strong local culture and accountability at each site.
* Build bench strength and succession pipelines across the Delivery Success organization.

* Proven experience managing multi\-site, globally distributed teams including BPO partnerships across LATAM and/or APAC.

title: Data Operations Lead
description:

Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The BP\&T HYD Data Operations Lead, Associate Director, provides strategic data leadership for the Hyderabad Data Operations organization and drives high\-quality execution, master data governance, NPI data readiness, and data quality across Global Supply Chain (GSC). The role leads and influences complex, cross\-functional initiatives that strengthen data as a strategic asset and enable process intelligence, digital transformation, advanced analytics, and AI\-enabled supply chain capabilities. The Associate Director translates the Global Data Operations and governance roadmap into Hyderabad execution plans, while also shaping priorities, risk decisions, standards, adoption measures, and value outcomes through regional, global, and cross\-functional forums. Working closely with Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Product Development, Process Intelligence, Global Data Operations, and BP\&T, the role builds a scalable data operating model across data foundation, mapping, stewardship, controls, lifecycle management, service performance, and continuous improvement. The role also develops data capability, coaches the Hyderabad team and matrix partners, and educates stakeholders on the business value of accurate, trusted, governed, and well\-managed data.
   

  

**Scope and Impact**
* Lead and influence cross\-functional data operations, governance, data quality, NPI readiness, and digital enablement initiatives with high organizational impact across GSC and the Hyderabad hub.
* Translate GSC, BP\&T, and Global Data Operations strategy into integrated roadmaps, execution priorities, decision points, KPIs, adoption measures, and measurable business outcomes.
* Provide strategic input to leadership and governance forums on data priorities, investment needs, operating model maturity, risks, trade\-offs, sequencing, and value realization.
* Strengthen decision making by connecting master data, process performance, data quality, operational controls, product lifecycle requirements, system impacts, and business outcomes.
* Operate as a regional data leader and matrix influencer, creating alignment across global, regional, and Hyderabad\-based teams on governance expectations, standards, accountabilities, and execution discipline.


**Duties/Responsibilities**
* Lead the Hyderabad Data Operations organization responsible for master data creation, extension, maintenance, remediation, obsoletion, and operational data services across GSC.
* Serve as the Hyderabad voice of data, representing data priorities, risks, opportunities, value outcomes, and improvement needs across regional, global, and cross\-functional forums.
* Shape and translate the Global Data Operations and governance roadmap into Hyderabad execution plans with clear milestones, ownership, adoption measures, controls, KPIs, and value outcomes.
* Lead cross\-functional, complex initiatives across data quality, governance, data foundation, data mapping, lifecycle management, workflow optimization, automation, service maturity, and data operations scalability.
* Lead NPI and launch master data readiness by ensuring timely, accurate, governed, and risk\-managed data execution across planning, manufacturing, quality, serialization, distribution, and supply chain processes.
* Strengthen master data governance by embedding standards, business rules, stewardship responsibilities, controls, escalation routines, and data quality disciplines into operational delivery.
* Partner with Process Intelligence to connect process maps, data flows, process performance, data quality insights, operational pain points, and improvement opportunities into an integrated operating model.

title: GPO - Hire to Retire
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
   

  

 Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Global Business Services
   

  

 Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
   

  

 Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting\-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Global Process Owner (GPO) – Hire to Retire (H2R) you will be accountable for shaping and governing the end\-to\-end design, and continuous improvement of the global H2R process landscape. The role ensures standardisation, simplification, scalability, and business\-alignment across the employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition through onboarding, performance, development, mobility, and offboarding.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of enabling an exceptional employee experience while ensuring operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with Reckitt’s talent strategy. You will collaborate with HR Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global People Services (Shared Services), IT\&D, and other Global Process Owners in Global business services to drive process design, technology enablement, and continuous improvement across the full hire\-to\-retire value chain.
   

  

 Note: This role is not responsible for running day\-to\-day HR Shared Services operations. Instead, the GPO partners with Global People Services to deliver process improvements, automation, and simplification across all markets, ensuring operational execution aligns with process design and governance standards.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the global end\-to\-end H2R process strategy, standards, and governance framework
* Lead global design authority for H2R processes including hiring, onboarding, core HR operations, payroll, time \& attendance, and offboarding
* Champion process harmonization and digitization across markets, in partnership with HR, IT, and GBS
* Identify and deliver transformation opportunities that improve employee experience and operational performance
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, policy, and data privacy requirements across the H2R process landscape
* Drive adoption and optimization of H2R platforms (e.g., Workday, ServiceNow, payroll solutions)
* Monitor process performance and drive continuous improvement through KPIs and feedback loops


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Deep understanding of the HR function and full employee lifecycle, with extensive experience designing and leading global H2R processes in a multinational company
* Demonstrated success in process transformation, automation, and employee experience enhancement. Proven experience as a H2R GPO or Head of HR Shared Services operations preferred
* Hands\-on experience with global HR technologies (Workday, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ATS, payroll systems)
* Experience working in or closely with a Global Business Services or Shared Services model
* Demonstrated expertise in process ownership, transformation, and governance
* Proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders across functions and regions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven mindset
* Strong exposure to GBS ramp\-up and mature environments, with a track record of scaling operations and evolving processes
* FMCG or other high\-volume, fast\-paced industry background preferred


 The skills for success
   

  

* Global Process Design
* Hire to Retire
* HR Operations
* HRIS Platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Payroll \& Time Management
* Employee Experience Design
* Process Transformation
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* GBS Collaboration


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

 About Randstad Enterprise
 



  





 As the leading global talent solutions provider, Randstad Enterprise enables companies to create sustainable business value and agility by keeping people at the heart of their organizations. Part of Randstad N.V., we combine unmatched talent data and market insights with smart technologies and deep people expertise. **About Team** 




 Our team is a group of talented and dedicated professionals who are passionate about our work and committed to delivering exceptional results. We are a global group that values collaboration, open communication, and a supportive work environment. Our team is responsible for Full Life Cycle Recruiting and Recruiting Operations for partnering with a global fortune\-500 client and we take pride in the important role we play in achieving the goals of our client's business. We are a diverse group with a range of skills and backgrounds, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. We are committed to fostering a culture of learning and growth, and we encourage each other to take on new challenges and develop our skills. We believe in working hard and having fun, and we enjoy celebrating our successes together as a team.
 



  





  





 Purpose of the Role
 



 ● Develops sourcing strategies that enhance candidate experience, ensuring a personalized approach to project\-based job opportunities.
 



 ● Works closely with the clients' hiring teams, ensuring all KPIs and SLA requirements regarding order\-based sourcing and talent conversion from passive candidates are met.
 



 ● Monitors and analyzes recruitment metrics and data to identify areas for improvement and optimize the recruitment process for passive and active candidates, considering candidates with limited online presence.
 



 ● Stays informed of industry best practices and trends in the career/hiring space, continually assessing where Randstad can tap into project\-based jobs.
 



 ● Leads sourcing activities/projects and drives to meet the key metrics goals as set by leadership, focusing on proactive engagement and headhunting of passive talent.
 



 ● Drives continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing sourcing efficiency and effectiveness.
 



 ● Manages candidates and ensures that the most qualified candidates are shortlisted for clients' short\-term engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● SLA \& KPI Management: You will track the team's daily and monthly hiring targets. You'll look at the data to make sure candidates are moving through the hiring stages quickly and efficiently.
 



 ● Capacity \& Demand Planning: You will look at incoming hiring requests and assign work to your team fairly, making sure they can handle sudden rushes of new job openings.
 



 ● Upskilling \& Mentorship: You will coach and train your team members to improve their sourcing skills, teaching them how to find hard\-to\-reach tech professionals.
 



 ● Advanced Sourcing Frameworks: You will build smart plans to find passive candidates (people who aren't actively looking for a job) for complex IT roles like Cloud, Infrastructure, and Security.
 



 ● AI \& Tech Stack Optimization: You will guide the team on how to best use modern recruitment tools, databases, and AI sourcing technology to work faster and smarter.
 



 ● Process Agility \& Continuous Improvement: You will find ways to fix delays or blockers in the sourcing process so everything runs smoothly and quickly.
 



 ● Client \& Stakeholder Management: You will work closely with the client’s hiring managers, sharing updates regularly, building strong relationships, and making sure we meet their expectations.
 



 ● Quality Assurance: You will check the quality of candidates your team finds to ensure only the best\-vetted profiles are sent to the client.

 ● Good understanding of procedures and concepts within own discipline and knowledge of these elements in other disciplines.

title: Manager, DevOps

**Join Us as Manager, DevOps!**
 We are seeking an experienced DevOps Manager to lead our DevOps and cloud infrastructure function. In this role, you will build and develop a high\-performing team while driving automation, operational excellence, and modern engineering practices. You will play a critical role in ensuring our applications and infrastructure remain secure, scalable, reliable, and highly available, enabling the business to deliver technology solutions efficiently and confidently.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
 As DevOps Manager, you will lead the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of our DevOps and cloud infrastructure capabilities. You will partner closely with Software Engineering, Security, Architecture, and Product teams to enhance delivery performance, system reliability, and operational efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to influence engineering standards, modernize infrastructure practices, and develop a culture focused on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This position will be based in our Hyderabad office, working onsite.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead and** 
 Develop the DevOps Function
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure engineers.
* Establish team goals, performance expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Support employee growth through coaching, mentoring, career development, and regular feedback.


**Drive DevOps Strategy and Engineering Excellence**
* Define and execute the organization's DevOps strategy, roadmap, and engineering standards.
* Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code ( IaC ), automation, and configuration management practices.
* Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and platforms that improve engineering productivity and operational reliability.
* Balance technical debt, operational risk, business priorities, and engineering capacity.


**Build and Operate Secure, Scalable Infrastructure**
* Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, highly available cloud infrastructure.
* Establish best practices for cloud operations, system reliability, observability, performance, and availability.
* Participate in capacity planning, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Manage cloud infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization.


**Improve Delivery, Reliability, and Operational Performance**
* Own and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident management capabilities.
* Lead root\-cause analysis activities and ensure corrective and preventative actions are completed following major incidents.
* Establish and track operational metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, availability, reliability, and recovery time.


**Partner Across the Organization**
* Collaborate with Engineering, Security, Architecture, and Product teams to improve software delivery and operational efficiency.
* Promote DevSecOps practices, including security controls, vulnerability management, access management, and compliance requirements.
* Develop documentation, standards, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Manage relationships with technology vendors and service providers as needed.
* Communicate technical risks, opportunities, and recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders.


**Who You Are**
 You are a hands\-on technology leader who combines deep technical expertise with a passion for building high\-performing teams. You have experience implementing modern DevOps practices and creating scalable, reliable cloud environments while enabling engineering teams to deliver at speed and with quality.
   

  

**If You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), systems engineering, or related disciplines.
* 3\+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams.
* Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform, including AWS, Azure, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools, pipelines, and deployment practices.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar platforms.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of Windows, Linux, networking, databases, and distributed systems.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and incident response practices.
* Working knowledge of security principles and DevSecOps methodologies.
* Strong understanding of Git and modern software development workflows.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience building or scaling DevOps or SRE organizations.
* Experience supporting multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud environments.
* Experience implementing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and reliability engineering principles.
* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar tools.
* Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Relevant cloud or DevOps certifications.
* Experience managing cloud budgets and driving infrastructure cost optimization.
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Monitor market trends, customer demand, competition and pricing.

Drive improvement in ride volume, average revenue per vehicle and overall contribution margin.

Ensure vehicle documentation, compliance and operational readiness.

Develop initiatives to improve driver retention and reduce attrition.

Develop relationships with hotels, corporates, travel companies, online travel platforms, residential communities and other B2B partners.

Develop local airport\-specific sales and promotional initiatives.

Identify and develop local corporate and institutional accounts.

Ensure strong service levels for existing corporate customers.

title: Senior Manager, IT Operations – India
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.  

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

Seismic is seeking an experienced, hands\-on IT leader to serve as the senior technical presence for our India offices. This is not a pure people\-management role — it is a high\-level systems administration position with a people\-leadership component. The Senior Manager, IT Operations will be the final escalation point for all technical IT issues in India, personally own day\-to\-day operations and troubleshooting, and lead a team spanning systems administration and helpdesk/support by doing the work alongside them — not simply directing others to do it.


This role operates under Seismic’s India dual solid\-line operating model: the Senior Manager reports solid\-line to the Sr. Director, IT (functional direction, standards, and technical strategy) and solid\-line to the India GM (day\-to\-day people management, coaching, hiring within budget, and local escalations).


Who you are::
* 8\+ years of hands\-on IT systems administration, infrastructure, or end\-user support experience, including current, active technical work — not purely managerial.
* 3\+ years leading or mentoring a technical team, ideally spanning both systems administration and helpdesk/support functions.
* Working knowledge of core enterprise IT tooling: identity/SSO (Azure AD), MDM (Jamf and/or Intune), ITSM/ticketing (Freshservice or similar), major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and security tooling.
* A demonstrated track record as a doer — someone who resolves issues directly and leads by example, not someone who only delegates.
* Experience operating within a US\-headquartered multinational’s India office; SaaS or enterprise software company experience preferred.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, dual solid\-line reporting structure, balancing global functional direction with local execution and people leadership.
* Strong troubleshooting, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills under time pressure.
* Clear, direct communicator, able to escalate risk transparently to both local and global stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


What you'll be doing::
* Serve as the final escalation point for all technical IT issues across Seismic’s India offices, spanning systems, network, endpoint, identity, and helpdesk\-tier issues.
* Own day\-to\-day IT operations for India — infrastructure administration, incident response, and end\-user support — personally diagnosing and resolving issues rather than only assigning them.
* Directly manage, coach, and mentor India\-based IT staff across both systems administration/integrations and helpdesk/support, setting the standard by leading from the front.
* Partner closely with the Sr. Director, IT and global IT functional leads to align India execution with global IT strategy, standards, and tooling (Jamf/Intune, Azure AD, Freshservice, Rapid7, 1Password, and similar).
* Own local hiring, performance management, and workload prioritization for the India IT team within approved budget, consistent with the India GM operating model.
* Drive local IT security posture and compliance execution (patching, endpoint management, incident response) in partnership with global Security and IT leadership.
* Identify and implement automation and self\-service improvements (Workato, Freshservice Service Catalog, AI tools) to reduce ticket volume and manual effort rather than defaulting to added headcount or process.
* Provide clear, timely communication to global IT leadership on India IT health, risks, incidents, and escalations.
* Represent India IT in regional and global operating rhythms as needed.


Job Posting Footer:  

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.  

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: Senior Manager – Campus Operations & Student Services
description:
**Role Purpose** 




 The Senior Manager \- Central Administration, Housing \& Faculty Services will be responsible for providing central oversight, governance and service coordination for workplace administration, student housing and faculty services across Emeritus in India.
 



 The role will act as a central governance, coordination and performance\-oversight interface between students, parents, faculty, campus teams, service providers and internal functions, ensuring that operational services delivered by campuses and external service providers meet agreed standards, contractual commitments and stakeholder expectations.
 



 The role will also contribute to commercial oversight, service performance, operational governance and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on student/faculty experience and institutional reputation.
 



 For student housing specifically, the accommodation operator remains accountable for day\-to\-day delivery; this role owns the central governance and interface layer – service quality, SLA adherence, escalation and commercial reconciliation – rather than direct hostel administration.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Workplace Administration, Facilities \& Coworking Management (\~40%)** 



* Provide central oversight of workplace administration and facilities services across Emeritus locations, including conventional offices and managed/coworking spaces.
* Manage and maintain a central repository of coworking/workplace agreements, commercial terms, service inclusions, utilisation provisions, renewal dates and key obligations.
* Coordinate with coworking/workplace providers on day\-to\-day service issues, maintenance, housekeeping, security, access, amenities and other workplace requirements.
* Monitor billing, utilisation and contractual charges against agreed commercial terms and coordinate with Finance/Procurement for reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.
* Track contract renewals, notice periods, rate revisions and changes in business requirements, ensuring timely review and decision\-making with relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with workplace/coworking providers to monitor compliance with applicable health, safety, statutory and emergency\-readiness requirements for spaces occupied by Emeritus employees.
* Monitor employee experience across workplace locations and coworking facilities, including workplace readiness, access, amenities, service quality and issue resolution.
* Act as the central point of coordination with workplace/coworking providers and internal stakeholders for escalations and service improvements.
* Coordinate with coworking/managed\-workplace providers to monitor delivery of agreed workplace services, facilities, access, safety and amenities against contractual commitments, with issues escalated and tracked through closure.
* Establish common standards, reporting and governance for distributed workplace arrangements while allowing for location\-specific operating models.



**2\. Student Housing \- Oversight \& Service Governance (\~40%)** 



* Act as the central coordination point between accommodation operators, campus administration, students and parents.
* Monitor and govern delivery of contracted services against agreed SLAs, service standards and student expectations, and drive corrective action with the accommodation operator where gaps are identified.
* Monitor accommodation experience, complaints, NPS, service quality, hygiene, food, security and maintenance standards across operators.
* Track occupancy and unsold inventory and work with relevant stakeholders to identify operational and commercial implications.
* Validate services delivered against contractual commitments and costs incurred, including service\-vs\-cost reconciliation and identification of recurring gaps or leakage.
* Drive resolution of escalations and recurring issues with operators and campus teams, and drive vendor accountability through corrective actions, escalation and contractual governance.
* Establish standard operating processes, reporting mechanisms and governance for student housing.
* Ensure housing service quality supports student wellbeing, university reputation and the overall student experience.



**3\. Faculty Engagement for Partner Universities (\~20%)** 



* Serve as the central, first point of operational engagement for faculty from partner universities, particularly international faculty.
* Coordinate the faculty service journey in partnership with HR, Travel, campus teams and relevant service providers, including mobility and accommodation support, day\-to\-day assistance, issue resolution and escalation management.
* Work closely with campus administration and service providers to ensure timely and consistent support.
* Proactively identify, coordinate and drive resolution of faculty service issues and escalations with the relevant functional teams and service providers.
* Develop a structured faculty\-service framework to ensure a consistent experience across campuses.



**4\. Central Operations \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Develop and implement common SOPs, service standards, KPIs, dashboards and escalation mechanisms.
* Work closely with Campus Operations, HR, Procurement, Finance, IT, Real Estate and other central functions.
* Support operational readiness for new campuses and evolving business requirements.
* Identify recurring operational issues and develop scalable solutions rather than location\-specific fixes.
* Represent Central Operations in discussions with key vendors and institutional stakeholders.



**5\. Commercial \& Performance Governance** 



* Apply the full commercial chain to every managed service: service delivered → contractual commitment → utilisation → cost incurred → commercial leakage → business impact.
* Validate service delivery, utilisation and billing against approved contractual terms and support Procurement/Finance in identifying commercial discrepancies, leakage and optimisation opportunities.
* Support commercial reviews related to housing and other managed services.
* Monitor contracted versus actual service delivery and associated costs.
* For housing specifically, apply enough commercial acumen to assess unsold inventory, reconciliation and service credits/gaps, while Procurement remains the commercial/contracting specialist.
* Review workplace/coworking utilisation, contracted services, billing and commercial terms, and identify opportunities for optimisation based on business requirements and employee utilisation.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, service improvement and better utilisation.
* Prepare periodic performance reviews covering service quality, complaints, NPS, costs, SLA performance and key risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals and governance are maintained.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Multi\-stakeholder management – students, parents, faculty, universities, campus teams and vendors.
* Service governance and vendor management.
* Student/faculty experience orientation.
* Commercial and analytical acumen.
* Problem\-solving and escalation management.
* Independent ownership – able to operate without close supervision and drive outcomes end to end.
* Process and SOP development.
* Multi\-location operations experience.
* Executive\-level communication and stakeholder influence.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and in a fast\-growing, scaling, multi\-campus environment.



  





**Experience \& Qualification** 



* 10–14 years of relevant professional experience, preferably across administration, facilities, hospitality, student accommodation, workplace or higher\-education operations.
* Experience managing external service providers and customer\-facing operations.
* Experience in multi\-location or distributed operations is preferred.
* Exposure to international faculty, students, residential services or higher education would be an advantage.
* Graduate degree in any relevant discipline; professional qualifications in Facilities Management, Hospitality, Administration or related areas would be an advantage.



  





**Success Measures** 



* Student housing service quality and NPS
* Timely closure and reduction of recurring complaints
* SLA and vendor performance
* Service delivery versus contractual commitments
* Cost/service reconciliation and commercial optimisation
* Faculty experience and issue\-resolution effectiveness
* Office operational performance
* Workplace/coworking service performance, commercial compliance and employee experience
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Readiness and scalability of central operating processes
* Successful support for new campus launches and operational expansion

 The Role

 Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 The Fleet Personnel Officer manages the crewing logistics team and works with seafarers, vessels, manning partners, and port agents to ensure that all joining, off\-signing activities, and communications are performed effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 This position works with the Personnel Manager and SCMIPL Mumbai Fleet Personnel team to ensure seafarers are competent and fit for purpose and works to engage and retain seafarers.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Ensures crewing logistics team carries out seafarer and supernumerary joining and off\-signing tasks in accordance with regulatory requirements and company policy (including compliance with flag state documentation and requirements) and communicates vessel joining details to manning agents
* Ensure that crewing logistics team communicates with vessel and addresses all queries with a timely manner
* Ensures crew management system is up to date; regularly checks seafarer data entry in company crewing software; prepares reporting on seafarers due off, director general reporting, and Protection and Indemnity (P\&I) insurance
* Regularly coordinates with planners to thoroughly plan seafarer relief and on\-boarding logistics; ensures staggering and overlap of senior staff and other ranks as applicable
* Provides updates to the Personnel Manager on crewing logistics operational status, and maintains good, timely communication; addresses concerns and grievances of ship staff on assigned vessels, and escalates them when necessary
* Follows up and communicates P\&I issues related to seafarer injuries or illness on assigned vessels; may include liaising with the accounting and other members of fleet personnel and supplying them with supporting documentation
* Conducts pre\-joining briefings and debriefings for junior officers and ratings; may also assist with selection interviews
* Approves travel expenses and vendors bills and issues purchase orders as required
* Conducts daily meetings with Personnel Officers for updates on crewing logistics operational status; communicates expectations to direct reports, manages performance and provides leadership and support to team members
* May act as back up when Personnel Manager is travelling or on vacation
* Monitors expenses of the department, submits monthly variance reporting tracks against budget. Ensures that all reporting employees adhere to company policies and procedures
* Communicates expectations to direct reports, manages performance, and provides leadership and support to team members
* Interview, assess, and select Fitter, Reefer Assistant, Gas Fitter, and Oiler candidates as required.
* Manage statutory flag\-state documentation and compliance for vessels under Marshall Island, Liberia, Panama, and other flag administrations.
* Support vessel transition projects, including management changes, vessel takeovers, flag changes, vessel renaming, and associated crew planning and regulatory compliance.
* Coordinate and manage DG casualty reporting and regulatory compliance.
* Liaise with manning agencies, training institutes, medical providers, flag administrations, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless crew management operations.
* Support continuous process improvement initiatives, operational projects, and compliance audits within the crewing department.
* Performs other duties as required


**Requirements:**
* Sailing experience as a Chief Officer or Second Engineer, or a minimum of six years of working experience in a shipping company, specifically in the crewing function (or similar industry set up)
* Candidates with relevant experience from crew management and fleet personnel are encouraged to apply.
* Proven ability to work under tight timelines with a structured mindset.
* For external candidates, minimum two years of supervisory or management experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
* Sound organizational and planning skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and good writing style
* Good interpersonal skills


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Graduate or post graduate degree
* Experience in a multinational company or with containerships
* Effective problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution skills
* Effective at developing and leading others
* Demonstrates a customer focus
* Understanding and experience with ISO management


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**
* Availability via a mobile device outside of office hours
* Work outside of office hours will be required periodically


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

description:
**Summary of Role \- Head of Portfolio Optimization Group, India Citi Commercial Bank**
 The Head of Portfolio Optimization Group (POG) for India Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) manages a team of POG Relationship Managers and is responsible for the end\-to\-end oversight of the assigned de\-marketing portfolio within the country. This includes supervising workload allocation, reviewing case quality, clearing blockers, and ensuring that each client progresses through assessment, de\-risking, and exit processes in accordance with Citi's policies, controls, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. The role provides centralized coordination for escalations, partners with Operations, Compliance, Risk, and Product teams to expedite execution, and keeps the Country CCB Head and Clusters POG Head informed on progress, risks, and key issues. The Team Lead is accountable for accurate reporting, timely dashboard updates, and portfolio\-level visibility for regional and global stakeholders. This position requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, execution discipline, and the ability to drive consistent, high\-quality outcomes across the team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Oversight**
* Lead, manage, and support a team of POG Relationship Managers responsible for de\-marketing and portfolio management activities.
* Perform and oversee day\-to\-day case execution, ensuring all POG RMs follow consistent standards, documentation requirements, and communication protocols.
* Review team output for quality, accuracy, and completeness, providing coaching where required to strengthen delivery and judgment.
* Monitor team workload and progress, reallocating resources as necessary to meet deadlines and maintain balanced capacity.
* Serve as the primary country\-level escalation point for complex or sensitive POG client situations.


**Portfolio Management \& Execution**
* Maintain end\-to\-end oversight of the assigned portfolio within the country, ensuring timely assessments, risk evaluations, and de\-marketing actions.
* Partner with Operations, Compliance, and cross\-functional teams to expedite client transitions, exits, and remediation activities.
* Track portfolio milestones, workflows, and bottlenecks to ensure smooth execution and proactive problem solving.
* Ensure all regulatory, KYC, AML, and policy\-driven obligations are met across the team's portfolio.


**Escalation \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Manage escalations in coordination with Compliance, Legal, Product, Risk, and Operations partners.
* Keep the Country CCB Head and Clusters POG Head informed of material issues, portfolio risks, delays, and decisions requiring senior management intervention.
* Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders to align priorities, clarify expectations, and remove execution barriers.


**Reporting, Transparency \& Controls**
* Oversee the accuracy and timeliness of all dashboards, trackers, and reporting submitted by POG Relationship Managers.
* Consolidate portfolio\-level reporting for regional and global stakeholders, ensuring full visibility of progress, timelines, risks, and outstanding actions.
* Ensure strict adherence to Citi policies, control requirements, regulatory obligations, and documentation standards.
* Appropriately assess risk when making decisions, demonstrating sound judgment, effective escalation, and transparency.

description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an exceptional person to lead our Ground and Water (Contaminated Land) team in India. You will have at least 15 years’ post\-graduate experience working in the Geo\-environmental field.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting and coaching team members in the GCC Ground \& Water Team. This will include the day\-to\-day management of a team, delivery of projects working closely with and being supported by other team members, Project Managers and Directors within the UK team.
   

  

 The position would suit someone with extensive experience in the UK contaminated land sector who would like to further develop their leadership and technical consultancy skills and build a successful team. The role involves organizational and administrative responsibilities and requires skills, such as planning, analysis and judgement. The Team Leader will be responsible for both the technical and commercial delivery of projects, including effective delegation and checking of work, and will be responsible for the line management and mentoring of more junior staff ensuring their technical development and career progression.
   

  

 The Team Leader is also expected to ensure that their own professional skills and competencies are continually improved to meet the requirements of the team and any relevant professional bodies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The requirements of the Ground \& Water Team Leader will include, but are not limited to, the consistent delivery of the following tasks and responsibilities:
   

  

* Leadership of projects and line management of staff including supporting career development (technical, professional and personal) goals of junior staff, to encourage training and learning.
* Be able to travel to support team members in other offices from time to time.
* Provision of reliable, effective and efficient delivery of environmental consultancy services and seeks regular feedback on performance.
* To work in an integrated manner with limited supervision where appropriate and to understand the task at hand; what is required, when it is required etc. and to deliver tasks in a cost effective and timely manner.

* Extensive experience (15 years \+) working with an Environmental Consultancy or any other company conducting Environmental Site Assessments and contaminated Land risk assessment and remediation for sites in the UK with a full understanding of UK legislation and guidance in relation to contaminated land.

title: Fund Services.Vice President
Trade Lifecycle Manager - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
 Join us in this dynamic role and be a catalyst for success, leveraging your expertise to shape the future of our trade operations and contribute to our organization's growth and excellence.
   

  

 As a Trade Lifecycle Manager III within JPMorganChase, you will be a key player in managing the operations of the pre\- and post\-trading life cycle across all asset classes. Your role will involve complex tasks such as coordinating cash movements in and out of client accounts, preparing funding for managed demand deposit accounts, and collaborating with other business lines to ensure proper funding. You will leverage your deep understanding of trade lifecycle principles and practices to make impactful decisions that affect our operations and financial management. Your advanced skills in areas such as process improvement, automation, and project management will be crucial in driving efficiency and innovation in our operations. As a leader, you will manage a diverse team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and excellence. Your ability to influence and manage internal stakeholders will be key to achieving our strategic objectives.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Ensure accurate and timely settlement of derivative cash flows across supported products and markets. Manage the end\-to\-end settlement lifecycle, including exception management, payment release, reconciliation and funding coordination.
* Execute and oversee pre\-settlement controls, payment validations and settlement risk mitigation activities. Approve and authorize high\-value settlements in accordance with established approval thresholds and governance frameworks.
* Escalate material operational, funding, client and control issues to senior management in a timely manner. Maintain strong focus on operational risk, regulatory compliance and control effectiveness.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of managers, associates and analysts. Drive a culture of accountability, control, inclusion and continuous improvement.
* Manage performance, succession planning, talent development and employee engagement. Promote cross\-training and resiliency across teams and locations.
* Own and deliver key operational metrics, management reporting and governance presentations. Lead root cause analysis efforts and drive sustainable remediation of recurring issues.
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, operating procedures and regulatory requirements. Participate in audits, control reviews and regulatory examinations as required.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual touchpoints, improve STP rates and enhance controls. Partner with Technology and Operations teams to deliver strategic automation and process improvement initiatives.
* Support business growth, platform migrations and industry change programs.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Minimum 8 years of Operations experience within Financial Services.
* Strong knowledge of Derivatives Operations, Settlements, Payments or Markets Operations.
* Proven track record managing teams and operating in a control\-focused environment.
* Experience managing high\-value, time\-critical operational processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Knowledge of OTC Derivatives, Equities, Rates, Credit, FX or Commodities products.
* Experience in settlement platforms, cash management and exception management workflows.
* Prior experience leading transformation, automation or strategic change initiatives.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements impacting Markets Operations.


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Working with institutional investors, banks, insurance companies, governments, and multinational corporations, this team covers fund administration, global custody, sub\-custody and clearing, and corporate trust and loan agency services.

 Our services include fund administration, global custody, sub\-custody and clearing, corporate trust, and loan agency services.

title: Interior site supervisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Interex Arch Designs Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9002 certified interior contracting firm operating across thirteen states in India with a strong PAN India presence. For more than a decade, the company has delivered comprehensive post\-design interior solutions for domestic and commercial spaces under one roof. Interex specializes in interiors for commercial complexes, financial institutions, hotels and restaurants, call centers, retail stores, and corporate offices. The firm offers a full range of services including gypsum work, partitions, carpentry, plumbing, electrical work, air conditioning, painting, polishing, and civil work. Known for exceptional workmanship, competitive pricing, and timely delivery, Interex maintains long\-standing relationships with high\-profile clients such as Future Group, Reliance, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Mahindra Retail, and others.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Interior Site Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day interior fit\-out activities at project locations. This position coordinates and supervises site teams and subcontractors, ensuring that work related to carpentry, partitions, gypsum, plumbing, electrical, air conditioning, painting, polishing, and civil tasks is executed as per design specifications, quality standards, and safety norms. The role involves monitoring project progress, managing site schedules, verifying material deliveries, and reporting daily updates to project managers and stakeholders. The Interior Site Supervisor will also handle site documentation, assist with inspections, resolve on\-site issues, and ensure work is completed within agreed timelines and budgets. Collaborating closely with designers, contractors, and clients, the supervisor ensures the finished space reflects the intended design and functionality.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong site supervision and project coordination skills, including experience managing interior fit\-out teams and subcontractors.
* Candidates should possess technical skills in interior works such as carpentry, partitions, gypsum work, basic plumbing, electrical coordination, air conditioning interfaces, painting, and civil finishing.
* Candidates should possess skills in reading and interpreting architectural and interior drawings, BOQs, and technical specifications.
* Candidates should possess skills in quality control, safety compliance, and adherence to timelines and budgeted resources.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with designers, contractors, vendors, and clients.
* Candidates should possess basic computer skills for documentation, reporting, and use of project tracking tools.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, or a related field, with prior experience in commercial or corporate interior projects, is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with local building codes, site safety standards, and vendor management in the Mumbai region is an added advantage.

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
**Quality Assurance Lead** 




  




* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're building the world's most admired tattoo company.
 



 With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders.
 



 We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations.
 



 We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners.
 



 If you thrive in high\-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you.
 



 As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 You will own quality across the entire studio network end to end — compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself — what gets checked, how often, through what method — and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 Checking every studio against its own standard — how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run — through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported.
 



 Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all — you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change.
 



 Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it — real visits and unannounced ones — so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to.
 



 Owning the physical readiness of every studio — hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on — and catching what's broken before a customer does.
 



 Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted — and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it.
 



 Building the entire audit system from nothing — the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask — designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day.
 



 Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale — holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 You've done this before — run quality or audit work across multiple locations, not a single site. You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all.
 



 Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past — the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later.
 



 You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen.
 



 You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone — a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior — you report what you found, not what's comfortable.
 



 Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both — the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once.
 



 Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi\-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline — what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 every studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses.
 



 The audit system runs as a system — not as you personally visiting every studio, but as a team you've built and trained, working to a standard you designed and can walk away from without it slipping.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Bachelor's degree, with 6–10 years in quality assurance, audit or operations,
 



 Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline
 



 A quality or process\-audit certification — Six Sigma, ISO auditing or equivalent \- This is optional, However this is an added advantage

title: Plant Manager - Cables/ Wires
description:
**Job Purpose**

To oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the manufacturing plant, ensuring efficient production, quality, equipment reliability, and regulatory compliance, while leading plant staff and driving continuous improvement in productivity and cost control.

**Key Result Areas (KRA)**

**1\. Plant Operations Management**

* Oversee daily operations of the manufacturing plant, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning.
* Ensure the facility runs efficiently with the highest productivity possible.
* Monitor and test various plant processes for optimum performance.
* Conduct regular inspections across the facility.

**2\. Production \& Quality Oversight**

* Oversee all production decisions, including production and quality control\-related activities, staffing, scheduling, and materials.
* Work with the production team to improve products and processes.
* Participate in manufacturing\-related activities such as quality, productivity, safety, innovation, and supply management.
* Ensure accurate production records and reports.

**3\. Equipment, Maintenance \& Expansion**

* Review recommendations for existing and new machinery.
* Participate in plant expansion, equipment planning, and conversion projects.
* Oversee the maintenance of equipment, building premises, plant security, and protection.
* Develop and implement a preventive maintenance programme.

**4\. Compliance \& Standards**

* Ensure compliance with environmental and health regulations.
* Stay up to date with the latest production trends, technology, and best practices.

**5\. People Management**

* Build trustworthy relationships with employees.
* Participate in managing factory staff, including hiring, training, and performance evaluations.

**6\. Reporting \& Cost Control**

* Prepare and present regular reports on factory performance and scope of improvement.
* Control costs to achieve budgetary goals for the company.

**Qualification \& Skill Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Production/Industrial Engineering or a related discipline; a Master's degree or diploma in Manufacturing/Operations Management is an added advantage.
* **Experience:** 10\+ years of experience in manufacturing plant operations, with at least 3\-5 years in a plant/factory management or leadership role.
* **Technical Skills:** Strong understanding of production processes, machinery, preventive maintenance, and quality control systems.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** Working knowledge of environmental, health, and safety (EHS) regulations and statutory compliance applicable to manufacturing plants.
* **Software/Tools:** Proficiency in ERP/production management systems, MS Excel, MS Word, and MS PowerPoint for reporting and analysis.
* **Leadership Skills:** Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, manage staffing and performance, and build strong working relationships with employees.
* **Other Skills:** Strong analytical, cost\-control, and decision\-making skills; ability to manage budgets and drive continuous improvement.
* **Key Attributes:** Hands\-on, safety\-conscious, detail\-oriented, and capable of balancing operational efficiency with compliance and people management.

Pay: ₹840,000\.00 \- ₹1,020,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have Computer Knowledge?
* When can you start?
* The factory is located in Vasai, are you open to travel?
* Where are you currently located?
* What is your salary expectation?

Experience:

* manufacturing plant operations in leadership role: 10 years (Required)
* Wire or cables or related product Manufacturing: 3 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* Diploma or Bachelor's \- Mechanical/Prod/Ind Eng or related (Preferred)

title: Hotel Operations Manager Overall Property Management
description:
About Orbit Serviced Apartments

Orbit Serviced Apartments is a premium serviced\-apartment property in Khar West, Mumbai.

We are looking for an **experienced, responsible and hands\-on Hotel Operations Manager** who can take ownership of the **overall day\-to\-day operation of the property**.

The property already has a front\-desk team and housekeeping staff. The responsibility of this role is to **supervise, manage and coordinate these teams and ensure the entire property operates smoothly and professionally.**

This is a **management and ownership role**, not simply a reception position.

Key ResponsibilitiesOverall Hotel Operations

* Take responsibility for the **day\-to\-day running of the entire property**
* Ensure smooth operations across Front Office, Housekeeping and other operational functions
* Monitor staff performance, attendance, grooming, discipline and conduct
* Create clear daily responsibilities and ensure staff follow them
* Identify operational problems and resolve them quickly
* Maintain high standards of service, cleanliness and guest experience
* Report important operational issues directly to management
* Ensure proper handovers between shifts and departments

Front Office

* Supervise the existing front\-desk team
* Ensure smooth check\-ins and check\-outs
* Monitor reservations, room allocations and guest requests
* Ensure guest complaints are handled professionally and promptly
* Monitor guest communication and service standards
* Ensure the front desk is properly staffed at all times
* Train and guide front\-office employees where required

Housekeeping

* Directly supervise the housekeeping team
* Ensure apartments are cleaned and inspected to the required standard
* Establish proper cleaning schedules and checklists
* Conduct regular inspections of rooms and common areas
* Monitor linen, towels, amenities and housekeeping inventory
* Ensure maintenance issues identified by housekeeping are reported and followed up
* Maintain consistent cleanliness standards across the property

Staff Management

* Manage and supervise the operational team
* Monitor attendance and punctuality
* Maintain discipline and professional behaviour
* Train new employees and improve staff performance
* Prepare duty rosters and ensure adequate coverage
* Address operational issues before they become management problems

Guest Experience

* Maintain a high standard of hospitality and guest service
* Personally oversee important guest issues when required
* Monitor reviews and recurring guest complaints
* Ensure guest requests are followed through until completion
* Maintain the premium positioning and standards of Orbit

Property \& Vendor Coordination

* Coordinate with maintenance, security, housekeeping suppliers and other vendors
* Ensure repairs and maintenance issues are followed up until completion
* Monitor operational inventory and consumables
* Ensure the property is always presentable and operational

Who We Are Looking For

We need someone who is **mature, disciplined, extremely responsible and capable of running a property independently.**

The ideal candidate:

* Has strong experience in **hotel / hospitality operations**
* Has previously managed or supervised **Front Office \+ Housekeeping**
* Understands the complete hotel operation, not just one department
* Is comfortable managing staff and maintaining discipline
* Has excellent guest\-handling skills
* Can make decisions independently
* Is proactive and does not wait for management to identify every problem
* Has strong follow\-up and organizational skills
* Is comfortable working in a premium hospitality environment
* Wants a **long\-term position**
* Lives in or around **Khar / Bandra / Santacruz / nearby areas preferred**

Mandatory Experience

**Hotel / hospitality operations experience is mandatory.**

Candidates who have worked only in non\-hospitality industries will not be considered.

Experience as a:

* Hotel Operations Manager
* Assistant Hotel Manager
* Front Office Manager with overall operational responsibility
* Duty Manager
* Property Manager
* Guest Relations / Operations Manager

will be considered.

Important

The Front Desk team is already in place.

We need a **manager who manages the managers/staff, supervises Front Office and Housekeeping, maintains discipline, solves operational problems and takes responsibility for the overall running of the property.**

We are looking for someone who takes **ownership**, maintains standards without constant supervision and can become a long\-term key member of the organization.

Salary

**Competitive salary based on experience and capability.**

Salary will not be the primary limitation for the right candidate.

**Only serious candidates with relevant hotel operations experience should apply.**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
