title: Head – School Partnerships & Growth
description:
HEAD – SALES
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Pan India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 CEO / Business Leadership
   

  

**About EdTerra**
 EdTerra Edventures is a leading experiential learning and educational travel company that designs and delivers immersive learning journeys for school students across India and international destinations.
   

  

 We partner with schools to create meaningful experiences that combine travel, learning, culture, adventure and real\-world exposure.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head – Sales** 
 to lead EdTerra's sales function and drive the next phase of revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a
 **business leadership role** 
 with end\-to\-end ownership of the sales engine—from market strategy and school acquisition to key account growth, sales\-team performance, forecasting and revenue delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a commercially strong, data\-driven and inspiring sales leader who can build scalable sales systems while personally driving strategic relationships with large schools and institutional partners.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. Revenue \& Business Growth
   

  

* Own the overall sales revenue, growth and commercial performance for the business.
* Develop and execute the annual and quarterly sales strategy in line with organizational objectives.
* Translate business targets into territory, segment, product and team\-level targets.
* Identify new revenue opportunities across geographies, school segments and products.
* Drive both new business acquisition and growth of existing accounts.
* Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value, repeat business and wallet share.
* School \& Institutional Partnerships
* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, principals, trustees, coordinators and other key decision\-makers.
* Lead negotiations and closures for strategic/high\-value school accounts.
* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions.
* Create account\-development plans for key schools.
* Drive cross\-selling and up\-selling across EdTerra's domestic, international and experiential learning programmes.
* Act as the senior escalation point for strategic clients.
* Sales Team Leadership
* Lead and mentor the complete sales organization across regions/functions.
* Define team structures, roles, territories, targets and performance expectations.
* Recruit, coach and develop high\-performing sales managers and sales professionals.
* Establish a strong culture of ownership, accountability and performance.
* Conduct structured weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted coaching and development plans.
* Build a strong succession pipeline for critical sales positions.
* Sales Process \& Performance Management
* Build a predictable and scalable sales process from lead generation → qualification → meetings → proposals → negotiation → closure → repeat business.
* Establish clear sales KPIs and performance dashboards.
* Monitor conversion ratios at every stage of the funnel.
* Improve sales productivity and reduce sales\-cycle time.
* Ensure disciplined CRM usage and accurate pipeline management.
* Establish mechanisms for identifying and resolving pipeline bottlenecks.
* Forecasting \& Business Intelligence
* Own the monthly and quarterly sales forecast.
* Maintain strong visibility on pipeline value, probability and expected closures.
* Develop accurate revenue projections based on historical performance and current pipeline.
* Use sales data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Present actionable sales insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Develop territory\-wise and account\-wise performance dashboards.
* Market Expansion
* Identify and evaluate new cities, regions and school segments for expansion.
* Analyse competitor positioning, pricing, offerings and market trends.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and markets.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the education and experiential\-learning ecosystem.
* Work with the leadership team to evaluate strategic partnerships and new business channels.
* Key Account Growth \& Retention
* Build a structured Key Account Management framework.
* Develop annual growth plans for strategic schools.
* Drive repeat journeys, renewals and increased engagement with existing schools.
* Monitor account health, satisfaction and revenue potential.
* Ensure high\-value clients receive proactive relationship management.
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to resolve critical client concerns.
* Commercial \& Margin Ownership
* Balance revenue growth with profitability and contribution margins.
* Participate in pricing and commercial strategy.
* Establish appropriate discounting and negotiation frameworks.
* Monitor deal economics and commercial effectiveness.
* Work closely with Finance to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding receivables.
* Ensure sales commitments remain commercially and operationally viable.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


**Work Closely With**
* Marketing – lead generation, campaigns and brand positioning
* Product – product development, pricing and market fit
* Operations – delivery feasibility and execution
* Finance – pricing, margins, collections and commercial controls
* HR – manpower planning, hiring and capability development
* Customer Experience – client satisfaction and retention


 Ensure seamless alignment between
 **what is sold, what is promised and what is delivered** 
 .
   

  

 Success in the First 12 Months
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Deliver agreed annual revenue and growth targets.
* Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
* Improve sales conversion and sales productivity.
* Strengthen the key\-school account portfolio.
* Increase repeat business and customer retention.
* Build a high\-performing and accountable sales leadership team.
* Improve forecast accuracy.
* Establish standardized sales processes and performance dashboards.
* Identify and successfully penetrate new markets.
* Improve revenue quality and contribution margins.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Business**
* Revenue Achievement %
* YoY Revenue Growth
* Gross Contribution / Margin
* New Revenue


**Acquisition**
* New Schools Acquired
* New Revenue from New Accounts
* Conversion Rate
* Average Deal Value


**Retention \& Growth**
* Repeat Revenue %
* School Retention
* Key Account Growth
* Revenue per Strategic Account


**Sales Productivity**
* Pipeline Coverage
* Sales Cycle
* Lead\-to\-Meeting Conversion
* Meeting\-to\-Closure Conversion
* Individual \& Team Productivity


**Forecasting**
* Forecast Accuracy
* Pipeline Health
* Closure Predictability


**People**
* Team Target Achievement
* Sales Attrition
* Manager Productivity
* Internal Talent Development


 Candidate ProfileExperience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in B2B / institutional / consultative sales.
* 4\+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing sizeable sales teams.
* Proven experience owning significant revenue targets.
* Experience managing multi\-city or multi\-region sales operations preferred.
* Strong experience in relationship\-led businesses such as education, EdTech, travel, hospitality, SaaS, media or other B2B services will be advantageous.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management or a related field preferred.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Revenue \& P\&L Orientation
* B2B / Institutional Sales
* Enterprise/Key Account Management
* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Sales Forecasting
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Market Expansion
* Team Building \& Leadership
* Coaching \& Performance Management
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Executive Communication


 Leadership Traits We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks like a business owner, not just a salesperson.
* Is highly accountable for outcomes.
* Can operate strategically while remaining close to the ground.
* Uses data to make decisions.
* Builds strong, long\-term relationships.
* Can challenge existing processes and create better systems.
* Develops people rather than simply managing them.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Has the energy and maturity to represent EdTerra with senior school stakeholders.


 Why Join EdTerra?
   

  

 At EdTerra, sales is not simply about selling a product.
   

  

 It is about building long\-term partnerships with schools and helping create experiences that can have a lasting impact on students.
   

  

 As Head – Sales, you will have the opportunity to
 **shape the sales organization, influence business strategy, build a high\-performing team and directly contribute to EdTerra's next phase of growth.**

title: Head of Operations – Interior Fit-Out & Project Execution
description:
**1\. Role Purpose**

The Head of Operations will be responsible for leading and controlling the **end\-to\-end operational delivery of Geographics Interiors LLP’s projects** across locations.

The role will ensure that projects are delivered **on time, within approved budgets, as per quality standards, safely and in line with client expectations**, while maintaining operational efficiency and project profitability.

The position will act as the **single\-point operational authority** between Management, Projects, Design, MEP, Procurement, Commercial/Accounts, Vendors, Contractors and Site Teams.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Execution \& Delivery**

* Lead the execution of multiple interior fit\-out and turnkey projects simultaneously.
* Take overall ownership of project delivery from project handover to final client handover.
* Ensure project execution is aligned with approved drawings, BOQ, specifications, timelines and commercial commitments.
* Review project schedules, milestones and critical\-path activities.
* Monitor planned vs. actual progress and take corrective action wherever required.
* Identify project delays, bottlenecks and dependencies at an early stage.
* Ensure timely completion, snag closure and final handover.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with Project Managers and Site Teams.

**B. Operations \& Resource Planning**

* Plan and allocate Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, MEP resources and other manpower based on project requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower across all active projects.
* Identify manpower gaps and arrange timely deployment.
* Review site productivity and team performance.
* Develop a structured manpower/resource deployment plan for upcoming projects.
* Ensure no critical project is affected due to resource shortages.

**C. Project Management Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor Project Managers, Site Engineers and operational teams.
* Establish clear accountability and ownership for every project.
* Set project\-level performance expectations and review them periodically.
* Monitor PM/site team performance through measurable KPIs.
* Resolve internal conflicts and operational issues.
* Develop a culture of ownership, discipline and timely execution.

**D. Procurement \& Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Purchase/Procurement for project material requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of material requisitions based on project schedules.
* Monitor material availability against project requirements.
* Track critical materials and long\-lead items.
* Coordinate with vendors, contractors and subcontractors for timely execution.
* Monitor vendor/contractor performance, quality and delivery commitments.
* Escalate procurement delays that may impact project timelines.
* Support commercial teams in vendor negotiations and operational decisions.

**E. Cost Control \& Project Profitability**

* Monitor project costs against approved budgets and BOQs.
* Review manpower productivity, material wastage, rework and subcontractor costs.
* Identify cost overruns at an early stage.
* Monitor project variations, additional works and client changes.
* Ensure commercial implications of project decisions are communicated to Management/Commercial teams.
* Work with Accounts/Commercial teams to monitor project profitability and cost\-to\-complete.
* Drive cost optimization without compromising quality or delivery.

**F. Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a senior escalation point for key clients and project stakeholders.
* Participate in important client meetings and project reviews.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants, architects and PMC representatives.
* Resolve critical operational issues and client escalations.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are properly communicated to internal teams and tracked to closure.
* Support the Project Team in achieving high client satisfaction and successful handovers.

**G. Design, Technical \& MEP Coordination**

* Ensure smooth coordination between Design, Projects and Site Teams.
* Review critical design/drawing issues affecting execution.
* Ensure drawings, BOQs, specifications and site requirements are aligned before execution.
* Coordinate with MEP, Civil, Interior and other specialist teams.
* Ensure technical issues and RFIs are resolved within required timelines.
* Prevent execution delays arising from design or coordination gaps.

**H. Quality \& Safety**

* Establish and monitor project quality standards across all sites.
* Ensure execution is as per approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Implement project quality checklists and inspection systems.
* Monitor workmanship, material quality and installation standards.
* Drive systematic snagging and snag closure.
* Ensure pre\-handover quality inspections are completed.
* Ensure compliance with company safety requirements and applicable site safety standards.
* Take immediate corrective action on serious quality or safety concerns.

**I. SOP \& Process Improvement**

* Develop, implement and continuously improve Operations SOPs.
* Standardize processes from project handover through execution and final handover.
* Establish clear workflows between:
* **Sales → Design → BOQ/Estimation → Procurement → Projects → Site → Commercial → Handover**
* Identify operational inefficiencies and introduce corrective systems.
* Implement standard project review formats, reporting systems and escalation mechanisms.
* Ensure SOP compliance across projects.**J. MIS \& Management Reporting**

Submit regular Operations MIS to the Management covering:

* Project\-wise progress
* Planned vs. actual completion
* Project\-wise manpower
* Material status
* Procurement delays
* Cost/budget status
* Project profitability
* Vendor/contractor performance
* Quality issues
* Safety concerns
* Client escalations
* Project risks
* Critical decisions required from Management
* Upcoming project resource requirements

**K. Risk \& Escalation Management**

* Maintain a project risk register for major projects.
* Identify risks related to manpower, material, design, procurement, client approvals, vendors and timelines.
* Ensure timely escalation of critical matters to Management.
* Develop recovery plans for delayed projects.
* Monitor corrective actions until closure.
* Ensure operational issues are resolved at the appropriate level without unnecessary escalation.

**3\. Key Performance Areas / KPIs**

The Head of Operations will be measured on:

* **On\-Time Project Delivery**
* **Project Budget \& Cost Control**
* **Project Gross Margin / Profitability**
* **Manpower Productivity \& Utilization**
* **Material Availability \& Procurement Efficiency**
* **Quality Compliance**
* **Snag Closure \& Handover Performance**
* **Client Satisfaction \& Escalation Closure**
* **Vendor \& Contractor Performance**
* **Safety \& Site Compliance**
* **SOP Implementation \& Process Discipline**
* **Accuracy and Timeliness of Operations MIS**
* **Project Risk Identification \& Resolution**
* **Overall Operational Efficiency**

**4\. Decision\-Making Authority**

The Head of Operations will have authority to:

* Recommend/approve operational manpower deployment within approved structures.
* Reallocate project resources based on business priorities.
* Escalate underperforming vendors/contractors.
* Recommend replacement of non\-performing project resources.
* Direct corrective actions for project delays and quality issues.
* Escalate commercial deviations and project risks to Management.
* Recommend process improvements and operational SOP changes.
* Recommend additional manpower, vendors or resources based on project requirements.

Major commercial commitments, salary decisions, contractual commitments and deviations beyond approved budgets will remain subject to Management approval.

**5\. Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related discipline.
* PMP / RICS / NICMAR / MBA in Operations or Project Management would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **12–18 years of overall experience**, preferably in commercial interior fit\-out, turnkey projects, workplace interiors or construction.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior project/operations leadership role.
* Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience managing large project teams, contractors and vendors.
* Experience handling corporate, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, retail or large\-scale fit\-out projects will be preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* Interior Fit\-Out Project Management
* Operations Leadership
* Project Planning \& Scheduling

* Client \& Stakeholder Management
* Procurement Coordination

description:
**Manager, Leather Cutting Department** 




**Company:** 
 Orion Fashions/ Orion CONMERX
 



**Department:** 
 Production – Leather Garments
 



**Position:** 
 Manager – Leather Cutting Department
 



**Experience:** 
 10–15 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram / Manesar
 



**Job Purpose** 




 To independently manage the complete Leather Cutting Department and ensure optimum leather utilization, accurate cutting, minimum wastage, timely feeding to production, and adherence to buyer and quality standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage complete day\-to\-day operations of the
 **Leather Cutting Department** 
 .
* Prepare and execute
 **daily, weekly and style\-wise cutting plans** 
 as per production requirements.
* Ensure correct
 **leather selection, grading, shade matching, defect identification and panel allocation** 
 before cutting.
* Monitor
 **cut plan vs. actual cutting** 
 and ensure timely feeding of cut components to production lines.
* Control
 **leather consumption and wastage** 
 and continuously work towards improving leather utilization.
* Verify cutting as per approved
 **patterns, size ratios, specifications and production files** 
 .
* Ensure correct
 **numbering, bundling, shade segregation and size\-wise control** 
 of cut components.
* Coordinate closely with
 **Merchandising, PPC, Leather Store, Pattern, Production, Quality and Planning teams** 
 .
* Ensure availability of required leather before starting bulk cutting and immediately highlight shortages or quality concerns.
* Monitor cutter productivity, manpower utilization and daily targets.
* Allocate work to cutters based on skill level, style complexity and production priorities.
* Maintain accurate records of
 **leather issued, leather consumed, cutting output, balance leather and wastage** 
 .
* Conduct regular checks to prevent incorrect cutting, mismatching, avoidable defects and excess consumption.
* Ensure replacement panels are controlled and properly recorded.
* Coordinate with the Pattern Department for pattern corrections, consumption concerns and technical issues.
* Ensure cutting department follows approved
 **SOPs, buyer requirements and quality standards** 
 .
* Conduct root\-cause analysis for cutting\-related quality problems and implement corrective action.
* Maintain proper housekeeping, discipline, safety and organized storage within the cutting area.
* Train and develop cutters, supervisors and other department team members.
* Prepare and submit
 **daily MIS / cutting reports** 
 to management.
* Support management in productivity improvement, cost reduction and process\-standardization initiatives.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Cutting target vs. actual achievement.
* Leather consumption vs. approved consumption.
* Leather utilization percentage.
* Wastage and rejection percentage.
* Timely feeding to production.
* Replacement/re\-cut percentage.
* Cutting quality and accuracy.
* Manpower productivity.
* Adherence to production and shipment schedules.



**Candidate Profile** 



* **10–15 years of relevant experience** 
 in leather garment cutting, preferably in a reputed leather garment export house.
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **sheep, lamb, goat and other garment leathers** 
 .
* Excellent understanding of leather defects, grain, stretch, shade variation and panel matching.
* Strong knowledge of
 **pattern placement, leather consumption and wastage control** 
 .
* Experience managing a sizeable team of cutters and supervisors.
* Good coordination and problem\-solving abilities.
* Should be comfortable working with
 **Excel/MIS reports and production data** 
 .
* Strong leadership, discipline and accountability.
* Ability to work under production and shipment deadlines.



**Qualification** 




 Graduate / Diploma in Leather Technology, Garment Manufacturing, Production or a related field preferred. For this position,

**Preferred Industry Background** 




 Leather Garments Manufacturing / Leather Export House / International Apparel Manufacturing.

* Develop a scalable regional delivery model that creates the right balance between centralized operations, market expertise, and vendor\-supported delivery.

* Continuously assess the maturity of APAC benefits operations and develop initiatives that strengthen service quality, colleague experience, controls, resilience, and scalability.

title: Plant Head (Washing Machine Manufacturing)
description:
Job Description \- Plant Head (Washing Machine Manufacturing)
 



  





 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



 Reports to: Managing Director
 



 Team size: \~200 (direct \+ indirect)
 



 CTC: ₹12 LPA
 



 Department: Manufacturing / Operations
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 Own end\-to\-end plant operations for washing machine manufacturing \- injection moulding, sub\-assembly, and final assembly lines. The role carries full accountability for production planning, output, quality, manpower, cost control and plant discipline. The right person is a hands\-on moulding expert who can also run a shop floor of 200 people and defend a costing sheet in front of management.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \#Moulding
 



 \- Full technical ownership of the injection moulding shop — machine setting, process parameters, cycle time optimisation, material drying, shot weight and rejection control.
 



 \- Mould maintenance and repair: preventive maintenance schedules, trial runs, troubleshooting short shots, flash, warpage, sink marks, weld lines, and colour/streak issues.
 



 \- Coordinate with tool room and mould suppliers on new mould development, T0/T1 trials and corrections.
 



 \- Control regrind usage, scrap generation and material yield.
 



  





 \#Assembly \& Production
 



 \- Plan and execute daily, weekly and monthly production schedules for washing machine models against the sales/dispatch plan.
 



 \- Line balancing, manpower deployment, cycle time and takt time management across assembly lines.
 



 \- Drive OEE, first\-pass yield and on\-time dispatch; escalate and resolve line stoppages.
 



 \- Coordinate with stores, purchase and quality to prevent line\-down situations.
 



  





 \#Materials
 



 \- Working knowledge of plastics (PP, ABS, HIPS, PC blends), masterbatch, sheet metal, motors, gearboxes, wiring harness, PCBA and packaging materials.
 



 \- Material planning, BOM validation, inventory norms, WIP control and shortage management.
 



 \- Support vendor development and material cost reduction initiatives.
 



  





 \#Costing \& Reporting (Excel)
 



 \- Build and maintain product costing sheets — material cost, conversion cost, moulding cost per part, labour, overheads and scrap cost.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Location: Gurgaon (on\-site)** 




**Experience: 2\-6 years** 




  





 Oyela is a fast\-growing fashion D2C brand redefining the Indian fashion ecosystem by combining technology and design. In just a few months we've scaled to a multi\-million ARR by delivering trend\-driven, high\-quality apparel to a new generation of fashion\-forward consumers.
 



  





**Role\- Category Manager** 




  





 Own a category end to end \- what we make, how much of it we make, what it costs, what it sells for and what it earns. You will build the range, drive the buying calendar with design and sourcing, and carry the number for revenue, margin and inventory health. This is a P\&L ownership role with targets attached, not a coordination role.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 



* Category P\&L: Revenue, gross margin and contribution margin after returns, discounts and marketing spend.
* Range \& assortment planning: Build the seasonal range architecture \- sub\-categories, price bands, colour and size depth, core vs trend vs hero styles.
* Buying \& OTB: Own open\-to\-buy, first buy quantities and reorder calls. Balance newness against sell\-through and hold the discipline of buying to plan.
* Vendor \& costing: Work with sourcing team to finalise costing approval, MOQ, lead times
* Pricing \& markdown: Set MRP and selling price ladders, build the discount and markdown calendar, and protect margin through sale events.
* Liquidation plan \- Own the ageing and liquidation plan for slow movers.
* Inventory health: Own sell\-through, weeks of cover, stock turns, ageing buckets and out\-of\-stock on best sellers. No stock outs on winners, no dead stock at season end.
* Weekly trading: Run the style\-level business review \- what to push, repeat, reprice or kill. Work with marketing on hero style selection, with catalog on listing quality (titles, images, attributes, size charts) and with the site team on collections, sort order and merchandising.
* Returns \& quality loop: Track return reasons by style \- fit, quality, description mismatch \- and close the loop with design, sourcing and quality before the next buy.
* Trend \& competition: Track competitor assortments, price points and launch cadence, and predict range plan 150 days beforehand.
* Own website sales runs and curation, integrate influencer content to website



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 2–6 yrs in fashion / D2C / ecommerce
* Strong trend sense \+ commercial thinking
* Comfortable with data (conversion, AOV, sell\-through)
* High ownership, fast execution mindset
* Working knowledge of Shopify and/or marketplace back\-ends (Myntra, Ajio, Amazon, Flipkart) for catalog, pricing and inventory.
* Sharp commercial judgement and the willingness to kill a style you personally liked because the data says so.



  





**What we offer:** 




 Full ownership of a category with direct founder access, the autonomy to build the range, pricing and vendor strategy from the ground up, a collaborative and growth\-focused culture, and competitive compensation with performance\-based growth.

title: Manager – ERP Implementation/Transformation Readiness, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
   

  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance


**How You Will Contribute**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation. The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Expertise across one or more of the following areas
   

  

* FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment
* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current\-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
* Finance Process Readiness
* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period\-end and year\-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet\-driven, highly customized, or non\-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future\-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
* Finance Master Data \& Chart of Accounts Readiness
* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data. Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master\-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
* Functional Readiness
* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori\-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean\-core readiness assessments.
* Data Migration Readiness
* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open\-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
* Integration \& Technology Readiness
* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with: MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
* Reporting \& Management Information Readiness
* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
* Controls \& Compliance Readiness
* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation\-of\-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future\-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
* Stakeholder \& Program Leadership
* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
* Team Leadership
* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.


**Qualifications**
* 6–11 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Finance processes and their ERP enablement.
* Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts, financial master data, organizational structures, reporting, controls, and data migration.
* Experience working with Finance leadership and senior business stakeholders.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and complex transformation workstreams.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

 Profitability \& Commercial Control

 Quotation TAT \| Query\-to\-Conversion Ratio \| Sales \& Gross Profit \| Proposal Accuracy \| Operational Excellence \| Client Satisfaction \| Repeat Business \| Team Productivity \| File Profitability \| Zero Major Service Failures

 ∙ Good destination and supplier knowledge for India and international markets.

 ∙ Commercially strong with excellent negotiation and problem\-solving abilities.

 ∙ Strong client communication and team leadership skills.

 A hands\-on manager and problem solver who believes that speed, accuracy and execution are equally important.
 



  





**Someone who can ensure:** 




 Query Received → Quote Sent on Time → Follow\-up → Conversion → Flawless Execution → Profitability → Happy Client → Repeat Business
 



  





**The ultimate KRA of this role:** 




 No enquiry should be delayed, no confirmed business should be poorly operated, and every file should be delivered professionally and profitably.

About ImagingIQ

ImagingIQ is an AI\-powered medical imaging and diagnostics company developing solutions that support radiologists in clinical decision\-making through AI\-assisted imaging, 3D visualization, and structured reporting.

Our current focus includes brain MRI oncology, with expansion into brain CT, trauma, vascular imaging, and other clinical applications. Our approach combines advanced technology with radiologist validation to enhance clinical workflows and support patient\-centered care.

Role Overview

We are looking for a **Head / VP – Operations** to lead operational strategy, execution, and business scaling across our AI\-powered medical imaging and healthcare technology business.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of healthcare operations, business leadership, technology implementation, and execution, with experience in medical imaging, radiology, diagnostics, healthtech, or related healthcare technology environments.

This role will work closely with the Founder/CEO and collaborate across product, technology, clinical, business development, and customer\-facing teams to build scalable operations, strengthen enterprise relationships, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Strategic \& Operational Leadership**

* Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with business objectives and growth plans.
* Build scalable operating models, processes, and governance frameworks.
* Drive operational efficiency, productivity, service quality, and continuous improvement.
* Establish KPIs, dashboards, and performance review mechanisms to track business outcomes.

**2\. Healthcare Technology Implementation \& Delivery**

* Lead implementation, deployment, and operational delivery of AI\-enabled healthcare and medical imaging solutions.
* Ensure smooth integration of technology into hospital, diagnostic centre, and radiology workflows.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to address implementation challenges and improve product adoption.
* Drive customer onboarding, implementation timelines, service delivery, and operational readiness.

**3\. Medical Imaging \& Clinical Workflow Operations**

* Build a strong understanding of medical imaging, radiology, and diagnostic workflows.
* Work with radiologists, hospital administrators, diagnostic centres, and healthcare stakeholders to improve workflow efficiency and adoption.
* Support the integration of imaging technology into existing clinical systems and processes.
* Experience with PACS, RIS, DICOM, and related imaging ecosystems will be highly relevant.

**4\. Business Growth \& Commercial Operations**

* Support business expansion, enterprise customer engagement, and strategic partnerships.
* Drive operational initiatives that improve revenue growth, customer retention, and service performance.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support customer acquisition, account growth, and commercial execution.
* Monitor operational budgets, resource allocation, and financial performance.

**5\. Enterprise Customer \& Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain relationships with hospitals, diagnostic networks, healthcare enterprises, and technology partners.
* Lead customer implementation reviews, escalations, and operational performance discussions.
* Understand enterprise healthcare customer requirements and translate them into actionable operational plans.
* Exposure to the US healthcare ecosystem and international healthcare markets will be an advantage.

**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Team Development**

* Work closely with product, engineering, clinical, sales, and business leadership.
* Establish clear accountability, performance standards, and team development plans.

title: Production Manager - Embroidery
description:
**Production Manager – Embroidery (Hand \& CME)**

​**Company:** Luxury Bridal Garment Manufacturing Company

**Location**: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Servicing flagship stores in Chandni Chowk \& Mehrauli, Delhi)

Position Type: Full\-time

**Experience Required**: Minimum 8\+ Years

**Education**: Graduate preferably Commerce (B.Com or equivalent)

​**About the Role**

​We are a premier luxury bridal couture brand specializing in richly embellished, handcrafted, and Computerized Machine Embroidery (CME) garments. We are seeking a highly experienced, proactive, and detail\-oriented Production Manager – Embroidery to oversee and streamline our complete embroidery operations.

​In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end work allocation (in\-house and external vendors), vendor management, quality assurance, timely delivery, and financial tracking for all hand and machine embroidery production.

​**Key Responsibilities**

​**1\. Work Allocation \& Production Management**

​Resource Optimization: Strategically allocate hand and CME embroidery work between in\-house production units and external vendors for optimum capacity utilization and cost efficiency.

​Timeline Management: Ensure strict adherence to production schedules to meet delivery deadlines for client orders across our Noida, Chandni Chowk and Mehrauli retail stores.

​Capacity Planning: Monitor day\-to\-day operations and balance workloads to avoid production bottlenecks.

​**2\. Vendor Management \& Onboarding**

​Vendor Identification: Sourcing and identifying potential, high\-quality embroidery vendors/job\-workers across North India.

​Rate Negotiation \& Onboarding: Negotiate competitive rates, clear commercial terms, and seamlessly onboard reliable new vendors into the company system.

​Vendor Evaluation: Periodically assess vendor performance based on turnaround time, quality compliance, and cost efficiency.

​**3\. Systems \& Process Tracking**

​Allocation Tracking System: Design, implement, and maintain robust systems to track vendor\-wise and unit\-wise work allocation.

​Financial \& Bill Management: Track and verify all vendor bills against delivered quantities and approved rate cards; manage vendor ledger updates and ensure timely, systematic vendor payment recommendations.

​**4\. Quality Control \& Assurance**

​Quality Standards: Maintain stringent luxury\-grade quality control for all hand embellishments (Zardozi, Dabka, Gota Patti, Aari, Threadwork, etc.) and Computerized Machine Embroidery (CME).

​Defect Reduction: Inspect raw/finished embellished panels before assembling to minimize rework and raw material wastage.

​**Candidate Profile \& Qualifications**

​Education: Minimum Graduate in Commerce (B.Com or equivalent finance/commerce degree) to effectively manage billing, ledger tracking, and commercial negotiations.

​Experience: Minimum 8\+ years of direct experience managing embroidery production (both Hand \& CME) in luxury bridalwear or high\-end couture garments.

​Technical Knowledge: Deep, hands\-on knowledge of various traditional and modern embroidery techniques, fabrics, thread types, and embellishment materials.

​Vendor Network: Established network and strong working knowledge of suitable embroidery vendors, karigars, and job\-workers across North India.

​**Skills:**

​Strong commercial acumen and rate negotiation skills.

​Proficiency in maintaining tracking sheets/ERP software for inventory and billing.

​Excellent leadership, communication, and vendor coordination abilities.

​Meticulous eye for detail and commitment to luxury finishing standards.

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Site Operations Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**About the Role**

  

The Site Operations Lead is responsible for building and leading the Operations function for Haleon's new greenfield manufacturing facility in Indore. The role will provide operational leadership during design, commissioning, qualification, start\-up and early stabilization, and subsequently lead manufacturing operations to deliver safety, quality, service level, cost and people engagement objectives.  



  

The role will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HAPS, EHS and Project teams to establish operational systems, build workforce capability and ensure successful commissioning and ramp\-up of the manufacturing site.


The incumbent will drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, capability development, performance management and continuous improvement while creating a safe, compliant and high\-performing manufacturing culture.


Build a future\-ready Operations organization that delivers safe start\-up, reliable supply, competitive performance and sustainable growth.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own and deliver site performance across Safety, Quality, GMP Compliance, Cost, Service, Productivity, and People Development.
* This role joins the project at an early stage to ensure operational requirements are incorporated into the facility execution. It leads operations and technical teams through a vertical startup. Then owns performance of the people and system once the site is operational.
* Lead manufacturing and packaging operations, ensuring achievement of production, OEE, cost, waste, and service targets (ATS adherence to schedule and ATP adherence to planning).
* Drive a strong safety\-first and quality culture, ensuring compliance with EHS, GMP, regulatory, and data integrity requirements.
* Build, coach, and develop high\-performing teams through capability building, succession planning, and performance management.
* Accountable for manufacturing budgets, MCC / PCC conversion costs, labor productivity, and delivery of productivity commitments.
* Lead operational readiness, commissioning, qualification, validation, start\-up, and stabilization of manufacturing operations.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and technical teams to ensure reliable product supply and operational excellence.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks while ensuring sustainable business performance Complexity/Scope
* Integrate Haleon Operational Excellence strategies from inception by working closely with Site Director.
* Integrate industry 4\.0 capabilities
* Establish effective daily management systems (HAPS), performance reviews, visual management, and KPI governance.
Champion continuous improvement, loss elimination, problem\-solving, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives  
* 

  

**Qualification and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Science, Manufacturing, Operations or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM is desirable
* Overall 15\+ years of industrial experience in manufacturing sector.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food or another regulated manufacturing sector.
* Demonstrated experience leading Manufacturing and Packaging operations, production performance, workforce capability and cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience supporting a greenfield facility, major expansion, commissioning, qualification, validation, technology transfer or manufacturing start\-up is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of GMP, EHS, operational risk management, production planning, OEE, cost control and continuous improvement systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make risk\-based decisions and translate project milestones into operational readiness and sustainable performance.
Relevant certification or practical experience in Lean, Six Sigma, TPM or another recognized operational\-excellence system is desirable.  
* 

  

**Soft Skills**

* Strong people leadership capability to build, engage and hold a large frontline organization accountable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence Project, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain and senior leaders.
* Hands\-on, collaborative and decisive leadership style with strong execution and change\-management capability.
* Excellent oral, written and presentation skills, with clear communication from shop\-floor teams to senior leadership.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, risk\-based decision\-making and commercial awareness.
* High resilience, ownership and ability to deliver in a fast\-paced greenfield and start\-up environment.
Proficiency in MS Office and working knowledge of SAP, Power BI, OEE, problem solving and digital manufacturing performance systems.  
* 

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety, Quality \& Compliance – Waste/ Scrap%, CAPA Closure Effectiveness, Deviation Reduction, GMP / EHS Compliance Adherence, Safety Observation Closure %, Zero LTI.
* Operational Readiness \& Performance \- Commissioning and start\-up milestones, schedule adherence (ATS), OEE, throughput, right\-first time (RFT), Cost (PCC, MCC), Waste, Customer Service Level (% OTIF) and productivity.
* People \& Organization \- Workforce readiness, drive shop floor associate ownership, role qualification, engagement, leadership capability, succession strength and a sustainable ownership culture.
Unplanned Downtime (hrs./month),Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), AM / PM and maturity assessment and Haleon Operational Excellence pillar drive and maturity assessment.  
* 

**Job Posting End Date**

2026\-10\-22  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

****Job Description****
**About TaskUs:** 
 TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next\-generation customer experience to fast\-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud\-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest\-growing sectors, including social media, e\-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride\-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
   

  

 The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty\-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
   

  

 It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

**What We Offer:** 
 At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well\-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your teammates and the other departments.
   

  

 Being a
 **Team Leader** 
 , you will manage the day\-to\-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses \- so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience \- which is the main thrust of your department.
   

  

 You must be adept at creating reports of your team's performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.
   

  

 So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Leader?
   

  

****Requirements:****
 So, what are we looking for?
   

  

 We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader. Someone with at least one (1\) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 10 \+ teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company. We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above\-average technical know\-how.
   

  

 If you have previous experience working on the phone, email and live chat customer support roles, then that's a plus in your favor. If you're familiar with E\-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts \- then we definitely want to talk to you.
   

  

 If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
   

  

 TaskUs is an Equal Opportunity Employer

 TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.

Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. title: Manager - Cushion & Covers
description:
**About Group Bayport** 




  





 Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e\-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operating in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers \& All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North Cape.
 



 From comprehensive trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signage and shades, eclectic personal accents, and home décor, we help our customers, clients, and partners make a personalized statement through customization.
 



 While our advanced technology and customer focus are key strengths, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
 



 For more about Group Bayport, please visit:
 



**Website:** 
 https://groupbayport.com/about\-us/
 



**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
 



  





**Designation: Manager – Cushion \& Covers** 




**Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Production Manager – Cushion \& Cover Category to lead end\-to\-end production operations for our cushion, cover, soft furnishing, and related customized textile products.
 



 The incumbent will be responsible for managing production planning and execution, cutting, stitching/sewing, filling, finishing, quality, manpower productivity, machine utilization, and timely order fulfilment.
 



 The role requires strong expertise in soft textile products, cushion and cover manufacturing, stitching operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and large\-scale shop\-floor operations. The candidate will work closely with PPC, Quality, SCM, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance, Design, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure efficient and timely execution of customer orders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Production Operations Management** 



* Lead day\-to\-day production operations for cushion, covers, soft furnishings, and customized textile products.
* Manage end\-to\-end manufacturing processes including fabric cutting, printing/customization, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, finishing, packing, and dispatch.
* Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
* Optimize manpower and machine utilization to achieve planned production volumes.
* Ensure production schedules are executed as per customer requirements and committed delivery timelines.
* Monitor shop\-floor operations and proactively address bottlenecks affecting production output.



**2\. Production Planning \& Execution** 



* Coordinate closely with PPC and SCM teams to ensure availability of fabrics, trims, fillers, accessories, packaging materials, and other required raw materials.
* Plan production capacity based on order volumes, product complexity, manpower availability, and machine capacity.
* Monitor WIP, production flow, line balancing, machine loading, and bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective production sequencing for multiple SKUs, customized orders, and varying product specifications.
* Establish effective shift planning, production allocation, and handover mechanisms.
* Ensure smooth execution of urgent and priority orders without compromising quality.



**3\. Cutting, Stitching \& Sewing Operations** 



* Drive operational efficiency across cutting, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, and finishing processes.
* Optimize cutting layouts and fabric utilization to minimize wastage.
* Improve stitching productivity through appropriate machine allocation, line balancing, and operator skill mapping.
* Monitor sewing machine efficiency, operator productivity, cycle times, and line output.
* Identify process constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Standardize processes and SOPs across different product categories and production lines.



**4\. Quality Management** 



* Ensure adherence to defined product specifications, workmanship standards, and customer requirements.
* Minimize defects, rejection, rework, fabric wastage, stitching defects, dimensional deviations, and finishing issues.
* Work closely with QA/QC teams to establish process quality checkpoints.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring quality issues.
* Ensure consistency in dimensions, stitching quality, filling density, finishing, appearance, and overall product quality.
* Monitor quality metrics and implement continuous improvement initiatives.



**5\. Manpower \& Shop\-Floor Management** 



* Lead supervisors, line leaders, operators, tailors, cutters, helpers, and other shop\-floor personnel.
* Plan manpower deployment based on production requirements and skill availability.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and workforce utilization.
* Develop skill matrices and identify training requirements for operators and supervisors.
* Drive multi\-skilling and cross\-training initiatives to improve workforce flexibility.
* Build a performance\-oriented, disciplined, and safety\-focused production culture.



**6\. Machine \& Equipment Management** 



* Ensure optimum utilization of stitching, sewing, cutting, printing, filling, and finishing equipment.
* Coordinate with Maintenance teams to minimize machine breakdowns and production downtime.
* Monitor machine efficiency and support preventive maintenance initiatives.
* Identify requirements for new machines, tooling, automation, and process improvements.
* Support machine installation, trials, commissioning, and production stabilization.
* Evaluate opportunities for automation in repetitive and high\-volume production processes.



**7\. Productivity \& Process Improvement** 



* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, line balancing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improve productivity through optimization of manpower, machine utilization, process flow, and cycle times.
* Identify opportunities to reduce material wastage, rework, overtime, and production costs.
* Analyze production MIS and KPI dashboards to identify performance gaps.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for productivity, efficiency, quality, wastage, downtime, and on\-time production.
* Drive standardization and process improvement across the cushion and cover manufacturing operations.



**8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Work closely with PPC, SCM, Quality, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance, Design, Product Development, and Warehouse teams.
* Coordinate with Design/Product teams to understand new product specifications and manufacturing requirements.
* Support new product introduction (NPI), sampling, trials, and production scale\-up.
* Ensure smooth transition of new products from sampling to mass production.
* Resolve production\-related issues impacting order fulfillment and customer commitments.



**9\. Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure adherence to EHS and statutory requirements across the production floor.
* Maintain safe working practices across cutting, stitching, filling, printing, and finishing operations.
* Conduct regular shop\-floor audits and ensure timely closure of safety observations.
* Promote 5S, workplace discipline, housekeeping, and safe equipment handling.



  





**Key Deliverables** 



* Achievement of daily/monthly production targets.
* Improved production efficiency and machine utilization.
* Reduction in rejection, rework, wastage, and production losses.
* Improved stitching, cutting, filling, and finishing productivity.
* Improved fabric utilization and reduction in material wastage.
* Timely completion of customized customer orders.
* Effective manpower utilization and productivity improvement.
* Reduction in machine downtime and process bottlenecks.
* Successful execution of new product introductions and production scale\-ups.
* Controlled manufacturing cost and continuous process improvement.
* Safe, disciplined, and compliant production operations.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Textile Engineering, Production, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in textile, home furnishing, soft furnishing, cushion, cover, upholstery, garmenting, or related manufacturing operations.
* Strong experience in cutting, stitching/sewing, filling, finishing, and soft textile product manufacturing.
* Experience managing large shop\-floor manpower and multiple production lines/shifts.
* Strong understanding of production planning, line balancing, productivity improvement, quality management, and manufacturing KPIs.
* Exposure to Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, and process improvement will be preferred.
* Experience in customized/high\-SKU or e\-commerce manufacturing environments will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, people\-management, and cross\-functional coordination skills.

 Cutting \& Sorting
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To manage the complete throughput of the Cutting Department — including cutting machines, manual cutting, and the sorting team — by ensuring high people productivity, optimal machine efficiency, minimal fabric and foam wastage, timely order execution based on ageing, accurate cut\-kit dispatch to vendors, and error\-free cutting and sorting to eliminate kit returns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Throughput \& Productivity Management
* 
+ Own end\-to\-end throughput of all cutting machines and the sorting team.
+ Monitor and drive machine efficiency (OEE) and operator productivity on a daily/shift basis.
+ Track output vs. plan for cutting and sorting; identify and resolve bottlenecks in real time.
+ Set and review productivity benchmarks (pieces/hour, kits/day, machine utilization %) for operators and machines.

* Cutting Operations (Fabric, Foam \& Manual)
* 
+ Plan and supervise fabric cutting, foam cutting, and manual cutting operations.
+ Deploy manual cutting judiciously for small\-scale/low\-volume requirements to optimize material usage and reduce wastage.
+ Continuously identify opportunities to reduce fabric and foam wastage through better marker planning, lay optimization, and cutting sequence.
+ Ensure correct cutting specifications, patterns, and sizes are followed as per order requirements.

* Order Prioritization \& Scheduling
* 
+ Track ageing of all pending orders and use ageing data to prioritize the daily/weekly cutting schedule.
+ Prepare and maintain a cutting schedule/plan aligned with dispatch commitments and order priority.
+ Coordinate with planning, merchandising, and production teams to align cutting schedules with overall production flow.

* Sorting \& Kit Management
* 
+ Supervise the sorting team to ensure accurate sorting and kitting of cut components.
+ Ensure cut kits are complete, correctly matched, and free of defects before dispatch.
+ Ensure cutting and sorting processes are executed error\-free to eliminate kit returns from vendors/downstream units.

* Vendor Kit Distribution
* 
+ Ensure cut kits are distributed to vendors strictly as per the agreed dispatch plan and timelines.
+ Maintain proper documentation and records of kits dispatched — including quantity, date, vendor, and order reference.
+ Coordinate with logistics/dispatch teams to ensure timely and accurate handover of kits.
+ Track and resolve any discrepancies or delays in kit distribution.

* Quality \& Wastage Control
* 
+ Implement checks/controls to minimize cutting errors, mismatches, and material wastage.
+ Conduct root\-cause analysis on kit returns or cutting errors and implement corrective/preventive actions.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce rework, wastage %, and kit rejection rate.

* Team Management
* 
+ Lead, train, and manage cutting machine operators, manual cutters, and the sorting team.
+ Plan manpower deployment/shift allocation based on order load and machine availability.
+ Monitor attendance, discipline, and performance of the team; conduct performance reviews.
+ Identify training needs and build a skilled, multi\-tasking workforce.

* Records \& Reporting
* 
+ Maintain accurate records of cutting output, wastage, machine efficiency, kit dispatch, and returns.
+ Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports with management on department performance.
+ Ensure documentation is audit\-ready and compliant with internal SOPs.

* Machine \& Resource Management
* 
+ Ensure preventive maintenance of cutting machines is planned and executed to avoid downtime.
+ Coordinate with maintenance team for timely breakdown resolution.
+ Monitor machine efficiency and take corrective action for underperforming equipment.


**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
* 
+ Cutting \& sorting throughput vs. plan
+ Machine efficiency / OEE %
+ Fabric \& foam wastage %
+ On\-time cut\-kit dispatch to vendors (%)
+ Kit return rate (target: zero/near\-zero)
+ Order ageing compliance in scheduling
+ Team productivity and attendance
+ Accuracy of dispatch and production records


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 
+ Graduate in Textile/Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or related field (relevant experience may be considered in lieu).
+ 5–10 years of experience in cutting department operations within furniture, mattress, upholstery, garment, or foam\-based manufacturing.
+ Proven experience managing cutting machines (fabric/foam) and sorting/kitting teams.
+ Hands\-on exposure to manual cutting operations is preferred.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* 
+ Strong understanding of fabric and foam cutting processes and wastage optimization techniques.
+ Good planning and scheduling skills, especially order\-ageing\-based prioritization.
+ People management and team leadership skills.
+ Data\-driven approach — comfortable maintaining records/MIS in Excel or ERP systems.
+ Strong coordination skills with planning, merchandising, dispatch, and vendor teams.
+ Problem\-solving mindset with focus on quality and error elimination.
+ Attention to detail and process discipline.
