title: Treasury Cash Management & Banking Operations Specialist - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Treasury Cash Management professional to lead cash accounting, bank reconciliations, payment controls and banking operations within a complex, multi\-entity environment based in Ahmedabad. This role combines treasury operations expertise with digital transformation capabilities to improve financial control, operational efficiency and automation. The successful candidate will work closely with Finance, Technology, Risk, Cyber Security, banking partners and external providers to build scalable, technology\-enabled treasury processes while ensuring accurate accounting, regulatory compliance and strong governance.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead Cash Accounting and Reconciliations
   

  

* Own daily and period\-end cash accounting, ensuring transactions are complete, accurate and appropriately recorded in the ERP and relevant sub\-ledgers
* Lead reconciliations across bank statements, payment platforms, collection files, clearing accounts, cash\-in\-transit accounts and the general ledger
* Drive timely resolution of unmatched, duplicated, rejected, returned and aged items with appropriate ownership and supporting documentation
* Establish consistent standards for reconciliation frequency, ageing, review, certification, evidence retention and escalation


 Own Bank Reconciliations and Banking Operations
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end bank reconciliations across bank accounts, entities and currencies
* Ensure bank statements and transaction files are received completely and processed accurately through approved connectivity channels
* Oversee bank account postings, charges, collections, direct debits, payment returns, unidentified receipts and related accounting treatment
* Manage bank account administration, mandates, signatories, access governance and periodic user access reviews
* Collaborate with banks and internal teams to resolve statement, interface, value\-date and transaction discrepancies


 Strengthen Payments, Controls and Financial Close
   

  

* Oversee secure and timely payment processing, including file validation, approvals, release controls and accounting for payment outcomes
* Monitor failed, rejected, duplicate, delayed and returned payments and lead root cause resolution
* Lead month\-end cash and banking close activities, including journal reviews, reconciliation certification, aged\-item reporting and balance sheet commentary
* Maintain robust segregation of duties, maker\-checker processes, access controls, audit trails and control evidence


 Drive FinTech and Digital Transformation
   

  

* Identify and implement automation opportunities across matching, reconciliations, exception management, reporting and bank administration
* Lead implementation and enhancement initiatives across Treasury Management Systems, reconciliation platforms, ERP modules, workflow solutions and payment technologies
* Advance API\-based and host\-to\-host banking connectivity and straight\-through processing where appropriate
* Apply analytics, AI\-assisted matching, anomaly detection and rules\-based automation to improve control effectiveness and reduce manual effort
* Own business requirements, process design, user acceptance testing, deployment readiness and benefit realisation activities for treasury technology initiatives


 Lead People and Stakeholder Relationships
   

  

* Coach, support and develop the Treasury Cash Management team, strengthening accounting, reconciliation, controls and digital capabilities
* Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Controllership, Technology, Cyber Security, Risk, banking partners, FinTech providers and auditors
* Lead governance reviews, communicate risks and issues clearly, and ensure actions are tracked and completed


**Who You Are**
* Typically bring 6 to 12 years of experience in treasury operations, cash and banking, financial operations or shared services environments, including people leadership responsibilities
* Demonstrate experience managing high\-volume cash and bank reconciliations within multi\-entity and/or multi\-currency organisations
* Possess strong knowledge of cash accounting, payment processing, clearing accounts, month\-end close processes, balance sheet controls and reconciliation governance
* Have hands\-on experience with ERP systems, Treasury Management Systems, bank connectivity solutions, reconciliation platforms, workflow tools and automation technologies
* Bring experience in process standardisation, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, change management and benefits realisation
* Exhibit strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, communication and problem\-solving capabilities
* Hold a professional qualification such as CA, CPA, CMA, MBA Finance, CIMA, ACCA or an equivalent qualification


**Preferred Digital And FinTech Capabilities**
* Experience with API\-based or host\-to\-host banking connectivity and straight\-through processing
* Practical exposure to automated matching, workflow automation, rules engines, RPA, AI\-assisted reconciliation or anomaly detection solutions
* Advanced Excel skills and reporting expertise using Power BI, Qlik or comparable analytics tools
* Working knowledge of SQL, data structures, integrations or automation platforms


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to lead treasury cash management operations across a complex multi\-entity environment.Exposure to enterprise Treasury Management Systems, ERP platforms and advanced banking technologies.Ownership of strategic automation and transformation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.Collaboration with global stakeholders, financial institutions, auditors and FinTech providers.Opportunity to influence governance, financial controls and process excellence across treasury operations.Leadership experience through coaching and developing high\-performing teams.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Treasury technology strategy and digital transformation delivery.Advanced cash and bank reconciliation governance and exception management.Treasury Management Systems, banking integrations and straight\-through processing.AI\-assisted reconciliation, automation frameworks and analytics\-driven decision making.Stakeholder management across Finance, Technology, Risk, Cyber Security and banking partners.Data analysis and reporting using enterprise tools such as Power BI, Qlik and advanced Excel.End\-to\-end treasury controls, governance and audit readiness.

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

 8\. Quality Control

 9\. Growth \& Branch Development

**Job Purpose:** 
 This role is responsible for managing billing processes, revenue, and payment collection by ensuring accurate and timely updates on various portals, responds to disputes, and provides detailed financial reporting.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Associate Manager \- Regulatory \& Commercial (ERCG)**
**Billing And Revenue Management**
 Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
   

  

 Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
   

  

 Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
   

  

 Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
   

  

 Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
   

  

 Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.
   

  

**Payment Tracking And Dispute Resolution**
 Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
   

  

 In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
   

  

 Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
   

  

 Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
   

  

 Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.
   

  

**Portal Management**
 Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
   

  

 Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
   

  

 Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
   

  

 Enforce restrictions on short\-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
   

  

 Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.
   

  

**Financial Reporting And Reconciliation**
 Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
   

  

 Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
   

  

 Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.
   

  

**Regulatory Support And Tariff Management**
 Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.
   

  

 Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.
   

  

 In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Finance Team
   

  

 Corporate Affairs Team
   

  

 Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) Team
   

  

 Fuel Management Team
   

  

 Power Sales Team
   

  

 Business Development (BD) Team
   

  

 ABEX Team
   

  

 Commercial Controller Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 DISCOMs/Procurers
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.
   

  

**Preferred Industry**
 Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

title: Manager, Internal Audit
description:
**Job Description**
**SOX 404 Compliance, Control Design and Testing (approximately 60–70%)**
 Plan and execute assigned activities within the Company’s SOX 404 compliance program, ensuring work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with internal methodology and external\-auditor expectations.
   

  

* Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs): Maintain and update RCMs for relevant business processes and IT applications. Confirm that risks are appropriately addressed, control descriptions are clear and complete, and changes in processes, systems, ownership, or risk are reflected promptly.
* Walkthroughs and scoping: Conduct process and control walkthroughs, assess annual scope and key\-control coverage, document process flows, and identify changes that may affect control design or testing strategy.
* Business\-process controls: Evaluate the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of controls across key cycles, including Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Financial Close and Consolidation, Human Resources and Payroll, Property, Plant and Equipment, Treasury, Inventory, and other in\-scope processes.
* IT application controls (ITACs): Identify and test automated and semi\-automated controls within enterprise applications, including automated calculations, workflow approvals, three\-way matching, system configurations, and interfaces between internal systems and external service providers.
* Key reports and information produced by the entity (IPE): Identify reports, queries, spreadsheets, and other information used in control performance. Test completeness and accuracy through report logic, parameters, configuration, source\-to\-output reconciliation, access, change management, and, where applicable, SQL or code review.
* Testing and documentation: Prepare clear, complete, and reproducible workpapers that document procedures performed, evidence examined, samples selected, conclusions reached, and reviewer follow\-up. Record testing results and findings in the designated audit and SOX management system.
* Deficiency evaluation and remediation: Identify control gaps, perform root\-cause analysis with stakeholders, assess deficiency severity in accordance with the Company’s framework, agree practical remediation actions, monitor milestones, and retest completed remediation.
* External\-auditor coordination: Act as a primary point of coordination for assigned SOX areas, facilitate walkthroughs and evidence requests, resolve questions, and maintain alignment on scope, testing status, deficiencies, and remediation.
* Control\-owner training: Provide onboarding and periodic refresher training to control owners and performers on control objectives, evidence standards, documentation requirements, and changes to the SOX program.


**Business\-Process Audits, Systems and Advisory (approximately 30–40%)**
* Business\-process and operational audits: Support risk assessments, develop audit programs, perform interviews and testing, analyze root causes and business impact, and prepare practical recommendations. Assignments may cover financial, operational, compliance, technology\-enabled, and cross\-functional processes.
* Audit reporting and communication: Prepare concise status updates, findings, risk statements, and recommendations for management reports and presentations. Maintain regular communication with process owners, Internal Audit leadership, IT, and external auditors; escalate significant issues or delays promptly.
* Issue follow\-up: Maintain accurate records of open actions, validate remediation evidence, confirm sustainable closure, and report overdue or unresolved matters to appropriate stakeholders.
* Control advisory and continuous improvement: Advise stakeholders on process and control improvements while preserving Internal Audit independence. Promote standardized, efficient, and sustainable controls that comply with Company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Data analytics: Use data analysis to identify unusual transactions, process exceptions, control failures, operational bottlenecks, and indicators of error or potential fraud.
* Use of AI: Use Company\-approved AI and audit\-automation tools to support audit planning, SOX control testing, evidence analysis, workpaper preparation, and identification of control gaps. Validate all AI\-generated outputs against source evidence, apply professional judgment and human oversight, and comply with the Company’s confidentiality, data\-privacy, information\-security, and responsible\-AI requirements.
* Other assignments: Support investigations, inventory cycle counts, year\-end physical counts, and other Internal Audit priorities as assigned. Travel to Company locations is required.


**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) CA \- Required
* Master Degree (MS/MA) ICWA \- Preferred
* Master Degree (MBA) MBA \- Preferred


**Experience:**
* 12 years or more in 12 \- 15 Years

* Deep understanding of SaaS financial and operational KPIs, a strong ability to analyze data to identify trends, actual performance against budget, forecast, prior periods risks, opportunities for growth. Monitor key KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly management reporting, dashboards, executive presentations and decision\-support materials.

* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity of financial data and reports through standardization, automation and effective use of finance systems.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls, documentation and data integrity, and support audit or compliance requests related to assigned work.

* 5\+ years of experience in in FP\&A, strategic finance, business finance or a closely related analytical finance role in a SaaS, enterprise\-software company
* Proficiency with NetSuite required;
* Advanced financial modelling skills, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and management accounting , financial statement and operation analysis.
* Ability to synthesize complex financial and operational data into concise insights and practical recommendations.

 Benefits include, but are not limited to:

**ABOUT LEGION**
 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award\-winning, AI\-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee\-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting\-edge technology in an easy\-to\-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
   

  

**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
 There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig\-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
   

  

 For more information, visit https://legion.co

title: Senior Analyst - FP&A
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
 



  





 Could you be the full\-time
 **Senior Analyst \- FP\&A IS\&T** 
 in
 **Bengaluru, India** 
 , we’re looking for?
 



  





**Your future role** 




 Take on a new challenge and apply your financial planning and analysis expertise in a dynamic and innovative field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, forward\-thinking, and detail\-oriented teammates.
 



 You'll play a pivotal role in consolidating IT RUN costs across all units of the Alstom group, ensuring accurate insights on actual costs versus budget to drive business performance. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Digital Services Controlling team, Digital Services Operational team, and India Finance team), support the IS\&T RUN Controller in driving forecasts and budget preparation, and oversee the implementation of global processes to improve IT cost efficiency and recharges.
 



 You’ll specifically take care of monthly reporting of IS\&T costs and variance analysis, but also manage the implementation of the service catalogue for IT across the globe.
 



 We’ll look to you for:
 


* Consolidating IS\&T RUN costs from different countries, regions, or systems and preparing monthly variance analysis and rolling forecasts.
* Driving budget preparation in collaboration with operations and country business partners.
* Managing budget, forecast, accruals, and invoicing for RUN recharge to projects and platforms based on consumption.
* Ensuring process efficiency in RUN recharge and adherence to agreements.
* Implementing and managing the service catalogue and related recharge processes.
* Handling India transfer pricing invoicing to France and local invoicing to other units in India.
* Managing Power BI tools for IS\&T, ensuring data accuracy and regular updates.
* Collaborating on ad\-hoc assignments to continuously improve IS\&T financial processes.



  





**All about you** 




 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
 


* **A Chartered Accountant qualification or CMA or MBA with 5\-8 years of post\-qualification experience in IT Finance.**
* **Experience in FP\&A, business controlling, or IT cost controlling with an international scope.**
* **Knowledge of ERP systems, specifically SAP.**
* Proficiency in advanced Excel skills.
* Familiarity with Power BI tools and financial data visualization.
* Strong business orientation and effective communication skills with international teams.
* Proactive, pragmatic, and open\-minded approach to problem\-solving.
* Ability to work autonomously in a matrixed and international organization.



  





**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
 


* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from routine.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards leadership roles in IT Finance or other areas of interest.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).



 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
 



  





**Important to note** 




 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Lead Service Finance Analyst
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Lead Service Finance Analyst partners with the regional and zone Service Finance teams to deliver financial planning, performance analysis, reporting, and operational finance support for the after\-sales services business ("Service organization"). The role reports into the Global Markets Service Income Leader with a dotted line to the regional Service Senior Finance Manager.
   

  

 The position plays a key role in supporting forecasting, budgeting, month\-end close, performance management, and business intelligence activities. The analyst is expected to independently manage recurring reporting processes, provide actionable financial insights, drive reporting simplification initiatives, and support finance leaders in business decision\-making across multiple geographies.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world
   

  

**Job Description**
**Financial reporting \& data extraction**
* Lead recurring financial reporting processes, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of management reports and business performance dashboards.
* Extract, validate, consolidate, and analyse financial data from multiple systems and databases.
* Develop meaningful insights on business performance, highlighting risks, opportunities, and key operational drivers.
* Drive process improvement and standardization in financial reporting.


**Forecasting, Budgeting \& Planning**
* Support monthly forecasts, annual Budgeting, and strategic planning processes.
* Partner with finance managers to identify performance risks and opportunities and recommend corrective actions.

**Business Intelligence \& Power BI**
* Manage and continuously enhance Power BI reports and dashboards.
* Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and improve data quality.
* Partner with stakeholders to develop new analytical tools and self\-service reporting capabilities.
* Support implementation of standardized reporting frameworks.


**Ad hoc analysis \& projects**
* Support zone\-specific initiatives and finance projects. Respond to business requests such as historical account trending and performance analysis.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting and analytical processes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Typically 7\-10 years of experience in FP\&A, Financial Reporting, Accounting, Business Finance, or related finance roles.
* Fluent in English.
* Experience working with large datasets and financial reporting systems.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities with the ability to translate financial results into business insights.
* Proven ability to operate independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience supporting forecasting, budgeting, and month\-end closing processes.
* Advanced Excel skills, including data manipulation, modelling, and automation techniques.
* Strong Power BI skills, including report development, maintenance, and dashboard design.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Hyperion, SmartView, or equivalent).
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact confidently with finance and operational stakeholders.
* Demonstrated process improvement mindset and passion for simplification and automation.
* Comfortable operating within a global, matrixed organization.

 GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

description:
**About Advith ITeC** 




  





 Advith ITeC is a venture that merges finance consulting with technology, with the word ITeC standing for Information Technology enabled Consulting. We are building various tech tools to make finance consulting more accessible and have a dedicated team of individuals that are trained on tasks related to finance consulting and compliance management.
 



  





 Job Title: Senior Finance Analyst \& Coordinator 
 



**Department:** 
 Virtual Finance Office (VFO) / FinOps
 



**Experience:** 
 3 – 5 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**About the Role** 




 At Advith, our Virtual Finance Office delivers tech\-driven FinOps and strategic finance capabilities to scaling enterprises across diverse industries.
 



  
 



 We are looking for a
 **Senior Finance Analyst \& Coordinator** 
 to serve as the critical operational anchor for multiple client accounts. This role functions as the central bridge connecting our
 **day\-to\-day execution pods (AP, AR, GL, Tax), the FP\&A Senior Manager, the Customer Relationship AVP, and client finance heads** 
 . You will ensure seamless service delivery, enforce delivery timelines, perform first\-level quality reviews, analyze financial performance, and ensure numbers are translated into actionable business narratives with zero bottlenecking.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Delivery Coordination \& Pod Orchestration** 



* Act as the primary operational coordinator across assigned client engagements, tracking daily execution workflows across FinOps execution teams.
* Maintain the master client deliverable calendar (month\-end close, statutory filings, vendor runs, payroll cut\-offs, MIS dates) and drive pods to hit deadlines proactively.
* Collaborate closely with the
 **Customer Relationship AVP** 
 to flag delivery risks, address client queries, monitor SLA adherence, and manage client communications on operational matters.
* Identify operational bottlenecks early, resolve cross\-pod dependencies, and drive accountability so that leadership does not need to step into daily execution.



**2\. Financial Analysis \& Reporting (FP\&A Support)** 



* Work alongside the
 **FP\&A Senior Manager** 
 to prepare monthly Management Information Systems (MIS), budget vs. actual variance reports, and operational dashboards.
* Analyze financial statements, cash flow forecasts, margins, and unit economics across various client verticals to identify underlying operational trends.
* Translate raw operational numbers into clear business commentary, highlighting performance anomalies, cost leakages, and working capital trends.
* Assist in rolling cash forecasts, pricing models, project costing, and profitability analyses for client decision\-makers.



**3\. First\-Level Quality Review \& Data Integrity** 



* Perform first\-level reviews of monthly schedules, balance sheet reconciliations, and journal entries prepared by junior pod accountants before data flows into the reporting deck.
* Ensure data hygiene and consistency across ERPs, spreadsheets, and internal tracking systems.
* Validate that numbers in MIS reports reconcile seamlessly with audited financials, statutory returns (GST/TDS), and underlying ledgers.



  





**Candidate Profile \& Qualifications** 



* **Education:** 
 Master’s (M.Com, MBA Finance) or Semi\-Qualified CA / CMA is a strong plus.
* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of blended experience in
 **Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), Finance Controllership, Client Delivery Coordination, or Virtual CFO services** 
 .
* **Accounting Foundation:** 
 Strong grasp of core accounting principles, GL structures, revenue recognition, and Indian statutory fundamentals (GST, TDS).
* **Coordination \& Ownership:** 
 High decision maturity with the ability to orchestrate tasks across multiple teams, manage competing client deadlines, and follow through independently.
* **Analytical Tools:** 
 Advanced proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets (financial modeling, nested formulas, pivot tables, dashboarding). Exposure to Power BI / Tableau and modern cloud ERPs (Zoho Books, QuickBooks, TallyPrime) is highly desirable.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable interacting with senior internal stakeholders, client CFOs, and operational founders.
* **Mindset:** 
 Proactive, organized, detail\-oriented, with a keen eye for finding the business story behind the numbers.

title: Business Controller

 As our Business Controller / Factory Controller, you’ll play a key role in turning factory performance into clear financial insight and practical business action. You will support local factory management and the Product Line leadership team in delivering sustainable results across cost, cash, productivity, inventory, and operational performance.
   

  

 Your impact? Better decisions, stronger cost control, improved forecasting accuracy, and sharper visibility on risks and opportunities in the factory. You will help leaders understand what is driving performance and what actions are needed to improve it.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with operations, supply chain, procurement, finance, and product line teams, taking ownership of core controlling processes such as monthly closing, forecasting, budgeting, cost analysis, inventory follow\-up, and business performance reviews.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Drive monthly factory performance analysis, translating financial results into clear insights, root causes, and concrete actions for improvement.
* Lead key controlling processes including month\-end closing, accrual reviews, deviation analysis, plant forecasting, and annual budgeting.
* Analyze supply chain and factory cost drivers such as productivity, procurement, freight, inventories, cost reductions, warranty, and manufacturing variances.
* Partner with factory and product line leaders to challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and support decisions that improve profitability and cash performance.
* Use tools such as Excel, SAP/S4HANA, Business Warehouse, HFM, and Power BI to improve transparency, reporting quality, and data\-driven decision\-making.

* Experience in financial analysis, business controlling, or factory controlling, ideally in a production or manufacturing environment.

* Excellent Excel skills and solid knowledge of ERP/reporting tools such as SAP, Business Warehouse, HFM, or Power BI; curiosity for automation and digital reporting is a plus.
* Fluent English communication skills and the confidence to challenge, advise, and collaborate with stakeholders across functions and cultures.


**What You'll Get From Us**

**Location : Bangalore** 




  





 At VIATRIS, we see healthcare not as it is but as it should be. We act courageously and are uniquely positioned to be a source of stability in a world of evolving healthcare needs.

* Partnership – Leveraging our collective expertise to connect people to products and services.



  





 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here is how this role will make an impact:
 




  





**Role Purpose**




 Act as the
 **Finance Business Partner to Sterile Vertical and Global 3P Operations** 
 , providing strategic financial insights, commercial support and robust financial controls across third\-party sourced sterile products. Partner closely with Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Commercial, Legal and Hub Finance teams to drive cost competitiveness, profitability, working\-capital optimization and financial discipline.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Budgeting, Forecasting \& Financial Planning** 



* Lead the annual budgeting process and periodic forecast updates
* Develop and monitor budgets, forecasts and financial performance, ensuring alignment with business plans and strategic objectives.
* Prepare and review monthly MIS, quarterly management packs, departmental expenses and key financial performance indicators.



**2\. Costing, COGS \& Transfer Pricing** 



* Support the calculation and validation of
 **Cost of Goods, standard costs and transfer prices** 
 for third\-party products.
* Provide costing support for annual budgeting, new product launches and commercial/business cases.
* Analyze cost drivers and identify opportunities for cost optimization and margin improvement.



**3\. PPV, Variance Analysis \& Cost Control** 



* Lead the calculation, reporting and analysis of
 **Purchase Price Variances (PPV)** 
 and other operating variances related to third\-party products.
* Analyze actual versus standard cost, identify root causes and drive corrective actions with Sourcing and Operations.
* Review PPV accruals, commercial COGS accruals and vendor debit/credit notes to identify and resolve mismatches.



  





**4\. Inventory \& Working Capital Management** 



* Support the monthly inventory reporting and control process for third\-party contract manufacturers, particularly injectable CMO partners.
* Review inventory movements, provisions, write\-offs and working\-capital performance.
* Partner with Operations and Hub Finance to strengthen inventory controls and improve working\-capital efficiency.



**5\. Commercial \& Contract Finance** 



* Support the development, establishment and maintenance of complex third\-party contracts, with specific focus on cost\-control mechanisms and bespoke financial clauses.
* Review commercial agreements and amendments from a financial and business\-impact perspective prior to execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to evaluate and pursue vendor claims in accordance with contractual terms.



**6\. Technical Transfer \& New Product Support** 



* Support preparation of
 **Technical Transfer business cases** 
 , including cost evaluation, project budgets, forecasts, actuals and project cost control.
* Provide financial evaluation and decision support for new products, sourcing opportunities and strategic initiatives.



**7\. Freight \& Supplier Cost Analysis** 



* Review YTD freight actuals through Trax/BI reports and investigate discrepancies against accruals or expectations.
* Analyze freight and other supplier\-related costs to identify financial leakage and improvement opportunities.



  





**Key Stakeholder Interface**




 Work closely with:
 


* Sterile Operations Teams / Site Heads
* Global Sourcing Leadership
* Supply Chain / SCM / Procurement / Commercial
* Commercial Finance, Legal
* Technical Transfer / Project Teams
* Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs)
* Senior Business Leadership



  





**Core Requirements**




  





**Qualifications, Experience and Skills**




 Here are the minimum qualifications for this position:
 


* **CA with minimum 8 years of post\-qualification experience** 
 , preferably within a large global organization.
* Strong experience in
 **Operations Finance, Sourcing/Procurement Finance, Costing, PPV, COGS and Budgeting/Forecasting** 
 .
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret and manage large, complex datasets.
* Hands\-on
 **SAP experience** 
 , particularly in costing, financial controls and variance analysis.
* Strong business systems, digital and data\-analysis skills.
* Proven ability to lead
 **process improvement, standardization and automation initiatives** 
 .
* Strong commercial understanding with the ability to evaluate contracts and financial implications.
* Excellent stakeholder\-management and communication skills across multiple functions and geographies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure and deliver within tight deadlines.
* Willingness and flexibility to work across
 **India, Europe and US time zones** 
 .
* Strong problem\-solving capability, with the ability to Analyze complex situations and develop practical, commercially sound solutions.
* Demonstrated
 **leadership presence, ownership, tenacity and determination to deliver results** 
 .

title: Financial Auditor II
description:
**Design Your Future at PVH**
 Financial Auditor II
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The primary function is to perform royalty and related financial audit assignments and assist management with contractual compliance which are part of the licensee and licensor agreements. The results of these audits will be reported to the Audit Committee and various levels of Company management. In addition, your role will include partnering with cross\-functional teams globally using data from several sources to solve complex analytical problems and drive the PVH Plus Plan.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Reviewing Contracts and Agreements
* Analyze Royalty Agreements: Examine licensing and royalty agreements to understand the terms, conditions, and formulas used to calculate royalties.
* Identify Key Terms: Focus on key terms related to royalty, advertising, and other compliance to ensure they are properly adhered.
* Conducting Audits
* Gather Documentation: Collect relevant documents such as sales reports, royalty statements, and other relevant reports and data.
* Perform Fieldwork: Execute audit procedures, including testing calculations, verifying data, and assessing the accuracy of royalty payments and advertising spent.
* Data Analysis
* Collect and Analyze Data: Use data analysis techniques to review large financial and transactional data volumes.
* Identify Anomalies: Look for discrepancies, unusual patterns, or deviations from expected royalty payments or financial records.
* Use Analytical Tools: Employ tools such as Excel, Power Query, or specialized audit software to facilitate data analysis and visualization.
* Communicating with Stakeholders
* Discuss Findings: Communicate preliminary findings and issues with relevant stakeholders, such as management or audit clients.
* Follow Up: Address any questions or concerns raised during the audit process and provide additional information as needed.
* Reporting and Documentation
* Prepare Work Papers: Document audit findings, procedures performed, and evidence collected in work papers.
* Draft Audit Reports: Compile and present audit results, including findings, issues, and recommendations for improvement.
* Professional Development
* Stay Informed: Keep up\-to\-date with changes in industry regulations, accounting standards, and audit practices.
* Training and Education: Participate in relevant training programs or certification courses to enhance your skills and knowledge.
* Collaboration
* Work with Teams: Collaborate with other auditors, financial analysts, and departments to ensure a comprehensive audit approach.
* Engage with Licensee: Coordinate with licensee and licensing teams or consultants, if required, to ensure alignment and address any issues.
* Additional Opportunities
* Assist with Diverse Internal Tasks: Based on needs, assist with and engage in a range of internal tasks, including Continuous Monitoring, SOX, and Operational Audits.

With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner serving customers worldwide.  The Accounts Payable Manager, USA Operations is responsible for leading end\-to\-end Accounts Payable (AP) operations for the United States region within GlobalFoundries' global finance organization. This role provides operational leadership, ensures strong internal controls and compliance, drives process excellence, and partners closely with Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Treasury, Tax, and business stakeholders. The successful candidate will combine financial acumen, leadership capability, and continuous improvement expertise to deliver world\-class AP services while supporting business objectives, working capital optimization, and transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Your Job**
**AP Operations Management**
* Lead daily Accounts Payable operations for the USA region.
* Ensure timely and accurate processing of supplier invoices, payment requests, employee reimbursements, and vendor credits.
* Monitor AP aging, blocked invoices, GRIR balances, and unresolved exceptions and drive prompt resolution.
* Review operational performance metrics and implement corrective actions to maintain service\-level commitments.
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end financial close activities related to Accounts Payable.

* Blocked invoice aging
* Supplier satisfaction

* Compliance and audit performance

**Education**

**Experience**

* Experience supporting complex, multi\-site business operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading process improvement and transformation initiatives.

description:

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Analyst \- Traded Risk Analysis.**

**In this role, you will:*** Identify repeatable BAU Market Risk tasks (e.g., reconciliation checks, commentary drafting inputs, threshold alerts) and translate them into AI\-automation opportunities with clear scope, benefits, and control requirements.
* Assist in building AI\-enabled workflows using Python as the orchestration layer (data extraction, feature preparation, model/LLM calls, output formatting) to reduce manual effort and turnaround time.
* Apply prompt engineering and structured output patterns (templates, JSON schemas, guardrails) to produce consistent, auditable AI outputs suitable for risk reporting and operational processes.
* Implement data quality and validation checks around AI pipelines (input completeness, exception handling, reasonableness tests) and document logic to support BAU controls and change governance.
* Support deployment and monitoring of AI automations (basic logging, performance drift flags, exception queues) and contribute to continuous improvement based on user feedback and incident learnings.
* Ownership of the front to back market risk data, analysis and reporting activities for the asset class, which is divided into Equities, Credit, Rates \& FX, and Markets Treasury.
* Risk Data (sensitivities and risk metrics) Monitoring and Management to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of risk Analysis and Reporting.
* Risk Analysis to perform explains on the drivers behind the movements in risk metrics such as sensitivities (PV01, CS01, EQ delta, Gamma etc.), VaR/SVaR/IRC and FRTB SA \& IMA metrics etc.
* Drive the analysis and reporting of market risk metrics to Risk Managers, Traders, Senior Management and Regulators.
* Drive the implementation of processes and policies to deliver service excellence by clearly communicating the rationale across sites and ensuring that the entire team functions as one coordinated unit.

**To be successful you will:*** Working proficiency in Python, including API integration, async programming, and data manipulation (pandas/numpy).
* Hands\-on experience building agentic applications — this can come from personal projects, hackathons, internships, or professional work
* Practical exposure to at least one agent orchestration framework (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) or direct experience with the Claude/OpenAI/Gemini APIs including function calling and tool use.
* Understanding of prompt engineering fundamentals: system prompts, chain\-of\-thought/structured reasoning prompts, few\-shot examples, output formatting (JSON schemas, XML tags).
* Professional certification like FRM / CFA /CQF can be an added advantage.
* Good to have experience in using vendor market data systems like Refinitiv (Reuters) and Bloomberg
* Good to have working knowledge in tools like JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint etc.
* A degree / qualification in Finance, Engineering, Business Management or previous experience in Risk Management (Market Risk) or quantitative courses
* Strong foundation in risk management principles, understanding of risk measures (i.e. PVBP, VaR) and systems

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Infinite NXT is an investment platform focused on helping individuals in India earn higher returns on their money through a user\-friendly investment app. The company aims to deliver strong interest on all investments and provide greater value for users’ digital assets. Infinite NXT positions itself as a trusted partner for building a more secure financial future, emphasizing transparency and customer\-centric services. The team is dedicated to simplifying investing and empowering users to make informed financial decisions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote role for a Finance Manager at Infinite NXT. The Finance Manager will oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management to support the company’s growth and stability. Responsibilities include monitoring investment performance, analyzing financial data, preparing reports for leadership, and ensuring compliance with relevant financial regulations and internal controls. The role also involves collaborating with product, operations, and leadership teams to optimize revenue, manage financial risks, and contribute to strategic decision\-making. The Finance Manager will continuously review and refine financial processes to improve efficiency and support long\-term business objectives.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting, with the ability to manage cash flow and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in financial analysis and reporting, including interpreting data, preparing management reports, and supporting strategic decisions.
* Experience with risk management and compliance, including knowledge of relevant financial regulations and internal control frameworks.
* Comfort with financial software, spreadsheets, and analytics tools, along with attention to detail and accuracy in financial records.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams in a remote environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA, CFA, CPA, CMA) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in fintech, investments, or financial services is beneficial, especially in fast\-growing or digital\-first organizations.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high ethical standards and confidentiality.

title: FP&A Manager
description:
**What’s The Role**
 The Financial Planning \& Appraisal Manager is accountable for enabling high\-quality business decisions through robust planning, performance management, appraisal, forecasting and decision ready insight generation. The role acts as a strategic finance partner to business and finance leadership, translating commercial drivers, operational performance, risks and opportunities into clear financial insights and actionable interventions. The role is expected to strengthen decision quality, drive value delivery, maintain financial discipline and accelerate the shift from reporting to providing forward\-looking decision ready insights through data, digital and analytics\-enabled ways of working.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a commercially minded finance leader who combines strong FP\&A fundamentals with curiosity, digital fluency and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, translating complex business information into clear recommendations, and leading teams through change. They bring a disciplined focus on value, risk, controls and performance, while continuously partnering with business to enable competitive decision quality, business strategy \& performance.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Lead integrated planning and forecasting: Own and coordinate planning, latest estimate and appraisal processes, ensuring assumptions, financial outcomes and business drivers are transparent, consistent and aligned with business strategy.
* Drive performance management: Monitor financial and operational performance against targets/benchmarks, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and support timely interventions to drive competitive performance.
* Provide business appraisal and decision support: Apply value and risk lenses to investment, portfolio, commercial and operational decisions, ensuring options are evaluated with sound financial logic and business judgement.
* Generate actionable options and recommendations: Leverage automated analytics dashboards to convert data, trends and scenarios into clear options, decision\-ready recommendations and practical interventions that support senior leadership decision\-making.
* Strengthen financial discipline and controls: Ensure planning, reporting and appraisal activities comply with governance, control, assurance and financial reporting requirements.
* Partner across the business: Build trusted relationships with business leaders, finance colleagues and cross\-functional stakeholders to align priorities, challenge constructively and influence better decisions.
* Enable digital and analytics transformation: Champion automation, self\-service reporting, driver\-based modelling, scenario planning and predictive analytics to improve speed, quality and efficiency of finance delivery.
* Develop capability and talent: Coach and develop team members, build future\-ready FP\&A capabilities and foster a learner mindset across business partnering, data, digital, analytics and process excellence.
* Transformation \& Continuous Improvement: Drive simplification, automation, digitisation and process improvement across planning \& appraisal activities, leveraging technology, analytics and AI\-enabled tools where appropriate.
* AI\-enabled FP\&A governance and decision support: Review, interpret and leverage outputs from AI\-enabled tools to deliver high\-quality FP\&A support, ensuring insights, forecasts and recommendations are grounded in robust assumptions, strong data integrity, sound judgement and disciplined AI risk management and governance.


**What You Bring**
* Business partnering and commercial acumen: Ability to understand value drivers, business models, market dynamics and operational levers, and convert them into practical financial advice.
* Financial performance management: Strong capability in KPI design, target setting, variance analysis, forecasting, performance appraisal and intervention planning.
* Planning and financial decision\-making: Ability to coordinate business planning, translate strategy into financial targets and link plans to milestones, actions and measurable outcomes.
* Financial modelling and scenario analysis: Experience in driver\-based modelling, sensitivity \& scenario analysis, risk and opportunity framing, business cases and investment appraisal.
* Data analytics and insights: Ability to validate, analyse and interpret data; identify patterns and trends; and generate insights that answer business questions and improve decision quality.
* Data management and digital acumen: Understanding of data quality, governance, reporting automation, dashboarding, analytics tools and digital solutions that improve finance processes with ability to work with AI.
* Storytelling and strategic executive communication: Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, concise and compelling messages for senior stakeholders, including recommendations and decision asks.
* Process excellence and continuous improvement: Ability to simplify, standardise and improve finance processes while maintaining governance, control and operational discipline.
* Stakeholder management and influencing: Ability to build trust, challenge constructively, navigate ambiguity and influence outcomes across functions, geographies and leadership levels.
* Change leadership: Ability to lead through transformation, adopt new ways of working, build engagement and embed sustainable improvements.


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Operate as a trusted finance advisor and strategic co\-pilot to the business.
* Demonstrate courage to challenge assumptions, surface risks and recommend value\-accretive actions.
* Lead with clarity, accountability and care, enabling a high\-performing and inclusive team environment.
* Build capability by coaching others, sharing best practices and contributing to communities of practice.
* Balance enterprise value, risk, controls and business pragmatism in decision support.
* Role\-model learner mindset, digital curiosity and adaptability in a fast\-evolving finance environment.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Significant experience in financial planning, appraisal, performance management, business finance or related finance roles.
* Proven track record of partnering with senior business stakeholders to influence decisions and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, value drivers, planning cycles, forecasting, business case development and performance reporting.
* Experience leading teams or influencing cross\-functional delivery through matrixed ways of working.
* Experience with digital finance tools, data visualisation, automation, analytics or driver\-based planning solutions is highly desirable.
* Professional finance qualification, accounting qualification, MBA or relevant business/finance degree preferred.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Timely, accurate and value\-adding delivery of planning, LE, appraisal and performance management cycles.
* Improved decision quality through clear insights, robust scenarios and transparent assumptions.
* Visible business impact from interventions, performance actions and value/risk\-based recommendations.
* Increased efficiency and effectiveness through simplification, automation and digital adoption.
* Strong stakeholder confidence in finance advice, analysis and governance.
* Improved team capability across business partnering, data, digital, analytics, insights, decision quality and process excellence.


**What We Offer**
 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
   

  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.


**An Inclusive \& Progressive Place to Work**
* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.


**Shell in India**
 Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R\&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
   

  

 Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net\-zero emissions energy business by 2050\. As India moves towards its target of net\-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
   

  

 Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end\-to\-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world\-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350\-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
   

  

 Shell owns and operates a LNG re\-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck\-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1\.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
   

  

 Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting\-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
   

  

 We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco\-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Treasury Hedge Accounting Analyst
description:
Join Barclays as Treasury Hedge Accounting Analyst where the role is principally responsible for monthly monitoring and reporting of segmental (head office) and statutory P\&L, and model management of certain bespoke hedge accounting activities. The team has wide diversity in responsibilities and interacts with stakeholders from multiple FTCs across the bank. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating it.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should have below skills.
   

  

  

* Basic hedge accounting knowledge \[cash flow and fair value] would be advantage.
* in a financial institution with interest rates being the key managed risk.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; tested in a variety of mediums including presentations, policy documents and stakeholder meetings/forums.
* Has the initiative and ability to break down problems into components parts and resolving them.
* Attention to detail and analytical.
* Desirable experience of linking entity results through to financial statement production.
* Fully qualified accountant.
* Degree (or higher) educated, from a top tier university.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Needed For This Role.**
* CFA / master’s in finance / financial engineering would be an advantage.
* Articleship / Industrial trainee in mid to large sized firms.
* Audit exposure in large financial institutions / banks preferred.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in our Chennai office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To report and analyse hedging relationships, identify potential hedge accounting opportunities, and implement effective hedging strategies to mitigate accounting asymmetry risk.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and implementation of effective hedge accounting strategies that support the bank's overall risk management framework and adjust as needed to maintain hedge effectiveness and respond to changes in market conditions.
* Assessment of potential hedge accounting relationships between financial instruments, considering factors such as effectiveness, designation, and hedge ratio.
* Preparation and maintenance of comprehensive hedge accounting documentation, including hedge designation reports, effectiveness testing results, and fair value measurements and ensure that hedge accounting documentation is accurate, compliant with accounting standards, and readily available for audit review.
* Fair value measurements for financial instruments, including both hedged and hedging instruments, using appropriate valuation methodologies, and calculation and recording of hedge accounting adjustments, including hedge ineffectiveness adjustments, to reflect the impact of hedging relationships on the financial statements.
* Management of regular effectiveness testing of hedging relationships to assess whether they continue to meet the requirements for hedge accounting, and evaluation of the effectiveness of hedging strategies and adjust as needed to maintain hedge effectiveness.
* Report the internal and external statutory view of hedge accounting effectiveness for presentation into Barclays Annual Accounts.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. * Own the manufacturing variance set: material usage and yield, labor efficiency, and overhead spending and absorption. Tie every variance back to a production run, not a plug.
* Reconcile costed bills of material and routings to actual consumption, and flag where the BOM no longer reflects how the line really runs.
* Value inventory across raw material, work in process, and finished goods, including reserves for excess, obsolete, and short\-dated stock.
* Reconcile cycle counts and physical inventory book\-to\-physical, investigate the differences, and clear them. A variance you cannot explain is an open item, not a rounding.
* Track the cost of quality: scrap, rework, product on hold and its release, lab and testing spend.
* Allocate freight\-in and landed cost to the right units.



**Margin, pricing, and profitability** 



* Produce customer and SKU\-level profitability by customer code name the



 analysis that tells our commercial team which business is actually earning its keep.
 


* Model toll rates against margin floors and blended targets, and give the margin read



 on customer quotes before they go out.
 


* Quantify and track cost\-out initiatives with Operations: identify them, size them, and report



 whether they actually landed.
 


* · Surface the financial risk you see in the numbers – raw material price movement, production



 variance trends, margin erosion, customer concentration.
 



**Close and reporting**



* · Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering P\&L, balance sheet, and cash
* flow within 7 business days of month\-end.
* ·  Reconcile every balance sheet account monthly, with supporting schedules retained and reviewable.
* ·  Maintain the chart of accounts and journal entry standards in Business Central.
* ·  Build the financial section of the monthly board package and the budget\-versus\-



 actual reporting behind it.
 


* · Write the variance commentary: what changed, why, whether it is temporary or structural,



 and what needs a decision.
 



**Controls, audit, and documentation**



* Prepare the full PBC package for our external audit and own the preparer\-side response cycle.
* Maintain the authorization limits framework, enforce segregation of duties



 and dual approvals, and escalate anything that bypassed them.
 


* Support sales and use tax, payroll tax oversight, 1099 and W\-9 administration, PACA



 license maintenance, and state grant reporting – prepared by you, filed by our U.S. team and advisors.
 


* · Write and maintain desk procedures for every recurring process you own. This is a



 standing expectation, not a one\-time project – we are explicitly trying to end the
 



 era of undocumented financ
 




 Team
 



* Give day\-to\-day technical direction to our Cost Accounting Manager and Staff Accountant on



 close deliverables, costing method, and reconciliation quality.
 


* Review their work and raise the standard of it. Formal HR matters reviews, compensation,



 discipline stay with the CEO and HR onsite.
 



  





**What You'll Bring** 




**Required** 



* CPA or Chartered Accountant.
* · 0\+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3\+ years personally owning a



 full monthly close – running one, not supporting one.
 


* Hands\-on manufacturing cost accounting under a standard costing system. This is our



 screening requirement. You should be able to walk us through a purchase price variance and
 



 a yield variance you personally calculated, explained, and defended.
 


* · Inventory accounting across raw material, WIP, and finished goods, including reserves and



 physical\- count reconciliation.
 


* · A manufacturing ERP with a real costing module, used hands\-on – Dynamics 365 Business



 Central, Dynamics NAV or AX, SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite.
 


* Working U.S. GAAP fluency, including ASC 842 lease accounting.
* Business\-fluent written and spoken English. You will write directly to our CEO, our sponsor



 finance team, and our auditors, so written clarity is part of how we evaluate candidates.
 


* · The ability to work U.S. Central hours sustainably, including close weeks. We would rather



 you have worked this shift before than agree to try it.
 



**Preferred** 



* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central specifically – it is our system, and direct experience



 shortens your ramp considerably.
 


* Food, CPG, or USDA\-regulated manufacturing. Co\-manufacturing or contract manufacturing



 is even better.
 


* The controller is genuinely hands\-on rather than supervising a department.
* Audit PBC preparation as the preparer, working directly with a U.S. firm.
* Experience as the offshore counterpart to a U.S. finance team – you already understand the



 prepare\-here, approve\-there rhythm.
 


* A manufacturing execution system such as RedZone, or an EDI platform such as SPS Commerce.



**Nice to have** 



* · CMA or CGMA alongside your primary credential.
* · Turnaround, transition, or finance\-function build experience.
* ·  Multi\-plant or multi\-entity consolidation exposure.
* · Experience standing up finance documentation and SOPs where none existed.



 Interested Candidates can apply in
 **Linkedin** 
 or send a mail to S
 **tephen.Raphael@caligne.com**
