* Lead the end\-to\-end design and implementation of the P\-Card programme across approved markets, from business case and operating model through rollout and stabilisation.
* Translate the P\-Card strategy into a phased implementation roadmap with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, benefits, risks and accountable owners.
* Own delivery governance, including programme plans, steering updates, decision logs, risk and issue tracking, and timely escalation of delivery constraints.
* Define the target operating model covering card request, approval, issuance, activation, usage, expense submission, reconciliation, settlement, suspension and closure.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Operational Risk, Technology, Information Security and business teams to deliver market\-ready solutions.
* Lead engagement with card issuers, expense\-platform providers and other external partners, ensuring service, control, data and implementation requirements are met.
* Develop and maintain P\-Card policies, standards, procedures, user guidance and control requirements aligned with organisational and local regulatory expectations.
* Establish robust maker\-checker controls, approval limits, merchant\-category restrictions, transaction limits and segregation of duties across the card lifecycle.
* Design preventive and detective controls for inappropriate spend, duplicate claims, split transactions, personal usage, cash withdrawal and other policy exceptions.
* Ensure cardholder, approver, administrator and programme\-owner responsibilities are clearly defined, communicated and evidenced.
* Oversee integration between the card issuer, expense\-management platform, procurement systems, enterprise resource planning systems and general ledger.
* Ensure accurate accounting, cost allocation, statement matching, settlement, reconciliation and month\-end reporting for P\-Card transactions.
* Define data, reporting and dashboard requirements covering spend, adoption, exceptions, ageing, delinquency, control breaches, savings and supplier coverage.
* Lead user acceptance testing, defect management, production\-readiness reviews, cutover planning and post\-implementation validation.
* Coordinate market onboarding, including local requirements assessment, stakeholder sign\-off, communications, training and hypercare support.
* Drive cardholder and approver adoption while maintaining appropriate eligibility criteria, approval discipline and spend governance.
* Act as the senior escalation point for implementation decisions, operational incidents, issuer performance, control gaps and complex stakeholder concerns.
* Ensure timely investigation, remediation and root\-cause analysis of failed transactions, unreconciled items, suspicious activity and policy breaches.
* Maintain complete documentation and audit trails for programme decisions, approvals, testing, controls, exceptions and issue remediation.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and risk assessments, ensuring actions are resolved within agreed timelines.
* Define service levels and performance measures for issuers, service teams and internal stakeholders, and lead regular governance reviews.
* Identify opportunities to increase compliant P\-Card usage, reduce low\-value purchase\-order and invoice volumes, and improve the employee and supplier experience.
* Deliver measurable benefits through process simplification, automation, improved visibility, reduced processing effort and stronger spend control.
* Plan resources and manage implementation capacity, budget and third\-party costs within approved parameters.
* Lead and develop the implementation team, promoting accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and strong risk ownership.
* Embed a sustainable business\-as\-usual model, including ownership, support arrangements, control monitoring, change management and continuous improvement.
* Embed resilience, access, data protection, fraud prevention and contingency controls in the programme design.

* Financial Accounting \& Reconciliation
* Operational Risk Management
* Regulatory Compliance \& Governance
* Data Analytics \& Business Reporting
* Strategic Operations Management
* Stakeholder Management \& Influencing
* Change \& Transformation Leadership
* Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement
* People Leadership \& Talent Development
* Resource and Capacity Planning

* AI and Automation Technologies
* ERP and Workflow Management Solutions
* SAP (VIM / S4 HANA / Ariba)

* 12\+ years of experience in Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, Purchasing Cards, Corporate Cards, expense management, procurement operations or payment operations.
* Proven experience leading a multi\-market P\-Card or Corporate Card implementation, expansion or major transformation from design through stabilisation.

title: Assistant Vice President - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Assistant Vice President – Regulatory Transaction Reporting \& Data Services
   

  

**Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations / Reporting
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Asset Management Reporting and Data Services are responsible for the end\-to\-end integrity of the data lifecycle. This includes transforming validated investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data into accurate, timely, and compliant reports for clients, regulators, and internal stakeholders. The function ensures that regulatory transaction reporting (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC) is executed with precision while maintaining the robust data foundations required for institutional\-grade reporting.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The Assistant Vice President (AVP) serves as a strategic leader and dual\-function controller within the Regulatory Transaction Reporting (RTR) and Data Services ecosystem. The role is responsible for the governance, oversight, and continuous improvement of both the regulatory reporting framework and the underlying data management architecture.
   

  

 The AVP is accountable for ensuring the "Golden Source" of data is maintained, managing the full data lineage from ingestion to regulatory submission, and driving the strategic roadmap for data quality and reporting automation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**
* Strategic Oversight: Lead the end\-to\-end delivery strategy for regulatory transaction reporting and the data services lifecycle, ensuring all global SLAs and multi\-jurisdictional requirements are met.
* Data Governance \& Integrity: Act as the primary authority for data quality; establish and enforce standards for data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency across all reporting streams.
* Regulatory Control Authority: Direct the oversight of both direct production (SFTR, MiFID II) and outsourced/delegated reporting (EMIR, ASIC), ensuring rigorous control over 3rd party Service Providers and Clearing Brokers.
* Critical Escalation \& Incident Management: Serve as the senior point of contact for resolving complex regulatory discrepancies, systemic data breaks, and high\-priority reporting failures.
* Quality Assurance Framework: Define and implement enhanced control standards for transaction pairing, matching, UTI management, and master data reconciliation.


**Contributing Responsibilities**
* Leadership \& Talent Development: Provide strategic direction to Production Analysts and Data Processors; drive a culture of technical excellence, data literacy, and continuous professional development.
* Transformation \& Data Engineering Oversight: Lead large\-scale automation and digitalization projects; oversee the implementation of automated data validation rules and streamlined data ingestion workflows.
* Data Lineage \& Traceability: Partner with IT and Data Engineering to ensure full end\-to\-end data lineage, enabling seamless audit trails from regulatory submission back to the original source system.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Partner with senior leaders in Performance, Accounting, and Product teams to optimize upstream data flows and resolve systemic "root cause" issues.
* Audit \& Regulatory Liaison: Lead the response to internal/external audits and regulatory inquiries, ensuring all data controls, governance documentation, and oversight evidence are robust.
* Change Management: Drive the implementation of new regulatory requirements (e.g., EMIR Refit) and system enhancements across the global reporting and data landscape.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**
* Advanced Regulatory Reporting Mastery: Deep expertise in the mechanics of EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, and ASIC, including submission lifecycles and exception handling.
* Data Management \& Governance Expertise: Advanced understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), data sourcing, enrichment, and the management of investment data domains (Holdings, Pricing, Reference Data, Corporate Actions).
* Data Quality \& Analytics: Ability to design data quality dashboards and use statistical methods to monitor data health and identify emerging trends/risks.
* Systems \& Data Architecture: High\-level understanding of the end\-to\-end data pipeline, including the connectivity between source systems, data warehouses, and regulatory interfaces (ARMs/APAs/TRs).
* Risk \& Control Design: Advanced ability to design and implement complex control frameworks to mitigate operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strategic Leadership: Ability to lead diverse teams through complex regulatory shifts and inspire a culture of data\-driven accountability.
* Influencing \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and effectively challenge 3rd party service providers and brokers.
* Decisiveness under Pressure: Ability to make high\-stakes, time\-sensitive decisions regarding regulatory deadlines and data integrity.
* Problem\-Solving \& Innovation: A proactive approach to identifying systemic gaps in data/reporting logic and implementing long\-term technological solutions.
* High Accountability: Absolute ownership of the function’s regulatory standing, data accuracy, and global delivery quality.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Education: Post Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (MBA/CFA preferred).
* Experience: Extensive experience (5\+ years) in Regulatory Transaction Reporting or Financial Data Management within an Asset Management or Sell\-side environment.
* Data Mastery: Proven track record in managing complex data flows, performing high\-level reconciliations, and validating data lineage and traceability.
* Leadership Track Record: Experience in managing operational teams and overseeing outsourced service providers/vendors.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Expert\-level understanding of the evolving global regulatory landscape (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Process Excellence: Demonstrated experience in leading process improvement, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.


**Skills Referential**
**Technical Skills:**
* Advanced Regulatory Frameworks (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Data Governance, Data Lineage, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Strategic Risk Management \& Control Design.
* Expert proficiency in Data Analysis tools (Advanced Excel, SQL/Python knowledge preferred) and Reporting Platforms (e.g., Aladdin, DTCC, Tri\-Optima).


**Behavioral Skills**
* Strategic Thinking \& Vision.
* Executive Communication (Reporting KPIs and trends to senior management).
* Change Leadership \& Transformation.
* Advanced Conflict Resolution \& Negotiation.
* Risk\-based Decision Making.


**Education Level:** 
 Post Graduate degree in Finance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai

title: Treasury Hedge Accounting Analyst
description:
Date live: 09/23/2026


Business Area: Finance


Area of Expertise: Finance


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000129027


  
Join Barclays as Treasury Hedge Accounting Analyst where the role is principally responsible for monthly monitoring and reporting of segmental (head office) and statutory P\&L, and model management of certain bespoke hedge accounting activities. The team has wide diversity in responsibilities and interacts with stakeholders from multiple FTCs across the bank. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating it.

  

  

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills.

  

  

* Basic hedge accounting knowledge \[cash flow and fair value] would be advantage.
* in a financial institution with interest rates being the key managed risk.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; tested in a variety of mediums including presentations, policy documents and stakeholder meetings/forums.
* Has the initiative and ability to break down problems into components parts and resolving them.
* Attention to detail and analytical.
* Desirable experience of linking entity results through to financial statement production.
* Fully qualified accountant.
* Degree (or higher) educated, from a top tier university.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills needed for this role.

  

  

* CFA / master’s in finance / financial engineering would be an advantage.
* Articleship / Industrial trainee in mid to large sized firms.
* Audit exposure in large financial institutions / banks preferred.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.

  

  

This role is based in our Chennai office.

  

  

**Purpose of the role**


To report and analyse hedging relationships, identify potential hedge accounting opportunities, and implement effective hedging strategies to mitigate accounting asymmetry risk.


**Accountabilities**


* Design and implementation of effective hedge accounting strategies that support the bank's overall risk management framework and adjust as needed to maintain hedge effectiveness and respond to changes in market conditions.
* Assessment of potential hedge accounting relationships between financial instruments, considering factors such as effectiveness, designation, and hedge ratio.
* Preparation and maintenance of comprehensive hedge accounting documentation, including hedge designation reports, effectiveness testing results, and fair value measurements and ensure that hedge accounting documentation is accurate, compliant with accounting standards, and readily available for audit review.
* Fair value measurements for financial instruments, including both hedged and hedging instruments, using appropriate valuation methodologies, and calculation and recording of hedge accounting adjustments, including hedge ineffectiveness adjustments, to reflect the impact of hedging relationships on the financial statements.
* Management of regular effectiveness testing of hedging relationships to assess whether they continue to meet the requirements for hedge accounting, and evaluation of the effectiveness of hedging strategies and adjust as needed to maintain hedge effectiveness.
* Report the internal and external statutory view of hedge accounting effectiveness for presentation into Barclays Annual Accounts.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \| Valuation \& Modeling \| Business Valuation \| FMV \| Consultant**
 Join our team of Strategy \& Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M\&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level: Consultant or equivalent**
 As a Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis, you will be liaising with onsite/offshore teams.
   

  

**The Team:**
 The Valuation \& Modeling team, part of Strategy \& Transactions offering portfolio, performs valuation of business entities, intellectual property, partnership interests, private debt instruments, Fee for service and Health Care Professional Fair Market Valuation services. As a professional in this team, you will be responsible for providing Fair Market Valuation services and commercial reasonableness analyses supporting management planning and regulatory compliance considerations to Pharmaceutical and Medical Device companies. The role combines analytical modeling, healthcare compliance awareness, and clear written reporting to deliver client\-ready deliverables and support client with their regulatory compliance or management planning requirements.
   

  

**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**
* Prepare FMV and fee reasonableness analyses for various pharmaceutical supply chain arrangements, spanning across traditional supply chain channels to nuanced collaborations.
* Select and apply appropriate valuation approaches (e.g., Cost\-plus approach, market benchmarking, Income approach, as applicable) and document assumptions and conclusions.
* Review engagement documentation (scope, agendas, deliverables, contracts, purchase orders) to validate time estimates, role requirements, and deliverables
* Draft client\-ready FMV reports, including methodology, data sources, assumptions, calculations, and conclusion ranges.
* Support quality control (QC) and peer review; respond to internal review comments and refine analyses accordingly.
* Manage multiple projects concurrently, meet service\-level expectations, and communicate status, risks, and dependencies to engagement leads.
* Contribute to practice development through template refinement, and benchmark library updates (where permitted).
* Participate in client communications as needed to clarify scope, request missing inputs, and explain conclusions in plain language.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Up to 5 years of relevant experience in Business Consulting, Regulatory Compliance management, Business Valuation, Equity research, Market Access, Clinical research
* Foundational knowledge associated with Life Sciences \& Health Care Industry (e.g., Knowledge of Supply Chain entities – Wholesalers / Specialty Distributors, Specialty Pharmacy, Group Purchasing Organizations, PBMs and Payors Landscape, etc.) and regulatory considerations (e.g., Anti\-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, etc.)
* Excellent problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, and strong storyboarding skills
* Time management and project management skills required to work across multiple client engagements, and senior stakeholders


**Education:**
* MBA (Tier 1 and Tier 2 preferred)

**Job Summary**
 The Sourcing Advisory Analyst supports the identification, tracking, and analysis of product cost opportunities across the merchandising organization. This role leverages data, analytics, market intelligence, and reporting tools to provide actionable insights that improve product profitability and support sourcing and category management strategies.
   

  

 Working closely with Category Management, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing partners, the Advisory Analyst develops reporting solutions, maintains cost tracking repositories, and conducts analytical assessments of commodity, freight, currency, and vendor cost drivers. This role plays a key part in enabling data\-driven decision making through fact\-based analysis and continuous process improvement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Reporting \& Dashboard Development: Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and visual analytics that improve visibility into cost change behaviors, savings performance, and sourcing initiatives.
* Data Management \& Governance: Build and manage analytical repositories, cost databases, and tracking mechanisms to ensure accurate historical records of negotiations, sourcing projects, savings initiatives, and business outcomes.
* Business Partner Support: Collaborate with Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, Finance, and cross functional teams to provide analytical support for negotiations, planning activities, and decision\-making processes.
* Market \& Commodity Intelligence: Monitor external market indicators, commodity indices, freight trends, currency movements, and supplier developments to assess potential impacts on product cost and gross margin performance.
* Ad Hoc Analysis: Conduct quantitative analyses and develop management\-ready insights to support special projects, vendor discussions, category reviews, and leadership requests.


**Qualifications**
* Analytical Mindset: Ability to synthesize large datasets into meaningful insights and recommendations that support business decisions.
* Data \& Reporting Skills: Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SQL, or related analytical tools.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to identify trends, uncover root causes, and develop practical business solutions.
* Attention to Detail: Strong commitment to accuracy, data integrity, and quality control.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Ability to effectively communicate insights and partner with stakeholders across multiple functional areas.

* Education: Masters in Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related discipline; OR equivalent combination of education and experience.

description:

**Contest Design**

* Develop rules documents and communication materials for field engagement.

**Health Check Analytics and Plan Monitoring**

* Identify anomalies, outliers, or gaming behaviors and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide monthly/quarterly dashboards and insights to Sales Leadership on IC plan performance.

**Data Management and Processing**

**Compliance, Governance, and Documentation**

**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Incentive Compensation professional we seek has these qualifications.

* Master’s degree OR Bachelor’s degree \& 2\+ years of experience in Incentive Compensation plan design, IC Operations preferably in healthcare industry.

* Execution\-Focused Delivery: Own and execute day\-to\-day analytics tasks, reporting development, and field data operations with speed, accuracy, and minimal oversight.
* Analytical and Problem\-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret large, complex datasets. Demonstrated ability to translate business rules into data logic and calculations. Proven track record of identifying errors, troubleshooting data, and resolving issues efficiently.

title: Lead - Finance Controller
description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special\-purpose transformers, high\-voltage circuit breakers, and medium\-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil \& gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines.
   

  

 Website: https://ayr.energy
   

  

**Job Description**
****Finance Controller \& Compliance Lead****
 CA (Qualified / Semi\-Qualified) \| India
   

  

****Function****
 Finance \& Accounts
   

  

****Reporting To****
 Senior Manager – Finance
   

  

****Location****
 India (Hybrid / On\-site Hyderabad)
   

  

****Qualification****
 CA Qualified (2–3 yrs PQE) or CA Semi\-Qualified with 7–8 yrs experience
   

  

****Articleship****
 Big 4 / Top\-10 firm strongly preferred
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a sharp, ownership\-driven finance professional to anchor the controllership function of a growing organisation with cross\-border operations (India–USA). The primary mandate is building and running a robust financial control environment — from books to board\-ready MIS — while providing hands\-on compliance support across tax, regulatory, secretarial, and international trade frameworks. This is a high\-accountability, high\-visibility role suited to someone who combines analytical rigour with practical execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Controllership (Primary Mandate)
* Books \& Financial Reporting
* Own end\-to\-end bookkeeping across entities ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Prepare and publish monthly financials — P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow — with variance commentary.
* Design and maintain a monthly close calendar; drive predictable, clean month\-ends.
* Build management dashboards and MIS packs for leadership decision\-making.
* Audit Management
* Lead statutory, internal, and tax audits end\-to\-end — planning, fieldwork coordination, and sign\-off.
* Liaise with external auditors; manage PBC requests and resolve queries efficiently.
* Track and close audit observations; maintain an action\-tracker with ownership and timelines.
* Accounting Policy \& Technical Research
* Draft, document, and maintain accounting policies aligned with Ind\-AS / IGAAP.
* Benchmark against industry practice and regulatory guidance before finalising positions.
* Prepare accounting memos for complex or judgement\-heavy transactions (leases, revenue recognition, related\-party dealings, business combinations).
* Business Finance — Corporate Purchases
* Act as the embedded finance partner for the procurement / corporate purchases function.
* Review vendor contracts and purchase orders for commercial, taxation, and accounting implications.
* Ensure correct GST treatment, TDS applicability, and capitalisation vs. expense classification on all purchases.
* Drive cost governance: budgets, actuals, forecasts, and variance analysis on capex / opex categories.
* Support vendor negotiations with data\-backed insights on pricing and payment terms.
* Compliance \& Regulatory (Supporting Mandate)
* Direct Tax
* File corporate income tax returns, advance tax computations, support for tax audit.
* Manage TDS/TCS compliance — deductions, payments, quarterly returns (24Q/26Q/27Q), and Form 16/16A issuance.
* Identify and implement tax\-efficient structures and exemptions to optimise the effective tax rate.
* Respond to income\-tax notices; coordinate with consultants for assessments and appeals.
* Indirect Tax \& Routine Filings
* Own GST compliance: monthly/quarterly returns (GSTR\-1, 3B), annual return (GSTR\-9/9C), and reconciliations.
* Handle input tax credit matching, reverse\-charge applicability, and e\-invoicing / e\-way bill processes.
* Manage other periodic filings: PF, ESIC, PT, and applicable cess/levies.
* Export Compliance \& FEMA / RBI Matters
* Ensure end\-to\-end compliance for export of goods and services: shipping bills, EDPMS, LUT / bond filing under GST.
* File and track Foreign Inward Remittance Certificates (FIRCs) and Bank Realisation Certificates (BRCs).
* Handle RBI / FEMA filings — ODI, FDI, FLA returns, APR/OPI reporting, and ECB reporting where applicable.
* Coordinate with AD banks on forex transactions and ensure timely realisation of export proceeds within prescribed timelines.
* Transfer Pricing
* Maintain contemporaneous TP documentation as applicable, benchmark inter\-company transactions, work with TP consultants.
* US Compliance Support (India\-Based)
* Coordinate with US CPAs / advisors on federal and state income tax filings for the group's US entity.
* Track US sales tax nexus, registrations, and periodic filings across applicable states.
* Support due diligence, W\-8/W\-9 documentation, and 1099/1042\-S reporting as required.
* Maintain intercompany agreements and ensure consistency of positions across India and US entities.
* Insurance
* Review, renew, and optimise the company's insurance portfolio (D\&O, product liability, marine cargo, property, professional indemnity, key\-man, etc.).
* Benchmark coverage and premiums annually; engage brokers for competitive quotes.
* Ensure claims are tracked, filed timely, and followed up to closure.
* Secretarial Compliance
* Coordinate with the Company Secretary for ROC filings (annual returns, financial statements, board resolutions, share allotments, etc.).
* Maintain statutory registers and ensure timely compliance with Companies Act, 2013 obligations.
* Support board meetings — prepare agenda, notes to accounts, and follow\-up action trackers.
* Manage any LLP / subsidiary / overseas entity compliance as applicable.


****CANDIDATE PROFILE****
**Qualifications**
* CA (Qualified) with 2–3 years of post\-qualification experience, OR
* CA (Semi\-Qualified — Intermediate cleared) with 7–8 years of relevant hands\-on experience.
* Articleship from a Big 4 (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, PwC) or top\-10 Indian CA firm is a strong differentiator.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong command of Ind\-AS / IGAAP and working knowledge of US GAAP a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Tally / Zohobooks/ SAP / QuickBooks or equivalent ERP.
* Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, financial models); Power BI or similar a bonus.
* Exposure to export documentation and foreign\-exchange accounting.


****Behavioural Competencies****
* Ownership mindset — treats compliance deadlines as non\-negotiable and proactively flags risks.
* Structured problem\-solver — comfortable researching ambiguous issues and forming a defensible position.
* Clear communicator — can translate complex tax / accounting positions for non\-finance stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented with a healthy appreciation for the big picture.
* Comfortable working in a lean, fast\-moving environment with limited hand\-holding.


****WHY THIS ROLE****
* End\-to\-end ownership: from ledger to board deck, India to USA — rare breadth for someone at this stage.
* Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over financial strategy and structure.
* Complex, multi\-jurisdictional exposure.
* Growing organisation — opportunity to build and formalise processes, not just follow them.


**The Pay Range For This Role Is**
 1,500,000 \- 2,000,000 INR per month(Hyderabad)

title: Sr. Analyst, Competitive Pricing
description:
Our Company:
   

  

 At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Analyst, Competitive Pricing plays a critical role in shaping how Teradata competes in the market. This role is anchored in deep competitive pricing research that directly feeds into pricing analysis, recommendations, and approval — and extends that intelligence into field enablement that equips Sales and Deal Desk to compete and win on price.
   

  

 Sitting within Teradata’s Product Marketing team, you will support the Pricing \& Packaging team and will partner closely with Product Management, Competitive Intelligence, Product Marketing, Sales, and Deal Desk to build a fact\-based view of competitor pricing — and translate those insights into actionable recommendations, pricing decisions, and field\-ready tools.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role that directly influences pricing strategy, pricing approvals, deal execution, and competitive positioning.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Competitive Pricing Research
   

  

* Conduct structured competitive pricing analysis across cloud data platform, analytics, and AI competitors — covering list prices, discount patterns, packaging models, and consumption\-based pricing structures.
* Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence database that serves as the authoritative source of record for Pricing \& Packaging, Product Marketing, and Competitive Intelligence teams — including list prices, discount patterns, packaging models, and TCO benchmarks.
* Develop TCO and price‑performance models comparing Teradata to key competitors across regions, workloads, and deployment models.
* Analyze win/loss pricing patterns to identify risks and opportunities, and translate findings into concrete inputs for pricing recommendations and approval decisions.
* Monitor AI pricing and cloud monetization trends — token\-based, consumption\-based, and outcome\-based models — and surface implications for Teradata’s pricing strategy and competitive positioning.
* Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing to ensure pricing strategy reflects current competitive realities and that research findings are integrated into packaging decisions and pricing recommendations.


 Competitive Pricing Enablement
   

  

* Develop field\-ready competitive pricing content — pricing briefs, battle cards, objection\-handling guides, and deal\-specific competitive summaries — grounded in research and immediately usable by Sales and Deal Desk.
* Build and maintain competitive pricing tools — including TCO calculators, price\-performance comparison frameworks, and consumption model explainers — that Sales and Deal Desk can use in active opportunities.
* Translate win/loss pricing patterns into actionable field guidance — not just analysis, but competitive positioning and response playbooks that Sales can use in the next conversation.
* Support strategic and competitive deals with rapid\-response competitive pricing analysis, negotiation framing, and custom TCO modeling tailored to specific account contexts.


**What You Bring**
 Skills \& Attributes
   

  

* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; ability to turn complex data into crisp insights.
* Excellent communication skills; able to write clear, concise competitive briefs.
* Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast‑moving environment.
* Passion for the cloud, data, and AI ecosystem.
* Ability to build and leverage AI tools to automate repetitive analysis, improve accuracy, and increase the velocity of competitive insights.


**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Math, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software, cloud, or data platforms, with demonstrated fluency in cloud and AI software pricing models (consumption\-based, token\-based, capacity\-based, or SaaS subscription).
* Experience producing competitive analysis or pricing content that has been used directly by Sales, Deal Desk, or GTM Enablement teams.
* Ability to collaborate across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.


**Preferred**
* MBA or advanced degree.
* Direct experience with cloud hyperscaler pricing (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or AI/ML platform pricing from vendors such as Snowflake, Databricks, Google, or Microsoft.
* Familiarity with Teradata’s competitive landscape.


**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
 We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti\-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
   

  

 Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Associate — Incentive Compensation Administration
description:
Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
   

  

 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Senior Associate, Incentive Compensation Administration will independently manage the accurate and timely administration of assigned field incentive compensation (IC) plans and compensation cycles. The role will lead end\-to\-end IC operational activities, including data intake and validation, eligibility and crediting, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, payout coordination, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation in accordance with approved plan rules and governance requirements.
   

  

 The Senior Associate will take ownership of complex data and operational issues, analyze payout trends and potential outliers, conduct plan health checks, and partner with cross\-functional teams to drive issues through resolution. The role will independently manage field inquiries and escalations, maintain strong process controls and documentation, and identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting, automation, operational efficiency, and the overall field experience.
   

  

 This position works within the Incentive Compensation Administration team in Field Excellence and partners closely with onshore business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams across Incentive Compensation, Field Effectiveness, data management, Finance, HR, Payroll, IT, and external partners. The role will coordinate assigned projects and support new plan implementations, field realignments, product launches, annual planning cycles, mid\-cycle changes, and platform enhancements, while providing guidance and quality review for Associate\-level work as needed.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**IC Administration and Analytical Ownership**
* Independently administer assigned field IC plans and recurring compensation cycles, ensuring accurate and timely execution in accordance with approved plan rules, governance requirements, and business timelines.
* Lead end\-to\-end operational activities, including data intake, eligibility validation, crediting, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, payout coordination, exception management, and post\-payment validation.
* Extract, transform, validate, and reconcile IC\-related data from multiple systems; investigate complex discrepancies and drive timely resolution with cross\-functional partners.
* Produce and interpret IC operational reports, including payout summaries, eligibility and attainment reports, payment reconciliations, payroll reports, master tables, and exception logs.
* Conduct regular plan health checks by monitoring payout trends, processing timelines, data issues, field inquiries, and potential outliers; identify risks and recommend corrective actions.


**Governance, Documentation, and Field Support**
* Ensure IC activities comply with internal controls, legal guidance, privacy requirements, applicable industry regulations, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Create, maintain, and periodically review SOPs, QC checklists, business\-rule documents, process flows, exception logs, approvals, and records of key decisions.
* Independently manage and resolve field inquiries and escalations related to plan rules, eligibility, crediting, goal attainment, calculations, and payments.
* Communicate complex IC outcomes clearly and empathetically to field employees, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional partners.


**Project Management and Stakeholder Partnership**
* Support implementation of new IC plans, realignments, product launches, mid\-cycle changes, and annual planning cycles; partner with internal teams and vendors to ensure accurate, timely execution.
* Manage assigned project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, actions, and deliverables using Planner or other project\-management tools.
* Partner with onshore business stakeholders, including Sales, Field Excellence, Finance, and other teams, to provide status updates, coordinate decisions, and align on requirements and timelines.
* Identify and implement improvements to IC processes, data controls, reporting, documentation, automation, and field experience.
* Support system enhancements, testing, new reporting requirements, and IC platform updates; provide guidance and quality review for Associate\-level work as needed.


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of experience in incentive compensation administration, sales operations, compensation operations, finance operations, analytics, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Relevant bio/pharmaceutical, healthcare, consulting, or commercial operations experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting end\-to\-end field IC administration, including eligibility, crediting, calculation validation, payment processing, reporting, reconciliations, and inquiry resolution.
* Strong analytical ability to work with large, complex datasets, identify root causes, and resolve data or process issues.
* Advanced SQL and Microsoft Excel skills
* Proficiency with industry\-leading incentive compensation administration platforms is preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability for deliverables, issue resolution, risk escalation, and timely completion of commitments.
* Ability to translate business rules into data logic, validation checks, and clear administrative procedures.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Good to have IC health checks, plan modeling and design, contest design, goal setting experience

title: Senior Accountant
description:

 Send your resume to

title: Associate Field effectiveness
description:
At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Associate, Field Effectiveness will provide hands\-on analytical and operational support that helps improve the productivity and effectiveness of the sales force. The role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on accurate execution, actionable insights, and reliable field enablement.
   

  

 This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and works closely with field leadership, analytics, reporting, incentive compensation, data\-management, and cross\-system partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Field Data Analysis and Insights
   

  

* Analyze data from Veeva CRM, distribution partners, claims, patient services, and other approved commercial sources.
* Assess reach, frequency, HCP engagement, call\-plan adherence, account performance, and targeting effectiveness for field sales teams.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses that translate complex datasets into clear observations and practical actions for business partners.


 Operational Execution and Field Enablement
   

  

* Support territory alignments, roster updates, targeting cycles, and call\-plan execution in accordance with agreed timelines and controls.
* Coordinate operational delivery of field tools and outputs, including Veeva CRM, Next Best Action dashboards, digital companion tools, alerts, and call\-plan refreshes.
* Respond to routine field or stakeholder questions, investigate issues, document findings, and escalate risks or dependencies promptly.


 Sales Force Size, Structure, and Deployment
   

  

* Assist with analyses of field\-force size, structure, coverage, deployment, territory design, and workload balance.
* Support evaluations of customer and account potential, targeting logic, call frequency, capacity, and affordable coverage scenarios.
* Prepare data, scenarios, and quality checks required for alignment updates driven by market dynamics and business priorities.


 Field Force Effectiveness
   

  

* Support call planning, coverage optimization, targeting, valuation, and execution audits across applicable brands and field forces.
* Conduct periodic analyses of workload balance, reach and frequency, engagement quality, and performance trends under the guidance of senior team members.
* Develop clear summaries, charts, and supporting documentation for leadership reviews and cross\-functional discussions.


 Compliance, Quality, and Process Optimization
   

  

* Execute defined quality\-control checks and ensure analytics, reports, and field outputs follow approved business rules and applicable engagement\-compliance requirements.
* Document data sources, assumptions, methodologies, process steps, and validation evidence to support audit readiness, repeatability, and knowledge transfer.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate recurring work and support implementation of approved improvements.


 Project Support and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Track deliverables, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items using tools such as Jira and ServiceNow; maintain clear ownership and timely status updates.
* Maintain project documentation, including timelines, decision logs, issue trackers, validation files, and closure summaries.
* Collaborate effectively with Field Reporting, Incentive Compensation, iDNA/data teams, analytics, cross\-system operations, and field stakeholders to deliver agreed priorities.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 1 \- 3 years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, commercial analytics, and/or field effectiveness.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the bio/pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Hands\-on ability to write SQL queries and perform data analysis, data visualization, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Experience with sales\-planning or operations platforms used for targeting, alignment, roster management, and call planning.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Veeva and with commercial data such as sales, activity, claims, and customer/account data.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify data\-quality issues and explain findings clearly.
* Effective written and verbal communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.
   

  

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity and Accommodation
   

  

 As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed, and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

The role will execute recurring IC activities including data intake and validation, eligibility and crediting support, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, reconciliations, reporting, and maintenance of participant and territory information in accordance with approved plan rules and established processes.
   

  

 The Associate will work with multiple data sources to validate and reconcile IC\-related information, perform quality\-control checks, prepare recurring IC reports and scorecards, and support resolution of field inquiries related to eligibility, crediting, attainment, calculations, and payments. The role will maintain accurate documentation, business rules, QC checklists, and administrative records while ensuring appropriate confidentiality, data integrity, process compliance, and audit readiness.
   

  

 This position works within the Incentive Compensation Administration team in Field Excellence and collaborates with onshore business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams across Incentive Compensation, Field Effectiveness, data management, Finance, HR, Payroll, IT, and external partners. * Support accurate and timely administration of field incentive compensation (IC) plans in accordance with approved plan rules, established processes, and business timelines.
* Execute assigned recurring IC activities, including data intake, eligibility validation, crediting support, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, and maintenance of participant and territory records.

**Stakeholder and Process Support**

* Bachelor’s degree and 1–3 years of experience in incentive compensation administration, sales operations, compensation operations, finance operations, analytics, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Sr Data Analyst
description:
‒ Review property, availability, tenancy and comp data as it moves through the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers, and flag quality issues before they reach downstream users.
   

  

 ‒ Build data validation checks, including AI\-assisted checks such as anomaly detection, that catch bad data automatically rather than after the fact.
   

  

 ‒ Standardize CRE data fields, such as property type, rent type, rate type and lease structure, so the same term means the same thing across every source system.
   

  

 ‒ Define and track data quality metrics, including completeness, consistency, accuracy, timeliness and duplication rate, and report them to stakeholders on a regular cadence.
   

  

 ‒ Investigate discrepancies between internal systems, external data feeds and source documents, and trace root causes back to the pipeline stage that introduced them.
   

  

 ‒ Analyze property, availability, tenancy and comp data to surface patterns: vacancy trends, rent growth, tenant turnover, lease expirations and comparable sales activity.
   

  

 ‒ Translate findings into business insights for brokers, researchers and leadership: build dashboards, write clear summaries and answer ad hoc questions.
   

  

 ‒ Partner with data engineers and AI engineers on upstream fixes, so quality issues get solved at the source, not patched downstream.
   

  

 ‒ Document data lineage, transformation logic and quality rules, so the team can audit and reproduce every number.
   

  

 ‒ Recommend AI and machine learning approaches to automate data validation work: anomaly detection, deduplication, document classification and similar.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 ‒ 6\+ years of experience as a data analyst, ideally in commercial real estate, financial services or another data\-heavy industry.
   

  

 ‒ Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
   

  

 ‒ Experience with a Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) or similar layered data architecture.
   

  

 ‒ A track record of building and improving data quality and validation frameworks, not just running one\-off checks.
   

  

 ‒ Experience applying AI or machine learning to data quality work: anomaly detection, entity resolution, document extraction or similar.
   

  

 ‒ Comfort working with property, availability, tenancy and comparable sales (comps) data, or the ability to learn the domain quickly.
   

  

 ‒ Strong business acumen: you connect data findings to what they mean for brokers, asset managers and clients, not just what the numbers say on their own.
   

  

 ‒ Proficiency with a business intelligence (BI) tool such as Power BI or Tableau, and Python for analysis and automation.
   

  

 ‒ Clear, confident communication. You explain data problems and insights to non\-technical stakeholders without losing precision.
   

  

**Nice to Have**
 ‒ Exposure to CRE data platforms or sources, such as CoStar, RealNex, Yardi or MRI.
   

  

 ‒ Experience with a data catalog or data governance tool.

title: Analyst
description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Analyst in the Financial Institutions Group (FIG), India, you will support the day\-to\-day management and growth of the FIG franchise through business analytics, management reporting, portfolio management, client intelligence, KYC coordination, and business governance activities. The role works closely with FIG bankers, product partners, risk, compliance, operations, and regional stakeholders to ensure efficient business management and high\-quality client support.
   

  

 This role provides an excellent foundation for building a career in Institutional Banking by offering exposure to financial institution clients, portfolio management, business strategy, governance processes, and the wider FIG business.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Altimus, Pandurang Budhkar Marg, Worli
   

  

 Work Hours: Regular working hours**
**What will your day look like?**
 As an Analyst, you will have the opportunity to:
   

  

* Prepare and maintain regular management information reports, dashboards, and business performance packs.
* Monitor business metrics including revenues, pipelines, client activity, wallet opportunities, and portfolio trends.
* Track and update pipeline reports, deal trackers, and business development initiatives.
* Compile and analyse business data to support decision\-making and strategic planning.
* Maintain reporting databases and ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of management information
* Support preparation and maintenance of client account plans and relationship reviews.
* Conduct industry research and gather market intelligence on clients, sectors, and competitors.
* Prepare briefing notes and background materials for client meetings and senior management interactions.
* Coordinate customer onboarding, KYC reviews, sanctions screening, and customer due diligence requirements.
* Track KYC renewal timelines and ensure timely completion of documentation in accordance with ANZ policies and regulatory requirements.
* Assist with implementation of business initiatives, regulatory projects, and process improvement activities.
* Support preparation of presentations, management papers, business reviews, and leadership updates.


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* Graduate qualification in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* 2\-3 years of experience in banking. FIG/ Corp team experience will be beneficial
* Understanding of banking regulation and local market nuances.
* Understanding of the credit and documentation principles
* Ability to form effective working relationships with senior bankers, product partners and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving ability, growth mindset and capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear client materials and senior management updates
* High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly around pipeline, revenue, portfolio, KYC and transaction information


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us? (Global)**
 From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.
   

  

 But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.
   

  

 We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more.
   

  

 At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. That's because we're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and encourage you to talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirement, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ, visit https://www.anz.com.au/careers. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 124185\.

title: Sector Analyst - India Equity Research - Consumer
description:

**Position Overview**
 Third Bridge’s Library division delivers investment research to global institutional investors across public and private markets. Our Sector Analyst team uncovers actionable insights through expert conversations, drives regional strategy, and engages clients to showcase our research value.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated analyst to join our team in Mumbai, which is responsible for driving research coverage in India.

title: Senior Manager - Strategic Finance
description:
**Location: Mumbai**
**Function: Finance**
**Reporting to: Head of Finance**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a high\-calibre Senior Manager \- Strategic Finance to join the Finance team and work closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on some of CoinDCX's most important strategic, financial and enterprise\-wide initiatives.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, high\-ownership role for someone who can operate comfortably between strategy and execution. The individual will work on complex business problems, strategic planning, financial analysis, capital allocation, enterprise performance, financial infrastructure, crypto\-asset reconciliation frameworks, financial processes and controls, and other high\-priority initiatives led by the Head of Finance.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring the structured problem\-solving approach of a top\-tier consultant, strong financial acumen and an operator's mindset.
   

  

 This is not a traditional FP\&A, Business Finance, Controllership or investment\-banking role. The role is designed to be a strategic extension of the Head of Finance, focused on solving complex, ambiguous problems and driving high\-impact initiatives across the organisation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Finance \& Enterprise Problem Solving
* Partner closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on high\-priority strategic and financial decisions.
* Take ownership of complex, ambiguous and cross\-functional problems and develop structured, data\-driven solutions.
* Analyse enterprise\-level financial and operating drivers to support strategic decision\-making, including cost structures, capital allocation, liquidity, cash deployment and operating leverage.
* Build financial models, scenarios and analytical frameworks to evaluate strategic choices and business decisions.
* Identify key risks, opportunities and value\-creation levers and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Challenge existing assumptions and bring an objective, fact\-based perspective to strategic discussions.
* Support Head of Finance in evaluating new initiatives, business models, strategic investments and other enterprise\-level decisions.
* Special Projects
* Lead high\-impact strategic projects sponsored by the Head of Finance, often involving multiple functions.
* Work across Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Business teams to solve complex problems.
* Drive projects end\-to\-end from problem definition to structuring, analysis, recommendation, stakeholder alignment and execution.
* Prepare high\-quality decision\-making materials for the Head of Finance, Executive Leadership Team and Board.
* Support strategic initiatives where there is no clearly defined playbook and where strong judgement and problem\-solving are required.
* Act as a trusted execution partner and thought partner to the Head of Finance on critical initiatives.
* Establish project governance, milestones, decision points and accountability for Head of Finance\-sponsored initiatives.
* Identify execution risks and proactively drive resolution across functions.
* Crypto \& Financial Infrastructure
* Partner with Finance, Treasury, Operations, Product and Technology teams to strengthen crypto\-asset and fiat reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop and enhance frameworks for reconciliation of customer balances, crypto assets, liabilities and financial records.
* Develop a strong understanding of complex transaction flows across wallets, exchanges, banking partners and internal systems.
* Identify systemic reconciliation gaps, control weaknesses and process inefficiencies and translate them into process, technology and control requirements.
* Design scalable frameworks for digital\-asset financial reporting, reconciliation and operational finance.
* Partner with Technology and Controllership teams to drive automation of financial data flows, reconciliations and controls.
* Define requirements, control frameworks, exception\-management mechanisms and governance processes for automated reconciliation.
* Monitor the effectiveness of reconciliation and financial\-control frameworks through appropriate KPIs, exception reporting and governance mechanisms.
* Financial Strategy \& Management Insights
* Develop enterprise\-level financial insights beyond standard reporting to support strategic decision\-making by the Head of Finance and leadership team.
* Build analytical frameworks to assess revenue drivers, cost structures, cash flows, liquidity, capital requirements and operating leverage.
* Support annual planning, forecasting and scenario analysis on strategic topics, where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve financial efficiency, capital utilisation and operating leverage at an enterprise level.
* Develop dashboards, analytical tools and management frameworks that enable senior leadership to make better decisions.
* Support Head of Finance in evaluating strategic trade\-offs across growth, profitability, liquidity, risk and capital allocation.
* Capital Markets \& IPO Readiness
* Support Head of Finance on IPO readiness and capital\-markets\-related initiatives as and when required.
* Work with investment bankers, auditors, lawyers and other external advisors on relevant projects.
* Support benchmarking, financial analysis, investor materials and management presentations.
* Help strengthen financial processes, reporting, governance and internal controls required for a potential public\-market environment.
* Support projects relating to equity story, investor readiness, financial disclosures and capital\-market benchmarking.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workstreams required to close identified IPO\-readiness gaps.


**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for someone with exceptional analytical horsepower, structured thinking, financial depth and the ability to independently drive ambiguous, high\-impact problems.
   

  

**Ideal Background**
* 8 to 12 years of experience in a top\-tier management consulting firm, investment bank, Big 4 advisory practice, strategic finance or corporate finance role.
* Candidates from McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY\-Parthenon, Strategy\&, Kearney, Deloitte, Accenture Strategy, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and similar institutions would be relevant.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, financial modelling and business drivers.
* Excellent Gen AI capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to break down complex and ambiguous problems into structured analytical frameworks.
* Ability to independently develop a point of view from incomplete or complex information.
* Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to operate independently with limited supervision and significant ambiguity.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* High attention to detail combined with strong strategic judgement.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial and evolving environment.


**Preferred Experience**
* Strategic Finance / CFO Office experience.
* Top\-tier consulting experience with significant exposure to financial services, fintech or technology.
* Experience leading complex, cross\-functional transformation or strategic projects.
* Experience designing financial controls, reconciliation frameworks or financial infrastructure.
* Fintech / financial services / digital\-asset experience.
* IPO / capital\-markets exposure.
* Experience working with technology teams on automation of finance processes and data flows.


**What Success Looks Like**
 The successful candidate will be capable of independently taking ownership of important strategic initiatives and driving them from ambiguity to execution.
   

  

**Success will be measured by the individual's ability to:**
* Independently solve high\-priority, ambiguous problems.
* Drive strategic initiatives from problem definition through execution.
* Develop high\-quality analysis and recommendations that materially improve management decision\-making.
* Build scalable frameworks and automation rather than relying on manual processes.
* Strengthen financial governance and infrastructure without becoming the owner of day\-to\-day Finance operations.
* Work effectively across Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and Business teams.
* Become a trusted thought and execution partner to the Head of Finance.

title: Project Controls Engineer - ENS (Contract)
description:
**Description**
 We are seeking a driven, analytical, and detail\-oriented Project Controls Analyst to join our dedicated Project Controls team. This role is integral to our project delivery success, where you will help drive financial integrity across our project portfolio. You will be responsible for maintaining, updating, and managing project financial data, structures, and reporting within our central project portfolio management platform, EcoSys.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for a detail\-oriented professional with a strong foundation in project cost concepts to master an enterprise\-grade platform and support our global project teams in delivering critical infrastructure projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Data and Project Management in EcoSys: Create and maintain project records, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS), and internal cost codes. Ensure Work Authorization Forms (WAFs) are accurately reflected in the system.
* Budgeting and Cost Control: Facilitate budget modifications, track actual expenditures, monitor commitments, and perform periodic variance analyses to provide early warnings on potential overruns and inform corrective actions.
* Reporting and Analysis: Generate standard cost reports and ad\-hoc analyses for project managers and clients. Translate complex financial data into actionable insights for decision\-making.
* Change Management: Monitor and record internal project change requests, mapping approved changes directly to active project budgets and contingency funds within EcoSys to ensure financial traceability.
* System and Configuration Support: Assist senior system administrators in EcoSys setup, testing, system upgrades, and minor configuration updates to enhance system functionality and user experience.


**Technical \& Soft Skills**
* Foundational Cost Knowledge: A firm grasp of fundamental project cost control concepts (e.g., budgets, forecasts, actuals, commitments, WBS, and Earned Value Metrics).
* Software Familiarity: Prior hands\-on exposure to EcoSys is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with other Project Portfolio Management (PPM) or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools (such as Primavera P6, Oracle Unifier, or SAP Cost Management) is beneficial.
* Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data analysis) are required.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong logical reasoning with the ability to identify anomalies, patterns, and trends in financial datasets.
* Detail\-Oriented: A keen eye for data integrity, ensuring database naming conventions and budget configurations are precise and consistently applied.
* Proactive Communicator: Comfortable collaborating with multi\-disciplinary stakeholders, including project managers, engineers, and financial analysts, to resolve issues and provide support.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 1 to 3 years of experience in project controls, project cost analysis, or commercial project support, ideally within an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) environment.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Research, Risk, Data Science and Tech Solution: CRG started in early 2000s as a group with investment banking, research and risk audit at its heart, has evolved into the CRG and expanded into Data Engineering, research and product development, analytics and model validation, product development \& management, and data science \& analytics. You will have the opportunity to participate in training, mentoring, access to senior leaders and projects that engage your current skillset while developing new ones.

As an Analyst, you'll join a team of experts including economists, research and industry specialists who develop insights for clients including companies in the market and industry trends. We are a part of the global oil and gas team with office in Houston. We are regularly involved with valuation, technical side and buy\-side asset and corporate advisory roles in the upstream and midstream space, including supporting banking teams in IPOs, debt offerings, asset level evaluation of technical data, asset and corporate models and providing technical insight.
   

  

 We are looking to recruit an energetic Petroleum engineer who will work as a core member of J.P. Morgan's CRG TTT. This person will be responsible for technical evaluation of oil and gas assets through data analysis, Technical\-Transaction analysis, decline curve creation, and asset/corporate company corporate model assisting in generating and preparing pitch materials and offering presentations.
   

  

 We're looking for highly motivated team players to be the future leaders of our business. Join us at J.P. Morgan, where the positive change for the company and the world begins with you. As a company, we seek creative ideas through a supportive culture to help you develop and make an impact throughout your career. If you're passionate, curious and ready to make an impact, we're looking for you!
   

  

**Education/Vocational Requirements** 
 B.Tech or M.Tech in Petroleum Engineering Investment banking or consulting experience is a plus
   

  

**The TTT Engineer should have the following skills and experience:**
* Strong fundamental understanding of the oil and gas value chain as it relates to conventional and unconventional assets
* Should be proficient in technical and technical evaluation of oil and gas assets
* Should be proficient in technical data analysis and application to technical models
* Should be proficient in technical data and data collection and amalgamation utilities (i.e. Enverus, IHS etc.)
* Should be proficient in high quality global data analysis and application to technical models
* Should possess logical aptitude for Python, VBA and R programming
* Knowledge of financial markets and corporate finance
* Ability to work independently and possess strong attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


**What's next?** 
 We will review applications as they are received and extend offers on a rolling basis.
   

  

**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success.  Global Investment Banking supports a broad range of corporations, institutions and governments by providing strategic advice, capital raising and risk management expertise.
