title: Manager, Internal Audit
description:
**Job Description**
**SOX 404 Compliance, Control Design and Testing (approximately 60–70%)**
 Plan and execute assigned activities within the Company’s SOX 404 compliance program, ensuring work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with internal methodology and external\-auditor expectations.
   

  

* Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs): Maintain and update RCMs for relevant business processes and IT applications. Confirm that risks are appropriately addressed, control descriptions are clear and complete, and changes in processes, systems, ownership, or risk are reflected promptly.
* Walkthroughs and scoping: Conduct process and control walkthroughs, assess annual scope and key\-control coverage, document process flows, and identify changes that may affect control design or testing strategy.
* Business\-process controls: Evaluate the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of controls across key cycles, including Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Financial Close and Consolidation, Human Resources and Payroll, Property, Plant and Equipment, Treasury, Inventory, and other in\-scope processes.
* IT application controls (ITACs): Identify and test automated and semi\-automated controls within enterprise applications, including automated calculations, workflow approvals, three\-way matching, system configurations, and interfaces between internal systems and external service providers.
* Key reports and information produced by the entity (IPE): Identify reports, queries, spreadsheets, and other information used in control performance. Test completeness and accuracy through report logic, parameters, configuration, source\-to\-output reconciliation, access, change management, and, where applicable, SQL or code review.
* Testing and documentation: Prepare clear, complete, and reproducible workpapers that document procedures performed, evidence examined, samples selected, conclusions reached, and reviewer follow\-up. Record testing results and findings in the designated audit and SOX management system.
* Deficiency evaluation and remediation: Identify control gaps, perform root\-cause analysis with stakeholders, assess deficiency severity in accordance with the Company’s framework, agree practical remediation actions, monitor milestones, and retest completed remediation.
* External\-auditor coordination: Act as a primary point of coordination for assigned SOX areas, facilitate walkthroughs and evidence requests, resolve questions, and maintain alignment on scope, testing status, deficiencies, and remediation.
* Control\-owner training: Provide onboarding and periodic refresher training to control owners and performers on control objectives, evidence standards, documentation requirements, and changes to the SOX program.


**Business\-Process Audits, Systems and Advisory (approximately 30–40%)**
* Business\-process and operational audits: Support risk assessments, develop audit programs, perform interviews and testing, analyze root causes and business impact, and prepare practical recommendations. Assignments may cover financial, operational, compliance, technology\-enabled, and cross\-functional processes.
* Audit reporting and communication: Prepare concise status updates, findings, risk statements, and recommendations for management reports and presentations. Maintain regular communication with process owners, Internal Audit leadership, IT, and external auditors; escalate significant issues or delays promptly.
* Issue follow\-up: Maintain accurate records of open actions, validate remediation evidence, confirm sustainable closure, and report overdue or unresolved matters to appropriate stakeholders.
* Control advisory and continuous improvement: Advise stakeholders on process and control improvements while preserving Internal Audit independence. Promote standardized, efficient, and sustainable controls that comply with Company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Data analytics: Use data analysis to identify unusual transactions, process exceptions, control failures, operational bottlenecks, and indicators of error or potential fraud.
* Use of AI: Use Company\-approved AI and audit\-automation tools to support audit planning, SOX control testing, evidence analysis, workpaper preparation, and identification of control gaps. Validate all AI\-generated outputs against source evidence, apply professional judgment and human oversight, and comply with the Company’s confidentiality, data\-privacy, information\-security, and responsible\-AI requirements.
* Other assignments: Support investigations, inventory cycle counts, year\-end physical counts, and other Internal Audit priorities as assigned. Travel to Company locations is required.

* Master Degree (MS/MA) ICWA \- Preferred

* 12 years or more in 12 \- 15 Years

title: Associate
description:
**Company Description** 




 First Principles Law is a boutique corporate law firm advising founders, investors, companies, and family offices across PE, VC and M\&A transactions and strategic legal advisory. FPL was founded with a different belief — that the best legal advice begins with first principles, by challenging assumptions to focus on what truly matters.
 
 The Firm takes pride in a partner\-led approach to service delivery and client relationships, with the goal of becoming a long\-term collaborator.
 




  





**Our Values** 




 Fairness, Quality, Flexibility, Humility, Inclusiveness, Empathy and Fun (not flippant) \- are the lenses we hire through. More on what they mean to us here: https://firstprincipleslaw.com/hello\-world\-the\-journey\-to\-first\-principles\-law/
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The partners are building a firm that is excellent at work and just as excellent in how it treats its people. These are not trade\-offs. The work is demanding and the standards are high, because our clients deserve nothing less. And in return, so do you: you will be respected, supported, fairly rewarded, and treated the way we would want to be treated ourselves.
 



  





 What that looks like day to day:
 


* Trust by default \- no micromanagement, no hourly targets, no time\-sheet quotas. It works because everyone here holds themselves to the standard without being asked.
* Real ownership \- we are a small team, so you will run workstreams, deal with clients directly and see transactions from term sheet to closing. Your work is visible, and so is your judgment.
* Learning, built in \- you will work directly with the partners. They put real time into helping you think from first principles, not just from precedent.
* Outcomes over hours \- we care about getting it right and getting it done well, and not about how long it takes. Nobody gets points for staying late.
* AI as a tool, not a crutch \- everyone has an enterprise AI licence. We expect you to use it, and to stand behind every line it helps you produce.



  





 Roles and pay are based on what you do, not your PQE. Alongside competitive fixed pay, our variable compensation is linked to both your own contribution and how the firm performs as a whole. When the firm does well, the people who built that share in it.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* 2\-4 years PQE in PE, VC or M\&A
* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) or equivalent degree from a recognized institution
* Bar enrolment in India



  





 If you are curious, you follow through, and you would rather be trusted than managed – this opportunity is for you. If you are looking for more responsibility, and the room to carry it your way, we would love to talk.
 



  





**To Apply** 




 Write to contact@firstprincipleslaw.com with the subject line "Associate Application". Send your CV and a short note (250 words max) talking about any instance on a deal where you took ownership and delivered something beyond your brief. Also tell us if it impacted you in anyway \- did it help you grow or did you learn to do something better?

title: Privacy Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 Privacy Impact Consultant
   

  

 Today’s world is fuelled by vast amounts of information, and data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1,200 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.
   

  

 Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security\-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 Privacy Impact Consultants are responsible for assisting Information Security and other teams at EY to navigate the Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) process. They have a unique skillset with a deep understanding of data privacy law, technology, and information security, and contribute to sustaining an effective data protection and compliance management posture.
   

  

 Data privacy is complex. In order to meet the increasing demand, we are opening up a Privacy Impact Consultant role to ensure that the standard of data privacy at EY is maintained and continues to remain in compliance with local and global data privacy laws and regulations.
   

  

 With your understanding of data privacy within the context of technology, the Privacy Impact Consultant will be expected to collaborate with multiple technical and business\-level teams teams, members of the EY General Counsel Office, and Global Privacy Network throughout the PIA process.
   

  

 Your key responsibilities
   

  

 Day\-to\-day, this role will be:
   

  

* Inputting, analyzing, and reporting on metrics and activity plans in support of continuous improvement of existing privacy frameworks
* Developing an understanding of the PIA process in EY Technology
* Providing input to help determine whether a technology requires a PIA
* Assessing privacy risks associated on EY technologies
* Assisting customer support with privacy\-specific inquiries
* Maintain your understanding of global data privacy laws and corporate policies that are impacting EY.
* Working with technology teams to successfully complete the PIA process from initiation to completion
* Collaborating with Privacy Consulting Team members to understand the work that needs to be done
* Conduct research to guide key decision\-making
* Inputting, analyzing, and reporting on activity plans
* Perform other duties as assigned


 Skills and attributes for success
   

  

 To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following core skills:
   

  

* Deep understanding and working knowledge of privacy frameworks (GDPR, etc)
* Strong work ethic that demonstrates analytical and critical thinking
* Ability to communicate fluently in English on complex subjects and adapt communications to various audiences, including Executives, Sponsors, Management, overall organization and project teams – includes verbal, written and presentation skills
* Attention to detail
* Ability to work on multiple tasks simultaneously, prioritizing tasks accordingly, and communicating these priorities with management
* Work as a team to consistently learn and share advanced knowledge and practices that promote team excellence
* Understanding of the importance of customer focus, based on openness, trust, and delivering on commitments
* Ability to gain stakeholder buy\-in and manage their expectations
* Ability to collaborate across functional teams, cultures and geographies, and build trust virtually
* Self\-starter requiring minimal supervision
* Understanding of project management methodology (includes project planning, and schedule and scope management)
* Intermediate skills with MS Office
* Confidence in decision\-making
* Highly organized and efficient


 To qualify for the role, you must have
   

  

* Judicial Doctorate, Master’s, or Bachelor’s degree with concentrations in Computer Science, Information Security, or Global Policies preferred
* One or more of the following: CIPP, CIPT, CIPM CISSP, CRISC, CISA, FIP, CDPSE
* At least 4\+ years’ experience in privacy and data protection, risk management, compliance or information security administration
* Solid knowledge of local and global data privacy laws, regulations, and concepts
* Experience conducting privacy and risk assessments
* Demonstrated project management and organizational skills
* Knowledge and experience working with technology teams, in particular information security
* Flexibility to work outside typical hours, as required of a global team


 Ideally, you’ll also have
   

  

* Proven trustworthiness and history of acting with integrity, taking pride in work, seeking to excel, being curious and adaptable, and communicating well
* Excellence in communicating privacy, business risk and remediation requirements from assessments
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset


 What we look for
   

  

* Understanding of, and experience using, analytical concepts and statistical techniques.
* Ability to deliver metrics from inception to completion


 What we offer
   

  

 As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Outsourcing Risk Manager, Account Compliance
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Payments entities operate as regulated financial services providers across multiple jurisdictions, subject to stringent third\-party risk management requirements. Some examples include CSSF Circular 22/806 (Luxembourg), EBA Guidelines on Outsourcing and FCA SYSC 8 (UK), and MAS Guidelines on Outsourcing (Singapore).
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) professional to join our Account Compliance team as an Outsourcing Risk Manager. This role requires demonstrated expertise in conducting outsourcing risk assessments for regulated financial institutions, with specific knowledge of regulatory frameworks governing critical and important outsourcing arrangements.
   

  

 You will be responsible for executing the First Line outsourcing risk management program for Amazon Payments' regulated entities (APE, APUK, API, APS SG, and others). This includes conducting annual risk assessments of intragroup and external vendor arrangements, partnering with Legal and Transfer Pricing teams to manage intercompany contracts, establishing KPIs and governance mechanisms to monitor service delivery, partnering with business teams to implement risk\-mitigation controls, and ensuring compliance with entity\-specific regulatory requirements.
   

  

 This is a critical role enabling Amazon Payments to scale globally while maintaining robust regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience performing risk assessments under frameworks such as CSSF 22/806, EBA Guidelines on Outsourcing, FCA SYSC 8, or equivalent regulatory regimes, and can demonstrate practical application of outsourcing risk management principles in a regulated financial services environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead First Line Risk Management for Amazon's outsourcing arrangements between internal Amazon entities and external vendors, establishing strategic partnerships with Second Line departments to ensure robust risk governance and regulatory compliance.
* Own and execute annual risk assessments for services between Amazon entities and external vendors, including comprehensive information gathering with partner teams, developing detailed risk assessments, and securing final approvals from Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Information Security stakeholders within established timelines.
* Partner strategically with Legal and Transfer Pricing, to maintain existing intragroup contracts to ensure service scope, KPIs, and terms remain aligned with evolving business requirements and regulatory obligations.
* Collaborate with partner teams to proactively identify risks, establish effective mitigation controls with clear delivery timelines, and define KPIs to track and measure performance against contractual obligations.
* Create and maintain robust documentation serving as an audit trail for Amazon Payments Compliance functions, insisting on the highest standards and embedding an 'audit\-ready' mentaility.
* Collaborate with Business Intelligence Engineers and Analysts to design, build, and automate reporting mechanisms, while establishing escalation protocols for KPIs that breach contractual obligations, ensuring timely remediation and stakeholder visibility.
* Enable business expansion by partnering with Business Expansion, Risk, and Compliance teams to establish compliant intragroup outsourcing structures for new legal entity launches and manage vendor onboarding processes in accordance with regulatory requirements, including preparation of regulatory notifications and submissions where required.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying and executing opportunities to enhance operational efficiency through standardization and automation, working cross\-functionally across Compliance, Operations, Risk, and Analytics teams to prioritize and deliver measurable improvements.
* Champion a culture of compliance by proactively engaging with on\-site partner teams, driving higher quality inputs, reinforcing compliance concepts, and fostering a risk\-aware environment across all outsourcing activities.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll conduct risk assessments for critical vendors, analyzing due diligence questionnaires to identify control gaps. You'll partner with Legal and Transfer Pricing on intragroup contract amendments, ensuring regulatory compliant clauses. You'll conduct outsourcing categorization assessments for new jurisdictions, guiding business teams through regulatory due diligence requirements. You'll monitor service providers KPIs, identifying SLA breaches requiring investigation, and prepare quarterly Board(s) reporting on outsourcing arrangements. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with a range of stakeholders (Second Line Risk and Compliance Officers, Information Security, Legal teams, business stakeholders, providing guidance on policy interpretation and regulatory obligations while balancing compliance precision with business pragmatism. You will be driving risk mitigation actions.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll join the Account Compliance Risk \& Quality team in TSI, serving as First Line of Defense for outsourcing risk management across Amazon Payments' regulated entities. We operate at the intersection of regulatory compliance, risk management, and business enablement—ensuring Amazon Payments meets regulatory obligations while supporting global scaling. We partner closely with Second Line Risk \& Compliance, Legal, Information Security, Finance, Tax, Transfer Pricing, and business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. We value regulatory expertise, practical problem\-solving, working through ambiguity, and translating complex compliance requirements into actionable guidance. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and maintaining highest regulatory standards while enabling business innovation.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent
* Experience in confidential environments


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Sapiens**

**What You’ll Do**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Security Compliance and Information Security Manager to ensure the organization’s compliance with all relevant security regulations, frameworks, and standards. The role is responsible for safeguarding our information systems, managing risk, and leading compliance efforts. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in both compliance and technical security measures, ensuring a proactive approach to security threats while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Security Compliance:**
* Lead the development, implementation, and management of the company’s security compliance programs (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards, including data protection laws, privacy regulations, and industry\-specific guidelines.
* Develop and maintain documentation related to compliance policies, standards, and processes.

**Information Security**
* Develop and implement the organization’s information security strategy, policies, and procedures to protect critical systems and data.
* Monitor and assess security risks, threats, and vulnerabilities across all information systems, networks, and applications.
* Lead incident response efforts, including forensic analysis, investigation, and reporting of security breaches or incidents.
* Implement security technologies such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), data loss prevention (DLP), and endpoint protection tools.
* Manage identity and access management (IAM) systems, ensuring that access controls and user privileges are appropriately defined and enforced.
* Oversee the security of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), including configuration reviews, security assessments, and monitoring.
* Conduct regular security testing, including vulnerability scans and penetration testing, to validate the security posture of systems.
* Work closely with DevOps and engineering teams to integrate security practices into development and operational processes (DevSecOps).

* Stay current on the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and technologies, and recommend upgrades to security infrastructure as necessary.

**Must have Skills.**
* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in information security, risk management, or security compliance.
* Experience managing compliance programs (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).
* In\-depth knowledge of information security principles, including network security, application security, encryption, identity management, and incident response.
* Familiarity with security tools and technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, DLP, SIEM, endpoint security, and vulnerability management.
* Experience with cloud security in platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong understanding of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and their impact on security compliance.
* Strong leadership skills and experience managing cross\-functional teams or security operations.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC are highly desirable.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in information security, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* Hands\-on experience with security automation and orchestration in a DevSecOps environment.
* Experience working with security frameworks for regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance).
* Familiarity with advanced threat detection and mitigation strategies.
* Certifications in cloud security (e.g., AWS Certified Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate).

**Employee Relations Manager (GCC)** 




**Organization: HR \- GCC** 




**Function: Human Resources**

**Position Summary:** 




 The Employee Relations Manager will serve as the primary advisor on Employee Relations, Grievance handling and setting up and operationalizing labor compliance adherence for the organization. This role provides strategic, operational inputs and secures implementation across employment laws, employee litigation, labor regulatory compliance with the company’s operations in India. Build a proactive ER framework that promotes a positive employee experience, workplace harmony, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of India Labor Laws, Codes and frameworks, experience supporting multinational organizations, working in matrixed organizations, and strong expertise in the field. The role will work closely with India Legal Counsel, US Legal and US Employee Relations teams as needed.
 



  





**Role Responsibilities:** 



* The Employee Relations Manager will be responsible for:
* HR Labor Law Strategy \& Implementation
* Provide expert guidance on a broad range of employment, labor regulatory matters impacting the Global Capability Center (GCC).
* Partner with business leaders and HR stakeholders to advise on complex employee relations matters, including disciplinary actions, grievance management, workplace investigations, performance issues, misconduct cases, and separations.
* Lead the design, review, and implementation of HR policies, practices, and processes, ensuring compliance with applicable labor laws and regulatory requirements in India.
* Develop and execute a comprehensive Employee Relations strategy that fosters a positive work environment, strengthens employee engagement, mitigates workplace risks, and ensures uninterrupted business operations.
* Establish and drive governance frameworks, compliance review mechanisms, and risk management practices to proactively identify, assess, and address employee relations and labor law risks.
* Monitor legislative developments and emerging employment law trends, providing timely recommendations to ensure organizational readiness and compliance.
* Drive stakeholder awareness and capability building through training, communication, and advisory initiatives on labor law compliance and employee relations best practices.



  





**Employee Relations Case \& Workplace Investigations:** 



* Manage complex employee relations matters including grievances, disciplinary actions, misconduct investigations, conflict resolution, and workplace complaints.
* Lead sensitive investigations while ensuring procedural fairness, confidentiality, and compliance with organizational policies.
* Recommend appropriate disciplinary actions and ensure consistent application of company policies. Monitor investigation outcomes and identify systemic improvements.
* Lead investigations related to misconduct, ethics violations, workplace concerns, and policy breaches.
* Partner with Ethics, Compliance, Legal, and HR teams to ensure objective and timely resolution of cases.



  





**Regulatory Compliance and Governance:** 



* Lead labor law compliance and regulatory governance across the GCC, ensuring adherence to applicable statutory requirements.
* Monitor changes in Indian labor laws and proactively recommend updates to policies, practices, and compliance frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate ER, HR, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure alignment and effective risk management.
* Oversee statutory compliance filings, audits, regulatory inspections, and interactions with government authorities.
* Support litigation, labor disputes, investigations, and regulatory inquiries in collaboration with Legal.
* Ensure the establishment, compliance, and effectiveness of statutory committees, including POSH and Grievance Redressal Committees.
* Implement governance and risk review mechanisms to identify, mitigate, and report employee relations and compliance risks.



  





**Stakeholder Management:** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders,
* Liaise effectively with external labor regulatory authorities, and government agencies.
* Provide labor law awareness training and guidance to GCC leaders and associates to foster a culture of compliance and integrity.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* We believe the successful candidate has these qualifications and experience:



**Education:** 



* Certified POSH Internal Committee member experience
* Experience establishing ER programs in a GCC or multinational environment
* Experience managing employment\-related investigations and labor inspections
* Bachelor’s / master’s degree specializing in Labor Relations and Employment Law.



  





**Experience:** 



* 10\+ years of handling the Employee Relations responsibilities, ideally supporting multinational or U.S.\-based corporations.
* Strong experience with India employment labor compliance laws.
* Preferred if have experience of working in Tech Start Ups / GCC.



  





**Key Competencies:** 



* Strong business acumen and ability to provide practical, risk\-balanced legal advice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English \& Kannada required).
* High ethical standards and professional integrity.
* Deep expertise in Indian employment and labor laws
* Experience managing interactions with labor authorities, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.
* Knowledge of Employee Relations practices, investigations, conflict resolution, and workplace governance.
* Strong consulting / problem resolution experience with demonstrated ability to influence all employee levels from front line to senior leaders;
* Demonstrates expected risk/controls behaviors by holding self and others accountable to operate within established standards and procedures.

The candidate will focus on minimizing legal risks and ensuring compliance across the organization.

* + Collaborate with business teams to understand legal requirements and align them with company objectives.

**Company Description** 




  





 Electronics Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (ELCOT) is a Government of Tamil Nadu undertaking under the Information Technology and Digital Services Department. ELCOT promotes IT investment in the state, builds technology infrastructure such as IT Parks and data centres, leads large\-scale IT procurement for Government, and supports emerging technology sectors including AI and AVGC\-XR.

 The Assistant Vice President – Company Secretarial \& Corporate Governance (Company Secretary) is a full\-time, on\-site contract role based in Chennai. The role leads ELCOT's company secretarial, Board governance, and corporate compliance functions, ensuring timely, accurate, and confidential coordination of statutory, Board, Government\-company, JV/associate\-company, and SPV matters. * 7–15 years of post\-qualification experience in company secretarial, corporate governance, and statutory compliance functions, including at least 3 years independently managing Board/Committee processes, statutory filings, and governance compliance
* Experience in a Government company, PSU, or large organisation with multiple subsidiaries/JVs/SPVs is desirable, as is experience coordinating with senior management, regulators, auditors, and legal advisers
* Strong drafting, documentation, analytical, and issue\-tracking skills, with sound judgement, discretion, and the ability to work independently under strict timelines.

title: Analyst, Third Party Risk Management
description:
**Job Purpose**
 The objective of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) Office is to promote, facilitate and support consistent and effective vendor risk management across the enterprise. This role supports activities associated with managing vendors and third\-party relationships.
   

  

 This team member will work with all levels of staff including senior management to mitigate vendor risks in alignment with company risk tolerances. This team member will manage on\-boarding activities, support periodic vendor reviews, continuous monitoring, vendor decommissioning, and assist with vendor risk reporting to ensure Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) maintains healthy vendor relationships.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage a portfolio of vendors across several business lines, across several risk domains.
* Assess vendor risk, perform appropriate due diligence, and ensure completeness of vendor documentation.
* Serve as a liaison between the vendor, business and supporting teams (i.e., IT, legal, procurement, accounting, and operations). Collaborate with business partners to maintain a clear documentation trail of vendors passing through the VM (Vendor Management) Lifecycle.
* Responsible to produce internal vendor management status reports and metrics.
* Facilitate resolution of escalated vendor\-related issues related to on\-boarding, decommissioning or risk assessing, monitoring and performance.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of relevant internal policies and external regulatory requirements applicable to ICE vendor risk management.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 6\+ years of experience in Third Party Risk Management, compliance, security audit management, supply chain management, or other directly related experience. Direct experience in TPRM or compliance highly desirable.
* Experience working for Banking, Insurance, or Information Technology company a plus.
* CRVPM or CTPRP highly desirable.
* Demonstrated leadership in Vendor Management and can be viewed as VM expert.
* Demonstrated competency working well within a team and across departments.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Proven record of accomplishment in taking ownership, driving results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Self\-starter with high degree of initiative and the ability to manage deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize while maintaining close attention to detail.
* Basic knowledge of and experience with legal contracts, contract negotiations and service agreements.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, particularly Excel, Power Point and Visio.

title: Tech Risk and Controls Lead - Technology regulatory change management
description:
**Job Description**
 Join our team to play a pivotal role in mitigating tech risks and upholding operational excellence. Drive innovation in risk management and advance your career with us.
   

  

 As a Tech Risk \& Controls Lead within the Cybersecurity and Technology Controls team, you will identify and mitigate compliance and operational risks in line with firm standards. You provide subject matter expertise and technical guidance to technology\-aligned process owners, ensuring controls operate effectively and comply with regulatory, legal, and industry standards. By partnering with stakeholders, you contribute to reporting a comprehensive view of technology risk posture and its impact on the business. Your advanced knowledge enables you to drive innovative solutions and manage a diverse team in a dynamic risk landscape.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Ensure effective identification, quantification, communication, and management of technology risk, focusing on root cause analysis and resolution recommendations

* Develop and maintain robust relationships, becoming a trusted partner with LOB technologists, assessments teams, and data officers to facilitate cross\-functional collaboration and progress toward shared goals
* Execute reporting and governance of controls, policies, issue management, and measurements, offering senior management insights into control effectiveness and inform governance work

* Promotes reuse\-first, AI\-assisted approaches to streamline recurring control testing and issue/action\-plan management routines, ensuring human review and alignment to auditability and regulatory expectations


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Minimum 5 years of experience or equivalent expertise in technology risk management, cybersecurity, or a related field, with a focus on regulatory compliance and risk mitigation
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support technology risk and controls workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted risk summaries and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to security, auditability, and regulatory expectations.
* In\-depth understanding of risk management frameworks, industry standards, and financial industry regulatory requirements
* Proficient knowledge and expertise in data security, risk assessment \& reporting, control evaluation, design, and governance, with a proven record of implementing effective risk mitigation strategies
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive\-level strategic decision\-making and translating technology insights into business strategies for senior executives


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Advanced degree in cybersecurity, information technology, or related field
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams in a technology risk environment
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Certified in CRISC, ISO 27001 and proven track record of implementing innovative risk management solutions

title: Legal Counsel - Mergers & Acquisitions
description:
**Role Overview :** 




  





 Legal counsel will be responsible for leading strategic M\&A transactions, drafting and negotiating complex, high\-value commercial agreements, and managing cross\-functional corporate projects. This role serves as a key legal advisor to senior leadership, balancing risk mitigation with business growth, while actively contributing to the overall development and scaling of the corporate legal function.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





**1\. M\&A \& Strategic Transactions** 



* End\-to\-end legal support for M\&A, joint ventures, strategic investments, and restructurings—from NDA execution to post\-merger integration.
* Drive transaction execution: conduct and manage legal due diligence, draft and negotiate transaction documents (term sheets, SHAs, SPAs, SSAs, asset purchase agreements), and coordinate regulatory/compliance approvals.
* Partner with Finance, Tax, Strategy, and external legal counsel to structure deals, manage transaction risks, and ensure seamless closing.



  





**2\. Complex Contracting \& Commercial Transactions** 



* Draft, vet, and negotiate high\-complexity, cross\-border, and bespoke commercial agreements (MSAs, Software/IP Licensing, Strategic Alliances, Joint Development, EPC/Infrastructure, Outsourcing, Distribution, and Vendor Agreements).
* Manage standard commercial contracts (Lease/Leave \& License, Warehousing, Marketing, Endorsement, Workplace Support, Manpower, SOWs, NDAs) with an emphasis on turnaround time and process efficiency.
* Identify legal deviations from standard positions, assess risk exposure, and present risk\-mitigation strategies to business teams.
* Lead complex, high\-stakes external contract negotiations with senior counterparties.



  





  





**3\. Corporate Projects \& Strategic Advisory** 



* Lead legal strategy for key corporate initiatives, new business launches, product rollouts, and internal reorganizations.
* Provide pragmatic, actionable legal counsel to internal stakeholders across Business, Admin, Procurement, IT, Finance, Tax, Marketing, and HR.
* Review marketing collaterals, advise on IP/branding strategies, and oversee trademark licensing and enforcement activities across regions.
* Manage real estate portfolio documentation, ensuring appropriate stamping, registration, and local compliance across India.



  





**4\. Corporate Legal Function Development \& Governance** 



* Build and standardize the legal ops infrastructure: design contract templates, playbooks, SLA workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Implement and manage digital legal tech tools (Contract Lifecycle Management / CLM platforms, compliance trackers, repository tools).
* Track regulatory changes and emerging legal risks, translating them into policy updates and internal training for business teams.
* Monitor and optimize legal spending by managing external counsel retainers, law firm engagement, and fee structures.



  





**5\. Litigation Strategy \& Risk Mitigation** 



* Formulate pre\-litigation strategies, draft legal notices, and manage responses to dispute notices to avoid litigation.
* Oversee disputes, legal notices, and arbitrations arising out of M\&A, joint ventures, or strategic commercial contracts alongside external counsel.



  





  





**Knowledge and Skill / Qualification Requirements :** 




  




* **Qualification:** 
 LL.B / LL.M from a premier law school or university in India.
* **Experience:** 
 8–12 years of Post\-Qualification Experience (PQE) at a leading law firm, top corporate house, or a blend of both.
* **Core Track Record:** 
 Proven experience in leading M\&A deals, negotiating complex contracts, and advising on multi\-stakeholder corporate projects.
* **M\&A Expertise:** 
 Strong technical expertise in corporate law, structural deal execution, deal documentation, and transaction management.
* **Complex Negotiation:** 
 Ability to stand firm on key commercial and legal positions while keeping deal momentum moving.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Ability to translate complex legal risks into business context and advise executive leaders on strategic trade\-offs.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build trust with C\-suite leadership, business partners, and external counsel.
* **Execution \& Ownership:** 
 High self\-motivation, sense of urgency, and ability to manage multiple complex mandates simultaneously under tight deadlines.
* **Process \& Technology Orientated:** 
 Track record of driving efficiency, introducing playbooks, or deploying CLM/legal tech tools.

title: Trade Surveillance, Vice President, Oversight, Monitoring and Testing
description:
We're seeking someone to join our team as a Vice President in the Legal and Compliance division.
   

  

 In the Legal \& Compliance division, we assist the Firm in achieving its business objectives by facilitating and overseeing the Firm's management of legal, regulatory and franchise risk. This is an Vice President level position within the Oversight, Monitoring and Testing.
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You'll Do In The Role**
* The successful candidate will be responsible for a range of surveillance and compliance activities, including but not limited to:
* Conducting daily surveillance across equities, derivatives, fixed income, and commodities trading to ensure compliance with regulatory and exchange requirements.
* Collaborating with Compliance, Operations, and front office teams to investigate and resolve surveillance alerts.
* Reviewing and escalating alerts appropriately, documenting outcomes clearly and escalating potential issues without delay. Assessing and enhancing the effectiveness of surveillance reports and related monitoring tools.
* Performing ad hoc trading reviews to support Legal and Compliance teams, including detailed incident assessments, and preparing and submitting STORs to the FCA or other competent authorities when required.
* Designing, enhancing, and calibrating surveillance controls, as well as supporting the implementation of new controls.
* Contributing to surveillance related projects and initiatives, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
* Maintaining strong working relationships across regions and levels, collaborating with colleagues in EMEA and global surveillance teams to support the surveillance program.
* Partnering with key stakeholders \- Sales \& Trading Coverage, Business Control Unit, Technology, external vendors to design and implement enhancements to the surveillance framework.
* Preparing and improving Management Information (MI) reporting to support governance and oversight.
* Providing subject matter expertise to Regulatory Enquiries and business\-line Compliance teams on surveillance matters, including trading behaviour, exchange mechanics, market dynamics, and indicators of suspicious activity


**What You'll Bring To The Role**
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex scenarios clearly and concisely\-both verbally and in writing\-to stakeholders at all levels.
* Typically, 8\+ years’ relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.
* Strong analytical capability, including experience handling, analysing, and presenting large datasets to identify anomalies or patterns of concern.
* Demonstrated ability to assess control logic and thresholds, evaluating effectiveness and identifying opportunities for enhancement.
* Highly organised and execution focused, able to manage competing priorities and deliver high quality work within deadlines.
* Confident decision maker, comfortable using sound judgment and initiative in an in house environment.
* Skilled at building strong working relationships, fostering open two way communication and trust with colleagues across global offices, and supporting a culture of development and constructive feedback.
* Adaptable team player, willing to support colleagues and contribute to the overall success of the EMEA surveillance programme.
* Hands on experience with third party surveillance systems, such as Nasdaq Trade Surveillance, Trading Hub, or Actimize, as well as market data platforms including Bloomberg and LSEG Workspace.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools, including the ability to use Tableau/SQL to interrogate and analyse large datasets.
* Post graduate qualification (e.g., MSc or MBA in Finance) preferred.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

**Job Purpose:**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Contract Specialist to manage low\-to\-medium value contracts across the APAC region. The role is responsible for end\-to\-end contract lifecycle management, including renewals, vendor engagement, bidding processes, negotiations, and collaboration with cross\-functional teams such as Procurement, Legal, and Global Governance.

**Renewals \& Spend Analysis**
* Monitor upcoming contract renewals and proactively review spend patterns.
* Conduct spend analysis and consolidation to identify optimization opportunities.
* Recommend renewal, renegotiation, or termination based on business needs and cost efficiency.


**Stakeholder Coordination**
* Collaborate closely with Buyers and End Users to determine contract renewal requirements.

**Governance \& Legal Coordination**
* Work closely with Global Governance and Legal teams for contract drafting, review, and execution.
* Ensure all contractual terms comply with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.


**Vendor Management**
* Serve as the primary owner for managing contracted vendors.
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to drive performance and value.
* Address vendor issues, escalations, and performance concerns.


**Sourcing \& Bidding**
* Initiate and manage bidding processes for new and renewal contracts.
* Run tenders and evaluate supplier proposals based on commercial and technical criteria.
* Ability to synthesize complex bid data into clear, concise summaries that highlight key commercial insights and risks
* Capability to structure and present a compelling bid narrative that supports effective and timely decision\-making.
* Ensure transparency and fairness in procurement processes.


**Negotiation**
* Lead negotiations on commercial terms, legal clauses, and company policies.
* Achieve cost savings while ensuring risk mitigation and compliance.


**Procurement Support**

* Handle Purchase Requisition (PR) processing by running tenders and facilitating approvals.
* Ensure PRs are routed and approved in accordance with procurement policies.


**Your profile:**
* Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management (CLM).
* Strong understanding of Legal clauses and ability to negotiate.
* Experience in sourcing, bidding, and vendor negotiations.
* Knowledge of procurement processes, policies, and compliance frameworks.
* Ability to analyse spend data and identify cost optimization opportunities.
* Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination across cross\-functional teams.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple contracts simultaneously.
* Proficiency in procurement tools (Oracle, Coupa, or similar is a plus).


**Experience Level:**
* 3–6 years of experience in contract management, procurement, or sourcing.
* Experience managing low\-to\-medium value contracts in a global or regional setup (APAC preferred).


**Education Level:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business administration, Supply Chain, Law.
   

  

**We offer:**
* Great opportunity to work for the biggest logistics company in the world
* International and virtual environment
* Flexibility and great opportunity to learn
* Tempting Compensation and benefits

**Job Title:** 
 Operational and Permanent Control Senior Analyst (AM)
   

  

**Department** 
 : P\&P ISPL ARAP
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Procurement \& Performance
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The OPC Senior Analyst operates the Control framework relating to all operational risks, including Fraud, Third Party, Conduct, Compliance, Regulatory, Information \& Communication Technology risks, and others risks types. OPC is responsible for the deployment of internal policies and procedures issued by specialized independent control functions part of Risk teams (2nd Line of Defence), and for the compliance with external regulatory and supervisory requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

 ▪ Identify and assess risks and controls (Risk and Control Self\-Assessment) of higher complexity, by ensuring that key operational units and processes, material risks and risk mitigants are identified. Perform/drive the risk identification and assessment in liaison with independent control Functions when needed, ensuring validation by the relevant management level and consistency with the defined risk tolerance. Contribute to the definition and follow\-up of remediation plan if needed.
   

  

 ▪ Manage Procedures by ensuring that Group procedures requirements are implemented locally, complemented with local specificities (regulations, tools, organizations ...). Ensure that the procedures designed by the businesses and functions are identified, updated, properly stored and communicated to the relevant stakeholders within the Operating Entity. Identify and propose calibration of procedures according to the outcome of the risk assessment and other risk events (HI, control results, external events, Audit missions).
   

  

 ▪ Implement Complex and elaborated controls and action plans: by defining and regularly updating the control plans according to the outcome of the risk assessment, regulations, other risk events (Historical Incidents, control results, external events, Audits). Perform and/or coordinate controls according to this control plan. Ensure that control results are reviewed and analysed by the Management and when relevant by operational teams / relevant stakeholders and that remediation action plans are defined if and when needed. Input in Group tools the control results and major action plans. Follow\-up the implementation of high\-complexity remediation actions.
   

  

 ▪ Document findings, recommendations and permanent control actions: Upon notification/receipt of reports, organise the follow\-up of the findings and recommendations on more complex and difficult situations, either issued internally (e.g. IG supervision) or externally (external auditors, supervisors) and ensure that they are closed within due date.
   

  

 ▪ Manage historical incidents with a higher complexity nature, by alerting the management and the independent control functions if needed on key incidents. Collect incidents (including impacts measurement), report and update in the incidents database, including suspected and attempted fraud cases. Analyse complex and difficult incidents in a timely manner and define, jointly with the relevant stakeholders, the correctives measures be implemented to mitigate risks. Follow\-up and /or initiate the implementation of elaborated remediation actions and the unfolding of long term incidents. Perform controls on the incident collection process, in particular the cross\-check with other databases (accounting or other when existing) and the half\-yearly attestation by the local management.
   

  

 ▪ Provide complex and consistent Management support and governance by active contribution (or organization) to any committee on Operational risks and Permanent Control committees. Alert and escalate to the relevant level of management any operational risk incident and/or any recurring weakness. Perform periodic and ad\-hoc reporting to the appropriate level of management as well as to independent control functions. Support in appropriate training on Operational risks and Permanent Control framework is provided to employees, notably newcomers. Show ability to take ownership of specific OPC activity streams/topics, and be able to deliver the full and exhaustive actions taken on the assigned process(es) to the management.
   

  

 ▪ Manage OPC related Projects including frame, design and lead autonomously the delivery of one or more projects, ensuring quality and respect of deadlines. Take full ownership on assigned modules and perform complex analyses whilst understanding their potential impact for the concerned teams/internal clients. Lead workshops and meetings using relevant techniques and providing insightful results. Deliver meaningful content bringing out\-of\-the\-box ideas on top of classic methodologies. Prepare, structure and conduct/deliver presentations for Business/Top Managers.
   

  

 ▪ Support team members' development by seeking proactively to participate and help the team beyond the assigned duties. Coach junior team members and contribute to their professional development. Facilitate the knowledge sharing within the team.

 Flexible working in EMEA \& APAC shifts

title: P5 Senior Lead - Corporate Secretarial
description:
PAYU PAYMENTS PRIVATE LIMITED
 **About the Team:**
 The Corporate Secretarial team is responsible for supporting corporate governance, statutory compliance and regulatory requirements across PayU. The team works closely with the Company Secretary, senior management, the Board and its committees, internal stakeholders, shareholders, auditors and regulatory authorities.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 PayU is looking for a technically strong and proactive Senior Lead – Corporate Secretarial to support the Company Secretary and lead key corporate secretarial and governance activities. The role will involve managing statutory compliances, Board and committee processes, regulatory filings, corporate records, shareholder\-related matters and governance initiatives. The position will require close engagement with senior management and internal and external stakeholders in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Manage compliances under the Companies Act, applicable SEBI regulations, Secretarial Standards and other corporate governance requirements.
* Manage end\-to\-end processes for Board and committee meetings, including: Preparation and circulation of notices, Agenda coordination, Compilation of Board papers, Drafting and finalisation of minutes, Tracking of action points.
* Coordinate statutory filings, disclosures and intimations with the Registrar of Companies, stock exchanges and other regulatory authorities.
* Maintain statutory registers, corporate records, compliance trackers and other secretarial documentation.
* Monitor regulatory developments and support their timely implementation across the organisation.
* Support the preparation of the Annual Report and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR).
* Support general meeting, postal ballot, dividend, Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) and shareholder\-service processes.
* Monitor compliance under the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015\.
* Lead, guide and review the work of team members.
* Support corporate secretarial audits, statutory audits, due diligence exercises and regulatory reviews.
* Provide corporate secretarial support for corporate transactions and special projects.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and strengthen corporate governance and compliance processes.
* Provide practical guidance to internal stakeholders on applicable corporate secretarial and governance requirements.


**Requirements:**
* Qualified Company Secretary.
* At least 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a listed company or a complex corporate secretarial environment.
* Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, applicable SEBI regulations, Secretarial Standards and corporate governance practices.
* Experience in managing end\-to\-end Board and committee meeting processes.
* Experience in handling regulatory filings, disclosures and intimations with the Registrar of Companies, stock exchanges and other regulatory authorities.
* Experience in maintaining statutory registers, corporate records and compliance trackers.
* Experience in managing general meetings, postal ballots, dividend\-related matters, IEPF processes and shareholder services.
* Working knowledge of compliance requirements under the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015\.
* Experience in supporting Annual Report and BRSR processes.
* Experience in handling audits, due diligence, corporate transactions and special projects.
* Strong drafting, written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and organisational skills, with a high level of accuracy and discretion.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines, interpret regulatory changes and provide practical guidance to the business.
* Experience in handling an IPO, including IPO\-related corporate secretarial, governance, due diligence, disclosure or regulatory activities, will be an advantage.


**What We Offer?**
* A positive, get\-things\-done workplace
* A dynamic, constantly evolving space (change is par for the course – important you are comfortable with this).
* An inclusive environment that ensures we listen to a diverse range of voices when making decisions.
* Ability to learn cutting edge concepts and innovation in an agile start\-up environment with a global scale.
* Access to 5000\+ training courses accessible anytime/anywhere to support your growth and development (Corporate with top learning partners like Harvard, Coursera, Udacity).


**About Us:**
 At PayU, we are a global fintech investor and our vision is to build a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. We give people in high growth markets the financial services and products they need to thrive. Our expertise in 18\+ high\-growth markets enable us to extend the reach of financial services. This drives everything we do, from investing in technology entrepreneurs to offering credit to underserved individuals, to helping merchants buy, sell, and operate online. Being part of Prosus, one of the largest technology investors in the world, gives us the presence and expertise to make a real impact. Find out more at www.payu.in
   

  

**Our Commitment to Building a Diverse and Inclusive Workforce**
 As a global and multi\-cultural organization with varied ethnicities thriving across locations, we realize that our responsibility towards fulfilling the D\&I commitment is huge. Therefore, we continuously strive to create a diverse, inclusive, and safe environment, for all our people, communities, and customers. Our leaders are committed to create an inclusive work culture which enables transparency, flexibility, and unbiased attention to every PayUneer so they can succeed, irrespective of gender, colour, or personal faith. An environment where every person feels they belong, that they are listened to, and where they are empowered to speak up. At PayU we have zero tolerance towards any form of prejudice whether a specific race, ethnicity, or of persons with disabilities, or the LGBTQ communities

 Regularly interacting with the regulators to seek clarifications on guidelines or representing various business proposals for their approval.

 The role is responsible for strengthening compliance culture, supporting anti\-corruption and fair competition efforts, and ensuring practical, effective controls across India.

title: Business Risk Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
* Assist Business Head/ Head BRM in coordinating, driving and directing effective compliance and operational risk management at the Business Unit level.
* Implement controls within the Business Unit to meet all regulatory and internal requirements.
* Ensure proper functioning of day\-to\-day controls, periodic monitoring activities and timely resolution of risk issues.
* Ensure effective management of non\-financial risk of the Banking business on behalf of the Group Process Owner through the following key responsibilities:


**Risk Identification, Assessment \& Insight**
* Lead risk incident governance (operational, financial, conduct and non\-financial) impacting business activities, client outcomes, and operational resilience, including triage, classification, escalation and management reporting
* Ensure thorough analysis of incidents, risk events, and near misses to identify root causes, control gaps, and systemic themes, providing actionable insights to prevent recurrence and proactive identification of risk.
* Apply data, scenario analysis, and thematic reviews to highlight emerging risks, concentration areas, and interdependencies across business activities.


**Key Responsibilities**
* To be the source of reference within the Business Unit in facilitating and promoting the understanding of OR and compliance requirements.
* Lead and support implementation of OR initiatives for the Business Unit.
* Proactively communicate with the Business Head/ Head, BRM / Head CR BRM on operational risk issues. Escalate significant events to Business Head / Head, BRM/ Head, CR BRM as appropriate.
* Coordinate and consolidate operational risk and loss reporting of the unit for the reporting to the various forums.
* Design and implement control measures and monitoring plans for compliance and operational risk management. Ensure effectiveness of controls for compliance monitoring and risk management.
* Undertake and/or coordinate periodic business monitoring (self\-assessment) activities within the Business Unit and escalate findings and or breaches to Head, CR, BRM
* Ensure risks issues identified are resolved in an appropriate and timely manner.
* Assist Business Head, CR BRM in the implementation of OR framework or other relevant OR initiatives.
* Could act as the Unit Money Laundering Prevention Officer (UMLPO) or cooperate with the BMLPO to ensure appropriate internal controls and procedures for money laundering prevention are in place and functioning as intended. Where appropriate, assist in the investigation of financial crime risks.
* Identify gaps and arrange training on compliance and OR for staff.


**Risk Mitigation and Control Effectiveness**
* Partner with business and functional teams to support the design, implementation, and strengthening of risk mitigation actions and controls
* Provide challenge and guidance on control effectiveness (including design effectiveness, operating effectiveness and testing strategies), ensuring risks are managed within agreed appetite and aligned to business objectives
* Track remediation actions and risk treatment plans, supporting timely closure and sustainable outcomes


**Risk Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance**
* Support ongoing monitoring and reporting of key risks, issues, and control metrics.
* Prepare risk insights, dashboards, and materials that enable effective oversight, escalation, and informed governance discussions.
* Ensure risk management activities are conducted in line with internal policies, frameworks, and regulatory expectations, supporting audit, review and regulatory engagements as required
* Work closely with Second and Third lines of defence (e.g. Compliance, Internal Audit, Second Line Assurance) on effective coordination and delivery of risk assessments and assurance reviews.


**Risk Advisory \& Business Decision Support**
* Act as a trusted risk advisory partner to business stakeholders, providing timely, practical risk insights that inform decision making, execution priorities, and trade\-offs
* Translate risk assessments, emerging risk themes, and control considerations into clear, business relevant guidance that supports strategic and day\-to\-day decisions
* Support the business in understanding risk implications associated with new initiatives, products, process changes, or external developments


**Strategy**
* Should be able to understand and align to the bank’s strategy and should be able to ensure that controls put in place do not become bottleneck in achieving the goals.


**Business**
* The incumbent should understand the Banking Operations requirements and accordingly perform the duties under this role.


**Processes**
* The incumbent is required to review the Banking Operations processes, controls and their results for which the appointment is being done.


**People \& Talent**
* The incumbent should be able to manage, handhold, develop talent of his teammates. Identify training and development needs, provide congenial atmosphere for team to work efficiently


**Risk Management**
* Execution responsibility for identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating operational and reputational risks to the Group. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them


**Governance**
* Monitor and track Issues and Events
* Track actionable from Internal and external audits
* Ensure reporting timelines are adhered


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Business Head /Functional Head
* Business Risk Manager Head
* Responsible Persons
* CFCC Team
* Banking Operation and Lending Ops
* GBS Team
* FRM
* CDD Operations
* Product Team
* Functional Heads of Operational Risk \- OTCR
* Group Governance and BRM
* TPRM


**Other Responsibilities**
* Cross team collaboration and leadership skills – proactive engagement with Unit Head and all responsible persons in the Unit.
* Effectiveness of the control and monitoring of operational risk, compliance risk prevention at the Business Unit level.
* Satisfactory results on audit undertaken by Group Internal Audit, regulators and external auditors.
* Timely communication of changes to the regulatory environment and internal Policies from Legal \& Compliance and Operational Risk Management Group.
* Timely reporting and escalation of all operational risk exposures.
* Regulatory champion and process champion for Business.


**Skills And Experience**
* Risk Management
* Assurance and Governance
* MS office
* Analytics
* Digital
* People Management
* Stake Holder Management


**Qualifications**
* Minimum Graduate or Post Graduate with relevant experience in Banking Operations, Risk Management


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. description:
PayGlocal is a global payments company enabling seamless international commerce. Our innovative suite of solutions helps businesses manage cross\-border payments by addressing key aspects of global transactions\-— business operations, customer experience, and associated risks.

**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced and business\-oriented Senior Manager – Legal Counsel to lead legal, contractual, and governance matters while partnering with leadership to support business growth, ensure compliance, and mitigate risk. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in BFSI, FinTech, Payments, or SaaS, with expertise in commercial contracts, regulatory compliance, and corporate governance.
 



  





**What you’ll work on** 




  





**Legal Strategy \& Business Advisory** 



* Serve as the primary legal advisor to the CEO and senior leadership on strategic business initiatives.

* Partner with Business, Product, Technology, Sales, Compliance, Finance, Procurement, and HR teams on legal matters.



**Commercial Contracts** 



* Lead end\-to\-end drafting, negotiation, review, and execution of commercial agreements, including:
* Customer Agreements
* Merchant Agreements
* Vendor \& Procurement Contracts
* SaaS Agreements
* Technology Licensing Agreements
* Partnership \& Alliance Agreements
* NDAs
* Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)

**Regulatory \& Compliance** 



* Interpret and advise on applicable laws and regulations governing financial services, payments, technology, and data privacy.
* Work closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements.
* Monitor regulatory developments and proactively assess their business impact.
* Support internal governance, policy creation, and compliance initiatives.



  





**Corporate Governance** 



* Support Board and management on governance matters.
* Oversee legal documentation relating to corporate restructuring, investments, strategic partnerships, and due diligence.
* Coordinate with external counsel on litigation, disputes, and regulatory matters.
* Maintain statutory records and oversee legal documentation.



  





**Risk Management** 



* Identify legal and commercial risks across business operations.
* Develop practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Support enterprise\-wide legal risk assessments and contract governance.
* Review new products, business models, and strategic initiatives from a legal perspective.



**Policy \& Process Development** 



* Develop and maintain legal policies, SOPs, contract management processes, and governance frameworks.
* Build scalable legal infrastructure aligned with the organization's growth plans.
* Conduct legal awareness sessions and training across business functions.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Manage relationships with external law firms, regulators, consultants, and industry bodies.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional leadership teams on strategic projects.
* Act as a trusted advisor across all business functions.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B.) from a recognized university.
* Master's Degree in Law (LL.M.) or Company Secretary qualification will be an added advantage.
* 8–12 years of post\-qualification experience.
* Prior experience as an in\-house legal counsel is strongly preferred.
* Experience in BFSI, FinTech, Payments, Banking, NBFC, Financial Services, or SaaS organizations is mandatory.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Extensive experience in commercial contracting and negotiations.
* Strong understanding of financial services and technology regulations.
* Experience in procurement, sourcing, vendor management, and contract lifecycle management.
* Expertise in drafting, vetting, redlining, and negotiating complex commercial agreements.
* Corporate governance and regulatory compliance experience.
* Due diligence, legal research, and risk assessment capabilities.
* Experience supporting strategic partnerships, investments, and business expansion initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and negotiation abilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* 4\-8 years of corporate experience in contracting, contract negotiations and building corporate legal infrastructure.
* Exposure to RBI regulations, payment ecosystems, digital platforms, data privacy, and technology contracting.
* Experience working with cross\-border transactions and international commercial agreements.
* Experience supporting fundraising, M\&A, strategic alliances, and corporate transactions.



  





 📌 Preferred Background: Candidates with experience in fintech, payments, payment gateways, payment aggregators, acquiring businesses, neobanks, cross\-border payments, or related organizations will be highly valued and can bring immediate impact to the role. 🚀
