title: Consultant - LBA
description:
The Consultant LBA for Wolters Kluwer will be responsible for performing Legal Bill Analysis (LBA) in the Legal Bill Analysis Center of Excellence (“LBACOE”).
   

  

 The Consultant LBA will be responsible for the prompt, accurate and efficient auditing of electronically submitted legal fee and expense invoices submitted by law firms and vendors of our clients. The candidate will be responsible for making adjustments to invoice line\-item entries, where those line item entries violate provisions of the relevant billing guidelines, and documenting the justification for such adjustments.
   

  

 The Consultant LBA will provide guidance to business unit partners regarding issues or opportunities within the LBA process.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Efficiently and accurately review legal invoice entries.
* Receive legal bill assignments from the Operations Support Specialist and/or work the intake queue for self\-assignments.
* Verify compliance with legal billing guidelines by law firms and vendors submitting invoices.
* Verify the accuracy of the UTBMS task codes (Fee, Activity and Expense codes) applied to invoice line items.
* Document reasons for any adjustments made to invoice line items, identifying the billing guideline violated and the rationale for the amount adjusted.
* Forward the audited legal bill through the review chain as required.
* Communicate and calibrate with Legal Invoice Analyst and Quality Assurance Analyst team members. Provide feedback to management on additional calibration opportunities.
* Demonstrated superior ability to review, analyze and evaluate legal fee and cost/expense invoice entries and to exercise discretion and sound judgment when making audit and adjustment decisions.
* Advanced understanding of legal terminology and claims legal situations required.
* When directed by management, support QA Analysts in addressing requests for reconsideration of adjusted amounts submitted by law firms.
* When directed by management, support QA Analysts in conducting the quality assurance review of invoices audited by Legal Invoice Analyst I \& II peers, while utilizing SME knowledge in specialized legal practice areas.
* Conduct periodic audit and data analysis to support management in collecting performance metrics for internal use and use with clients and law firms.
* Analyze and condense clients’ legal service agreements to produce effective operational tools, meeting and in some cases exceeding customer expectations.
* When directed by management, assist with the creation and updating of various team and department wide standard operating procedures.
* Participate in the training and mentoring of new Legal Invoice Analysts via informal and formal mentorship and training initiatives, both for new client roll outs and for back\-filling vacancies on existing client teams.
* Liaise with and provide periodic feedback to CIOX Artificial Intelligence Decision Science team on functionality and improvement of machine learning end\-user experience and accuracy.
* Self\-motivated with an ability to work independently and with very limited supervision after training.
* Excellent computer skills with the ability to learn the electronic legal bill submission and auditing software.
* Sound command of the English language\-\- grammar, syntax and style \-\- including an understanding of the conventions of punctuation and capitalization.
* Excellent spelling and proofreading skills.
* Effective communication skills \- ability to obtain information from others and deliver information to others orally and in written form.
* Organizational skills, including the ability to organize work in an orderly fashion conducive to the prompt, efficient review of an appropriate number of legal invoices in a given day or time period.
* Familiarity with common business math and possess appropriate business telephone skills.
* Ability to carry out detailed written or verbal instructions; ability to respond to requests effectively and efficiently.


**Job Qualifications**
**Education**
 Minimum: Paralegal Certification or equivalent work experience. Bachelor’s Degree in legal related discipline and/or equivalent work experience either in\-house or with a third\-party legal invoice auditing company strongly preferred. Advanced degree a plus.
   

  

 Experience, Knowledge and Tools
   

  

 Minimum Experience: 3 \- 5 years of experience in a legal services or legal bill auditing environment, including:
   

  

* Extensive experience with legal billing processes.
* Firm understanding of the federal and/or state rules of civil procedure.
* Prior legal bill review experience required.
* Experience with one or more practice areas in a legal billing or legal services setting, including but not limited to; insurance, civil litigation, intellectual property, corporate, and banking.


**Required Competencies:**
* Communications: Strong arbitration and organizational skills are critical to being successful in this role. Strong communications skills and the ability to organize and motivate team members in a matrix environment are essential.
* Team Work: Must work collaboratively with people within FCOE and throughout the entire WK organization, while providing constructive feedback to LBACOE leadership.
* Problem Solving: Capable of independent thinking and rendering sound decisions. Astute at identifying and engaging the necessary resources to help in decision making. Takes quick actions to identify and resolve the cause of any problem. Proactive in nature.
* Leadership: Exhibits individual control over day to day responsibilities as well as the ability to work collaboratively with other BUs to produce results.
* Planning and Organizing: Must be able to implement plans with the purpose of achieving short and long term goals. Must be able to prioritize in order to accomplish these goals in a given time period.
* Technology: Has the ability to partner with experts in the technology field to identify technology gaps and requirements necessary to develop position and impactful solutions.
* Learning: Ability to acquire new or modify existing knowledge to support a changing market place and workforce. Can demonstrate a capability to learn by study, experience, or instruction.
* Initiative and Enterprise: Is self\-directed and has the ability to translate ideas into action and get things done.
* Critical Thinking: Able to firmly understand the nuances of language and think critically about the meaning behind cryptic language and legal jargon.


**Tools:**
* Microsoft Office Suite ( Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)


 Our Interview Practices
   

  

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

* Responsive and adaptable to complex business challenges.
* Clear written and verbal communication

* 10\+ years of relevant experience in public policy, regulatory affairs, legal/compliance, risk management or technology regulation roles.

* Exposure to third\-party risk, procurement or contracting implications for technology regulation is an advantage.
* Strong drafting, research, communication and Microsoft Office skills.


**What We Look For**
* Someone who wants to grow into a Policy Lead Support role at EY and develop future\-focused skills in AI regulation, public policy and responsible innovation.
* A professional who can combine regulatory judgment with practical, adoptable guidance and collaborative stakeholder engagement.
* A passion to learn and contribute to the responsible and ethical procurement, development, deployment and use of AI and emerging technologies across EY.


**What We Offer**

title: Manager, Resposible AI, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work \- guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 You will be joining a newly formed Global AI \& Knowledge Organization (GAIKO) led by a Chief AI \& Knowledge Officer who is moving fast. The team is global, still being staffed, and operating with urgency. The broader team includes a product \& tech pillar, change management, KM services, operations and value \& governance.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* AI Governance \& Policy
* Working in partnership with the GAIKO \+ IT\+ Risk \+ InfoSec and with support of the AI Operating Committee (AIOC), help design and operationalize the firm's global Responsible AI framework, including policies, standards, intake processes, use case approvals, and risk escalation procedures.
* Define the firm’s end\-to\-end pathway for creating and deploying AI — who may build, in which environments (including sandbox standards for prototyping and experimentation), what data controls apply at each stage, and the gates, criteria, and approval forums required to move work from internal experimentation to client\-facing deployment — integrating with, rather than duplicating, existing technology risk review forums.\[C1\.1]
* Provide RAI assessments of proposed AI tools and partnerships, evaluating data residency, confidentiality, bias, and compliance risk. This includes independently supporting the evaluation of vendors’ technical architecture and data\-handling claims, in partnership with Information Security.
* Co\-own and maintain, with GSO and other designated stakeholders, \[JB2\.1]\[C2\.2]the firm's AI Responsible Use guidelines, updating them as the regulatory landscape evolves across key jurisdictions (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, India DPDP Act, and others).
* Define the RAI function's charter, roadmap, and KPIs in collaboration with the other relevant stakeholders; build the operating model for how RAI integrates with risk, delivery, legal, compliance, and IT security teams globally.
* Serve as a firm\-wide subject matter expert on AI governance, policy, and responsible use strategy.
* Ethics \& Bias Review
* Design and lead a repeatable pre\-deployment ethics review process for AI models and tools, including fairness audits, bias testing, impact assessments, documentation standards, escalation paths, and sign\-off criteria.
* Build and strengthen client AI case review processes ensuring that AI used in client engagements meets appropriate standards for transparency, bias, accuracy, and data handling before delivery.
* Build playbooks and toolkits that embed responsible AI principles into project delivery lifecycles across all practice areas and geographies.
* Partner closely with the Change Management function to weave RAI messaging into the firm's broader AI adoption and culture change agenda, making responsible use a visible, positive part of the firm's AI transformation, not a compliance afterthought.
* AI Risk \& Audit
* Define and manage a global AI risk taxonomy and register; assess risk across the full AI lifecycle (data sourcing, model development, deployment, monitoring, and decommissioning).
* Establish audit and monitoring mechanisms for production AI systems, including tracking for model drift, performance degradation, data handling violations, and regulatory compliance gaps.
* Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and IT Security to ensure all AI deployments meet applicable data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions.
* Serve as the RAI technical counterpart to Information Security across all AI work including vendor tools, internally built solutions, agentic workflows, and engagement\-team prototypes, and jointly evaluating data handling, controls, security architecture, and residency.
* Prepare and deliver executive\-level risk reporting on the firm's AI risk posture for the AIOC and, where required, for escalation to the AI Board or client audiences.


**Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of total experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI governance, responsible AI, technology risk, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience building a governance framework, risk program, or compliance function. Prior experience standing up a new function or practice is strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on technical experience assessing AI/ML systems: data flows and pipelines, model development lifecycles, API and integration architecture (including agentic patterns and MCP\-style integrations), cloud data residency and security controls, and common bias and fairness methodologies.
* Ability to independently evaluate a vendor’s technical and data\-handling claims and partner credibly with information security teams on assessments — challenging technical evidence, not only summarizing it.
* Career background in ML engineering, data engineering, security/GRC engineering, or technology risk with demonstrable technical depth. Candidates whose experience is exclusively policy or legal are unlikely to meet the technical bar for this role.
* Solid command of key regulatory and standards frameworks relevant to a global consulting firm: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, and India's DPDP Act.
* Ability to operate effectively across geographies and time zones; comfortable collaborating with a primarily USbased leadership team from an India\-based position.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex risk and governance concepts for both technical practitioners and C\-suite audiences.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed, fast\-paced professional services environment.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Assistant Manager-RMS Personal Independence-GMS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Career Family:** 
 Risk Management Services
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Supervising Associate/Assistant Manager
   

  

 This role requires the candidate to build and demonstrate an in\-depth technical knowledge of personal independence processes which are developed globally in accordance with the EY Global (EYG) Independence policies aimed towards safeguarding EY as an Independent auditor. These processes are standardized in nature and are performed by the RMS teams on behalf of EY engagement teams. The candidate will be responsible for coaching mentoring and supervising a team of about 15\-25 members on technical matters and should be able to handle and resolve their queries. The role also involves liaising with Global Independence process owners and a variety of stakeholders and end users across countries and geographies. The candidate is also expected to contribute the GDS wide priorities and initiatives and help in building a better working world for our EY professionals and team members.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Centre of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.
   

  

 This role will be part of the largest sub\-service function, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting EY professionals to maintain auditor objectivity by identifying and mitigating any potential conflicts of interest that could compromise an auditor's independence.
   

  

 RMS Independence team is currently 950\+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centres: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.
   

  

 The role offers opportunities to work in a dynamic, growth\-focused environment, with a special emphasis on protecting EY’s reputation as an independent auditor, by providing support to EY Professionals, Global \& Regional stakeholders on Personal Independence matters. It also involves close collaboration with global \& regional teams to strengthen the compliance framework and foster a mindset of continuous improvement and client enablement. The role also involves liaising with Global Independence process owners and a variety of stakeholders and end users across countries and geographies. The candidate is also expected to contribute the GDS wide priorities and initiatives and help in building a better working world for our EY professionals and team members.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 An Assistant Manager in the RMS Independence GMS team, will lead 5\-15 high performing individuals, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment. Your role involves working closely with EY professionals as well as Global and Regional stakeholders to strengthen the personal independence compliance framework, spearheading continuous improvement at process level. By effectively managing your team, engaging with stakeholders, and optimizing the processes, you will contribute significantly to EY's success. Other responsibilities include conducting quality reviews, analyzing issues, and producing well\-documented deliverables, as the work product for these individuals is subject to review and scrutiny by external regulators.
   

  

**Technical expertise**
* Develop \& maintain subject matter expertise in personal independence processes and policies, thereby enabling EY professionals to uphold their Independence compliance requirements.
* Stay updated on relevant regulatory policies like EYG and local country policies and industry best practices related to potential investments conflicts of interest.
* Consistently drive team to deliver high\-quality project outcomes by thoroughly understanding EY Global \& Independence policies and adhering to best practices and standard operating procedures
* Identify \& implement process improvements to enhance efficiency \& the overall effectiveness of the Personal Independence process.
* Be abreast of emerging trends and regulatory changes and effectively communicate these developments to Independence team members.
* Conduct thorough secondary research using a wide range of internal and external databases to support personal independence monitoring processes.
* Effectively facilitate and implement process \& policy updates, ensuring comprehensive knowledge sharing sessions are conducted.
* Establish credibility by consistently providing deep insights and technical expertise, actively engaging in strategic discussions with stakeholders.
* Continuously develop and refine technical knowledge in Independence processes to become a recognized subject matter expert within the team.
* Lead process trainings for team members to ensure consistent understanding and application of EY Global \& Personal Independence policies.
* Understand and strive to meet or exceed individual and team KPIs for the role.
* Effectively address \& resolve service delivery issues / escalations using tools like RCA (Root cause analysis) and CAPA (Corrective and preventive actions)
* Conduct reviews \& second level sample audits for reviewers in the team to ensure strong quality assurance model is maintained.


**Client/Stakeholder Management**
* Maintain regular and proactive communication with stakeholders to keep them informed about project progress, potential issues and any changes in timelines or scope.
* Actively engage with global and regional Independence stakeholders to implement any process changes, enhancements and improvement to ensure their expectations are met
* Develop effective conflict resolution and escalation management strategies to address and resolve any issues or escalations promptly and professionally.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to client management to ensure high standards of service delivery.
* Act as a point of contact between EY Professionals, Global/Regional stakeholders, members of other Independence competencies, and relevant GDS functions to effectively coordinate efforts for a project/request.


**Operations Management:**
* Oversee volume inflows, strategize resource allocation and ensure adherence to work\-flow protocol and tools.
* Engage in reporting activities to support internal and external stakeholder’s requirements.
* Establish and monitor the team's key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Contribute to strategic projects/initiatives to drive success \& growth within Global EY landscape.


**People Management**
* Responsible for managing/leading a team of 5\-10 professionals, ensuring the highest quality of work through effective project management and adherence to delivery standards.
* Maintain open and transparent communication with team members to ensure clarity of expectations and foster a collaborative environment that encourages engagement and participation in decision\-making processes.
* Foster a culture of engagement by recognizing and rewarding team members' contributions, and encourage their professional development through coaching, mentoring, and recommending training to address skill gaps.
* Promote a healthy work\-life balance by encouraging flexible working arrangements and supporting initiatives aimed at team members' well\-being.
* Evaluate and manage team performance by setting clear goals, assessing against KPIs, and providing constructive feedback to enhance productivity and professional growth.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Act as first point of contact for guidance to the team and as well for the stakeholders.
* Lead and drive transformation initiatives on process improvements and client enablement to enhance efficiency and effectiveness for the team.
* Demonstrate strong problem solving and critical thinking abilities to navigate through complex situations.
* Must possess a client\- centric and enablement mindset which involves continuously seeking ways to improve service delivery.
* Uphold and drive the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and values.
* Must be adaptable and agile in dynamic situations, facilitating change management.
* Innovative mindset with proficiency in using current technologies and willingness to adapt to new digital tools to enhance efficiency.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Masters/post\-graduate degree (preferably in Finance) from a reputed institute.
* At least 7\-8 years of professional experience, out of which minimum 4 years’ experience should have:
+ Compliance or research functions in Big 4 or other professional service organizations
+ Managing reasonably mid\-size teams (5\-10 team members)
+ Experience in Risk Management/ Independence would be preferred

* Candidates with exposure of handing client interactions would be preferred
* Well\-developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication (both verbal and written) skills in English
* Working knowledge of type of financial instruments, deposit accounts, loans, insurance etc
* Experience in performing external research, data reconciliation and exposure to performing data analysis and interpretation of output.


**Technologies and Tools**
* Experience in MS Office (Outlook, MS Word, MS Excel, SharePoint etc)
* Project management and Business analytics tool like Power\-BI and experience in lean methodologies like Value stream mapping would be preferred.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, including generative AI, to maintain a competitive edge in tech\-driven solutions.
* Knowledge of Databases like Factiva, D\&B, Thomson Reuters etc would be preferred.


**What You Can Look For**
* A Team of people with business acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in face \-moving ecosystem.
* A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming. The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiencies to processes.
* Opportunities to work with Global Executive risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring compliance framework


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Specialist, Financial Operations
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Specialist, Financial Operations
 


  

  


**Role:** 
 This role aligns with industry titles such as Contract Analyst, Contract specialist, or Contract reviewer analyst (legal)
 


  

  


 Role Purpose
 


  

  


 The Specialist, Contract Operations is an experienced individual contributor responsible for the accurate, timely and controlled processing of complex contractual information across global businesses. The role combines hands\-on contract analysis and system expertise with quality assurance, issue resolution, stakeholder partnership, and technical guidance to colleagues. It supports consistent contract operations from agreement receipt and interpretation through data entry, approval, archival and downstream readiness.
 


  

  


**Role Value** 



  

  


 Protects contractual and financial data quality, strengthens operational controls, resolves complex processing issues, and enables reliable royalty and rights administration.
 


  

  


**Key Accountabilities** 
**1\.** 
**Contract Analysis and Processing** 



  

  
* Review, interpret and process executed agreements, amendments and supporting documentation, including complex commercial, rights and royalty terms.
  

  
* Validate contract and financial data before approval, ensuring that information entered by colleagues is complete, accurate and aligned with the underlying agreement.
  

  
* Apply sound judgement to identify ambiguous, conflicting or adverse clauses and route matters to the appropriate business, legal, portfolio or operational stakeholder for resolution.
  

  
* Ensure contract records and supporting documents are accurately indexed, archived and readily retrievable.
  


  


**2\.** 
**Quality Assurance, Controls and Service Delivery** 



  

  
* Perform quality checks and approvals in line with documented procedures, delegated authority and segregation\-of\-duties requirements.
  

  
* Monitor assigned work against service levels, turnaround expectations and operational priorities, taking timely action where delivery or data quality is at risk.
  

  
* Comply with standard operating procedures, control requirements, data retention standards and privacy obligations.
  

  
* Identify control gaps, recurring errors and operational risks, document findings and recommend practical corrective or preventive actions.
  


  


**3\.** 
**Data Integrity and Systems Expertise** 



  

  
* Maintain accurate, complete and dashboard\-ready contract data across relevant operational regions and systems.
  

  
* Use contract and rights management platforms effectively, applying strong knowledge of system dependencies and downstream impacts.
  

  
* Support data remediation, reconciliations, system testing and process changes where contract expertise is required.
  

  
* Maintain auditable trackers and records that provide clear status, ownership and evidence of completion.
  


  


**4\.** 
**Complex Query Resolution** 



  

  
* Own complex contract\-processing queries through to resolution, completing appropriate investigation and maintaining a clear audit trail.
  

  
* Provide accurate and timely guidance to Contract Operations, Portfolio, Rights, Royalties, Finance, Technology and other relevant stakeholders.
  

  
* Escalate material contractual, control or delivery risks with clear facts, impact assessment, options and recommended next steps.
  


  


**5\.** 
**Technical Leadership and Continuous Improvement** 



  

  
* Act as a subject\-matter resource for contract interpretation, processing standards, controls and systems within the Contract Processing Hub.
  

  
* Coach and support colleagues through knowledge sharing, peer review and practical guidance, without direct people\-management accountability.
  

  
* Contribute to the maintenance of procedures, training materials, checklists and control documentation.
  

  
* Use root\-cause analysis and operational insight to simplify processes, reduce avoidable rework and improve quality, consistency and stakeholder experience.
  

  
* Support automation and transformation initiatives by translating contract requirements into clear business rules, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  


  


**6** 
**. Stakeholder Partnership** 



  

  
* Build effective working relationships across global and regional teams, communicating complex issues in a clear, concise and commercially aware manner.
  

  
* Influence outcomes within agreed authority, balancing contractual accuracy, control requirements, service delivery and business needs.
  

  
* Participate in operational reviews and cross\-functional forums, providing evidence\-based updates and following actions through to closure.
  


  


**Decision\-Making and Scope** 



  

  
* Works independently within established policies, procedures, controls and delegated authority.
  

  
* Handles varied and complex work where solutions require analysis, interpretation and the application of specialist knowledge.
  

  
* Makes recommendations on contract treatment, operational risk and process improvement, escalating matters that require legal, commercial or policy decisions.
  

  
* Operates across multiple global business areas and adapts priorities in response to changing volumes, deadlines and stakeholder requirements.
  


  


**Experience and Qualifications** 



  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Legal Studies, Commerce or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  

  
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract administration, rights and royalties, finance operations, legal operations or a comparable processing environment.
  

  
* Demonstrated experience reviewing complex agreements, maintaining high\-quality data and working within structured service and control frameworks.
  

  
* Experience supporting global stakeholders and resolving issues across functional or regional boundaries.
  


  


**Core Capabilities** 



  

  


**Capability** 



  

  


**Expected application at IC20** 



  

  


**Contract expertise** 



  

  


 Interprets complex contract terms accurately and connects them to operational and system requirements.
 


  

  


**Analytical judgement** 



  

  


 Assesses incomplete or conflicting information, identifies risk and recommends a reasoned course of action.
 


  

  


**Quality and control mindset** 



  

  


 Applies controls consistently, maintains evidence and addresses root causes rather than symptoms.
 


  

  


**Ownership and delivery** 



  

  


 Prioritises effectively, follows issues through to closure and meets agreed service expectations.
 


  

  


**Stakeholder influence** 



  

  


 Explains complex matters clearly, challenges constructively and builds alignment across teams.
 


  

  


**Technical leadership** 



  

  


 Shares expertise, supports capability building and provides reliable guidance without formal line\-management responsibility.
 


  

  


**Continuous improvement** 



  

  


 Identifies improvement opportunities and contributes contract expertise to process, technology and automation changes.
 


  

  


**Adaptability** 



  

  


 Responds effectively to changing requirements, volumes, systems and global business priorities.
 


  

  


**Systems and tools** 



  

  


 Working knowledge of relevant contract, rights, royalty and workflow tools, which may include IPM, Oracle, Alfresco, Microsoft 365, JIRA and Smartsheet. The role must be able to learn and apply additional platforms used by the global Contract Processing Hub.
 


  

  


**Measures of Success** 



  

  
* Accurate and complete contract data with strong first\-time\-right quality.
  

  
* Timely delivery against agreed service levels and operational priorities.
  

  
* Effective resolution and escalation of complex queries and contractual risks.
  

  
* Consistent adherence to procedures, controls, privacy and record\-retention requirements.
  

  
* Reduced repeat errors and rework through root\-cause action and knowledge sharing.
  

  
* Positive stakeholder experience and effective contribution to change initiatives.

description:
**About Medhavi Skills University**
Medhavi Skills University (MSU) is a government\-notified private State Skills University established under a State Act in Sikkim in 2021, dedicated to advancing quality skill\-integrated higher education and entrepreneurship. Recognised by the UGC and aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, MSU is a pioneer in converging the skilling ecosystem with formal higher education through its “Industry as Campus” model. The University collaborates extensively with industries and Skill Development Institutes to deliver work\-integrated degree programs embedding structured on\-the\-job training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognised Awarding Body under NCVET, empanelled with DGT, and serves as an anchor university partner with NSDC and the PMU of NSDC International\-collectively reinforcing its demand\-driven, industry\-co\-led academic framework. Ranked 4th among India’s Top Skill Universities in the Outlook ICARE Rankings 2025 and supported by over 11 defence partnerships along with multiple national recognitions, MSU stands among India’s leading skill\-integrated higher education institutions.  

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in **About Medhavi Group:**
Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill\-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry\-integrated higher education. With a strong outcome\-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000\+active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry\-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry\-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on\-the\-job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry\-ready skills. Through deep, outcome\-driven partnerships with over 300\+ leading industry and skill partners across 26\+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others\- WISE enables learners to acquire role\- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand\-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.  

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise **Role Overview:**
The Executive – Legal \& Regulatory Affairs will support the Legal Department in contract drafting and review, legal research, regulatory compliance, documentation, legal correspondence and day\-to\-day legal advisory requirements of the organisation. The role will involve coordination with internal
business teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely closure of legal and contractual matters while managing associated legal and regulatory risks. **Key Responsibilities:** **A. Contract Drafting \& Review*** Draft, review and revise various commercial and legal documents, including MoUs, agreements,

**B. Legal Research \& Advisory Support*** Conduct legal research on applicable laws, rules, regulations, notifications, circulars and judicial decisions.

**D. Legal Notices \& Dispute Support*** Assist in drafting legal notices, replies, representations, demand letters and other legal correspondence.
* Support the Legal Department in managing disputes, claims and litigation\-related matters.
* Coordinate with external advocates/counsels and maintain records of ongoing legal matters.
* Assist in preparing documents and information required for legal proceedings.

**E. Contract Management \& Documentation*** Maintain an organised repository of executed and pending agreements.

* Ensure that legal matters are appropriately documented and escalated where required.
* Assist in developing internal legal processes, SOPs, checklists and compliance mechanisms.

**G. General Legal Support*** Assist in due diligence exercises, vendor/partner onboarding and background documentation.
* Support the preparation of management reports.
* Undertake other legal and regulatory assignments as may be allocated by the reporting manager.

 **Qualifications \& Skills Required:*** LL.B. / B.A. LL.B. / B.B.A. LL.B. from a recognised institution.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in a corporate legal department, law firm or in\-house legal function.

* Experience in the education, skilling, training, technology or services sector will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of basic principles of contract law and commercial agreements.
* Good legal drafting and reviewing skills.
* Strong legal research and analytical abilities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to identify contractual and regulatory risks.

 **What We Offer*** Opportunity to architect and scale a future\-focused, industry\-integrated higher education ecosystem.

* Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
* A collaborative, mission\-driven environment.
* The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at careers@msu.edu.in at earliest possible.

title: Technology Attorney
description:
**About The Company**
 On a mission to give people limitless access to the vast world of Entertainment, Cineverse’s advanced, proprietary technology drives the distribution of over 70,000 premium films, series, and podcasts. From providing a complete streaming solution to some of the world’s most recognizable brands to super\-serving our network of fan channels – from direct ad sales partnerships to premium global content – we offer more of the stories that move us and technology that moves us forward. Industry leaders with a history of innovation, Cineverse is powering the future of Entertainment.
   

  

 Job Title: Technology Attorney
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Technology Attorney to manage legal and business matters related to technology services, software licensing, SaaS agreements, and commercial transactions for the US market while working in Kolkata, India. This role will be instrumental in negotiating and drafting technology agreements, including SaaS subscriptions, master service agreements, software licensing arrangements, professional services agreements, vendor contracts, advertising technology agreements, film post\-editing and post\-production services agreements, and technology partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in technology law, commercial transactions, and data privacy regulations.
   

  

 The attorney will work cross\-functionally across the organization, providing legal guidance and ensuring compliance while supporting commercial transactions, technology operations, and deal flows. This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of technology services, advertising technology, media production services, and software business strategies in an evolving digital landscape.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Draft, review, and negotiate technology\-related agreements, including SaaS agreements, Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), software licensing agreements, professional services agreements, vendor agreements, partnership agreements, advertising technology agreements, film post\-editing and post\-production services agreements, and other commercial contracts for US and global markets.
* Provide strategic legal counsel on business activities, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and risk management strategies.
* Structure and execute commercial transactions, manage deal flows, and facilitate contract execution.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including technology, product, finance, procurement, security, compliance, and operations, to ensure smooth and legally sound business operations.
* Advise on legal aspects of software licensing, technology services, SaaS offerings, cloud\-based solutions, advertising technology services, media production services, and commercial agreements.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy laws and regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable global data protection requirements.
* Identify and mitigate legal risks while supporting business initiatives, product development, customer engagements, and growth strategies.
* Maintain daily email and chat communication with the Chief Legal Officer in the USA, along with external counsel, customers, vendors, and regulatory bodies as needed.
* Participate in daily, weekly, and monthly calls with internal and external stakeholders during US business hours.


**Qualifications**
* B. or equivalent legal degree with strong experience in technology law, commercial contracting, SaaS agreements, software licensing, advertising technology agreements, film post\-production/post\-editing agreements, or a similar technology\-focused industry.
* 3\+ years of experience in legal drafting, negotiations, software licensing, advertising technology agreements, technology transactions, trademarks, and commercial agreements and business affairs within the technology, software, SaaS, IT services, advertising technology, media production, or related industries.
* Expertise in handling complex commercial transactions, structuring deals, and negotiating technology\-focused agreements.
* Strong knowledge of global data privacy laws and regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable data protection frameworks.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and supporting contract negotiations, vendor management, procurement activities, and commercial deal execution.
* Excellent English communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a software company, SaaS organization, technology services firm, cloud services provider, advertising technology company, film or media production company, post\-production studio, or enterprise technology business.
* Familiarity with SaaS subscription agreements, cloud services agreements, vendor management, procurement contracts, and technology partnership arrangements as well as advertising technology and media services agreements.
* Proven ability to navigate evolving technology regulations, cybersecurity requirements, software licensing models, and industry trends.

title: Senior Analyst -I Kolkata
description:
**Job Description:**
**About AML RightSource**
 We are AML RightSource, the leading technology\-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
   

  

 Using a blend of highly trained anti\-financial crime professionals, cutting\-edge technology tools, and industry\-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
   

  

 We support clients in meeting day\-to\-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full\-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
   

  

**About The Position**
 A Senior Analyst I works with our clients (banks and non\-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing both quality control work related to the work of our Associate Analysts, and performing his/her own detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures. In short, you are on the front\-line of making decisions as to how to keep clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst I, you research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
   

  

 You may perform quality control activities, supervisory responsibility on occasion and be responsible for ad hoc communication with client. You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work, and you must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.
* Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures, escalating where appropriate for second level review· Ability to perform quality control work as needed.

title: Associate Manager - Regulatory and Commercial
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Power Limited (APL):** 
 Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India.We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This role is responsible for supporting the team by executing essential regulatory tasks, initiating compliance procedures, and maintaining effective communication both internally and externally. This role is pivotal role for ensuring smooth operation within the regulatory framework of the power.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Lead \- Regulatory (ERCG)**
**Policy Advocacy And Regulatory Compliance**
 Assist in monitoring policy developments and regulatory changes that may impact the organization's operations.
   

  

 Support efforts to ensure that the organization's practices align with current regulations and legislative requirements.
   

  

 Help gather information and contribute to internal discussions on how sector regulations and government interventions may affect the organization.
   

  

 Aid in the preparation of compliance documentation and reports, ensuring that all business activities adhere to regulatory standards.
   

  

 Stay up\-to\-date with changes in legislation and regulatory requirements, and assist in communicating these changes to relevant departments within the organization.
   

  

**Due Diligence And Research**
 Conduct due diligence for mergers and acquisitions (M\&A) from a regulatory perspective, preparing notes and presentations for the Business Development (BD) team.
   

  

 Perform regulatory research by reviewing updates from regulatory websites such as the Ministry of Power (MOP) to identify new draft notifications, regulations, or policies.
   

  

 Support compliance efforts by contributing to the development and maintenance of internal controls and procedures.
   

  

**Litigation Coordination And Petition Drafting**
 Coordinate with advocates, briefing them on regulatory litigation matters, and ensure timely submission of petitions.
   

  

 Brief legal firms on specific cases and assist with in\-house drafting of petitions by compiling information and ensuring logical presentation.
   

  

 If law firms are drafting petitions, provide a first draft or a comprehensive information bucket for their use.
   

  

 Manage administrative tasks related to litigation, such as obtaining certified copies of legal documents.
   

  

**Internal MIS And Reporting**
 Prepare internal MIS reports listing cases pending before the court, categorizing them by criticality, forum, and plant, and disseminate to promoters.
   

  

 Compile monthly reports detailing judgments passed, new guidelines from state or central regulators, and other relevant updates.
   

  

 Conduct weekly review meetings to discuss regulatory cases and develop strategies based on direction from the Head/ Chief of Energy Regulatory and Commercial group (ERCG).
   

  

 Monitor the progression of regulatory cases, keeping detailed records of filings, hearings, and judgments.
   

  

 Assist in the preparation and organization of legal documents required for regulatory submissions and correspondence.
   

  

**Public Hearings And Petition Filing**
 Attend public hearings, both online and in\-person, and provide briefings on the proceedings.
   

  

 File petitions after obtaining approval from the team lead and Head/ Chief of ERCG, ensuring adherence to internal protocols.
   

  

**Payment Processing**
 Generate a Note in SAP (NIS) checklist and apply for filing fees for petitions related to disputes and claims.
   

  

 Coordinate with the Group Data Governance and Control (GDGC) team for system uploads and facilitate the review process with the Adani Business Excellence team before final payment by the finance team.
   

  

 Handle different types of statutory or court fee payments required by various regulatory bodies, whether online or via challan.
   

  

 Obtain payment certificates and provide them to the team lead for record\-keeping and further action.
   

  

**Administrative Assistance And Process Enhancement**
 Execute administrative tasks related to legal filings, such as managing Vakalatnamas and ensuring the availability of certified copies for proceedings.
   

  

 Support the Lead in organizing and managing regulatory files and references for efficient access and review.
   

  

 Identify opportunities for streamlining regulatory processes and propose improvements to current systems.
   

  

 Participate in the implementation of technological solutions that enhance the efficiency and accuracy of regulatory monitoring and reporting .
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 GDGC
   

  

 ABEX Team
   

  

 Finance team
   

  

 Legal team
   

  

 Commercial team
   

  

 Regulatory team for transmission, thermal, AEML team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Advocates/lawyers
   

  

 Regulatory authorities/governmental agencies
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 B.E./ B.Tech/ Masters ( Power Management, related field), Additional Certifications in regulatory affairs or compliance preferred
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 Minimum 5 years of experience in regulatory compliance, preferably in power and transmission or related field.
   

  

**Preferred Industry**
 Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to power and transmission industry, with an understanding of regulatory challenges and compliance mechanisms.

title: US Tax Manager - International Tax & Advisory, K C Mehta & Co LLP · Ahmedabad · Full-time
description:
**About us** 




 K C Mehta \& Co LLP is a firm of chartered accountants founded in 1958, with offices across India and in the UAE. We advise Indian and multinational groups on tax, transfer pricing, transactions, assurance and business advisory. Our international practice serves clients across the India–US corridor: Indian groups investing in the US, US businesses with operations in India, and US\-resident individuals with assets and income in India.
 



  





**The role** 




 We are looking for a US Tax Manager to lead our US tax work. This is an advisory role first. We want someone who can identify the issue, research it, write the memo, explain the answer to a client's CFO, and stand behind the recommendation, while also overseeing the compliance that follows from it. You will work closely with the partners, our transfer pricing and transactions teams, and clients in the US.
 



  





**Who will you report to** 




 Dhaval Trivedi, Partner, Corporate \& International Tax
 



  





**What you will do** 




**Advisory** 



* Advising Indian groups on US expansion, including choice of entity, check\-the\-box elections, capitalization and financing, effectively connected income exposure, and profit repatriation.
* Advising US groups with Indian / overseas operations (other jurisdictions) on Subpart F, GILTI (NCTI), FDII (FDDEI), foreign tax credits and BEAT, including the effect of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act changes on existing structures.
* Applying the India–US tax treaty and other tax treaties that US has with various countries to live fact patterns, including permanent establishment, withholding rates, limitation on benefits and treaty\-based return positions.
* Supporting cross\-border acquisitions, restructurings, flips and reverse flips with tax due diligence and structuring advice, working with our transactions team.
* Working with our transfer pricing team on intercompany arrangements and their effect on US tax positions.
* Advising US\-resident individuals and families on Indian assets and income, including foreign information reporting, PFIC exposure and cross\-border estate and gift planning.



  





**Compliance and review** 



* Reviewing corporate, partnership and individual returns with international content, including Forms 1120, 1120\-F, 1065, 1040, 5471, 5472, 8858, 8865, 8621, 1116, 1118, 8938, 3520, 3520\-A and FBAR.
* Reviewing withholding compliance, including Forms 1042 and 1042\-S and FIRPTA.
* Supporting clients through IRS notices and examinations.



  





**Engagement leadership** 



* Running engagements day to day, including scoping, timelines, deadline tracking, budgets and client communication across time zones.
* Reviewing the work of the team and building a US tax bench through training and coaching.
* Keeping clean engagement files, including engagement letters, contemporaneous documentation, taxpayer consents and data\-security procedures for US taxpayer information.



  





**Practice building** 



* Contributing to proposals, client presentations, articles and webinars on US and cross\-border tax.
* Building relationships with US accounting firms, law firms and other referral sources.



  





**What you bring** 



* 4 to 6 years of US tax experience, of which at least 2 years in international tax, gained in a Big 4 or national firm, a US tax practice in India, or a tax advisory firm.
* A US CPA license or Enrolled Agent status. Candidates who are Chartered Accountants with the relevant US tax experience and are pursuing the CPA or EA will also be considered.
* A track record of advisory work, not only compliance: research memos you have written, structuring recommendations you have made, and client conversations you have led.
* Strong research skills using primary sources and standard US tax research platforms.
* Clear writing and the ability to turn technical analysis into a recommendation a client can act on.
* Willingness to work some hours overlapping with the US business day.



  





**An advantage, not a requirement:** 
 knowledge of Indian direct tax, FEMA or transfer pricing, and experience with India\-connected clients.

title: Compliance Officer
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today**
 At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.
   

  

 In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting\-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.
   

  

 While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3\. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!
   

  

**Inside CoinDCX’s Compliance Team**
 Our Compliance team ensures CoinDCX operates with integrity and within regulatory frameworks, navigating the complex world of blockchain with precision. We’re dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of compliance to protect our business and users. If you’re detail\-oriented and have a strong understanding of regulatory landscapes, join us in safeguarding the future of digital finance.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Compliance Officer (“CO”) will be responsible for establishing, implementing and independently overseeing the regulatory compliance framework for the Company’s Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker operations in GIFT IFSC. The CO will monitor adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars, directions and other regulatory requirements and provide independent compliance advice, monitoring and challenge to the business.
   

  

**You need to be a HODLer of these**
* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree/postgraduate diploma of at least one year in Finance, Law, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, Actuarial Science, FinTech, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics; or CFA / FRM; or such other relevant qualification as may be specified by IFSCA. Provided that minimum two years of experience in the financial services market. Experience in another field may be considered with at least two years of work experience in a compliance\-related role or function .
* Alternatively, a graduate degree in any discipline with at least five years of work experience in the financial services market, in accordance with applicable IFSCA requirements.
* A recognised Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) are also specifically eligible
* Relevant experience in capital markets compliance, securities/brokerage regulation, regulatory compliance, AML/CFT or financial\-services compliance is preferred.
* Strong understanding of IFSCA regulations, Broker\-Dealer requirements, regulatory reporting, client protection and compliance\-monitoring frameworks.
* Strong regulatory interpretation, analytical, monitoring and documentation skills.
* Ability to exercise independent judgement, challenge and escalation on regulatory and compliance matters.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills, including interaction with regulators, exchanges, auditors and senior management.
* High standards of integrity, independence and regulatory judgement.
* Must be based out of the IFSC, as required under applicable IFSCA regulations.
* Must complete certification course " Regulatory Framework for Capital Market Intermediaries in IFSC (ICSI) " as prescribed by IFSCA.


**You will be mining through these tasks**
* Establish, implement and maintain an effective regulatory compliance framework for the Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker activities and monitor ongoing compliance with the IFSCA (Capital Market Intermediaries) Regulations, applicable Broker\-Dealer requirements, exchange requirements and circulars and directions.
* Act as a key point of contact for IFSCA, recognised stock exchanges (India INX/ NSE IX) and other relevant authorities on compliance\-related matters, as applicable.
* Maintain a regulatory obligations and compliance calendar and oversee timely completion of regulatory filings, returns, disclosures, certifications and other periodic obligations.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the business products, processes, policies and control framework and ensure relevant policies, procedures and SOPs are updated accordingly.
* Oversee compliance with applicable requirements relating to client onboarding, KYC/CDD, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and record keeping, in coordination with designated AML personnel and relevant operational teams.

title: Owner
description:
**Company Description** 
 Freelance is an independently owned and operated business based in Rajarhat, focused on delivering tailored services to local clients and partners. The company structure is lean and flexible, allowing rapid decision\-making and close collaboration with stakeholders. As an owner\-led venture, Freelance emphasizes accountability, quality of service, and long\-term relationships. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, support business growth, and adapt to evolving client needs. The environment is dynamic and hands\-on, offering exposure to multiple aspects of running a business.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Owner role at Freelance is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Rajarhat, responsible for overseeing all aspects of business operations and growth. Day\-to\-day tasks include managing client relationships, supervising projects and service delivery, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The Owner will handle budgeting, basic accounting activities, and vendor coordination, while monitoring performance and identifying opportunities to expand services or reach new markets. This role also involves setting strategic goals, maintaining compliance with relevant regulations, and leading any team members or partners involved in the business. The position requires a hands\-on approach, with regular on\-site presence to address operational issues, support staff, and maintain strong community and client engagement.
   

**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated ability to manage day\-to\-day business operations, including planning, organizing, and overseeing service delivery.
* Experience in client relationship management and stakeholder communication, with strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Basic proficiency in financial management, such as budgeting, expense tracking, and coordinating with accountants or financial advisors.
* Comfort with handling administrative tasks, documentation, and compliance with local regulations and business requirements.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, the capacity to make informed decisions, and a proactive attitude toward business development.
* Ability to work on\-site full time in Rajarhat and maintain a consistent presence to support operations and customer interactions.
* Prior experience in running a small business, managing a team, or working in an entrepreneurial environment is beneficial.
* Relevant education or training in business, management, or a related field is an advantage but not strictly required if experience is substantial.

title: Site Operations Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**About the Role**

  

The Site Operations Lead is responsible for building and leading the Operations function for Haleon's new greenfield manufacturing facility in Indore. The role will provide operational leadership during design, commissioning, qualification, start\-up and early stabilization, and subsequently lead manufacturing operations to deliver safety, quality, service level, cost and people engagement objectives.  



  

The role will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HAPS, EHS and Project teams to establish operational systems, build workforce capability and ensure successful commissioning and ramp\-up of the manufacturing site.


The incumbent will drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, capability development, performance management and continuous improvement while creating a safe, compliant and high\-performing manufacturing culture.


Build a future\-ready Operations organization that delivers safe start\-up, reliable supply, competitive performance and sustainable growth.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own and deliver site performance across Safety, Quality, GMP Compliance, Cost, Service, Productivity, and People Development.
* This role joins the project at an early stage to ensure operational requirements are incorporated into the facility execution. It leads operations and technical teams through a vertical startup. Then owns performance of the people and system once the site is operational.
* Lead manufacturing and packaging operations, ensuring achievement of production, OEE, cost, waste, and service targets (ATS adherence to schedule and ATP adherence to planning).
* Drive a strong safety\-first and quality culture, ensuring compliance with EHS, GMP, regulatory, and data integrity requirements.
* Build, coach, and develop high\-performing teams through capability building, succession planning, and performance management.
* Accountable for manufacturing budgets, MCC / PCC conversion costs, labor productivity, and delivery of productivity commitments.
* Lead operational readiness, commissioning, qualification, validation, start\-up, and stabilization of manufacturing operations.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and technical teams to ensure reliable product supply and operational excellence.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks while ensuring sustainable business performance Complexity/Scope
* Integrate Haleon Operational Excellence strategies from inception by working closely with Site Director.
* Integrate industry 4\.0 capabilities
* Establish effective daily management systems (HAPS), performance reviews, visual management, and KPI governance.
Champion continuous improvement, loss elimination, problem\-solving, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives  
* 

  

**Qualification and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Science, Manufacturing, Operations or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM is desirable
* Overall 15\+ years of industrial experience in manufacturing sector.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food or another regulated manufacturing sector.
* Demonstrated experience leading Manufacturing and Packaging operations, production performance, workforce capability and cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience supporting a greenfield facility, major expansion, commissioning, qualification, validation, technology transfer or manufacturing start\-up is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of GMP, EHS, operational risk management, production planning, OEE, cost control and continuous improvement systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make risk\-based decisions and translate project milestones into operational readiness and sustainable performance.
Relevant certification or practical experience in Lean, Six Sigma, TPM or another recognized operational\-excellence system is desirable.  
* 

  

**Soft Skills**

* Strong people leadership capability to build, engage and hold a large frontline organization accountable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence Project, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain and senior leaders.
* Hands\-on, collaborative and decisive leadership style with strong execution and change\-management capability.
* Excellent oral, written and presentation skills, with clear communication from shop\-floor teams to senior leadership.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, risk\-based decision\-making and commercial awareness.
* High resilience, ownership and ability to deliver in a fast\-paced greenfield and start\-up environment.
Proficiency in MS Office and working knowledge of SAP, Power BI, OEE, problem solving and digital manufacturing performance systems.  
* 

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety, Quality \& Compliance – Waste/ Scrap%, CAPA Closure Effectiveness, Deviation Reduction, GMP / EHS Compliance Adherence, Safety Observation Closure %, Zero LTI.
* Operational Readiness \& Performance \- Commissioning and start\-up milestones, schedule adherence (ATS), OEE, throughput, right\-first time (RFT), Cost (PCC, MCC), Waste, Customer Service Level (% OTIF) and productivity.
* People \& Organization \- Workforce readiness, drive shop floor associate ownership, role qualification, engagement, leadership capability, succession strength and a sustainable ownership culture.
Unplanned Downtime (hrs./month),Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), AM / PM and maturity assessment and Haleon Operational Excellence pillar drive and maturity assessment.  
* 

**Job Posting End Date**

2026\-10\-22  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.
